```js
// Open BIM Studio - Step 1.5: Family Browser UI.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
const MARK = "openbim-step1.5:family-browser";

const stats = { created: 0, patched: 0, noop: 0, skipped: 0, warned: 0 };

function full(rel) { return path.join(root, rel); }
function exists(rel) { try { fs.accessSync(full(rel)); return true; } catch { return false; } }
function read(rel) { try { return fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8"); } catch { return null; } }
function ensureDir(rel) { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(full(rel)), { recursive: true }); }
function backup(rel) { if (exists(rel)) fs.copyFileSync(full(rel), full(rel) + ".bak-fbui-" + stamp); }
function write(rel, s) { ensureDir(rel); fs.writeFileSync(full(rel), s, "utf8"); }
function log(kind, name, note) {
  let tag;
  if (kind === "CREATE") { tag = "CREATE"; stats.created++; }
  else if (kind === "PATCH") { tag = "PATCH "; stats.patched++; }
  else if (kind === "NOOP") { tag = "NOOP  "; stats.noop++; }
  else if (kind === "WARN") { tag = "WARN  "; stats.warned++; }
  else { tag = "SKIP  "; stats.skipped++; }
  console.log("  [" + tag + "] " + name + (note ? "  -- " + note : ""));
}
function readNorm(rel) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8");
  const crlf = raw.indexOf("\r\n") >= 0;
  return { text: crlf ? raw.split("\r\n").join("\n") : raw, crlf };
}
function writeNorm(rel, text, crlf) {
  fs.writeFileSync(full(rel), crlf ? text.split("\n").join("\r\n") : text, "utf8");
}
function dumpContext(text, needle, radius) {
  const lines = text.split("\n");
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    if (lines[i].indexOf(needle) >= 0) {
      const a = Math.max(0, i - radius), b = Math.min(lines.length - 1, i + radius);
      console.log("    (diag) around line " + (i + 1) + ":");
      for (let j = a; j <= b; j++) console.log("    " + String(j + 1).padStart(5, " ") + " | " + lines[j]);
      return;
    }
  }
  console.log("    (diag) no line contains: " + JSON.stringify(needle));
}

// =============================================================================
// 1. src/features/family-browser.ts
// =============================================================================
const TS_PANEL = `// ${MARK}
// Family Browser - dockable panel surfacing the family system from Step 1.
//
// Layout:
//   +--------------------------------------------------+
//   |  Families                            [x] [+]      |
//   +--------------------------------------------------+

//   +------------------+-------------------------------+
//   |  status bar: counts + storage key                 |
//   +--------------------------------------------------+
//
// All actions are wired. Place sets the matching authoring tool. Step 2
// will replace the authoring tool path with a real family-driven mesh.

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { makeDockable, type DockHandle } from "./dockable";
import { setupFamilies, isFamilySystemReady } from "../modules/families";
import type { FamilyDefinition, FamilyType, FamilyService } from "../modules/families";

const PANEL_ID = "obs-family-browser";
const SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Panel shell
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
const panel = document.createElement("div");
panel.id = PANEL_ID;
panel.style.cssText =

  "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:10px;" +
  "box-shadow:0 16px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);" +
  "font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden;min-width:460px";
panel.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

const header = document.createElement("div");
header.style.cssText =
  "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 10px;" +
  "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);" +
  "background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);cursor:grab;user-select:none";

const title = document.createElement("div");
title.textContent = "Families";
title.style.cssText = "font-weight:700;flex:1;letter-spacing:.2px";

const newBtn = mkHeaderBtn("+ Family", "Duplicate the current family under a new name", () => onNewFamily());
const refreshBtn = mkHeaderBtn("\u21BB", "Reload from storage", () => reloadAll());
const closeBtn = mkHeaderBtn("\u2715", "Close", () => hideFamilyBrowser());

function mkHeaderBtn(label: string, tooltip: string, onclick: () => void): HTMLButtonElement {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.type = "button";
  b.textContent = label;
  b.title = tooltip;

    "cursor:pointer;font:11px system-ui";
  b.onmouseenter = () => { b.style.background = "var(--bg-hover,#232633)"; b.style.color = "var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0)"; };
  b.onmouseleave = () => { b.style.background = "transparent"; b.style.color = "var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5)"; };
  b.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onclick(); };
  return b;
}

// --- Toolbar ---------------------------------------------------------------
const toolbar = document.createElement("div");
toolbar.style.cssText =

  "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017)";

const searchInput = document.createElement("input");
searchInput.type = "text";
searchInput.placeholder = "Search families, types, IFC entity\u2026";
searchInput.style.cssText =

  "border-radius:5px;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:11.5px system-ui;outline:none";

categoryFilter.style.cssText =

toolbar.append(searchInput, categoryFilter);

// --- Body ------------------------------------------------------------------
const body = document.createElement("div");
body.style.cssText = "display:flex;flex:1;min-height:0;height:520px";

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// State
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
let dock: DockHandle | null = null;
let visible = false;
let selectedFamilyId: string | null = null;
let selectedTypeId: string | null = null;
let searchQuery = "";
let categoryValue = "all";

function svc(): FamilyService | null {
  const s = (ctx.features as any).family as FamilyService | undefined;
  return s ?? null;
}

function reloadAll(): void {
  const s = svc();
  if (!s) {
    statusBar.textContent = "family system not initialized";
    return;
  }
  const list = s.list();
  const categories = new Set<string>(["all"]);
  for (const f of list) categories.add(f.category);

  const prevFilter = categoryFilter.value;
  categoryFilter.innerHTML = Array.from(categories)
    .map((c) => "<option value=\"" + c + "\">" + (c === "all" ? "All categories" : c) + "</option>")
    .join("");
  categoryFilter.value = categories.has(prevFilter) ? prevFilter : "all";
  categoryValue = categoryFilter.value;

  if (!selectedFamilyId && list.length) selectedFamilyId = list[0].id;

  const totalTypes = list.reduce((n, f) => n + f.types.length, 0);
  statusBar.textContent = list.length + " families \u00B7 " + totalTypes + " types \u00B7 obs.families.v1";
  renderTree();
  renderDetail();
}

function filteredFamilies(): FamilyDefinition[] {
  const s = svc();
  if (!s) return [];
  const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
  return s.list().filter((f) => {
    if (categoryValue !== "all" && f.category !== categoryValue) return false;
    if (!q) return true;
    if (f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
    if (f.category.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
    if (f.ifcEntity.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
    for (const t of f.types) if (t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
    return false;
  });
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tree
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
function renderTree(): void {
  treePane.innerHTML = "";
  const list = filteredFamilies();
  if (!list.length) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.textContent = "No matching families.";
    empty.style.cssText = "padding:16px;color:#6b7280;font-size:11px;text-align:center";
    treePane.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }

  // Group families by category, in alphabetical order.
  const byCat = new Map<string, FamilyDefinition[]>();
  for (const f of list) {
    const bucket = byCat.get(f.category) ?? [];
    bucket.push(f);
    byCat.set(f.category, bucket);
  }
  const cats = Array.from(byCat.keys()).sort();

  for (const cat of cats) {
    const header = document.createElement("div");
    header.textContent = cat + "  (" + byCat.get(cat)!.length + ")";
    header.style.cssText =
      "padding:5px 8px;font:600 10px system-ui;letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;" +
      "color:#64748b;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);border-radius:4px;margin-top:4px";
    treePane.appendChild(header);

    for (const fam of byCat.get(cat)!) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      const active = fam.id === selectedFamilyId;
      row.style.cssText =
        "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:5px;" +
        "cursor:pointer;font-size:11.5px;margin:1px 0;" +
        (active
          ? "background:rgba(56,189,248,.14);color:#7dd3fc"
          : "color:#cbd5e1");
      row.onmouseenter = () => { if (!active) row.style.background = "rgba(255,255,255,.04)"; };
      row.onmouseleave = () => { if (!active) row.style.background = ""; };
      row.onclick = () => {
        selectedFamilyId = fam.id;
        selectedTypeId = fam.types[0]?.id ?? null;
        renderTree();
        renderDetail();
      };

      const icon = document.createElement("span");
      icon.textContent = fam.builtIn ? "\u25CF" : "\u25CB";
      icon.style.cssText = "font-size:9px;color:" + (fam.builtIn ? "#38bdf8" : "#a855f7");

      const name = document.createElement("span");
      name.textContent = fam.name;
      name.style.cssText = "flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap";

      const count = document.createElement("span");
      count.textContent = String(fam.types.length);
      count.style.cssText = "font-size:9.5px;color:#64748b;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace";

      row.append(icon, name, count);
      treePane.appendChild(row);

      // Types under the family, if it is selected.
      if (active) {
        for (const t of fam.types) {
          const trow = document.createElement("div");
          const tActive = t.id === selectedTypeId;
          trow.style.cssText =
            "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:3px 8px 3px 24px;border-radius:4px;" +
            "cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;margin:1px 0;" +
            (tActive
              ? "background:rgba(56,189,248,.10);color:#7dd3fc"
              : "color:#94a3b8");
          trow.onmouseenter = () => { if (!tActive) trow.style.background = "rgba(255,255,255,.03)"; };
          trow.onmouseleave = () => { if (!tActive) trow.style.background = ""; };
          trow.onclick = (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            selectedTypeId = t.id;
            renderTree();
            renderDetail();
          };
          const bullet = document.createElement("span");
          bullet.textContent = "\u25B8";
          bullet.style.cssText = "font-size:8px;opacity:.6";
          const tname = document.createElement("span");
          tname.textContent = t.name;
          tname.style.cssText = "flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap";
          trow.append(bullet, tname);
          treePane.appendChild(trow);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Detail
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
function renderDetail(): void {
  detailPane.innerHTML = "";
  const s = svc();
  if (!s) {
    const msg = document.createElement("div");
    msg.textContent = "Family service is not initialized. Reload the page.";
    msg.style.cssText = "padding:20px;color:#fca5a5;font-size:12px";
    detailPane.appendChild(msg);
    return;
  }
  const fam = selectedFamilyId ? s.get(selectedFamilyId) : null;
  if (!fam) {
    const msg = document.createElement("div");
    msg.textContent = "Select a family on the left.";
    msg.style.cssText = "padding:20px;color:#6b7280;font-size:12px;text-align:center";
    detailPane.appendChild(msg);
    return;
  }

  const head = document.createElement("div");
  head.style.cssText = "display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;margin-bottom:4px";
  const nm = document.createElement("div");
  nm.textContent = fam.name;
  nm.style.cssText = "font-size:15px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1px";
  const kind = document.createElement("span");
  kind.textContent = fam.builtIn ? "built-in" : "user";
  kind.style.cssText =
    "font:600 9.5px ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;" +
    "padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;" +
    (fam.builtIn
      ? "background:rgba(56,189,248,.14);color:#7dd3fc"
      : "background:rgba(168,85,247,.14);color:#c4b5fd");
  head.append(nm, kind);

  const meta = document.createElement("div");
  meta.style.cssText = "font:11px ui-monospace,monospace;color:#94a3b8;margin-bottom:10px";
  meta.textContent =
    "category: " + fam.category +
    "   ifc: " + fam.ifcEntity +
    (fam.sourceElementType ? "   maps to: " + fam.sourceElementType : "");

  detailPane.append(head, meta);

  // --- Preview (isometric SVG of the bounding box of the built geometry) ---
  const preview = document.createElement("div");
  preview.style.cssText =
    "background:#0b0d12;border:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);border-radius:6px;" +
    "padding:8px;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:160px";
  try {
    const built = s.buildGeometry(fam.id, selectedTypeId, undefined);
    if (built) preview.appendChild(buildPreviewSvg(built));
    else {
      const em = document.createElement("div");
      em.textContent = "(no geometry for this type)";
      em.style.cssText = "color:#6b7280;font-size:11px";
      preview.appendChild(em);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    const em = document.createElement("div");
    em.textContent = "preview failed: " + (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
    em.style.cssText = "color:#fca5a5;font-size:11px";
    preview.appendChild(em);
  }
  detailPane.appendChild(preview);

  // --- Parameters table ---
  detailPane.appendChild(sectionLabel("Parameters"));
  const pTable = document.createElement("table");
  pTable.style.cssText = "width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11.5px;margin-bottom:12px";
  const pHead = document.createElement("thead");
  pHead.innerHTML =
    "<tr style=\"background:#12141b\">" +
    "<th style=\"text-align:left;padding:4px 6px;font-weight:600;color:#94a3b8\">Name</th>" +
    "<th style=\"text-align:left;padding:4px 6px;font-weight:600;color:#94a3b8\">Type</th>" +
    "<th style=\"text-align:left;padding:4px 6px;font-weight:600;color:#94a3b8\">Scope</th>" +
    "<th style=\"text-align:right;padding:4px 6px;font-weight:600;color:#94a3b8\">Value</th>" +
    "</tr>";
  pTable.appendChild(pHead);
  const pBody = document.createElement("tbody");
  const resolved = s.resolveParams(fam.id, selectedTypeId, undefined) ?? {};
  for (const p of fam.parameters) {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    tr.style.cssText = "border-bottom:1px solid #1a1d24";
    const v = resolved[p.name];
    const formatted = formatParamValue(p, v);
    tr.innerHTML =
      "<td style=\"padding:4px 6px\">" + esc(p.name) + "</td>" +
      "<td style=\"padding:4px 6px;color:#94a3b8\">" + esc(p.type) + (p.unit ? " (" + esc(p.unit) + ")" : "") + "</td>" +
      "<td style=\"padding:4px 6px;color:#94a3b8\">" + esc(p.scope) + "</td>" +
      "<td style=\"padding:4px 6px;text-align:right;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;color:#7dd3fc\">" + esc(formatted) + "</td>";
    pBody.appendChild(tr);
  }
  pTable.appendChild(pBody);
  detailPane.appendChild(pTable);

  // --- Types table ---
  detailPane.appendChild(sectionLabel("Types"));
  const tBar = document.createElement("div");
  tBar.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px";
  const addType = mkActionBtn("+ Type", () => onAddType(fam), false);
  const removeType = mkActionBtn("Remove", () => onRemoveType(fam), false);
  removeType.disabled = !selectedTypeId || fam.types.length <= 1;
  if (removeType.disabled) removeType.style.opacity = "0.45";
  tBar.append(addType, removeType);
  detailPane.appendChild(tBar);

  const tList = document.createElement("div");
  tList.style.cssText = "display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin-bottom:14px";
  for (const t of fam.types) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    const active = t.id === selectedTypeId;
    row.style.cssText =
      "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-size:11.5px;" +
      "cursor:pointer;" +
      (active
        ? "background:rgba(56,189,248,.14);color:#7dd3fc;border:1px solid #38bdf8"
        : "background:#0b0d12;border:1px solid #1e2029;color:#cbd5e1");
    row.onclick = () => { selectedTypeId = t.id; renderTree(); renderDetail(); };

    const tname = document.createElement("span");
    tname.textContent = t.name;
    tname.style.cssText = "flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap";

    const overrides = document.createElement("span");
    const keys = Object.keys(t.values || {});
    overrides.textContent = keys.length ? keys.length + " override" + (keys.length === 1 ? "" : "s") : "defaults";
    overrides.style.cssText = "font:10px ui-monospace,monospace;color:#64748b";

    row.append(tname, overrides);
    tList.appendChild(row);
  }
  detailPane.appendChild(tList);

  // --- Footer actions -------------------------------------------------------
  const actions = document.createElement("div");
  actions.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #1e2029";
  const place = mkActionBtn("Place " + (selectedTypeId ? "this type" : "family"), () => onPlace(fam), true);
  const dup = mkActionBtn("Duplicate family", () => onDuplicate(fam), false);
  const del = mkActionBtn("Delete family", () => onDelete(fam), false);
  const exportBtn = mkActionBtn("Export JSON", () => onExport(fam), false);
  del.disabled = fam.builtIn;
  if (del.disabled) del.style.opacity = "0.45";

  actions.append(place, dup, del, exportBtn);
  detailPane.appendChild(actions);
}

function sectionLabel(text: string): HTMLElement {
  const h = document.createElement("div");
  h.textContent = text;
  h.style.cssText =
    "font:700 10px system-ui;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;" +
    "color:#64748b;margin:8px 0 6px";
  return h;
}

function formatParamValue(p: any, v: any): string {
  if (v === undefined || v === null) return "\u2014";
  if (p.type === "length" && typeof v === "number") return v.toFixed(3) + " m";
  if (p.type === "angle"  && typeof v === "number") return v.toFixed(3) + " rad";
  if (typeof v === "number") return Number.isInteger(v) ? String(v) : v.toFixed(3);
  if (typeof v === "boolean") return v ? "yes" : "no";
  return String(v);
}

function esc(s: unknown): string {
  return String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Isometric preview
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
function buildPreviewSvg(obj: THREE.Object3D): SVGSVGElement {
  const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(obj);
  if (box.isEmpty()) {
    const svg = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", "200");
    svg.setAttribute("height", "150");
    return svg;
  }

  const w = 220, h = 160, pad = 20;
  const size = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
  const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  const maxDim = Math.max(size.x, size.y, size.z, 0.001);
  const scale = (Math.min(w, h) - pad * 2) / (maxDim * 1.6);

  const c30 = Math.cos(Math.PI / 6);
  const s30 = Math.sin(Math.PI / 6);
  const project = (p: THREE.Vector3) => {
    const dx = p.x - center.x, dy = p.y - center.y, dz = p.z - center.z;
    return {
      x: (dx - dz) * c30 * scale + w / 2,
      y: ((dx + dz) * s30 - dy) * scale + h / 2,
    };
  };

  const min = box.min, max = box.max;
  const corners: THREE.Vector3[] = [
    new THREE.Vector3(min.x, min.y, min.z),
    new THREE.Vector3(max.x, min.y, min.z),
    new THREE.Vector3(max.x, min.y, max.z),
    new THREE.Vector3(min.x, min.y, max.z),
    new THREE.Vector3(min.x, max.y, min.z),
    new THREE.Vector3(max.x, max.y, min.z),
    new THREE.Vector3(max.x, max.y, max.z),
    new THREE.Vector3(min.x, max.y, max.z),
  ];
  const edges: [number, number][] = [
    [0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 0],
    [4, 5], [5, 6], [6, 7], [7, 4],
    [0, 4], [1, 5], [2, 6], [3, 7],
  ];

  const svg = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "svg");
  svg.setAttribute("xmlns", SVG_NS);
  svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + w + " " + h);
  svg.setAttribute("width", String(w));
  svg.setAttribute("height", String(h));
  svg.style.cssText = "display:block";

  for (const [a, b] of edges) {
    const pa = project(corners[a]);
    const pb = project(corners[b]);
    const line = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "line");
    line.setAttribute("x1", pa.x.toFixed(2));
    line.setAttribute("y1", pa.y.toFixed(2));
    line.setAttribute("x2", pb.x.toFixed(2));
    line.setAttribute("y2", pb.y.toFixed(2));
    line.setAttribute("stroke", "#38bdf8");
    line.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.2");
    line.setAttribute("stroke-linecap", "round");
    svg.appendChild(line);
  }

  // Dimensions annotation
  const dims = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "text");
  dims.setAttribute("x", String(w - 6));
  dims.setAttribute("y", String(h - 6));
  dims.setAttribute("text-anchor", "end");
  dims.setAttribute("font-family", "ui-monospace, monospace");
  dims.setAttribute("font-size", "9.5");
  dims.setAttribute("fill", "#64748b");
  dims.textContent =
    size.x.toFixed(2) + " \u00D7 " + size.y.toFixed(2) + " \u00D7 " + size.z.toFixed(2) + " m";
  svg.appendChild(dims);

  return svg;
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Actions
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
function mkActionBtn(label: string, onclick: () => void, primary: boolean): HTMLButtonElement {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.type = "button";
  b.textContent = label;
  b.style.cssText =
    "padding:5px 11px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font:600 11px system-ui;" +
    (primary
      ? "background:var(--accent,#38bdf8);color:#0b0d12;border:1px solid var(--accent,#38bdf8)"
      : "background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a)");
  b.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onclick(); };
  return b;
}

function toast(msg: string, kind: "info" | "success" | "warn" = "info") {
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", { detail: { message: msg, kind } }));
  } catch { /* */ }
}

function onPlace(fam: FamilyDefinition): void {
  const sourceType = fam.sourceElementType;
  if (!sourceType) {
    toast("This family has no authoring mapping yet (Step 2).", "warn");
    return;
  }
  try {
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    if (auth?.setAuthoringTool) {
      auth.setAuthoringTool(sourceType);
      const t = selectedTypeId ? fam.types.find((x) => x.id === selectedTypeId) : null;
      toast("Place " + fam.name + (t ? " \u00B7 " + t.name : "") + " \u2014 click in the viewport", "success");
    } else {
      toast("Authoring not ready.", "warn");
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[family-browser] place failed", err);
  }
}

function onDuplicate(fam: FamilyDefinition): void {
  const s = svc();
  if (!s) return;
  const name = prompt("New family name:", fam.name + " Copy");
  if (!name) return;
  const clone = s.duplicate(fam.id, name.trim() || (fam.name + " Copy"));
  if (clone) {
    selectedFamilyId = clone.id;
    selectedTypeId = clone.types[0]?.id ?? null;
    toast("Family duplicated: " + clone.name, "success");
    reloadAll();
  }
}

function onDelete(fam: FamilyDefinition): void {
  const s = svc();
  if (!s) return;
  if (fam.builtIn) { toast("Built-in families cannot be deleted.", "warn"); return; }
  if (!confirm("Delete family \u201C" + fam.name + "\u201D and all its types?")) return;
  if (s.remove(fam.id)) {
    if (selectedFamilyId === fam.id) {
      selectedFamilyId = null;
      selectedTypeId = null;
    }
    toast("Family deleted.", "info");
    reloadAll();
  }
}

function onNewFamily(): void {
  const s = svc();
  if (!s) return;
  const src = selectedFamilyId ? s.get(selectedFamilyId) : s.list()[0];
  if (!src) { toast("No family to duplicate.", "warn"); return; }
  const name = prompt("New family name:", "New " + src.category);
  if (!name) return;
  const clone = s.duplicate(src.id, name.trim() || ("New " + src.category));
  if (clone) {
    selectedFamilyId = clone.id;
    selectedTypeId = clone.types[0]?.id ?? null;
    toast("Created family: " + clone.name, "success");
    reloadAll();
  }
}

function onAddType(fam: FamilyDefinition): void {
  const s = svc();
  if (!s) return;
  const name = prompt("New type name:", fam.name + " Type " + (fam.types.length + 1));
  if (!name) return;
  const base: Record<string, any> = {};
  const resolved = s.resolveParams(fam.id, selectedTypeId, undefined) ?? {};
  for (const p of fam.parameters) if (p.scope === "type") base[p.name] = resolved[p.name];
  const t = s.createType(fam.id, name.trim() || ("Type " + (fam.types.length + 1)), base);
  if (t) {
    selectedTypeId = t.id;
    toast("Added type: " + t.name, "success");
    reloadAll();
  }
}

function onRemoveType(fam: FamilyDefinition): void {
  const s = svc();
  if (!s) return;
  if (!selectedTypeId) return;
  if (fam.types.length <= 1) { toast("A family must keep at least one type.", "warn"); return; }
  const t = fam.types.find((x) => x.id === selectedTypeId);
  if (!t) return;
  if (!confirm("Delete type \u201C" + t.name + "\u201D?")) return;
  if (s.removeType(fam.id, t.id)) {
    selectedTypeId = fam.types[0]?.id ?? null;
    toast("Type removed.", "info");
    reloadAll();
  }
}

function onExport(fam: FamilyDefinition): void {
  try {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(fam, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = fam.name.replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]+/gi, "_") + ".family.json";
    a.click();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1500);
    toast("Exported " + fam.name, "success");
  } catch (err) {
    toast("Export failed: " + (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)), "warn");
  }
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Search / filter wiring
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
searchInput.addEventListener("input", () => { searchQuery = searchInput.value; renderTree(); });
categoryFilter.addEventListener("change", () => { categoryValue = categoryFilter.value; renderTree(); });

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Visibility
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
function ensureDock(): void {
  if (dock) return;
  dock = makeDockable(panel, {
    id: "family-browser",
    host: ctx.rightHost,
    header,
    minWidth: 460,
    minHeight: 400,
    defaultDock: "right",
    defaultWidth: 560,
    defaultHeight: 640,
  });
}

export function openFamilyBrowser(): void {
  if (!isFamilySystemReady()) {
    try { setupFamilies(); } catch (err) { console.warn("[family-browser] boot failed", err); }
  }
  if (!panel.parentElement) ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);
  ensureDock();
  visible = true;
  panel.style.display = "flex";
  dock?.show();
  reloadAll();
}

export function closeFamilyBrowser(): void {
  visible = false;
  dock?.hide();
  panel.style.display = "none";
}

export function toggleFamilyBrowser(): void {
  visible ? closeFamilyBrowser() : openFamilyBrowser();
}

export function isFamilyBrowserVisible(): boolean {
  return visible;
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Setup
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
let installed = false;

export function setupFamilyBrowser(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  // Panel is lazily mounted; only ensure the singleton service exists.
  if (!isFamilySystemReady()) {
    try { setupFamilies(); } catch (err) { console.warn("[family-browser] boot failed", err); }
  }

  const svcAny = svc();
  const api = {
    open: openFamilyBrowser,
    close: closeFamilyBrowser,
    toggle: toggleFamilyBrowser,
    isVisible: isFamilyBrowserVisible,
    reload: reloadAll,
  };
  (ctx.features as any).familyBrowser = api;
  (window as any).__obsFamilyBrowser = api;

  // Ctrl+Shift+B toggles the panel.
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "b") {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      toggleFamilyBrowser();
    }
  }, true);

  console.log("[family-browser] ready. Toggle with Ctrl+Shift+B.");
  void svcAny;
}
`;

function patchMain() {

}
```

```js
// Open BIM Studio - Step 1: Family system foundation.
// Adds src/modules/families/*, registers a service, adds one boot step,
// and extends the regression guard. Idempotent.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
const MARK = "openbim-step1:family-foundation";

const stats = { created: 0, patched: 0, noop: 0, skipped: 0, warned: 0 };

function full(rel) { return path.join(root, rel); }
function exists(rel) { try { fs.accessSync(full(rel)); return true; } catch { return false; } }
function read(rel) { try { return fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8"); } catch { return null; } }
function ensureDir(rel) {
  const dir = path.dirname(full(rel));
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
}
function backup(rel) {
  if (!exists(rel)) return;
  fs.copyFileSync(full(rel), full(rel) + ".bak-step1-" + stamp);
}
function write(rel, s) { ensureDir(rel); fs.writeFileSync(full(rel), s, "utf8"); }
function log(kind, name, note) {
  let tag;
  if (kind === "CREATE") { tag = "CREATE"; stats.created++; }
  else if (kind === "PATCH") { tag = "PATCH "; stats.patched++; }
  else if (kind === "NOOP") { tag = "NOOP  "; stats.noop++; }
  else if (kind === "WARN") { tag = "WARN  "; stats.warned++; }
  else { tag = "SKIP  "; stats.skipped++; }
  console.log("  [" + tag + "] " + name + (note ? "  -- " + note : ""));
}
function readNorm(rel) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8");
  const crlf = raw.indexOf("\r\n") >= 0;
  return { text: crlf ? raw.split("\r\n").join("\n") : raw, crlf };
}
function writeNorm(rel, text, crlf) {
  fs.writeFileSync(full(rel), crlf ? text.split("\n").join("\r\n") : text, "utf8");
}
function dumpContext(text, needle, radius) {
  const lines = text.split("\n");
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    if (lines[i].indexOf(needle) >= 0) {
      const a = Math.max(0, i - radius), b = Math.min(lines.length - 1, i + radius);
      console.log("    (diag) around line " + (i + 1) + ":");
      for (let j = a; j <= b; j++) console.log("    " + String(j + 1).padStart(5, " ") + " | " + lines[j]);
      return;
    }
  }
  console.log("    (diag) no line contains: " + JSON.stringify(needle));
}

// 1. src/modules/families/types.ts
// =============================================================================
const TS_TYPES = `// ${MARK}
// Family system foundation - type definitions.
//
// A FamilyDefinition is a data-driven, user-extensible description of a
// parametric BIM family: named parameters, a geometry recipe, and one or
// more named types. Nothing in this file imports runtime code, so it is
// safe to use as a type-only dependency from services.ts.

import type * as THREE from "three";

export type FamilyCategory =
  | "wall" | "slab" | "column" | "beam" | "brace" | "truss" | "footing"
  | "strip" | "mline" | "door" | "window" | "duct" | "pipe"
  | "cable-tray" | "conduit" | "equipment" | "fitting"
  | "curtain-wall" | "stairs" | "railing" | "ramp" | "roof" | "ceiling"
  | "generic";

export type ParameterType =
  | "length" | "angle" | "number" | "integer" | "text"
  | "boolean" | "material" | "colour" | "family-type";

export type ParameterScope = "instance" | "type";

export interface FamilyParameter {
  name: string;
  type: ParameterType;
  scope: ParameterScope;
  default: any;
  editable: boolean;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  unit?: string;
  group?: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Formula referencing other parameter names, evaluated in declaration order. */
  formula?: string;
}

export interface FamilyType {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Type-scope parameter overrides. */
  values: Record<string, any>;
}

export type NumberRef = { ref: string } | { const: number };

export type ProfileSpec =
  | { kind: "rect"; w: NumberRef; h: NumberRef }
  | { kind: "circle"; r: NumberRef; segments?: number }
  | { kind: "polygon"; points: [number, number][] };

export interface TransformSpec {
  /** Translation in metres, [x, y, z]. */
  translate?: [NumberRef, NumberRef, NumberRef];
  /** Rotation in radians, [x, y, z]. */
  rotate?: [NumberRef, NumberRef, NumberRef];
  /** Scale, [x, y, z]. */
  scale?: [NumberRef, NumberRef, NumberRef];
}

export type FamilyGeometrySpec =
  | { kind: "box"; w: NumberRef; d: NumberRef; h: NumberRef; transform?: TransformSpec }
  | { kind: "cylinder"; r: NumberRef; h: NumberRef; segments?: number; transform?: TransformSpec }
  | { kind: "extrusion"; profile: ProfileSpec; depth: NumberRef; holes?: ProfileSpec[]; transform?: TransformSpec }
  | { kind: "composed"; parts: FamilyGeometrySpec[] }
  | { kind: "custom"; builder: string };

export interface FamilyDefinition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: FamilyCategory;
  /** IFC entity this family maps to on export. E.g. "IfcWall". */
  ifcEntity: string;
  /** Schema version for future migration. */
  schemaVersion: number;
  /** The element type in the current hardcoded system this family mirrors. */
  sourceElementType?: string;
  parameters: FamilyParameter[];
  geometry: FamilyGeometrySpec;
  types: FamilyType[];
  /** Optional grouping in the browser. */
  group?: string;
  /** Whether this family was shipped with the app. */
  builtIn: boolean;
}

export type CustomGeometryBuilder = (
  params: Record<string, any>,
  resolveNumber: (ref: NumberRef) => number,
  resolveTransform: (t: TransformSpec | undefined) => THREE.Object3D,
) => THREE.Object3D | null;

/** Public family service contract. */
export interface FamilyService {
  list(): FamilyDefinition[];
  get(id: string): FamilyDefinition | null;
  getByElementType(elementType: string): FamilyDefinition | null;

  create(def: Omit<FamilyDefinition, "id" | "schemaVersion" | "builtIn">): FamilyDefinition;
  update(id: string, patch: Partial<FamilyDefinition>): FamilyDefinition | null;
  remove(id: string): boolean;
  duplicate(id: string, newName: string): FamilyDefinition | null;

  createType(familyId: string, name: string, values?: Record<string, any>): FamilyType | null;
  updateType(familyId: string, typeId: string, patch: Partial<FamilyType>): FamilyType | null;
  removeType(familyId: string, typeId: string): boolean;

  resolveParams(
    familyId: string,
    typeId: string | null,
    overrides?: Record<string, any>,
  ): Record<string, any> | null;

  buildGeometry(
    familyId: string,
    typeId: string | null,
    overrides?: Record<string, any>,
  ): THREE.Object3D | null;

  registerCustomBuilder(name: string, fn: CustomGeometryBuilder): void;

  onChange(cb: () => void): () => void;
  reset(): void;
}
`;

// =============================================================================
// 2. src/modules/families/store.ts
// =============================================================================
const TS_STORE = `// ${MARK}
// Family system foundation - in-memory store with localStorage persistence.
//
// Mirrors the pattern used by core/options-registry.ts. Every mutation
// notifies subscribers so the UI (or verify scripts) can react.

import type { FamilyDefinition, FamilyType } from "./types";

const STORAGE_KEY = "obs.families.v1";

function uid(): string {
  return (crypto as any).randomUUID?.()
    ?? ("fam-" + Date.now().toString(36) + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8));
}

class FamilyStore {
  private byId = new Map<string, FamilyDefinition>();
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private booted = false;

  boot(seedBuiltIns: FamilyDefinition[]): void {
    if (this.booted) return;
    this.booted = true;

    let restored: FamilyDefinition[] | null = null;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) restored = parsed;
      }
    } catch { /* */ }

    if (restored && restored.length) {
      for (const d of restored) this.byId.set(d.id, d);
    } else {
      for (const d of seedBuiltIns) this.byId.set(d.id, d);
      this.persist();
    }
  }

  list(): FamilyDefinition[] {
    return [...this.byId.values()].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  }

  get(id: string): FamilyDefinition | null {
    return this.byId.get(id) ?? null;
  }

  getByElementType(elementType: string): FamilyDefinition | null {
    for (const d of this.byId.values()) {
      if (d.sourceElementType === elementType) return d;
    }
    return null;
  }

  create(def: Omit<FamilyDefinition, "id" | "schemaVersion" | "builtIn">): FamilyDefinition {
    const family: FamilyDefinition = {
      ...def,
      id: uid(),
      schemaVersion: 1,
      builtIn: false,
    };
    this.byId.set(family.id, family);
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return family;
  }

  update(id: string, patch: Partial<FamilyDefinition>): FamilyDefinition | null {
    const cur = this.byId.get(id);
    if (!cur) return null;
    const next: FamilyDefinition = { ...cur, ...patch, id: cur.id };
    this.byId.set(id, next);
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return next;
  }

  remove(id: string): boolean {
    const cur = this.byId.get(id);
    if (!cur) return false;
    if (cur.builtIn) return false;
    const ok = this.byId.delete(id);
    if (ok) { this.persist(); this.emit(); }
    return ok;
  }

  duplicate(id: string, newName: string): FamilyDefinition | null {
    const cur = this.byId.get(id);
    if (!cur) return null;
    const clone: FamilyDefinition = {
      ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cur)),
      id: uid(),
      name: newName,
      builtIn: false,
    };
    this.byId.set(clone.id, clone);
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return clone;
  }

  createType(familyId: string, name: string, values: Record<string, any> = {}): FamilyType | null {
    const fam = this.byId.get(familyId);
    if (!fam) return null;
    const t: FamilyType = { id: uid(), name, values };
    fam.types.push(t);
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return t;
  }

  updateType(familyId: string, typeId: string, patch: Partial<FamilyType>): FamilyType | null {
    const fam = this.byId.get(familyId);
    if (!fam) return null;
    const idx = fam.types.findIndex((t) => t.id === typeId);
    if (idx < 0) return null;
    fam.types[idx] = { ...fam.types[idx], ...patch, id: typeId };
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return fam.types[idx];
  }

  removeType(familyId: string, typeId: string): boolean {
    const fam = this.byId.get(familyId);
    if (!fam) return false;
    const before = fam.types.length;
    fam.types = fam.types.filter((t) => t.id !== typeId);
    if (fam.types.length === before) return false;
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
    return true;
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.byId.clear();
    this.booted = false;
    try { localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch { /* */ }
  }

  onChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  private emit(): void {
    for (const cb of this.listeners) { try { cb(); } catch { /* */ } }
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try {
      const arr = [...this.byId.values()];
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(arr));
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[families] persist failed", err);
    }
  }
}

export const familyStore = new FamilyStore();
`;

// 3. src/modules/families/parametric-geometry.ts
// =============================================================================
const TS_GEOM = `// ${MARK}
// Family system foundation - parametric geometry resolver.
//
// Walks a FamilyGeometrySpec together with a resolved parameter map and
// returns a THREE.Object3D. All primitives are built from scratch with
// THREE geometry classes; this module has no dependency on authoring.ts.

import * as THREE from "three";
import type {
  CustomGeometryBuilder,
  FamilyGeometrySpec,
  NumberRef,
  ProfileSpec,
  TransformSpec,
} from "./types";

const CUSTOM_BUILDERS = new Map<string, CustomGeometryBuilder>();

export function registerCustomBuilder(name: string, fn: CustomGeometryBuilder): void {
  CUSTOM_BUILDERS.set(name, fn);
}

export function getCustomBuilder(name: string): CustomGeometryBuilder | null {
  return CUSTOM_BUILDERS.get(name) ?? null;
}

/** Resolve a NumberRef to a concrete number given the parameter map. */
export function resolveNumber(ref: NumberRef, params: Record<string, any>): number {
  if ("const" in ref) return ref.const;
  const v = params[ref.ref];
  const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : Number(v);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) {
    console.warn("[families] NumberRef '" + ref.ref + "' resolved to non-number; using 0");
    return 0;
  }
  return n;
}

/** Build a Transform matrix from a TransformSpec. */
export function resolveTransform(
  spec: TransformSpec | undefined,
  params: Record<string, any>,
): THREE.Object3D {
  const wrapper = new THREE.Group();
  if (!spec) return wrapper;
  if (spec.translate) {
    wrapper.position.set(
      resolveNumber(spec.translate[0], params),
      resolveNumber(spec.translate[1], params),
      resolveNumber(spec.translate[2], params),
    );
  }
  if (spec.rotate) {
    wrapper.rotation.set(
      resolveNumber(spec.rotate[0], params),
      resolveNumber(spec.rotate[1], params),
      resolveNumber(spec.rotate[2], params),
    );
  }
  if (spec.scale) {
    wrapper.scale.set(
      resolveNumber(spec.scale[0], params),
      resolveNumber(spec.scale[1], params),
      resolveNumber(spec.scale[2], params),
    );
  }
  return wrapper;
}

function profileToShape(profile: ProfileSpec, params: Record<string, any>): THREE.Shape {
  const shape = new THREE.Shape();
  if (profile.kind === "rect") {
    const w = resolveNumber(profile.w, params);
    const h = resolveNumber(profile.h, params);
    shape.moveTo(-w / 2, -h / 2);
    shape.lineTo( w / 2, -h / 2);
    shape.lineTo( w / 2,  h / 2);
    shape.lineTo(-w / 2,  h / 2);
    shape.closePath();
  } else if (profile.kind === "circle") {
    const r = resolveNumber(profile.r, params);
    shape.absarc(0, 0, r, 0, Math.PI * 2, false);
  } else if (profile.kind === "polygon") {
    const pts = profile.points;
    if (pts.length < 3) return shape;
    shape.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
    for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) shape.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
    shape.closePath();
  }
  return shape;
}

function profileToHole(profile: ProfileSpec, params: Record<string, any>): THREE.Path {
  const shape = profileToShape(profile, params);
  const path = new THREE.Path();
  const pts = shape.getPoints(64);
  if (pts.length < 3) return path;
  path.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) path.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
  path.closePath();
  return path;
}

/**
 * Build a THREE.Object3D from a FamilyGeometrySpec + resolved parameters.
 * Returns null on unsupported spec or empty geometry.
 */
export function buildParametricGeometry(
  spec: FamilyGeometrySpec,
  params: Record<string, any>,
): THREE.Object3D | null {
  switch (spec.kind) {
    case "box": {
      const w = resolveNumber(spec.w, params);
      const d = resolveNumber(spec.d, params);
      const h = resolveNumber(spec.h, params);
      if (w <= 0 || d <= 0 || h <= 0) return null;
      const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo);
      const wrap = resolveTransform(spec.transform, params);
      wrap.add(mesh);
      return wrap;
    }

    case "cylinder": {
      const r = resolveNumber(spec.r, params);
      const h = resolveNumber(spec.h, params);
      const seg = spec.segments ?? 24;
      if (r <= 0 || h <= 0) return null;
      const geo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r, r, h, seg);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo);
      const wrap = resolveTransform(spec.transform, params);
      wrap.add(mesh);
      return wrap;
    }

    case "extrusion": {
      const shape = profileToShape(spec.profile, params);
      if (spec.holes && spec.holes.length) {
        for (const h of spec.holes) shape.holes.push(profileToHole(h, params));
      }
      const depth = resolveNumber(spec.depth, params);
      if (depth <= 0) return null;
      const geo = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, { depth, bevelEnabled: false });
      // Extrusion runs along +Z; centre it on Z so the transform origin is
      // the mid-depth of the solid. Caller can override with transform.
      geo.translate(0, 0, -depth / 2);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo);
      const wrap = resolveTransform(spec.transform, params);
      wrap.add(mesh);
      return wrap;
    }

    case "composed": {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      for (const part of spec.parts) {
        const child = buildParametricGeometry(part, params);
        if (child) group.add(child);
      }
      return group.children.length ? group : null;
    }

    case "custom": {
      const builder = CUSTOM_BUILDERS.get(spec.builder);
      if (!builder) {
        console.warn("[families] custom builder '" + spec.builder + "' is not registered");
        return null;
      }
      return builder(params, (ref) => resolveNumber(ref, params), (t) => resolveTransform(t, params));
    }
  }

  return null;
}

/** Colour every mesh in the tree with the given THREE colour. */
export function tintObject(root: THREE.Object3D, colour: THREE.Color | string): void {
  const c = colour instanceof THREE.Color ? colour : new THREE.Color(colour);
  root.traverse((obj: any) => {
    if (!obj.isMesh) return;
    if (!obj.material) obj.material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: c });
    else if (obj.material.color) obj.material.color.copy(c);
  });
}
`;

// 4. src/modules/families/registry.ts
// =============================================================================
const TS_REGISTRY = `// ${MARK}
// Family system foundation - registry that ties store + geometry + params.

import * as THREE from "three";
import { familyStore } from "./store";
import { buildParametricGeometry, registerCustomBuilder } from "./parametric-geometry";
import type {
  CustomGeometryBuilder,
  FamilyDefinition,
  FamilyParameter,
  FamilyService,
  FamilyType,
} from "./types";

/** Resolve parameters for a family/type, applying instance overrides last. */
function resolveParameters(
  family: FamilyDefinition,
  type: FamilyType | null,
  overrides: Record<string, any> | undefined,
): Record<string, any> {
  const params: Record<string, any> = {};

  // 1. Family defaults.
  for (const p of family.parameters) {
    params[p.name] = p.default;
  }

  // 2. Type-scope overrides.
  if (type) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(type.values)) {
      params[k] = v;
    }
  }

  // 3. Instance overrides.
  if (overrides) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(overrides)) {
      params[k] = v;
    }
  }

  // 4. Formulas in declaration order (they may reference earlier params).
  for (const p of family.parameters) {
    if (!p.formula) continue;
    try {
      const fn = new Function(...Object.keys(params), "return (" + p.formula + ";");
      const v = fn(...Object.values(params));
      if (v !== undefined && v !== null && Number.isFinite(Number(v))) {
        params[p.name] = Number(v);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[families] formula for '" + p.name + "' failed:", err);
    }
  }

  return params;
}

export function createFamilyService(): FamilyService {
  const svc: FamilyService = {
    list: () => familyStore.list(),
    get: (id) => familyStore.get(id),
    getByElementType: (et) => familyStore.getByElementType(et),

    create: (def) => familyStore.create(def),
    update: (id, patch) => familyStore.update(id, patch),
    remove: (id) => familyStore.remove(id),
    duplicate: (id, name) => familyStore.duplicate(id, name),

    createType: (fid, name, values) => familyStore.createType(fid, name, values),
    updateType: (fid, tid, patch) => familyStore.updateType(fid, tid, patch),
    removeType: (fid, tid) => familyStore.removeType(fid, tid),

    resolveParams: (fid, tid, overrides) => {
      const fam = familyStore.get(fid);
      if (!fam) return null;
      const type = tid ? fam.types.find((t) => t.id === tid) ?? null : null;
      return resolveParameters(fam, type, overrides);
    },

    buildGeometry: (fid, tid, overrides) => {
      const fam = familyStore.get(fid);
      if (!fam) return null;
      const type = tid ? fam.types.find((t) => t.id === tid) ?? null : null;
      const params = resolveParameters(fam, type, overrides);
      const obj = buildParametricGeometry(fam.geometry, params);
      if (!obj) return null;
      obj.userData.familyId = fam.id;
      obj.userData.familyTypeId = tid;
      obj.userData.familyParams = params;
      return obj;
    },

    registerCustomBuilder: (name, fn) => registerCustomBuilder(name, fn),

    onChange: (cb) => familyStore.onChange(cb),
    reset: () => familyStore.reset(),
  };
  return svc;
}

/** Type-guard helper used by built-in family definitions. */
export function isFamilyParameter(v: any): v is FamilyParameter {
  return v && typeof v === "object" && typeof v.name === "string" && typeof v.type === "string";
}

/** Expose the raw geometry builder for tests / editor previews. */
export { buildParametricGeometry, resolveParameters };

/** Convenience: build a bare THREE.Group from a family + type. */
export function buildFamilyPreview(
  svc: FamilyService,
  familyId: string,
  typeId: string | null,
): THREE.Object3D | null {
  return svc.buildGeometry(familyId, typeId, undefined);
}

// Re-export the register hook so modules can install custom builders without
// importing parametric-geometry directly.
export type { CustomGeometryBuilder };
`;

const TS_INDEX = `// ${MARK}
// Family system foundation - public entry point.
//
// Importing this module installs the family service in the typed service
// registry and mounts it on ctx.features.family. Call setupFamilies()
// once during boot; it is idempotent.

import { ctx } from "../../core/context";
import { register } from "../../core/services";
import { familyStore } from "./store";
import { createFamilyService } from "./registry";
import { createBuiltInFamilies } from "./builtin-families";
import type { FamilyService } from "./types";

export * from "./types";
export { familyStore } from "./store";
export {
  buildParametricGeometry,
  registerCustomBuilder,
  resolveNumber,
  resolveTransform,
} from "./parametric-geometry";
export {
  createFamilyService,
  buildFamilyPreview,
} from "./registry";
export { createBuiltInFamilies } from "./builtin-families";

let installed = false;

export function setupFamilies(): FamilyService {
  if (installed) {
    return (ctx.features as any).family as FamilyService;
  }
  installed = true;

  // Seed built-ins on first boot, then load any persisted user families.
  const builtins = createBuiltInFamilies();
  familyStore.boot(builtins);

  const svc = createFamilyService();

  register("family", svc);
  (ctx.features as any).family = svc;
  try { (window as any).__obsFamily = svc; } catch { /* */ }

  // Diagnostics.
  const list = svc.list();
  console.log(
    "[families] ready. " + list.length + " family definition(s), " +
    list.reduce((n, f) => n + f.types.length, 0) + " type(s)."
  );

  return svc;
}

/** True after setupFamilies() has run. */
export function isFamilySystemReady(): boolean {
  return installed;
}
`;
```

```js
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

function full(rel) { return path.join(root, rel); }
function exists(rel) { try { fs.accessSync(full(rel)); return true; } catch { return false; } }
function read(rel) { try { return fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8"); } catch { return null; } }
function backup(rel) {
  if (!exists(rel)) return false;
  fs.copyFileSync(full(rel), full(rel) + ".bak-" + stamp);
  console.log("  Backup: " + rel);
  return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. authoring.ts : clamp openings to the host's CURRENT length at read time,
//    and write the clamp back to the hosted element params so the door/window
//    mesh and the wall hole agree in the SAME rebuild pass (no flicker, no
//    float, every rebuild path covered). Whitespace-robust, idempotent.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const AUTH_REL = "src/features/authoring.ts";
const MARKER = "hosted-recut: clamp each opening";

const NEW_FN = `function openingsForWall(wallId: string): WallOpening[] {
  // hosted-recut: clamp each opening to the host's CURRENT length so a moved or
  // resized wall re-cuts its door/window holes in-bounds on every rebuild, and
  // write the clamp back to the hosted element params so the door/window mesh
  // (built from the same offsetAlongHost) stays glued to the wall in one pass.
  const out: WallOpening[] = [];
  const wall = elements.find((e) => e.id === wallId);
  const wp = wall?.params;
  let L = 0;
  let ax = 0, az = 0, dx = 0, dz = 0;
  if (wp && wp.start && wp.end) {
    ax = wp.start[0]; az = wp.start[1];
    dx = wp.end[0] - ax; dz = wp.end[1] - az;
    L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  }
  const angle = L > 1e-6 ? Math.atan2(dz, dx) : 0;
  for (const el of getHostedForWall(wallId)) {
    const p = el.params;
    const w = p.width ?? DEFAULTS[el.type]?.width ?? 0.9;
    const h = p.height;
    const sill = el.type === "window" ? (p.sillHeight ?? 0.9) : (p.sillHeight ?? 0);
    let offset = p.offsetAlongHost ?? (L > 0 ? L / 2 : 0);
    if (L > 1e-6) {
      const half = w / 2;
      if (L <= w + 0.02) offset = L / 2;
      else offset = Math.max(half, Math.min(L - half, offset));
      offset = Math.round(offset * 1000) / 1000;
      p.offsetAlongHost = offset;
      const t01 = offset / L;
      const cx = ax + dx * t01;
      const cz = az + dz * t01;
      if ("x" in p) p.x = Math.round(cx * 1000) / 1000;
      if ("z" in p) p.z = Math.round(cz * 1000) / 1000;
      if ("hostAngle" in p) p.hostAngle = Math.round(angle * 10000) / 10000;
      if ("rotation" in p) p.rotation = p.hostAngle;
      if ("angle" in p) p.angle = p.hostAngle;
    }
    out.push({ offset, width: w, height: h, sill });
  }
  return out;
}`;

function patchAuthoring() {
  if (!exists(AUTH_REL)) { console.log("  SKIP: " + AUTH_REL + " not found"); return false; }
  let src = read(AUTH_REL);
  if (src.includes(MARKER)) { console.log("  NO CHANGE: authoring.ts already has hosted-recut clamp"); return false; }

  // Match the whole openingsForWall function: signature ... first column-0 closing brace.
  const re = /function openingsForWall\(wallId: string\): WallOpening\[\] \{[\s\S]*?\n\}/;
  if (!re.test(src)) { console.log("  SKIP: openingsForWall anchor not matched (paste the raw function if so)"); return false; }

  backup(AUTH_REL);
  src = src.replace(re, NEW_FN);
  fs.writeFileSync(full(AUTH_REL), src, "utf8");
  console.log("  PATCHED: authoring.ts openingsForWall -> clamp-to-host-length at read");
  return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. Extend the regression guard with a [hosted-recut] check group, inserted
//    right before the report section. Idempotent.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const GUARD_REL = "scripts/verify-input-focus.mjs";
const GUARD_MARKER = "hosted-recut contract";

const GUARD_BLOCK = `// ---- hosted-recut contract (added by Apply-Hosted-Recut) ----
const authSrc = read("src/features/authoring.ts") || "";
check("hosted-recut", "openingsForWall clamps offset to host length", /hosted-recut: clamp each opening/.test(authSrc));
check("hosted-recut", "openingsForWall writes clamp back to p.offsetAlongHost", /p\\.offsetAlongHost\\s*=\\s*offset/.test(authSrc));
check("hosted-recut", "wall build still dispatches openings to builder", /openingsForWall\\(el\\.id\\)/.test(authSrc) && /buildWallWithOpenings\\(el, openings\\)/.test(authSrc));
check("hosted-recut", "legacy builder still cuts holes from openings", /for \\(const op of openings\\)/.test(authSrc) && /new THREE\\.Path\\(\\)/.test(authSrc));
const owCount = (authSrc.match(/function openingsForWall/g) || []).length;
check("hosted-recut", "exactly one openingsForWall definition (no duplicate owner)", owCount === 1, "found " + owCount);
check("hosted-recut", "constraint-solver still exports solveHostedConstraints", /export function solveHostedConstraints/.test(read("src/features/constraint-solver.ts") || ""));

`;

function patchGuard() {
  if (!exists(GUARD_REL)) { console.log("  SKIP: " + GUARD_REL + " not found (run Add-Regression-Guard.ps1 first)"); return false; }
  let src = read(GUARD_REL);
  if (src.includes(GUARD_MARKER)) { console.log("  NO CHANGE: guard already has hosted-recut checks"); return false; }

  const anchor = "const byGroup = {};";
  const idx = src.indexOf(anchor);
  if (idx < 0) { console.log("  SKIP: guard report anchor not found"); return false; }

  backup(GUARD_REL);
  src = src.slice(0, idx) + GUARD_BLOCK + src.slice(idx);
  fs.writeFileSync(full(GUARD_REL), src, "utf8");
  console.log("  PATCHED: guard extended with [hosted-recut] checks");
  return true;
}

console.log("");
console.log("Applying hosted re-cut patch...");
console.log("");
patchAuthoring();
patchGuard();
console.log("");
console.log("Hosted re-cut patch applied (IFC authored-void export intentionally deferred).");
```

```js
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const src = path.join(__dirname, "..", "node_modules", "web-ifc");
const dest = path.join(__dirname, "..", "public", "web-ifc");
if (!fs.existsSync(src)) {
  console.warn("[copy-wasm] node_modules/web-ifc missing — run npm install");
  process.exit(0);
}
fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true });
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(src)) {
  const from = path.join(src, f);
  if (!fs.statSync(from).isFile()) continue;
  if (/\.(wasm|js|mjs|data)$/i.test(f) || f.startsWith("web-ifc")) {
    fs.copyFileSync(from, path.join(dest, f));
  }
}
const wasm = path.join(dest, "web-ifc.wasm");
console.log(fs.existsSync(wasm) ? "[copy-wasm] OK " + wasm : "[copy-wasm] FAILED — web-ifc.wasm not found");
```

--- FILE: scripts/copy-web-ifc.mjs ---
```js
/**
 * Copies node_modules/web-ifc/* into public/web-ifc/*
 * so the runtime can fetch them at /web-ifc/<file>.
 * Runs as a postinstall hook and can be called directly:
 *   node scripts/copy-web-ifc.mjs
 */
import {
  copyFileSync,
  existsSync,
  mkdirSync,
  readdirSync,
  statSync,
} from "node:fs";
import { resolve, join, dirname } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const root = resolve(__dirname, "..");
const src  = resolve(root, "node_modules", "web-ifc");
const dst  = resolve(root, "public", "web-ifc");

if (!existsSync(src)) {
  console.log("[copy-web-ifc] node_modules/web-ifc not found — skipping.");
  process.exit(0);
}

mkdirSync(dst, { recursive: true });

let n = 0;
for (const f of readdirSync(src)) {
  const s = join(src, f);
  if (!statSync(s).isFile()) continue;
  copyFileSync(s, join(dst, f));
  n++;
}
console.log(`[copy-web-ifc] Copied ${n} file(s) → public/web-ifc/`);
```

```js
import fs from "node:fs"; import path from "node:path";
const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const rel = "src/features/authoring.ts";
const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, rel), "utf8");
const lines = src.split(/\r?\n/);
function braceEnd(i){ let d=0,ins=false,q="",esc=false; for(;i<src.length;i++){const ch=src[i]; if(ins){if(esc)esc=false;else if(ch==="\\")esc=true;else if(ch===q)ins=false;continue;} if(ch==='"'||ch==="'"||ch==="`"){ins=true;q=ch;continue;} if(ch==="{")d++; else if(ch==="}"){d--; if(d===0)return i;} } return -1; }
function fnBody(name){ const re=new RegExp("function\\s+"+name+"\\s*\\("); const m=re.exec(src); if(!m){console.log("  (no "+name+")");return;} const st=m.index+m[0].indexOf("{"); const en=braceEnd(st); const a=src.slice(0,st).split("\n").length; const b=src.slice(0,en+1).split("\n").length; console.log("\n===== "+name+"  lines "+a+"-"+b+" ====="); console.log(lines.slice(a-1,b).map((l,k)=>String(a+k).padStart(5)+"| "+l).join("\n")); }
function win(re,radius,label,max){ const out=[]; for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++){ re.lastIndex=0; if(re.test(lines[i])){ const a=Math.max(0,i-radius),b=Math.min(lines.length-1,i+radius); out.push({a:a+1,b:b+1,t:lines.slice(a,b+1).map((l,k)=>String(a+k+1).padStart(5)+"| "+l).join("\n")}); } } console.log("\n===== "+label+"  ("+out.length+" hit(s)) ====="); out.slice(0,max||6).forEach(w=>{console.log("--- lines "+w.a+"-"+w.b+" ---");console.log(w.t);}); if(out.length>(max||6))console.log("  ...+"+(out.length-(max||6))+" more..."); }
console.log("authoring.ts lines:", lines.length);
fnBody("buildDoor"); fnBody("buildWindow");
win(/^export function rebuild\b|^function rebuild\b/, 26, "rebuild() HEAD (ordering / where a pre-pass would go)", 2);
```

```js
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();

function full(rel) { return path.join(root, rel); }
function exists(rel) { try { fs.accessSync(full(rel)); return true; } catch { return false; } }
function read(rel) { try { return fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8"); } catch { return null; } }

let printed = 0;
const CAP = 700;
function out(s) {
  if (printed >= CAP) return;
  const lines = String(s).split("\n");
  printed += lines.length;
  console.log(s);
}
function truncNote() {
  if (printed >= CAP) console.log("\n... [output capped at " + CAP + " lines; re-run with a larger CAP if needed] ...");
}

function toLines(src) { return src.split(/\r?\n/); }

// Return windows of +/- radius lines around every match of re, deduped by overlap.
function windows(src, re, radius) {
  const lines = toLines(src);
  const marks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    re.lastIndex = 0;
    if (re.test(lines[i])) marks.push(i);
  }
  const ranges = [];
  for (const m of marks) {
    const a = Math.max(0, m - radius);
    const b = Math.min(lines.length - 1, m + radius);
    if (ranges.length && a <= ranges[ranges.length - 1].b + 1) {
      ranges[ranges.length - 1].b = Math.max(ranges[ranges.length - 1].b, b);
      ranges[ranges.length - 1].hits.push(m);
    } else {
      ranges.push({ a, b, hits: [m] });
    }
  }
  return ranges.map((r) => ({
    start: r.a + 1,
    end: r.b + 1,
    hits: r.hits.map((h) => h + 1),
    text: lines.slice(r.a, r.b + 1).map((l, k) => String(r.a + k + 1).padStart(5, " ") + "| " + l).join("\n"),
  }));
}

function printWindows(title, wins, max) {
  out("\n============================== " + title + " ==============================");
  if (!wins.length) { out("  (no matches)"); return; }
  const show = wins.slice(0, max);
  for (const w of show) {
    out("  --- lines " + w.start + "-" + w.end + "  (anchor hit(s) at line " + w.hits.join(", ") + ") ---");
    out(w.text);
    out("");
  }
  if (wins.length > max) out("  ... +" + (wins.length - max) + " more window(s) suppressed ...");
}

const GEOM_TOKENS = /new THREE\.Shape|\.holes|ExtrudeGeometry|BufferGeometry|setAttribute\(\s*["']position|Float32Array|makeGeometry|buildGeometry|toGeometry|extrude|lathe|revolve/i;
const OPEN_TOKEN = /openings/i;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. authoring.ts : wall/beam geometry builder + openings consumption + move rebuild
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const authRel = "src/features/authoring.ts";
const auth = read(authRel);

let geomHonorsOpenings = "unknown";
let geomEvidence = "";
let rebuildOnMove = "unknown";
let rebuildEvidence = "";

if (auth) {
  out("\n>>> Reading " + authRel + "  (" + auth.length + " bytes, " + toLines(auth).length + " lines)");

  // A) Where are openings referenced at all?
  const openWins = windows(auth, OPEN_TOKEN, 6);
  printWindows("AUTHORING :: openings references", openWins, 6);

  // B) Wall/beam geometry builder anchors
  const builderRe = /function\s+\w*(?:[Ww]all|[Bb]eam|[Ss]trip|[Mm]line|[Ee]lement|[Mm]esh|[Gg]eometry|rebuild)\w*\s*\(|(?:const|let|var)\s+\w*(?:[Ww]allGeom|buildWall|makeWall|wallGeometry|elementToMesh|buildElement|rebuildAuthored)\b|rebuildAuthored\s*[=:(]|markAuthoringDirty\s*[=:(]/;
  const builderWins = windows(auth, builderRe, 14);
  printWindows("AUTHORING :: geometry / rebuild builder anchors", builderWins, 8);

  // Verdict A: does any openings-window ALSO contain a geometry token?
  for (const w of openWins) {
    if (GEOM_TOKENS.test(w.text)) {
      geomHonorsOpenings = "YES";
      geomEvidence = "openings window at lines " + w.start + "-" + w.end + " contains a geometry-construction token";
      break;
    }
  }
  if (geomHonorsOpenings === "unknown") {
    // Maybe openings are read in a builder window instead
    for (const w of builderWins) {
      if (OPEN_TOKEN.test(w.text) && GEOM_TOKENS.test(w.text)) {
        geomHonorsOpenings = "YES";
        geomEvidence = "builder window at lines " + w.start + "-" + w.end + " references openings AND geometry";
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  if (geomHonorsOpenings === "unknown") {
    geomHonorsOpenings = "NO / NOT-VISIBLE";
    geomEvidence = "no window couples an openings reference with geometry construction (builder may ignore params.openings, or uses a token outside the scan set)";
  }

  // C) Move/copy/rotate op pipeline -> does it trigger a rebuild?
  const moveRe = /move-copy|PendingOp|applyMove|commitOp|setElementParams|updateElement|onElementsChanged|authoring-changed/;
  const moveWins = windows(auth, moveRe, 10);
  printWindows("AUTHORING :: move / op pipeline anchors", moveWins, 6);

  for (const w of moveWins) {
    if (/rebuildAuthored|markAuthoringDirty|authoring-changed|notifyAuthoringChange/.test(w.text)) {
      rebuildOnMove = "YES";
      rebuildEvidence = "op window at lines " + w.start + "-" + w.end + " triggers a rebuild/dirty/notify";
      break;
    }
  }
  if (rebuildOnMove === "unknown") {
    rebuildOnMove = "NOT-VISIBLE";
    rebuildEvidence = "no op window in the scanned set calls rebuildAuthored/markAuthoringDirty/notify (rebuild may be centralized elsewhere)";
  }
} else {
  out("\n!!! " + authRel + " NOT FOUND");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. Cross-tree : is there an authored -> IFC export path at all?
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
out("\n>>> Scanning src/ for an authored->IFC export path ...");

const IFC_RE = /IfcWall|IfcBeam|IfcOpeningElement|IfcRelVoidsElement|IfcRelAggregates|exportIFC|writeIFC|toIFC|IFC2X3|IFC4|IFC4X3|ifcSerializer|serializeIFC|buildIFC|createIfc/i;
const ifcHits = [];
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(["node_modules", "dist", ".git", "public"]);

function walk(dir, acc) {
  let ents;
  try { ents = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return; }
  for (const e of ents) {
    if (e.isDirectory()) {
      if (SKIP_DIRS.has(e.name)) continue;
      walk(path.join(dir, e.name), acc);
    } else if (e.isFile() && /\.(ts|tsx|mts|js|mjs)$/.test(e.name)) {
      acc.push(path.relative(root, path.join(dir, e.name)).replace(/\\/g, "/"));
    }
  }
}
const files = [];
walk(path.join(root, "src"), files);

for (const rel of files) {
  if (rel === authRel) continue; // authoring.ts already inspected above
  const t = read(rel);
  if (!t) continue;
  if (IFC_RE.test(t)) {
    const wins = windows(t, IFC_RE, 4);
    ifcHits.push({ rel, count: wins.length, first: wins[0] });

}

out("\n============================== IFC EXPORT CANDIDATES ==============================");
if (!ifcHits.length) {
  out("  NONE FOUND in src/ (excluding authoring.ts).");
  out("  => An authored->IFC void export likely does NOT exist yet; emitting IfcOpeningElement");
  out("     would be a NEW subsystem, not a small patch. Scope decision needed (see plan).");
} else {
  for (const h of ifcHits.slice(0, 12)) {
    out("  FILE: " + h.rel + "   (" + h.count + " ifc-token window(s))");
    if (h.first) out(h.first.text);
    out("");
  }
  if (ifcHits.length > 12) out("  ... +" + (ifcHits.length - 12) + " more candidate file(s) suppressed ...");
}

// Also check authoring.ts itself for ifc tokens (maybe export lives there)
let authIfc = false;
if (auth) {
  const aw = windows(auth, IFC_RE, 4);
  if (aw.length) {
    authIfc = true;
    printWindows("AUTHORING :: ifc tokens inside authoring.ts", aw, 4);
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 3. Project persistence : are openings saved/restored with the project JSON?
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
out("\n>>> Checking project persistence for openings round-trip ...");
const projRel = "src/modules/projects/projects.ts";
const proj = read(projRel);
if (proj) {
  const pw = windows(proj, /openings|serializeElement|elementToDoc|doc\.elements|params/i, 3);
  // We only need to know whether params (and thus params.openings) are persisted wholesale.
  const persistsWholeParams = /JSON\.stringify|spread|\.\.\.(?:el|element|e)\b|params:\s*\{?\s*\.\.\.|serialize/i.test(proj);

  printWindows("PROJECTS :: serialize/params anchors (sample)", pw.slice(0, 3), 3);
} else {

}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// VERDICT + PATCH PLAN
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
out("");
out("############################## VERDICT ##############################");
out("GEOMETRY_HONORS_OPENINGS : " + geomHonorsOpenings);
out("  evidence: " + geomEvidence);
out("REBUILD_ON_MOVE          : " + rebuildOnMove);
out("  evidence: " + rebuildEvidence);
out("IFC_EXPORT_PATH          : " + (ifcHits.length || authIfc ? "FOUND (see candidates above)" : "NONE-FOUND (new subsystem required)"));
out("PROJECT_OPENINGS_PERSIST : see heuristic above");
```

```js
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

async function exists(p) {
  try { await fs.access(p); return true; } catch { return false; }
}
async function backup(rel) {
  const full = path.join(root, rel);
  if (await exists(full)) await fs.copyFile(full, full + ".bak-" + stamp);
}
async function read(rel) { return fs.readFile(path.join(root, rel), "utf8"); }
async function write(rel, s) { await fs.writeFile(path.join(root, rel), s, "utf8"); }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. drafting-bridge.ts : fix TS2345 on the raycaster camera argument
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function fixDraftingBridge() {
  const rel = "src/features/drafting-bridge.ts";
  if (!(await exists(path.join(root, rel)))) { console.log("SKIP: " + rel); return; }
  let s = await read(rel);
  const before = s;

  // Primary: cast at the call site (unique anchor).
  s = s.replace(
    "new THREE.Vector2(ndcX, ndcY), cam)",
    "new THREE.Vector2(ndcX, ndcY), cam as unknown as THREE.Camera)"
  );

  // Fallback (if formatting differed): loosen the local declaration.
  if (s === before) {
    s = s.replace(
      "const cam = cont.world?.camera?.three as Any;",
      "const cam = cont.world?.camera?.three as any;"
    );
  }

  if (s !== before) {
    await backup(rel);
    await write(rel, s);
    console.log("PATCHED: " + rel + " (camera cast)");
  } else if (s.includes("cam as unknown as THREE.Camera") || s.includes("camera?.three as any")) {
    console.log("NO CHANGE: " + rel + " (already fixed)");
  } else {
    console.log("SKIP: " + rel + " (anchor not found)");
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. index.html : silence /favicon.ico 404 with an empty icon link
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function fixFavicon() {
  const rel = "index.html";
  if (!(await exists(path.join(root, rel)))) { console.log("SKIP: " + rel); return; }
  let s = await read(rel);
  if (/rel=["']icon["']/i.test(s) || /rel=["']shortcut icon["']/i.test(s)) {
    console.log("NO CHANGE: " + rel + " (icon link present)");
    return;
  }
  const m = s.match(/<head[^>]*>/i);
  if (!m) { console.log("SKIP: " + rel + " (no <head>)"); return; }
  const insertAt = m.index + m[0].length;
  s = s.slice(0, insertAt) + "\n    <link rel=\"icon\" href=\"data:,\">" + s.slice(insertAt);
  await backup(rel);
  await write(rel, s);
  console.log("PATCHED: " + rel + " (favicon suppressed)");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 3. vite.config.ts : dedupe Lit so only ONE copy loads (kills the warning
//    and prevents double custom-element registration / dropped reactivity)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function dedupeLit() {
  const rel = "vite.config.ts";
  if (!(await exists(path.join(root, rel)))) { console.log("SKIP: " + rel); return; }
  let s = await read(rel);
  const before = s;

  const already = /dedupe\s*:/.test(s) && /["']lit["']/.test(s);
  if (already) { console.log("NO CHANGE: " + rel + " (lit dedupe present)"); return; }

  const arr = '["lit", "lit-html", "lit-element", "@lit/reactive-element"]';

  const resolveIdx = s.indexOf("resolve:");
  if (resolveIdx >= 0) {
    const braceIdx = s.indexOf("{", resolveIdx);
    if (braceIdx >= 0) {
      s = s.slice(0, braceIdx + 1) + "\n    dedupe: " + arr + "," + s.slice(braceIdx + 1);
    }
  } else {
    const dcIdx = s.indexOf("defineConfig(");
    if (dcIdx >= 0) {
      const braceIdx = s.indexOf("{", dcIdx);
      if (braceIdx >= 0) {
        s = s.slice(0, braceIdx + 1) + "\n  resolve: { dedupe: " + arr + " }," + s.slice(braceIdx + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  if (s !== before) {
    await backup(rel);
    await write(rel, s);
    console.log("PATCHED: " + rel + " (Lit dedupe added)");
  } else {
    console.log("SKIP: " + rel + " (no safe anchor)");
  }
}

async function main() {
  console.log("");
  console.log("Running finalize patch...");
  console.log("");
  await fixDraftingBridge();
  await fixFavicon();
  await dedupeLit();
  console.log("");
  console.log("Finalize patch completed.");
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });
```
