```js
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const rel = "vite.config.ts";
const full = path.join(root, rel);
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

let src;
try { src = await fs.readFile(full, "utf8"); }
catch (e) { console.log("SKIP: cannot read " + rel + " (" + (e.code || e.message) + ")"); process.exit(0); }

// Idempotent: already done?
if (/target:\s*["']esnext["']/.test(src)) {
  console.log("NO CHANGE: build.target already esnext.");
  process.exit(0);
}

function findMatchingBrace(text, start) {
  if (text[start] !== "{") return -1;
  let depth = 0, inStr = false, q = "", esc = false;
  for (let i = start; i < text.length; i++) {
    const ch = text[i];
    if (inStr) {
      if (esc) esc = false;
      else if (ch === "\\") esc = true;
      else if (ch === q) inStr = false;
      continue;
    }
    if (ch === '"' || ch === "'" || ch === "`") { inStr = true; q = ch; continue; }
    if (ch === "{") depth++;
    else if (ch === "}") { depth--; if (depth === 0) return i; }
  }
  return -1;
}

// Parse a JS value starting at index i (after a colon). Returns end index (exclusive).
function parseValue(text, i) {
  while (i < text.length && /\s/.test(text[i])) i++;
  const ch = text[i];
  if (ch === '"' || ch === "'" || ch === "`") {
    const q = ch; i++;
    while (i < text.length) {
      if (text[i] === "\\") { i += 2; continue; }
      if (text[i] === q) { i++; break; }
      i++;
    }
    return i;
  }
  if (ch === "[" || ch === "{") {
    const open = ch, close = ch === "[" ? "]" : "}";
    let depth = 0, inStr = false, sq = "", esc = false;
    for (; i < text.length; i++) {
      const c = text[i];
      if (inStr) {
        if (esc) esc = false;
        else if (c === "\\") esc = true;
        else if (c === sq) inStr = false;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === '"' || c === "'" || c === "`") { inStr = true; sq = c; continue; }
      if (c === open) depth++;
      else if (c === close) { depth--; if (depth === 0) return i + 1; }
    }
    return i;
  }
  // bare token: identifier / number / true / false / null
  while (i < text.length && !/[,;)\}\s]/.test(text[i])) i++;
  return i;
}

let changed = false;

// 1) Is there a top-level build: { ... } ?
const bm = /(^|[^\w$.])build\s*:\s*\{/m.exec(src);

if (bm) {
  const braceIdx = bm.index + bm[0].length - 1;
  const endIdx = findMatchingBrace(src, braceIdx);

  if (endIdx > braceIdx) {
    const inner = src.slice(braceIdx + 1, endIdx);
    const tm = /(^|[^\w$.])target\s*:/.exec(inner);

    if (tm) {
      // Replace the existing target value (scalar OR array) with "esnext".
      const colonAbs = braceIdx + 1 + tm.index + tm[0].length - 1;
      const valStart = colonAbs + 1;
      const valEnd = parseValue(src, valStart);
      const cur = src.slice(valStart, valEnd).trim();
      if (cur === '"esnext"' || cur === "'esnext'" || cur === "`esnext`") {
        // already esnext (shouldn't reach here due to top guard, but safe)
      } else {
        src = src.slice(0, valStart) + ' "esnext"' + src.slice(valEnd);
        changed = true;
        console.log("PATCHED: replaced existing build.target value with esnext.");
      }
    } else {
      // build block exists but has no target -> insert one.
      src = src.slice(0, braceIdx + 1) + ' target: "esnext",' + src.slice(braceIdx + 1);
      changed = true;
      console.log("PATCHED: inserted target into existing build block.");
    }
  } else {
    console.log("WARN: build: { found but brace match failed; falling back to insert.");
  }
}

// 2) No usable build block -> add a fresh one right after defineConfig({
if (!changed) {
  const dc = src.indexOf("defineConfig(");
  if (dc < 0) { console.log("SKIP: defineConfig( anchor not found."); process.exit(0); }
  const ob = src.indexOf("{", dc);
  if (ob < 0) { console.log("SKIP: no opening brace after defineConfig(."); process.exit(0); }
  src = src.slice(0, ob + 1) + '\n  build: { target: "esnext" },' + src.slice(ob + 1);
  changed = true;
  console.log("PATCHED: added new build: { target: \"esnext\" } block.");
}

if (!changed) { console.log("NO CHANGE."); process.exit(0); }

await fs.copyFile(full, full + ".bak-" + stamp);
await fs.writeFile(full, src, "utf8");
console.log("WROTE: " + rel);
```

```js
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

async function existsFile(fullPath) {
  try {
    await fs.access(fullPath);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

async function backup(rel) {
  const full = path.join(root, rel);
  if (!(await existsFile(full))) return false;
  await fs.copyFile(full, full + ".bak-" + stamp);
  return true;
}

async function read(rel) {
  return fs.readFile(path.join(root, rel), "utf8");
}

async function write(rel, content) {
  await fs.writeFile(path.join(root, rel), content, "utf8");
}

function stripNonAscii(value) {
  return String(value || "").replace(/[^\x20-\x7E]/g, "");
}

function cleanIconValue(value) {
  let clean = stripNonAscii(value).trim();

  if (/^[?\uFFFD]+$/.test(clean)) {
    clean = "";
  }

  return clean;
}

function cleanIcons(src) {
  let changed = false;

  src = src.replace(/icon:\s*"([^"]*)"/g, (match, value) => {
    const clean = cleanIconValue(value);
    if (clean !== value) changed = true;
    return 'icon: "' + clean + '"';
  });

  src = src.replace(/icon:\s*'([^']*)'/g, (match, value) => {
    const clean = cleanIconValue(value);
    if (clean !== value) changed = true;
    return "icon: '" + clean + "'";
  });

  return { src, changed };
}

function findMatchingBrace(src, start) {
  if (src[start] !== "{") return -1;

  let depth = 0;
  let inString = false;
  let quote = "";
  let escaped = false;

  for (let i = start; i < src.length; i++) {
    const ch = src[i];

    if (inString) {
      if (escaped) {
        escaped = false;
      } else if (ch === "\\") {
        escaped = true;
      } else if (ch === quote) {
        inString = false;
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (ch === '"' || ch === "'" || ch === "`") {
      inString = true;
      quote = ch;
      continue;
    }

    if (ch === "{") {
      depth++;
    } else if (ch === "}") {
      depth--;
      if (depth === 0) return i;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}

const newFocusObject = `{
            type: "action",
            text: "Focus",
            icon: "",
            onclick: () => {
              void (async () => {
                try {
                  const m: any = await import("./focus-service");
                  const ev: any = (window as any).__obsLastCtxEvent ?? null;
                  const ok = await m.focusSelected(ev);

                  if (!ok) {
                    try {
                      const n: any = await import("../core/notify");
                      n.toast?.("Nothing selected to focus.", "warn");
                    } catch {
                      /* notify optional */
                    }
                  }
                } catch (err) {
                  console.warn("[context-menu] Focus selected object failed", err);
                }
              })();
            },
          }`;

function replaceFocusItems(src) {
  const re = /text:\s*["']Focus["']/g;
  const indexes = [];
  let m;

  while ((m = re.exec(src))) {
    indexes.push(m.index);
  }

  let changed = false;

  for (let i = indexes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const textIndex = indexes[i];
    const start = src.lastIndexOf("{", textIndex);

    if (start < 0) continue;

    const end = findMatchingBrace(src, start);

    if (end < 0 || end < textIndex) continue;

    src = src.slice(0, start) + newFocusObject + src.slice(end + 1);
    changed = true;
  }

  return { src, changed };
}

function ensureCtxEventStorage(src) {
  if (src.includes("__obsLastCtxEvent")) {
    return { src, changed: false };
  }

  const re = /(async\s+)?function\s+openCtxMenu\s*\(\s*e:\s*MouseEvent\s*\)\s*\{/;
  const m = src.match(re);

  if (!m) {
    return { src, changed: false };
  }

  const insertAt = m.index + m[0].length;
  const injection = "\n  (window as any).__obsLastCtxEvent = e;";

  return {
    src: src.slice(0, insertAt) + injection + src.slice(insertAt),
    changed: true,
  };
}

const newRmbHandler = `if (g.kind !== "rmb-click") return false;
void (async () => {
  try {
    const selMod: any = await import("./selection");
    const auth: any = (ctx as any).features?.authoring;

    const authIdsRaw = auth?.getSelectedIds?.() ?? [];
    const authIds: string[] = Array.from(authIdsRaw as any).map((x: any) => String(x));

    const snap = selMod.selection?.snapshot?.() ?? {};
    const fragSelected: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};
    let fragCount = 0;

    for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(snap)) {
      if (ids instanceof Set && ids.size) {
        fragSelected[String(modelId)] = ids;
        fragCount += ids.size;
      }
    }

    const authoredIdRaw = auth?.pickAuthoredElementAt?.(g.event as MouseEvent) ?? null;
    const hit = authoredIdRaw ? null : await selMod.pickFragmentAtPointer?.();

    if (authoredIdRaw) {
      const id = String(authoredIdRaw);

      if (!authIds.includes(id) && fragCount === 0) {
        auth?.setSelectedAuthored?.([...authIds, id], "replace");
      }
    } else if (hit) {
      const modelKey = String(hit.modelId);
      const set = fragSelected[modelKey];
      const already = !!set && set.has(hit.localId);

      if (!already && authIds.length === 0) {
        selMod.selection.applyClick(hit.modelId, hit.localId, { ctrl: true });
        await selMod.selection.applyToHighlighter?.();
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[context-menu] right-click preserve selection failed", err);
  }

  await openCtxMenu(g.event);
})();
return true;`;

function patchRmbHandler(src) {
  const reMarker = /if\s*\(\s*g\.kind\s*!==?\s*["']rmb-click["']\s*\)\s*return\s+false\s*;/;
  const mm = src.match(reMarker);

  if (!mm) {
    return { src, changed: false };
  }

  const start = mm.index;
  const markerLength = mm[0].length;
  const rest = src.slice(start + markerLength);

  const reReturn = /return\s+true\s*;/g;
  let r;
  let endRel = -1;

  while ((r = reReturn.exec(rest))) {
    const after = rest.slice(r.index + r[0].length);

    if (/^\s*\}/.test(after)) {
      endRel = r.index + r[0].length;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (endRel < 0) {
    reReturn.lastIndex = 0;
    r = reReturn.exec(rest);

    if (r) {
      endRel = r.index + r[0].length;
    }
  }

  if (endRel < 0) {
    return { src, changed: false };
  }

  const replacementStart = start;
  const replacementEnd = start + markerLength + endRel;

  return {
    src: src.slice(0, replacementStart) + newRmbHandler + src.slice(replacementEnd),
    changed: true,
  };
}

const focusService = `import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

function w(): Any {
  return window as Any;
}

function c(): Any {
  return (ctx as Any) || w().__OBS_CTX__ || {};
}

function asSet(v: any): Set<number> {
  const out = new Set<number>();

  if (!v) return out;

  if (v instanceof Set) {
    for (const x of v) {
      const n = Number(x);
      if (Number.isFinite(n)) out.add(n);
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    for (const x of v) {
      const n = Number(x);
      if (Number.isFinite(n)) out.add(n);
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) {
    out.add(v);
  }

  return out;
}

function mergeMap(
  target: Record<string, Set<number>>,
  source: any,
): void {
  if (!source || typeof source !== "object") return;

  if (source instanceof Map) {
    for (const [modelId, value] of source.entries()) {
      const ids = asSet(value);
      if (!ids.size) continue;

      const key = String(modelId);

      if (!target[key]) {
        target[key] = new Set<number>();
      }

      for (const id of ids) {
        target[key].add(id);
      }
    }

    return;
  }

  for (const [modelId, value] of Object.entries(source)) {
    const ids = asSet(value);
    if (!ids.size) continue;

    const key = String(modelId);

    if (!target[key]) {
      target[key] = new Set<number>();
    }

    for (const id of ids) {
      target[key].add(id);
    }
  }
}

function getFragmentSelection(): Record<string, Set<number>> {
  const out: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};
  const cont = c();

  const sources: any[] = [
    cont.features?.selection,
    cont.selection,
    cont.highlighter,
    cont.highlighter?.selection,
    cont.features?.selectionManager,
    cont.selectionManager,
    w().__obsSelection,
    w().__obsSelectionManager,
  ];

  for (const s of sources) {
    if (!s) continue;

    let snap: any = null;

    if (typeof s.snapshot === "function") {
      try {
        snap = s.snapshot();
      } catch {
        snap = null;
      }
    }

    if (!snap && s.selection && typeof s.selection === "object") {
      snap = s.selection;
    }

    if (!snap && typeof s === "object" && !(s instanceof Map)) {
      const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(s);

      if (proto === Object.prototype || proto === null) {
        snap = s;
      }
    }

    if (snap) {
      mergeMap(out, snap);
    }
  }

  return out;
}

function getAuthoredSelection(): string[] {
  const cont = c();
  const auth = cont.features?.authoring || w().__obsAuthoring;

  const raw =
    auth?.getSelectedIds?.() ??
    auth?.selectedIds ??
    auth?.selection ??
    [];

  return Array.from(raw as any)
    .map((x: any) => String(x))
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function boxFromAnyBox(b: any): THREE.Box3 | null {
  if (!b) return null;

  if (b.isBox3) {
    return new THREE.Box3().copy(b);
  }

  if (b.min && b.max) {
    try {
      return new THREE.Box3(
        new THREE.Vector3(b.min.x, b.min.y, b.min.z),
        new THREE.Vector3(b.max.x, b.max.y, b.max.z),
      );
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function includeObject(obj: any, box: THREE.Box3): void {
  if (!obj) return;

  if (obj.isMesh) {
    const geo = obj.geometry;

    if (!geo) return;

    if (!geo.boundingBox) {
      try {
        geo.computeBoundingBox();
      } catch {
        return;
      }
    }

    const bb = geo.boundingBox;

    if (bb && !bb.isEmpty()) {
      box.union(bb.clone().applyMatrix4(obj.matrixWorld));
    }

    return;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(obj.children)) {
    for (const child of obj.children) {
      includeObject(child, box);
    }
  }
}

function getAuthoredBox(ids: string[]): THREE.Box3 | null {
  const cont = c();
  const auth = cont.features?.authoring || w().__obsAuthoring;

  if (!auth || !ids.length) return null;

  const elements = auth.getElements?.() ?? auth.elements ?? [];
  const box = new THREE.Box3();

  for (const id of ids) {
    const el = (elements as any[]).find(
      (x: any) => String(x?.id) === id,
    );

    if (!el) continue;

    const candidates = [
      auth.getElementWorldBox?.(el),
      auth.getWorldBox?.(el),
      auth.getBoundingBox?.(el),
      el.worldBox,
      el.box,
      el.boundingBox,
    ];

    let added = false;

    for (const cand of candidates) {
      const b = boxFromAnyBox(cand);

      if (b && !b.isEmpty()) {
        box.union(b);
        added = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!added) {
      includeObject(el.mesh ?? el.three ?? el.object ?? el, box);
    }
  }

  return box.isEmpty() ? null : box;
}

async function getFragmentBox(
  frag: Record<string, Set<number>>,
): Promise<THREE.Box3 | null> {
  const entries = Object.entries(frag).filter(
    ([, ids]) => ids instanceof Set && ids.size,
  );

  if (!entries.length) return null;

  const box = new THREE.Box3();
  const cont = c();

  try {
    const wbMod: any = await import("../modules/geometry/world-box");

    for (const [modelId, ids] of entries) {
      const model: any =
        cont.fragments?.list?.get?.(modelId) ??
        cont.fragments?.list?.get?.(String(modelId));

      if (!model) continue;

      const idList = [...ids]
        .map(Number)
        .filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n));

      if (!idList.length) continue;

      const wbs = await wbMod.getElementWorldBoxes?.(
        model,
        idList,
        modelId,
      );

      for (const item of wbs ?? []) {
        const b = boxFromAnyBox(item?.box ?? item);

        if (b && !b.isEmpty()) {
          box.union(b);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[focus-service] world-box failed", err);
  }

  if (!box.isEmpty()) return box;

  const scene: any = cont.world?.scene?.three ?? cont.world?.scene;

  if (scene && typeof scene.traverse === "function") {
    try {
      scene.updateMatrixWorld?.(true);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }

    const lookup = new Map<string, Set<string>>();

    for (const [modelId, ids] of entries) {
      const set = new Set<string>();

      for (const id of ids) {
        set.add(String(id));
      }

      if (set.size) {
        lookup.set(String(modelId), set);
      }
    }

    scene.traverse((obj: Any) => {
      const ud = obj?.userData || {};

      const mid = String(
        ud.modelID ??
          ud.modelId ??
          ud.model ??
          ud.fragmentModelID ??
          ud.ownerModelID ??
          "",
      );

      const lid = String(
        ud.expressID ??
          ud.localID ??
          ud.localId ??
          ud.id ??
          ud.elementID ??
          ud.instanceID ??
          "",
      );

      if (!mid || !lid) return;

      const set = lookup.get(mid);

      if (set?.has(lid)) {
        includeObject(obj, box);
      }
    });
  }

  return box.isEmpty() ? null : box;
}

function getCurrentTarget(cam: Any, controls: Any): THREE.Vector3 {
  const t = new THREE.Vector3();

  try {
    if (typeof controls?.getTarget === "function") {
      controls.getTarget(t);

      if (
        Number.isFinite(t.x) &&
        Number.isFinite(t.y) &&
        Number.isFinite(t.z)
      ) {
        return t;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  try {
    const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
    cam.getWorldDirection(dir);
    t.copy(cam.position).addScaledVector(dir, 10);
  } catch {
    t.set(0, 0, 0);
  }

  return t;
}

function focusBoxManual(box: THREE.Box3): boolean {
  const cont = c();
  const cam: Any = cont.world?.camera?.three;
  const controls: Any = cont.world?.camera?.controls;

  if (!cam || box.isEmpty()) return false;

  const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  const size = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
  const maxDim = Math.max(size.x, size.y, size.z, 0.001);

  const target = center.clone();
  const currentTarget = getCurrentTarget(cam, controls);

  const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(cam.position, currentTarget);

  if (!Number.isFinite(dir.lengthSq()) || dir.lengthSq() < 1e-8) {
    dir.set(0, 0.35, 1);
  }

  dir.normalize();

  let distance: number;

  if (cam.isOrthographicCamera) {
    distance = Math.max(maxDim * 2.5, 1);

    const height = Math.abs(Number(cam.top ?? 1) - Number(cam.bottom ?? -1));
    const width = Math.abs(Number(cam.right ?? 1) - Number(cam.left ?? -1));

    const zoomY = height / Math.max(maxDim * 1.35, 0.0001);
    const zoomX = width / Math.max(maxDim * 1.35, 0.0001);
    const zoom = Math.min(zoomX, zoomY);

    cam.zoom = Math.max(0.0001, Math.min(100000, Number(zoom) || 1));
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  } else {
    const fov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(Number(cam.fov) || 50);
    distance = ((maxDim / 2) / Math.tan(fov / 2)) * 1.75;
    distance = Math.max(distance, maxDim * 0.85);
  }

  const pos = target.clone().addScaledVector(dir, distance);

  try {
    if (typeof controls?.setLookAt === "function") {
      controls.setLookAt(
        pos.x,
        pos.y,
        pos.z,
        target.x,
        target.y,
        target.z,
        true,
      );

      controls.update?.(0);
    } else {
      cam.position.copy(pos);
      cam.lookAt(target);
    }
  } catch {
    cam.position.copy(pos);

    try {
      cam.lookAt(target);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:camera-changed"));
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  return true;
}

async function applyBox(box: THREE.Box3): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!box || box.isEmpty()) return false;

  try {
    const cam: any = await import("./camera-tools");

    if (typeof cam.focusOnBox === "function") {
      await cam.focusOnBox(box);
      return true;
    }
  } catch {
    /* fallback below */
  }

  return focusBoxManual(box);
}

async function tryFitToMap(frag: any): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const cam: any = await import("./camera-tools");

    if (typeof cam.fitToMap === "function") {
      await cam.fitToMap(frag);
      return true;
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  return false;
}

async function pickAndFocus(event: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!event) return false;

  const cont = c();
  const auth = cont.features?.authoring || w().__obsAuthoring;

  try {
    const authoredId = auth?.pickAuthoredElementAt?.(event);

    if (authoredId) {
      const ids = [String(authoredId)];
      auth?.setSelectedAuthored?.(ids, "replace");

      const box = getAuthoredBox(ids);

      if (box) {
        return await applyBox(box);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  try {
    const selMod: any = await import("./selection");
    const hit = await selMod.pickFragmentAtPointer?.();

    if (hit) {
      const lid = Number(hit.localId);

      selMod.selection?.applyClick?.(hit.modelId, hit.localId, {});
      await selMod.selection?.applyToHighlighter?.();

      if (Number.isFinite(lid)) {
        const frag: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};
        frag[String(hit.modelId)] = new Set<number>([lid]);

        const box = await getFragmentBox(frag);

        if (box) {
          return await applyBox(box);
        }

        return await tryFitToMap(frag);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  return false;
}

export async function focusSelected(event?: any): Promise<boolean> {
  const authIds = getAuthoredSelection();
  const frag = getFragmentSelection();

  const box = new THREE.Box3();
  let has = false;

  if (authIds.length) {
    const ab = getAuthoredBox(authIds);

    if (ab) {
      box.union(ab);
      has = true;
    }
  }

  if (Object.keys(frag).length) {
    const fb = await getFragmentBox(frag);

    if (fb) {
      box.union(fb);
      has = true;
    }
  }

  if (has && !box.isEmpty()) {
    return await applyBox(box);
  }

  if (Object.keys(frag).length) {
    const ok = await tryFitToMap(frag);

    if (ok) return true;
  }

  if (authIds.length) {
    try {
      const auth: any = c().features?.authoring;

      if (typeof auth?.focusSelected === "function") {
        await auth.focusSelected();
        return true;
      }
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

  return await pickAndFocus(event ?? (w() as Any).__obsLastCtxEvent ?? null);
}

(w() as Any).__obsFocusSelected = focusSelected;

(w() as Any).__obsFocusService = {
  focusSelected,
  getAuthoredSelection,
  getFragmentSelection,
};

console.log("[focus-service] ready");
```

```js
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

async function existsFile(fullPath) {
  try {
    await fs.access(fullPath);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

async function backup(rel) {
  const full = path.join(root, rel);
  if (!(await existsFile(full))) return false;
  await fs.copyFile(full, full + ".bak-" + stamp);
  return true;
}

async function read(rel) {
  return fs.readFile(path.join(root, rel), "utf8");
}

async function write(rel, content) {
  await fs.writeFile(path.join(root, rel), content, "utf8");
}

function cleanIconValue(value) {
  let clean = String(value || "").replace(/[^\x20-\x7E]/g, "").trim();

  if (/^[?\uFFFD]+$/.test(clean)) {
    clean = "";
  }

  return clean;
}

function cleanIcons(src) {
  let changed = false;

  src = src.replace(/icon:\s*"([^"]*)"/g, (match, value) => {
    const clean = cleanIconValue(value);
    if (clean !== value) changed = true;
    return 'icon: "' + clean + '"';
  });

  src = src.replace(/icon:\s*'([^']*)'/g, (match, value) => {
    const clean = cleanIconValue(value);
    if (clean !== value) changed = true;
    return "icon: '" + clean + "'";
  });

  return { src, changed };
}

function findMatchingBraceForward(src, start) {
  if (src[start] !== "{") return -1;

  let depth = 0;
  let inString = false;
  let quote = "";
  let escaped = false;

  for (let i = start; i < src.length; i++) {
    const ch = src[i];

    if (inString) {
      if (escaped) {
        escaped = false;
      } else if (ch === "\\") {
        escaped = true;
      } else if (ch === quote) {
        inString = false;
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (ch === '"' || ch === "'" || ch === "`") {
      inString = true;
      quote = ch;
      continue;
    }

    if (ch === "{") {
      depth++;
    } else if (ch === "}") {
      depth--;
      if (depth === 0) return i;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}

function patchFocusItems(src) {
  const focusObjectLines = [
    "{",
    '            type: "action",',
    '            text: "Focus",',
    '            icon: "",',
    "            onclick: () => {",
    "              void (async () => {",
    "                try {",
    '                  const m: any = await import("./focus-service");',
    "                  const ok = await m.focusSelected();",
    "                  if (!ok) {",
    "                    try {",
    '                      const n: any = await import("../core/notify");',
    '                      n.toast?.("Nothing selected to focus.", "warn");',
    "                    } catch {",
    "                      /* notify optional */",
    "                    }",
    "                  }",
    "                } catch (err) {",
    '                  console.warn("[context-menu] Focus selected object failed", err);',
    "                }",
    "              })();",
    "            },",
    "          }",
  ];

  const focusObject = focusObjectLines.join("\n");
  const re = /text:\s*["']Focus["']/g;
  const indexes = [];
  let m;

  while ((m = re.exec(src))) {
    indexes.push(m.index);
  }

  let changed = false;

  for (let i = indexes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const textIndex = indexes[i];
    const start = src.lastIndexOf("{", textIndex);

    if (start < 0) continue;

    const end = findMatchingBraceForward(src, start);

    if (end < 0 || end < textIndex) continue;

    const before = src.slice(0, start);
    const after = src.slice(end + 1);

    src = before + focusObject + after;
    changed = true;
  }

  return { src, changed };
}

function patchRmbHandler(src) {
  const rmbReplacementLines = [
    'if (g.kind !== "rmb-click") return false;',
    "void (async () => {",
    "  try {",
    '    const selMod: any = await import("./selection");',
    "    const auth: any = (ctx as any).features?.authoring;",
    "",
    "    const authIdsRaw = auth?.getSelectedIds?.() ?? [];",
    "    const authIds: string[] = Array.from(authIdsRaw as any).map((x: any) => String(x));",
    "",
    "    const snap = selMod.selection?.snapshot?.() ?? {};",
    "    const fragSelected: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};",
    "    let fragCount = 0;",
    "",
    "    for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(snap)) {",
    "      if (ids instanceof Set && ids.size) {",
    "        fragSelected[String(modelId)] = ids;",
    "        fragCount += ids.size;",
    "      }",
    "    }",
    "",
    "    const authoredIdRaw = auth?.pickAuthoredElementAt?.(g.event as MouseEvent) ?? null;",
    "    const hit = authoredIdRaw ? null : await selMod.pickFragmentAtPointer?.();",
    "",
    "    if (authoredIdRaw) {",
    "      const id = String(authoredIdRaw);",
    "",
    "      if (!authIds.includes(id) && fragCount === 0) {",
    '        auth?.setSelectedAuthored?.([...authIds, id], "replace");',
    "      }",
    "    } else if (hit) {",
    "      const modelKey = String(hit.modelId);",
    "      const set = fragSelected[modelKey];",
    "      const already = !!set && set.has(hit.localId);",
    "",
    "      if (!already && authIds.length === 0) {",
    "        selMod.selection.applyClick(hit.modelId, hit.localId, { ctrl: true });",
    "        await selMod.selection.applyToHighlighter?.();",
    "      }",
    "    }",
    "  } catch (err) {",
    '    console.warn("[context-menu] right-click preserve selection failed", err);',
    "  }",
    "",
    "  await openCtxMenu(g.event);",
    "})();",
    "return true;",
  ];

  const replacement = rmbReplacementLines.join("\n");

  const re =
    /if\s*\(\s*g\.kind\s*!==?\s*["']rmb-click["']\s*\)\s*return\s+false\s*;[\s\S]*?return\s+true\s*;/;

  if (re.test(src)) {
    src = src.replace(re, replacement);
    return { src, changed: true };
  }

  return { src, changed: false };
}

const focusService = `import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

function w(): Any {
  return window as Any;
}

function c(): Any {
  return (ctx as Any) || w().__OBS_CTX__ || {};
}

function asSet(v: any): Set<number> {
  const out = new Set<number>();

  if (!v) return out;

  if (v instanceof Set) {
    for (const x of v) {
      const n = Number(x);
      if (Number.isFinite(n)) out.add(n);
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    for (const x of v) {
      const n = Number(x);
      if (Number.isFinite(n)) out.add(n);
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) {
    out.add(v);
  }

  return out;
}

function mergeMap(
  target: Record<string, Set<number>>,
  source: any,
): void {
  if (!source || typeof source !== "object") return;

  for (const [modelId, value] of Object.entries(source)) {
    const ids = asSet(value);
    if (!ids.size) continue;

    const key = String(modelId);

    if (!target[key]) {
      target[key] = new Set<number>();
    }

    for (const id of ids) {
      target[key].add(id);
    }
  }
}

function getFragmentSelection(): Record<string, Set<number>> {
  const out: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};
  const cont = c();

  const sources: any[] = [
    cont.features?.selection,
    cont.highlighter,
    w().__obsSelection,
  ];

  for (const s of sources) {
    if (!s) continue;

    let snap: any = null;

    if (typeof s.snapshot === "function") {
      try {
        snap = s.snapshot();
      } catch {
        snap = null;
      }
    }

    if (!snap && s.selection && typeof s.selection === "object") {
      snap = s.selection;
    }

    if (snap) {
      mergeMap(out, snap);
    }
  }

  return out;
}

function getAuthoredSelection(): string[] {
  const cont = c();
  const auth = cont.features?.authoring || w().__obsAuthoring;

  const raw =
    auth?.getSelectedIds?.() ??
    auth?.selectedIds ??
    auth?.selection ??
    [];

  return Array.from(raw as any)
    .map((x: any) => String(x))
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function boxFromAnyBox(b: any): THREE.Box3 | null {
  if (!b) return null;

  if (b.isBox3) {
    return new THREE.Box3().copy(b);
  }

  if (b.min && b.max) {
    try {
      return new THREE.Box3(
        new THREE.Vector3(b.min.x, b.min.y, b.min.z),
        new THREE.Vector3(b.max.x, b.max.y, b.max.z),
      );
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function includeObject(obj: any, box: THREE.Box3): void {
  if (!obj) return;

  if (obj.isMesh) {
    const geo = obj.geometry;

    if (!geo) return;

    if (!geo.boundingBox) {
      try {
        geo.computeBoundingBox();
      } catch {
        return;
      }
    }

    const bb = geo.boundingBox;

    if (bb && !bb.isEmpty()) {
      box.union(bb.clone().applyMatrix4(obj.matrixWorld));
    }

    return;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(obj.children)) {
    for (const child of obj.children) {
      includeObject(child, box);
    }
  }
}

function getAuthoredBox(ids: string[]): THREE.Box3 | null {
  const cont = c();
  const auth = cont.features?.authoring || w().__obsAuthoring;

  if (!auth || !ids.length) return null;

  const elements = auth.getElements?.() ?? auth.elements ?? [];
  const box = new THREE.Box3();

  for (const id of ids) {
    const el = (elements as any[]).find(
      (x: any) => String(x?.id) === id,
    );

    if (!el) continue;

    const candidates = [
      auth.getElementWorldBox?.(el),
      auth.getWorldBox?.(el),
      auth.getBoundingBox?.(el),
      el.worldBox,
      el.box,
      el.boundingBox,
    ];

    let added = false;

    for (const cand of candidates) {
      const b = boxFromAnyBox(cand);

      if (b && !b.isEmpty()) {
        box.union(b);
        added = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!added) {
      includeObject(el.mesh ?? el.three ?? el.object ?? el, box);
    }
  }

  return box.isEmpty() ? null : box;
}

function getFragmentBox(
  frag: Record<string, Set<number>>,
): THREE.Box3 | null {
  const cont = c();
  const scene = cont.world?.scene?.three ?? cont.world?.scene;

  if (!scene || !Object.keys(frag).length) return null;

  try {
    scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  const lookup = new Map<string, Set<string>>();

  for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(frag)) {
    const set = new Set<string>();

    for (const id of ids) {
      set.add(String(id));
    }

    if (set.size) {
      lookup.set(String(modelId), set);
    }
  }

  const box = new THREE.Box3();

  scene.traverse?.((obj: Any) => {
    const ud = obj?.userData || {};

    const mid = String(
      ud.modelID ??
        ud.modelId ??
        ud.model ??
        ud.fragmentModelID ??
        ud.ownerModelID ??
        "",
    );

    const lid = String(
      ud.expressID ??
        ud.localID ??
        ud.localId ??
        ud.id ??
        ud.elementID ??
        ud.instanceID ??
        "",
    );

    if (!mid || !lid) return;

    const set = lookup.get(mid);

    if (set?.has(lid)) {
      includeObject(obj, box);
    }
  });

  return box.isEmpty() ? null : box;
}

function getCurrentTarget(cam: Any, controls: Any): THREE.Vector3 {
  const t = new THREE.Vector3();

  try {
    if (typeof controls?.getTarget === "function") {
      controls.getTarget(t);

      if (Number.isFinite(t.x) && Number.isFinite(t.y) && Number.isFinite(t.z)) {
        return t;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  try {
    const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
    cam.getWorldDirection(dir);
    t.copy(cam.position).addScaledVector(dir, 10);
  } catch {
    t.set(0, 0, 0);
  }

  return t;
}

function focusBox(box: THREE.Box3): boolean {
  const cont = c();
  const cam = cont.world?.camera?.three;
  const controls = cont.world?.camera?.controls;

  if (!cam) return false;

  const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  const size = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
  const maxDim = Math.max(size.x, size.y, size.z, 0.001);

  const target = center.clone();
  const currentTarget = getCurrentTarget(cam, controls);

  const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(cam.position, currentTarget);

  if (!Number.isFinite(dir.lengthSq()) || dir.lengthSq() < 1e-8) {
    dir.set(0, 0.35, 1);
  }

  dir.normalize();

  let distance: number;

  if (cam.isOrthographicCamera) {
    distance = Math.max(maxDim * 2.5, 1);

    const height = Math.abs(cam.top - cam.bottom);
    const zoom = Math.max(
      0.0001,
      Math.min(100000, height / Math.max(maxDim * 1.35, 0.0001)),
    );

    cam.zoom = zoom;
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  } else {
    const fov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(Number(cam.fov) || 50);
    distance = (maxDim / 2) / Math.tan(fov / 2) * 1.75;
    distance = Math.max(distance, maxDim * 0.85);
  }

  const pos = target.clone().addScaledVector(dir, distance);

  try {
    if (typeof controls?.setLookAt === "function") {
      controls.setLookAt(
        pos.x,
        pos.y,
        pos.z,
        target.x,
        target.y,
        target.z,
        true,
      );

      controls.update?.(0);
    } else {
      cam.position.copy(pos);
      cam.lookAt(target);
    }
  } catch {
    cam.position.copy(pos);

    try {
      cam.lookAt(target);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:camera-changed"));
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  return true;
}

export async function focusSelected(): Promise<boolean> {
  const authIds = getAuthoredSelection();
  const frag = getFragmentSelection();

  const box = new THREE.Box3();

  const ab = authIds.length ? getAuthoredBox(authIds) : null;
  if (ab) box.union(ab);

  const fb = Object.keys(frag).length ? getFragmentBox(frag) : null;
  if (fb) box.union(fb);

  if (box.isEmpty()) {
    return false;
  }

  return focusBox(box);
}

(w() as Any).__obsFocusSelected = focusSelected;
`;
```

```js
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

function full(rel) { return path.join(root, rel); }
function exists(rel) { try { fs.accessSync(full(rel)); return true; } catch { return false; } }
function read(rel) { try { return fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8"); } catch { return null; } }
function backup(rel) {
  if (!exists(rel)) return false;
  fs.copyFileSync(full(rel), full(rel) + ".bak-" + stamp);
  console.log("  Backup: " + rel);
  return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. constraint-solver.ts : full rewrite -> button-driven, no placement race.
//    Marker: "solver-mode: button-driven". authoring.ts is NOT touched here.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const CS_REL = "src/features/constraint-solver.ts";
const CS_MARKER = "solver-mode: button-driven";

const CS_NEW = `// solver-mode: button-driven (no pointerup / no auto-rebuild race with placement)
// openingsForWall() in authoring.ts already re-clamps hosted offsets at READ time on
// the single rebuild the placement/move commit performs, so the solver must NOT also
// solve on pointerup. The [S] button calls solveHostedConstraints() deliberately.
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let solving = false;

function getFeatures(): Any {
  const c = ctx as Any;
  if (!c.features) c.features = {};
  return c.features as Any;
}

function getAuthoring(): Any | null {
  const f = getFeatures();
  return (f.authoring as Any) ?? (window as Any).__obsAuthoring ?? null;
}

function getElements(): Any[] {
  const a = getAuthoring();
  if (!a) return [];
  if (typeof a.getElements === "function") {
    try { return a.getElements() ?? []; } catch { return []; }
  }
  if (Array.isArray(a.elements)) return a.elements;
  return [];
}

function rebuildAuthoring(): void {
  const a = getAuthoring();
  if (!a) return;
  try {
    if (typeof a.rebuildAuthored === "function") a.rebuildAuthored();
    else if (typeof a.rebuild === "function") a.rebuild();
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  try {
    if (typeof a.markAuthoringDirty === "function") a.markAuthoringDirty();
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:authoring-changed", { detail: { reason: "constraint-solver" } }));
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

function pair(v: Any): [number, number] | null {
  if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length >= 2) return [Number(v[0]), Number(v[1])];
  if (v && typeof v === "object") {
    if ("x" in v && "z" in v) return [Number(v.x), Number(v.z)];
    if ("x" in v && "y" in v) return [Number(v.x), Number(v.y)];
  }
  return null;
}

export function solveHostedConstraints(): number {
  if (solving) return 0;
  solving = true;
  try {
    const elements = getElements();
    if (!elements.length) return 0;

    const hosts = new Map<string, Any>();
    for (const el of elements) {
      if (!el || !el.id || !el.params) continue;
      const t = String(el.type ?? "");
      if ((t === "wall" || t === "beam" || t === "line" || t === "mline") && el.params.start && el.params.end) {
        hosts.set(String(el.id), el);
      }
    }

    let changed = 0;
    for (const el of elements) {
      if (!el || !el.hostId || !el.params) continue;
      const t = String(el.type ?? "");
      if (t !== "door" && t !== "window" && t !== "opening" && t !== "fitting") continue;

      const host = hosts.get(String(el.hostId));
      if (!host || !host.params) continue;

      const p = el.params as Any;
      const hp = host.params as Any;
      const start = pair(hp.start);
      const end = pair(hp.end);
      if (!start || !end) continue;

      const ax = start[0], az = start[1], bx = end[0], bz = end[1];
      const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
      const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      if (!Number.isFinite(L) || L < 0.01) continue;

      const half = Number(p.width ?? p.WIDTH ?? 0.9) / 2;
      const current = Number(p.offsetAlongHost ?? p.offset ?? L / 2);
      const min = Math.min(half, L / 2);
      const max = Math.max(L - half, L / 2);
      const clamped = Math.max(min, Math.min(max, current));

      if (typeof p.offsetAlongHost !== "number" || Math.abs(clamped - current) > 1e-4) {
        p.offsetAlongHost = Math.round(clamped * 1000) / 1000;
        changed++;
      }
    }

    if (changed) rebuildAuthoring();
    return changed;
  } finally {
    solving = false;
  }
}

export function setupConstraintSolver(): void {
  const f = getFeatures();
  f.constraintSolver = { solve: solveHostedConstraints };
  (window as Any).__obsSolveHostedConstraints = solveHostedConstraints;
  console.log("[constraint-solver] button-driven ready (no pointerup auto-solve; openingsForWall clamps at read)");
}
`;

function patchConstraintSolver() {
  if (!exists(CS_REL)) { console.log("  SKIP: " + CS_REL + " not found"); return; }
  const cur = read(CS_REL) || "";
  if (cur.includes(CS_MARKER)) { console.log("  NO CHANGE: constraint-solver already button-driven"); return; }
  backup(CS_REL);
  fs.writeFileSync(full(CS_REL), CS_NEW, "utf8");
  console.log("  PATCHED: constraint-solver.ts -> button-driven (race removed)");
}

const HO_REL = "src/features/hosted-openings.ts";

function patchHostedOpenings() {
  if (!exists(HO_REL)) { console.log("  SKIP: " + HO_REL + " not found"); return; }
  let src = read(HO_REL) || "";
  if (src.includes(HO_MARKER)) { console.log("  NO CHANGE: hosted-openings already data-only"); return; }

  // Remove the const a = getAuthoring(); + the two rebuild try-blocks at the top
  // of refreshDownstream, leaving only the event dispatches. Tolerant regex.
  const re = /function refreshDownstream\(\): void \{[\s\S]*?try \{\s*\(window as Any\)\.__obsCost\?\.refresh\?\.\(\);\s*\} catch \{[\s\S]*?\}/;
  const m = re.exec(src);
  if (!m) { console.log("  SKIP: hosted-openings refreshDownstream anchor not matched"); return; }

  const replacement =
    "function refreshDownstream(): void {\n" +
    "  // " + HO_MARKER + "\n" +
    "  // 3D openings come from authoring.openingsForWall() at read time; this data\n" +
    "  // layer only refreshes schedules / cost / IFC events. It must NOT rebuild\n" +
    "  // geometry, or it races the placement commit (hollow wall / floating door).\n" +
    "  try {\n" +
    "    (window as Any).__obsProjects?.markDirty?.();\n" +
    "  } catch {\n" +
    "    // ignore\n" +
    "  }\n" +
    "  try {\n" +
    "    (window as Any).__obsSchedules?.refresh?.();\n" +
    "  } catch {\n" +
    "    // ignore\n" +
    "  }\n" +
    "  try {\n" +
    "    (window as Any).__obsCost?.refresh?.();\n" +
    "  } catch {\n" +
    "    // ignore\n" +
    "  }";

  src = src.slice(0, m.index) + replacement + src.slice(m.index + m[0].length);
  backup(HO_REL);
  fs.writeFileSync(full(HO_REL), src, "utf8");
  console.log("  PATCHED: hosted-openings.ts -> data-only refresh (no rebuild)");
}
```

```js
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

function full(rel) { return path.join(root, rel); }
function exists(rel) { try { fs.accessSync(full(rel)); return true; } catch { return false; } }
function read(rel) { try { return fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8"); } catch { return null; } }
function backup(rel) {
  if (!exists(rel)) return false;
  fs.copyFileSync(full(rel), full(rel) + ".bak-" + stamp);
  console.log("  Backup: " + rel);
  return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. NEW owned module: hosted-place-sync.ts
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const PS_REL = "src/features/hosted-place-sync.ts";
const PS_SRC = `import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

function c(): Any {
  return (ctx as Any) || (window as Any).__OBS_CTX__ || {};
}

function getAuthoring(): Any | null {
  const cont = c();
  return (cont.features as Any)?.authoring ?? (window as Any).__obsAuthoring ?? null;
}

// place-sync: reconcile hosted door/window mesh transforms to the SAME
// offsetAlongHost the wall hole and the authored grips use, after every
// rebuild. buildDoor/buildWindow build in local coords; placeHostedElement
// applies the world transform. If that transform is derived from a positional
// field the placement commit never provides, the mesh floats off the host
// while the hole stays correct. This re-places the group from offsetAlongHost
// using the author's own basis convention (makeBasis(dir, up, normal)), so
// door == hole == on-wall, deterministically, without touching the builders.
export function syncHostedPlacement(): number {
  const auth = getAuthoring();
  if (!auth) return 0;

  const els: Any[] =
    typeof auth.getElements === "function"
      ? auth.getElements() ?? []
      : Array.isArray(auth.elements)
        ? auth.elements
        : [];

  const group: Any =
    typeof auth.getAuthoredGroup === "function"
      ? auth.getAuthoredGroup()
      : auth.group ?? auth.root ?? auth.three;

  if (!group || typeof group.traverse !== "function" || !Array.isArray(group.children)) {
    return 0;
  }

  const walls = new Map<string, Any>();
  for (const e of els) {
    if (e && e.type === "wall" && e.params?.start && e.params?.end) {
      walls.set(String(e.id), e);
    }
  }

  const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  let synced = 0;

  for (const d of els) {
    if (!d || (d.type !== "door" && d.type !== "window") || !d.hostId) continue;
    const host = walls.get(String(d.hostId));
    if (!host) continue;

    const hp = host.params;
    const ax = Number(hp.start[0]);
    const az = Number(hp.start[1]);
    const bx = Number(hp.end[0]);
    const bz = Number(hp.end[1]);
    const dx = bx - ax;
    const dz = bz - az;
    const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (!(L > 1e-6)) continue;

    const ux = dx / L;
    const uz = dz / L;
    const off = Number(d.params?.offsetAlongHost ?? L / 2);
    if (!Number.isFinite(off)) continue;

    const dir = new THREE.Vector3(ux, 0, uz);
    const normal = new THREE.Vector3(-uz, 0, ux);
    const basis = new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(dir, up, normal);
    const quat = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(basis);

    const elev = Number(hp.elevation ?? 0);
    const sill = Number(d.params?.sillHeight ?? (d.type === "window" ? 0.9 : 0));
    const px = ax + ux * off;
    const pz = az + uz * off;
    const py = (Number.isFinite(elev) ? elev : 0) + (Number.isFinite(sill) ? sill : 0);

    let target: Any = null;
    for (const child of group.children) {
      let hit = false;
      try {
        child.traverse((m: Any) => {
          if (m?.isMesh && m?.userData?.elementId === d.id) hit = true;
        });
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
      if (hit) {
        target = child;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!target) continue;

    try {
      target.position.set(px, py, pz);
      target.quaternion.copy(quat);
      target.updateMatrix?.();
      synced++;
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

  return synced;
}

(window as Any).__obsSyncHostedPlacement = syncHostedPlacement;

export function setupHostedPlaceSync(): void {
  (window as Any).__obsSyncHostedPlacement = syncHostedPlacement;
  console.log(
    "[hosted-place-sync] ready: reconciles hosted door/window meshes to clamped offsetAlongHost after every rebuild",
  );
}
`;

function writePlaceSync() {
  const cur = read(PS_REL);
  if (cur && cur.includes("place-sync: reconcile hosted")) {
    console.log("  NO CHANGE: hosted-place-sync.ts already present");
    return;
  }
  backup(PS_REL);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(full(PS_REL)), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(full(PS_REL), PS_SRC, "utf8");
  console.log("  OK: " + PS_REL + " (new owned module)");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. authoring.ts : ONE anchored insert in rebuild() after refreshGrips();
//    No import added. Marker: "hosted-place-sync:". Idempotent.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const AUTH_REL = "src/features/authoring.ts";
const AUTH_MARKER = "hosted-place-sync:";

function patchAuthoringRebuild() {
  if (!exists(AUTH_REL)) { console.log("  SKIP: " + AUTH_REL + " not found"); return; }
  let src = read(AUTH_REL) || "";
  if (src.includes(AUTH_MARKER)) { console.log("  NO CHANGE: authoring.ts rebuild already calls place-sync"); return; }

  const re = /(\n([ \t]*)refreshGrips\(\);)(\s*\n[ \t]*\})/;
  if (!re.test(src)) { console.log("  SKIP: rebuild() refreshGrips anchor not matched"); return; }

  const insert =
    "$1\n$2// hosted-place-sync: reconcile hosted door/window mesh transforms to the\n" +
    "$2// clamped offsetAlongHost (same source as the wall hole) so a freshly placed\n" +
    "$2// opening cannot float off its host. No-op if the module is not loaded.\n" +
    "$2(window as any).__obsSyncHostedPlacement?.();$3";

  src = src.replace(re, insert);
  backup(AUTH_REL);
  fs.writeFileSync(full(AUTH_REL), src, "utf8");
  console.log("  PATCHED: authoring.ts rebuild() -> +1 line place-sync call (no builder change)");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 3. critical-gaps-boot.ts : wire hosted-place-sync (dynamic import pattern).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const BOOT_REL = "src/critical-gaps-boot.ts";
const BOOT_TOKEN = "hosted-place-sync";

function patchBoot() {
  if (!exists(BOOT_REL)) { console.log("  SKIP: " + BOOT_REL + " not found"); return; }
  let src = read(BOOT_REL) || "";
  if (src.includes(BOOT_TOKEN)) { console.log("  NO CHANGE: boot already wires hosted-place-sync"); return; }

  const anchor = '  await safe("critical-gaps-ui", setupCriticalGapsUI);';
  if (!src.includes(anchor)) { console.log("  SKIP: boot critical-gaps-ui anchor not found"); return; }

  const inject =
    '  await safe("hosted-place-sync", async () => {\n' +
    '    await import("./features/hosted-place-sync");\n' +
    "  });\n\n" +
    anchor;

  src = src.replace(anchor, inject);
  backup(BOOT_REL);
  fs.writeFileSync(full(BOOT_REL), src, "utf8");
  console.log("  PATCHED: boot wires hosted-place-sync");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 4. Extend the regression guard with a [place-sync] group. Marker idempotent.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const GUARD_REL = "scripts/verify-input-focus.mjs";
const GUARD_MARKER = "place-sync contract";

const BLOCK = [
  "// ---- " + GUARD_MARKER + " (added by Fix-Hosted-Place-Sync) ----",
  'const psSrc = read("src/features/hosted-place-sync.ts") || "";',
  'check("place-sync", "hosted-place-sync module exists", psSrc.length > 0);',
  'check("place-sync", "sets __obsSyncHostedPlacement", /__obsSyncHostedPlacement\\s*=/.test(psSrc));',
  'check("place-sync", "reconciles from offsetAlongHost (same source as hole)", /offsetAlongHost/.test(psSrc));',
  'check("place-sync", "uses author basis makeBasis(dir, up, normal)", /makeBasis\\(\\s*dir,\\s*up,\\s*normal\\s*\\)/.test(psSrc));',
  'check("place-sync", "authoring rebuild calls the sync", /__obsSyncHostedPlacement\\?\\.\\(\\)/.test(read("src/features/authoring.ts") || ""));',
  'check("place-sync", "boot wires hosted-place-sync", /hosted-place-sync/.test(read("src/critical-gaps-boot.ts") || ""));',
  "",
].join("\n");

function patchGuard() {
  if (!exists(GUARD_REL)) { console.log("  SKIP: " + GUARD_REL + " not found"); return; }
  let src = read(GUARD_REL) || "";
  if (src.includes(GUARD_MARKER)) { console.log("  NO CHANGE: guard already has place-sync checks"); return; }
  const anchor = "const byGroup = {};";
  const idx = src.indexOf(anchor);
  if (idx < 0) { console.log("  SKIP: guard report anchor not found"); return; }
  backup(GUARD_REL);
  src = src.slice(0, idx) + BLOCK + src.slice(idx);
  fs.writeFileSync(full(GUARD_REL), src, "utf8");
  console.log("  PATCHED: guard appended [place-sync] group");
}

console.log("");
console.log("Applying hosted place-sync patch...");
console.log("");
writePlaceSync();
patchAuthoringRebuild();
patchBoot();
patchGuard();
console.log("");
console.log("Place-sync patch applied. Builders (buildDoor/buildWindow/placeHostedElement/wallAtPoint) were NOT modified.");
```

```js
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const rel = "src/features/authoring.ts";
const full = path.join(root, rel);
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

let src;

try {
  src = fs.readFileSync(full, "utf8");
} catch (e) {
  console.log("SKIP: cannot read " + rel + " (" + (e.code || e.message) + ")");
  process.exit(0);
}

if (src.includes("(p as any).hostAngle = hostAngle")) {
  console.log("NO CHANGE: hosted re-cut TypeScript fix already present.");
  process.exit(0);
}

const before = src;

// Preferred: replace the whole three-line block in one pass.
const blockRe =
  /if\s*\(\s*"hostAngle"\s+in\s+p\s*\)\s*p\.hostAngle\s*=\s*Math\.round\([\s\S]{0,500}?if\s*\(\s*"angle"\s+in\s+p\s*\)\s*p\.angle\s*=\s*p\.hostAngle\s*;/;

const blockRep = `const hostAngle = Math.round(angle * 10000) / 10000;
      if ("hostAngle" in p) (p as any).hostAngle = hostAngle;
      if ("rotation" in p) (p as any).rotation = hostAngle;
      if ("angle" in p) (p as any).angle = hostAngle;`;

if (blockRe.test(src)) {
  src = src.replace(blockRe, blockRep);
  console.log("PATCHED: replaced full hostAngle block with local hostAngle variable.");
} else {
  // Fallback: replace individual lines if formatting differs.
  src = src.replace(
    /if\s*\(\s*"hostAngle"\s+in\s+p\s*\)\s*p\.hostAngle\s*=\s*Math\.round\(\s*angle\s*\*\s*10000\s*\)\s*\/\s*10000\s*;/g,
    `const hostAngle = Math.round(angle * 10000) / 10000;
      if ("hostAngle" in p) (p as any).hostAngle = hostAngle;`
  );

  src = src.replace(
    /if\s*\(\s*"rotation"\s+in\s+p\s*\)\s*p\.rotation\s*=\s*p\.hostAngle\s*;/g,
    `if ("rotation" in p) (p as any).rotation = hostAngle;`
  );

  src = src.replace(
    /if\s*\(\s*"angle"\s+in\s+p\s*\)\s*p\.angle\s*=\s*p\.hostAngle\s*;/g,
    `if ("angle" in p) (p as any).angle = hostAngle;`
  );

  if (src !== before) {
    console.log("PATCHED: replaced individual hostAngle lines.");
  }
}

// Safety: if somehow rotation/angle now use hostAngle but hostAngle is not declared,
// insert a declaration before the first use inside openingsForWall.
if (
  src.includes("(p as any).rotation = hostAngle") &&
  !src.includes("const hostAngle = Math.round(angle * 10000) / 10000;")
) {
  src = src.replace(
    /if\s*\(\s*"rotation"\s+in\s+p\s*\)\s*\(p as any\)\.rotation\s*=\s*hostAngle\s*;/,
    `const hostAngle = Math.round(angle * 10000) / 10000;
      if ("rotation" in p) (p as any).rotation = hostAngle;`
  );
  console.log("PATCHED: inserted missing local hostAngle declaration.");
}

if (src === before) {
  console.log("SKIP: no matching hostAngle pattern found. The file may already be fixed or formatted differently.");
  process.exit(0);
}

fs.copyFileSync(full, full + ".bak-" + stamp);
fs.writeFileSync(full, src, "utf8");

console.log("WROTE: " + rel);
```

```js
}
```

```js
// Open BIM Studio - code review fix pack (Node side).
// Generated by Fix-OpenBIMStudio-Issues.ps1. Idempotent, marker-based.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
const FIX = "openbim-fix";   // marker used across all patched files

const stats = { patched: 0, noop: 0, skipped: 0, warned: 0 };

function full(rel) { return path.join(root, rel); }
function exists(rel) { try { fs.accessSync(full(rel)); return true; } catch { return false; } }
function read(rel) { try { return fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8"); } catch { return null; } }
function backup(rel) {
  if (!exists(rel)) return;
  fs.copyFileSync(full(rel), full(rel) + ".bak-" + stamp);
}
function write(rel, s) { fs.writeFileSync(full(rel), s, "utf8"); }
function log(kind, name, note) {
  let tag;
  if (kind === "PATCH") { tag = "PATCH"; stats.patched++; }
  else if (kind === "NOOP") { tag = "NOOP "; stats.noop++; }
  else if (kind === "WARN") { tag = "WARN "; stats.warned++; }
  else { tag = "SKIP "; stats.skipped++; }
  const line = "  [" + tag + "] " + name + (note ? "  -- " + note : "");
  console.log(line);
}
function hasMarker(src, suffix) {
  return src.indexOf(FIX + ":" + suffix) >= 0;
}

// =============================================================================
// A. native-twin-ifc.ts -- IFC4 unit assignment + correct entity name
// =============================================================================
function fixNativeTwinIfc() {
  const rel = "src/modules/export/native-twin-ifc.ts";
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }
  let s = read(rel);
  if (hasMarker(s, "native-twin-ifc")) {
    log("NOOP", rel + " (already patched)");
    return;
  }
  let changed = false;

  // (A1) declare the unit-assignment ids before the project id.
  const anchorA1 = "  const project = next();\n  const site = next();";
  const replA1 =
    "  // " + FIX + ": native-twin-ifc -- IFC4 unit assignment ids\n" +
    "  const lengthUnit = next();\n" +
    "  const areaUnit   = next();\n" +
    "  const volumeUnit = next();\n" +
    "  const angleUnit  = next();\n" +
    "  const unitAssign = next();\n" +
    "\n" +
    "  const project = next();\n" +
    "  const site = next();";
  if (s.indexOf(anchorA1) >= 0) { s = s.split(anchorA1).join(replA1); changed = true; }
  else log("WARN", rel + " (unit-id anchor not found)");

  //      lenUnit) with proper IFCSIUNIT + IFCUNITASSIGNMENT + IFCPROJECT.
  const anchorA2 =
    "  lines.push(`#${project}=IFCPROJECT('${guid()}',#${owner},'Native Twin Export',$,$,$,$,(#${next()}),#${next()});`);\n" +
    "  // units assignment placeholder ids already consumed \\u2014 keep file parseable with length unit\n" +
    "  const lenUnit = id - 1;\n" +
    "  lines[lines.length - 1] = `#${project}=IFCPROJECT('${guid()}',#${owner},'Native Twin Export',$,$,$,$,(#${lenUnit}),$);`\n" +
    "  // Fix: rewrite unit lines properly\n" +
    "  // Actually inject units before project\n" +
    "  // Simpler approach: minimal valid structure without full unit assignment complexity";

  // The source file has a real em-dash (U+2014); build the anchor with it.
  const emDash = String.fromCharCode(0x2014);
  const anchorA2Real = anchorA2.replace("\\u2014", emDash);

  const replA2 =
    "  // " + FIX + ": native-twin-ifc -- correct IFC4 unit + project header\n" +
    "  lines.push(`#${lengthUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.LENGTHUNIT.,$,.METRE.);`);\n" +
    "  lines.push(`#${areaUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.AREAUNIT.,$,.SQUARE_METRE.);`);\n" +
    "  lines.push(`#${volumeUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.VOLUMEUNIT.,$,.CUBIC_METRE.);`);\n" +
    "  lines.push(`#${angleUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.PLANEANGLEUNIT.,$,.RADIAN.);`);\n" +
    "  lines.push(`#${unitAssign}=IFCUNITASSIGNMENT((#${lengthUnit},#${areaUnit},#${volumeUnit},#${angleUnit}));`);\n" +
    "  lines.push(`#${project}=IFCPROJECT('${guid()}',#${owner},'Native Twin Export',$,$,$,$,(#${unitAssign}),$);`);";

  if (s.indexOf(anchorA2Real) >= 0) { s = s.split(anchorA2Real).join(replA2); changed = true; }
  else if (s.indexOf(anchorA2) >= 0) { s = s.split(anchorA2).join(replA2); changed = true; }
  else log("WARN", rel + " (IFCPROJECT anchor not found)");

  // (A3) remove the IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESSET typo / duplicate write.
  const anchorA3 =
    "    lines.push(`#${faces}=IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESSET(#${coords},$,.F.,(${faceList.join(\",\")}),$);`);\n" +

    "    lines[lines.length - 1] = `#${faces}=IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET(#${coords},$,.F.,(${faceList.join(\",\")}),$);`;";
  const replA3 =
    "    // " + FIX + ": native-twin-ifc -- IFC4 entity name\n" +
    "    lines.push(`#${faces}=IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET(#${coords},$,.F.,(${faceList.join(\",\")}),$);`);";
  if (s.indexOf(anchorA3) >= 0) { s = s.split(anchorA3).join(replA3); changed = true; }
  else if (s.indexOf("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESSET") >= 0) {
    // Fallback: replace the typo in place, keep the (harmless) duplicate write.
    s = s.split("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESSET").join("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET");
    changed = true;
  } else log("WARN", rel + " (triangulated face-set typo not found)");

  if (changed) { backup(rel); write(rel, s); log("PATCH", rel); }
  else log("SKIP", rel + " (no anchors matched)");
}

// =============================================================================
// B. units.ts -- suffix matchers for area/volume/mass/angle + regex widen
// =============================================================================
function fixUnitsSuffixes() {
  const rel = "src/core/units.ts";
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }
  let s = read(rel);
  if (hasMarker(s, "units.ts")) {
    log("NOOP", rel + " (already patched)");
    return;
  }
  let changed = false;
  const sq = String.fromCharCode(0x00B2); // superscript 2
  const cu = String.fromCharCode(0x00B3); // superscript 3
  const dg = String.fromCharCode(0x00B0); // degree sign

  // (B1) insert the four suffix matchers immediately before parseDimension.
  const anchorB1 = "function parseDimension(input: string, unit: string): number | null {";
  const helpers =
    "// " + FIX + ": units.ts -- suffix matchers for non-length kinds\n" +
    "function matchAreaSuffix(s: string): AreaUnit | null {\n" +
    "  switch (s) {\n" +
    "    case \"mm2\": case \"mm" + sq + "\": return \"mm2\";\n" +
    "    case \"cm2\": case \"cm" + sq + "\": return \"cm2\";\n" +
    "    case \"m2\":  case \"m" + sq + "\":  return \"m2\";\n" +
    "    case \"ft2\": case \"ft" + sq + "\": return \"ft2\";\n" +
    "    case \"in2\": case \"in" + sq + "\": return \"in2\";\n" +
    "    default: return null;\n" +
    "  }\n" +
    "}\n" +
    "function matchVolumeSuffix(s: string): VolumeUnit | null {\n" +
    "  switch (s) {\n" +
    "    case \"mm3\": case \"mm" + cu + "\": return \"mm3\";\n" +
    "    case \"cm3\": case \"cm" + cu + "\": return \"cm3\";\n" +
    "    case \"m3\":  case \"m" + cu + "\":  return \"m3\";\n" +
    "    case \"ft3\": case \"ft" + cu + "\": return \"ft3\";\n" +
    "    case \"in3\": case \"in" + cu + "\": return \"in3\";\n" +
    "    case \"l\": case \"ltr\": return \"l\";\n" +
    "    default: return null;\n" +
    "  }\n" +
    "}\n" +
    "function matchMassSuffix(s: string): MassUnit | null {\n" +
    "  switch (s) {\n" +
    "    case \"g\": return \"g\";\n" +
    "    case \"kg\": return \"kg\";\n" +
    "    case \"t\": return \"t\";\n" +
    "    case \"lb\": case \"lbs\": return \"lb\";\n" +
    "    case \"oz\": return \"oz\";\n" +
    "    default: return null;\n" +
    "  }\n" +
    "}\n" +
    "function matchAngleSuffix(s: string): AngleUnit | null {\n" +
    "  switch (s) {\n" +
    "    case \"deg\": case \"" + dg + "\": return \"deg\";\n" +
    "    case \"rad\": return \"rad\";\n" +
    "    case \"grad\": return \"grad\";\n" +
    "    default: return null;\n" +
    "  }\n" +
    "}\n\n";
  if (s.indexOf("function matchAreaSuffix") < 0) {
    if (s.indexOf(anchorB1) >= 0) { s = s.split(anchorB1).join(helpers + anchorB1); changed = true; }
    else log("WARN", rel + " (parseDimension anchor not found)");
  }

  // (B2) rewrite the four switch cases.
  const cases = [
    [
      "    case \"mm2\": case \"cm2\": case \"m2\": case \"ft2\": case \"in2\":\n" +
      "      return value * AREA_TO_M2[unit as AreaUnit];",
      "    case \"mm2\": case \"cm2\": case \"m2\": case \"ft2\": case \"in2\": {\n" +
      "      const u = (suffix ? matchAreaSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as AreaUnit);\n" +
      "      return value * AREA_TO_M2[u];\n" +
      "    }"
    ],
    [
      "    case \"mm3\": case \"cm3\": case \"m3\": case \"ft3\": case \"in3\": case \"l\":\n" +
      "      return value * VOLUME_TO_M3[unit as VolumeUnit];",
      "    case \"mm3\": case \"cm3\": case \"m3\": case \"ft3\": case \"in3\": case \"l\": {\n" +
      "      const u = (suffix ? matchVolumeSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as VolumeUnit);\n" +
      "      return value * VOLUME_TO_M3[u];\n" +
      "    }"
    ],
    [
      "    case \"g\": case \"kg\": case \"t\": case \"lb\": case \"oz\":\n" +
      "      return value * MASS_TO_KG[unit as MassUnit];",
      "    case \"g\": case \"kg\": case \"t\": case \"lb\": case \"oz\": {\n" +
      "      const u = (suffix ? matchMassSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as MassUnit);\n" +
      "      return value * MASS_TO_KG[u];\n" +
      "    }"
    ],
    [
      "    case \"deg\": case \"rad\": case \"grad\":\n" +
      "      return value * ANGLE_TO_RAD[unit as AngleUnit];",
      "    case \"deg\": case \"rad\": case \"grad\": {\n" +
      "      const u = (suffix ? matchAngleSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as AngleUnit);\n" +
      "      return value * ANGLE_TO_RAD[u];\n" +
      "    }"
    ],
  ];
  for (const [oldStr, newStr] of cases) {
    if (s.indexOf(oldStr) >= 0) { s = s.split(oldStr).join(newStr); changed = true; }
  }

  // (B3) widen the parse regex to accept superscript 2 and 3 in the suffix.
  //      Match the existing literal and add the two chars if missing.
  const reLine = s.match(/const\s+m\s*=\s*cleaned\.match\(\/\^.*\);/);
  if (reLine) {
    const original = reLine[0];
    if (original.indexOf(sq) < 0 || original.indexOf(cu) < 0) {
      // Insert superscript chars into the suffix character class.
      const patched = original.replace(
        /\[a-zA-Z([^\]]+)\]/,
        (m, inner) => {
          const extras = inner + (inner.indexOf(sq) < 0 ? sq : "") + (inner.indexOf(cu) < 0 ? cu : "");
          return "[a-zA-Z" + extras + "]";
        }
      );
      if (patched !== original) { s = s.replace(original, patched); changed = true; }
    }
  }

  if (changed) { backup(rel); write(rel, s); log("PATCH", rel); }
  else log("SKIP", rel + " (no anchors matched)");
}

function fixPackageEngines() {
  const rel = "package.json";
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }
  const raw = read(rel);
  let pkg;
  try { pkg = JSON.parse(raw); }
  catch (e) { log("WARN", rel + " (parse failed: " + e.message + ")"); return; }
  if (!pkg.engines) pkg.engines = {};
  if (pkg.engines.node === ">=20.11.0") { log("NOOP", rel + " (already >=20.11.0)"); return; }
  pkg.engines.node = ">=20.11.0";
  backup(rel);
  write(rel, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + "\n");

}
```

```js
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

async function existsFile(fullPath) {
  try {
    await fs.access(fullPath);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

async function backup(rel) {
  const full = path.join(root, rel);
  if (!(await existsFile(full))) return false;
  await fs.copyFile(full, full + ".bak-" + stamp);
  return true;
}

async function read(rel) {
  return fs.readFile(path.join(root, rel), "utf8");
}

async function write(rel, content) {
  await fs.writeFile(path.join(root, rel), content, "utf8");
}

function stripNonAscii(value) {
  return value.replace(/[^\x20-\x7E]/g, "");
}

function cleanIconValue(value) {
  let clean = stripNonAscii(value);

  // Remove obvious corrupted placeholder icons.
  if (/\?/.test(clean)) clean = "";

  // Remove control/control-like residue.
  clean = clean.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, "").trim();

  return clean;
}

function cleanStringProperty(src, prop) {
  let changed = false;

  const doubleRe = new RegExp(prop + ':\\s*"([^"]*)"', "g");
  src = src.replace(doubleRe, (match, value) => {
    let clean = value;

    if (prop === "icon") {
      clean = cleanIconValue(value);
    } else {
      clean = stripNonAscii(value).trim();
    }

    if (clean !== value) {
      changed = true;
      return prop + ': "' + clean + '"';
    }

    return match;
  });

  const singleRe = new RegExp(prop + ":\\s*'([^']*)'", "g");
  src = src.replace(singleRe, (match, value) => {
    let clean = value;

    if (prop === "icon") {
      clean = cleanIconValue(value);
    } else {
      clean = stripNonAscii(value).trim();
    }

    if (clean !== value) {
      changed = true;
      return prop + ": '" + clean + "'";
    }

    return match;
  });

  return { src, changed };
}

                  for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(snap)) {
                    if (ids instanceof Set && ids.size) {
                      map[modelId] = ids;
                      hasFrag = true;
                    }
                  }

                  if (hasFrag) {
                    await cam.fitToMap?.(map);
                    return;
                  }

                  cam.fitAll?.();
                } catch (err) {
                  console.warn("[context-menu] Focus safe fallback failed", err);

                  try {
                    const cam: any = await import("./camera-tools");
                    cam.fitAll?.();
                  } catch {
                    /* focus unavailable */
                  }
                }
              })();
            },
          }`;

function patchFocusObjects(src) {
  const re = /text:\s*["']Focus["']/g;
  const indexes = [];
  let m;

  while ((m = re.exec(src))) {
    indexes.push(m.index);
  }

  let changed = false;

  for (let i = indexes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const textIndex = indexes[i];
    const start = src.lastIndexOf("{", textIndex);

    if (start < 0) continue;

    let depth = 0;
    let end = -1;

    for (let j = start; j < src.length; j++) {
      const ch = src[j];

      if (ch === "{") {
        depth++;
      } else if (ch === "}") {
        depth--;

        if (depth === 0) {
          end = j;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (end < 0) continue;

    const before = src.slice(0, start);
    const after = src.slice(end + 1);

    src = before + focusObject + after;
    changed = true;
  }

  return { src, changed };
}

async function patchContextMenu() {
  const rel = "src/features/context-menu.ts";
  const full = path.join(root, rel);

  if (!(await existsFile(full))) {
    console.log("SKIP: context-menu.ts not found");
    return;
  }

  let src = await read(rel);
  const original = src;

  const rIcon1 = cleanStringProperty(src, "icon");
  src = rIcon1.src;

  const rText = cleanStringProperty(src, "text");
  src = rText.src;

  const rFocus = patchFocusObjects(src);
  src = rFocus.src;

  const rIcon2 = cleanStringProperty(src, "icon");
  src = rIcon2.src;

  if (src !== original) {
    await backup(rel);
    await write(rel, src);
    console.log("PATCHED: src/features/context-menu.ts");
  } else {
    console.log("NO CHANGE: src/features/context-menu.ts");
  }
}

function removeMmbMovedGuards(src) {
  const lines = src.split(/\r?\n/);
  const out = [];
  let changed = false;
  let i = 0;

  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i];

    if (line.includes("__OBS_MMB_MOVED") && line.includes("drag-end")) {
      changed = true;

      let depth =
        (line.match(/\{/g) || []).length - (line.match(/\}/g) || []).length;

      i++;

      while (i < lines.length && depth > 0) {
        depth +=
          (lines[i].match(/\{/g) || []).length -
          (lines[i].match(/\}/g) || []).length;
        i++;
      }

      continue;
    }

    out.push(line);
    i++;
  }

  return { src: out.join("\n"), changed };
}

function ensureSingleWheelMmbGuard(src) {
  const lines = src.split(/\r?\n/);
  const cleaned = [];
  let changed = false;

  for (const line of lines) {
    if (line.includes("__OBS_MMB_HELD") && line.includes("return true")) {
      changed = true;
      continue;
    }

    cleaned.push(line);
  }

  const out = [];
  let inserted = false;

  for (const line of cleaned) {
    out.push(line);

    if (
      !inserted &&
      /if\s*\(\s*g\.kind\s*===\s*["']wheel["']\s*\)\s*\{/.test(line)
    ) {
      const indent = line.match(/^\s*/)?.[0] ?? "";
      out.push(indent + "  if ((window as any).__OBS_MMB_HELD) return true;");
      inserted = true;
      changed = true;
    }
  }

  return { src: out.join("\n"), changed };
}

function ensureWheelAuthorityGuard(src) {
  if (src.includes("__OBS_WHEEL_AUTHORITY")) {
    return { src, changed: false };
  }

  const lines = src.split(/\r?\n/);
  const out = [];
  let inserted = false;

  for (const line of lines) {
    if (
      !inserted &&
      /zoomAtCursor\s*\(\s*g\.event\.deltaY/.test(line)
    ) {
      const indent = line.match(/^\s*/)?.[0] ?? "";
      out.push(
        indent + "if ((window as any).__OBS_WHEEL_AUTHORITY) return false;",
      );
      inserted = true;
    }

    out.push(line);
  }

  return { src: out.join("\n"), changed: inserted };
}

function patchDampingLines(src) {
  const lines = src.split(/\r?\n/);
  let changed = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i];
    const trimmed = line.trim();

    if (
      line.includes("dampingFactor") &&
      !trimmed.startsWith("/*") &&
      !trimmed.startsWith("//")
    ) {
      lines[i] = "/* dampingFactor deprecated; skipped */";
      changed = true;
    }
  }

  return { src: lines.join("\n"), changed };
}

async function patchNavigation() {
  const rel = "src/features/navigation.ts";
  const full = path.join(root, rel);

  if (!(await existsFile(full))) {
    console.log("SKIP: navigation.ts not found");
    return;
  }

  let src = await read(rel);
  const original = src;

  const r1 = removeMmbMovedGuards(src);
  src = r1.src;

  const r2 = ensureSingleWheelMmbGuard(src);
  src = r2.src;

  const r3 = ensureWheelAuthorityGuard(src);
  src = r3.src;

  const r4 = patchDampingLines(src);
  src = r4.src;

  if (src !== original) {
    await backup(rel);
    await write(rel, src);
    console.log("PATCHED: src/features/navigation.ts");
  } else {
    console.log("NO CHANGE: src/features/navigation.ts");
  }
}

async function main() {
  console.log("");
  console.log("Running Node.js right-click / Focus / navigation cleanup...");
  console.log("");

  await patchContextMenu();
  await patchNavigation();

  console.log("");
  console.log("Node patch completed.");
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});
```
