```js
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

async function exists(p) {
  try {
    await fs.access(p);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

async function backup(rel) {
  const full = path.join(root, rel);
  if (await exists(full)) {
    await fs.copyFile(full, full + ".bak-" + stamp);
    console.log("Backup: " + rel);
  }
}

async function read(rel) {
  return fs.readFile(path.join(root, rel), "utf8");
}

async function write(rel, content) {
  await fs.writeFile(path.join(root, rel), content, "utf8");
}

function findMatchingBrace(text, start) {
  if (text[start] !== "{") return -1;

  let depth = 0;
  let inString = false;
  let quote = "";
  let escaped = false;

  for (let i = start; i < text.length; i++) {
    const ch = text[i];

    if (inString) {
      if (escaped) {
        escaped = false;
      } else if (ch === "\\") {
        escaped = true;
      } else if (ch === quote) {
        inString = false;
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (ch === '"' || ch === "'" || ch === "`") {
      inString = true;
      quote = ch;
      continue;
    }

    if (ch === "{") {
      depth++;
    } else if (ch === "}") {
      depth--;
      if (depth === 0) return i;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}

function parseValue(text, i) {
  while (i < text.length && /\s/.test(text[i])) i++;

  const ch = text[i];

  if (ch === '"' || ch === "'" || ch === "`") {
    const q = ch;
    i++;

    while (i < text.length) {
      if (text[i] === "\\") {
        i += 2;
        continue;
      }

      if (text[i] === q) {
        i++;
        break;
      }

      i++;
    }

    return i;
  }

  if (ch === "[" || ch === "{") {
    const open = ch;
    const close = ch === "[" ? "]" : "}";
    let depth = 0;
    let inString = false;
    let quote = "";
    let escaped = false;

    for (; i < text.length; i++) {
      const c = text[i];

      if (inString) {
        if (escaped) {
          escaped = false;
        } else if (c === "\\") {
          escaped = true;
        } else if (c === quote) {
          inString = false;
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (c === '"' || c === "'" || c === "`") {
        inString = true;
        quote = c;
        continue;
      }

      if (c === open) {
        depth++;
      } else if (c === close) {
        depth--;
        if (depth === 0) return i + 1;
      }
    }

    return i;
  }

  while (i < text.length && !/[,;)\}\s]/.test(text[i])) {
    i++;
  }

  return i;
}

function findBlockStart(src, key) {
  const re = new RegExp("(^|\\n)\\s*" + key + "\\s*:\\s*\\{");
  const m = re.exec(src);

  if (!m) return -1;

  return m.index + m[0].length - 1;
}

function replaceTargetInBlock(src, blockStart) {
  const blockEnd = findMatchingBrace(src, blockStart);

  if (blockEnd < 0) {
    return { src, changed: false, reason: "brace-match-failed" };
  }

  const inner = src.slice(blockStart + 1, blockEnd);
  const targetRe = /(^|[^\w$.])target\s*:/;
  const tm = targetRe.exec(inner);

  if (!tm) {
    const insert = ' target: "esnext",';
    const out =
      src.slice(0, blockStart + 1) +
      insert +
      src.slice(blockStart + 1);

    return { src: out, changed: true, reason: "inserted-target" };
  }

  const colonAbs = blockStart + 1 + tm.index + tm[0].length - 1;
  const valStart = colonAbs + 1;
  const valEnd = parseValue(src, valStart);
  const current = src.slice(valStart, valEnd).trim();

  if (
    current === '"esnext"' ||
    current === "'esnext'" ||
    current === "`esnext`"
  ) {
    return { src, changed: false, reason: "already-esnext" };
  }

  const out =
    src.slice(0, valStart) +
    ' "esnext"' +
    src.slice(valEnd);

  return { src: out, changed: true, reason: "replaced-target" };
}

function ensureBlockWithTarget(src, key) {
  const start = findBlockStart(src, key);

  if (start >= 0) {
    return replaceTargetInBlock(src, start);
  }

  const dc = src.indexOf("defineConfig(");

  if (dc < 0) {
    return { src, changed: false, reason: "no-defineConfig" };
  }

  const ob = src.indexOf("{", dc);

  if (ob < 0) {
    return { src, changed: false, reason: "no-config-brace" };
  }

  const insert = "\n  " + key + ': { target: "esnext" },';
  const out = src.slice(0, ob + 1) + insert + src.slice(ob + 1);

  return { src: out, changed: true, reason: "added-block" };
}

async function patchPackageJson() {
  const rel = "package.json";
  const full = path.join(root, rel);

  if (!(await exists(full))) {
    console.log("SKIP: package.json not found");
    return;
  }

  const original = await read(rel);
  const pkg = JSON.parse(original);

  const desired = "tsc && vite build --target esnext";

  if (!pkg.scripts) {
    pkg.scripts = {};
  }

  if (pkg.scripts.build === desired) {
    console.log("NO CHANGE: package.json build script already forced.");
    return;
  }

  pkg.scripts.build = desired;

  await backup(rel);
  await write(rel, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + "\n");
  console.log("PATCHED: package.json build script -> " + desired);
}

async function patchViteConfig() {
  const rel = "vite.config.ts";
  const full = path.join(root, rel);

  if (!(await exists(full))) {
    console.log("SKIP: vite.config.ts not found");
    return;
  }

  let src = await read(rel);
  const original = src;
  let changed = false;

  const buildRes = ensureBlockWithTarget(src, "build");
  src = buildRes.src;

  if (buildRes.changed) {
    changed = true;
    console.log("PATCHED: vite.config.ts build.target -> esnext (" + buildRes.reason + ")");
  } else {
    console.log("NOTE: vite.config.ts build.target (" + buildRes.reason + ")");
  }

  const esbuildRes = ensureBlockWithTarget(src, "esbuild");
  src = esbuildRes.src;

  if (esbuildRes.changed) {
    changed = true;
    console.log("PATCHED: vite.config.ts esbuild.target -> esnext (" + esbuildRes.reason + ")");
  } else {
    console.log("NOTE: vite.config.ts esbuild.target (" + esbuildRes.reason + ")");
  }

  if (changed) {
    await backup(rel);
    await write(rel, src);
    console.log("WROTE: vite.config.ts");
  } else {
    console.log("NO CHANGE: vite.config.ts");
  }
}

async function main() {
  console.log("");
  console.log("Forcing Vite build target for top-level await...");
  console.log("");

  await patchPackageJson();
  await patchViteConfig();

  console.log("");
  console.log("Force build target patch completed.");
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```js
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

function full(rel) { return path.join(root, rel); }
function exists(rel) { try { fs.accessSync(full(rel)); return true; } catch { return false; } }
function read(rel) { try { return fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8"); } catch { return null; } }
function backup(rel) {
  if (!exists(rel)) return false;
  fs.copyFileSync(full(rel), full(rel) + ".bak-" + stamp);
  console.log("  Backup: " + rel);
  return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// openingsForWall : keep last turn's clamp + write-back + hostAngle TS fix,
// and ADD a full-face skip so a wall can never be hollowed into a frame.
// Markers: "hosted-recut: clamp each opening" (old) + "skip full-face opening" (new).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const AUTH_REL = "src/features/authoring.ts";
const NEW_MARKER = "hosted-recut: skip full-face opening";

const NEW_FN = `function openingsForWall(wallId: string): WallOpening[] {
  // hosted-recut: clamp each opening to the host's CURRENT length so a moved or
  // resized wall re-cuts its door/window holes in-bounds on every rebuild, and
  // write the clamp back to the hosted element params so the door/window mesh
  // (built from the same offsetAlongHost) stays glued to the wall in one pass.
  // hosted-recut: skip full-face opening so a bad/degenerate opening can never
  // hollow the wall solid into a thin frame (the door mesh still draws on top).
  const out: WallOpening[] = [];
  const wall = elements.find((e) => e.id === wallId);
  const wp = wall?.params;
  let L = 0;
  let ax = 0, az = 0, dx = 0, dz = 0;
  if (wp && wp.start && wp.end) {
    ax = wp.start[0]; az = wp.start[1];
    dx = wp.end[0] - ax; dz = wp.end[1] - az;
    L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  }
  const angle = L > 1e-6 ? Math.atan2(dz, dx) : 0;
  const H = Number(wp?.height ?? 3);
  for (const el of getHostedForWall(wallId)) {
    const p = el.params;
    const w = p.width ?? DEFAULTS[el.type]?.width ?? 0.9;
    const h = p.height;
    const sill = el.type === "window" ? (p.sillHeight ?? 0.9) : (p.sillHeight ?? 0);
    let offset = p.offsetAlongHost ?? (L > 0 ? L / 2 : 0);
    if (L > 1e-6) {
      const half = w / 2;
      if (L <= w + 0.02) offset = L / 2;
      else offset = Math.max(half, Math.min(L - half, offset));
      offset = Math.round(offset * 1000) / 1000;
      p.offsetAlongHost = offset;
      const t01 = offset / L;
      const cx = ax + dx * t01;
      const cz = az + dz * t01;
      if ("x" in p) p.x = Math.round(cx * 1000) / 1000;
      if ("z" in p) p.z = Math.round(cz * 1000) / 1000;
      const hostAngle = Math.round(angle * 10000) / 10000;
      if ("hostAngle" in p) (p as any).hostAngle = hostAngle;
      if ("rotation" in p) (p as any).rotation = hostAngle;
      if ("angle" in p) (p as any).angle = hostAngle;
    }
    // full-face skip: compute the hole rect exactly as the legacy builder does,
    // and drop the opening if it would erase >= 90% of the wall face.
    const u0 = Math.max(0, offset - w / 2);
    const u1 = Math.min(L, offset + w / 2);
    const v0 = Math.max(0, sill);
    const v1 = Math.min(H, sill + h);
    const holeW = u1 - u0;
    const holeH = v1 - v0;
    const degenerate = holeW < 0.02 || holeH < 0.02;
    const fullFace = L > 0.05 && H > 0.05 && holeW >= L * 0.9 && holeH >= H * 0.9;
    if (degenerate || fullFace) continue;
    out.push({ offset, width: w, height: h, sill });
  }
  return out;
}`;

function patchAuthoring() {
  if (!exists(AUTH_REL)) { console.log("  SKIP: " + AUTH_REL + " not found"); return; }
  let src = read(AUTH_REL) || "";
  if (src.includes(NEW_MARKER)) { console.log("  NO CHANGE: openingsForWall already hardened (full-face skip)"); return; }
  const re = /function openingsForWall\(wallId: string\): WallOpening\[\] \{[\s\S]*?\n\}/;
  if (!re.test(src)) { console.log("  SKIP: openingsForWall anchor not matched"); return; }
  backup(AUTH_REL);
  src = src.replace(re, NEW_FN);
  fs.writeFileSync(full(AUTH_REL), src, "utf8");
  console.log("  PATCHED: authoring.ts openingsForWall -> + full-face skip (wall can never hollow)");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Extend the regression guard with a [recut-hardening] group. Marker idempotent.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const GUARD_REL = "scripts/verify-input-focus.mjs";
const GUARD_MARKER = "recut hardening contract";

const BLOCK = [
  "// ---- " + GUARD_MARKER + " (added by Harden-Hosted-Recut) ----",
  'const authH = read("src/features/authoring.ts") || "";',
  'check("recut-hardening", "openingsForWall keeps clamp marker", /hosted-recut: clamp each opening/.test(authH));',
  'check("recut-hardening", "openingsForWall has full-face skip", /hosted-recut: skip full-face opening/.test(authH));',
  'check("recut-hardening", "skip drops degenerate OR full-face holes", /degenerate\\s*\\|\\|\\s*fullFace/.test(authH) && /holeW >= L \\* 0\\.9 && holeH >= H \\* 0\\.9/.test(authH));',
  'check("recut-hardening", "hostAngle TS narrowing fix still present", /const hostAngle = Math\\.round\\(angle \\* 10000\\) \\/ 10000;/.test(authH) && /\\(p as any\\)\\.rotation = hostAngle/.test(authH));',
  'const owN = (authH.match(/function openingsForWall/g) || []).length;',
  'check("recut-hardening", "exactly one openingsForWall definition", owN === 1, "found " + owN);',
  "",
].join("\n");

function patchGuard() {
  if (!exists(GUARD_REL)) { console.log("  SKIP: " + GUARD_REL + " not found"); return; }
  let src = read(GUARD_REL) || "";
  if (src.includes(GUARD_MARKER)) { console.log("  NO CHANGE: guard already has recut-hardening checks"); return; }
  const anchor = "const byGroup = {};";
  const idx = src.indexOf(anchor);
  if (idx < 0) { console.log("  SKIP: guard report anchor not found"); return; }
  backup(GUARD_REL);
  src = src.slice(0, idx) + BLOCK + src.slice(idx);
  fs.writeFileSync(full(GUARD_REL), src, "utf8");
  console.log("  PATCHED: guard appended [recut-hardening] group");
}

console.log("");
console.log("Applying hosted re-cut hardening (owned function only)...");
console.log("");
patchAuthoring();
patchGuard();
console.log("");
console.log("Hardening applied. authoring.ts builders / placement / rebuild were NOT modified.");
```

--- FILE: scripts/install-revit-gaps.mjs ---
```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Installs the Revit-gaps package (Milestones 1, 2 and 3) into an OpenBIMStudio checkout.
 *
 *   node scripts/install-revit-gaps.mjs [projectRoot] [--dry-run]
 *
 * Copy the package's `src/modules/revit-gaps/` folder into the project first.
 * The script makes eleven small, idempotent edits (markers openbim-revit-gaps:v1 / :m2 / :m3):
 *   M1  1. src/critical-gaps-boot.ts              start the revit-gaps boot
 *       2. src/shell/file-menu.ts                 File > Export > Model > IFC4 / IFC2X3
 *       3. src/modules/export/native-twin-ifc.ts  valid IFC GlobalIds
 *   M2  4. src/features/authoring.ts              createMesh asks window.__obsMeshBuilders first
 *       5. src/modules/cost/quantities.ts         takeoff rows for the new element types
 *       6. src/features/revit-parity-bridge.ts    Place Stair / Railing / Curtain Wall buttons start the click tools
 *   M3  7. 8. src/modules/views/generators/plan.ts       drop base geometry of M2 types, then add poche, room tags, symbols, marks
 *       9. src/modules/views/generators/section.ts       real cut sections (poche, oblique cuts, openings)
 *       10. src/modules/views/generators/elevation.ts    real elevations (silhouettes with openings, roof slope)
 *       11. src/modules/export/pdf.ts                    filled polygons that actually appear in the sheet PDF
 * Originals are saved once in <projectRoot>/.revit-gaps-backup/. Line endings
 * (CRLF/LF) are preserved. Nothing is changed if an anchor is not found; the
 * script says so instead of guessing.
 */
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const dry = args.includes("--dry-run");
const root = path.resolve(args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--")) ?? ".");
const MARK = "openbim-revit-gaps:v1";
const MARK2 = "openbim-revit-gaps:m2";
const MARK3 = "openbim-revit-gaps:m3";
const results = [];

function read(rel) {
  const p = path.join(root, rel);
  if (!fs.existsSync(p)) return null;
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8");
  const bom = raw.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff;
  const body = bom ? raw.slice(1) : raw;
  const eol = body.includes("\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n";
  return { p, rel, bom, eol, text: body.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n") };
}
function write(f, text) {
  const out = (f.bom ? "\ufeff" : "") + text.replace(/\n/g, f.eol);
  if (dry) return;
  const bdir = path.join(root, ".revit-gaps-backup");
  fs.mkdirSync(bdir, { recursive: true });
  const b = path.join(bdir, f.rel.replace(/[\\/]/g, "__"));
  if (!fs.existsSync(b)) fs.copyFileSync(f.p, b);
  fs.writeFileSync(f.p, out, "utf8");
}
function patch(rel, name, fn, marker = MARK) {
  const f = read(rel);
  if (!f) return results.push({ name, state: "SKIPPED", why: `${rel} not found` });
  if (f.text.includes(marker)) return results.push({ name, state: "already installed" });
  const next = fn(f.text);
  if (!next) return results.push({ name, state: "NOT PATCHED", why: "anchor not found - apply by hand (see docs/REVIT_GAPS_M1.md)" });
  write(f, next);
  results.push({ name, state: dry ? "would patch" : "patched" });
```

```js
// Repair pass for Fix-OpenBIMStudio-Issues. Idempotent, CRLF-aware, granular markers.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
const FIX = "openbim-fix";

const stats = { patched: 0, noop: 0, skipped: 0, warned: 0, crlf: 0, lf: 0 };

function full(rel) { return path.join(root, rel); }
function exists(rel) { try { fs.accessSync(full(rel)); return true; } catch { return false; } }
function backup(rel) {
  if (!exists(rel)) return;
  fs.copyFileSync(full(rel), full(rel) + ".bak-" + stamp + "2");
}
function log(kind, name, note) {
  let tag;
  if (kind === "PATCH") { tag = "PATCH"; stats.patched++; }
  else if (kind === "NOOP") { tag = "NOOP "; stats.noop++; }
  else if (kind === "WARN") { tag = "WARN "; stats.warned++; }
  else { tag = "SKIP "; stats.skipped++; }
  console.log("  [" + tag + "] " + name + (note ? "  -- " + note : ""));
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CRLF-aware read/write. Returns { text, wasCRLF }.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
function readNormalized(rel) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8");
  const wasCRLF = raw.indexOf("\r\n") >= 0;
  const text = wasCRLF ? raw.split("\r\n").join("\n") : raw;
  if (wasCRLF) stats.crlf++; else stats.lf++;
  return { text, wasCRLF };
}
function writeRestored(rel, text, wasCRLF) {
  const out = wasCRLF ? text.split("\n").join("\r\n") : text;
  fs.writeFileSync(full(rel), out, "utf8");
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Diagnostic: print lines of `text` that contain `needle`, +/- radius.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
function dumpContext(text, needle, radius) {
  const lines = text.split("\n");
  const hits = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) if (lines[i].indexOf(needle) >= 0) hits.push(i);
  if (!hits.length) {
    console.log("    (diagnostic) no line contains: " + JSON.stringify(needle));
    return;
  }
  for (const h of hits.slice(0, 3)) {
    const a = Math.max(0, h - radius);
    const b = Math.min(lines.length - 1, h + radius);
    console.log("    (diagnostic) around line " + (h + 1) + ":");
    for (let i = a; i <= b; i++) {
      console.log("    " + String(i + 1).padStart(5, " ") + " | " + lines[i]);
    }
  }
  if (hits.length > 3) console.log("    (diagnostic) ... " + (hits.length - 3) + " more hit(s).");
}

// =============================================================================
// A. native-twin-ifc.ts
//    v1 partially applied: A1 (unit-id declarations) may already be in place.
//    A2 (IFCPROJECT + IFCUNITASSIGNMENT) and A3 (face-set typo) still to apply.
// =============================================================================
function fixNativeTwinIfc() {
  const rel = "src/modules/export/native-twin-ifc.ts";
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }

  const { text: src, wasCRLF } = readNormalized(rel);
  let s = src;
  let changed = false;

  const hasUnitsMarker = s.indexOf(FIX + ":native-twin-ifc:units") >= 0
                      || s.indexOf(FIX + ":native-twin-ifc -- IFC4 unit assignment ids") >= 0;
  const hasFacesMarker = s.indexOf(FIX + ":native-twin-ifc:faces") >= 0;

  // ---------- A1: declarations (only if v1 didn't already do it) ----------
  if (!hasUnitsMarker) {
    const a1 = "  const project = next();\n  const site = next();";
    if (s.indexOf(a1) >= 0) {
      s = s.split(a1).join(
        "  // " + FIX + ":native-twin-ifc:units -- IFC4 unit ids declared before project\n" +
        "  const lengthUnit = next();\n" +
        "  const areaUnit   = next();\n" +
        "  const volumeUnit = next();\n" +
        "  const angleUnit  = next();\n" +
        "  const unitAssign = next();\n" +
        "\n" +
        "  const project = next();\n" +
        "  const site = next();"
      );
      changed = true;
    } else {
      log("WARN", rel + " (A1 unit-id anchor not found)");
      dumpContext(s, "const project = next();", 3);
    }
  }

  // ---------- A2: replace the broken IFCPROJECT block ----------
  if (s.indexOf(FIX + ":native-twin-ifc:header") < 0) {
    // Structural search: find the line that starts with `  lines.push(\`#${project}=IFCPROJECT(`...
    const reStart = /lines\.push\(`#\$\{project\}=IFCPROJECT\([^\n]*\n/;
    const mStart = reStart.exec(s);
    // End anchor: the last comment in the broken block.
    const endAnchor = "// Simpler approach: minimal valid structure without full unit assignment complexity";
    const endIdx = s.indexOf(endAnchor);

    if (mStart && endIdx > mStart.index) {
      const replacement =
        "  // " + FIX + ":native-twin-ifc:header -- correct IFC4 unit + project header\n" +
        "  lines.push(`#${lengthUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.LENGTHUNIT.,$,.METRE.);`);\n" +
        "  lines.push(`#${areaUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.AREAUNIT.,$,.SQUARE_METRE.);`);\n" +
        "  lines.push(`#${volumeUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.VOLUMEUNIT.,$,.CUBIC_METRE.);`);\n" +
        "  lines.push(`#${angleUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.PLANEANGLEUNIT.,$,.RADIAN.);`);\n" +
        "  lines.push(`#${unitAssign}=IFCUNITASSIGNMENT((#${lengthUnit},#${areaUnit},#${volumeUnit},#${angleUnit}));`);\n" +
        "  lines.push(`#${project}=IFCPROJECT('${guid()}',#${owner},'Native Twin Export',$,$,$,$,(#${unitAssign}),$);`);";
      s = s.slice(0, mStart.index) + replacement + s.slice(endIdx + endAnchor.length);
      changed = true;
    } else {
      log("WARN", rel + " (A2 IFCPROJECT block not located)");
      dumpContext(s, "IFCPROJECT", 4);
    }
  }

  // ---------- A3: face-set typo ----------
  if (!hasFacesMarker) {
    if (s.indexOf("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESSET") >= 0) {
      s = s.split("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESSET").join("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET");
      // Leave a marker so re-runs are no-ops.
      s = s.replace(
        /(\n[ \t]*lines\.push\(`#\$\{faces\}=IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET)/,
        "\n    // " + FIX + ":native-twin-ifc:faces -- correct IFC4 entity name\n$1"
      );
      changed = true;
    } else if (s.indexOf("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET") < 0) {
      log("WARN", rel + " (A3 no triangulated face-set token found at all)");
      dumpContext(s, "FaceSet", 3);
    }
  }

  if (changed) {
    backup(rel);
    writeRestored(rel, s, wasCRLF);
    log("PATCH", rel, wasCRLF ? "(CRLF preserved)" : "(LF)");
  } else {
    log("NOOP", rel + " (nothing to do)");
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// B. units.ts -- suffix matchers + switch rewrites + regex widen
// =============================================================================
function fixUnitsSuffixes() {
  const rel = "src/core/units.ts";
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }
  const { text: src, wasCRLF } = readNormalized(rel);
  let s = src;
  let changed = false;

  const sq = String.fromCharCode(0x00B2);
  const cu = String.fromCharCode(0x00B3);
  const dg = String.fromCharCode(0x00B0);

  // -------- B1: helpers --------
  if (s.indexOf("function matchAreaSuffix") < 0) {
    // Anchor on the parseDimension function declaration, whitespace-tolerant.
    const re = /(^|\n)(function parseDimension\(input: string, unit: string\): number \| null \{)/;
    const m = re.exec(s);
    if (m) {
      const helpers =
        "// " + FIX + ":units.ts -- suffix matchers for non-length kinds\n" +
        "function matchAreaSuffix(s: string): AreaUnit | null {\n" +
        "  switch (s) {\n" +
        "    case \"mm2\": case \"mm" + sq + "\": return \"mm2\";\n" +
        "    case \"cm2\": case \"cm" + sq + "\": return \"cm2\";\n" +
        "    case \"m2\":  case \"m" + sq + "\":  return \"m2\";\n" +
        "    case \"ft2\": case \"ft" + sq + "\": return \"ft2\";\n" +
        "    case \"in2\": case \"in" + sq + "\": return \"in2\";\n" +
        "    default: return null;\n" +
        "  }\n" +
        "}\n" +
        "function matchVolumeSuffix(s: string): VolumeUnit | null {\n" +
        "  switch (s) {\n" +
        "    case \"mm3\": case \"mm" + cu + "\": return \"mm3\";\n" +
        "    case \"cm3\": case \"cm" + cu + "\": return \"cm3\";\n" +
        "    case \"m3\":  case \"m" + cu + "\":  return \"m3\";\n" +
        "    case \"ft3\": case \"ft" + cu + "\": return \"ft3\";\n" +
        "    case \"in3\": case \"in" + cu + "\": return \"in3\";\n" +
        "    case \"l\": case \"ltr\": return \"l\";\n" +
        "    default: return null;\n" +
        "  }\n" +
        "}\n" +
        "function matchMassSuffix(s: string): MassUnit | null {\n" +
        "  switch (s) {\n" +
        "    case \"g\": return \"g\";\n" +
        "    case \"kg\": return \"kg\";\n" +
        "    case \"t\": return \"t\";\n" +
        "    case \"lb\": case \"lbs\": return \"lb\";\n" +
        "    case \"oz\": return \"oz\";\n" +
        "    default: return null;\n" +
        "  }\n" +
        "}\n" +
        "function matchAngleSuffix(s: string): AngleUnit | null {\n" +
        "  switch (s) {\n" +
        "    case \"deg\": case \"" + dg + "\": return \"deg\";\n" +
        "    case \"rad\": return \"rad\";\n" +
        "    case \"grad\": return \"grad\";\n" +
        "    default: return null;\n" +
        "  }\n" +
        "}\n\n";
      s = s.slice(0, m.index + m[1].length) + helpers + s.slice(m.index + m[1].length);
      changed = true;
    } else {
      log("WARN", rel + " (B1 parseDimension anchor not found)");
      dumpContext(s, "parseDimension", 3);
    }
  }

  // -------- B2: switch-case rewrites (regex, whitespace tolerant) --------
  const cases = [
    {
      re: /case\s+"mm2"\s*:\s*case\s+"cm2"\s*:\s*case\s+"m2"\s*:\s*case\s+"ft2"\s*:\s*case\s+"in2"\s*:\s*\n\s*return\s+value\s*\*\s*AREA_TO_M2\[unit as AreaUnit\];/,
      repl: 'case "mm2": case "cm2": case "m2": case "ft2": case "in2": {\n' +
            '      const u = (suffix ? matchAreaSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as AreaUnit);\n' +
            '      return value * AREA_TO_M2[u];\n' +
            '    }'
    },
    {
      re: /case\s+"mm3"\s*:\s*case\s+"cm3"\s*:\s*case\s+"m3"\s*:\s*case\s+"ft3"\s*:\s*case\s+"in3"\s*:\s*case\s+"l"\s*:\s*\n\s*return\s+value\s*\*\s*VOLUME_TO_M3\[unit as VolumeUnit\];/,
      repl: 'case "mm3": case "cm3": case "m3": case "ft3": case "in3": case "l": {\n' +
            '      const u = (suffix ? matchVolumeSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as VolumeUnit);\n' +
            '      return value * VOLUME_TO_M3[u];\n' +
            '    }'
    },
    {
      re: /case\s+"g"\s*:\s*case\s+"kg"\s*:\s*case\s+"t"\s*:\s*case\s+"lb"\s*:\s*case\s+"oz"\s*:\s*\n\s*return\s+value\s*\*\s*MASS_TO_KG\[unit as MassUnit\];/,
      repl: 'case "g": case "kg": case "t": case "lb": case "oz": {\n' +
            '      const u = (suffix ? matchMassSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as MassUnit);\n' +
            '      return value * MASS_TO_KG[u];\n' +
            '    }'
    },
    {
      re: /case\s+"deg"\s*:\s*case\s+"rad"\s*:\s*case\s+"grad"\s*:\s*\n\s*return\s+value\s*\*\s*ANGLE_TO_RAD\[unit as AngleUnit\];/,
      repl: 'case "deg": case "rad": case "grad": {\n' +
            '      const u = (suffix ? matchAngleSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as AngleUnit);\n' +
            '      return value * ANGLE_TO_RAD[u];\n' +
            '    }'
    },
  ];
  for (const c of cases) {
    if (c.re.test(s)) {
      s = s.replace(c.re, c.repl);
      changed = true;
    }
  }

  // -------- B3: widen the parse regex to accept superscript 2/3 --------
  //   Match any `cleaned.match(/^...$/);` inside parseDimension and inject
  //   the two superscript characters into its character class.
  const reLine = /cleaned\.match\(\/(-?\[[^\]]*\]\+)\s\*\(\[a-zA-Z([^\]\n]*)\]\)\?\$\//;
  const m3 = reLine.exec(s);
  if (m3 && m3[2].indexOf(sq) < 0) {
    const inner = m3[2] + sq + cu;

  if (changed) {
    backup(rel);
    writeRestored(rel, s, wasCRLF);
    log("PATCH", rel, wasCRLF ? "(CRLF preserved)" : "(LF)");
  } else {
    log("NOOP", rel + " (nothing to do)");
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// E. clash/geometry.ts -- 1-based idRanges fallback with warning
// =============================================================================
function fixClashGeometryIdRanges() {
  const rel = "src/modules/clash/geometry.ts";
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }
  const { text: src, wasCRLF } = readNormalized(rel);
  if (src.indexOf(FIX + ":clash/geometry.ts") >= 0) { log("NOOP", rel + " (already patched)"); return; }

  // Whitespace-tolerant: capture indent, tolerate `??` or `||`.
  const re = /([ \t]*)const\s+range\s*=\s*ranges\.get\(localId\)\s*\?\?\s*ranges\.get\(localId\s*\+\s*1\);/;
  const m = re.exec(src);
  if (!m) {
    log("WARN", rel + " (idRanges anchor not found)");
    dumpContext(src, "ranges.get", 3);
    return;
  }
  const indent = m[1];
  const repl =
    indent + "let range = ranges.get(localId);\n" +
    indent + "if (!range) {\n" +
    indent + "  const alt = ranges.get(localId + 1);\n" +
    indent + "  if (alt) {\n" +
    indent + "    // " + FIX + ":clash/geometry.ts -- 1-based idRanges fallback\n" +
    indent + "    console.warn(\"[geometry] 1-based idRanges fallback for localId=\" + localId);\n" +
    indent + "    range = alt;\n" +
    indent + "  }\n" +
    indent + "}";
  const s = src.replace(m[0], repl);
  backup(rel); writeRestored(rel, s, wasCRLF); log("PATCH", rel, wasCRLF ? "(CRLF preserved)" : "(LF)");
}

// =============================================================================
// F. authoring.ts -- refreshGrips requires the wall-handles overlay to be live
// =============================================================================
function fixAuthoringGripGuard() {
  const rel = "src/features/authoring.ts";
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }
  const { text: src, wasCRLF } = readNormalized(rel);
  if (src.indexOf(FIX + ":authoring.ts") >= 0) { log("NOOP", rel + " (already patched)"); return; }

  // Find the `const skip = (window as any).__obsWallHandlesActive === true` block.
  const re = /const\s+skip\s*=\s*\(window as any\)\.__obsWallHandlesActive\s*===\s*true\s*\n\s*\?\s*new Set\(\[[^\]]+\]\)\s*\n\s*:\s*null;/;
  const m = re.exec(src);
  if (!m) {
    log("WARN", rel + " (refreshGrips guard anchor not found)");
    dumpContext(src, "__obsWallHandlesActive", 4);
    return;
  }
  // Extract indent from the matched block.
  const lineStart = src.lastIndexOf("\n", m.index) + 1;
  const indent = src.slice(lineStart, m.index + (m[0].match(/^\s*/) || [""])[0].length);
  const baseIndent = (m[0].match(/^\s*/) || [""])[0];
  const repl =
    baseIndent + "// " + FIX + ":authoring.ts -- require the wall-handles overlay to be live\n" +
    baseIndent + "const handlesActive = (window as any).__obsWallHandlesActive === true\n" +
    baseIndent + "  && !!document.getElementById(\"obs-wall-handles\")?.isConnected;\n" +
    baseIndent + "const skip = handlesActive\n" +
    baseIndent + "  ? new Set([\"wall\", \"beam\", \"duct\", \"pipe\", \"cable-tray\", \"conduit\", \"strip\", \"mline\"])\n" +
    baseIndent + "  : null;";
  const s = src.replace(m[0], repl);
  void indent;
  backup(rel); writeRestored(rel, s, wasCRLF); log("PATCH", rel, wasCRLF ? "(CRLF preserved)" : "(LF)");
}

// =============================================================================
// G. navigation.ts -- wheel authority check before raycast
// =============================================================================
function fixNavigationWheelOrder() {
  const rel = "src/features/navigation.ts";
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }
  const { text: src, wasCRLF } = readNormalized(rel);
  if (src.indexOf(FIX + ":navigation.ts") >= 0) { log("NOOP", rel + " (already patched)"); return; }

  // Whitespace-tolerant: find the wheel block, reorder the two lines.
  const re = /([ \t]*)const\s+focus\s*=\s*pickWorldPointUnderCursor\(g\.event\.clientX,\s*g\.event\.clientY\);\n([ \t]*)if\s*\(\(window as any\)\.__OBS_WHEEL_AUTHORITY\)\s*return\s+false;\n([ \t]*)zoomAtCursor\(g\.event\.deltaY,\s*mods,\s*focus\);/;
  const m = re.exec(src);
  if (!m) {
    log("WARN", rel + " (wheel block anchor not found)");
    dumpContext(src, "__OBS_WHEEL_AUTHORITY", 4);
    return;
  }
  const i1 = m[1];
  const i2 = m[2];
  const i3 = m[3];
  const repl =
    i1 + "// " + FIX + ":navigation.ts -- check wheel authority before raycasting\n" +
    i1 + "if ((window as any).__OBS_WHEEL_AUTHORITY) return false;\n" +
    i2 + "const focus = pickWorldPointUnderCursor(g.event.clientX, g.event.clientY);\n" +
    i3 + "zoomAtCursor(g.event.deltaY, mods, focus);";
  const s = src.replace(m[0], repl);
  backup(rel); writeRestored(rel, s, wasCRLF); log("PATCH", rel, wasCRLF ? "(CRLF preserved)" : "(LF)");
}

// =============================================================================
// J. Collect-Project.ps1 -- UTF-8 read
// =============================================================================
function fixCollectorEncoding() {
  const rel = "Collect-Project.ps1";
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }
  const { text: src, wasCRLF } = readNormalized(rel);
  if (src.indexOf(FIX + ":collector-utf8") >= 0) { log("NOOP", rel + " (already utf8)"); return; }
  if (src.indexOf("ReadAllText($f.FullName") >= 0) { log("NOOP", rel + " (ReadAllText already present)"); return; }

  // Whitespace-tolerant anchor.
  const re = /([ \t]*)\$content\s*=\s*Get-Content\s+-LiteralPath\s+\$f\.FullName\s+-Raw\s+-ErrorAction\s+Stop/;
  const m = re.exec(src);
  if (!m) {
    log("WARN", rel + " (Get-Content anchor not found)");
    dumpContext(src, "Get-Content", 3);
    return;
  }
  const indent = m[1];
  const repl =
    indent + "# " + FIX + ":collector-utf8 -- read as UTF-8 so the bundle is not mojibake\n" +
    indent + "$content = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))";
  const s = src.replace(m[0], repl);
  backup(rel); writeRestored(rel, s, wasCRLF); log("PATCH", rel, wasCRLF ? "(CRLF preserved)" : "(LF)");
}

// =============================================================================
// Run
// =============================================================================
console.log("");
console.log("Repair pass for Open BIM Studio code review fix pack...");
console.log("");
fixNativeTwinIfc();
fixUnitsSuffixes();
fixClashGeometryIdRanges();
fixAuthoringGripGuard();
fixNavigationWheelOrder();
fixCollectorEncoding();
console.log("");
console.log("Files scanned: " + (stats.crlf + stats.lf) +
            "  (CRLF: " + stats.crlf + "  LF: " + stats.lf + ")");
console.log("Summary: " + stats.patched + " patched, " + stats.noop + " no-op, " +
            stats.skipped + " skipped, " + stats.warned + " warned.");
console.log("");
if (stats.warned > 0) {
  console.log("WARN lines above print the surrounding 8 lines so you can copy them back");
  console.log("verbatim and I can produce exact anchors on the next pass.");
  console.log("");
}
```

```js
// Open BIM Studio - v3 repair pass. Structural detection, CRLF-aware, idempotent.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
const V3 = "openbim-fix:v3";

const stats = { patched: 0, noop: 0, skipped: 0, warned: 0, repaired: 0, marked: 0 };

function full(rel) { return path.join(root, rel); }
function exists(rel) { try { fs.accessSync(full(rel)); return true; } catch { return false; } }

function readNormalized(rel) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8");
  const wasCRLF = raw.indexOf("\r\n") >= 0;
  const text = wasCRLF ? raw.split("\r\n").join("\n") : raw;
  return { text, wasCRLF };
}
function writeRestored(rel, text, wasCRLF) {
  const out = wasCRLF ? text.split("\n").join("\r\n") : text;
  fs.writeFileSync(full(rel), out, "utf8");
}
function backup(rel, suffix) {
  if (!exists(rel)) return;
  const sfx = suffix || ("v3-" + stamp);
  fs.copyFileSync(full(rel), full(rel) + ".bak-" + sfx);
}
function findBackups(rel) {
  const dir = path.dirname(full(rel));
  const base = path.basename(rel);
  let entries = [];
  try { entries = fs.readdirSync(dir); } catch { return []; }
  const matches = entries.filter(f => f.startsWith(base + ".bak"));
  matches.sort((a, b) => {
    const sa = fs.statSync(path.join(dir, a)).mtimeMs;
    const sb = fs.statSync(path.join(dir, b)).mtimeMs;
    return sa - sb;
  });
  return matches.map(f => path.join(dir, f));
}
function log(kind, name, note) {
  let tag;
  if (kind === "PATCH") { tag = "PATCH "; stats.patched++; }
  else if (kind === "NOOP") { tag = "NOOP  "; stats.noop++; }
  else if (kind === "WARN") { tag = "WARN  "; stats.warned++; }
  else if (kind === "REPAIR") { tag = "REPAIR"; stats.repaired++; }
  else if (kind === "MARK") { tag = "MARK  "; stats.marked++; }
  else { tag = "SKIP  "; stats.skipped++; }
  console.log("  [" + tag + "] " + name + (note ? "  -- " + note : ""));
}
function hasV3(rel) {
  try { return fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8").indexOf(V3) >= 0; }
  catch { return false; }
}
function markIfNeeded(rel) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8");
  if (raw.indexOf(V3) >= 0) return false;
  const hasCRLF = raw.indexOf("\r\n") >= 0;
  const header = "// " + V3 + ":applied -- do not re-apply the earlier fix scripts\n";
  const out = hasCRLF ? header.replace(/\n/g, "\r\n") + raw : header + raw;
  fs.writeFileSync(full(rel), out, "utf8");
  return true;
}
function dumpContext(text, needle, radius) {
  const lines = text.split("\n");
  const hits = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) if (lines[i].indexOf(needle) >= 0) hits.push(i);
  if (!hits.length) { console.log("    (diag) no line contains: " + JSON.stringify(needle)); return; }
  for (const h of hits.slice(0, 2)) {
    const a = Math.max(0, h - radius);
    const b = Math.min(lines.length - 1, h + radius);
    console.log("    (diag) around line " + (h + 1) + ":");
    for (let i = a; i <= b; i++) console.log("    " + String(i + 1).padStart(5, " ") + " | " + lines[i]);
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// A. native-twin-ifc.ts
// =============================================================================
function fixNativeTwinIfc() {
  const rel = "src/modules/export/native-twin-ifc.ts";
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }

  let raw = fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8");
  const countLen = (raw.match(/const\s+lengthUnit\s*=\s*next\(\);/g) || []).length;
  const countAssign = (raw.match(/const\s+unitAssign\s*=\s*next\(\);/g) || []).length;
  const hasUnitAssign = raw.indexOf("IFCUNITASSIGNMENT") >= 0;
  const hasFaceSet = raw.indexOf("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET") >= 0;
  const hasFaceTypo = raw.indexOf("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESSET") >= 0;
  const dup = countLen > 1 || countAssign > 1;

  const structurallyFixed =
    !dup && hasUnitAssign && hasFaceSet && !hasFaceTypo &&
    countLen === 1 && countAssign === 1;

  if (structurallyFixed && hasV3(rel)) {
    log("NOOP", rel + " (already fixed + marked)");
    return;
  }

  if (dup) {
    const backups = findBackups(rel);
    if (!backups.length) {
      log("WARN", rel + " (duplicates present; no backup to restore)");
      return;
    }
    const oldest = backups[0];
    console.log("    (repair) duplicate unit-id blocks: lengthUnit x" + countLen +
                ", unitAssign x" + countAssign);
    console.log("    (repair) restoring from " + path.basename(oldest));
    backup(rel, "pre-restore-" + stamp);
    fs.copyFileSync(oldest, full(rel));
    log("REPAIR", rel + " (restored from " + path.basename(oldest) + ")");
    raw = fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8");
  }

  const { text: s0, wasCRLF } = readNormalized(rel);
  let s = s0;
  let changed = false;

  // ---- A1: unit-id declarations before the project id ----
  if (s.indexOf("const lengthUnit = next();") < 0) {
    const anchor = "const project = next();";
    const idx = s.indexOf(anchor);
    if (idx < 0) {
      log("WARN", rel + " (A1 `project = next()` not found)");
      dumpContext(s, "next()", 4);
      return;
    }
    const lineStart = s.lastIndexOf("\n", idx) + 1;
    const indent = s.slice(lineStart, idx);
    const block =
      indent + "const lengthUnit = next();\n" +
      indent + "const areaUnit   = next();\n" +
      indent + "const volumeUnit = next();\n" +
      indent + "const angleUnit  = next();\n" +
      indent + "const unitAssign = next();\n" +
      "\n";
    s = s.slice(0, lineStart) + block + s.slice(lineStart);
    changed = true;
  }

  // ---- A2: replace the broken IFCPROJECT block ----
  const startRe = /lines\.push\(`#\$\{project\}=IFCPROJECT\(/;
  const startM = startRe.exec(s);
  const endAnchor = "// Simpler approach: minimal valid structure without full unit assignment complexity";
  const endIdx = s.indexOf(endAnchor);
  if (!startM || endIdx < startM.index) {
    log("WARN", rel + " (A2 IFCPROJECT block anchor missing)");
    dumpContext(s, "IFCPROJECT", 4);
    return;
  }
  // Only replace if IFCUNITASSIGNMENT is not already emitted nearby.
  const lookAhead = s.slice(startM.index, Math.min(s.length, startM.index + 400));
  if (lookAhead.indexOf("IFCUNITASSIGNMENT") < 0) {
    const idxLineStart = s.lastIndexOf("\n", startM.index) + 1;
    const indent2 = s.slice(idxLineStart, startM.index);
    const replacement =
      indent2 + "lines.push(`#${lengthUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.LENGTHUNIT.,$,.METRE.);`);\n" +
      indent2 + "lines.push(`#${areaUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.AREAUNIT.,$,.SQUARE_METRE.);`);\n" +
      indent2 + "lines.push(`#${volumeUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.VOLUMEUNIT.,$,.CUBIC_METRE.);`);\n" +
      indent2 + "lines.push(`#${angleUnit}=IFCSIUNIT(*,.PLANEANGLEUNIT.,$,.RADIAN.);`);\n" +
      indent2 + "lines.push(`#${unitAssign}=IFCUNITASSIGNMENT((#${lengthUnit},#${areaUnit},#${volumeUnit},#${angleUnit}));`);\n" +
      indent2 + "lines.push(`#${project}=IFCPROJECT('${guid()}',#${owner},'Native Twin Export',$,$,$,$,(#${unitAssign}),$);`);\n";
    s = s.slice(0, idxLineStart) + replacement + s.slice(endIdx + endAnchor.length);
    changed = true;
  }

  // ---- A3: face-set typo ----
  if (s.indexOf("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESSET") >= 0) {
    s = s.split("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESSET").join("IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET");
    changed = true;
  }

  // ---- mark ----
  if (s.indexOf(V3) < 0) s = "// " + V3 + ":applied\n" + s;

  if (changed || !hasV3(rel)) {
    backup(rel, "v3-" + stamp);
    writeRestored(rel, s, wasCRLF);
    log("PATCH", rel, wasCRLF ? "(CRLF preserved)" : "(LF)");
  } else {
    log("NOOP", rel + " (nothing to do)");
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// B. units.ts
// =============================================================================
function fixUnits() {
  const rel = "src/core/units.ts";
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }
  const { text: src, wasCRLF } = readNormalized(rel);

  const structurallyFixed =
    src.indexOf("function matchAreaSuffix") >= 0 &&
    src.indexOf("function matchVolumeSuffix") >= 0 &&
    src.indexOf("function matchMassSuffix") >= 0 &&
    src.indexOf("function matchAngleSuffix") >= 0 &&
    src.indexOf("matchAreaSuffix(suffix)") >= 0 &&
    src.indexOf("matchVolumeSuffix(suffix)") >= 0 &&
    src.indexOf("matchMassSuffix(suffix)") >= 0 &&
    src.indexOf("matchAngleSuffix(suffix)") >= 0;

  if (structurallyFixed) {
    if (markIfNeeded(rel)) log("MARK", rel + " (structure ok, marker added)");
    else log("NOOP", rel + " (already fixed + marked)");
    return;
  }

  let s = src;
  let changed = false;

  // ---- B1: helper functions before parseDimension ----
  if (s.indexOf("function matchAreaSuffix") < 0) {
    const anchor = "function parseDimension(input: string, unit: string): number | null {";
    const idx = s.indexOf(anchor);
    if (idx < 0) {
      log("WARN", rel + " (B1 parseDimension not found)");
      dumpContext(s, "parseDimension", 5);
      return;
    }
    const sq = String.fromCharCode(0x00B2);
    const cu = String.fromCharCode(0x00B3);
    const dg = String.fromCharCode(0x00B0);
    const helpers =
      "// " + V3 + ":units.ts -- suffix matchers for non-length kinds\n" +
      "function matchAreaSuffix(s: string): AreaUnit | null {\n" +
      "  switch (s) {\n" +
      "    case \"mm2\": case \"mm" + sq + "\": return \"mm2\";\n" +
      "    case \"cm2\": case \"cm" + sq + "\": return \"cm2\";\n" +
      "    case \"m2\":  case \"m" + sq + "\":  return \"m2\";\n" +
      "    case \"ft2\": case \"ft" + sq + "\": return \"ft2\";\n" +
      "    case \"in2\": case \"in" + sq + "\": return \"in2\";\n" +
      "    default: return null;\n" +
      "  }\n" +
      "}\n" +
      "function matchVolumeSuffix(s: string): VolumeUnit | null {\n" +
      "  switch (s) {\n" +
      "    case \"mm3\": case \"mm" + cu + "\": return \"mm3\";\n" +
      "    case \"cm3\": case \"cm" + cu + "\": return \"cm3\";\n" +
      "    case \"m3\":  case \"m" + cu + "\":  return \"m3\";\n" +
      "    case \"ft3\": case \"ft" + cu + "\": return \"ft3\";\n" +
      "    case \"in3\": case \"in" + cu + "\": return \"in3\";\n" +
      "    case \"l\": case \"ltr\": return \"l\";\n" +
      "    default: return null;\n" +
      "  }\n" +
      "}\n" +
      "function matchMassSuffix(s: string): MassUnit | null {\n" +
      "  switch (s) {\n" +
      "    case \"g\": return \"g\";\n" +
      "    case \"kg\": return \"kg\";\n" +
      "    case \"t\": return \"t\";\n" +
      "    case \"lb\": case \"lbs\": return \"lb\";\n" +
      "    case \"oz\": return \"oz\";\n" +
      "    default: return null;\n" +
      "  }\n" +
      "}\n" +
      "function matchAngleSuffix(s: string): AngleUnit | null {\n" +
      "  switch (s) {\n" +
      "    case \"deg\": case \"" + dg + "\": return \"deg\";\n" +
      "    case \"rad\": return \"rad\";\n" +
      "    case \"grad\": return \"grad\";\n" +
      "    default: return null;\n" +
      "  }\n" +
      "}\n\n";
    s = s.slice(0, idx) + helpers + s.slice(idx);
    changed = true;
  }

  // ---- B2: switch case rewrites ----
  const cases = [
    {
      re: /case\s+"mm2"\s*:\s*case\s+"cm2"\s*:\s*case\s+"m2"\s*:\s*case\s+"ft2"\s*:\s*case\s+"in2"\s*:\s*\n\s*return\s+value\s*\*\s*AREA_TO_M2\[unit as AreaUnit\];/,
      repl: 'case "mm2": case "cm2": case "m2": case "ft2": case "in2": {\n' +
            '      const u = (suffix ? matchAreaSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as AreaUnit);\n' +
            '      return value * AREA_TO_M2[u];\n' +
            '    }'
    },
    {
      re: /case\s+"mm3"\s*:\s*case\s+"cm3"\s*:\s*case\s+"m3"\s*:\s*case\s+"ft3"\s*:\s*case\s+"in3"\s*:\s*case\s+"l"\s*:\s*\n\s*return\s+value\s*\*\s*VOLUME_TO_M3\[unit as VolumeUnit\];/,
      repl: 'case "mm3": case "cm3": case "m3": case "ft3": case "in3": case "l": {\n' +
            '      const u = (suffix ? matchVolumeSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as VolumeUnit);\n' +
            '      return value * VOLUME_TO_M3[u];\n' +
            '    }'
    },
    {
      re: /case\s+"g"\s*:\s*case\s+"kg"\s*:\s*case\s+"t"\s*:\s*case\s+"lb"\s*:\s*case\s+"oz"\s*:\s*\n\s*return\s+value\s*\*\s*MASS_TO_KG\[unit as MassUnit\];/,
      repl: 'case "g": case "kg": case "t": case "lb": case "oz": {\n' +
            '      const u = (suffix ? matchMassSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as MassUnit);\n' +
            '      return value * MASS_TO_KG[u];\n' +
            '    }'
    },
    {
      re: /case\s+"deg"\s*:\s*case\s+"rad"\s*:\s*case\s+"grad"\s*:\s*\n\s*return\s+value\s*\*\s*ANGLE_TO_RAD\[unit as AngleUnit\];/,
      repl: 'case "deg": case "rad": case "grad": {\n' +
            '      const u = (suffix ? matchAngleSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as AngleUnit);\n' +
            '      return value * ANGLE_TO_RAD[u];\n' +
            '    }'
    },
  ];
  for (const c of cases) {
    if (c.re.test(s)) { s = s.replace(c.re, c.repl); changed = true; }
  }

  // ---- B3: widen the parse regex ----
  const reLine = /cleaned\.match\(\/\^\(-?\[[^\]]*\]\+\)\s\*\(\[a-zA-Z([^\]\n]*)\]\)\?\$\//;
  const m3 = reLine.exec(s);
  if (m3) {
    const sq = String.fromCharCode(0x00B2);
    const cu = String.fromCharCode(0x00B3);
    if (m3[1].indexOf(sq) < 0) {
      const inner = m3[1] + sq + cu;
      s = s.replace(m3[0], m3[0].replace("[a-zA-Z" + m3[1] + "]", "[a-zA-Z" + inner + "]"));
      changed = true;
    }
  }

  if (!changed) {
    log("WARN", rel + " (no anchors matched; see diagnostic)");
    dumpContext(s, "parseDimension", 5);
    dumpContext(s, "cleaned.match", 3);
    return;
  }

  if (s.indexOf(V3) < 0) s = "// " + V3 + ":applied\n" + s;

  backup(rel, "v3-" + stamp);
  writeRestored(rel, s, wasCRLF);
  log("PATCH", rel, wasCRLF ? "(CRLF preserved)" : "(LF)");
}

// =============================================================================
// E/F/G. Mark-only for the three files v1 already fixed.
// =============================================================================
function markOnly(rel, structural) {
  if (!exists(rel)) { log("SKIP", rel + " (missing)"); return; }
  const src = fs.readFileSync(full(rel), "utf8");
  if (!structural(src)) {
    log("WARN", rel + " (structure missing; manual repair needed)");
    dumpContext(src, "openbim-fix", 3);
    return;
  }
  if (markIfNeeded(rel)) log("MARK", rel + " (structure ok, marker added)");
  else log("NOOP", rel + " (already fixed + marked)");
}

const isClashFixed = (src) =>
  /let\s+range\s*=\s*ranges\.get\(localId\);\s*\n\s*if\s*\(!range\)\s*\{/.test(src);

const isAuthoringFixed = (src) =>
  src.indexOf("handlesActive") >= 0 && src.indexOf("obs-wall-handles") >= 0;

const isNavigationFixed = (src) => {
  const a = src.indexOf("__OBS_WHEEL_AUTHORITY");
  const b = src.indexOf("pickWorldPointUnderCursor(g.event.clientX");
  return a >= 0 && b >= 0 && a < b;
};

// =============================================================================
// Run
// =============================================================================
console.log("");
console.log("v3 repair pass -- structural detection + duplicate cleanup...");
console.log("");
fixNativeTwinIfc();
fixUnits();
markOnly("src/modules/clash/geometry.ts", isClashFixed);
markOnly("src/features/authoring.ts", isAuthoringFixed);
markOnly("src/features/navigation.ts", isNavigationFixed);
console.log("");
console.log("Summary: " + stats.patched + " patched, " + stats.repaired + " repaired, " +
            stats.marked + " marked, " + stats.noop + " no-op, " +
            stats.skipped + " skipped, " + stats.warned + " warned.");
console.log("");
if (stats.warned > 0) {
  console.log("Copy any (diag) block above back verbatim so the next pass can be exact.");
  console.log("");
}
```

```js
// Dedupe the [code-review-fix] block in scripts/verify-input-focus.mjs.
// Idempotent. Touches one file only.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const root = process.argv[2] || process.cwd();
const rel = "scripts/verify-input-focus.mjs";
const full = path.join(root, rel);
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

// Marker exactly as Fix-OpenBIMStudio-Issues.ps1 writes it (with a space
// after the colon -- that is the source of the original idempotency bug).
const MARKER = "// ---- openbim-fix: verify-input-focus.mjs -- code review fix contract ----";

if (!fs.existsSync(full)) {
  console.log("  [SKIP] " + rel + " (missing)");
  process.exit(0);
}

const raw = fs.readFileSync(full, "utf8");
const hasCRLF = raw.indexOf("\r\n") >= 0;
const src = hasCRLF ? raw.split("\r\n").join("\n") : raw;

const parts = src.split(MARKER);
const markerCount = parts.length - 1;

if (markerCount === 0) {
  console.log("  [SKIP] " + rel + " (no [code-review-fix] marker -- nothing to dedupe)");
  process.exit(0);
}

if (markerCount === 1) {
  console.log("  [NOOP] " + rel + " (1 marker, already clean)");
  process.exit(0);
}

console.log("  Found " + markerCount + " copies of the [code-review-fix] block.");

// parts[0]   = everything before the first marker
// parts[1]   = body of block 1 (up to, but not including, marker 2)
// parts[2]   = body of block 2 (up to, but not including, marker 3)
// ...
// parts[last]= body of the last block, immediately followed by the
//              original trailing content that used to sit right before
//              `const byGroup = {};`.
const bodies = parts.slice(1, parts.length - 1);  // all but the last
const lastBody = parts[parts.length - 1];

// Guard: the last part must begin with the same body as the others,
// followed by the original trailing content.
const reference = parts[1];
if (!lastBody.startsWith(reference)) {
  console.log("  [WARN] " + rel + " (block bodies differ; refusing to guess)");
  console.log("        Run this to inspect:");
  console.log("        node -e \"const s=require('fs').readFileSync('" + rel + "','utf8');");
  console.log("          const p=s.split('" + MARKER.replace(/'/g, "\\'") + "');");
  console.log("          p.forEach((x,i)=>console.log('--- part',i,'---\\n'+x.slice(0,200)));\"");
  process.exit(1);
}
for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
  if (bodies[i] !== reference) {
    console.log("  [WARN] " + rel + " (block body #" + (i + 1) + " differs from #1)");
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

const trailing = lastBody.slice(reference.length);
const deduped = parts[0] + MARKER + reference + trailing;

fs.copyFileSync(full, full + ".bak-dedupe-" + stamp);
fs.writeFileSync(full, hasCRLF ? deduped.split("\n").join("\r\n") : deduped, "utf8");

console.log("  [PATCH] " + rel + " (" + markerCount + " -> 1 copy, backup .bak-dedupe-" + stamp + ")");
```

```js
);

    console.log("Installed npm script:  npm run verify");
    console.log("");
  }
}
```

```js
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';

const root = path.resolve(new URL('..', import.meta.url).pathname);
const checks = [
  ['selection raycast canonical fragments.modelId', 'src/features/selection.ts', /r\.fragments\?\.modelId/],
  ['manual selection style', 'src/core/setup.ts', /styles\.set\("select"/],
  ['preselection style', 'src/core/setup.ts', /styles\.set\("preselect"/],
  ['context menu vertical scroll', 'src/features/context-menu.ts', /max-height:calc\(100vh - 24px\);overflow-y:auto/],
  ['Native Twin action fallback', 'src/features/context-menu.ts', /const editMap: IdMap = picked\.map/],
  ['Native Twin source selection clear', 'src/features/frag-edit.ts', /sel\?\.clear\?\./],
  ['Revit dimension references', 'src/features/plan-view-panel.ts', /interface PlanDimensionRef/],
  ['Revit view range', 'src/modules/drawings/plan-generator.ts', /viewRangeTop/],
  ['middle-button plan pan', 'src/features/plan-view-panel.ts', /e\.button !== 1 && !\(e\.button === 0 && e\.shiftKey\)/],
  ['dimension format/unit style', 'src/features/plan-view-panel.ts', /formatPlanDimension/],
  ['release version', 'package.json', /"version": "0\.54\.0"/],
];
let failed = 0;
for (const [label, file, re] of checks) {
  const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), 'utf8');
  const ok = re.test(text);
  console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${label}`);
  if (!ok) failed++;
}
try {
  const tsc = execFileSync('tsc', ['--version'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
  console.log(`INFO  ${tsc}`);
} catch {
  console.log('INFO  tsc executable not available; syntax verification remains external.');
}
if (failed) process.exit(1);
console.log(`VERIFY_V50_BASELINE checks=${checks.length} failures=${failed}`);
```

```js
];

for (const [label, file, re] of checks) {

  const ok = re.test(text);
  console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${label}`);

}
try {

} catch {

}
if (failed) process.exit(1);
console.log(`VERIFY_V51 checks=${checks.length} failures=${failed}`);
```

```js
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const root = path.resolve(new URL('.', import.meta.url).pathname, '..');
let files = [];
function walk(dir) {
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (entry.name === 'node_modules') continue;
    const p = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(p);
    else if (entry.isFile() && entry.name.endsWith('.ts')) files.push(p);
  }
}
walk(path.join(root, 'src'));

const fragEdit = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'src/features/frag-edit.ts'), 'utf8');
const checks = [
  ['getItemsGeometry primary path', /getItemsGeometry/],
  ['localId passed to getItemsGeometry', /getter\.call\(model, \[localId\]\)/],
  ['indexed geometry support', /if \(indices && indices\.length >= 3\)/],
  ['non-indexed geometry support', /for \(let i = 0; i \+ 2 < vertexCount; i \+= 3\)/],
  ['renderer fallback retained', /getElementTrianglesExact\(model\.object, localId\)/],
  ['source metadata retained', /getItemsData\(\[localId\]/],
];
let passed = 0;
for (const [name, re] of checks) {
  if (re.test(fragEdit)) passed++;
  else console.error(`FAIL: ${name}`);
}

console.log(`Source inventory: ${files.length} TypeScript file(s)`);
console.log(`Native Twin regression checks: ${passed}/${checks.length} pass`);
if (passed !== checks.length) process.exit(1);
```

--- FILE: server/index.mjs ---
```js
import http from "node:http";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

const dataDir = path.join(__dirname, "data");
const projectsFile = path.join(dataDir, "projects.json");
const roomsFile = path.join(dataDir, "rooms.json");

const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT || 4000);
const MAX_BODY = 200 * 1024 * 1024;
const PRESENCE_TIMEOUT_MS = 45000;
const MAX_CHANGES_PER_ROOM = 500;

const sseClients = new Map();

function ensureStore() {
  fs.mkdirSync(dataDir, { recursive: true });

  if (!fs.existsSync(projectsFile)) {
    fs.writeFileSync(projectsFile, "{}", "utf8");
  }

  if (!fs.existsSync(roomsFile)) {
    fs.writeFileSync(roomsFile, "{}", "utf8");
  }
}

function loadJson(file, fallback) {
  ensureStore();

  try {
    return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

function saveJson(file, value) {
  ensureStore();
  fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(value, null, 2), "utf8");
}

let projects = loadJson(projectsFile, {});
let rooms = loadJson(roomsFile, {});

function send(res, status, body) {
  const data =
    typeof body === "string"
      ? body
      : JSON.stringify(body ?? {}, null, 2);

  res.writeHead(status, {
    "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,PUT,OPTIONS",
    "Content-Length": Buffer.byteLength(data),
  });

  res.end(data);
}

function readBody(req) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let size = 0;
    const chunks = [];

    req.on("data", (chunk) => {
      size += chunk.length;

      if (size > MAX_BODY) {
        reject(new Error("Payload too large"));
        req.destroy();
        return;
      }

      chunks.push(chunk);
    });

    req.on("end", () => {
      resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8"));
    });

    req.on("error", reject);
  });
}

function getRoom(roomId) {
  if (!rooms[roomId]) {
    rooms[roomId] = {
      id: roomId,
      clients: {},
      changes: [],
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }

  return rooms[roomId];
}

function touchRoom(room) {
  room.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  saveJson(roomsFile, rooms);
}

function presenceList(roomId) {
  const room = getRoom(roomId);
  const now = Date.now();

  const list = [];

  for (const c of Object.values(room.clients)) {
    if (!c || !c.clientId) continue;
    if (now - Number(c.updatedAt || 0) > PRESENCE_TIMEOUT_MS) continue;

    list.push({
      clientId: c.clientId,
      name: c.name || "Guest",
      cursor: c.cursor || null,
      updatedAt: c.updatedAt,
    });
  }

  return list;
}

function broadcast(roomId, event, payload) {
  const set = sseClients.get(roomId);

  if (!set || !set.size) {
    return;
  }

  const msg = `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(payload)}\n\n`;

  for (const res of set) {
    try {
      res.write(msg);
    } catch {
      try {
        res.end();
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    }
  }
}

function addSse(roomId, res) {
  if (!sseClients.has(roomId)) {
    sseClients.set(roomId, new Set());
  }

  sseClients.get(roomId).add(res);

  res.on("close", () => {
    const set = sseClients.get(roomId);

    if (set) {
      set.delete(res);

      if (!set.size) {
        sseClients.delete(roomId);
      }
    }
  });
}

function addChange(roomId, change) {
  const room = getRoom(roomId);

  const item = {
    id: change.id || `chg-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
    clientId: change.clientId,
    type: change.type || "unknown",
    payload: change.payload ?? {},
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  room.changes.push(item);

  if (room.changes.length > MAX_CHANGES_PER_ROOM) {
    room.changes = room.changes.slice(-MAX_CHANGES_PER_ROOM);
  }

  touchRoom(room);
  broadcast(roomId, "change", item);

  return item;
}

setInterval(() => {
  let changed = false;
  const now = Date.now();

  for (const roomId of Object.keys(rooms)) {
    const room = rooms[roomId];

    if (!room || !room.clients) continue;

    for (const clientId of Object.keys(room.clients)) {
      const c = room.clients[clientId];

      if (!c || now - Number(c.updatedAt || 0) > PRESENCE_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        delete room.clients[clientId];
        changed = true;
      }
    }

    if (changed) {
      broadcast(roomId, "presence", presenceList(roomId));
    }
  }

  if (changed) {
    saveJson(roomsFile, rooms);
  }
}, 15000);

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return send(res, 204, "");
  }

  const url = new URL(
    req.url || "/",
    `http://${req.headers.host || "localhost"}`,
  );

  const projectMatch = url.pathname.match(/^\/api\/projects\/([^/]+)$/);

  if (projectMatch) {
    const id = decodeURIComponent(projectMatch[1]);

    if (req.method === "GET") {
      const project = projects[id];

      if (!project) {
        return send(res, 404, { error: "Project not found" });
      }

      return send(res, 200, project);
    }

    if (req.method === "PUT") {
      try {
        const raw = await readBody(req);
        const body = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};

        const project = {
          id,
          name: body.name || id,
          data: body.data ?? body,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        projects[id] = project;
        saveJson(projectsFile, projects);

        return send(res, 200, project);
      } catch (e) {
        return send(res, 400, {
          error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e),
        });
      }
    }

    return send(res, 405, { error: "Method not allowed" });
  }

  const roomEventsMatch = url.pathname.match(/^\/api\/rooms\/([^/]+)\/events$/);

  if (roomEventsMatch && req.method === "GET") {
    const roomId = decodeURIComponent(roomEventsMatch[1]);
    getRoom(roomId);

    res.writeHead(200, {
      "Content-Type": "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8",
      "Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-transform",
      Connection: "keep-alive",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type",
    });

    res.write("retry: 2000\n\n");
    res.write(`event: hello\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ roomId, at: Date.now() })}\n\n`);
    res.write(`event: presence\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(presenceList(roomId))}\n\n`);

    addSse(roomId, res);
    return;
  }

  const roomBaseMatch = url.pathname.match(/^\/api\/rooms\/([^/]+)$/);

  if (roomBaseMatch && req.method === "GET") {
    const roomId = decodeURIComponent(roomBaseMatch[1]);
    const room = getRoom(roomId);

    return send(res, 200, {
      id: roomId,
      presence: presenceList(roomId),
      changes: room.changes.slice(-80),
      updatedAt: room.updatedAt,
    });
  }

  const roomActionMatch = url.pathname.match(
    /^\/api\/rooms\/([^/]+)\/(join|heartbeat|leave|change)$/,
  );

  if (roomActionMatch && req.method === "POST") {
    const roomId = decodeURIComponent(roomActionMatch[1]);
    const action = roomActionMatch[2];

    let body = {};

    try {
      const raw = await readBody(req);
      body = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    } catch {
      return send(res, 400, { error: "Invalid JSON" });
    }

    const room = getRoom(roomId);
    const clientId = String(body.clientId || "").trim();

    if (!clientId) {
      return send(res, 400, { error: "clientId required" });
    }

    if (action === "join" || action === "heartbeat") {
      room.clients[clientId] = {
        clientId,
        name: String(body.name || "Guest"),
        cursor: body.cursor ?? null,
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      };

      touchRoom(room);
      broadcast(roomId, "presence", presenceList(roomId));

      return send(res, 200, { ok: true, presence: presenceList(roomId) });
    }

    if (action === "leave") {
      delete room.clients[clientId];
      touchRoom(room);
      broadcast(roomId, "presence", presenceList(roomId));

      return send(res, 200, { ok: true });
    }

    if (action === "change") {
      const change = addChange(roomId, {
        id: body.id,
        clientId,
        type: body.type,
        payload: body.payload,
      });

      return send(res, 200, { ok: true, change });
    }
  }

  return send(res, 404, {
    error:
      "Not found. Use /api/projects/:id or /api/rooms/:room or /api/rooms/:room/events or /api/rooms/:room/join",
  });
});

server.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(
    `[collab] Open BIM Studio server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`,
  );
  console.log(`[collab] Projects API:   /api/projects/:id`);
  console.log(`[collab] Rooms API:      /api/rooms/:room`);
  console.log(`[collab] Live SSE API:   /api/rooms/:room/events`);
});
```

```ts
export abstract class Command {
  /** Human readable name */
  abstract name: string;
  /** Execute the command */
  abstract execute(): Promise<any>;
  /** Undo the command */
  abstract undo(): Promise<any>;
  /** Optional JSON serialization for versioning */
  toJSON?(): any {
    return { type: this.constructor.name };
  }
}
```

```ts
// src/commands/CreateStairAdvanced.ts
import { Command } from './CommandBase';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';
import * as THREE from 'three';

/**
 * Advanced stair generator that creates separate tread and riser elements.
 * For demo purposes we only create a simple monolithic geometry but expose
 * a clear extension point for generating multiple IFC elements.
 */
export class CreateStairAdvanced extends Command {
  name = 'Create Advanced Stair';
  private stairIds: number[] = [];
  constructor(private api?: IfcAPI, private params?: {
    base: [number, number, number];
    direction: [number, number, number];
    rise: number;
    run: number;
    treadDepth: number;
    treadWidth: number;
    numSteps: number;
  }) { super(); }

  async execute() {
    if (!this.api || !this.params) throw new Error('IfcAPI or parameters not provided');
    const { base, direction, rise, run, treadDepth, treadWidth, numSteps } = this.params!;
    for (let i = 0; i < numSteps; i++) {
      const stepGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(treadWidth, rise, treadDepth);
      const placement = await this.api.CreateAxis2Placement3D({
        Location: [base[0] + direction[0] * (i * treadDepth), base[1] + i * rise, base[2]],
        // orientation omitted for brevity
      });
      const shape = await this.api.CreateIfcShapeRepresentation({
        ContextOfItems: 0,
        RepresentationIdentifier: 'Body',
        RepresentationType: 'SweptSolid',
        Items: [{ type: 'IfcFacetedBrep', geometry: stepGeometry }],
      });
      const elem = await this.api.CreateIfcBuildingElementProxy({ ObjectPlacement: placement, Representation: shape });
      this.stairIds.push(elem.id);
    }
    return this.stairIds;
  }

  async undo() {
    for (const id of this.stairIds) {
      await this.api!.DeleteEntity!(id);
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Command } from './CommandBase';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';

export interface WallParams {
  start: [number, number, number];
  end: [number, number, number];
  height?: number;
  thickness?: number;
  fireRating?: string;
}

export class CreateWall extends Command {
  name = 'Create Wall';
  private wallId!: number;

  constructor(private api?: IfcAPI, private params?: WallParams) {
    super();
  }

  async execute() {
    if (!this.api || !this.params) throw new Error('IfcAPI or parameters not provided');
    const { start, end, height = 3000, thickness = 200, fireRating } = this.params;
    const profile = await this.api.CreateRectangleProfileDef({ XDim: thickness, YDim: height });
    // direction vector length
    const dir = [end[0] - start[0], end[1] - start[1], end[2] - start[2]] as [number, number, number];
    const length = Math.hypot(...dir);
    const placement = await this.api.CreateAxis2Placement3D({ Location: start });
    const solid = await this.api.CreateExtrudedAreaSolid({
      SweptArea: profile,
      Depth: length,
      ExtrudedDirection: [0, 0, 1],
      Position: placement,
    });
    const wall = await this.api.CreateIfcWallStandardCase({
      ObjectPlacement: placement,
      Representation: {
        Representations: [
          {
            RepresentationIdentifier: 'Body',
            RepresentationType: 'SweptSolid',
            Items: [solid],
          },
        ],
      },
    });
    if (fireRating) {
      const pset = await this.api.CreatePropertySet('Pset_FireRating', [
        { Name: 'FireRating', NominalValue: fireRating },
      ]);
      await this.api.AssignPropertySet(wall, pset);
    }
    this.wallId = wall.id;
    return this.wallId;
  }

  async undo() {
    await this.api!.DeleteEntity!(this.wallId);
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Command } from '../CommandBase';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { select } from '../../main';

/**
 * Imports a GLB/GLTF file, creates a separate IFC element for each mesh,
 * and selects the first imported element.
 */
export class ImportGLBCommand extends Command {
  name = 'Import GLB';
  private file: File;
  private createdIds: number[] = [];

  constructor(file: File) {
    super();
    this.file = file;
  }

  async execute() {
    const api = (window as any).ifcAPI as IfcAPI; // assume global reference
    if (!api) throw new Error('IFC API not available');

    const arrayBuffer = await this.file.arrayBuffer();
    const loader = new GLTFLoader();
    const gltf: any = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      loader.parse(arrayBuffer, '', resolve, reject);
    });

    // Find all meshes in the GLB
    const meshes: any[] = [];
    gltf.scene.traverse((obj: any) => {
      if (obj.isMesh) meshes.push(obj);
    });
    if (meshes.length === 0) throw new Error('No mesh found in GLB file');

    for (const mesh of meshes) {
      const placement = await api.CreateAxis2Placement3D({ Location: [0, 0, 0] });
      const shape = await api.CreateIfcShapeRepresentation({
        ContextOfItems: 0,
        RepresentationIdentifier: 'Body',
        RepresentationType: 'SweptSolid',
        Items: [], // Placeholder – real geometry conversion would be added here
      });
      const elem = await api.CreateIfcBuildingElementProxy({ ObjectPlacement: placement, Representation: shape });
      this.createdIds.push(elem.id);
    }

    // Select the first created element for convenience
    if (this.createdIds.length > 0) {
      select(this.createdIds[0]);
    }
    return this.createdIds;
  }

  async undo() {
    const api = (window as any).ifcAPI as IfcAPI;
    for (const id of this.createdIds) {
      await api.DeleteEntity(id);
    }
  }
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/AdaptiveComponentEditor.tsx
import React from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogTitle, DialogContent, DialogActions, Button, TextField } from '@mui/material';
import { useAppDispatch } from '../storeHooks';
import { pushCommand } from '../main';
import { Command } from '../commands/CommandBase';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';
import * as THREE from 'three';

/**
 * A placeholder UI for creating Adaptive Components.
 * Users specify a host element ID and a rule (simple JavaScript expression).
 * The rule will be evaluated at runtime to modify geometry based on host size.
 */
export const AdaptiveComponentEditor: React.FC<{ open: boolean; onClose: () => void; api: IfcAPI }> = ({ open, onClose, api }) => {
  const [hostId, setHostId] = React.useState('');
  const [rule, setRule] = React.useState('size * 0.5'); // very simple placeholder
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const handleCreate = () => {
    class AdaptiveCommand extends Command {
      name = 'Adaptive Component';
      private createdId!: number;
      async execute() {
        const host = api.GetLine(api.GetModelID(), Number(hostId)); // simplistic
        const size = (host?.BoundingBox?.[0]?.value ?? 1) as number; // placeholder
        const factor = eval(rule); // unsafe – only for demo
        const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(factor, factor, factor);
        const placement = await api.CreateAxis2Placement3D({ Location: [0, 0, 0] });
        const shape = await api!.CreateIfcShapeRepresentation!({
          ContextOfItems: 0,
          RepresentationIdentifier: 'Body',
          RepresentationType: 'SweptSolid',
          Items: [{ type: 'IfcFacetedBrep', geometry }],
        });
        const elem = await api!.CreateIfcBuildingElementProxy!({ ObjectPlacement: placement, Representation: shape });
        this.createdId = elem.id;
        return this.createdId;
      }
      async undo() { await api.DeleteEntity(this.createdId); }
    }
    const cmd = new AdaptiveCommand();
    cmd.execute();
    dispatch(pushCommand(cmd));
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle>Adaptive Component</DialogTitle>
      <DialogContent>
        <TextField label="Host Element ID" fullWidth margin="dense" value={hostId} onChange={e => setHostId(e.target.value)} />
        <TextField label="Rule (JS expression)" fullWidth margin="dense" value={rule} onChange={e => setRule(e.target.value)} helperText='Use "size" variable representing host size' />
      </DialogContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
        <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleCreate}>Create</Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
};
```

```tsx
// src/components/AdvancedRenderer.tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Canvas, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { OrbitControls, Stats, EffectComposer, Bloom, SSAO } from '@react-three/postprocessing';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';

/**
 * Advanced renderer using post‑processing passes (Bloom, SSAO) and a
 * physically‑based material. This is a thin wrapper around the existing
 * Viewport but demonstrates how to enable ray‑tracing like features when the
 * hardware / browser supports WebGL2.
 */
export const AdvancedRenderer: React.FC<{ api: IfcAPI }> = ({ api }) => {
  const sceneRef = useRef<THREE.Scene>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sceneRef.current) return;
    const modelID = api.GetModelID();
    const ids = api.GetAllLines(modelID, 'IFCPRODUCT');
    const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x7da7d9, roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.1 });
    ids.forEach(id => {
      const geom = api.GetGeometry(modelID, id);
      if (!geom) return;
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, material);
      mesh.userData.expressID = id;
      sceneRef.current!.add(mesh);
    });
  }, [api]);

  return (
    <Canvas camera={{ position: [10, 10, 10], fov: 60 }} style={{ height: '100%' }}>
      <ambientLight intensity={0.5} />
      <directionalLight position={[10, 10, 10]} intensity={0.8} castShadow />
      <OrbitControls makeDefault />
      <group ref={sceneRef as any} />
      <EffectComposer>
        <SSAO intensity={0.5} radius={5} />
        <Bloom luminanceThreshold={0} luminanceSmoothing={0.9} height={300} />
      </EffectComposer>
      <Stats />
    </Canvas>
  );
};
```
