```tsx
// src/components/FamilySketchEditor.tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Tldraw } from '@tldraw/editor';
import { useAppDispatch } from '../storeHooks';
import { pushCommand } from '../main';
import { Command } from '../commands/CommandBase';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { GLTFExporter } from 'three/examples/jsm/exporters/GLTFExporter';

/**
 * A very thin wrapper around @tldraw/editor that lets the user sketch a 2‑D profile
 * and then extrudes it into a parametric family.
 * The UI is inserted as a modal (simple div for now). When the user clicks "Create",
 * the sketch data is converted to a THREE.Shape, extruded, and wrapped in an IFC
 * command (CreateFamilyInstance) that will be added to the model.
 */
export const FamilySketchEditor: React.FC<{ api: IfcAPI; onClose: () => void }> = ({ api, onClose }) => {
  const editorRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!editorRef.current) return;
    const geometries = editorRef.current.getScene()?.shapes ?? [];
    if (geometries.length === 0) {
      alert('Draw a closed shape first');
      return;
    }
    // Take the first shape (for demo) and build a THREE.Shape
    const points = geometries[0].points.map((p: any) => new THREE.Vector2(p.x, p.y));
    const shape = new THREE.Shape(points);
    const extrude = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, { depth: 3000, bevelEnabled: false });
    // Export to GLTF (placeholder) – you could also directly feed into IFC API.
    const exporter = new GLTFExporter();
    exporter.parse(
      extrude,
      (gltf: any) => {
        // In a real implementation we would store this GLTF as a family asset
        console.log('Exported GLTF', gltf);
        // For now we just dispatch a generic command placeholder
        class SketchFamilyCommand extends Command {
          name = 'Sketch Family';
          async execute() {
            // Insert geometry into IFC as a generic IfcBuildingElementProxy
            const placement = await api.CreateAxis2Placement3D({ Location: [0, 0, 0] });
            const shapeRep = await api!.CreateIfcShapeRepresentation!({
              ContextOfItems: 0,
              RepresentationIdentifier: 'Body',
              RepresentationType: 'SweptSolid',
              Items: [{ type: 'IfcFacetedBrep', geometry: extrude }],
            });
            const entity = await api!.CreateIfcBuildingElementProxy!({
              ObjectPlacement: placement,
              Representation: shapeRep,
            });
            return entity.id;
          }
          async undo() {
            // Not implemented – in a full version we would store the id and delete it.
          }
        }
        const cmd = new SketchFamilyCommand();
        cmd.execute();
        dispatch(pushCommand(cmd));
        onClose();
      },
      { binary: false }
    );
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)', zIndex: 2000, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, background: '#fff' }}>
        <Tldraw ref={editorRef} schema="web" />
      </div>
      <div style={{ padding: 8, background: '#eee', display: 'flex', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
        <button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
        <button onClick={handleCreate}>Create Family</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { TreeItem, TreeView } from '@mui/lab';
import { useAppSelector, useAppDispatch } from '../storeHooks';
import { select } from '../main';

export const ProjectTree: React.FC = () => {
  const api = useAppSelector(s => s.bim.ifcAPI);
  const modelID = useAppSelector(s => s.bim.modelID);
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  if (!api || modelID === null) return <div>Loading…</div>;

  const projects = api.GetAllLines(modelID, 'IFCPROJECT');
  if (projects.length == 0) return <div>No project</div>;
  const projectId = projects[0];
  const project = api.GetLine(modelID, projectId);

  const renderNode = (expressID: number) => {
    const line = api.GetLine(modelID, expressID) as any;
    const label = line.Name?.value ?? line.constructor.name;
    // collect direct children via IfcRelAggregates where RelatingObject = expressID
    const children: number[] = [];
    const rels = api.GetAllLines(modelID, 'IFCRELAGGREGATES');
    rels.forEach((relId: number) => {
      const rel = api.GetLine(modelID, relId) as any;
      if (rel.RelatingObject?.value === expressID) {
        (rel.RelatedObjects ?? []).forEach((obj:any) => children.push(obj.value));
      }
    });
    return (
      <TreeItem key={expressID} nodeId={expressID.toString()} label={label} onLabelClick={() => dispatch(select(expressID))}>
        {children.map(renderNode)}
      </TreeItem>
    );
  };

  return (
    <TreeView
      defaultCollapseIcon={<span>-</span>}
      defaultExpandIcon={<span>+</span>}
      sx={{ height: '100%', overflowY: 'auto', bgcolor: '#fafafa' }}
    >
      {renderNode(projectId)}
    </TreeView>
  );
};
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogTitle, DialogContent, DialogActions, Button, TextField } from '@mui/material';
import { useAppDispatch } from '../storeHooks';
import { pushCommand } from '../main';
import { Command } from '../commands/CommandBase';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';

/**
 * Very simple schedule export for new M2 element types.
 * Generates a CSV string and triggers a file download.
 */
export const SchedulePanel: React.FC<{ open: boolean; onClose: () => void; api: IfcAPI }> = ({ open, onClose, api }) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('Stair Schedule');

  const handleExport = async () => {
    // Gather all stairs (example) – real implementation would query IFC for specific types
    const stairs = api.GetAllLines(api.GetModelID(), 'IFCSTAIR');
    const rows = [['ID', 'Rise', 'Run', 'Steps']];
    for (const id of stairs) {
      const line: any = api.GetLine(api.GetModelID(), id);
      rows.push([id.toString(), line.Rise?.value ?? '', line.Run?.value ?? '', line.NumberOfRiser?.value ?? '']);
    }
    const csv = rows.map(r => r.join(',')).join('\n');
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${title.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle>Export Schedule</DialogTitle>
      <DialogContent>
        <TextField label="Schedule Title" fullWidth margin="dense" value={title} onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)} />
      </DialogContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
        <Button variant="contained" onClick={handleExport}>Export CSV</Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
};
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { OrbitControls, Stats } from '@react-three/drei';
import { useAppSelector, useAppDispatch } from '../storeHooks';
import { select } from '../main';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { MeshBVH, acceleratedRaycast } from 'three-mesh-bvh';

THREE.Mesh.prototype.raycast = acceleratedRaycast;

export const Viewport: React.FC = () => {
  const api = useAppSelector(s => s.bim.ifcAPI);
  const modelID = useAppSelector(s => s.bim.modelID);
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!api || modelID === null) return;
    const ids = api.GetAllLines(modelID, 'IFCPRODUCT');
    const scene = new THREE.Group();
    const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x7da7d9 });
    ids.forEach((id: number) => {
      const geom = api.GetGeometry(modelID, id);
      if (!geom) return;
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom.geometry, material);
      mesh.userData.expressID = id;
      // BVH for fast selection / clash
      (mesh.geometry as any).computeBoundsTree?.();
      (mesh.geometry as any).boundsTree = new MeshBVH(mesh.geometry);
      scene.add(mesh);
    });
    // expose scene globally for debugging (optional)
    (window as any).bimScene = scene;
  }, [api, modelID]);

  const handleClick = (event: any) => {
    const { clientX, clientY, target } = event;
    const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    const y = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    const camera = (event.currentTarget as any).camera; // three-fiber exposes camera via ref
    raycaster.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(x, y), camera);
    const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects((window as any).bimScene.children, false);
    if (intersects.length > 0) {
      const id = (intersects[0].object as any).userData.expressID;
      dispatch(select(id));
    } else {
      dispatch(select(null));
    }
  };

  return (
    <Canvas onClick={handleClick} style={{ background: '#eaeaea' }} camera={{ position: [10, 10, 10], fov: 60 }}>
      <ambientLight intensity={0.5} />
      <directionalLight position={[10, 10, 10]} intensity={0.8} castShadow />
      <OrbitControls makeDefault />
      <Stats />
    </Canvas>
  );
};
```

```tsx
// src/components/WorksharingPanel.tsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogTitle, DialogContent, DialogActions, Button, List, ListItem, ListItemText } from '@mui/material';
import * as Y from 'yjs';
import { WebsocketProvider } from 'y-websocket';
import { IfcAPI } from 'web-ifc';

/**
 * Minimal UI to show element‑level lock status using Y‑js.
 * Each element gets a lock entry in a Y‑Map: { elementId: userId }.
 * When the current user selects an element, we attempt to acquire the lock.
 */
export const WorksharingPanel: React.FC<{ open: boolean; onClose: () => void; api: IfcAPI }> = ({ open, onClose, api }) => {
  const [ydoc] = useState(() => new Y.Doc());
  const [provider] = useState(() => new WebsocketProvider('wss://yjs.dev:1234', 'openbimstudio-room', ydoc));
  const locks = ydoc.getMap('elementLocks');
  const [lockedElements, setLockedElements] = useState<Array<{ id: number; user: string }>>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => {
      const arr: Array<{ id: number; user: string }> = [];
      locks.forEach((user, id) => arr.push({ id: Number(id), user: user as string }));
      setLockedElements(arr);
    };
    locks.observe(update);
    return () => locks.unobserve(update);
  }, [locks]);

  const attemptLock = (elemId: number) => {
    const myId = 'user-' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);
    const current = locks.get(elemId.toString());
    if (!current) {
      locks.set(elemId.toString(), myId);
      alert(`Locked element ${elemId}`);
    } else {
      alert(`Element ${elemId} already locked by ${current}`);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
      <DialogTitle>Worksharing – Element Locks</DialogTitle>
      <DialogContent>
        <List>
          {lockedElements.map(l => (
            <ListItem key={l.id}>
              <ListItemText primary={`Element ${l.id}`} secondary={`Locked by ${l.user}`} />
            </ListItem>
          ))}
        </List>
        <Button variant="contained" onClick={() => attemptLock(1)}>Lock Element 1 (demo)</Button>
      </DialogContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <Button onClick={onClose}>Close</Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </Dialog>
  );
};
```

```ts
/**
 * Camera-controls gating.
 *
 * Different @thatopen/components versions expose the underlying
 * CameraControls instance at different paths. This module probes once,
 * caches the reference, and provides a reference-counted pause so multiple
 * features (gizmo, box-select, authoring grip drag) can hold the camera
 * paused simultaneously without one re-enabling it while another still
 * needs it disabled.
 */
import { ctx } from "./context";

let cached: any = null;
let cacheAttempted = false;

function findControls(): any {
  if (cacheAttempted) return cached;
  cacheAttempted = true;
  try {
    const cam: any = (ctx.world as any)?.camera;
    if (!cam) return (cached = null);

    // Prefer an object that exposes `.enabled` directly (the actual controls).
    if (cam.controls && typeof cam.controls === "object") {
      if (typeof cam.controls.enabled === "boolean") return (cached = cam.controls);
      if (cam.controls.controls && typeof cam.controls.controls.enabled === "boolean") {
        return (cached = cam.controls.controls);
      }
    }
    if (cam.cameraControls && typeof cam.cameraControls.enabled === "boolean") {
      return (cached = cam.cameraControls);
    }
  } catch {
    /* swallow — a missing controls object is a valid state during boot */
  }
  return (cached = null);
}

export function resetCameraGateCache(): void {
  cached = null;
  cacheAttempted = false;
  holders = 0;
  lastEnabled = null;
}

let holders = 0;
let lastEnabled: boolean | null = null;

function applyEnabled(on: boolean): void {
  if (lastEnabled === on) return;
  const c = findControls();
  if (c) c.enabled = on;
  lastEnabled = on;
}

/**
 * Pause camera interaction. Returns a release function. Callers must call
 * the release exactly once. Nested calls are supported via refcount.
 */
export function pauseCameraControls(): () => void {
  holders++;
  applyEnabled(false);
  let released = false;
  return () => {
    if (released) return;
    released = true;
    holders = Math.max(0, holders - 1);
    if (holders === 0) applyEnabled(true);
  };
}

export function cameraControlsPaused(): boolean {
  return holders > 0;
}

/** Force-reset the gate — used by recovery code after a stuck gesture. */
export function forceResumeCameraControls(): void {
  holders = 0;
  applyEnabled(true);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Diagnostics — ring-buffered warn/error capture for the whole app.
 */
import { ctx } from "./context";

export type DiagLevel = "info" | "warn" | "error";

export interface DiagEvent {
  id: number;
  ts: number;
  level: DiagLevel;
  scope: string;
  message: string;
  error?: unknown;
}

const MAX_EVENTS = 500;
const listeners = new Set<(e: DiagEvent) => void>();

let counter = 0;
let events: DiagEvent[] = [];

function record(
  level: DiagLevel,
  scope: string,
  message: unknown,
  error?: unknown,
): DiagEvent {
  const ev: DiagEvent = {
    id: ++counter,
    ts: Date.now(),
    level,
    scope,
    message: typeof message === "string" ? message : String(message ?? ""),
    error,
  };
  events.push(ev);
  if (events.length > MAX_EVENTS) events.shift();

  const fn =
    level === "error" ? console.error : level === "warn" ? console.warn : console.info;
  if (error !== undefined) fn(`[${scope}]`, message, error);
  else fn(`[${scope}]`, message);

  for (const l of listeners) {
    try {
      l(ev);
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }
  refreshBadge();
  return ev;
}

export const diagnostics = {
  info: (scope: string, message: unknown) => record("info", scope, message),
  warn: (scope: string, message: unknown, error?: unknown) =>
    record("warn", scope, message, error),
  error: (scope: string, message: unknown, error?: unknown) =>
    record("error", scope, message, error),
  list: (): readonly DiagEvent[] => events,
  clear: () => {
    events = [];
    refreshBadge();
  },
  counts: (): { info: number; warn: number; error: number } => {
    const out = { info: 0, warn: 0, error: 0 };
    for (const e of events) out[e.level]++;
    return out;
  },
  onEvent: (cb: (e: DiagEvent) => void): (() => void) => {
    listeners.add(cb);
    return () => listeners.delete(cb);
  },
  installGlobalHandlers: () => {
    // main.ts already shows an overlay; we only ring-buffer here.
    window.addEventListener("error", (ev) => {
      record("error", "window.error", ev.message, ev.error);
    });
    window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (ev) => {
      const reason = (ev as PromiseRejectionEvent).reason ?? "unhandled rejection";
      record("error", "window.unhandledrejection", reason);
    });
  },
};

let badge: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let badgeClickInstalled = false;

function ensureBadge(): HTMLDivElement {
  if (badge) return badge;
  badge = document.createElement("div");
  badge.id = "obs-diag-badge";
  badge.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;right:14px;bottom:40px;z-index:57;display:none;" +
    "min-width:22px;height:20px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:10px;" +
    "background:rgba(239,68,68,.85);color:#fff;" +
    "font:700 10.5px/20px ui-monospace,monospace;text-align:center;" +
    "cursor:pointer;pointer-events:auto;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.4)";
  badge.title = "Diagnostics";
  if (ctx.rightHost) ctx.rightHost.appendChild(badge);
  return badge;
}

function refreshBadge(): void {
  try {
    if (!ctx.rightHost) return;
    const el = ensureBadge();
    const c = diagnostics.counts();
    const n = c.warn + c.error;
    if (n === 0) {
      el.style.display = "none";
      return;
    }
    el.style.display = "block";
    el.textContent = String(n);
    el.style.background =
      c.error > 0 ? "rgba(239,68,68,.85)" : "rgba(245,158,11,.85)";
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

function installBadgeClick(): void {
  if (badgeClickInstalled) return;
  badgeClickInstalled = true;
  ensureBadge().addEventListener("click", () => openDiagnosticsPanel());
}

let panel: HTMLDivElement | null = null;

function openDiagnosticsPanel(): void {
  if (panel) {
    panel.style.display = "flex";
    renderPanel();
    return;
  }
  if (!ctx.rightHost) return;
  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = "obs-diag-panel";
  panel.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;right:14px;top:14px;bottom:64px;width:420px;z-index:58;" +
    "display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#1c1e28;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 16px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:#e8eaf0;" +
    "font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden";
  panel.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

  const header = document.createElement("div");
  header.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 10px;" +
    "border-bottom:1px solid #1e2029;background:#181a23;flex-shrink:0";
  header.innerHTML = `<span style="font-weight:700;flex:1">Diagnostics</span>`;
  const clearBtn = document.createElement("button");
  clearBtn.textContent = "Clear";
  clearBtn.style.cssText =
    "padding:3px 9px;background:transparent;color:#9ca3af;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10.5px";
  clearBtn.onclick = () => {
    diagnostics.clear();
    renderPanel();
  };
  const closeBtn = document.createElement("button");
  closeBtn.textContent = "✕";
  closeBtn.style.cssText =
    "padding:3px 8px;background:transparent;color:#9ca3af;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px";
  closeBtn.onclick = () => {
    if (panel) panel.style.display = "none";
  };
  header.append(clearBtn, closeBtn);

  const body = document.createElement("div");
  body.style.cssText = "flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px";

  panel.append(header, body);
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);
  renderPanel();
}

function renderPanel(): void {
  if (!panel) return;
  const body = panel.querySelector("div:nth-child(2)") as HTMLElement;
  if (!body) return;
  body.innerHTML = "";

  const list = diagnostics.list();
  if (!list.length) {
    body.innerHTML =
      `<div style="padding:30px;text-align:center;color:#6b7280">No diagnostics recorded.</div>`;
    return;
  }

  for (const e of list.slice().reverse()) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    const color = e.level === "error" ? "#ef4444" : e.level === "warn" ? "#f59e0b" : "#38bdf8";
    row.style.cssText =
      "padding:7px 9px;margin-bottom:5px;border-radius:6px;" +
      `border-left:3px solid ${color};background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);font-size:11px;line-height:1.4`;
    const time = new Date(e.ts).toLocaleTimeString();
    const msg = String(e.message)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
    row.innerHTML =
      `<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:baseline;font-size:10px;color:#6b7280">` +
      `<b style="color:${color}">${e.level.toUpperCase()}</b>` +
      `<span style="font-family:monospace">${e.scope}</span>` +
      `<span style="margin-left:auto">${time}</span></div>` +
      `<div style="margin-top:3px;word-break:break-word">${msg}</div>`;
    body.appendChild(row);
  }
}

export function setupDiagnostics(): void {
  ensureBadge();
  installBadgeClick();
  diagnostics.installGlobalHandlers();
  refreshBadge();
  (ctx.features as any).diagnostics = diagnostics;
  console.log("[diagnostics] ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Error handling: a global reporter, a ring-buffer log, and a boot-failure
 * screen. Replaces ad-hoc `console.error` + `alert()` calls with a single
 * entry point that surfaces failures in the UI instead of hiding them in
 * the dev-tools console.
 */
import { notify, type NotifyKind } from "./notify";

export interface ErrorEntry {
  time: number;
  message: string;
  stack?: string;
  context?: string;
}

const LOG_LIMIT = 200;
const log: ErrorEntry[] = [];

export function logError(err: unknown, context?: string): ErrorEntry {
  const entry: ErrorEntry = {
    time: Date.now(),
    message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
    stack: err instanceof Error ? err.stack : undefined,
    context,
  };
  log.push(entry);
  if (log.length > LOG_LIMIT) log.shift();
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
  console.error(`[obs-error]${context ? ` ${context}:` : ""}`, err);
  return entry;
}

export function recentErrors(): readonly ErrorEntry[] {
  return log;
}

export function clearErrorLog(): void {
  log.length = 0;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Global handlers
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const BENIGN = [
  /Fragments\s*:?\s*Model not found/i,
  /ResizeObserver loop/i,
  /Loading CSS chunk/i,
  /Script error\.?/i,
  /cancelled/i,
  /AbortError/i,
];

function isBenign(msg: string): boolean {
  return BENIGN.some((re) => re.test(msg));
}

export function installGlobalErrorHandlers(): void {
  window.addEventListener("error", (e) => {
    const msg = String(e.error?.message ?? e.message ?? "");
    if (isBenign(msg)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    logError(e.error ?? e.message, "window.error");
  });
  window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (e) => {
    const reason = e.reason;
    const msg =
      reason instanceof Error ? reason.message
      : typeof reason === "string" ? reason
      : String((reason as { message?: string })?.message ?? reason ?? "");
    if (isBenign(msg)) {
      console.warn("[suppressed benign] " + msg);
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    logError(e.reason, "unhandled-rejection");
  });
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Boot failure screen
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export interface BootFailure {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  hint?: string;
  details?: string;
}

export function renderBootFailure(failure: BootFailure): void {
  // Remove any prior screen (idempotent).
  document.getElementById("obs-boot-failure")?.remove();

  const app = document.getElementById("app");
  if (!app) {
    notify("error", `${failure.title}: ${failure.message}`);
    return;
  }

  const screen = document.createElement("div");
  screen.id = "obs-boot-failure";
  screen.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;display:flex;align-items:center;" +
    "justify-content:center;background:#0b0d12;color:#e8eaf0;" +
    "font:14px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif;padding:24px;overflow:auto";

  const card = document.createElement("div");
  card.style.cssText =
    "max-width:640px;width:100%;background:#1c1e28;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-left:4px solid #ef4444;" +
    "border-radius:12px;padding:24px 26px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.55)";

  const title = document.createElement("h1");
  title.textContent = failure.title;
  title.style.cssText = "margin:0 0 8px;font-size:19px;color:#fca5a5";

  const msg = document.createElement("p");
  msg.textContent = failure.message;
  msg.style.cssText = "margin:0 0 12px;color:#cbd5e1";

  card.append(title, msg);

  if (failure.hint) {
    const hint = document.createElement("div");
    hint.style.cssText =
      "padding:12px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(56,189,248,.08);" +
      "border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.35);color:#bae6fd;font-size:13px;" +
      "line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:14px";
    hint.textContent = failure.hint;
    card.appendChild(hint);
  }

  if (failure.details) {
    const details = document.createElement("details");
    details.style.cssText = "margin-bottom:16px";
    const summary = document.createElement("summary");
    summary.textContent = "Technical details";
    summary.style.cssText = "cursor:pointer;color:#94a3b8;font-size:12px";
    const pre = document.createElement("pre");
    pre.textContent = failure.details;
    pre.style.cssText =
      "margin:8px 0 0;padding:10px 12px;background:#0e1017;border-radius:6px;" +
      "font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow:auto;" +
      "max-height:240px;color:#cbd5e1";
    details.append(summary, pre);
    card.appendChild(details);
  }

  const actions = document.createElement("div");
  actions.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap";

  const reload = document.createElement("button");
  reload.textContent = "Reload";
  reload.style.cssText = btnCss("#38bdf8", "#0b0d12");
  reload.onclick = () => location.reload();

  const copy = document.createElement("button");
  copy.textContent = "Copy diagnostics";
  copy.style.cssText = btnCss("transparent", "#cbd5e1", "#2a2e3a");
  copy.onclick = () => {
    const diag = [
      `Message: ${failure.message}`,
      failure.hint ? `Hint: ${failure.hint}` : "",
      failure.details ? `Details: ${failure.details}` : "",
      `User agent: ${navigator.userAgent}`,
      `URL: ${location.href}`,
    ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
    void navigator.clipboard.writeText(diag).then(
      () => { copy.textContent = "Copied ✓"; setTimeout(() => (copy.textContent = "Copy diagnostics"), 1200); },
      () => { copy.textContent = "Copy failed"; },
    );
  };

  actions.append(reload, copy);
  card.appendChild(actions);

  screen.appendChild(card);
  document.body.appendChild(screen);
}

function btnCss(bg: string, fg: string, border = "transparent"): string {
  return (
    `padding:9px 18px;border-radius:6px;font:600 13px system-ui,sans-serif;` +
    `background:${bg};color:${fg};border:1px solid ${border};cursor:pointer`
  );
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Convenience: run a block with structured error reporting
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export async function guarded<T>(
  fn: () => Promise<T> | T,
  context: string,
  kind: NotifyKind = "error",
): Promise<T | null> {
  try {
    return await fn();
  } catch (err) {
    const entry = logError(err, context);
    notify(kind, `${context}: ${entry.message}`);
    return null;
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Locale-aware formatting for numbers, dates, currency, and file sizes.
 * Delegates unit formatting to units.ts — this module is for everything else.
 */
import { i18n, type Locale } from "./i18n";

/* ── Numbers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export interface NumberFormatOptions {
  /** Fixed decimal places. Omit for auto. */
  precision?: number;
  /** Force thousands separators on/off. Default: on for |value| ≥ 1000. */
  grouping?: boolean;
  /** Sign display: "auto" | "always" | "never" | "exceptZero". */
  sign?: "auto" | "always" | "never" | "exceptZero";
}

export function fmtNumber(value: number, opts: NumberFormatOptions = {}): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "—";
  const locale = i18n.getLocale();
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: opts.precision ?? 3,
      useGrouping: opts.grouping ?? Math.abs(value) >= 10000,
      signDisplay: opts.sign ?? "auto",
    }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return value.toFixed(opts.precision ?? 3);
  }
}

export function fmtInteger(value: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "—";
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat(i18n.getLocale(), {
      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return Math.round(value).toString();
  }
}

export function fmtPercent(ratio: number, precision = 1): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(ratio)) return "—";
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat(i18n.getLocale(), {
      style: "percent",
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: precision,
    }).format(ratio);
  } catch {
    return `${(ratio * 100).toFixed(precision)}%`;
  }
}

/* ── Currency ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

const DEFAULT_CURRENCY_KEY = "obs.currency";

export function getCurrency(): string {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(DEFAULT_CURRENCY_KEY);
    if (raw) return raw;
  } catch { /* */ }
  // Default by locale
  const locale = i18n.getLocale();
  switch (locale) {
    case "en": return "USD";
    case "ar": return "AED";
    case "de": case "fr": case "es": case "it": case "pt-BR": return "EUR";
    case "zh-CN": return "CNY";
    case "ja": return "JPY";
    case "ko": return "KRW";
    case "ru": return "RUB";
    case "tr": return "TRY";
    case "pl": return "PLN";
    case "nl": return "EUR";
    case "hi": return "INR";
    default: return "USD";
  }
}

export function setCurrency(code: string): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(DEFAULT_CURRENCY_KEY, code); } catch { /* */ }
}

export interface CurrencyFormatOptions {
  precision?: number;
  /** Show the currency code suffix instead of the symbol. Default false. */
  showCode?: boolean;
  /** Override currency symbol. */
  currency?: string;
}

export function fmtCurrency(value: number, opts: CurrencyFormatOptions = {}): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "—";
  const code = opts.currency ?? getCurrency();
  const locale = i18n.getLocale();
  try {
    const optsObj: Intl.NumberFormatOptions = {
      style: "currency",
      currency: code,
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: opts.precision ?? 2,
    };
    if (opts.showCode) optsObj.currencyDisplay = "code";
    return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, optsObj).format(value);
  } catch {
    return `${code} ${value.toFixed(opts.precision ?? 2)}`;
  }
}

/* ── Dates ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export type DateStyle = "short" | "medium" | "long" | "full" | "iso";

export function fmtDate(value: Date | number | string, style: DateStyle = "short"): string {
  const d = toDate(value);
  if (!d) return "—";
  if (style === "iso") return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const locale = i18n.getLocale();
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { dateStyle: style }).format(d);
  } catch {
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}

export function fmtTime(value: Date | number | string): string {
  const d = toDate(value);
  if (!d) return "—";
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(i18n.getLocale(), {
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
      second: "2-digit",
    }).format(d);
  } catch {
    return d.toTimeString().slice(0, 8);
  }
}

export function fmtDateTime(value: Date | number | string): string {
  const d = toDate(value);
  if (!d) return "—";
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(i18n.getLocale(), {
      dateStyle: "short",
      timeStyle: "short",
    }).format(d);
  } catch {
    return d.toISOString().replace("T", " ").slice(0, 16);
  }
}

function toDate(value: Date | number | string): Date | null {
  if (value instanceof Date) return value;
  if (typeof value === "number") return new Date(value);
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    const d = new Date(value);
    return Number.isFinite(d.getTime()) ? d : null;
  }
  return null;
}

/* ── Relative time (e.g. "3 minutes ago") ────────────────────────── */

const _rtfCache = new Map<string, Intl.RelativeTimeFormat>();
const DIVISIONS: Array<{ amount: number; unit: Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit }> = [
  { amount: 60,          unit: "second" },
  { amount: 60,          unit: "minute" },
  { amount: 24,          unit: "hour" },
  { amount: 7,           unit: "day" },
  { amount: 4.34524,     unit: "week" },
  { amount: 12,          unit: "month" },
  { amount: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, unit: "year" },
];

export function fmtRelative(value: Date | number | string): string {
  const d = toDate(value);
  if (!d) return "—";
  const locale = i18n.getLocale();
  let rtf = _rtfCache.get(locale);
  if (!rtf) {
    try {
      rtf = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(locale, { numeric: "auto" });
    } catch {
      rtf = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat("en", { numeric: "auto" });
    }
    _rtfCache.set(locale, rtf);
  }
  let duration = (d.getTime() - Date.now()) / 1000;
  for (const div of DIVISIONS) {
    if (Math.abs(duration) < div.amount) {
      return rtf.format(Math.round(duration), div.unit);
    }
    duration /= div.amount;
  }
  return fmtDate(d);
}

/* ── File size ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export function fmtBytes(bytes: number, precision = 1): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) return "—";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  let i = 0;
  let v = bytes;
  while (v >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) { v /= 1024; i++; }
  return `${fmtNumber(v, { precision })} ${units[i]}`;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Locale-aware translation service.
 *
 * Design goals:
 *   - Zero dependencies — works with plain JSON catalogs
 *   - Namespaced keys via dot notation: t("clash.status.selectModels")
 *   - Plural rules via Intl.PluralRules — no ICU parser needed
 *   - Variable interpolation with {name} syntax
 *   - RTL detection and Direction state
 *   - Feature/plugin catalogs can register at runtime
 *   - Locale change fires an event so UI can re-render
 *
 * Catalog shape:
 *   {
 *     "meta": { "name": "English", "nativeName": "English", "dir": "ltr" },
 *     "clash": {
 *       "status": {
 *         "selectModels": "Select models in A and B, then Run Test.",
 *         "found": { "one": "1 clash found.", "other": "{count} clashes found." }
 *       }
 *     }
 *   }
 */
import { diagnostics } from "./diagnostics";

export type Locale =
  | "en" | "ar" | "de" | "fr" | "es" | "pt-BR" | "it"
  | "zh-CN" | "zh-TW" | "ja" | "ko"
  | "ru" | "tr" | "pl" | "nl"
  | "hi" | "he" | "fa" | "ur";

export type TextDirection = "ltr" | "rtl";

const RTL_LOCALES: ReadonlySet<Locale> = new Set<Locale>([
  "ar", "he", "fa", "ur",
]);

export interface CatalogMeta {
  name: string;
  nativeName: string;
  dir: TextDirection;
}

export type CatalogLeaf = string | PluralForms;
export type PluralForms = Partial<Record<
  Intl.LDMLPluralRule | "other",
  string
>>;
export type CatalogNode = CatalogLeaf | { [key: string]: CatalogNode };

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */

const STORAGE_KEY = "obs.locale";
const FALLBACK_LOCALE: Locale = "en";
const MISSING_MARKER = "\u2400";

type ChangeListener = (locale: Locale) => void;

class I18nService {
  private catalogs = new Map<Locale, Catalog>();
  private current: Locale = FALLBACK_LOCALE;
  private listeners = new Set<ChangeListener>();
  private pluralRulesCache = new Map<Locale, Intl.PluralRules>();
  private missingKeys = new Set<string>();
  private booted = false;

  /* -- Registration --------------------------------------------------- */

  register(locale: Locale, catalog: Partial<Catalog>): void {
    const existing = this.catalogs.get(locale);
    if (!existing) {
      this.catalogs.set(locale, catalog as Catalog);
      return;
    }
    const merged = deepMerge(existing, catalog);
    this.catalogs.set(locale, merged as Catalog);
  }

  registerAll(bundle: Partial<Record<Locale, Partial<Catalog>>>): void {
    for (const [locale, cat] of Object.entries(bundle)) {
      if (!cat) continue;
      this.register(locale as Locale, cat);
    }
  }

  /* -- Lifecycle ------------------------------------------------------ */

  boot(): void {
    if (this.booted) return;
    this.booted = true;

    let saved: Locale | null = null;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) saved = raw as Locale;
    } catch { /* */ }

    const detected = saved ?? this.detectBrowserLocale();
    this.setLocale(detected, { silent: !saved });
  }

  private detectBrowserLocale(): Locale {
    const langs = navigator.languages?.length
      ? navigator.languages
      : [navigator.language];
    for (const l of langs) {
      const exact = l as Locale;
      if (this.catalogs.has(exact)) return exact;

      // Keep the raw string so we can compare against values that are
      // intentionally not in the Locale union (e.g. "zh").
      const baseStr = l.split("-")[0];
      const base = baseStr as Locale;
      if (this.catalogs.has(base)) return base;

      // Special case for Chinese: "zh" → "zh-CN"
      if (baseStr === "zh") return "zh-CN";
    }
    return FALLBACK_LOCALE;
  }

  getLocale(): Locale {
    return this.current;
  }

  getDirection(): TextDirection {
    const cat = this.catalogs.get(this.current);
    return cat?.meta?.dir ?? (RTL_LOCALES.has(this.current) ? "rtl" : "ltr");
  }

  isRTL(): boolean {
    return this.getDirection() === "rtl";
  }

  listLocales(): Array<{ id: Locale; meta: CatalogMeta }> {
    const out: Array<{ id: Locale; meta: CatalogMeta }> = [];
    for (const [id, cat] of this.catalogs) {
      out.push({ id, meta: cat.meta });
    }
    out.sort((a, b) => a.meta.name.localeCompare(b.meta.name));
    return out;
  }

  setLocale(locale: Locale, opts: { silent?: boolean } = {}): void {
    if (!this.catalogs.has(locale)) {
      diagnostics.warn(
        "i18n.setLocale",
        `locale "${locale}" not registered — falling back to en`,
      );
      locale = FALLBACK_LOCALE;
    }
    if (this.current === locale && this.booted) return;
    this.current = locale;

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, locale);
    } catch { /* */ }

    this.applyDocumentAttributes();

    if (!opts.silent) {
      for (const cb of this.listeners) {
        try {
          cb(locale);
        } catch (err) {
          diagnostics.warn("i18n.listener", "listener threw", err);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private applyDocumentAttributes(): void {
    if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
    const dir = this.getDirection();
    document.documentElement.lang = this.current;
    document.documentElement.dir = dir;
    document.body?.setAttribute("data-locale", this.current);
    document.body?.setAttribute("data-dir", dir);
  }

  onChange(cb: ChangeListener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  /* -- Translation ---------------------------------------------------- */

  t(key: string, vars?: Record<string, string | number>): string {
    const value =
      this.lookup(this.current, key) ??
      this.lookup(FALLBACK_LOCALE, key);

    if (value === undefined) {
      if (!this.missingKeys.has(key)) {
        this.missingKeys.add(key);
        diagnostics.warn(
          "i18n.missing",
          `missing key "${key}" for locale "${this.current}"`,
        );
      }
      return key;
    }

    if (typeof value === "string") {
      return interpolate(value, vars);
    }

    const count = vars?.count;
    const n = typeof count === "number" ? count : Number(count ?? 0);
    const rule = this.pluralRule(this.current, n);
    const chosen =
      value[rule] ??
      value.other ??
      value.one ??
      Object.values(value)[0] ??
      key;
    return interpolate(chosen, vars);
  }

  has(key: string): boolean {
    return (
      this.lookup(this.current, key) !== undefined ||
      this.lookup(FALLBACK_LOCALE, key) !== undefined
    );
  }

  clearMissing(): void {
    this.missingKeys.clear();
  }

  listMissing(): string[] {
    return [...this.missingKeys].sort();
  }

  private pluralRule(locale: Locale, count: number): Intl.LDMLPluralRule {
    let rules = this.pluralRulesCache.get(locale);
    if (!rules) {
      try {
        rules = new Intl.PluralRules(locale);
      } catch {
        rules = new Intl.PluralRules(FALLBACK_LOCALE);
      }
      this.pluralRulesCache.set(locale, rules);
    }
    return rules.select(count);
  }

  private lookup(locale: Locale, key: string): CatalogLeaf | undefined {
    const cat = this.catalogs.get(locale);
    if (!cat) return undefined;
    const parts = key.split(".");
    let node: CatalogNode | undefined = cat as unknown as CatalogNode;
    for (const p of parts) {
      if (node === undefined || typeof node === "string") return undefined;
      if (isPluralForms(node)) return undefined;
      node = node[p];
    }
    if (node === undefined) return undefined;
    if (typeof node === "string" || isPluralForms(node)) return node;
    return undefined;
  }
}

function isPluralForms(v: unknown): v is PluralForms {
  if (!v || typeof v !== "object") return false;
  const keys = Object.keys(v);
  if (!keys.length) return false;
  return keys.every((k) =>
    ["zero", "one", "two", "few", "many", "other"].includes(k),
  );
}

function interpolate(
  template: string,
  vars?: Record<string, string | number>,
): string {
  if (!vars) return template;
  return template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, name) => {
    const v = vars[name];
    if (v === undefined) return match;
    return String(v);
  });
}

function deepMerge<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  a: T,
  b: Partial<T>,
): T {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = { ...a };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(b)) {
    const prev = out[k];
    if (
      v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v) &&
      prev && typeof prev === "object" && !Array.isArray(prev)
    ) {
      out[k] = deepMerge(
        prev as Record<string, unknown>,
        v as Record<string, unknown>,
      );
    } else {
      out[k] = v;
    }
  }
  return out as T;
}

/* -- Singleton + convenience exports ---------------------------------- */

export const i18n = new I18nService();

export const t = (
  key: string,
  vars?: Record<string, string | number>,
): string => i18n.t(key, vars);

export function scoped(prefix: string) {
  return (key: string, vars?: Record<string, string | number>): string =>
    i18n.t(`${prefix}.${key}`, vars);
}

export const MISSING_KEY_MARKER = MISSING_MARKER;

export interface Catalog {
  meta: CatalogMeta;
  [namespace: string]: CatalogNode | CatalogMeta;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Single authoritative pointer / wheel / Escape router for the 3D viewport.
 *
 * Key properties:
 *   • Gesture ownership — the first handler to accept a `drag-start` owns
 *     that gesture. Only the owner sees `drag-move` and `drag-end`.
 *   • Priority ordering — higher priority runs first. Gizmo (100) beats
 *     box-select (50) beats context-menu (20) beats authoring (10).
 *   • Cancel registration — Escape handlers run in reverse registration
 *     order; the first to return true consumes the key.
 *   • Camera auto-pause — the router pauses CameraControls for the duration
 *     of any claimed drag and releases it on drag-end.
 *   • Hover — throttled to one dispatch per frame; all subscribers receive it.
 *
 * The router attaches capture-phase listeners to the host so it sees events
 * before anything else, but only calls preventDefault / stopPropagation when
 * a handler claims the gesture. Unclaimed input falls through to the camera
 * controls and any legacy listeners still present.
 */
import { ctx } from "./context";
import { pauseCameraControls, forceResumeCameraControls } from "./camera-gate";

export type PointerButton = 0 | 1 | 2;

export interface Mods {
  ctrl: boolean;
  shift: boolean;
  alt: boolean;
  meta: boolean;
}

export type Gesture =
  | { kind: "click"; button: PointerButton; mods: Mods; event: PointerEvent }
  | { kind: "dblclick"; button: PointerButton; mods: Mods; event: PointerEvent }
  | { kind: "drag-start"; button: PointerButton; mods: Mods; event: PointerEvent }
  | { kind: "drag-move"; button: PointerButton; mods: Mods; dx: number; dy: number; event: PointerEvent }
  | { kind: "drag-end"; button: PointerButton; mods: Mods; dx: number; dy: number; moved: boolean; event: PointerEvent }
  | { kind: "rmb-click"; mods: Mods; event: PointerEvent }
  | { kind: "wheel"; event: WheelEvent; mods: Mods };

export type GestureHandler = (g: Gesture) => boolean;
export type HoverHandler = (e: PointerEvent) => void;
export type CancelHandler = () => boolean;


/** True when the event originated on a floating panel / form control — not the canvas. */
function isUiEventTarget(t: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  const el = t as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!el || !el.closest) return false;
  if (el.closest(
    "input,textarea,select,button,label,a," +
    "[contenteditable=true],[data-obs-window-controls]",
  )) return true;
  // Any dockable / floating panel shell
  if (el.closest(
    '#obs-ai-chat,#obs-bim-toolbox,[id^="obs-"],[data-obs-panel],.obs-panel,.obs-toast-host',
  )) {
    // Still allow canvas-like surfaces inside panels (e.g. plan view)
    if (el.closest("canvas")) return false;
    return true;
  }
  // Generic: if it's not the WebGL canvas, treat as UI when inside rightHost children that are not the canvas parent
  const tag = el.tagName;
  if (tag === "CANVAS") return false;
  return false;
}

const DRAG_THRESHOLD = 4;
const DBLCLICK_MS = 320;
const DBLCLICK_PX = 6;

interface Sub { fn: GestureHandler; priority: number; order: number; }

class InputRouterImpl {
  private host: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private subs: Sub[] = [];
  private hoverHandlers: HoverHandler[] = [];
  private cancelHandlers: CancelHandler[] = [];
  private orderCounter = 0;

  private down: {
    x: number; y: number;
    button: PointerButton;
    mods: Mods;
    moved: boolean;
    id: number;
  } | null = null;

  private owner: GestureHandler | null = null;
  private releaseCamera: (() => void) | null = null;

  private lastClick: { t: number; x: number; y: number; button: PointerButton } | null = null;

  private hoverPending = false;
  private lastHoverEvent: PointerEvent | null = null;

  /* ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  attach(host: HTMLElement): void {
    if (this.host === host) return;
    this.detach();
    this.host = host;
    host.addEventListener("pointerdown", this.onDown, { capture: true });
    host.addEventListener("pointermove", this.onMove, { capture: true });
    host.addEventListener("pointerup", this.onUp, { capture: true });
    host.addEventListener("pointercancel", this.onUp, { capture: true });
    host.addEventListener("wheel", this.onWheel, { capture: true, passive: false });
    host.addEventListener("contextmenu", this.onContextMenu, { capture: true });
    window.addEventListener("keydown", this.onKeyDown, { capture: true });
  }

  detach(): void {
    const host = this.host;
    if (host) {
      host.removeEventListener("pointerdown", this.onDown, true);
      host.removeEventListener("pointermove", this.onMove, true);
      host.removeEventListener("pointerup", this.onUp, true);
      host.removeEventListener("pointercancel", this.onUp, true);
      host.removeEventListener("wheel", this.onWheel, true);
      host.removeEventListener("contextmenu", this.onContextMenu, true);
    }
    window.removeEventListener("keydown", this.onKeyDown, true);
    this.host = null;
    this.down = null;
    this.releaseOwner();
  }

  /* ── Subscription ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  subscribe(h: GestureHandler, priority = 0): () => void {
    const sub: Sub = { fn: h, priority, order: this.orderCounter++ };
    this.subs.push(sub);
    this.subs.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority || a.order - b.order);
    return () => {
      const i = this.subs.indexOf(sub);
      if (i >= 0) this.subs.splice(i, 1);
    };
  }

  subscribeHover(h: HoverHandler): () => void {
    this.hoverHandlers.push(h);
    return () => {
      const i = this.hoverHandlers.indexOf(h);
      if (i >= 0) this.hoverHandlers.splice(i, 1);
    };
  }

  registerCancel(h: CancelHandler): () => void {
    this.cancelHandlers.push(h);
    return () => {
      const i = this.cancelHandlers.indexOf(h);
      if (i >= 0) this.cancelHandlers.splice(i, 1);
    };
  }

  hasOwner(): boolean { return this.owner !== null; }

  /* ── Internals ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  private mods(e: MouseEvent | WheelEvent | PointerEvent): Mods {
    return { ctrl: e.ctrlKey, shift: e.shiftKey, alt: e.altKey, meta: e.metaKey };
  }

  private dispatch(g: Gesture): GestureHandler | null {
    for (const s of this.subs) {
      try {
        if (s.fn(g)) return s.fn;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[input-router] handler threw", err);
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  private releaseOwner(): void {
    this.owner = null;
    if (this.releaseCamera) {
      try { this.releaseCamera(); } catch { /* */ }
      this.releaseCamera = null;
    }
  }

  private scheduleHover(e: PointerEvent): void {
    this.lastHoverEvent = e;
    if (this.hoverPending) return;
    this.hoverPending = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.hoverPending = false;
      const ev = this.lastHoverEvent;
      if (!ev) return;
      for (const h of this.hoverHandlers) {
        try { h(ev); } catch (err) { console.error("[input-router] hover threw", err); }
      }
    });
  }

  /* ── Pointer events ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  private onDown = (e: PointerEvent): void => {
    if (e.button !== 0 && e.button !== 1 && e.button !== 2) return;
    if (isUiEventTarget(e.target)) return;
    if (this.down && this.down.id !== e.pointerId) return;
    this.down = {
      x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY,
      button: e.button as PointerButton,
      mods: this.mods(e),
      moved: false,
      id: e.pointerId,
    };
    this.owner = null;
  };

  private onMove = (e: PointerEvent): void => {
    if (!this.down) { this.scheduleHover(e); return; }
    if (this.down.id !== e.pointerId) return;

    const dx = e.clientX - this.down.x;
    const dy = e.clientY - this.down.y;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);

    if (!this.down.moved && dist >= DRAG_THRESHOLD) {
      this.down.moved = true;
      const owner = this.dispatch({
        kind: "drag-start",
        button: this.down.button,
        mods: this.mods(e),
        event: e,
      });
      if (owner) {
        this.owner = owner;
        this.releaseCamera = pauseCameraControls();
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
      }
    }

    if (this.owner) {
      try {
        this.owner({
          kind: "drag-move",
          button: this.down.button,
          mods: this.mods(e),
          dx, dy,
          event: e,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[input-router] owner drag-move threw", err);
      }
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
    }
  };

  private onUp = (e: PointerEvent): void => {
    if (!this.down || this.down.id !== e.pointerId) return;
    const d = this.down;
    this.down = null;

    const dx = e.clientX - d.x;
    const dy = e.clientY - d.y;
    const moved = d.moved || Math.hypot(dx, dy) >= DRAG_THRESHOLD;

    if (this.owner) {
      try {
        this.owner({
          kind: "drag-end",
          button: d.button,
          mods: this.mods(e),
          dx, dy,
          moved: true,
          event: e,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[input-router] owner drag-end threw", err);
      }
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      this.releaseOwner();
      return;
    }

    if (moved) {
      // Drag completed but nothing claimed it — reset double-click timing.
      this.lastClick = null;
      return;
    }

    if (d.button === 2) {
      if (this.dispatch({ kind: "rmb-click", mods: this.mods(e), event: e })) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
      }
      this.lastClick = null;
      return;
    }

    const now = performance.now();
    const isDbl = !!this.lastClick
      && now - this.lastClick.t < DBLCLICK_MS
      && Math.hypot(e.clientX - this.lastClick.x, e.clientY - this.lastClick.y) < DBLCLICK_PX
      && this.lastClick.button === d.button;

    const g: Gesture = isDbl
      ? { kind: "dblclick", button: d.button, mods: this.mods(e), event: e }
      : { kind: "click", button: d.button, mods: this.mods(e), event: e };

    if (this.dispatch(g)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
    }
    this.lastClick = { t: now, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, button: d.button };
  };

  private onWheel = (e: WheelEvent): void => {
    if (isUiEventTarget(e.target)) return;
    if (this.dispatch({ kind: "wheel", event: e, mods: this.mods(e) })) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
    }
  };

  private onContextMenu = (e: MouseEvent): void => {
    // The application owns the menu. Never let the browser default leak
    // through over the viewport.
    e.preventDefault();
  };

  private onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent): void => {
    if (e.key !== "Escape") return;
    for (let i = this.cancelHandlers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      try {
        if (this.cancelHandlers[i]()) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopImmediatePropagation();
          // Always clear a stuck camera pause after cancel.
          forceResumeCameraControls();
          this.releaseOwner();
          return;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[input-router] cancel handler threw", err);
      }
    }
    // Escape with no cancel handler: still unstick camera if a drag left it paused.
    forceResumeCameraControls();
    this.releaseOwner();
  };
}

export const inputRouter = new InputRouterImpl();

export function setupInputRouter(): () => void {
  if (!ctx.rightHost) {
    console.warn("[input-router] rightHost not ready");
    return () => {};
  }
  inputRouter.attach(ctx.rightHost);
  (ctx.features as any).inputRouter = inputRouter;
  console.log("[input-router] attached");
  return () => inputRouter.detach();
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Locale boot sequence.
 */
import { ctx } from "./context";
import { i18n, t, type Locale, type Catalog } from "./i18n";
import { units, type UnitSystem } from "./units";
import { register, type ServiceMap } from "./services";
import { registerOption } from "./options-registry";

import en from "../locales/en.json";
import ar from "../locales/ar.json";
import de from "../locales/de.json";
import ja from "../locales/ja.json";
import zhCN from "../locales/zh-CN.json";

const FONT_STACKS: Record<string, string> = {
  default: `system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif`,
  ar:      `"Noto Naskh Arabic", "Segoe UI", "Geeza Pro", system-ui, sans-serif`,
  he:      `"Noto Sans Hebrew", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif`,
  ja:      `"Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic UI", "Noto Sans JP", "Meiryo", system-ui, sans-serif`,
  "zh-CN": `"PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif`,
  "zh-TW": `"PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif`,
  ko:      `"Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif`,
  hi:      `"Noto Sans Devanagari", "Nirmala UI", system-ui, sans-serif`,
};

function fontStackFor(locale: string): string {
  if (FONT_STACKS[locale]) return FONT_STACKS[locale];
  const base = locale.split("-")[0];
  return FONT_STACKS[base] ?? FONT_STACKS.default;
}

function applyLocaleCss(): void {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  const locale = i18n.getLocale();
  const stack = fontStackFor(locale);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--font-ui", stack);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
    "--font-mono",
    `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "Cascadia Mono", "Noto Sans Mono", monospace`,
  );
}

function registerLocaleOptions(): void {
  registerOption({
    id: "locale.language",
    group: "Language & Region",
    label: "Language",
    description:
      "Interface language. Technical names (IFC entities, property set keys) " +
      "stay in their original form.",
    type: "select",
    default: i18n.getLocale(),
    choices: i18n.listLocales().map((l) => ({
      value: l.id,
      label: `${l.meta.nativeName}  ·  ${l.meta.name}`,
    })),
    apply: (v) => i18n.setLocale(v as Locale),
  });

  registerOption({
    id: "locale.unitSystem",
    group: "Language & Region",
    label: "Unit system",
    description:
      "Display units for all lengths, areas, volumes and masses. " +
      "Model data is always stored in SI internally.",
    type: "select",
    default: units.getSystem(),
    choices: [
      { value: "metric-mm",   label: "Metric  ·  millimetres (mm)" },
      { value: "metric-cm",   label: "Metric  ·  centimetres (cm)" },
      { value: "metric-m",    label: "Metric  ·  metres (m)" },
      { value: "imperial-in", label: "Imperial  ·  inches / feet" },
      { value: "imperial-ft", label: "Imperial  ·  feet" },
    ],
    apply: (v) => units.setSystem(v as UnitSystem),
  });

  registerOption({
    id: "locale.currency",
    group: "Language & Region",
    label: "Currency",
    description: "Used by the 5D cost panel and BOQ exports.",
    type: "select",
    default: "USD",
    choices: [
      { value: "USD", label: "USD  ·  US Dollar" },
      { value: "EUR", label: "EUR  ·  Euro" },
      { value: "GBP", label: "GBP  ·  Pound Sterling" },
      { value: "AED", label: "AED  ·  UAE Dirham" },
      { value: "SAR", label: "SAR  ·  Saudi Riyal" },
      { value: "EGP", label: "EGP  ·  Egyptian Pound" },
      { value: "CNY", label: "CNY  ·  Chinese Yuan" },
      { value: "JPY", label: "JPY  ·  Japanese Yen" },
      { value: "INR", label: "INR  ·  Indian Rupee" },
      { value: "AUD", label: "AUD  ·  Australian Dollar" },
      { value: "CAD", label: "CAD  ·  Canadian Dollar" },
    ],
    apply: (v) => {
      try { localStorage.setItem("obs.currency", String(v)); } catch { /* */ }
    },
  });
}

export interface LocaleBootResult {
  locale: string;
  dir: "ltr" | "rtl";
  unitSystem: UnitSystem;
}

let booted = false;

export function setupLocale(): LocaleBootResult {
  if (booted) {
    return {
      locale: i18n.getLocale(),
      dir: i18n.getDirection(),
      unitSystem: units.getSystem(),
    };
  }
  booted = true;

  i18n.register("en", en as Partial<Catalog>);
  i18n.register("ar", ar as Partial<Catalog>);
  i18n.register("de", de as Partial<Catalog>);
  i18n.register("ja", ja as Partial<Catalog>);
  i18n.register("zh-CN", zhCN as Partial<Catalog>);

  i18n.boot();
  units.boot();

  applyLocaleCss();

  i18n.onChange(() => {
    applyLocaleCss();
    try {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-locale-changed", {
        detail: { locale: i18n.getLocale(), dir: i18n.getDirection() },
      }));
    } catch { /* */ }
  });

  const i18nService: ServiceMap["i18n"] = {
    t,
    setLocale: (l) => i18n.setLocale(l as Locale),
    getLocale: () => i18n.getLocale(),
    getDirection: () => i18n.getDirection(),
    isRTL: () => i18n.isRTL(),
    listLocales: () => i18n.listLocales(),
    onChange: (cb) => i18n.onChange(cb as (l: Locale) => void),
    register: (locale, catalog) =>
      i18n.register(locale as Locale, catalog as Partial<Catalog>),
    listMissing: () => i18n.listMissing(),
  };
  register("i18n", i18nService);
  ctx.features.i18n = i18nService;

  const unitsService: ServiceMap["units"] = {
    formatLength: (m, o) => units.formatLength(m, o),
    formatArea: (m2, o) => units.formatArea(m2, o),
    formatVolume: (m3, o) => units.formatVolume(m3, o),
    formatMass: (kg, o) => units.formatMass(kg, o),
    formatAngle: (rad, o) => units.formatAngle(rad, o),
    formatTemperature: (k, o) => units.formatTemperature(k, o),
    parseLengthInput: (s) => units.parseLengthInput(s),
    getSystem: () => units.getSystem(),
    setSystem: (s) => units.setSystem(s as UnitSystem),
    getConfig: () => units.getConfig(),
    onChange: (cb) => units.onChange(cb),
  };
  register("units", unitsService);
  ctx.features.units = unitsService;

  registerLocaleOptions();

  console.log(
    `[locale] booted · locale=${i18n.getLocale()} · dir=${i18n.getDirection()} ` +
    `· units=${units.getSystem()}`,
  );

  return {
    locale: i18n.getLocale(),
    dir: i18n.getDirection(),
    unitSystem: units.getSystem(),
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Centralised notification + history event bus.
 *
 * Every feature previously dispatched `obs-toast` and `obs-history` from a
 * dozen modules with slightly different shapes. Listeners (the status bar,
 * the ribbon, the toast host) now only need one subscription each.
 */
export type NotifyKind = "info" | "success" | "warn" | "error";

export interface NotifyOptions {
  /** Auto-dismiss delay in ms. 0 keeps the toast until dismissed. */
  timeout?: number;
  /** Optional inline action button. */
  action?: { label: string; run: () => void };
}

const TOAST_EVENT = "obs-toast";
const HISTORY_EVENT = "obs-history";

export function notify(
  kind: NotifyKind,
  message: string,
  opts: NotifyOptions = {},
): void {
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent(TOAST_EVENT, { detail: { kind, message, ...opts } }),
    );
  } catch {
    /* non-browser env */
  }
}

export function notifyHistory(action: "undo" | "redo", label: string): void {
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent(HISTORY_EVENT, { detail: { action, label } }),
    );
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

/* ── Compatibility shim ────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Some call sites still use `detail.kind` and `detail.message`; some use
   `detail.message` and `detail.kind`. The host listener reads both.
   Nothing else needs to change here.                                */

export type ToastHandler = (kind: NotifyKind, message: string, opts: NotifyOptions) => void;
const toastHandlers = new Set<ToastHandler>();

export function onNotify(cb: ToastHandler): () => void {
  toastHandlers.add(cb);
  return () => toastHandlers.delete(cb);
}

/** Called by the toast host when a `obs-toast` event arrives. */
export function __dispatchToSubscribers(
  kind: NotifyKind,
  message: string,
  opts: NotifyOptions,
): void {
  for (const cb of toastHandlers) {
    try { cb(kind, message, opts); } catch { /* */ }
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Options Registry — central place for app-level preferences.
 */
import { ctx } from "./context";
import { diagnostics } from "./diagnostics";

export type OptionType = "boolean" | "number" | "string" | "select";

export interface OptionBase {
  id: string;
  group: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  type: OptionType;
  default: boolean | number | string;
  apply?: (value: any) => void;
}

export interface BooleanOption extends OptionBase {
  type: "boolean";
  default: boolean;
}
export interface NumberOption extends OptionBase {
  type: "number";
  default: number;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  unit?: string;
}
export interface StringOption extends OptionBase {
  type: "string";
  default: string;
  placeholder?: string;
}
export interface SelectOption extends OptionBase {
  type: "select";
  default: string;
  choices: Array<{ value: string; label: string }>;
}

export type OptionDef = BooleanOption | NumberOption | StringOption | SelectOption;

const STORAGE_KEY = "obs.options.v1";
const registry = new Map<string, OptionDef>();
const values = new Map<string, any>();
const listeners = new Set<(id: string, value: any) => void>();

function loadPersisted(): Record<string, any> {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" ? parsed : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function persist(): void {
  try {
    const out: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const [id, v] of values) out[id] = v;
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(out));
  } catch (err) {
    diagnostics.warn("options.persist", "could not save options", err);
  }
}

function validate(def: OptionDef, v: any): boolean {
  switch (def.type) {
    case "boolean":
      return typeof v === "boolean";
    case "number":
      return typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);
    case "string":
      return typeof v === "string";
    case "select":
      return def.choices.some((c) => c.value === v);
  }
}

export function registerOption(def: OptionDef): void {
  if (registry.has(def.id)) {
    diagnostics.warn("options.register", `duplicate option id "${def.id}"`);
    return;
  }
  registry.set(def.id, def);
}

export function listOptions(group?: string): OptionDef[] {
  const all = [...registry.values()];
  return group ? all.filter((o) => o.group === group) : all;
}

export function getOption<T = any>(id: string): T {
  if (values.has(id)) return values.get(id) as T;
  const def = registry.get(id);
  if (!def) return undefined as any;
  const persisted = loadPersisted();
  const v =
    id in persisted && validate(def, persisted[id]) ? persisted[id] : def.default;
  values.set(id, v);
  return v as T;
}

export function setOption(id: string, value: any): void {
  const def = registry.get(id);
  if (!def) {
    diagnostics.warn("options.set", `unknown option "${id}"`);
    return;
  }
  if (!validate(def, value)) {
    diagnostics.warn("options.set", `invalid value for "${id}"`, value);
    return;
  }
  values.set(id, value);
  try {
    def.apply?.(value);
  } catch (err) {
    diagnostics.warn(`options.apply.${id}`, "apply threw", err);
  }
  persist();
  for (const l of listeners) {
    try {
      l(id, value);
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }
}

export function onOptionChanged(cb: (id: string, value: any) => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(cb);
  return () => listeners.delete(cb);
}

export function applyAllOptions(): void {
  for (const def of registry.values()) {
    const v = getOption(def.id);
    try {
      def.apply?.(v);
    } catch (err) {
      diagnostics.warn(`options.apply.${def.id}`, "apply threw", err);
    }
  }
}

let dialog: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let currentGroup: string | null = null;

function ensureDialog(): HTMLDivElement {
  if (dialog) return dialog;
  dialog = document.createElement("div");
  dialog.id = "obs-options-dialog";
  dialog.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9000;display:none;align-items:center;" +
    "justify-content:center;background:rgba(8,9,12,.55)";
  dialog.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
    if (e.target === dialog) hideOptions();
  });

  const card = document.createElement("div");
  card.style.cssText =
    "width:min(760px,94vw);max-height:82vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;" +
    "background:#1c1e28;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:12px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.55);overflow:hidden;color:#e8eaf0;" +
    "font:12.5px system-ui,sans-serif";

  const header = document.createElement("div");
  header.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 14px;" +
    "border-bottom:1px solid #1e2029;background:#181a23";
  header.innerHTML = `<span style="font-weight:700;font-size:14px;flex:1">Options</span>`;
  const close = document.createElement("button");
  close.textContent = "✕";
  close.style.cssText =
    "padding:4px 9px;background:transparent;color:#9ca3af;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer";
  close.onclick = () => hideOptions();
  header.appendChild(close);

  const body = document.createElement("div");
  body.style.cssText = "display:flex;flex:1;min-height:0";

  const sidebar = document.createElement("div");
  sidebar.dataset.role = "sidebar";
  sidebar.style.cssText =
    "width:200px;flex:none;border-right:1px solid #1e2029;padding:10px 6px;overflow-y:auto;background:#181a23";

  const content = document.createElement("div");
  content.dataset.role = "content";
  content.style.cssText = "flex:1;padding:14px 18px;overflow-y:auto";

  body.append(sidebar, content);
  card.append(header, body);
  dialog.appendChild(card);
  document.body.appendChild(dialog);

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && dialog?.style.display === "flex") hideOptions();
  });

  return dialog;
}

export function showOptions(group?: string): void {
  const d = ensureDialog();
  d.style.display = "flex";
  renderOptions(group);
}

export function hideOptions(): void {
  if (dialog) dialog.style.display = "none";
}

export function toggleOptions(): void {
  if (dialog?.style.display === "flex") hideOptions();
  else showOptions();
}

function renderOptions(group?: string): void {
  if (!dialog) return;
  const sidebar = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="sidebar"]') as HTMLElement;
  const content = dialog.querySelector('[data-role="content"]') as HTMLElement;
  if (!sidebar || !content) return;

  const groups = [...new Set(listOptions().map((o) => o.group))].sort();
  if (!currentGroup || (group && groups.includes(group))) {
    currentGroup = group ?? groups[0] ?? null;
  }

  sidebar.innerHTML = "";
  for (const g of groups) {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.textContent = g;
    const active = g === currentGroup;
    b.style.cssText =
      "display:block;width:100%;padding:7px 10px;margin-bottom:2px;text-align:left;" +
      `background:${active ? "rgba(56,189,248,.14)" : "transparent"};` +
      `color:${active ? "#38bdf8" : "#e8eaf0"};border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit`;
    b.onclick = () => {
      currentGroup = g;
      renderOptions();
    };
    sidebar.appendChild(b);
  }

  content.innerHTML = "";
  if (!currentGroup) {
    content.innerHTML =
      `<div style="color:#6b7280;text-align:center;padding:40px">No options registered.</div>`;
    return;
  }

  for (const def of listOptions(currentGroup)) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText =
      "display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:14px;align-items:start;" +
      "padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #1e2029";

    const labelWrap = document.createElement("div");
    const label = document.createElement("div");
    label.textContent = def.label;
    label.style.cssText = "font-weight:600";
    labelWrap.appendChild(label);
    if (def.description) {
      const desc = document.createElement("div");
      desc.textContent = def.description;
      desc.style.cssText = "font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.45";
      labelWrap.appendChild(desc);
    }

    const control = createControl(def);
    row.append(labelWrap, control);
    content.appendChild(row);
  }
}

function createControl(def: OptionDef): HTMLElement {
  const value = getOption(def.id);

  if (def.type === "boolean") {
    const cb = document.createElement("input");
    cb.type = "checkbox";
    cb.checked = !!value;
    cb.style.cssText = "cursor:pointer;transform:scale(1.2);accent-color:#38bdf8";
    cb.onchange = () => setOption(def.id, cb.checked);
    return cb;
  }

  if (def.type === "number") {
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center";
    const inp = document.createElement("input");
    inp.type = "number";
    inp.value = String(value);
    if (def.min != null) inp.min = String(def.min);
    if (def.max != null) inp.max = String(def.max);
    if (def.step != null) inp.step = String(def.step);
    inp.style.cssText =
      "width:110px;padding:5px 8px;background:#0e1017;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;" +
      "border-radius:5px;color:#e8eaf0;font:inherit";
    inp.onchange = () => {
      const v = Number(inp.value);
      if (Number.isFinite(v)) setOption(def.id, v);
    };
    wrap.appendChild(inp);
    if (def.unit) {
      const u = document.createElement("span");
      u.textContent = def.unit;
      u.style.cssText = "font-size:11px;color:#6b7280";
      wrap.appendChild(u);
    }
    return wrap;
  }

  if (def.type === "string") {
    const inp = document.createElement("input");
    inp.type = "text";
    inp.value = String(value);
    inp.style.cssText =
      "min-width:220px;padding:5px 8px;background:#0e1017;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;" +
      "border-radius:5px;color:#e8eaf0;font:inherit";
    inp.oninput = () => setOption(def.id, inp.value);
    return inp;
  }

  if (def.type === "select") {
    const sel = document.createElement("select");
    sel.style.cssText =
      "min-width:180px;padding:5px 8px;background:#0e1017;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;" +
      "border-radius:5px;color:#e8eaf0;font:inherit;cursor:pointer";
    for (const c of def.choices) {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = c.value;
      opt.textContent = c.label;
      if (c.value === value) opt.selected = true;
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    }
    sel.onchange = () => setOption(def.id, sel.value);
    return sel;
  }

  return document.createElement("div");
}

export function setupOptions(): void {
  registerOption({
    id: "nav.smoothTime",
    group: "Navigation",
    label: "Camera smoothing",
    description: "Time constant for smoothing camera motion. Lower = snappier.",
    type: "number",
    default: 0.04,
    min: 0,
    max: 0.5,
    step: 0.01,
    unit: "s",
    apply: (v) => {
      try {
        const c: any = ctx.world?.camera?.controls;
        if (c && "smoothTime" in c) c.smoothTime = v;
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    },
  });

  registerOption({
    id: "nav.draggingSmoothTime",
    group: "Navigation",
    label: "Drag smoothing",
    description: "Smoothing while dragging. Lower = more responsive.",
    type: "number",
    default: 0.02,
    min: 0,
    max: 0.5,
    step: 0.01,
    unit: "s",
    apply: (v) => {
      try {
        const c: any = ctx.world?.camera?.controls;
        if (c && "draggingSmoothTime" in c) c.draggingSmoothTime = v;
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    },
  });

  registerOption({
    id: "nav.invertOrbit",
    group: "Navigation",
    label: "Invert orbit direction",
    type: "boolean",
    default: false,
    apply: () => {},
  });

  registerOption({
    id: "nav.wheelZoomMultiplier",
    group: "Navigation",
    label: "Wheel zoom multiplier",
    type: "number",
    default: 1,
    min: 0.25,
    max: 5,
    step: 0.25,
    apply: () => {},
  });

  registerOption({
    id: "diagnostics.showBadge",
    group: "Diagnostics",
    label: "Show warning badge",
    type: "boolean",
    default: true,
    apply: (v) => {
      const el = document.getElementById("obs-diag-badge");
      if (!el) return;
      if (!v) el.style.display = "none";
    },
  });

  applyAllOptions();

  (ctx.features as any).options = {
    show: showOptions,
    hide: hideOptions,
    toggle: toggleOptions,
    register: registerOption,
    list: listOptions,
    get: getOption,
    set: setOption,
    onChanged: onOptionChanged,
  };

  console.log("[options] ready");
}
```

```ts
type Any = Record<string, any>;

let installed = false;
let enabled = true;

function getScene(): Any | null {
  const c = (globalThis as Any).__OBS_CTX__ || null;
  const ctxAny = c as Any;

  const world = ctxAny?.world as Any;

  return world?.scene?.three ?? world?.scene ?? null;
}

function applyCulling(next: boolean): void {
  const scene = getScene();

  if (!scene || typeof scene.traverse !== "function") {
    return;
  }

  scene.traverse((obj: Any) => {
    if (obj?.isMesh) {
      obj.frustumCulled = next;
    }
  });
}

export function setPerformanceCullingEnabled(next: boolean): boolean {
  enabled = !!next;
  applyCulling(enabled);
  return enabled;
}

export function isPerformanceCullingEnabled(): boolean {
  return enabled;
}

export function setupPerformanceOptimizer(): void {
  if (installed) {
    return;
  }

  installed = true;

  applyCulling(enabled);

  const w = window as Any;

  w.__obsPerfOptimizer = {
    setEnabled: setPerformanceCullingEnabled,
    isEnabled: isPerformanceCullingEnabled,
  };

  console.log("[performance-optimizer] Revit-safe frustum culling ready");
}
```

--- FILE: src/core/p-map.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Bounded-concurrency async map.
 *
 * Runs at most `concurrency` tasks in parallel. Preserves input order in the
 * result array. Aborts early if the signal fires, rejecting with an
 * AbortError so the caller can distinguish a cancelled run from a failure.
 */
export class AbortError extends Error {
  constructor(message = "Aborted") {
    super(message);
    this.name = "AbortError";
  }
}

export interface PMapOptions {
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  onProgress?: (done: number, total: number) => void;
  /** Stop scheduling new work after this many failures. Default: reject fast. */
  continueOnError?: boolean;
}

export async function pMap<T, R>(
  items: readonly T[],
  concurrency: number,
  fn: (item: T, index: number) => Promise<R>,
  opts: PMapOptions = {},
): Promise<R[]> {
  const total = items.length;
  if (total === 0) return [];

  const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(concurrency, total));
  const out: R[] = new Array(total);
  let cursor = 0;
  let done = 0;
  let firstError: unknown = null;

  const runWorker = async (): Promise<void> => {
    for (;;) {
      if (opts.signal?.aborted) throw new AbortError();
      if (firstError && !opts.continueOnError) throw firstError;

      const i = cursor++;
      if (i >= total) return;

      try {
        out[i] = await fn(items[i], i);
      } catch (err) {
        if (firstError === null) firstError = err;
        if (!opts.continueOnError) throw err;
      } finally {
        done++;
        opts.onProgress?.(done, total);
      }
    }
  };

  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: limit }, () => runWorker()));
  if (firstError && !opts.continueOnError) throw firstError;
  return out;
}
```
