```ts
import { ctx } from "./context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

/*
 * Input arbiter.
 *
 * This module does NOT install its own pan/orbit/zoom behaviour and does NOT
 * mutate CameraControls mouse buttons (navigation.ts already forces those OFF
 * and is the single driver). Instead it maintains a few WINDOW-LEVEL FLAGS that
 * navigation.ts and the rest of the app read, plus a couple of capture-phase
 * guards that are safe regardless of listener registration order:
 *
 *   __OBS_MMB_HELD   : true while middle button is down
 *   __OBS_MMB_MOVED  : true once the MMB drag exceeded a few pixels
 *   __OBS_MMB_DOWN_T : timestamp of MMB down (watchdog)
 *   __OBS_BLOCK_MMB_CLICK : swallow the synthetic click after a dragged MMB
 *
 * Why flags instead of stopPropagation? Because navigation.ts / selection.ts
 * register their window capture listeners during app boot, i.e. BEFORE this
 * arbiter is imported by critical-gaps-boot. A later capture listener cannot
 * cancel an earlier one. Flags, however, are simply *read* by the earlier
 * handlers at the moment they run, so coordination works in any order.
 *
 * The only things we actively suppress at capture phase are:
 *   - wheel events while __OBS_MMB_HELD (no zoom-out during a pan)
 *   - the click that the browser synthesises after a DRAGGED MMB (so a pan
 *     never also selects / focuses / fits)
 * Both are safe to suppress because they are never legitimate during those
 * states under the documented Revit map.
 */

let installed = false;

const MMB_MOVE_THRESHOLD = 3;     // px before a press becomes a drag
const MMB_CLICK_WINDOW = 380;     // ms for a genuine double-MMB (kept for fit)
const WATCHDOG_MS = 8000;         // clear stuck HELD if no up arrived

function w(): Any { return window as Any; }

function clearMMB(): void {
  const W = w();
  W.__OBS_MMB_HELD = false;
  W.__OBS_MMB_MOVED = false;
  W.__OBS_MMB_DOWN_T = 0;
}

function isTextInput(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  const el = target as Any;
  if (!el) return false;
  const tag = String(el.tagName ?? "").toLowerCase();
  if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || tag === "select") return true;
  if (el.isContentEditable) return true;
  if (typeof el.closest === "function" &&
      el.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]')) return true;
  return false;
}

function activeAuthoringTool(): string | null {
  const c = ctx as Any;
  const a = (c.features as Any)?.authoring as Any;
  const t =
    a?.getActiveTool?.() ?? a?.activeTool ?? a?.currentTool ?? null;
  if (typeof t === "string" && t && t !== "select") return t;
  return null;
}

function cancelActiveOperation(): boolean {
  let canceled = false;
  const W = w();

  // 1) drafting overlay (left-mouse tool)
  const d = W.__obsDrafting2D;
  if (d && typeof d.getTool === "function" && d.getTool()) {
    d.setTool(null);
    canceled = true;
  }

  // 2) authoring placement tool
  const c = ctx as Any;
  const a = (c.features as Any)?.authoring as Any;
  if (activeAuthoringTool()) {
    if (typeof a?.setAuthoringTool === "function") {
      a.setAuthoringTool(null);
      canceled = true;
    }
  }

  // 3) measure / section / walk (best effort through known globals)
  const m = W.__obsMeasure;
  if (m && (typeof m.isEnabled === "function" ? m.isEnabled() : m.enabled)) {
    m.setMeasureEnabled?.(false); m.disable?.(); canceled = true;
  }
  const s = W.__obsSection;
  if (s && (typeof s.isSectionOn === "function" ? s.isSectionOn() : s.enabled)) {
    s.setSectionOn?.(false); s.disable?.(); canceled = true;
  }
  const wk = W.__obsWalkMode;
  if (wk && (typeof wk.isActive === "function" ? wk.isActive() : wk.enabled)) {
    wk.disable?.(); wk.setActive?.(false); canceled = true;
  }

  // 4) always drop MMB arbitration state on a cancel
  clearMMB();

  if (canceled) {
    try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:operation-cancelled")); } catch { /* */ }
  }
  return canceled;
}

function installArbiter(): void {
  const W = w();

  // ---- pointer tracking (capture; we never stopPropagation on down/move so
  //      navigation.ts still receives the gesture and can pan/orbit) ----
  window.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e: PointerEvent) => {
    if (e.button !== 1) return;            // middle only
    W.__OBS_MMB_HELD = true;
    W.__OBS_MMB_MOVED = false;
    W.__OBS_MMB_DOWN_T = performance.now();
    W.__OBS_MMB_START_X = e.clientX;
    W.__OBS_MMB_START_Y = e.clientY;
  }, true);

  window.addEventListener("pointermove", (e: PointerEvent) => {
    if (!W.__OBS_MMB_HELD) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - (W.__OBS_MMB_START_X ?? e.clientX);
    const dy = e.clientY - (W.__OBS_MMB_START_Y ?? e.clientY);
    if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > MMB_MOVE_THRESHOLD) {
      W.__OBS_MMB_MOVED = true;
    }
  }, true);

  const onUp = (e: PointerEvent | MouseEvent) => {
    const be = e as PointerEvent;
    if (typeof be.button === "number" && be.button !== 1) return;
    const moved = !!W.__OBS_MMB_MOVED;
    const downT = Number(W.__OBS_MMB_DOWN_T || 0);
    clearMMB();
    // A dragged MMB must not also produce a select / focus / fit click.
    if (moved) {
      W.__OBS_BLOCK_MMB_CLICK = true;
      window.setTimeout(() => { W.__OBS_BLOCK_MMB_CLICK = false; }, 0);
    }
    // remember a clean (no-move) MMB click time for genuine double-MMB fit
    if (!moved && downT > 0) {
      W.__OBS_LAST_MMB_CLICK_T = performance.now();
    }
  };
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp as any, true);
  window.addEventListener("pointercancel", onUp as any, true);
  window.addEventListener("mouseup", onUp as any, true);   // backup
  window.addEventListener("blur", () => clearMMB(), true);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (document.hidden) clearMMB();
  });

  // ---- wheel guard: no zoom while panning (capture; safe to suppress) ----
  window.addEventListener("wheel", (e: WheelEvent) => {
    if (W.__OBS_MMB_HELD) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
    }
  }, { capture: true, passive: false });

  // ---- swallow the synthetic click after a dragged MMB ----
  window.addEventListener("click", (e: MouseEvent) => {
    if (e.button === 1 && W.__OBS_BLOCK_MMB_CLICK) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      W.__OBS_BLOCK_MMB_CLICK = false;
    }
  }, true);

  // ---- watchdog: never leave HELD stuck if an up was missed ----
  window.setInterval(() => {
    if (W.__OBS_MMB_HELD && W.__OBS_MMB_DOWN_T &&
        performance.now() - Number(W.__OBS_MMB_DOWN_T) > WATCHDOG_MS) {
      clearMMB();
    }
  }, 1000);

  // ---- keyboard / right-click cancel (Revit behaviour) ----
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (isTextInput(e.target)) return;
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      if (cancelActiveOperation()) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
      }
    }
  }, true);

  window.addEventListener("contextmenu", (e: MouseEvent) => {
    // Only cancel when an operation is actually active; otherwise let
    // navigation.ts open its right-click context menu untouched.
    if (cancelActiveOperation()) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
    }
  }, true);

  W.__obsRevitMousePolicy = {
    cancelOperation: cancelActiveOperation,
    isMMBHeld: () => !!w().__OBS_MMB_HELD,
    isMMBMoved: () => !!w().__OBS_MMB_MOVED,
    clearMMB,
  };
}

export function setupRevitMousePolicy(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  // NOTE: we deliberately do NOT call any disableNativeCameraMouse() here.
  // navigation.ts already forces CameraControls mouse/touch OFF and re-asserts
  // it via forceResumeCameraControls(); a second writer raced with it and was a
  // source of the rotate/zoom-on-release artefact.

  installArbiter();

  console.log(
    "[revit-mouse-policy] arbiter ready: flags-only coordination; " +
    "wheel blocked while MMB held; dragged-MMB click suppressed; " +
    "Esc / RMB cancel active tool; navigation.ts remains sole MMB/wheel owner",
  );
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Typed service registry.
 *
 * Every feature that other features need to call registers a service here
 * with an explicit interface. Consumers call `services.selection.snapshot()`
 * and get full IntelliSense plus compile-time protection against typos.
 *
 * Late registration is supported via `services.ready("selection")` — a
 * promise that resolves when the service is registered. This is important
 * because features are set up in different phases during boot.
 *
 * Migration strategy: the old `ctx.features.X` bag remains populated for
 * backward compatibility during the transition. Both point at the same
 * object, so existing code that has not been migrated keeps working.
 */

type ServiceKey = keyof ServiceMap;

const registry = new Map<ServiceKey, ServiceMap[ServiceKey]>();
const readyResolvers = new Map<ServiceKey, Array<(v: ServiceMap[ServiceKey]) => void>>();

/**
 * Register a service. Re-registration overwrites and wakes any pending
 * `ready()` calls. This is what happens during HMR or a project reload.
 */
export function register<K extends ServiceKey>(key: K, value: ServiceMap[K]): void {
  registry.set(key, value);

  // Mirror into the legacy ctx.features bag so unmigrated code keeps working.
  try {
    (ctx.features as Record<string, unknown>)[key as string] = value;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  const waiters = readyResolvers.get(key);
  if (waiters) {
    readyResolvers.delete(key);
    for (const cb of waiters) {
      try { cb(value); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }
}

export function use<K extends ServiceKey>(key: K): ServiceMap[K] {
  const v = registry.get(key);
  if (!v) {
    throw new ServiceNotReadyError(key);
  }
  return v as ServiceMap[K];
}

export function tryUse<K extends ServiceKey>(key: K): ServiceMap[K] | null {
  return (registry.get(key) as ServiceMap[K]) ?? null;
}

export function hasService<K extends ServiceKey>(key: K): boolean {
  return registry.has(key);
}

/**
 * Resolve when the service is registered. If it is already registered, the
 * returned promise resolves on the next microtask so callers can always
 * `await` without branching.
 */
export function ready<K extends ServiceKey>(key: K): Promise<ServiceMap[K]> {
  const existing = registry.get(key);
  if (existing) return Promise.resolve(existing as ServiceMap[K]);

  return new Promise<ServiceMap[K]>((resolve) => {
    const list = readyResolvers.get(key) ?? [];
    list.push(resolve as (v: ServiceMap[ServiceKey]) => void);
    readyResolvers.set(key, list);
  });
}

export class ServiceNotReadyError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly key: ServiceKey) {
    super(
      `Service "${String(key)}" was requested before it was registered. ` +
      `Call services.ready("${String(key)}") to await it, or use ` +
      `services.tryUse("${String(key)}") if it is optional.`,
    );
    this.name = "ServiceNotReadyError";
  }
}

/** Convenience re-exports for call sites. */
export const services = {
  get selection(): SelectionService { return use("selection"); },
  get authoring(): AuthoringService { return use("authoring"); },
  get family(): FamilyService { return use("family"); },
  get camera(): CameraService { return use("camera"); },
  get clash(): ClashService { return use("clash"); },
  get fragEdit(): FragEditService { return use("fragEdit"); },
  get issues(): IssuesService { return use("issues"); },
  get schedules(): SchedulesService { return use("schedules"); },
  get projects(): ProjectsService { return use("projects"); },
  get planView(): PlanViewService { return use("planView"); },
  get appLoader(): AppLoaderService { return use("appLoader"); },
  get commandPalette() { return use("commandPalette"); },

  register,
  ready,
  use,
  tryUse,
  has: hasService,
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Debug helpers
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function listRegisteredServices(): ServiceKey[] {
  return [...registry.keys()];
}

/** Print a snapshot of registered services to the console. */
export function dumpServiceRegistry(): void {
  console.group("[services] registry");
  for (const k of listRegisteredServices()) {
    console.log("  •", k);
  }
  console.groupEnd();
}
```

```ts
import * as THREE from "three";
import * as OBC from "@thatopen/components";
import * as OBCF from "@thatopen/components-front";
import * as BUI from "@thatopen/ui";
import * as BUIC from "@thatopen/ui-obc";
import { ctx } from "./context";

BUI.Manager.init();

export async function setupViewer() {
  const appEl = document.getElementById("app") as HTMLElement;
  appEl.style.cssText = "display:flex;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;margin:0";

  const leftHost = document.createElement("div");
  leftHost.style.cssText = "min-width:320px;height:100%;overflow:auto;background:#1D1E24;border-right:1px solid #2a2a35";
  const rightHost = document.createElement("div");
  rightHost.style.cssText = "flex:1;height:100%;position:relative;overflow:hidden";
  appEl.append(leftHost, rightHost);

  const components = new OBC.Components();
  const worlds = components.get(OBC.Worlds);
  const world = worlds.create<OBC.SimpleScene, OBC.OrthoPerspectiveCamera, OBC.SimpleRenderer>();
  world.scene = new OBC.SimpleScene(components);
  world.renderer = new OBC.SimpleRenderer(components, rightHost);
  world.camera = new OBC.OrthoPerspectiveCamera(components);

  // 3D navigation (MMB/wheel/dbl-MMB) is owned by features/navigation.ts
  // after input-router attaches. Only disable LMB/RMB/wheel on camera-controls.
  try {
    const controls: any = world.camera.controls;
    const ACTION = controls?.constructor?.ACTION || (window as any).CameraControls?.ACTION;
    const mouseButtons = controls?.mouseButtons;
    if (mouseButtons && ACTION) {
      mouseButtons.left = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
      mouseButtons.middle = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
      mouseButtons.right = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
      mouseButtons.wheel = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn("[navigation] mouse mapping unavailable", error);
  }

  components.init();
  world.scene.setup();
  world.scene.three.background = new THREE.Color(0x0f1117);
  world.scene.three.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.55));
  const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.35);
  sun.position.set(50, 100, 40);
  world.scene.three.add(sun);
  components.get(OBC.Grids).create(world);

  const groundPlane = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1000, 1000),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ visible: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
  );
  groundPlane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  groundPlane.name = "groundPlane";
  world.scene.three.add(groundPlane);

  const fragments = components.get(OBC.FragmentsManager);
  try {
    fragments.init(await OBC.FragmentsManager.getWorker());
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[fragments] worker init failed", e);
    throw new Error(
      "Fragments worker failed to load. Often caused by COEP/CORS or a 404 HTML page. " +
      "Restart Vite after npm install. Original: " + (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e))
    );
  }
  world.camera.controls.addEventListener("update", () => fragments.core.update());
  world.onCameraChanged.add((camera) => {
    for (const [, model] of fragments.list) model.useCamera(camera.three);
    fragments.core.update(true);
  });
  fragments.list.onItemSet.add(async ({ value: model }) => {
    model.useCamera(world.camera.three);
    world.scene.three.add(model.object);
    await fragments.core.update(true);
  });
  fragments.core.models.materials.list.onItemSet.add(({ value: material }) => {
    if (!("isLodMaterial" in material && (material as any).isLodMaterial)) {
      material.polygonOffset = true;
      material.polygonOffsetUnits = 1;
      material.polygonOffsetFactor = Math.random();
    }
  });

  components.get(OBC.Raycasters).get(world);

  const highlighter = components.get(OBCF.Highlighter);
  highlighter.setup({
    world,
    autoHighlightOnClick: false,
    selectMaterialDefinition: { color: new THREE.Color("#bcf124"), opacity: 1, transparent: false, renderedFaces: 0 },
  });
  highlighter.styles.set("clash", { color: new THREE.Color("#ef4444"), opacity: 0.9, transparent: true, renderedFaces: 0 });
  // Selection A = blue, Selection B = yellow (clash focus)
  highlighter.styles.set("clashA", { color: new THREE.Color("#3b82f6"), opacity: 0.95, transparent: true, renderedFaces: 0 });
  highlighter.styles.set("clashB", { color: new THREE.Color("#eab308"), opacity: 0.95, transparent: true, renderedFaces: 0 });
  // Revit-style preselection: hover feedback sits below selection priority.
  // Explicit selection style so linked-model selection is always visibly blue,
  // independent of the SDK default material definition. Keep it above preselection.
  highlighter.styles.set("select", {
    color: new THREE.Color("#2563eb"),
    opacity: 0.82,
    transparent: true,
    renderedFaces: 0,
    priority: 20,
  } as any);
  highlighter.styles.set("preselect", {
    color: new THREE.Color("#38bdf8"),
    opacity: 0.42,
    transparent: true,
    renderedFaces: 0,
    priority: 10,
  } as any);

  const [propertiesTable, updatePropertiesTable] = BUIC.tables.itemsData({ components, modelIdMap: {} });
  propertiesTable.preserveStructureOnFilter = true;
  const [modelsList] = BUIC.tables.modelsList({ components, metaDataTags: ["schema"], actions: { download: true } });

  Object.assign(ctx, {
    components, world, fragments, highlighter,
    hider: components.get(OBC.Hider),
    clipper: components.get(OBC.Clipper),
    lengthMeasurer: components.get(OBCF.LengthMeasurement),
    leftHost, rightHost, groundPlane, modelsList,
  });
  ctx.clipper.enabled = true;
  ctx.props.table = propertiesTable;
  ctx.props.update = (map: any) => updatePropertiesTable({ modelIdMap: map });

  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    world.renderer?.resize();
    world.camera.updateAspect();
    ctx.cam.updateClipping();
  });

  return ctx;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Uniform 3D spatial hash for broadphase candidate lookup.
 *
 * Cell size is chosen from the median item diagonal. Each item is inserted
 * into every cell its AABB overlaps. Queries return the union of items in
 * the same cells — a superset of the true AABB-overlap set, so the caller
 * must still do the actual Box3 test (which is cheap).
 */
import * as THREE from "three";

export class SpatialHash {
  private readonly cellSize: number;
  private readonly buckets = new Map<string, number[]>();
  private readonly itemBoxes: THREE.Box3[] = [];

  constructor(cellSize: number) {
    this.cellSize = Math.max(cellSize, 1e-3);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.itemBoxes.length;
  }

  get cell(): number {
    return this.cellSize;
  }

  /** Insert an item's world-space AABB and get its index back. */
  insert(box: THREE.Box3): number {
    const idx = this.itemBoxes.length;
    this.itemBoxes.push(box.clone());

    const i0 = Math.floor(box.min.x / this.cellSize);
    const i1 = Math.floor(box.max.x / this.cellSize);
    const j0 = Math.floor(box.min.y / this.cellSize);
    const j1 = Math.floor(box.max.y / this.cellSize);
    const k0 = Math.floor(box.min.z / this.cellSize);
    const k1 = Math.floor(box.max.z / this.cellSize);

    const cells = (i1 - i0 + 1) * (j1 - j0 + 1) * (k1 - k0 + 1);
    if (!Number.isFinite(cells) || cells > 4096) {
      const arr = this.buckets.get("*") ?? [];
      arr.push(idx);
      this.buckets.set("*", arr);
      return idx;
    }

    for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) {
      for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) {
        for (let k = k0; k <= k1; k++) {
          const key = `${i},${j},${k}`;
          const arr = this.buckets.get(key);
          if (arr) arr.push(idx);
          else this.buckets.set(key, [idx]);
        }
      }
    }
    return idx;
  }

  /**
   * Fill `out` with candidate indices whose cells overlap the query box.
   * `out` is cleared first. Excludes `selfIdx` if it appears.
   */
  query(box: THREE.Box3, out: Set<number>, selfIdx = -1): void {
    out.clear();

    const i0 = Math.floor(box.min.x / this.cellSize);
    const i1 = Math.floor(box.max.x / this.cellSize);
    const j0 = Math.floor(box.min.y / this.cellSize);
    const j1 = Math.floor(box.max.y / this.cellSize);
    const k0 = Math.floor(box.min.z / this.cellSize);
    const k1 = Math.floor(box.max.z / this.cellSize);

    const cells = (i1 - i0 + 1) * (j1 - j0 + 1) * (k1 - k0 + 1);
    if (!Number.isFinite(cells) || cells > 4096) {
      for (let i = 0; i < this.itemBoxes.length; i++) {
        if (i !== selfIdx) out.add(i);
      }
      return;
    }

    for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) {
      for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) {
        for (let k = k0; k <= k1; k++) {
          const arr = this.buckets.get(`${i},${j},${k}`);
          if (!arr) continue;
          for (const idx of arr) {
            if (idx !== selfIdx) out.add(idx);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    const global = this.buckets.get("*");
    if (global) {
      for (const idx of global) {
        if (idx !== selfIdx) out.add(idx);
      }
    }
  }

  boxAt(idx: number): THREE.Box3 | undefined {
    return this.itemBoxes[idx];
  }

  /** Choose a sensible cell size from a sample of item sizes. */
  static suggestCellSize(boxes: readonly THREE.Box3[], fallback = 2): number {
    if (boxes.length === 0) return fallback;
    const sample = boxes.slice(0, Math.min(boxes.length, 512));
    const diag = new THREE.Vector3();
    const sizes: number[] = [];
    for (const b of sample) {
      b.getSize(diag);
      const d = Math.hypot(diag.x, diag.y, diag.z);
      if (Number.isFinite(d) && d > 0) sizes.push(d);
    }
    if (!sizes.length) return fallback;
    sizes.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const median = sizes[Math.floor(sizes.length / 2)];
    return Math.max(0.25, Math.min(median * 1.5, 25));
  }
}
```

```ts
// openbim-fix:v3:applied -- do not re-apply the earlier fix scripts
/**
 * Unit system service.
 *
 * Internal storage is always SI: metres, m², m³, kilograms, radians, kelvin.
 * Display conversion happens only at the UI boundary via this module.
 *
 * Two independent axes:
 *   • LengthUnit — the length display unit (mm, cm, m, ft, ft-in)
 *   • UnitSystem — a bundle that pins every kind to a coherent family
 *
 * Most projects only need to set the UnitSystem; power users can override
 * individual kinds.
 */
import { i18n, type Locale } from "./i18n";

export type UnitSystem =
  | "metric-mm"      // mm / m² / m³ / kg — common in EU, CN, JP
  | "metric-cm"      // cm / m² / m³ / kg — common in FR, ES, IT
  | "metric-m"       // m / m² / m³ / kg  — international, IFC-native
  | "imperial-in"    // in / ft² / ft³ / lb
  | "imperial-ft";   // ft / ft² / ft³ / lb

export type LengthUnit = "mm" | "cm" | "m" | "ft" | "in" | "ft-in";
export type AreaUnit = "mm2" | "cm2" | "m2" | "ft2" | "in2";
export type VolumeUnit = "mm3" | "cm3" | "m3" | "ft3" | "in3" | "l";
export type MassUnit = "g" | "kg" | "t" | "lb" | "oz";
export type AngleUnit = "deg" | "rad" | "grad";
export type TemperatureUnit = "C" | "F" | "K";

export type UnitKind = "length" | "area" | "volume" | "mass" | "angle" | "temperature";

export interface UnitConfig {
  length: LengthUnit;
  area: AreaUnit;
  volume: VolumeUnit;
  mass: MassUnit;
  angle: AngleUnit;
  temperature: TemperatureUnit;
}

export interface DisplayOptions {
  /** Fixed decimal places. Omit for auto. */
  precision?: number;
  /** Show the unit suffix. Default true. */
  withUnit?: boolean;
  /** Force a specific unit, overriding the current config. */
  unit?: LengthUnit | AreaUnit | VolumeUnit | MassUnit | AngleUnit | TemperatureUnit;
  /** For ft-in: show trailing inches as fractions (default true). */
  fractions?: boolean;
  /** For ft-in: fraction denominator (2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64). Default 16. */
  fractionDenominator?: number;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

const STORAGE_SYSTEM = "obs.units.system";
const STORAGE_CONFIG = "obs.units.config";

const SYSTEM_PRESETS: Record<UnitSystem, UnitConfig> = {
  "metric-mm":    { length: "mm", area: "m2",  volume: "m3",  mass: "kg", angle: "deg", temperature: "C" },
  "metric-cm":    { length: "cm", area: "m2",  volume: "m3",  mass: "kg", angle: "deg", temperature: "C" },
  "metric-m":     { length: "m",  area: "m2",  volume: "m3",  mass: "kg", angle: "deg", temperature: "C" },
  "imperial-in":  { length: "in", area: "ft2", volume: "ft3", mass: "lb", angle: "deg", temperature: "F" },
  "imperial-ft":  { length: "ft", area: "ft2", volume: "ft3", mass: "lb", angle: "deg", temperature: "F" },
};

/* ── Conversion factors to SI (metres, m², m³, kilograms, radians, kelvin) */

const LENGTH_TO_M: Record<Exclude<LengthUnit, "ft-in">, number> = {
  mm: 1e-3,
  cm: 1e-2,
  m: 1,
  in: 0.0254,
  ft: 0.3048,
};
const AREA_TO_M2: Record<AreaUnit, number> = {
  mm2: 1e-6,
  cm2: 1e-4,
  m2: 1,
  ft2: 0.09290304,
  in2: 0.00064516,
};
const VOLUME_TO_M3: Record<VolumeUnit, number> = {
  mm3: 1e-9,
  cm3: 1e-6,
  m3: 1,
  ft3: 0.028316846592,
  in3: 1.6387064e-5,
  l:   1e-3,
};
const MASS_TO_KG: Record<MassUnit, number> = {
  g: 1e-3,
  kg: 1,
  t: 1000,
  lb: 0.45359237,
  oz: 0.028349523125,
};
const ANGLE_TO_RAD: Record<AngleUnit, number> = {
  deg: Math.PI / 180,
  rad: 1,
  grad: Math.PI / 200,
};

/* Unit suffix strings per locale. Kept here because they are not language
   strings — they are notation, and mostly identical across locales. The
   differences (e.g. "m" vs "м" in Cyrillic) are handled by the formatter. */
const LENGTH_SUFFIX: Record<LengthUnit, string> = {
  mm: "mm", cm: "cm", m: "m", ft: "ft", in: "in", "ft-in": "",
};
const AREA_SUFFIX: Record<AreaUnit, string> = {
  mm2: "mm²", cm2: "cm²", m2: "m²", ft2: "ft²", in2: "in²",
};
const VOLUME_SUFFIX: Record<VolumeUnit, string> = {
  mm3: "mm³", cm3: "cm³", m3: "m³", ft3: "ft³", in3: "in³", l: "L",
};
const MASS_SUFFIX: Record<MassUnit, string> = {
  g: "g", kg: "kg", t: "t", lb: "lb", oz: "oz",
};
const ANGLE_SUFFIX: Record<AngleUnit, string> = {
  deg: "°", rad: "rad", grad: "grad",
};
const TEMP_SUFFIX: Record<TemperatureUnit, string> = {
  C: "°C", F: "°F", K: "K",
};

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

type ChangeListener = (config: UnitConfig, system: UnitSystem) => void;

class UnitsService {
  private system: UnitSystem = "metric-m";
  private config: UnitConfig = { ...SYSTEM_PRESETS["metric-m"] };
  private listeners = new Set<ChangeListener>();
  private booted = false;

  /* ── Lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  boot(): void {
    if (this.booted) return;
    this.booted = true;
    try {
      const sys = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_SYSTEM) as UnitSystem | null;
      if (sys && sys in SYSTEM_PRESETS) {
        this.system = sys;
        this.config = { ...SYSTEM_PRESETS[sys] };
      }
      const rawCfg = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_CONFIG);
      if (rawCfg) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawCfg) as Partial<UnitConfig>;
        this.config = { ...this.config, ...parsed };
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
  }

  getSystem(): UnitSystem { return this.system; }

  setSystem(system: UnitSystem): void {
    if (!(system in SYSTEM_PRESETS)) return;
    this.system = system;
    this.config = { ...SYSTEM_PRESETS[system] };
    this.persist();
    this.emit();
  }

  getConfig(): UnitConfig { return { ...this.config }; }

  setLengthUnit(u: LengthUnit): void { this.config.length = u; this.persist(); this.emit(); }
  setAreaUnit(u: AreaUnit): void     { this.config.area = u; this.persist(); this.emit(); }
  setVolumeUnit(u: VolumeUnit): void { this.config.volume = u; this.persist(); this.emit(); }
  setMassUnit(u: MassUnit): void     { this.config.mass = u; this.persist(); this.emit(); }
  setAngleUnit(u: AngleUnit): void   { this.config.angle = u; this.persist(); this.emit(); }
  setTemperatureUnit(u: TemperatureUnit): void { this.config.temperature = u; this.persist(); this.emit(); }

  onChange(cb: ChangeListener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  private emit(): void {
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(this.config, this.system); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }

  private persist(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SYSTEM, this.system);
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_CONFIG, JSON.stringify(this.config));
    } catch { /* */ }
  }

  /* ── Display ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  formatLength(meters: number, opts: DisplayOptions = {}): string {
    const unit = (opts.unit as LengthUnit) ?? this.config.length;
    const precision = opts.precision ?? defaultLengthPrecision(unit);
    const showUnit = opts.withUnit !== false;

    if (unit === "ft-in") {
      return formatFeetInches(meters, {
        precision,
        showUnit,
        fractions: opts.fractions !== false,
        denominator: opts.fractionDenominator ?? 16,
      });
    }

    const value = meters / LENGTH_TO_M[unit];
    const num = formatNumberLocale(value, precision);
    if (!showUnit) return num;
    return `${num}\u2009${LENGTH_SUFFIX[unit]}`;
  }

  formatArea(m2: number, opts: DisplayOptions = {}): string {
    const unit = (opts.unit as AreaUnit) ?? this.config.area;
    const precision = opts.precision ?? 2;
    const value = m2 / AREA_TO_M2[unit];
    const num = formatNumberLocale(value, precision);
    if (opts.withUnit === false) return num;
    return `${num}\u2009${AREA_SUFFIX[unit]}`;
  }

  formatVolume(m3: number, opts: DisplayOptions = {}): string {
    const unit = (opts.unit as VolumeUnit) ?? this.config.volume;
    const precision = opts.precision ?? 3;
    const value = m3 / VOLUME_TO_M3[unit];
    const num = formatNumberLocale(value, precision);
    if (opts.withUnit === false) return num;
    return `${num}\u2009${VOLUME_SUFFIX[unit]}`;
  }

  formatMass(kg: number, opts: DisplayOptions = {}): string {
    const unit = (opts.unit as MassUnit) ?? this.config.mass;
    const precision = opts.precision ?? 2;
    const value = kg / MASS_TO_KG[unit];
    const num = formatNumberLocale(value, precision);
    if (opts.withUnit === false) return num;
    return `${num}\u2009${MASS_SUFFIX[unit]}`;
  }

  /** Angles stored in radians. */
  formatAngle(radians: number, opts: DisplayOptions = {}): string {
    const unit = (opts.unit as AngleUnit) ?? this.config.angle;
    const precision = opts.precision ?? 2;
    const value = radians / ANGLE_TO_RAD[unit];
    const num = formatNumberLocale(value, precision);
    if (opts.withUnit === false) return num;
    return `${num}\u2009${ANGLE_SUFFIX[unit]}`;
  }

  /** Temperatures stored in kelvin. */
  formatTemperature(kelvin: number, opts: DisplayOptions = {}): string {
    const unit = (opts.unit as TemperatureUnit) ?? this.config.temperature;
    const value =
      unit === "C" ? kelvin - 273.15 :
      unit === "F" ? (kelvin - 273.15) * 9 / 5 + 32 :
      kelvin;
    const precision = opts.precision ?? 1;
    const num = formatNumberLocale(value, precision);
    if (opts.withUnit === false) return num;
    return `${num}\u2009${TEMP_SUFFIX[unit]}`;
  }

  /* ── Parse (user input → SI) ────────────────────────────────────── */

  parseLength(input: string): number | null {
    return parseDimension(input, this.config.length);
  }
  parseArea(input: string): number | null {
    const r = parseDimension(input, this.config.area);
    if (r == null) return null;
    return r;
  }
  parseVolume(input: string): number | null {
    return parseDimension(input, this.config.volume);
  }
  parseMass(input: string): number | null {
    return parseDimension(input, this.config.mass);
  }
  parseAngle(input: string): number | null {
    const r = parseDimension(input, this.config.angle);
    if (r == null) return null;
    return r;
  }

  /** Revit-style: interpret a user-typed length against the display unit,
   *  or against an explicit suffix if the user typed one.
   *  Returns metres. */
  parseLengthInput(input: string, fallbackUnit?: LengthUnit): number | null {
    const cleaned = String(input ?? "").trim();
    if (!cleaned) return null;
    return parseLengthString(cleaned, fallbackUnit ?? this.config.length);
  }

  /* ── Unit metadata for UI ───────────────────────────────────────── */

  lengthUnits(): LengthUnit[] { return ["mm", "cm", "m", "ft", "in", "ft-in"]; }
  areaUnits(): AreaUnit[] { return ["mm2", "cm2", "m2", "ft2", "in2"]; }
  volumeUnits(): VolumeUnit[] { return ["mm3", "cm3", "m3", "ft3", "in3", "l"]; }
  massUnits(): MassUnit[] { return ["g", "kg", "t", "lb", "oz"]; }
  angleUnits(): AngleUnit[] { return ["deg", "rad", "grad"]; }

  systems(): UnitSystem[] {
    return ["metric-mm", "metric-cm", "metric-m", "imperial-in", "imperial-ft"];
  }
}

/* ── Formatting helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function formatNumberLocale(value: number, precision: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "—";
  const locale = i18n.getLocale();
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: precision,
      useGrouping: Math.abs(value) >= 10000,
    }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return value.toFixed(precision);
  }
}

function defaultLengthPrecision(unit: LengthUnit): number {
  switch (unit) {
    case "mm":    return 0;
    case "cm":    return 1;
    case "m":     return 3;
    case "ft":    return 2;
    case "in":    return 1;
    case "ft-in": return 2;
  }
}

/**
 * Revit-style feet-inches. Precision is the inch fraction denominator:
 *   fractionDenominator = 16 → "5'-6 1/2""
 *   showUnit = false       → omit the trailing double-quote
 */
function formatFeetInches(
  meters: number,
  opts: { precision: number; showUnit: boolean; fractions: boolean; denominator: number },
): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(meters)) return "—";
  const negative = meters < 0;
  const totalInches = Math.abs(meters) / LENGTH_TO_M.in;
  const sign = negative ? "-" : "";

  let feet = Math.floor(totalInches / 12);
  let inches = totalInches - feet * 12;

  if (opts.fractions) {
    const denom = Math.max(2, Math.min(64, opts.denominator));
    let numerator = Math.round((inches - Math.floor(inches)) * denom);
    let whole = Math.floor(inches);
    if (numerator === denom) { whole += 1; numerator = 0; }
    if (whole === 12) { feet += 1; whole = 0; }

    let inchStr = String(whole);
    if (numerator > 0) {
      const g = gcd(numerator, denom);
      inchStr += ` ${numerator / g}/${denom / g}`;
    }

    const feetStr = `${feet}'`;
    if (opts.showUnit) return `${sign}${feetStr}-${inchStr}"`;
    return `${sign}${feetStr}-${inchStr}`;
  }

  const inchesRounded = Math.round(inches * 100) / 100;
  const inchStr = formatNumberLocale(inchesRounded, opts.precision);
  const feetStr = `${feet}'`;
  return opts.showUnit ? `${sign}${feetStr}-${inchStr}"` : `${sign}${feetStr}-${inchStr}`;
}

function gcd(a: number, b: number): number {
  return b === 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
}

/**
 * Parse a string like "12.5m", "500 mm", "5'-6\"", "3,20 m" into a
 * value in the base SI unit of the given kind.
 */
// openbim-fix: units.ts -- suffix matchers for non-length kinds
function matchAreaSuffix(s: string): AreaUnit | null {
  switch (s) {
    case "mm2": case "mm²": return "mm2";
    case "cm2": case "cm²": return "cm2";
    case "m2":  case "m²":  return "m2";
    case "ft2": case "ft²": return "ft2";
    case "in2": case "in²": return "in2";
    default: return null;
  }
}
function matchVolumeSuffix(s: string): VolumeUnit | null {
  switch (s) {
    case "mm3": case "mm³": return "mm3";
    case "cm3": case "cm³": return "cm3";
    case "m3":  case "m³":  return "m3";
    case "ft3": case "ft³": return "ft3";
    case "in3": case "in³": return "in3";
    case "l": case "ltr": return "l";
    default: return null;
  }
}
function matchMassSuffix(s: string): MassUnit | null {
  switch (s) {
    case "g": return "g";
    case "kg": return "kg";
    case "t": return "t";
    case "lb": case "lbs": return "lb";
    case "oz": return "oz";
    default: return null;
  }
}
function matchAngleSuffix(s: string): AngleUnit | null {
  switch (s) {
    case "deg": case "°": return "deg";
    case "rad": return "rad";
    case "grad": return "grad";
    default: return null;
  }
}

function parseDimension(input: string, unit: string): number | null {
  const cleaned = String(input ?? "").trim();
  if (!cleaned) return null;

  // Feet-inches notation
  if (/^-?\d+'/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return parseFeetInches(cleaned);
  }

  // [number][optional whitespace][suffix]
  const m = cleaned.match(/^(-?[\d.,\u00A0\u202F ]+)\s*([a-zA-Z°'"²³]+)?$/);
  if (!m) return null;

  const numStr = m[1].replace(/\s|\u00A0|\u202F/g, "");
  const value = parseNumberLocale(numStr);
  if (value == null) return null;

  const suffix = (m[2] ?? "").toLowerCase();

  switch (unit) {
    case "mm": case "cm": case "m":
    case "ft": case "in": case "ft-in": {
      const explicit = suffix ? matchLengthSuffix(suffix) : null;
      const u = explicit ?? (unit as LengthUnit);
      if (u === "ft-in") return parseFeetInches(`${value}'`) ?? value * LENGTH_TO_M.ft;
      return value * LENGTH_TO_M[u as Exclude<LengthUnit, "ft-in">];
    }
    case "mm2": case "cm2": case "m2": case "ft2": case "in2": {
      const u = (suffix ? matchAreaSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as AreaUnit);
      return value * AREA_TO_M2[u];
    }
    case "mm3": case "cm3": case "m3": case "ft3": case "in3": case "l": {
      const u = (suffix ? matchVolumeSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as VolumeUnit);
      return value * VOLUME_TO_M3[u];
    }
    case "g": case "kg": case "t": case "lb": case "oz": {
      const u = (suffix ? matchMassSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as MassUnit);
      return value * MASS_TO_KG[u];
    }
    case "deg": case "rad": case "grad": {
      const u = (suffix ? matchAngleSuffix(suffix) : null) ?? (unit as AngleUnit);
      return value * ANGLE_TO_RAD[u];
    }
    default:
      return value;
  }
}

function parseLengthString(input: string, fallback: LengthUnit): number | null {
  const suffixMatch = input.match(/([a-zA-Z°'"]+)\s*$/);
  if (suffixMatch) {
    const found = matchLengthSuffix(suffixMatch[1].toLowerCase());
    if (found) {
      const r = parseDimension(input, found);
      if (r != null) return r;
    }
  }
  return parseDimension(input, fallback);
}

function matchLengthSuffix(s: string): LengthUnit | null {
  switch (s) {
    case "mm": return "mm";
    case "cm": return "cm";
    case "m":  return "m";
    case "ft": case "'": return "ft";
    case "in": case '"': return "in";
    default: return null;
  }
}

function parseFeetInches(input: string): number | null {
  // e.g. 5'-6 1/2"  |  5' 6"  |  5'
  const s = input.trim().replace(/[\u2019\u02BC]/g, "'");
  const ftIn = s.match(/^(-?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*'\s*(?:-\s*)?(.*)$/);
  if (!ftIn) return null;
  const feet = parseNumberLocale(ftIn[1].replace(",", "."));
  if (feet == null) return null;

  const rest = ftIn[2].replace(/["″]/g, "").trim();
  if (!rest) return feet * LENGTH_TO_M.ft;

  // Possible fraction: "6 1/2" or "6-1/2"
  const frac = rest.match(/^(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)(?:\s+|[-])(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)$/);
  if (frac) {
    const whole = parseNumberLocale(frac[1].replace(",", ".")) ?? 0;
    const num = parseFloat(frac[2]);
    const den = parseFloat(frac[3]);
    const inches = whole + (den ? num / den : 0);
    return feet * LENGTH_TO_M.ft + inches * LENGTH_TO_M.in;
  }
  const plain = parseNumberLocale(rest.replace(",", "."));
  if (plain == null) return feet * LENGTH_TO_M.ft;
  return feet * LENGTH_TO_M.ft + plain * LENGTH_TO_M.in;
}

/** Locale-aware number parse: accepts "1.234,56", "1,234.56", "1 234,56". */
function parseNumberLocale(s: string): number | null {
  if (!s) return null;
  // Heuristic: if there's a single comma with digits after, treat as decimal.
  // If both, the last one wins.
  const lastComma = s.lastIndexOf(",");
  const lastDot = s.lastIndexOf(".");
  let normalized: string;

  if (lastComma === -1 && lastDot === -1) normalized = s;
  else if (lastComma === -1) normalized = s;
  else if (lastDot === -1) normalized = s.replace(",", ".");
  else if (lastComma > lastDot) normalized = s.replace(/\./g, "").replace(",", ".");
  else normalized = s.replace(/,/g, "");

  const n = Number(normalized);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}

/* ── Singleton + convenience ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

export const units = new UnitsService();

/** Convenience aliases used widely by feature code. */
export const fmtLength = (m: number, o?: DisplayOptions) => units.formatLength(m, o);
export const fmtArea   = (m2: number, o?: DisplayOptions) => units.formatArea(m2, o);
export const fmtVolume = (m3: number, o?: DisplayOptions) => units.formatVolume(m3, o);
export const fmtMass   = (kg: number, o?: DisplayOptions) => units.formatMass(kg, o);
export const fmtAngle  = (rad: number, o?: DisplayOptions) => units.formatAngle(rad, o);
export const fmtTemp   = (k: number, o?: DisplayOptions) => units.formatTemperature(k, o);
```

```ts
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "./context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

/*
 * Single authoritative wheel-zoom owner for the 3D viewport.
 *
 * Why this exists:
 *   navigation.ts (router wheel branch) AND a secondary ortho/plan handler
 *   both consumed wheel events, producing double-zoom / jitter, and the raw
 *   deltaY sign was not normalized across deltaMode (pixel/line/page), so
 *   "up" vs "down" felt inverted on some devices. Middle-mouse pan also let
 *   wheel leak through.
 *
 * This module:
 *   - normalizes deltaY (deltaMode + clamp) and applies Revit convention
 *     (wheel up = zoom in). setInvert(true) flips it for reversed devices.
 *   - Shift = x3, plus the registered nav.wheelZoomMultiplier option.
 *   - ignores wheel while __OBS_MMB_HELD (no zoom during pan).
 *   - ignores wheel over panels / ribbon / property palette / plan SVG /
 *     text inputs, so 2D plan zoom and UI scrolling are not stolen.
 *   - stopImmediatePropagation() so no secondary module double-zooms.
 *   - sets window.__OBS_WHEEL_AUTHORITY = true permanently after install,
 *     which navigation.ts reads to no-op its router wheel branch (this is
 *     order-independent: the flag is set once at boot, not per-event).
 *
 * It does NOT touch CameraControls mouse mapping (navigation owns that).
 */

let installed = false;
let enabled = true;
let invert = false;
let multiplier = 1;

const UI_BLOCK =
  ".obs-panel,[data-obs-panel],#obs-ai-chat,#obs-bim-toolbox,.obs-ribbon," +
  ".obs-property,.obs-dialog,.obs-adv-toolbar,.obs-plan-view,#plan-svg," +
  "input,textarea,select,button,label,a,[contenteditable=true]";

function w(): Any { return window as Any; }

function readMultiplier(): number {
  try {
    const reg: Any = (w().__obsOptionsRegistry ?? null);
    const v = reg?.get?.("nav.wheelZoomMultiplier");
    if (typeof v === "number" && v > 0) return v;
  } catch { /* registry optional */ }
  return multiplier;
}

function normalizeDelta(e: WheelEvent): number {
  let d = e.deltaY;
  if (e.deltaMode === 1) d *= 16;        // DOM_DELTA_LINE
  else if (e.deltaMode === 2) d *= 100;  // DOM_DELTA_PAGE
  // clamp trackpad momentum spikes
  if (d > 600) d = 600;
  if (d < -600) d = -600;
  return d;
}

function isOverViewport(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  const el = target as Any;
  if (!el) return false;
  if (typeof el.closest === "function" && el.closest(UI_BLOCK)) return false;
  // must be inside the 3D host / canvas, not a side panel
  const c = ctx as Any;
  const host: Any = c.rightHost;
  if (host && host.contains && !host.contains(el)) {
    // allow the canvas itself even if rightHost ref is stale
    const tag = String(el.tagName ?? "").toUpperCase();
    if (tag !== "CANVAS") return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function applyZoom(ndelta: number, shift: boolean): void {
  const c = ctx as Any;
  const cam: Any = c.world?.camera?.three;
  const controls: Any = c.world?.camera?.controls;
  if (!cam) return;

  const speed = 0.0016 * readMultiplier() * (shift ? 3 : 1);
  // Revit: wheel up (ndelta < 0) => zoom in => factor > 1
  const signed = invert ? -ndelta : ndelta;
  const factor = Math.exp(-signed * speed);
  if (!Number.isFinite(factor) || factor <= 0) return;

  const isOrtho = cam.isOrthographicCamera === true;

  if (isOrtho) {
    cam.zoom = Math.max(1e-4, cam.zoom * factor);
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  } else {
    const target = new THREE.Vector3();
    let got = false;
    try { if (typeof controls?.getTarget === "function") { controls.getTarget(target); got = true; } } catch { /* */ }
    if (!got) {
      const fwd = new THREE.Vector3();
      cam.getWorldDirection(fwd);
      target.copy(cam.position).addScaledVector(fwd, 10);
    }
    const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(cam.position, target);
    const dist = dir.length();
    if (dist < 1e-6) return;
    const newDist = Math.max(1e-4, dist / factor);
    dir.normalize().multiplyScalar(newDist);
    const np = new THREE.Vector3().addVectors(target, dir);
    try {
      controls.setLookAt(np.x, np.y, np.z, target.x, target.y, target.z, false);
      controls.update?.(0);
    } catch {
      cam.position.copy(np);
    }
  }

  try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:camera-changed")); } catch { /* */ }
}

function onWheel(e: WheelEvent): void {
  if (!enabled) return;
  if ((w() as Any).__OBS_MMB_HELD) return;          // panning: no zoom
  if (!isOverViewport(e.target)) return;            // panels / UI / plan svg
  const nd = normalizeDelta(e);
  if (nd === 0) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  applyZoom(nd, !!e.shiftKey);
}

export function setWheelInvert(next: boolean): boolean {
  invert = !!next;
  return invert;
}
export function setWheelMultiplier(next: number): number {
  multiplier = Number.isFinite(next) && next > 0 ? next : 1;
  return multiplier;
}
export function setWheelEnabled(next: boolean): boolean {
  enabled = !!next;
  return enabled;
}
export function isWheelEnabled(): boolean { return enabled; }

export function setupWheelArbiter(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  // Permanent flag read by navigation.ts router-wheel branch (order-independent).
  (w() as Any).__OBS_WHEEL_AUTHORITY = true;

  window.addEventListener("wheel", onWheel, { capture: true, passive: false });

  (w() as Any).__obsWheelFix = {
    setInvert: setWheelInvert,
    setMultiplier: setWheelMultiplier,
    setEnabled: setWheelEnabled,
    isEnabled: isWheelEnabled,
    getState: () => ({ enabled, invert, multiplier: readMultiplier() }),
  };

  console.log(
    "[wheel-arbiter] single owner ready: Revit direction (up=zoom-in), " +
    "deltaMode normalized, Shift=x3, ignored while MMB held / over panels. " +
    "Flip direction with __obsWheelFix.setInvert(true) if your device is reversed.",
  );
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Critical Gaps Boot - wires every Revit-parity module.
 *
 * Import once from main.ts (`import "./critical-gaps-boot"`).
 *
 * Design rules for zero-crash boot:
 *  - Only ctx is a static import
 *  - Everything else loads via dynamic import() inside safe()
 *  - One failure never stops the rest
 */

import { ctx } from "./core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let started = false;
let timer: number | null = null;

function isReady(): boolean {
  const c = ctx as Any;
  const renderer = c.world?.renderer?.three ?? c.world?.renderer;
  const hasRenderer = !!renderer && typeof renderer.render === "function";
  const hasHost =
    !!c.rightHost ||
    !!document.getElementById("viewport") ||
    !!document.querySelector(".obs-viewport");
  return hasRenderer && hasHost;
}

async function safe(label: string, fn: () => unknown): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await fn();
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[critical-gaps-boot]", label, e);
  }
}

async function runOnce(): Promise<void> {
  if (started) return;
  started = true;
  (window as Any).__OBS_CTX__ = ctx;

  // Existing project modules
  await safe("performance-optimizer", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./core/performance-optimizer");
    m.setupPerformanceOptimizer?.();
  });
  await safe("hosted-openings", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/hosted-openings");
    m.setupHostedOpenings?.();
  });
  await safe("constraint-solver", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/constraint-solver");
    m.setupConstraintSolver?.();
  });
  await safe("drafting-2d", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/drafting-2d");
    m.setupDrafting2D?.();
  });
  await safe("drafting-bridge", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/drafting-bridge");
    m.setupDraftingBridge?.();
  });
  await safe("lod-manager", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/lod-manager");
    m.setupLodManager?.();
  });
  await safe("focus-service", async () => { await import("./features/focus-service"); });
  await safe("hosted-place-sync", async () => { await import("./features/hosted-place-sync"); });

  // Core Revit-parity stores
  await safe("rooms", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/rooms/rooms");
    m.setupRooms?.();
  });
  await safe("phases", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/phases/phases");
    m.setupPhases?.();
  });
  await safe("groups", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/groups/groups");
    m.setupGroups?.();
  });
  await safe("design-options", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/design-options/design-options");
    m.setupDesignOptions?.();
  });
  await safe("ref-planes", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/ref-planes/ref-planes");
    m.setupRefPlanes?.();
  });
  await safe("shared-params", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/shared-params/shared-params");
    m.setupSharedParams?.();
  });
  await safe("visibility-filter", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/visibility/visibility-filter");
    m.setupVisibilityFilter?.();
  });

  // Geometry generators
  await safe("stairs", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/stairs/stairs");
    m.setupStairs?.();
  });
  await safe("railings", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/railings/railings");
    m.setupRailings?.();
  });
  await safe("curtain-wall", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/curtain-wall/curtain-wall");
    m.setupCurtainWall?.();
  });

  // Coordination
  await safe("copy-monitor", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/copy-monitor/copy-monitor");
    m.setupCopyMonitor?.();
  });
  await safe("type-catalog", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/type-catalog/type-catalog");
    m.setupTypeCatalog?.();
  });

  // Tools
  await safe("align-tool", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/align-tool");
    m.setupAlignTool?.();
  });
  await safe("temp-dimensions", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/temp-dimensions");
    m.setupTempDimensions?.();
  });

  // Parametric families - full engine upgrade + sample door + UI
  await safe("parametric-families", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/families/families-parametric-boot");
    m.setupParametricFamilies?.();
  });
  await safe("parametric-family-panel", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/parametric-family-panel");
    m.setupParametricFamilyPanel?.();
  });

  // UI
  await safe("gap-panels", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/panels/gap-panels");
    m.setupGapPanels?.();
  });
  await safe("ui-items-gap-patch", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/ui-items-register-patch");
    m.registerClosedGapUiItems?.();
  });
  await safe("revit-parity-bridge", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/revit-parity-bridge");
    m.setupRevitParityBridge?.();
  });
  await safe("revit-command-center", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/revit-command-center");
    m.setupRevitCommandCenter?.();

    m.setupNavSelectionPivotPatch?.();
  });
  await safe("revit-input-parity", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/revit-input-parity");
    m.setupRevitInputParity?.();
  });
  await safe("cad-parity", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/cad-parity");
    m.setupCadParity?.();
  });
  await safe("dwg-engine", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/drawings/dwg-engine");
    m.setupDwgEngine?.();
  });
  await safe("drawings-panel", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/drawings-panel");
    m.setupDrawingsPanel?.();
  });
  await safe("parity-tab-bar", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/parity-tab-bar");
    m.setupParityTabBar?.();
  });
  await safe("section-arrow-select-block", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/section-arrow-select-block");
    m.setupSectionArrowSelectBlock?.();
  });
  await safe("section-cut-interaction", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/section-cut-interaction");
    m.setupSectionCutInteraction?.();
  });
  await safe("ribbon-parity-inject", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/ribbon-parity-inject");
    m.setupRibbonParityInject?.();
  });
  await safe("critical-gaps-ui", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/critical-gaps-ui");
    m.setupCriticalGapsUI?.();
  });

  // Enable previously-stubbed features
  await safe("navigation-bar", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/navigation-bar");
    m.setupNavigationBar?.();
  });
  await safe("system-browser", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/system-browser");
    m.setupSystemBrowser?.();
  });
  await safe("mep-fabrication", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/mep-fabrication");
    m.setupMepFabrication?.();
  });
  await safe("pid-modeler", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./features/pid-modeler");
    m.setupPidModeler?.();
  });

  await safe("wheel-arbiter", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./core/wheel-arbiter");
    m.setupWheelArbiter?.();
  });
  await safe("realtime-client", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./modules/collaboration/realtime-client");
    m.setupRealtimeClient?.();
  });
  await safe("revit-mouse-policy", async () => {
    const m: Any = await import("./core/revit-mouse-policy");
    m.setupRevitMousePolicy?.();
  });

  console.log("[critical-gaps-boot] all critical gaps wired");
}

timer = window.setInterval(() => {
  if (isReady()) {
    if (timer !== null) {
      window.clearInterval(timer);
      timer = null;
    }
    void runOnce();
  }
}, 200);

window.setTimeout(() => {
  if (timer !== null) {
    window.clearInterval(timer);
    timer = null;
    void runOnce();
  }
}, 120000);
```

```ts
/**
 * AccuDraw v2 — Bentley-style axis guidance with shift-ortho, angle snaps,
 * and typed distance entry.
 *
 * Keyboard (active only while a base point is placed):
 *   X / Z / Y     toggle axis lock
 *   Tab           cycle Free → X → Z → Y
 *   Shift (hold)  Ortho — force-project onto the nearest axis
 *   A             cycle angle-increment lock: Off → 15° → 30° → 45° → 90°
 *   0-9 .         typed distance; Enter commits the point at that distance
 *   Backspace     erase last digit
 *   Esc           clear lock (chain survives); press again to end
 *
 * Auto-lock: within 12° of an axis → snap to that axis automatically.
 *
 * Angles: when an angle-lock is active, the candidate point is rotated to
 * the nearest multiple of the increment from the base point.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

export type AccuAxis = "free" | "x" | "y" | "z";
export type AngleLock = 0 | 15 | 30 | 45 | 90;

const AUTO_ANGLE_DEG = 12;
const AUTO_MIN_DISTANCE = 0.15;
const COMPASS_SIZE = 132;

const ANGLE_CYCLE: AngleLock[] = [0, 15, 30, 45, 90];

class AccuDrawManager {
  private enabled = false;
  private lock: AccuAxis = "free";
  private autoLock = true;
  private angleLock: AngleLock = 0;
  private basePoint: THREE.Vector3 | null = null;

  // Shift-ortho (transient, only while Shift held)
  private shiftOrtho = false;

  // Typed distance buffer
  private typedBuffer = "";

  // Screen tracking for Y-lock math
  private lastScreenX = 0;
  private lastScreenY = 0;

  // DOM
  private host: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private svg: SVGSVGElement | null = null;
  private armX: SVGLineElement | null = null;
  private armY: SVGLineElement | null = null;
  private armZ: SVGLineElement | null = null;
  private armXHead: SVGPolygonElement | null = null;
  private armYHead: SVGPolygonElement | null = null;
  private armZHead: SVGPolygonElement | null = null;
  private statusText: SVGTextElement | null = null;
  private deltaX: SVGTextElement | null = null;
  private deltaY: SVGTextElement | null = null;
  private deltaZ: SVGTextElement | null = null;
  private angleText: SVGTextElement | null = null;
  private typedText: SVGTextElement | null = null;

  // Cursor tooltip (distance + angle near pointer)
  private tooltip: HTMLDivElement | null = null;

  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();

  /* ── Setup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  init(): void {
    if (this.enabled) return;
    this.enabled = true;

    window.addEventListener("keydown", this.onKeyDown, true);
    window.addEventListener("keyup", this.onKeyUp, true);
    ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("mousemove", this.onMouseMove);

    console.log("[accudraw] enabled");
  }

  destroy(): void {
    this.enabled = false;
    window.removeEventListener("keydown", this.onKeyDown, true);
    window.removeEventListener("keyup", this.onKeyUp, true);
    ctx.rightHost.removeEventListener("mousemove", this.onMouseMove);
    this.hideCompass();
    this.hideTooltip();
  }

  onChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }
  private emit() {
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }

  /* ── Public state ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  getLock(): AccuAxis { return this.lock; }
  getAngleLock(): AngleLock { return this.angleLock; }
  getBasePoint(): THREE.Vector3 | null { return this.basePoint ? this.basePoint.clone() : null; }
  isActive(): boolean { return this.basePoint !== null; }
  isOrtho(): boolean { return this.shiftOrtho; }

  setLock(axis: AccuAxis): void {
    this.lock = axis;
    this.refreshCompass();
    this.emit();
  }

  cycleLock(): void {
    const order: AccuAxis[] = ["free", "x", "z", "y"];
    const i = order.indexOf(this.lock);
    this.lock = order[(i + 1) % order.length];
    this.refreshCompass();
    this.emit();
  }

  clearLock(): void {
    this.lock = "free";
    this.typedBuffer = "";
    this.refreshCompass();
    this.emit();
  }

  cycleAngleLock(): void {
    const i = ANGLE_CYCLE.indexOf(this.angleLock);
    this.angleLock = ANGLE_CYCLE[(i + 1) % ANGLE_CYCLE.length];
    this.refreshCompass();
    this.emit();
  }

  setAutoLock(on: boolean): void { this.autoLock = on; this.emit(); }
  isAutoLock(): boolean { return this.autoLock; }

  begin(base: THREE.Vector3): void {
    this.basePoint = base.clone();
    this.lock = "free";
    this.typedBuffer = "";
    this.ensureCompass();
    this.ensureTooltip();
    this.showCompass();
    this.emit();
  }

  end(): void {
    this.basePoint = null;
    this.typedBuffer = "";
    this.hideCompass();
    this.hideTooltip();
    this.emit();
  }

  /* ── Constrain ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  constrain(candidate: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector3 {
    if (!this.enabled || !this.basePoint) return candidate;

    const base = this.basePoint;
    const dxWorld = candidate.x - base.x;
    const dzWorld = candidate.z - base.z;

    // ── Typed distance takes precedence ──
    if (this.typedBuffer.length > 0) {
      const dist = parseFloat(this.typedBuffer);
      if (Number.isFinite(dist) && dist > 0) {
        const dir = this.currentDirection(candidate, base);
        const out = base.clone().add(dir.multiplyScalar(dist));
        this.updateDeltas(base, out);
        this.updateTooltip(base, out, candidate);
        return out;
      }
    }

    // ── Determine effective axis ──
    let axis: AccuAxis = this.lock;

    // Shift-ortho overrides auto-lock and forces the nearest axis.
    if (this.shiftOrtho && axis === "free") {
      const horiz = Math.hypot(dxWorld, dzWorld);
      if (horiz >= AUTO_MIN_DISTANCE) {
        const nx = Math.abs(dxWorld) / horiz;
        const nz = Math.abs(dzWorld) / horiz;
        axis = nx >= nz ? "x" : "z";
      }
    }

    // Auto-lock (skipped when Shift-ortho already resolved the axis)
    if (axis === "free" && this.autoLock && !this.shiftOrtho) {
      const horiz = Math.hypot(dxWorld, dzWorld);
      if (horiz >= AUTO_MIN_DISTANCE) {
        const nx = Math.abs(dxWorld) / horiz;
        const nz = Math.abs(dzWorld) / horiz;
        const threshold = Math.cos(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(AUTO_ANGLE_DEG));
        if (nx >= threshold) axis = "x";
        else if (nz >= threshold) axis = "z";
      }
    }

    const out = candidate.clone();

    // ── Project onto axis ──
    if (axis === "x") {
      out.x = base.x + dxWorld;
      out.z = base.z;
      out.y = base.y;
    } else if (axis === "z") {
      out.z = base.z + dzWorld;
      out.x = base.x;
      out.y = base.y;
    } else if (axis === "y") {
      const dy = this.computeVerticalDelta();
      out.x = base.x;
      out.z = base.z;
      out.y = base.y + dy;
    }

    // ── Angle lock ──
    if (this.angleLock > 0 && axis !== "y") {
      const horiz = new THREE.Vector2(out.x - base.x, out.z - base.z);
      const len = horiz.length();
      if (len > 0.001) {
        const step = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(this.angleLock);
        const ang = Math.atan2(horiz.y, horiz.x);
        const snapped = Math.round(ang / step) * step;
        out.x = base.x + Math.cos(snapped) * len;
        out.z = base.z + Math.sin(snapped) * len;
        out.y = base.y;
      }
    }

    this.updateDeltas(base, out);
    this.updateTooltip(base, out, candidate);
    return out;
  }

  /** Direction from base to candidate, respecting the active axis lock. */
  private currentDirection(candidate: THREE.Vector3, base: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector3 {
    if (this.lock === "x") return new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0);
    if (this.lock === "z") return new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);
    if (this.lock === "y") return new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

    // Otherwise: the direction from base to the candidate, normalised.
    const d = candidate.clone().sub(base);
    if (d.lengthSq() < 1e-9) return new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0);
    return d.normalize();
  }

  isReadyForConstraint(): boolean {
    return this.enabled && this.basePoint !== null;
  }

  /** Consume the typed distance (called by authoring on Enter). */
  consumeTypedDistance(): number | null {
    if (!this.typedBuffer) return null;
    const n = parseFloat(this.typedBuffer);
    this.typedBuffer = "";
    this.refreshCompass();
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
  }

  /* ── Vertical (screen-driven) ────────────────────────────────────── */
  private computeVerticalDelta(): number {
    if (!this.basePoint) return 0;
    const cam = ctx.world.camera.three as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
    const dist = cam.position.distanceTo(this.basePoint);
    let worldPerPixel: number;
    if ((cam as any).isPerspectiveCamera) {
      const vFov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cam.fov ?? 60);
      const viewportH = ctx.rightHost.clientHeight || 800;
      worldPerPixel = (2 * Math.tan(vFov / 2) * dist) / viewportH;
    } else {
      const ortho = cam as unknown as THREE.OrthographicCamera;
      const viewportH = ctx.rightHost.clientHeight || 800;
      worldPerPixel = (ortho.top - ortho.bottom) / viewportH;
    }
    const baseScreen = this.projectToScreen(this.basePoint);
    if (!baseScreen) return 0;
    const dyScreen = baseScreen.y - this.lastScreenY;
    return dyScreen * worldPerPixel;
  }

  private projectToScreen(p: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector2 | null {
    try {
      const v = p.clone().project(ctx.world.camera.three);
      const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
      return new THREE.Vector2(
        (v.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.width,
        (-v.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.height,
      );
    } catch { return null; }
  }

  /* ── Keyboard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  private onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent): void => {
    // Shift-ortho engages even before a base point (we set the flag and wait).
    if (e.key === "Shift" && !e.repeat) {
      this.shiftOrtho = true;
      if (this.basePoint) this.refreshCompass();
      return;
    }
    if (!this.enabled || !this.basePoint) return;

    const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (t) {
      const tag = t.tagName?.toLowerCase();
      if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || t.isContentEditable) return;
    }
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;

    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();

    if (k === "x") {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      this.setLock(this.lock === "x" ? "free" : "x");
      return;
    }
    if (k === "z") {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      this.setLock(this.lock === "z" ? "free" : "z");
      return;
    }
    if (k === "y") {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      this.setLock(this.lock === "y" ? "free" : "y");
      return;
    }
    if (k === "a") {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      this.cycleAngleLock();
      return;
    }
    if (k === "tab") {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      this.cycleLock();
      return;
    }
    if (k === "escape") {
      // Clear AccuDraw state but do NOT stop propagation —
      // global Esc handler must still cancel the active tool (Revit-style).
      if (this.lock !== "free" || this.typedBuffer || this.basePoint !== null) {
        this.clearLock();
        this.typedBuffer = "";
        try { this.end(); } catch { /* */ }
      }
      return;
    }

    // Typed distance: digits, dot, backspace
    if (/^[0-9.]$/.test(k)) {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      if (k === "." && this.typedBuffer.includes(".")) return;
      this.typedBuffer += k;
      this.refreshCompass();
      return;
    }
    if (k === "backspace") {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      this.typedBuffer = this.typedBuffer.slice(0, -1);
      this.refreshCompass();
      return;
    }
  };

  private onKeyUp = (e: KeyboardEvent): void => {
    if (e.key === "Shift") {
      this.shiftOrtho = false;
      if (this.basePoint) this.refreshCompass();
    }
  };

  private onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent): void => {
    const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
    this.lastScreenX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    this.lastScreenY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    if (this.basePoint && (this.lock !== "free" || this.shiftOrtho || this.angleLock > 0)) {
      const live = this.constrain(this.basePoint.clone());
      this.updateDeltas(this.basePoint, live);
    }
  };

  /* ── Compass DOM ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  private ensureCompass(): void {
    if (this.host) return;

    const host = document.createElement("div");
    host.style.cssText =
      "position:absolute;left:44px;bottom:44px;z-index:56;width:" + COMPASS_SIZE + "px;" +
      "height:" + (COMPASS_SIZE + 32) + "px;pointer-events:auto;user-select:none;" +
      "display:none;font:11px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#e8eaf0";

    const svg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", String(COMPASS_SIZE));
    svg.setAttribute("height", String(COMPASS_SIZE));
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 132 132");
    svg.style.cssText = "display:block;overflow:visible";

    const cx = 66;
    const cy = 72;
    const R = 44;

    // Backdrop
    const bg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
    bg.setAttribute("cx", String(cx));
    bg.setAttribute("cy", String(cy));
    bg.setAttribute("r", String(R + 14));
    bg.setAttribute("fill", "rgba(20,22,30,0.9)");
    bg.setAttribute("stroke", "rgba(56,189,248,0.28)");
    bg.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1");
    svg.appendChild(bg);

    // Ring
    const ring = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
    ring.setAttribute("cx", String(cx));
    ring.setAttribute("cy", String(cy));
    ring.setAttribute("r", "5");
    ring.setAttribute("fill", "none");
    ring.setAttribute("stroke", "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)");
    ring.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1");
    svg.appendChild(ring);

    const buildArm = (dir: THREE.Vector2, color: string, label: string) => {
      const x2 = cx + dir.x * R;
      const y2 = cy + dir.y * R;

      const line = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "line");
      line.setAttribute("x1", String(cx));
      line.setAttribute("y1", String(cy));
      line.setAttribute("x2", String(x2));
      line.setAttribute("y2", String(y2));
      line.setAttribute("stroke", color);
      line.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.6");
      line.setAttribute("stroke-linecap", "round");
      line.setAttribute("opacity", "0.45");
      line.dataset.axis = label;

      const head = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "polygon");
      const ux = dir.x, uy = dir.y;
      const px = -uy, py = ux;
      const HL = 8, HW = 4;
      head.setAttribute(
        "points",
        `${x2},${y2} ${x2 - ux * HL + px * HW},${y2 - uy * HL + py * HW} ${x2 - ux * HL - px * HW},${y2 - uy * HL - py * HW}`,
      );
      head.setAttribute("fill", color);
      head.setAttribute("opacity", "0.45");
      head.dataset.axis = label;

      const text = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
      text.setAttribute("x", String(cx + dir.x * (R + 11)));
      text.setAttribute("y", String(cy + dir.y * (R + 11) + 3));
      text.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
      text.setAttribute("font-size", "11");
      text.setAttribute("font-weight", "700");
      text.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
      text.setAttribute("fill", color);
      text.setAttribute("opacity", "0.6");
      text.textContent = label.toUpperCase();
      text.dataset.axis = label;

      return { line, head, text };
    };

    const armX = buildArm(new THREE.Vector2(1, 0), "#ef4444", "x");
    const armZ = buildArm(new THREE.Vector2(0.75, 0.66), "#3b82f6", "z");
    const armY = buildArm(new THREE.Vector2(0, -1), "#22c55e", "y");

    svg.append(
      armX.line, armX.head, armX.text,
      armY.line, armY.head, armY.text,
      armZ.line, armZ.head, armZ.text,
    );

    this.armX = armX.line; this.armXHead = armX.head;
    this.armY = armY.line; this.armYHead = armY.head;
    this.armZ = armZ.line; this.armZHead = armZ.head;

    // Status (bottom)
    const statusText = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    statusText.setAttribute("x", String(cx));
    statusText.setAttribute("y", String(COMPASS_SIZE - 4));
    statusText.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    statusText.setAttribute("font-size", "10.5");
    statusText.setAttribute("font-weight", "700");
    statusText.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
    statusText.setAttribute("fill", "#38bdf8");
    statusText.setAttribute("letter-spacing", "0.5");
    statusText.textContent = "FREE";
    svg.appendChild(statusText);
    this.statusText = statusText;

    // Angle lock (top-right)
    const angleText = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    angleText.setAttribute("x", String(COMPASS_SIZE - 2));
    angleText.setAttribute("y", "12");
    angleText.setAttribute("text-anchor", "end");
    angleText.setAttribute("font-size", "9.5");
    angleText.setAttribute("font-family", "ui-monospace, monospace");
    angleText.setAttribute("fill", "#c084fc");
    angleText.setAttribute("letter-spacing", "0.3");
    angleText.textContent = "A: OFF";
    svg.appendChild(angleText);
    this.angleText = angleText;

    // Deltas (top-left)
    const dX = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    dX.setAttribute("x", "4"); dX.setAttribute("y", "12");
    dX.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); dX.setAttribute("font-family", "ui-monospace, monospace");
    dX.setAttribute("fill", "#ef4444"); dX.setAttribute("opacity", "0.9");
    dX.textContent = "x 0.00";

    const dZ = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    dZ.setAttribute("x", "4"); dZ.setAttribute("y", "24");
    dZ.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); dZ.setAttribute("font-family", "ui-monospace, monospace");
    dZ.setAttribute("fill", "#3b82f6"); dZ.setAttribute("opacity", "0.9");
    dZ.textContent = "z 0.00";

    const dY = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    dY.setAttribute("x", "4"); dY.setAttribute("y", "36");
    dY.setAttribute("font-size", "10"); dY.setAttribute("font-family", "ui-monospace, monospace");
    dY.setAttribute("fill", "#22c55e"); dY.setAttribute("opacity", "0.9");
    dY.textContent = "y 0.00";

    svg.append(dX, dZ, dY);
    this.deltaX = dX; this.deltaZ = dZ; this.deltaY = dY;

    // Typed buffer (center-top)
    const typedText = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    typedText.setAttribute("x", String(cx));
    typedText.setAttribute("y", "16");
    typedText.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    typedText.setAttribute("font-size", "12");
    typedText.setAttribute("font-weight", "700");
    typedText.setAttribute("font-family", "ui-monospace, monospace");
    typedText.setAttribute("fill", "#fbbf24");
    typedText.textContent = "";
    svg.appendChild(typedText);
    this.typedText = typedText;

    host.appendChild(svg);

    // Clickable axes
    const axes: { el: Element | null; axis: AccuAxis }[] = [
      { el: armX.line, axis: "x" }, { el: armX.head, axis: "x" }, { el: armX.text, axis: "x" },
      { el: armY.line, axis: "y" }, { el: armY.head, axis: "y" }, { el: armY.text, axis: "y" },
      { el: armZ.line, axis: "z" }, { el: armZ.head, axis: "z" }, { el: armZ.text, axis: "z" },
    ];
    for (const a of axes) {
      if (!a.el) continue;
      (a.el as any).style.cursor = "pointer";
      (a.el as any).addEventListener("pointerdown", (e: PointerEvent) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        this.setLock(this.lock === a.axis ? "free" : a.axis);
      });
    }
    (ring as any).style.cursor = "pointer";
    (ring as any).addEventListener("pointerdown", (e: PointerEvent) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      this.clearLock();
    });

    // Bottom hint strip
    const hints = document.createElement("div");
    hints.style.cssText =
      "position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-24px;text-align:center;" +
      "font:9.5px ui-monospace, monospace;color:#94a3b8;letter-spacing:.3px;white-space:nowrap";
    hints.textContent = "X Z Y · Shift ortho · A angle · type distance · Tab";
    host.appendChild(hints);

    ctx.rightHost.appendChild(host);
    this.host = host;
    this.svg = svg;
  }

  private ensureTooltip(): void {
    if (this.tooltip) return;
    const t = document.createElement("div");
    t.style.cssText =
      "position:absolute;z-index:57;pointer-events:none;display:none;" +
      "background:rgba(20,22,30,0.92);border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.45);" +
      "border-radius:5px;padding:3px 8px;font:11px ui-monospace, monospace;" +
      "color:#e8eaf0;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.45)";
    ctx.rightHost.appendChild(t);
    this.tooltip = t;
  }

  private showCompass(): void {
    if (this.host) this.host.style.display = "block";
    this.refreshCompass();
  }
  private hideCompass(): void {
    if (this.host) this.host.style.display = "none";
  }
  private hideTooltip(): void {
    if (this.tooltip) this.tooltip.style.display = "none";
  }

  private refreshCompass(): void {
    const isActive = (axis: AccuAxis) => this.lock === axis || (this.shiftOrtho && this.autoLock && this.lock === "free" && this.autoAxisCandidate === axis);

    const apply = (line: SVGLineElement | null, head: SVGPolygonElement | null, on: boolean) => {
      if (!line || !head) return;
      line.setAttribute("stroke-width", on ? "3" : "1.6");
      line.setAttribute("opacity", on ? "1" : "0.45");
      head.setAttribute("opacity", on ? "1" : "0.45");
    };

    apply(this.armX, this.armXHead, isActive("x"));
    apply(this.armY, this.armYHead, isActive("y"));
    apply(this.armZ, this.armZHead, isActive("z"));

    if (this.statusText) {
      const label =
        this.typedBuffer ? `DIST ${this.typedBuffer}` :
        this.shiftOrtho ? "ORTHO" :
        this.lock === "free" ? "FREE" :
        this.lock === "x" ? "X-LOCK" :
        this.lock === "y" ? "Y-LOCK" :
        "Z-LOCK";
      this.statusText.textContent = label;
      this.statusText.setAttribute(
        "fill",
        this.typedBuffer ? "#fbbf24" :
        this.shiftOrtho ? "#f59e0b" :
        this.lock === "free" ? "#38bdf8" :
        this.lock === "x" ? "#ef4444" :
        this.lock === "y" ? "#22c55e" :
        "#3b82f6",
      );
    }

    if (this.angleText) {
      this.angleText.textContent = this.angleLock > 0 ? `A: ${this.angleLock}°` : "A: OFF";
      this.angleText.setAttribute("fill", this.angleLock > 0 ? "#c084fc" : "#6b7280");
    }

    if (this.typedText) {
      this.typedText.textContent = this.typedBuffer ? `→ ${this.typedBuffer} m` : "";
    }
  }

  // Cache of the last auto-resolved axis, for visual feedback while free.
  private autoAxisCandidate: AccuAxis = "free";

  private updateDeltas(base: THREE.Vector3, candidate: THREE.Vector3): void {
    if (this.deltaX) this.deltaX.textContent = `x ${(candidate.x - base.x).toFixed(2)}`;
    if (this.deltaZ) this.deltaZ.textContent = `z ${(candidate.z - base.z).toFixed(2)}`;
    if (this.deltaY) this.deltaY.textContent = `y ${(candidate.y - base.y).toFixed(2)}`;
  }

  private updateTooltip(base: THREE.Vector3, snapped: THREE.Vector3, raw: THREE.Vector3): void {
    if (!this.tooltip) return;
    const dx = snapped.x - base.x;
    const dz = snapped.z - base.z;
    const dy = snapped.y - base.y;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);
    const angDeg = (Math.atan2(dz, dx) * 180) / Math.PI;
    const angleStr = `${angDeg.toFixed(0)}°`;

    // Position the tooltip near the cursor.
    this.tooltip.style.left = `${this.lastScreenX + 18}px`;
    this.tooltip.style.top = `${this.lastScreenY - 34}px`;
    this.tooltip.textContent = `${dist.toFixed(2)} m · ${angleStr}`;
    this.tooltip.style.display = "block";
  }
}

export const accuDraw = new AccuDrawManager();

export function setupAccuDraw(): void {
  accuDraw.init();
  (window as any).__obs_accuDraw = accuDraw;
  console.log("[accudraw] setup complete");
}
```
