```ts
/**
 * LLM provider abstraction with reliable persistence.
 *
 * Persistence improvements:
 *   • saveProviderConfig reports failures instead of swallowing them
 *   • loadProviderConfig validates each field independently so a partial
 *     config doesn't reset the whole thing to defaults
 *   • onProviderConfigChanged lets UI subscribe to storage updates
 */

export type ProviderKind = "ollama" | "openai";

export interface ProviderConfig {
  kind: ProviderKind;
  endpoint: string;
  model: string;
  apiKey?: string;
}

export const DEFAULT_CONFIG: ProviderConfig = {
  kind: "ollama",
  endpoint: "http://localhost:11434",
  model: "llama3.1",
};

const CONFIG_KEY = "obs.ai.provider";
const GEMINI_THOUGHT_SIGNATURE_BYPASS = "skip_thought_signature_validator";

/* ── Persistence ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

let lastSaveError: string | null = null;
const listeners = new Set<(cfg: ProviderConfig) => void>();

export function onProviderConfigChanged(cb: (cfg: ProviderConfig) => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(cb);
  return () => listeners.delete(cb);
}

function emit(cfg: ProviderConfig): void {
  for (const cb of listeners) {
    try { cb(cfg); } catch { /* */ }
  }
}

export function getLastSaveError(): string | null {
  return lastSaveError;
}

export function loadProviderConfig(): ProviderConfig {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(CONFIG_KEY);
    if (!raw) return { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG };

    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);

    // Validate each field independently — a bad `kind` doesn't reset `model`.
    const kind: ProviderKind = parsed?.kind === "openai" ? "openai" : "ollama";
    const endpoint = typeof parsed?.endpoint === "string" && parsed.endpoint
      ? parsed.endpoint
      : DEFAULT_CONFIG.endpoint;
    const model = typeof parsed?.model === "string" && parsed.model
      ? parsed.model
      : DEFAULT_CONFIG.model;
    const apiKey = typeof parsed?.apiKey === "string" && parsed.apiKey
      ? parsed.apiKey
      : undefined;

    return { kind, endpoint, model, apiKey };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[ai-providers] load failed, using defaults", err);
    return { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG };
  }
}

export function saveProviderConfig(cfg: ProviderConfig): boolean {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG_KEY, JSON.stringify(cfg));
    lastSaveError = null;
    emit(cfg);
    console.log("[ai-providers] saved", {
      kind: cfg.kind,
      endpoint: cfg.endpoint,
      model: cfg.model,
      hasKey: !!cfg.apiKey,
    });
    return true;
  } catch (err: any) {
    lastSaveError = err?.message ?? String(err);
    console.error("[ai-providers] save FAILED:", lastSaveError, {
      kind: cfg.kind,
      endpoint: cfg.endpoint,
      model: cfg.model,
      hasKey: !!cfg.apiKey,
    });
    return false;
  }
}

/** Wipe the saved config and reload defaults. */
export function resetProviderConfig(): ProviderConfig {
  try { localStorage.removeItem(CONFIG_KEY); } catch { /* */ }
  const fresh = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG };
  saveProviderConfig(fresh);
  return fresh;
}

/* ── The rest of the file is unchanged from here ── */
/* (ToolDef, ToolCall, ChatMessage, ChatResult, ChatRequest, TokenCallback,
    callChat, callChatStream, resolveEndpoint, classifyHttpError,
    networkErrorHint, callOllama, callOllamaStream, toOllamaMessage,
    callOpenAICompat, callOpenAIStream, buildOpenAIHeaders, toOpenAIMessage,
    joinUrl, normaliseArgs, testProvider, listModels — all identical.) */

export interface ToolDef {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  parameters: {
    type: "object";
    properties: Record<string, any>;
    required?: string[];
  };
}

export interface ToolCall {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  args: Record<string, any>;
  extraContent?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface ChatMessage {
  role: "system" | "user" | "assistant" | "tool";
  content: string;
  toolCalls?: ToolCall[];
  toolCallId?: string;
  name?: string;
}

export interface ChatResult {
  message: ChatMessage;
  toolCalls: ToolCall[];
}

export interface ChatRequest {
  messages: ChatMessage[];
  tools: ToolDef[];
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export type TokenCallback = (delta: string) => void;

export async function callChat(cfg: ProviderConfig, req: ChatRequest): Promise<ChatResult> {
  if (cfg.kind === "ollama") return callOllama(cfg, req);
  return callOpenAICompat(cfg, req);
}

export async function callChatStream(
  cfg: ProviderConfig,
  req: ChatRequest,
  onToken: TokenCallback,
): Promise<ChatResult> {
  if (cfg.kind === "ollama") return callOllamaStream(cfg, req, onToken);
  return callOpenAIStream(cfg, req, onToken);
}

function resolveEndpoint(cfg: ProviderConfig): string {
  if (cfg.kind === "ollama") return "/ollama";
  const ep = cfg.endpoint.toLowerCase();
  if (ep.includes("localhost:1234") || ep.includes("127.0.0.1:1234")) return "/lmstudio";
  if (ep.includes("api.anthropic.com")) return "/anthropic";
  return cfg.endpoint;
}

function isGeminiEndpoint(cfg: ProviderConfig): boolean {
  return cfg.endpoint.includes("generativelanguage.googleapis.com");
}

function classifyHttpError(status: number, statusText: string, body: string): string {
  const trimmedBody = body.length > 240 ? body.slice(0, 240) + "…" : body;

  if (status === 400 && /thought_signature|thought signature/i.test(body)) {
    return `400 — Gemini rejected the request because a function call is missing its thought_signature. Try clearing the chat history (Clear button) and sending the message again.\n\nProvider said: ${trimmedBody}`;
  }
  switch (status) {
    case 401: return `401 Unauthorized — the API key is missing or invalid. Get one from the provider's dashboard and paste it in the API key field.` + (trimmedBody ? `\n\nProvider said: ${trimmedBody}` : "");
    case 402: return `402 Payment Required — the provider account has no balance. Add funds or switch to a free-tier provider (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter).` + (trimmedBody ? `\n\nProvider said: ${trimmedBody}` : "");
    case 403: return `403 Forbidden — the API key is valid but does not have access to "${statusText}". Check your provider's billing / model access.` + (trimmedBody ? `\n\nProvider said: ${trimmedBody}` : "");
    case 404: return `404 Not Found — the endpoint URL is wrong, or the model name does not exist on this provider.` + (trimmedBody ? `\n\nProvider said: ${trimmedBody}` : "");
    case 429: return `429 Rate limit — the provider is throttling requests. Wait a moment or upgrade your plan.` + (trimmedBody ? `\n\nProvider said: ${trimmedBody}` : "");
    case 500: case 502: case 503: case 504:
      return `${status} — the provider's server is having problems. Try again in a minute.` + (trimmedBody ? `\n\nProvider said: ${trimmedBody}` : "");
    default: return `${status} ${statusText}${trimmedBody ? `\n\n${trimmedBody}` : ""}`;
  }
}

function networkErrorHint(err: unknown, cfg: ProviderConfig): string {
  const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
  if (/failed to fetch/i.test(msg)) {
    if (cfg.kind === "ollama") return `Cannot reach Ollama at ${cfg.endpoint}. Check that "ollama serve" is running.`;
    if (cfg.endpoint.includes("localhost") || cfg.endpoint.includes("127.0.0.1")) {
      return `Cannot reach ${cfg.endpoint}. The local server is not running, or it does not allow requests from the browser (CORS).`;
    }
    return `Cannot reach ${cfg.endpoint}. Either the network is down, or the provider does not send CORS headers for browser requests.`;
  }
  return msg;
}

/* Non-streaming Ollama */
async function callOllama(cfg: ProviderConfig, req: ChatRequest): Promise<ChatResult> {
  const url = joinUrl(resolveEndpoint(cfg), "/api/chat");
  const body = {
    model: cfg.model,
    messages: req.messages.map(toOllamaMessage),
    tools: req.tools.map((t) => ({ type: "function", function: t })),
    stream: false,
  };
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: req.signal });
  } catch (err) { throw new Error(networkErrorHint(err, cfg)); }
  if (!res.ok) { const txt = await res.text().catch(() => ""); throw new Error(classifyHttpError(res.status, res.statusText, txt)); }
  const json: any = await res.json();
  const msg = json?.message ?? {};
  const content = String(msg.content ?? "");
  const rawCalls: any[] = Array.isArray(msg.tool_calls) ? msg.tool_calls : [];
  const toolCalls: ToolCall[] = rawCalls.map((c, i) => {
    const fn = c?.function ?? c;
    return {
      id: c?.id ?? `ollama-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
      name: String(fn?.name ?? ""),
      args: normaliseArgs(fn?.arguments),
      extraContent: c?.extra_content && typeof c.extra_content === "object" ? c.extra_content : undefined,
    };
  });
  return {
    message: { role: "assistant", content, ...(toolCalls.length ? { toolCalls } : {}) },
    toolCalls,
  };
}

/* Streaming Ollama — same as before */
async function callOllamaStream(cfg: ProviderConfig, req: ChatRequest, onToken: TokenCallback): Promise<ChatResult> {
  const url = joinUrl(resolveEndpoint(cfg), "/api/chat");
  const body = { model: cfg.model, messages: req.messages.map(toOllamaMessage), tools: req.tools.map((t) => ({ type: "function", function: t })), stream: true };
  let res: Response;
  try { res = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: req.signal }); }
  catch (err) { throw new Error(networkErrorHint(err, cfg)); }
  if (!res.ok) { const txt = await res.text().catch(() => ""); throw new Error(classifyHttpError(res.status, res.statusText, txt)); }
  if (!res.body) throw new Error("Ollama returned no response body");
  const reader = res.body.getReader();
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  let buffer = "";
  let fullContent = "";
  const toolCalls: ToolCall[] = [];
  try {
    for (;;) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
      let nl: number;
      while ((nl = buffer.indexOf("\n")) >= 0) {
        const line = buffer.slice(0, nl).trim();
        buffer = buffer.slice(nl + 1);
        if (!line) continue;
        let obj: any;
        try { obj = JSON.parse(line); } catch { continue; }
        const content = obj?.message?.content;
        if (typeof content === "string" && content.length) { fullContent += content; onToken(content); }
        const rawCalls = obj?.message?.tool_calls;
        if (Array.isArray(rawCalls) && rawCalls.length) {
          for (const c of rawCalls) {
            const fn = c?.function ?? c;
            toolCalls.push({ id: c?.id ?? `ollama-${Date.now()}-${toolCalls.length}`, name: String(fn?.name ?? ""), args: normaliseArgs(fn?.arguments), extraContent: c?.extra_content && typeof c.extra_content === "object" ? c.extra_content : undefined });
          }
        }
        if (obj?.done) break;
      }
    }
  } finally { try { reader.releaseLock(); } catch { /* */ } }
  return {
    message: { role: "assistant", content: fullContent, ...(toolCalls.length ? { toolCalls } : {}) },
    toolCalls,
  };
}

function toOllamaMessage(m: ChatMessage): any {
  if (m.role === "tool") return { role: "tool", content: m.content };
  if (m.role === "assistant" && m.toolCalls?.length) {
    return { role: "assistant", content: m.content, tool_calls: m.toolCalls.map((tc) => { const call: any = { function: { name: tc.name, arguments: tc.args } }; if (tc.extraContent) call.extra_content = tc.extraContent; return call; }) };
  }
  return { role: m.role, content: m.content };
}

/* OpenAI-compatible non-streaming */
async function callOpenAICompat(cfg: ProviderConfig, req: ChatRequest): Promise<ChatResult> {
  const url = joinUrl(resolveEndpoint(cfg), "/v1/chat/completions");
  const isGemini = isGeminiEndpoint(cfg);
  const body = { model: cfg.model, messages: req.messages.map((m) => toOpenAIMessage(m, isGemini)), tools: req.tools.map((t) => ({ type: "function", function: t })), tool_choice: req.tools.length ? "auto" : undefined };
  const headers = buildOpenAIHeaders(cfg);
  let res: Response;
  try { res = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: req.signal }); }
  catch (err) { throw new Error(networkErrorHint(err, cfg)); }
  if (!res.ok) { const txt = await res.text().catch(() => ""); throw new Error(classifyHttpError(res.status, res.statusText, txt)); }
  const json: any = await res.json();
  const choice = json?.choices?.[0]?.message ?? {};
  const content = typeof choice.content === "string" ? choice.content : Array.isArray(choice.content) ? choice.content.map((c: any) => c?.text ?? "").join("") : "";
  const rawCalls: any[] = Array.isArray(choice.tool_calls) ? choice.tool_calls : [];
  const toolCalls: ToolCall[] = rawCalls.map((c, i) => ({ id: c?.id ?? `oai-${Date.now()}-${i}`, name: String(c?.function?.name ?? ""), args: normaliseArgs(c?.function?.arguments), extraContent: c?.extra_content && typeof c.extra_content === "object" ? c.extra_content : undefined }));
  return { message: { role: "assistant", content, ...(toolCalls.length ? { toolCalls } : {}) }, toolCalls };
}

/* OpenAI-compatible streaming — same as before */
async function callOpenAIStream(cfg: ProviderConfig, req: ChatRequest, onToken: TokenCallback): Promise<ChatResult> {
  const url = joinUrl(resolveEndpoint(cfg), "/v1/chat/completions");
  const isGemini = isGeminiEndpoint(cfg);
  const body = { model: cfg.model, messages: req.messages.map((m) => toOpenAIMessage(m, isGemini)), tools: req.tools.map((t) => ({ type: "function", function: t })), tool_choice: req.tools.length ? "auto" : undefined, stream: true };
  const headers = buildOpenAIHeaders(cfg);
  let res: Response;
  try { res = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: req.signal }); }
  catch (err) { throw new Error(networkErrorHint(err, cfg)); }
  if (!res.ok) { const txt = await res.text().catch(() => ""); throw new Error(classifyHttpError(res.status, res.statusText, txt)); }
  if (!res.body) throw new Error("Provider returned no response body");
  const reader = res.body.getReader();
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  let buffer = "";
  let fullContent = "";
  interface PartialToolCall { id?: string; name?: string; argsStr?: string; extraContent?: any; }
  const toolCallMap = new Map<number, PartialToolCall>();
  try {
    for (;;) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
      let nl: number;
      while ((nl = buffer.indexOf("\n")) >= 0) {
        const line = buffer.slice(0, nl).trim();
        buffer = buffer.slice(nl + 1);
        if (!line) continue;
        if (line === "data: [DONE]") continue;
        if (!line.startsWith("data:")) continue;
        const jsonStr = line.slice(line.indexOf(":") + 1).trim();
        let obj: any;
        try { obj = JSON.parse(jsonStr); } catch { continue; }
        const delta = obj?.choices?.[0]?.delta ?? {};
        const content = delta.content;
        if (typeof content === "string" && content.length) { fullContent += content; onToken(content); }
        else if (Array.isArray(content)) { for (const part of content) { if (typeof part?.text === "string" && part.text.length) { fullContent += part.text; onToken(part.text); } } }
        const rawCalls = delta.tool_calls;
        if (Array.isArray(rawCalls)) {
          for (const c of rawCalls) {
            const idx = typeof c.index === "number" ? c.index : toolCallMap.size;
            let entry = toolCallMap.get(idx);
            if (!entry) { entry = {}; toolCallMap.set(idx, entry); }
            if (typeof c.id === "string" && c.id.length) entry.id = c.id;
            if (typeof c.function?.name === "string" && c.function.name.length) entry.name = (entry.name ?? "") + c.function.name;
            if (typeof c.function?.arguments === "string") entry.argsStr = (entry.argsStr ?? "") + c.function.arguments;
            if (c.extra_content && typeof c.extra_content === "object") entry.extraContent = c.extra_content;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } finally { try { reader.releaseLock(); } catch { /* */ } }
  const toolCalls: ToolCall[] = [];
  const sortedIdx = [...toolCallMap.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  for (const idx of sortedIdx) {
    const entry = toolCallMap.get(idx)!;
    if (!entry.name) continue;
    toolCalls.push({ id: entry.id ?? `oai-${Date.now()}-${idx}`, name: entry.name, args: normaliseArgs(entry.argsStr), extraContent: entry.extraContent });
  }
  return { message: { role: "assistant", content: fullContent, ...(toolCalls.length ? { toolCalls } : {}) }, toolCalls };
}

function buildOpenAIHeaders(cfg: ProviderConfig): Record<string, string> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { "Content-Type": "application/json" };
  if (cfg.apiKey) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${cfg.apiKey}`;
  if (cfg.endpoint.includes("api.anthropic.com")) {
    headers["anthropic-version"] = "2023-06-01";
    headers["anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access"] = "true";
  }
  return headers;
}

function toOpenAIMessage(m: ChatMessage, isGemini: boolean): any {
  if (m.role === "tool") return { role: "tool", content: m.content, tool_call_id: m.toolCallId ?? "unknown", name: m.name };
  if (m.role === "assistant" && m.toolCalls?.length) {
    const tool_calls = m.toolCalls.map((tc, index) => {
      const base: any = { id: tc.id, type: "function", function: { name: tc.name, arguments: JSON.stringify(tc.args) } };
      if (isGemini) {
        if (tc.extraContent?.google?.thought_signature) base.extra_content = tc.extraContent;
        else if (index === 0) base.extra_content = { google: { thought_signature: GEMINI_THOUGHT_SIGNATURE_BYPASS } };
      }
      return base;
    });
    return { role: "assistant", content: m.content || null, tool_calls };
  }
  return { role: m.role, content: m.content };
}

function joinUrl(base: string, path: string): string {
  const b = base.endsWith("/") ? base.slice(0, -1) : base;
  const p = path.startsWith("/") ? path : "/" + path;
  return b + p;
}

function normaliseArgs(raw: any): Record<string, any> {
  if (raw == null) return {};
  if (typeof raw === "object") return raw;
  if (typeof raw === "string") {
    try { const parsed = JSON.parse(raw); return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" ? parsed : {}; } catch { return {}; }
  }
  return {};
}

export async function testProvider(cfg: ProviderConfig): Promise<string> {
  if (cfg.kind === "ollama") {
    const url = joinUrl(resolveEndpoint(cfg), "/api/tags");
    let res: Response;
    try { res = await fetch(url); } catch (err) { throw new Error(networkErrorHint(err, cfg)); }
    if (!res.ok) { const txt = await res.text().catch(() => ""); throw new Error(classifyHttpError(res.status, res.statusText, txt)); }
    const json: any = await res.json();
    const names = (json?.models ?? []).map((m: any) => String(m?.name ?? m?.model ?? "")).filter(Boolean);
    return `OK · ${names.length} model(s): ${names.slice(0, 4).join(", ")}`;
  }
  const url = joinUrl(resolveEndpoint(cfg), "/v1/models");
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (cfg.apiKey) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${cfg.apiKey}`;
  if (cfg.endpoint.includes("api.anthropic.com")) {
    headers["anthropic-version"] = "2023-06-01";
    headers["anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access"] = "true";
  }
  let res: Response;
  try { res = await fetch(url, { headers }); } catch (err) { throw new Error(networkErrorHint(err, cfg)); }
  if (!res.ok) { const txt = await res.text().catch(() => ""); throw new Error(classifyHttpError(res.status, res.statusText, txt)); }
  const json: any = await res.json();
  const ids = (json?.data ?? []).map((m: any) => String(m?.id ?? "")).filter(Boolean);
  return `OK · ${ids.length} model(s): ${ids.slice(0, 4).join(", ")}`;
}

export async function listModels(cfg: ProviderConfig): Promise<string[]> {
  if (cfg.kind === "ollama") {
    const url = joinUrl(resolveEndpoint(cfg), "/api/tags");
    let res: Response;
    try { res = await fetch(url); } catch (err) { throw new Error(networkErrorHint(err, cfg)); }
    if (!res.ok) { const txt = await res.text().catch(() => ""); throw new Error(classifyHttpError(res.status, res.statusText, txt)); }
    const json: any = await res.json();
    const names = (json?.models ?? []).map((m: any) => String(m?.name ?? m?.model ?? "")).filter(Boolean);
    names.sort((a: string, b: string) => {
      const aLatest = a.endsWith(":latest") ? 1 : 0;
      const bLatest = b.endsWith(":latest") ? 1 : 0;
      if (aLatest !== bLatest) return aLatest - bLatest;
      return a.localeCompare(b);
    });
    return names;
  }
  const url = joinUrl(resolveEndpoint(cfg), "/v1/models");
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (cfg.apiKey) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${cfg.apiKey}`;
  if (cfg.endpoint.includes("api.anthropic.com")) {
    headers["anthropic-version"] = "2023-06-01";
    headers["anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access"] = "true";
  }
  let res: Response;
  try { res = await fetch(url, { headers }); } catch (err) { throw new Error(networkErrorHint(err, cfg)); }
  if (!res.ok) { const txt = await res.text().catch(() => ""); throw new Error(classifyHttpError(res.status, res.statusText, txt)); }
  const json: any = await res.json();
  const ids = (json?.data ?? []).map((m: any) => String(m?.id ?? "")).filter(Boolean);
  ids.sort((a: string, b: string) => a.localeCompare(b));
  return ids;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Tool registry for the AI chat.
 *
 * Every cross-module import is dynamic (via `await import(...)`) so a
 * missing helper file does not break the build. If a tool's dependency
 * is not present at runtime, the tool returns a clear error to the model.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { services } from "../core/services";
import { listCommands, registerCommand } from "./command-palette";

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Types (inlined — no cross-module import needed)
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export interface ToolDef {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  parameters: {
    type: "object";
    properties: Record<string, any>;
    required?: string[];
  };
}

export interface ToolCall {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  args: Record<string, any>;
  extraContent?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface ToolResult {
  ok: boolean;
  data?: any;
  error?: string;
}

/** Tools that must be approved by the user before running. */
const DESTRUCTIVE_TOOLS = new Set<string>([
  "clear_all_elements",
  "delete_elements",
  "clear_index",
]);

export function isDestructiveTool(name: string): boolean {
  return DESTRUCTIVE_TOOLS.has(name);
}

   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Executor
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export async function executeTool(call: ToolCall): Promise<ToolResult> {
  try {
    switch (call.name) {
      case "get_app_state": return { ok: true, data: await getAppState() };
      case "list_commands": return { ok: true, data: listCommands().map(cmdToBrief) };
      case "run_command": return await runCommandTool(String(call.args.id ?? ""));

      case "select_by_category": return await selectByCategoryTool(call.args);
      case "focus_camera": return await focusCameraTool();

      case "get_model_categories": return await getModelCategoriesTool(call.args);
      case "get_element_properties": return await getElementPropertiesTool(call.args);
      case "query_elements": return await queryElementsTool(call.args);

      case "run_clash_test": return await runClashTestTool(call.args);
      case "summarize_clashes": return await summarizeClashesTool();

      case "create_issue": return await createIssueTool(call.args);

      case "semantic_search": return await semanticSearchTool(call.args);
      case "build_semantic_index": return await buildSemanticIndexTool(call.args);

      case "list_schedule_templates": return await listScheduleTemplatesTool();
      case "run_schedule": return await runScheduleTool(call.args);
      case "schedule_diff": return await scheduleDiffTool();
      case "list_saved_schedules": return await listSavedSchedulesTool();
      case "list_schedule_columns": return await listScheduleColumnsTool();
      case "create_schedule": return await createScheduleTool(call.args);
      case "run_saved_schedule": return await runSavedScheduleTool(call.args);

      case "delete_elements": return await deleteElementsTool(call.args);
      case "clear_all_elements": return await clearAllElementsTool();

      default: return { ok: false, error: `Unknown tool: ${call.name}` };
    }
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   App state & commands
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function cmdToBrief(c: any) {
  return {
    id: c.id,
    label: c.label,
    category: c.category,
    hint: c.hint ?? undefined,
    kbd: c.kbd ?? undefined,
  };
}

async function getAppState() {
  const project = services.tryUse("projects")?.getCurrentProject() ?? null;

  const models: { id: string; name: string; elementCount: number | null }[] = [];
  for (const [id, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    let count: number | null = null;
    try {
      const ids = await (model as any).getItemsIdsWithGeometry?.();
      if (Array.isArray(ids)) count = ids.length;
    } catch { /* */ }
    models.push({
      id,
      name: (model as any)?.name ?? (model as any)?.modelName ?? id,
      elementCount: count,
    });
  }

  const selection: Record<string, number> = {};
  const snap = services.tryUse("selection")?.snapshot();
  if (snap) {
    for (const [mid, ids] of Object.entries(snap)) {
      selection[mid] = ids.size;
    }
  }

  const auth = services.tryUse("authoring");
  const authoredCount = auth?.getElementCount() ?? 0;
  const activeTool = auth?.getActiveTool() ?? null;

  return {
    project: project ? { id: project.id, name: project.name } : null,
    models,
    selection,
    authoredElementCount: authoredCount,
    activeAuthoringTool: activeTool,
  };
}

async function runCommandTool(id: string): Promise<ToolResult> {
  if (!id) return { ok: false, error: "Missing command id" };
  const cmd = listCommands().find((c) => c.id === id);
  if (!cmd) return { ok: false, error: `No command with id "${id}"` };
  try {
    await cmd.run();
    return { ok: true, data: { ran: id, label: cmd.label } };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, error: `Command "${id}" failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}` };
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Selection & view
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
async function selectByCategoryTool(args: Record<string, any>): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const category = String(args.category ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!category) return { ok: false, error: "Missing category" };
  const modelId = args.modelId ? String(args.modelId) : null;
  const add = !!args.addToSelection;

  const selection = services.tryUse("selection");
  if (!selection) return { ok: false, error: "Selection module not loaded" };

  const map: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};
  let total = 0;

  for (const [mid, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    if (modelId && mid !== modelId) continue;
    let cats: Record<string, number[]> = {};
    try { cats = await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]); }
    catch { continue; }
    const ids: number[] = [];
    for (const [cat, list] of Object.entries(cats ?? {})) {
      const upper = String(cat).toUpperCase();
      if (upper === category || upper.startsWith(category)) {
        for (const id of (list as number[]) ?? []) ids.push(id);
      }
    }
    if (ids.length) { map[mid] = new Set(ids); total += ids.length; }
  }

  if (!total) {
    return { ok: true, data: { selected: 0, category, note: "No matching elements" } };
  }

  if (add) {
    for (const [mid, ids] of Object.entries(map)) selection.addMany(mid, ids);
  } else {
    selection.replace(map);
  }
  await selection.applyToHighlighter?.();

  return { ok: true, data: { selected: total, category, addToSelection: add } };
}

async function focusCameraTool(): Promise<ToolResult> {
  try {
    const cam = services.tryUse("camera");
    const sel = services.tryUse("selection");
    const isEmpty = !sel || sel.isEmpty?.();
    if (isEmpty || !sel) { cam?.fitAll?.(); return { ok: true, data: { focused: "scene" } }; }
    await sel.focus?.();
    return { ok: true, data: { focused: "selection" } };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Model inspection
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
async function getModelCategoriesTool(args: Record<string, any>): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const modelId = args.modelId ? String(args.modelId) : null;
  const out: Record<string, Record<string, number>> = {};
  for (const [mid, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    if (modelId && mid !== modelId) continue;
    try {
      const cats = await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
      const bucket: Record<string, number> = {};
      for (const [cat, list] of Object.entries(cats ?? {})) {
        bucket[cat] = ((list as number[]) ?? []).length;
      }
      out[mid] = bucket;
    } catch (err) {
      out[mid] = { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) } as any;
    }
  }
  return { ok: true, data: out };
}

function flattenData(d: any): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (!d || typeof d !== "object") return out;
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(d)) {
    if (k === "psets") continue;
    const val = (v as any)?.value ?? v;
    if (val == null) continue;
    if (typeof val === "object") continue;
    out[k] = String(val);
  }
  const psets = d.psets;
  if (psets && typeof psets === "object") {
    for (const [psName, props] of Object.entries(psets)) {
      for (const [pk, pv] of Object.entries(props as any)) {
        const val = (pv as any)?.value ?? pv;
        if (val == null) continue;
        if (typeof val === "object") continue;
        out[`${psName}.${pk}`] = String(val);
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

async function getElementPropertiesTool(args: Record<string, any>): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const modelId = String(args.modelId ?? "");
  const localId = Number(args.localId);
  if (!modelId || !Number.isFinite(localId)) {
    return { ok: false, error: "modelId and localId are required" };
  }
  const model = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
  if (!model) return { ok: false, error: `Model "${modelId}" not loaded` };
  try {
    const data = await (model as any).getItemsData([localId], {
      attributesDefault: true,
      psetsDefault: true,
    });
    return { ok: true, data: flattenData((data as any[])?.[0] ?? {}) };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
  }
}

function getProp(flat: Record<string, string>, name: string): string | undefined {
  if (flat[name] != null) return flat[name];
  const lower = name.toLowerCase();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(flat)) {
    if (k.toLowerCase() === lower) return v;
    const bare = k.includes(".") ? k.split(".").pop()! : k;
    if (bare.toLowerCase() === lower) return v;
  }
  return undefined;
}

function matchFilter(actual: string | undefined, op: string, expected: any): boolean {
  if (actual == null) return false;
  switch (op) {
    case "eq": return actual.toLowerCase() === String(expected).toLowerCase();
    case "neq": return actual.toLowerCase() !== String(expected).toLowerCase();
    case "contains": return actual.toLowerCase().includes(String(expected).toLowerCase());
    case "gt": return parseFloat(actual) > Number(expected);
    case "gte": return parseFloat(actual) >= Number(expected);
    case "lt": return parseFloat(actual) < Number(expected);
    case "lte": return parseFloat(actual) <= Number(expected);
    default: return false;
  }
}

async function queryElementsTool(args: Record<string, any>): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const category = String(args.category ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!category) return { ok: false, error: "Missing category" };
  const modelId = args.modelId ? String(args.modelId) : null;
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit) || 200, 500);
  const rawFilters = (args.filters ?? {}) as Record<string, any>;

  const filters: { name: string; op: string; value: any }[] = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(rawFilters)) {
    if (v && typeof v === "object" && "op" in v) {
      filters.push({ name: k, op: String(v.op), value: (v as any).value });
    } else {
      filters.push({ name: k, op: "eq", value: v });
    }
  }

  const hits: { modelId: string; localId: number; name: string; category: string }[] = [];

  for (const [mid, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    if (modelId && mid !== modelId) continue;
    let cats: Record<string, number[]> = {};
    try { cats = await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]); } catch { continue; }
    const ids: number[] = [];
    for (const [cat, list] of Object.entries(cats ?? {})) {
      const upper = String(cat).toUpperCase();
      if (upper === category || upper.startsWith(category)) {
        for (const id of (list as number[]) ?? []) ids.push(id);
      }
    }
    if (!ids.length) continue;

    let data: any[] = [];
    try {
      data = await (model as any).getItemsData(ids, {
        attributesDefault: true,
        psetsDefault: filters.length > 0,
      });
    } catch { /* */ }

    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
      if (hits.length >= limit) break;
      const d = (data as any[])?.[i] ?? {};
      const name = String(d?.Name?.value ?? d?.ObjectType?.value ?? `#${ids[i]}`);
      if (!filters.length) {
        hits.push({ modelId: mid, localId: ids[i], name, category });
        continue;
      }
      const flat = flattenData(d);
      let pass = true;
      for (const f of filters) {
        if (!matchFilter(getProp(flat, f.name), f.op, f.value)) { pass = false; break; }
      }
      if (pass) hits.push({ modelId: mid, localId: ids[i], name, category });
    }
    if (hits.length >= limit) break;
  }

  return { ok: true, data: { count: hits.length, category, filters, limit, elements: hits } };
}

   Analysis

async function runClashTestTool(_args: Record<string, any>): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const clash = services.tryUse("clash");
  if (!clash) return { ok: false, error: "Clash module not loaded" };
  try {
    await clash.run?.();
    return { ok: true, data: { clashes: clash.getClashCount?.() ?? 0 } };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
  }
}

async function summarizeClashesTool(): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const clash = services.tryUse("clash");
  if (!clash) return { ok: false, error: "Clash module not loaded" };
  const list = clash.listClashes?.() ?? [];
  if (!list.length) {
    return { ok: true, data: { total: 0, clusters: [], note: "No clash results in memory" } };
  }
  const byKind: Record<string, number> = {};
  const clusters = new Map<string, { aCat: string; bCat: string; count: number; kind: string }>();
  for (const c of list) {
    byKind[c.kind] = (byKind[c.kind] ?? 0) + 1;
    const key = `${c.a.cat}|${c.b.cat}|${c.kind}`;
    const e = clusters.get(key);
    if (e) e.count++;
    else clusters.set(key, { aCat: c.a.cat, bCat: c.b.cat, count: 1, kind: c.kind });
  }
  const top = [...clusters.values()].sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count).slice(0, 10);
  return { ok: true, data: { total: list.length, byKind, topClusters: top } };
}

async function semanticSearchTool(args: Record<string, any>): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const query = String(args.query ?? "").trim();
  if (!query) return { ok: false, error: "Query is required" };
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit) || 20, 100);
  try {
    const mod: any = await import("./ai-embeddings");
    const stats = await mod.getIndexStats();
    if (!stats.total) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error:
          "Semantic index is empty. Call build_semantic_index first, or " +
          "ask the user to build it from the settings panel.",
      };
    }
    const hits = await mod.semanticSearch(query, limit);
    return { ok: true, data: { query, count: hits.length, hits } };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error:
        `Semantic search unavailable: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : err}. ` +
        `Ensure src/features/ai-embeddings.ts exists.`,
    };
  }
}

async function buildSemanticIndexTool(args: Record<string, any>): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const modelId = args.modelId ? String(args.modelId) : undefined;
  const maxPerModel = args.maxPerModel ? Number(args.maxPerModel) : undefined;
  try {
    const mod: any = await import("./ai-embeddings");
    const cfg = mod.loadEmbeddingConfig();
    let lastPhase = "";
    await mod.buildIndex({
      cfg,
      modelIds: modelId ? [modelId] : undefined,
      maxPerModel,
      onProgress: (p: any) => { lastPhase = p.phase; },
    });
    const stats = await mod.getIndexStats();
    return { ok: true, data: { ...stats, lastPhase } };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error:
        `Semantic index build failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : err}. ` +
        `Ensure src/features/ai-embeddings.ts exists.`,
    };
  }
}

async function runScheduleTool(args: Record<string, any>): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const templateId = String(args.templateId ?? "");
  const maxRows = Math.min(Number(args.maxRows) || 50, 500);
  if (!templateId) return { ok: false, error: "Missing templateId" };

  try {
    const tplMod: any = await import("../modules/schedules/schedule-templates");
    const genMod: any = await import("../modules/schedules/schedule-generator");

    const tpl = tplMod.getTemplate(templateId);
    if (!tpl) {
      const available = tplMod.BUILT_IN_TEMPLATES.map((t: any) => t.id).join(", ");
      return { ok: false, error: `No template with id "${templateId}". Available: ${available}` };
    }

    const run = await genMod.runSchedule(tpl);
    const dataRows = run.rows.filter((r: any) => !r.subtotal);
    const groupRows = run.rows.filter((r: any) => r.subtotal);

    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        template: tpl.name,
        templateId,
        totalRows: dataRows.length,
        totalGroups: groupRows.length,
        totals: run.totals,
        sampleRows: dataRows.slice(0, maxRows).map((r: any) => r.values),
        sampleGroupRows: groupRows.slice(0, 30).map((r: any) => ({
          path: r.groupPath,
          depth: r.depth,
          subtotals: r.subtotalValues,
          label: r.values,
        })),
      },
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error:
        `Schedule run failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : err}. ` +
        `Ensure the schedule modules exist and export runSchedule.`,
    };
  }
}

async function scheduleDiffTool(): Promise<ToolResult> {
  try {
    const diffMod: any = await import("../modules/schedules/schedule-diff");
    const schedules = (ctx.features as any).schedules;
    if (!schedules?.getDefinition) {
      return { ok: false, error: "Schedules panel not loaded" };
    }
    const def = schedules.getDefinition();
    const snaps = diffMod.listSnapshots(def.id);
    if (!snaps.length) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        data: {
          note:
            "No snapshots for the current schedule yet. The user needs to " +
            "click 'Snapshot' in the Schedules panel first.",
        },
      };
    }
    const diff = schedules.diffLatest?.();
    if (!diff) return { ok: false, error: "Could not compute diff" };
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        snapshotLabel: diff.snapshotLabel,
        takenAt: diff.snapshotAt,
        added: diff.added.length,
        removed: diff.removed.length,
        changed: diff.changed.length,
        unchanged: diff.unchanged,
        summary: diffMod.summarizeDiff(diff),
      },
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error:
        `Schedule diff unavailable: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : err}. ` +
        `Ensure schedule-diff.ts exists.`,
    };
  }
}

async function createScheduleTool(args: Record<string, any>): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const name = String(args.name ?? "").trim();
  if (!name) return { ok: false, error: "Name is required" };
  try {
    const builder: any = await import("../modules/schedules/schedule-builder");
    const store: any = await import("../modules/schedules/schedule-store");

    const spec: any = {
      name,
      category: args.category ? String(args.category) : null,
      columns: Array.isArray(args.columns) ? args.columns.map(String) : undefined,
      grouping: Array.isArray(args.grouping) ? args.grouping.map(String) : undefined,
      sortBy: args.sortBy ? String(args.sortBy) : undefined,
      useCostData: args.useCostData !== false,
      useLiveQuantities: args.useLiveQuantities !== false,
    };

    const def = builder.buildSchedule(spec);
    const stored = store.saveSchedule(def);

    try {
      const panel = (ctx.features as any).schedules;
      if (panel?.load) panel.load(stored.id);
    } catch { /* */ }

    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        id: stored.id,
        name: stored.name,
        category: stored.category,
        columns: stored.columns.map((c: any) => c.key),
        grouping: stored.grouping?.map((g: any) => g.key) ?? [],
        saved: true,
      },
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error:
        `Could not create schedule: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : err}. ` +
        `Ensure schedule-builder.ts and schedule-store.ts exist.`,
    };
  }
}

async function runSavedScheduleTool(args: Record<string, any>): Promise<ToolResult> {
  const id = String(args.id ?? "");
```

```ts
/**
 * Align Tool - Revit-style alignment of authored elements.
 *
 * Aligns selected elements to a target edge / point / ref plane along
 * X, Z (plan) or Y (elevation). Operates on AuthoredElement params
 * (start/end/point) without requiring full geometry rebuild mid-drag.
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { notify } from "../core/notify";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

export type AlignAxis = "x" | "y" | "z";
export type AlignMode = "min" | "max" | "center";

interface Alignable {
  id: string;
  getBounds: () => { min: { x: number; y: number; z: number }; max: { x: number; y: number; z: number } } | null;
  applyDelta: (dx: number, dy: number, dz: number) => void;
}

function getAuthoring(): Any | null {
  return (ctx.features as Any)?.authoring ?? (window as Any).__obsAuthoring ?? null;
}

function getSelectionIds(): string[] {
  const sel = (ctx.features as Any)?.selection;
  if (sel && typeof sel.getSelectedIds === "function") {
    try { return sel.getSelectedIds() ?? []; } catch { /* */ }
  }
  if (sel && typeof sel.ids === "function") {
    try { return [...sel.ids()]; } catch { /* */ }
  }
  return [];
}

function elementBounds(el: Any): { min: { x: number; y: number; z: number }; max: { x: number; y: number; z: number } } | null {
  const p = el.params ?? {};
  const elev = Number(p.elevation ?? 0);
  const h = Number(p.height ?? 0);
  const thick = Number(p.thickness ?? p.width ?? 0.2);

  if (p.start && p.end) {
    const x0 = Math.min(p.start.x, p.end.x);
    const x1 = Math.max(p.start.x, p.end.x);
    const z0 = Math.min(p.start.z ?? p.start.y, p.end.z ?? p.end.y);
    const z1 = Math.max(p.start.z ?? p.start.y, p.end.z ?? p.end.y);
    return {
      min: { x: x0 - thick / 2, y: elev, z: z0 - thick / 2 },
      max: { x: x1 + thick / 2, y: elev + h, z: z1 + thick / 2 },
    };
  }
  if (p.point) {
    const w = Number(p.width ?? thick);
    const d = Number(p.depth ?? thick);
    return {
      min: { x: p.point.x - w / 2, y: elev, z: (p.point.z ?? p.point.y) - d / 2 },
      max: { x: p.point.x + w / 2, y: elev + h, z: (p.point.z ?? p.point.y) + d / 2 },
    };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(p.polygon) && p.polygon.length) {
    let x0 = Infinity, x1 = -Infinity, z0 = Infinity, z1 = -Infinity;
    for (const pt of p.polygon) {
      x0 = Math.min(x0, pt.x);
      x1 = Math.max(x1, pt.x);
      z0 = Math.min(z0, pt.z ?? pt.y);
      z1 = Math.max(z1, pt.z ?? pt.y);
    }
    return {
      min: { x: x0, y: elev, z: z0 },
      max: { x: x1, y: elev + h, z: z1 },
    };
  }
  return null;
}

function applyDeltaToElement(el: Any, dx: number, dy: number, dz: number): void {
  const p = el.params ?? {};
  if (p.start) {
    p.start.x = (p.start.x ?? 0) + dx;
    if ("z" in p.start) p.start.z = (p.start.z ?? 0) + dz;
    else if ("y" in p.start) p.start.y = (p.start.y ?? 0) + dz;
  }
  if (p.end) {
    p.end.x = (p.end.x ?? 0) + dx;
    if ("z" in p.end) p.end.z = (p.end.z ?? 0) + dz;
    else if ("y" in p.end) p.end.y = (p.end.y ?? 0) + dz;
  }
  if (p.point) {
    p.point.x = (p.point.x ?? 0) + dx;
    if ("z" in p.point) p.point.z = (p.point.z ?? 0) + dz;
    else if ("y" in p.point) p.point.y = (p.point.y ?? 0) + dz;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(p.polygon)) {
    for (const pt of p.polygon) {
      pt.x = (pt.x ?? 0) + dx;
      if ("z" in pt) pt.z = (pt.z ?? 0) + dz;
      else if ("y" in pt) pt.y = (pt.y ?? 0) + dz;
    }
  }
  if (dy) {
    p.elevation = (Number(p.elevation) || 0) + dy;
  }
}

function edgeValue(
  b: { min: { x: number; y: number; z: number }; max: { x: number; y: number; z: number } },
  axis: AlignAxis,
  mode: AlignMode,
): number {
  const lo = b.min[axis];
  const hi = b.max[axis];
  if (mode === "min") return lo;
  if (mode === "max") return hi;
  return (lo + hi) / 2;
}

/**
 * Align selected elements to the first selected element (or to a numeric target).
 */
export function alignSelection(
  axis: AlignAxis,
  mode: AlignMode = "min",
  targetValue?: number,
): number {
  const auth = getAuthoring();
  if (!auth) {
    notify("warn", "Authoring not ready");
    return 0;
  }

  const ids = getSelectionIds();
  if (ids.length < 1) {
    notify("info", "Select elements to align");
    return 0;
  }

  const elements: Any[] =
    typeof auth.getElements === "function" ? auth.getElements() ?? [] : auth.elements ?? [];

  const selected = elements.filter((e) => ids.includes(e.id));
  if (!selected.length) return 0;

  // Target = explicit value, else first element's edge
  let target = targetValue;
  if (target == null) {
    const b0 = elementBounds(selected[0]);
    if (!b0) {
      notify("warn", "Cannot compute bounds for target");
      return 0;
    }
    target = edgeValue(b0, axis, mode);
  }

  let moved = 0;
  for (const el of selected) {
    const b = elementBounds(el);
    if (!b) continue;
    const current = edgeValue(b, axis, mode);
    const delta = target - current;
    if (Math.abs(delta) < 1e-9) continue;

    const dx = axis === "x" ? delta : 0;
    const dy = axis === "y" ? delta : 0;
    const dz = axis === "z" ? delta : 0;
    applyDeltaToElement(el, dx, dy, dz);
    moved++;
  }

  if (moved) {
    try {
      if (typeof auth.rebuildAuthored === "function") auth.rebuildAuthored();
      else if (typeof auth.rebuild === "function") auth.rebuild();
      if (typeof auth.markAuthoringDirty === "function") auth.markAuthoringDirty();
    } catch { /* */ }
    notify("success", `Aligned ${moved} element(s) on ${axis.toUpperCase()}`, { timeout: 1600 });
  }

  return moved;
}

/** Distribute selected elements evenly along an axis. */
export function distributeSelection(axis: AlignAxis): number {
  const auth = getAuthoring();
  if (!auth) return 0;
  const ids = getSelectionIds();
  if (ids.length < 3) {
    notify("info", "Select 3+ elements to distribute");
    return 0;
  }

  const elements: Any[] =
    typeof auth.getElements === "function" ? auth.getElements() ?? [] : auth.elements ?? [];
  const selected = elements
    .filter((e) => ids.includes(e.id))
    .map((e) => ({ el: e, b: elementBounds(e) }))
    .filter((x) => x.b) as Array<{ el: Any; b: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof elementBounds>> }>;

  selected.sort((a, b) => edgeValue(a.b, axis, "center") - edgeValue(b.b, axis, "center"));

  const first = edgeValue(selected[0].b, axis, "center");
  const last = edgeValue(selected[selected.length - 1].b, axis, "center");
  const step = (last - first) / (selected.length - 1);

  let moved = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < selected.length - 1; i++) {
    const desired = first + step * i;
    const current = edgeValue(selected[i].b, axis, "center");
    const delta = desired - current;
    if (Math.abs(delta) < 1e-9) continue;
    applyDeltaToElement(
      selected[i].el,
      axis === "x" ? delta : 0,
      axis === "y" ? delta : 0,
      axis === "z" ? delta : 0,
    );
    moved++;
  }

  if (moved) {
    try {
      if (typeof auth.rebuildAuthored === "function") auth.rebuildAuthored();
      else if (typeof auth.rebuild === "function") auth.rebuild();
    } catch { /* */ }
    notify("success", `Distributed ${moved} element(s)`, { timeout: 1600 });
  }
  return moved;
}

export function setupAlignTool(): void {
  (ctx.features as any).align = { alignSelection, distributeSelection };
  (window as any).__obsAlign = { alignSelection, distributeSelection };
  console.log("[align-tool] ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * App Loader — blocking progress overlay for long operations.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   appLoader.begin("Opening project…");
 *   appLoader.set("Loading models", 0.4);
 *   appLoader.set("Rebuilding", 0.8);
 *   appLoader.finish();
 *
 * While active, the overlay:
 *   • Covers the entire app with a dim + blurred backdrop
 *   • Shows a spinner + progress bar + status line
 *   • Captures pointer events on the capture phase so no underlying button
 *     can be clicked (prevents duplicate operations and hangs)
 *   • Cancels wheel/scroll outside the overlay
 *
 * The overlay is fully self-contained; nothing else in the app has to change.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { register, type AppLoaderService } from "../core/services";

class AppLoader {
  private overlay: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private messageEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private statusEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private progressEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private spinner: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private cancelBtn: HTMLButtonElement | null = null;
  private cancelCb: (() => void) | null = null;
  private active = false;

  private ensure(): void {
    if (this.overlay) return;

    const ov = document.createElement("div");
    ov.id = "obs-app-loader";
    ov.style.cssText =
      "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99998;display:none;" +
      "align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(8,9,12,.72);" +
      "backdrop-filter:blur(6px);cursor:progress;user-select:none";

    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.style.cssText =
      "width:min(440px,90vw);background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);" +
      "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:12px;" +
      "padding:22px;box-shadow:0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.65);" +
      "display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;align-items:center;" +
      "font:13px system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0)";

    const spinner = document.createElement("div");
    spinner.style.cssText =
      "width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;" +
      "border:3px solid rgba(56,189,248,.2);border-top-color:#38bdf8;" +
      "animation:obs-spin 0.9s linear infinite";
    const styleEl = document.createElement("style");
    styleEl.textContent =
      "@keyframes obs-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }";
    document.head.appendChild(styleEl);

    const message = document.createElement("div");
    message.style.cssText =
      "font-weight:700;font-size:14px;text-align:center";

    const progress = document.createElement("div");
    progress.style.cssText =
      "width:100%;height:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:3px;" +
      "overflow:hidden";
    const bar = document.createElement("div");
    bar.style.cssText =
      "height:100%;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#38bdf8,#818cf8);" +
      "transition:width .18s ease-out";
    progress.appendChild(bar);

    const status = document.createElement("div");
    status.style.cssText =
      "font-size:11.5px;opacity:.7;text-align:center;min-height:16px;line-height:1.5";

    const cancel = document.createElement("button");
    cancel.textContent = "Cancel";
    cancel.style.cssText =
      "display:none;padding:6px 14px;background:transparent;color:#fca5a5;" +
      "border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.6);border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;" +
      "font:600 11.5px system-ui;margin-top:4px";

    card.append(spinner, message, progress, status, cancel);
    ov.appendChild(card);
    document.body.appendChild(ov);

    // ── Block underlying interaction while the overlay is visible ──
    const blockEvent = (e: Event) => {
      if (!this.active) return;
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (target && this.overlay && this.overlay.contains(target)) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    };
    // Capture-phase listeners on the whole window.
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", blockEvent, true);
    window.addEventListener("mousedown", blockEvent, true);
    window.addEventListener("click", blockEvent, true);
    window.addEventListener("wheel", blockEvent, { capture: true, passive: false });
    window.addEventListener("contextmenu", blockEvent, true);
    window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (!this.active) return;
      // Allow Escape to trigger cancel.
      if (e.key === "Escape" && this.cancelCb) {
        e.preventDefault();
        try { this.cancelCb(); } catch { /* */ }
        return;
      }
      // Swallow everything else so hotkeys don't fire mid-load.
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }, true);

    this.overlay = ov;
    this.messageEl = message;
    this.statusEl = status;
    this.progressEl = bar;
    this.spinner = spinner;
    this.cancelBtn = cancel;
    cancel.onclick = () => { try { this.cancelCb?.(); } catch { /* */ } };
  }

  begin(message: string, opts: { cancellable?: boolean; onCancel?: () => void } = {}): void {
    this.ensure();
    if (!this.overlay) return;
    this.active = true;
    if (this.messageEl) this.messageEl.textContent = message;
    if (this.statusEl) this.statusEl.textContent = "";
    if (this.progressEl) this.progressEl.style.width = "0%";
    if (this.cancelBtn) {
      this.cancelBtn.style.display = opts.cancellable ? "inline-block" : "none";
    }
    this.cancelCb = opts.onCancel ?? null;
    this.overlay.style.display = "flex";

    // Block the ribbon tabs and any hover state that could interfere.
    try { (ctx.rightHost as HTMLElement).style.pointerEvents = "none"; } catch { /* */ }
  }

  set(status: string, progress?: number): void {
    if (!this.active) return;
    if (this.statusEl) this.statusEl.textContent = status;
    if (this.progressEl && typeof progress === "number") {
      const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progress * 100));
      this.progressEl.style.width = `${pct}%`;
    }
  }

  finish(): void {
    if (!this.overlay) return;
    this.active = false;
    this.overlay.style.display = "none";
    try { (ctx.rightHost as HTMLElement).style.pointerEvents = ""; } catch { /* */ }
  }

  isActive(): boolean {
    return this.active;
  }
}

export const appLoader = new AppLoader();

export function setupAppLoader(): void {
  // Pre-warm the DOM so the first show is instant.
  (appLoader as any).ensure?.();
  const svc: AppLoaderService = {
    begin: (msg, opts) => appLoader.begin(msg, opts),
    set: (s, p) => appLoader.set(s, p),
    finish: () => appLoader.finish(),
    isActive: () => appLoader.isActive(),
  };
  ctx.features.appLoader = svc;
  register("appLoader", svc);
  console.log("[app-loader] ready");
}
```

```ts
// openbim-fix:v3:applied -- do not re-apply the earlier fix scripts
/**
 * Authoring v6 — hosted doors & windows + AccuDraw + property palette sync
 * + auto-fittings at chain bends.
 *
 * New in this revision:
 *   - chainStartDir tracks the direction of the last completed segment;
 *     when the next segment changes direction, a fitting is spawned at
 *     the bend for MEP types (duct, pipe, cable-tray, conduit).
 *   - buildFitting() constructs the elbow geometry — rectangular profiles
 *     use a lofted quad strip, circular profiles use TubeGeometry.
 *   - selectAllAuthored() is exported so select-all.ts can select both
 *     fragment and authored elements in one call.
 *   - Property palette state is published via onAuthoringChange.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { register, type AuthoringService } from "../core/services";
import { inputRouter, type Gesture, type Mods } from "../core/input-router";
import { notify } from "../core/notify";

  AuthoredElement,

  LevelDatum,
  Vec2,
  WindowPanelType,
} from "../modules/projects/types";

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Types
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
type Tool =
  | "select" | "move" | "copy" | "rotate" | "mirror" | "array" | "offset"
  | "wall" | "slab" | "column" | "beam" | "brace" | "truss" | "footing" | "strip" | "mline"
  | "duct" | "pipe" | "cable-tray" | "conduit" | "equipment"
  | "door" | "window"
  | "grid" | "level";

interface GripSpec {
  elementId: string;
  kind: "start" | "end" | "vertex" | "point" | "hosted-offset";
  vertexIndex?: number;
  position: THREE.Vector3;
  mesh: THREE.Mesh;
}

interface WallOpening {
  offset: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  sill: number;
}

type PendingOp =
  | { kind: "none" }
  | { kind: "move-copy"; mode: "move" | "copy"; id: string | null; base: THREE.Vector3 | null }
  | { kind: "rotate"; ids: string[]; center: THREE.Vector3 | null; ref: THREE.Vector3 | null }
  | { kind: "mirror"; ids: string[]; axisA: THREE.Vector3 | null; axisB: THREE.Vector3 | null }
  | { kind: "array"; ids: string[]; mode: "linear" | "radial"; base: THREE.Vector3 | null }
  | { kind: "offset"; id: string | null; base: THREE.Vector3 | null; side: 1 | -1 | null };

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// State
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
let activeTool: Tool | null = null;
let level = 0;
let activeLevelId: string | null = null;
let activeFamilyId: string | null = null;
let activeFamilyTypeId: string | null = null;

const selectedIds = new Set<string>();
const elements: AuthoredElement[] = [];
let grids: GridDatum[] = [];
let levels: LevelDatum[] = [];
let gridIdx = 0;
let levelIdx = 0;
const counters: Record<string, number> = {};

const group = new THREE.Group();
const datumGroup = new THREE.Group();
const previewGroup = new THREE.Group();
const gripGroup = new THREE.Group();

let chainStart: THREE.Vector3 | null = null;
let chainStartDir: number | null = null;   // ← direction of last completed segment
let poly: THREE.Vector3[] = [];
let pendingOp: PendingOp = { kind: "none" };

let preview: THREE.Object3D | null = null;
let polyLine: THREE.Line | null = null;
let polyStartMarker: THREE.Mesh | null = null;

let gripDrag: {
  grip: GripSpec;
  snapshot: AuthoredElement["params"];
  original: THREE.Vector3;
} | null = null;

let lastSnapValid = false;
let lastSnapResult: import("./snapping").SnapResult | null = null;

let hoveredWall: { wallId: string; offset: number; point: THREE.Vector3 } | null = null;

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Palette state — defaults per element type + current palette target.
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
type PaletteTarget =
  | { mode: "defaults"; type: ElementType }
  | { mode: "edit"; elementId: string; type: ElementType }
  | null;

interface TypeDefaults {
  params: Record<string, any>;
  properties: Record<string, any>;
  name?: string;
  color?: string;
}

const typeDefaults = new Map<string, TypeDefaults>();
let paletteTarget: PaletteTarget = null;
const authoringListeners = new Set<() => void>();

function notifyAuthoringChange(): void {
  for (const cb of authoringListeners) {
    try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
  }
}

export function onAuthoringChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
  authoringListeners.add(cb);
  return () => authoringListeners.delete(cb);
}

export function getTypeDefaults(type: string): TypeDefaults {
  let d = typeDefaults.get(type);
  if (!d) {
    const defaults = DEFAULTS[type] ?? { height: 1, thickness: 0.2 };
    d = {
      params: { ...defaults },
      properties: {},
      color: COLORS[type] ?? "#cccccc",
    };
    typeDefaults.set(type, d);
  }
  return d;
}

export function setTypeDefault(
  type: string,
  target: "params" | "properties" | "root",
  key: string,
  value: any,
): void {
  const d = getTypeDefaults(type);
  if (target === "params") d.params[key] = value;
  else if (target === "properties") d.properties[key] = value;
  else if (key === "name") d.name = value;
  else if (key === "color") d.color = value;
  typeDefaults.set(type, d);
  notifyAuthoringChange();
}

export function getPaletteTarget(): PaletteTarget {
  return paletteTarget;
}

export function setPaletteTarget(t: PaletteTarget): void {
  paletteTarget = t;
  notifyAuthoringChange();
}

export function markAuthoringDirty(): void {
  markDirty();
}

// Utilities
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const uid = () =>
  (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ??
  `el-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;

const snap = (v: number, step = 0.01) => Math.round(v / step) * step;
const cap = (s: string) => s[0].toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);

function nextName(type: string) {
  counters[type] = (counters[type] ?? 0) + 1;
  return `${cap(type)} ${String(counters[type]).padStart(3, "0")}`;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/* ── Wall placement options (Revit Modify | Place Wall) ───────────────── */
export type WallLocationLine =
  | "wall-centerline"
  | "core-centerline"
  | "finish-exterior"
  | "finish-interior"
  | "core-exterior"
  | "core-interior";

export type WallJoinStatus = "allow" | "disallow" | "chamfer" | "extended" | "butt";

let wallLocationLine: WallLocationLine = "wall-centerline";
let wallChain = true;
let wallOffset = 0; // m additional offset
let wallJoinStatus: WallJoinStatus = "allow";
let wallRadius = 0; // for future arc walls
/** Last linear segment from plan (for auto MEP fittings on chain). */
let lastPlanLinear: {
  type: string;
  end: [number, number];
  dir: number;
  thickness: number;
  height: number;
  elevation: number;
  id: string;
} | null = null;
export function clearLastPlanLinear() { lastPlanLinear = null; }


export function getWallLocationLine() { return wallLocationLine; }
export function setWallLocationLine(v: WallLocationLine) { wallLocationLine = v; }
export function getWallChain() { return wallChain; }
export function setWallChain(v: boolean) { wallChain = v; }
export function getWallOffset() { return wallOffset; }
export function setWallOffset(v: number) { wallOffset = v; }
export function getWallJoinStatus() { return wallJoinStatus; }
export function setWallJoinStatus(v: WallJoinStatus) { wallJoinStatus = v; }
export function getWallRadius() { return wallRadius; }
export function setWallRadius(v: number) { wallRadius = v; }

/** Shift start/end so the drawn line is the selected location line. */
export function applyWallLocationOffset(
  x1: number, z1: number, x2: number, z2: number, thickness: number,
): { start: [number, number]; end: [number, number] } {
  const dx = x2 - x1, dz = z2 - z1;
  const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
  const nx = -dz / L, nz = dx / L; // left normal
  const t = thickness;
  let shift = 0;
  switch (wallLocationLine) {
    case "wall-centerline":
    case "core-centerline":
      shift = 0; break;
    case "finish-exterior":
    case "core-exterior":
      shift = t / 2; break;
    case "finish-interior":
    case "core-interior":
      shift = -t / 2; break;
  }
  shift += wallOffset;
  return {
    start: [x1 + nx * shift, z1 + nz * shift],
    end: [x2 + nx * shift, z2 + nz * shift],
  };
}

/**
 * Revit Join Status at a corner.
 * IMPORTANT: location-line endpoints must NOT shift for Allow/Disallow —
 * that caused walls to jog. Only snap both ends to the shared corner.
 * Extended/Chamfer may extend slightly for special cases.
 */
/**
 * Pin two wall location-line ends to a shared corner (for chain drawing only).
 * Does not skew walls — only moves the listed endpoints to the corner point.
 */
export function applyWallJoinAtCorner(
  prev: { start: [number, number]; end: [number, number] },
  next: { start: [number, number]; end: [number, number] },
  _thickness: number,
  _status: WallJoinStatus = wallJoinStatus,
): void {
  // Shared corner = exact meeting point of the two location lines
  const cx = next.start[0];
  const cz = next.start[1];
  prev.end = [cx, cz];
  next.start = [cx, cz];
}

/**
 * Project point P onto segment AB. Returns { point, t, dist }.
 */
function projectOntoSegment(
  px: number, pz: number,
  ax: number, az: number,
  bx: number, bz: number,
): { x: number; z: number; t: number; dist: number } {
  const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
  const L2 = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1;
  let t = ((px - ax) * dx + (pz - az) * dz) / L2;
  t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
  const x = ax + t * dx, z = az + t * dz;
  return { x, z, t, dist: Math.hypot(px - x, pz - z) };
}

/**
 * Revit-style join for a NEWLY placed wall only.
 *
 * CRITICAL RULE (matches Revit): existing walls are NEVER moved or rotated.
 * Only the new wall's start/end may snap onto:
 *   - an existing wall endpoint (corner / L-join)
 *   - a point on an existing wall centerline (T-join)
 *
 * Centerline is used (location line). Thickness is visual only.
 */
export function autoJoinWallToNeighbors(wallId: string): void {
  const wall = elements.find((e) => e.id === wallId);
  if (!wall || wall.type !== "wall" || !wall.params.start || !wall.params.end) return;

  const thick = wall.params.thickness ?? 0.2;
  // Snap tolerance ≈ half thickness + small slack (Revit endpoint snap feel)
  const endTol = Math.max(0.12, thick * 0.85);
  const faceTol = Math.max(0.14, thick * 0.95);

  let changed = false;
  const trySnapEnd = (which: "start" | "end"): void => {
    const pt = which === "start" ? wall.params.start! : wall.params.end!;
    let best: { x: number; z: number; score: number } | null = null;

    for (const other of elements) {
      if (other.id === wallId || other.type !== "wall") continue;
      if (!other.params.start || !other.params.end) continue;
      // Skip if other is extremely short
      const [ax, az] = other.params.start;
      const [bx, bz] = other.params.end;
      if (Math.hypot(bx - ax, bz - az) < 0.02) continue;

      // Prefer endpoint snaps (clean L/corner)
      for (const ep of [other.params.start!, other.params.end!] as [number, number][]) {
        const d = Math.hypot(pt[0] - ep[0], pt[1] - ep[1]);
        if (d <= endTol && (!best || d < best.score)) {
          best = { x: ep[0], z: ep[1], score: d };
        }
      }
      // Else T-join onto centerline (only if closer to face than any end)
      const proj = projectOntoSegment(pt[0], pt[1], ax, az, bx, bz);
      if (proj.t > 0.02 && proj.t < 0.98 && proj.dist <= faceTol) {
        if (!best || proj.dist < best.score) {
          best = { x: proj.x, z: proj.z, score: proj.dist };
        }
      }
    }

    if (!best) return;
    // Only move THIS wall — never the neighbor
    if (which === "start") wall.params.start = [best.x, best.z];
    else wall.params.end = [best.x, best.z];
    changed = true;
  };

  trySnapEnd("start");
  trySnapEnd("end");

  // Guard: do not collapse the wall to a point
  const [sx, sz] = wall.params.start!;
  const [ex, ez] = wall.params.end!;
  if (Math.hypot(ex - sx, ez - sz) < 0.05) {
    // Revert is not tracked here; skip if degenerate — caller should avoid
    return;
  }

  if (changed) {
    rebuild();
    markDirty();
    notifyAuthoringChange();
  }
}

// Geometry helpers
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function memberMesh(a: THREE.Vector3, b: THREE.Vector3, w: number, h: number, mat: THREE.Material): THREE.Mesh {
  const len = a.distanceTo(b);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(len, h, w), mat);
  mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(b, a).normalize();
  mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), dir);
  return mesh;
}

function buildTruss(el: AuthoredElement): THREE.Group {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  const [ax, az] = el.params.start!;
  const [bx, bz] = el.params.end!;
  const t = Math.max(el.params.thickness, 0.03);
  const H = el.params.height;
  const panels = Math.max(2, Number(el.properties?.panels ?? 4));
  const A = new THREE.Vector3(ax, el.params.elevation, az);
  const B = new THREE.Vector3(bx, el.params.elevation, bz);
  const L = A.distanceTo(B);
  if (L < 0.5) return g;
  const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(el.color || COLORS.truss) });
  const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  const M = A.clone().add(B).multiplyScalar(0.5).add(up.clone().multiplyScalar(H));
  g.add(memberMesh(A, B, t, t, mat));
  g.add(memberMesh(A, M, t, t, mat));
  g.add(memberMesh(M, B, t, t, mat));
  const dir = B.clone().sub(A).normalize();
  const topAt = (x: number) => {
    const half = L / 2;
    const base = A.clone().add(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(x));
    const h = H * (1 - Math.abs(x - half) / half);
    return base.add(up.clone().multiplyScalar(h));
  };
  const bottomAt = (x: number) => A.clone().add(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(x));
  for (let i = 1; i < panels; i++) {
    const x = (L * i) / panels;
    const h = H * (1 - Math.abs(x - L / 2) / (L / 2));
    if (h > 0.05) {
      const p = bottomAt(x).add(up.clone().multiplyScalar(h / 2));
      const post = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(t, h, t), mat);
      post.position.copy(p);
      g.add(post);
    }
    if (i < panels - 1) {
      const x2 = (L * (i + 1)) / panels;
      const diag = i % 2 === 0
        ? memberMesh(bottomAt(x), topAt(x2), t * 0.8, t * 0.8, mat)
        : memberMesh(topAt(x), bottomAt(x2), t * 0.8, t * 0.8, mat);
      g.add(diag);
    }
  }
  return g;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Fittings — auto-generated elbows at chain bends
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/**
 * Insert a fitting at a chain bend.
 * Copies the parent's cross-section and stores the incoming / outgoing
 * direction angles so the geometry can be built as a proper swept elbow.
 */
export type FittingKind = "elbow" | "tee" | "cross" | "transition" | "cap" | "union" | "wye";

function spawnFitting(
  parentType: ElementType,
  parentEl: AuthoredElement | null,
  bendX: number,
  bendZ: number,
  angleIn: number,
  angleOut: number,
  kind: FittingKind = "elbow",
  size?: { thickness?: number; height?: number; elevation?: number; bendRadius?: number },
): AuthoredElement | null {
  if (!FITTED_TYPES.has(parentType) && parentType !== "fitting") return null;

  const p = parentEl?.params;
  const thick = size?.thickness ?? p?.thickness ?? 0.3;
  const height = size?.height ?? p?.height ?? thick;
  const elev = size?.elevation ?? p?.elevation ?? level;
  const fitting: AuthoredElement = {
    id: uid(),
    type: "fitting",
    name: `${cap(parentType)} ${kind} ${String((counters.fitting ?? 0) + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`,
    color: parentEl?.color || COLORS[parentType] || "#cccccc",
    params: {
      point: [bendX, bendZ],
      height,
      thickness: thick,
      depth: p?.depth,
      elevation: elev,
      angleIn,
      angleOut,
      bendRadius: size?.bendRadius, 
      parentType: parentType as any,
      fittingKind: kind as any,
    },
    properties: {
      ifcType: (() => {
        const root = parentType === "pipe" ? "IfcPipeFitting" :
          parentType === "cable-tray" ? "IfcCableCarrierFitting" :
          parentType === "conduit" ? "IfcCableCarrierFitting" :
          "IfcDuctFitting";
        const suffix = kind === "elbow" ? "Elbow" : kind === "tee" ? "Tee" : kind === "cross" ? "Cross" :
          kind === "transition" ? "Transition" : kind === "cap" ? "EndCap" : kind === "wye" ? "Junction" : "Union";
        return `${root}/${suffix}`;
      })(),
    },
  };
  counters.fitting = (counters.fitting ?? 0) + 1;

  history.exec({
    label: `Create ${cap(parentType)} fitting`,
    apply: () => {
      if (!elements.includes(fitting)) elements.push(fitting);
      rebuild();
      markDirty();
    },
    revert: () => {
      const i = elements.indexOf(fitting);
      if (i >= 0) elements.splice(i, 1);
      rebuild();
      markDirty();
    },
  });
  return fitting;
}

/**
 * Build the swept elbow geometry.
 * Rectangular profiles use a lofted quad strip; circular profiles use a
 * Tube along a quadratic Bezier from the incoming to the outgoing tangent.
 */
function buildFitting(el: AuthoredElement): THREE.Object3D | null {
  const p = el.params;
  if (!p.point) return null;
  const aIn = p.angleIn ?? 0;
  const aOut = p.angleOut ?? Math.PI / 2;
  const parentType = (p.parentType as string) || "duct";
  const isRound = parentType === "pipe" || parentType === "conduit";
  const kind = String((p as any).fittingKind ?? el.properties?.fittingKind ?? "elbow");
  const cx = p.point[0];
  const cz = p.point[1];
  const yCenter = p.elevation + (isRound ? 0 : p.height / 2);
  const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({
    color: new THREE.Color(el.color || COLORS[parentType] || "#38bdf8"),
  });
  const r = Math.max(Number(p.bendRadius ?? ((isRound ? p.thickness : Math.max(p.thickness, p.height)) / 2)), 0.04);

  // ── Revit-style MEP fittings ──────────────────────────────────────────
  // Tee / Cross / Wye: continuous body + branch arms matching duct/pipe profile
  if (kind === "tee" || kind === "cross" || kind === "wye") {
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    const w = isRound ? r * 1.85 : Math.max(p.thickness, 0.08);
    const h = isRound ? r * 1.85 : Math.max(p.height, 0.08);
    // Center body (junction cube / sphere)
    const body = new THREE.Mesh(
      isRound
        ? new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 1.05, 20, 16)
        : new THREE.BoxGeometry(w * 1.15, h * 1.15, w * 1.15),
      mat.clone(),
    );
    body.position.set(cx, yCenter, cz);
    body.userData.elementId = el.id;
    g.add(body);

    const armLen = Math.max(r * 2.4, w * 1.6);
    const placeArm = (angle: number) => {
      const ax = Math.cos(angle);
      const az = Math.sin(angle);
      let mesh: THREE.Mesh;
      if (isRound) {
        mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r * 0.95, r * 0.95, armLen, 20), mat.clone());
        // Cylinder default Y-up → align to horizontal direction (ax, 0, az)
        mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
          new THREE.Vector3(ax, 0, az).normalize(),
        );
      } else {
        mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(armLen, h, w), mat.clone());
        mesh.rotation.y = -angle;
      }
      mesh.position.set(cx + ax * armLen * 0.45, yCenter, cz + az * armLen * 0.45);
      mesh.userData.elementId = el.id;
      g.add(mesh);
    };

    // Main run through + branch (Revit duct/pipe fitting orientation)
    placeArm(aIn);
    placeArm(aIn + Math.PI);
    placeArm(aOut);
    if (kind === "cross") {
      placeArm(aOut + Math.PI);
    } else if (kind === "wye") {
      // 45° branch between main and branch
      placeArm((aIn + aOut) / 2);
    }
    g.userData.elementId = el.id;
    g.userData.baseColor = el.color || COLORS[parentType] || "#38bdf8";
    return g;
  }
  if (kind === "cap") {
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      isRound
        ? new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 1.05, 20, 14)
        : new THREE.BoxGeometry(Math.max(p.thickness, 0.08), Math.max(p.height, 0.08), r * 0.7),
      mat,
    );
    mesh.position.set(cx, yCenter, cz);
    mesh.userData.elementId = el.id;
    return mesh;
  }
  if (kind === "transition" || kind === "union") {
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      isRound
        ? new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r * 0.55, r * 1.15, r * 2.8, 20)
        : new THREE.BoxGeometry(r * 2.8, p.height, p.thickness * 1.15),
      mat,
    );
    mesh.position.set(cx, yCenter, cz);
    mesh.rotation.y = -aIn;
    if (isRound) {
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(aIn), 0, Math.sin(aIn)).normalize(),
      );
    }
    mesh.userData.elementId = el.id;
    return mesh;
  }

  // Elbow (default) — skip only if angles nearly equal (straight)
  if (Math.abs(((aIn - aOut + Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI)) - Math.PI) < 0.05) return null;

  const bendR = Math.max(r * 1.15, 0.06);
  const inStartX = cx - Math.cos(aIn) * bendR;
  const inStartZ = cz - Math.sin(aIn) * bendR;
  const outEndX = cx + Math.cos(aOut) * bendR;
  const outEndZ = cz + Math.sin(aOut) * bendR;

  // Smoother elbow (more segments = Revit-like curved fitting)
  const N = isRound ? 16 : 14;
  const pts: THREE.Vector3[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
    const t = i / N;
    const oneT = 1 - t;
    const x = oneT * oneT * inStartX + 2 * oneT * t * cx + t * t * outEndX;
    const z = oneT * oneT * inStartZ + 2 * oneT * t * cz + t * t * outEndZ;
    pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, yCenter, z));
  }

  if (isRound) {
    const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts);
    const geo = new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, Math.max(N, 18), Math.max(p.thickness / 2, 0.02), 18, false);
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    mesh.userData.elementId = el.id;
    mesh.userData.baseColor = el.color || COLORS[parentType] || "#38bdf8";
    return mesh;
  }

  // Rectangular: loft four corner rails along the sampled curve.
  const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  const halfW = p.thickness / 2;
  const halfH = p.height / 2;
  const rings: THREE.Vector3[][] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const t = i / N;
    const oneT = 1 - t;
    const dx = 2 * (oneT * (cx - inStartX) + t * (outEndX - cx));
    const dz = 2 * (oneT * (cz - inStartZ) + t * (outEndZ - cz));
    let tan = new THREE.Vector3(dx, 0, dz);
    if (tan.lengthSq() < 1e-9) tan.set(1, 0, 0);
    tan.normalize();

    const right = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(up, tan);
    if (right.lengthSq() < 1e-9) right.set(1, 0, 0);
    right.normalize();

    const c = pts[i];
    rings.push([
      c.clone().add(right.clone().multiplyScalar(halfW)).add(up.clone().multiplyScalar(-halfH)),
      c.clone().add(right.clone().multiplyScalar(halfW)).add(up.clone().multiplyScalar(halfH)),
      c.clone().add(right.clone().multiplyScalar(-halfW)).add(up.clone().multiplyScalar(halfH)),
```
