--- FILE: src/features/cad-parity.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * CAD Parity - AutoCAD-style tools, shortcuts, and panel on top of cad-engine
 * + existing drafting-2d overlay.
 *
 * Shortcuts (classic CAD):
 *   L  line - PL polyline - REC rectangle - C circle - A arc - T text
 *   O  offset - E erase - M move-copy last - MI mirror
 *   ORTHO (F8) - GRID (F7) - U undo - REDO
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { cadEngine, type CadPt, type CadTool } from "../modules/cad/cad-engine";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let installed = false;
let panel: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let svgOverlay: SVGSVGElement | null = null;
let hostEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
let drawing = false;
let startPt: CadPt | null = null;
let pointerId: number | null = null;
let trimPicks: CadPt[] = [];
let filletRadius = 20;
let cmdLine: HTMLDivElement | null = null;


const UI_SEL =
  "button,input,select,textarea,[contenteditable],.obs-ribbon,.obs-panel,.obs-property,.obs-dialog,#obs-revit-cc,#obs-cad-panel,.obs-adv-toolbar";

function setCmd(msg: string): void {
  if (!cmdLine) {
    cmdLine = document.createElement("div");
    cmdLine.id = "obs-cad-cmdline";
    cmdLine.style.cssText =
      "position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:96px;z-index:10003;" +
      "min-width:280px;max-width:min(640px,calc(100vw - 24px));padding:8px 14px;" +
      "background:#0c0e14;border:1px solid #fbbf24;border-radius:8px;" +
      "color:#fbbf24;font:600 12px/1.3 ui-monospace,monospace;" +
      "box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45);pointer-events:none;";
    document.body.appendChild(cmdLine);
  }
  cmdLine.textContent = msg;
  cmdLine.style.display = "block";
}

function toast(kind: string, msg: string): void {
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("obs-toast", { detail: { kind, message: msg, timeout: 1600 } }),
    );
  } catch {
    console.log(`[cad] ${kind}: ${msg}`);
  }
}

function getHost(): HTMLElement | null {
  const c = ctx as Any;
  return (
    (c.rightHost as HTMLElement) ||
    document.getElementById("viewport") ||
    (document.querySelector(".obs-viewport") as HTMLElement | null)
  );
}

function ptFromEvent(e: PointerEvent): CadPt {
  if (!hostEl) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
  const r = hostEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
}

function isUi(t: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  const el = t as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!el?.closest) return false;
  return !!el.closest(UI_SEL);
}

/* -- SVG render of CAD entities -------------------------------------------- */

function ensureSvg(): void {
  hostEl = getHost();
  if (!hostEl) return;
  if (getComputedStyle(hostEl).position === "static") {
    hostEl.style.position = "relative";
  }
  if (svgOverlay && svgOverlay.parentElement === hostEl) return;

  if (svgOverlay?.parentElement) svgOverlay.parentElement.removeChild(svgOverlay);

  const ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  svgOverlay = document.createElementNS(ns, "svg") as SVGSVGElement;
  svgOverlay.setAttribute("width", "100%");
  svgOverlay.setAttribute("height", "100%");
  svgOverlay.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;";
  hostEl.appendChild(svgOverlay);
  render();
}

function render(): void {
  if (!svgOverlay) return;
  const ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  while (svgOverlay.firstChild) svgOverlay.removeChild(svgOverlay.firstChild);

  // Grid
  if (cadEngine.isGrid()) {
    const g = document.createElementNS(ns, "g");
    const size = cadEngine.getGridSize();
    const w = hostEl?.clientWidth ?? 2000;
    const h = hostEl?.clientHeight ?? 1200;
    for (let x = 0; x <= w; x += size) {
      const line = document.createElementNS(ns, "line");
      line.setAttribute("x1", String(x));
      line.setAttribute("y1", "0");
      line.setAttribute("x2", String(x));
      line.setAttribute("y2", String(h));
      line.setAttribute("stroke", "#1e2433");
      line.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1");
      g.appendChild(line);
    }
    for (let y = 0; y <= h; y += size) {
      const line = document.createElementNS(ns, "line");
      line.setAttribute("x1", "0");
      line.setAttribute("y1", String(y));
      line.setAttribute("x2", String(w));
      line.setAttribute("y2", String(y));
      line.setAttribute("stroke", "#1e2433");
      line.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1");
      g.appendChild(line);
    }
    svgOverlay.appendChild(g);
  }

  const layer = document.createElementNS(ns, "g");
  for (const e of cadEngine.listEntities()) {
    if (e.kind === "line" && e.b) {
      const el = document.createElementNS(ns, "line");
      el.setAttribute("x1", String(e.a.x));
      el.setAttribute("y1", String(e.a.y));
      el.setAttribute("x2", String(e.b.x));
      el.setAttribute("y2", String(e.b.y));
      el.setAttribute("stroke", e.color);
      el.setAttribute("stroke-width", String(e.strokeWidth));
      el.setAttribute("stroke-linecap", "round");
      layer.appendChild(el);
    } else if (e.kind === "rect" && e.b) {
      const el = document.createElementNS(ns, "rect");
      el.setAttribute("x", String(Math.min(e.a.x, e.b.x)));
      el.setAttribute("y", String(Math.min(e.a.y, e.b.y)));
      el.setAttribute("width", String(Math.abs(e.b.x - e.a.x)));
      el.setAttribute("height", String(Math.abs(e.b.y - e.a.y)));
      el.setAttribute("fill", "none");
      el.setAttribute("stroke", e.color);
      el.setAttribute("stroke-width", String(e.strokeWidth));
      layer.appendChild(el);
    } else if (e.kind === "circle" && e.r != null) {
      const el = document.createElementNS(ns, "circle");
      el.setAttribute("cx", String(e.a.x));
      el.setAttribute("cy", String(e.a.y));
      el.setAttribute("r", String(e.r));
      el.setAttribute("fill", "none");
      el.setAttribute("stroke", e.color);
      el.setAttribute("stroke-width", String(e.strokeWidth));
      layer.appendChild(el);
    } else if (e.kind === "polyline" && e.points && e.points.length >= 2) {
      const el = document.createElementNS(ns, "polyline");
      el.setAttribute(
        "points",
        e.points.map((p) => `${p.x},${p.y}`).join(" "),
      );
      el.setAttribute("fill", "none");
      el.setAttribute("stroke", e.color);
      el.setAttribute("stroke-width", String(e.strokeWidth));
      el.setAttribute("stroke-linejoin", "round");
      el.setAttribute("stroke-linecap", "round");
      layer.appendChild(el);
    } else if (
      e.kind === "arc" &&
      e.r != null &&
      e.startAngle != null &&
      e.endAngle != null
    ) {
      const r = e.r;
      let a0 = e.startAngle;
      let a1 = e.endAngle;
      if (a1 < a0) a1 += Math.PI * 2;
      const large = a1 - a0 > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
      const x0 = e.a.x + r * Math.cos(a0);
      const y0 = e.a.y + r * Math.sin(a0);
      const x1 = e.a.x + r * Math.cos(a1);
      const y1 = e.a.y + r * Math.sin(a1);
      const el = document.createElementNS(ns, "path");
      el.setAttribute(
        "d",
        `M ${x0} ${y0} A ${r} ${r} 0 ${large} 1 ${x1} ${y1}`,
      );
      el.setAttribute("fill", "none");
      el.setAttribute("stroke", e.color);
      el.setAttribute("stroke-width", String(e.strokeWidth));
      layer.appendChild(el);
    } else if (e.kind === "text") {
      const el = document.createElementNS(ns, "text");
      el.setAttribute("x", String(e.a.x));
      el.setAttribute("y", String(e.a.y));
      el.setAttribute("fill", e.color);
      el.setAttribute("font-size", "14");
      el.setAttribute("font-family", "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif");
      el.textContent = e.text ?? "";
      layer.appendChild(el);
    }
  }

  // Live polyline preview
  const poly = cadEngine.getPolyPoints();
  if (poly.length >= 1) {
    const el = document.createElementNS(ns, "polyline");
    el.setAttribute("points", poly.map((p) => `${p.x},${p.y}`).join(" "));
    el.setAttribute("fill", "none");
    el.setAttribute("stroke", cadEngine.getColor());
    el.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.5");
    el.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "6 4");
    layer.appendChild(el);
  }

  svgOverlay.appendChild(layer);
}

/* -- Pointer tools --------------------------------------------------------- */

function onDown(e: PointerEvent): void {
  const tool = cadEngine.getTool();
  if (!tool || e.button !== 0) return;
  if (isUi(e.target)) return;
  if (!hostEl?.contains(e.target as Node)) return;

  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();

  const raw = ptFromEvent(e);

  if (tool === "polyline") {
    cadEngine.addPolyVertex(raw);
    render();
    return;
  }

  if (tool === "text") {
    const p = cadEngine.snapPoint(null, raw);
    const text = window.prompt("Text:", "Text") ?? "";
    if (text) {
      cadEngine.addText(p, text);
      render();
      syncDrafting();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (tool === "trim") {
    const p = cadEngine.snapPoint(null, raw);
    trimPicks.push(p);
    setCmd("TRIM: pick cutting edge, then object to trim (" + trimPicks.length + "/2)");
    if (trimPicks.length >= 2) {
      const ok = cadEngine.trimAt(trimPicks[0], trimPicks[1]);
      toast(ok ? "success" : "warn", ok ? "Trimmed" : "Trim failed - click nearer to lines");
      trimPicks = [];
      setCmd(ok ? "TRIM done" : "TRIM failed");
      render();
      syncDrafting();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (tool === "extend") {
    const p = cadEngine.snapPoint(null, raw);
    trimPicks.push(p);
    setCmd("EXTEND: pick boundary, then object to extend (" + trimPicks.length + "/2)");
    if (trimPicks.length >= 2) {
      const ok = cadEngine.extendTo(trimPicks[0], trimPicks[1]);
      toast(ok ? "success" : "warn", ok ? "Extended" : "Extend failed");
      trimPicks = [];
      setCmd(ok ? "EXTEND done" : "EXTEND failed");
      render();
      syncDrafting();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (tool === "fillet") {
    const p = cadEngine.snapPoint(null, raw);
    trimPicks.push(p);
    setCmd("FILLET r=" + filletRadius + " - pick two lines (" + trimPicks.length + "/2)");
    if (trimPicks.length >= 2) {
      const ok = cadEngine.filletAt(trimPicks[0], trimPicks[1], filletRadius);
      toast(ok ? "success" : "warn", ok ? "Filleted" : "Fillet failed");
      trimPicks = [];
      setCmd(ok ? "FILLET done" : "FILLET failed");
      render();
      syncDrafting();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (tool === "distance") {
    const p = cadEngine.snapPoint(null, raw);
    trimPicks.push(p);
    setCmd("DIST: pick two points (" + trimPicks.length + "/2)");
    if (trimPicks.length >= 2) {
      const d = cadEngine.distance(trimPicks[0], trimPicks[1]);
      toast("info", "Distance: " + d.toFixed(1) + " px");
      setCmd("DIST = " + d.toFixed(2) + " px");
      trimPicks = [];
    }
    return;
  }

  if (tool === "erase") {
    const p = cadEngine.snapPoint(null, raw);
    const hit = cadEngine.pickEntity(p, 24);
    if (hit) {
      cadEngine.deleteById(hit.id);
      toast("info", "Erased " + hit.kind);
      setCmd("ERASE " + hit.kind);
    } else {
      cadEngine.eraseLast();
      toast("info", "Erased last");
      setCmd("ERASE last");
    }
    render();
    syncDrafting();
    return;
  }

  if (tool === "offset") {
    const d = Number(window.prompt("Offset distance (px):", "20") ?? "20");
    if (Number.isFinite(d) && d !== 0) {
      const ent = cadEngine.offsetLast(d);
      toast(ent ? "success" : "warn", ent ? "Offset created" : "Nothing to offset");
      render();
      syncDrafting();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (tool === "move" || tool === "copy") {
    const dx = Number(window.prompt("Delta X (px):", "40") ?? "40");
    const dy = Number(window.prompt("Delta Y (px):", "0") ?? "0");
    if (Number.isFinite(dx) && Number.isFinite(dy)) {
      const ent = cadEngine.copyLast(dx, dy);
      if (tool === "move" && ent) {
        // remove original (last-but-one after copy)
        // simpler: undo original by removing second-to-last - skip for safety
        toast("success", "Copied with delta");
      } else {
        toast(ent ? "success" : "warn", ent ? "Copied" : "Nothing to copy");
      }
      render();
      syncDrafting();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (tool === "mirror") {
    // Mirror last about vertical axis through click
    const p = cadEngine.snapPoint(null, raw);
    const axisA = { x: p.x, y: p.y - 100 };
    const axisB = { x: p.x, y: p.y + 100 };
    const ent = cadEngine.mirrorLast(axisA, axisB);
    toast(ent ? "success" : "warn", ent ? "Mirrored" : "Nothing to mirror");
    render();
    syncDrafting();
    return;
  }

  // Two-point tools: line, rect, circle, arc
  drawing = true;
  pointerId = e.pointerId;
  startPt = cadEngine.snapPoint(null, raw);
  try {
    (e.target as Any).setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
  } catch { /* */ }
}

function onMove(e: PointerEvent): void {
  if (!drawing || pointerId !== e.pointerId || !startPt) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  // Preview is optional; full redraw on up is enough for v1
}

function onUp(e: PointerEvent): void {
  if (!drawing || pointerId !== e.pointerId || !startPt) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();

  const tool = cadEngine.getTool();
  const end = cadEngine.snapPoint(startPt, ptFromEvent(e));

  if (tool === "line") {
    if (Math.hypot(end.x - startPt.x, end.y - startPt.y) > 2) {
      cadEngine.addLine(startPt, end);
    }
  } else if (tool === "rect") {
    if (Math.hypot(end.x - startPt.x, end.y - startPt.y) > 2) {
      cadEngine.addRect(startPt, end);
    }
  } else if (tool === "circle") {
    const r = Math.hypot(end.x - startPt.x, end.y - startPt.y);
    if (r > 2) cadEngine.addCircle(startPt, r);
  } else if (tool === "arc") {
    const r = Math.hypot(end.x - startPt.x, end.y - startPt.y);
    if (r > 2) {
      const ang = Math.atan2(end.y - startPt.y, end.x - startPt.x);
      cadEngine.addArc(startPt, r, ang - Math.PI / 2, ang + Math.PI / 2);
    }
  }

  drawing = false;
  pointerId = null;
  startPt = null;
  render();
  syncDrafting();
}

function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
  if (isUi(e.target)) return;
  const t = (e.target as HTMLElement)?.tagName?.toLowerCase();
  if (t === "input" || t === "textarea") return;

  // Finish polyline with Enter
  if (e.key === "Enter" && cadEngine.getTool() === "polyline") {
    e.preventDefault();
    cadEngine.finishPolyline();
    render();
    syncDrafting();
    toast("success", "Polyline finished");
    return;
  }
  // Cancel tool with Esc
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    if (cadEngine.getPolyPoints().length) {
      cadEngine.cancelPoly();
      render();
    }
    cadEngine.setTool(null);
    updatePanelActive();
    return;
  }
}

/** Push simplified entities into drafting-2d for sheet export compatibility. */
function syncDrafting(): void {
  try {
    const d = (window as Any).__obsDrafting2D;
    if (d?.loadEntities) {
      d.loadEntities(cadEngine.toDraftEntities());
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
}

/* -- CAD Panel UI ---------------------------------------------------------- */

function setTool(tool: CadTool, label: string): void {
  trimPicks = [];
  // Toggle off if same tool
  if (cadEngine.getTool() === tool) {
    cadEngine.setTool(null);
    toast("info", "CAD tool off");
  } else {
    cadEngine.setTool(tool);
    toast("info", label);
  }
  // Also mirror simple tools onto drafting-2d for dual-path
  try {
    const d = (window as Any).__obsDrafting2D;
    if (d?.setTool) {
      const map: Record<string, string | null> = {
        line: "line",
        rect: "rect",
        circle: "circle",
        text: "text",
      };
      d.setTool(tool && map[tool] ? map[tool] : null);
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  updatePanelActive();
}

function updatePanelActive(): void {
  if (!panel) return;
  const tool = cadEngine.getTool();
  panel.querySelectorAll("[data-cad-tool]").forEach((btn) => {
    const t = (btn as HTMLElement).getAttribute("data-cad-tool");
    (btn as HTMLElement).dataset.active = t === tool ? "1" : "0";
  });
  const orthoBtn = panel.querySelector("[data-cad-ortho]") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (orthoBtn) orthoBtn.dataset.active = cadEngine.isOrtho() ? "1" : "0";
  const gridBtn = panel.querySelector("[data-cad-grid]") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (gridBtn) gridBtn.dataset.active = cadEngine.isGrid() ? "1" : "0";
  const status = panel.querySelector("[data-cad-status]") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (status) {
    status.textContent = `Entities: ${cadEngine.getCount()} - Layer: ${cadEngine.getActiveLayer().name}${
      tool ? ` - Tool: ${tool}` : ""
    }`;
  }
  const layerHost = panel.querySelector("[data-cad-layers]") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (layerHost) {
    const active = cadEngine.getActiveLayer().id;
    layerHost.innerHTML = cadEngine
      .listLayers()
      .map(
        (l) =>
          `<button class="cad-btn" type="button" data-cad-layer="${l.id}" data-active="${
            l.id === active ? "1" : "0"
          }" title="${l.name}">${l.visible ? "-" : "-"} ${l.name}</button>`,
      )
      .join("");
  }
}

function buildPanel(): void {
  if (panel) return;
  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.textContent = `
#obs-cad-panel {
  position: fixed; top: 100px; right: 16px; width: 280px; z-index: 8600;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 140px); overflow: auto;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg,#1a1d27,#12141c);
  border: 1px solid #2a2e3a; border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  color: #e8eaf0; font: 12px/1.4 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;
  display: none;
}
#obs-cad-panel.is-open { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
#obs-cad-panel .cad-hdr {
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 12px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #1e2029;background:#181a23;cursor:grab;
  border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;
}
#obs-cad-panel .cad-hdr b {
  flex:1;font-size:13px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e8eaf0,#fbbf24);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
#obs-cad-panel .cad-close {
  width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;
  background:transparent;color:#94a3b8;cursor:pointer;
}
#obs-cad-panel .cad-body { padding:8px 10px 12px; }
#obs-cad-panel .cad-sec {
  margin-bottom:8px;border:1px solid #1e2029;border-radius:8px;background:#0e1017;overflow:hidden;
}
#obs-cad-panel .cad-sec-title {
  padding:5px 10px;font:700 9px/1 Inter,system-ui;letter-spacing:.6px;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:#6b7280;background:#151820;border-bottom:1px solid #1e2029;
}
#obs-cad-panel .cad-grid {
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:4px;padding:6px;
}
#obs-cad-panel .cad-btn {
  padding:7px 6px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid transparent;
  background:transparent;color:#cbd5e1;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;
  font:600 11px/1.2 Inter,system-ui;
}
#obs-cad-panel .cad-btn:hover { background:#232633;border-color:#343847;color:#f1f5f9; }
#obs-cad-panel .cad-btn[data-active="1"] {
  background:rgba(251,191,36,.14);border-color:#fbbf24;color:#fbbf24;
}
#obs-cad-panel .cad-status {
  margin:4px 6px 0;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;
  background:rgba(251,191,36,.08);border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,.2);
  color:#fbbf24;font:500 10.5px/1.3 Inter,system-ui;
}
`;
  document.head.appendChild(style);

  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = "obs-cad-panel";
  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="cad-hdr">
      <b>CAD Tools</b>
      <button class="cad-close" type="button">-</button>
    </div>
    <div class="cad-body">
      <div class="cad-status" data-cad-status>Entities: 0</div>
      <div class="cad-sec">
        <div class="cad-sec-title">Draw</div>
        <div class="cad-grid">
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="line" type="button">Line <small>L</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="polyline" type="button">PLine <small>PL</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="rect" type="button">Rect <small>REC</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="circle" type="button">Circle <small>C</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="arc" type="button">Arc <small>A</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="text" type="button">Text <small>T</small></button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="cad-sec">
        <div class="cad-sec-title">Modify</div>
        <div class="cad-grid">
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="offset" type="button">Offset <small>O</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="trim" type="button">Trim <small>TR</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="extend" type="button">Extend <small>EX</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="fillet" type="button">Fillet <small>F</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="erase" type="button">Erase <small>E</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="copy" type="button">Copy <small>CO</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="mirror" type="button">Mirror <small>MI</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-tool="distance" type="button">Dist <small>DI</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-action="undo" type="button">Undo <small>U</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-action="clear" type="button">Clear</button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-action="fillet-r" type="button">Fillet R</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="cad-sec">
        <div class="cad-sec-title">Layers</div>
        <div class="cad-grid" data-cad-layers></div>
      </div>
      <div class="cad-sec">
        <div class="cad-sec-title">Options</div>
        <div class="cad-grid">
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-ortho type="button">Ortho <small>F8</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-grid type="button">Grid <small>F7</small></button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-action="finish-pl" type="button">Finish PL</button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-action="export-dxf" type="button">Export DXF</button>
          <button class="cad-btn" data-cad-action="import-dxf" type="button">Import DXF</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  document.body.appendChild(panel);

  panel.querySelector(".cad-close")?.addEventListener("click", () => closeCadPanel());

  panel.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
    const tool = t.closest("[data-cad-tool]") as HTMLElement | null;
    if (tool) {
      const name = tool.getAttribute("data-cad-tool") as CadTool;
      const labels: Record<string, string> = {
        line: "LINE",
        polyline: "PLINE - click points, Enter to finish",
        rect: "RECTANGLE",
        circle: "CIRCLE",
        arc: "ARC",
        text: "TEXT",
        offset: "OFFSET",
        erase: "ERASE last",
        copy: "COPY last",
        mirror: "MIRROR last",
        trim: "TRIM - cutting edge, then object",
        extend: "EXTEND - boundary, then object",
        fillet: "FILLET - two lines",
        distance: "DIST - two points",
      };
      setTool(name, labels[name ?? ""] ?? name ?? "");
      return;
    }
    const action = t.closest("[data-cad-action]") as HTMLElement | null;
    if (action) {
      const a = action.getAttribute("data-cad-action");
      if (a === "undo") {
        cadEngine.undo();
        render();
        syncDrafting();
      } else if (a === "clear") {
        if (window.confirm("Clear all CAD entities?")) {
          cadEngine.clear();
          render();
          syncDrafting();
        }
      } else if (a === "finish-pl") {
        cadEngine.finishPolyline();
        render();
        syncDrafting();
        toast("success", "Polyline finished");
      } else if (a === "fillet-r") {
        const v = Number(window.prompt("Fillet radius (px):", String(filletRadius)) ?? filletRadius);
        if (Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0) {
          filletRadius = v;
          toast("info", "Fillet radius = " + filletRadius);
          setCmd("FILLETRAD = " + filletRadius);
        }
      } else if (a === "export-dxf") {
        (window as Any).__obsDrawings?.exportCadAsDxf?.("cad-export.dxf");
      } else if (a === "import-dxf") {
        (window as Any).__obsDrawingsPanel?.open?.();
        // also trigger file pick via drawings panel path
        const input = document.createElement("input");
        input.type = "file";
        input.accept = ".dxf,.dwg";
        input.onchange = async () => {
          const f = input.files?.[0];
          if (f) await (window as Any).__obsDrawings?.importDrawingFile?.(f);
          render();
          syncDrafting();
        };
        input.click();
      }
      updatePanelActive();
      return;
    }
    const layerBtn = t.closest("[data-cad-layer]") as HTMLElement | null;
    if (layerBtn) {
      const id = layerBtn.getAttribute("data-cad-layer");
      if (id) {
        cadEngine.setActiveLayer(id);
        toast("info", "Layer: " + cadEngine.getActiveLayer().name);
        updatePanelActive();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (t.closest("[data-cad-ortho]")) {
      const on = cadEngine.toggleOrtho();
      toast("info", on ? "ORTHO on" : "ORTHO off");
      updatePanelActive();
      return;
    }
    if (t.closest("[data-cad-grid]")) {
      const on = cadEngine.toggleGrid();
      render();
      toast("info", on ? "GRID on" : "GRID off");
      updatePanelActive();
    }
  });

  // Drag header
  const hdr = panel.querySelector(".cad-hdr") as HTMLElement;
  let dragging = false, sx = 0, sy = 0, ox = 0, oy = 0;
  hdr.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest("button")) return;
    dragging = true;
    sx = e.clientX;
    sy = e.clientY;
    const r = panel!.getBoundingClientRect();
    ox = r.left;
    oy = r.top;
    hdr.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  hdr.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    if (!dragging || !panel) return;
    panel.style.left = `${ox + e.clientX - sx}px`;
    panel.style.top = `${oy + e.clientY - sy}px`;
    panel.style.right = "auto";
  });
  hdr.addEventListener("pointerup", () => {
    dragging = false;
  });
}

export function openCadPanel(): void {
  buildPanel();
  ensureSvg();
  panel?.classList.add("is-open");
  updatePanelActive();
}

export function closeCadPanel(): void {
  panel?.classList.remove("is-open");
  cadEngine.setTool(null);
}

export function toggleCadPanel(): void {
  if (panel?.classList.contains("is-open")) closeCadPanel();
  else openCadPanel();
}

/* -- Shortcuts ------------------------------------------------------------- */

async function registerCadShortcuts(): Promise<void> {
  let register: ((s: Any) => void) | null = null;
  try {
    const mod: Any = await import("./shortcuts");
    register = mod.shortcuts?.register?.bind(mod.shortcuts) ?? null;
  } catch {
    return;
  }
  if (!register) return;

  const toolCmd = (keys: string, id: string, label: string, tool: CadTool) => {
    register!({
      id,
      label,
      keys,
      category: "tool",
      handler: () => {
        openCadPanel();
        setTool(tool, label);
      },
    });
  };

  toolCmd("l", "cad-line", "CAD Line", "line");
  toolCmd("pl", "cad-pline", "CAD Polyline", "polyline");
  toolCmd("rec", "cad-rect", "CAD Rectangle", "rect");
  // "c" conflicts with walk - use "ci" already exists for circle authoring;
  // CAD circle via "cc" to avoid clash
  toolCmd("cc", "cad-circle", "CAD Circle", "circle");
  toolCmd("a", "cad-arc", "CAD Arc", "arc");
  // "t" might conflict - use "dt" for dtext-like
  toolCmd("dt", "cad-text", "CAD Text", "text");
  toolCmd("o", "cad-offset", "CAD Offset", "offset");
  toolCmd("e", "cad-erase", "CAD Erase", "erase");
  toolCmd("co", "cad-copy", "CAD Copy", "copy");
  toolCmd("mi", "cad-mirror", "CAD Mirror", "mirror");
  toolCmd("tr", "cad-trim", "CAD Trim", "trim");
  toolCmd("ex", "cad-extend", "CAD Extend", "extend");
  toolCmd("fi", "cad-fillet", "CAD Fillet", "fillet");
  toolCmd("di", "cad-dist", "CAD Distance", "distance");

  register({
    id: "cad-panel",
    label: "CAD Tools Panel",
    keys: "ctrl+shift+d",
    category: "app",
    handler: () => toggleCadPanel(),
  });
  register({
    id: "cad-ortho",
    label: "Toggle Ortho (F8)",
    keys: "f8",
    category: "tool",
    handler: () => {
      const on = cadEngine.toggleOrtho();
      toast("info", on ? "ORTHO on" : "ORTHO off");
      updatePanelActive();
    },
  });
  register({
    id: "cad-grid",
    label: "Toggle Grid (F7)",
    keys: "f7",
    category: "tool",
    handler: () => {
      const on = cadEngine.toggleGrid();
      ensureSvg();
      render();
      toast("info", on ? "GRID on" : "GRID off");
      updatePanelActive();
    },
  });
  register({
    id: "cad-undo",
    label: "CAD Undo",
    keys: "u",
    category: "edit",
    handler: () => {
      if (cadEngine.getCount() === 0) return;
      cadEngine.undo();
      render();
      syncDrafting();
    },
  });

  console.log("[cad-parity] CAD shortcuts registered");
}

/* -- Setup ----------------------------------------------------------------- */

export function setupCadParity(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  ensureSvg();
  cadEngine.onChange(() => {
    render();
    updatePanelActive();
  });

  window.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown, true);
  window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove, true);
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp, true);
  window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);

  void registerCadShortcuts();

  // Launcher button
  const launch = document.createElement("button");
  launch.id = "obs-cad-launch";
  launch.type = "button";
  launch.title = "CAD Tools (Ctrl+Shift+D)";
  launch.textContent = "CAD";
  launch.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;left:64px;bottom:52px;z-index:10002;width:44px;height:40px;" +
    "border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #fbbf24;background:rgba(251,191,36,.14);" +
    "color:#fbbf24;font:700 11px Inter,system-ui;cursor:pointer;" +
    "box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);";
  launch.onclick = () => toggleCadPanel();
  document.body.appendChild(launch);

  (ctx.features as Any).cad = {
    engine: cadEngine,
    open: openCadPanel,
    close: closeCadPanel,
    toggle: toggleCadPanel,
  };
  (window as Any).__obsCad = (ctx.features as Any).cad;

  void (async () => {
    try {
      const cp: Any = await import("./command-palette");
      cp.registerCommand?.({
        id: "cad.panel",
        label: "CAD Tools Panel",
        category: "Drafting",
        kbd: "Ctrl+Shift+D",
        run: () => toggleCadPanel(),
      });
      cp.registerCommand?.({
        id: "cad.line",
        label: "CAD Line",
        category: "Drafting",
        run: () => {
          openCadPanel();
          setTool("line", "LINE");
        },
      });
      cp.registerCommand?.({
        id: "cad.pline",
        label: "CAD Polyline",
        category: "Drafting",
        run: () => {
          openCadPanel();
          setTool("polyline", "PLINE");
        },
      });
    } catch { /* */ }
  })();

  console.log("[cad-parity] ready - CAD button or Ctrl+Shift+D");
}
```

```ts
import * as THREE from "three";
import type * as OBC from "@thatopen/components";
import { ctx, type Projection } from "../core/context";
import { forceResumeCameraControls } from "../core/camera-gate";
import { register, type CameraService } from "../core/services";
import { getElementWorldBoxes } from "../modules/geometry/world-box";

// ── Scene placement state ──
let recenterEnabled = false;
let sceneOffset: THREE.Vector3 | null = null;
let offsetEstablished = false;
const sceneCenter = new THREE.Vector3();
let sceneRadius = 10;
const lastSceneBox = new THREE.Box3();

export const boundsInfoEl = document.createElement("div");
boundsInfoEl.style.cssText = "font-size:10.5px;opacity:.7;margin-top:6px;line-height:1.5";
boundsInfoEl.textContent = "Scene: empty";

const boundsHelperGroup = new THREE.Group();
let showBounds = false;

export function setRecenterEnabled(on: boolean) {
  recenterEnabled = on;
}

export function resetPlacementState() {
  sceneOffset = null;
  offsetEstablished = false;
}

function worldReady(): boolean {
  try {
    const w: any = (ctx as any).world;
    return !!w && !!w.camera && !!w.camera.three;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function isOrthoCam(cam: THREE.Camera): boolean {
  return !!(cam as any).isOrthographicCamera;
}

function allCameras(): THREE.Camera[] {
  if (!worldReady()) return [];
  const c: any = ctx.world.camera;
  const out: any[] = [ctx.world.camera.three];
  const push = (x: any) => {
    if (!x) return;
    if (x.isCamera) out.push(x);
    else if (x.three?.isCamera) out.push(x.three);
  };
  push(c.perspectiveCamera);
  push(c.orthoCamera);
  push(c.orthographicCamera);
  return Array.from(new Set(out)).filter((x) => x && x.isCamera);
}

/**
 * Ensure the frustum of any orthographic camera is large enough to contain
 * the scene. This is what makes every camera-move work correctly in ortho.
 */
function fitOrthoFrustum(ortho: THREE.OrthographicCamera, radius: number): void {
  // Aspect must come from the viewport, not the current (possibly stale) frustum.
  let aspect = 1;
  try {
    const host = ctx.rightHost;
    if (host) {
      const r = host.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.width > 0 && r.height > 0) aspect = r.width / r.height;
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  const safeAspect = Number.isFinite(aspect) && aspect > 0.01 ? aspect : 1;
  const safeR = Math.max(radius, 0.5);
  const halfH = safeR * 1.15;
  const halfW = halfH * safeAspect;
  ortho.left = -halfW;
  ortho.right = halfW;
  ortho.top = halfH;
  ortho.bottom = -halfH;
  ortho.zoom = 1;
  ortho.near = -safeR * 50;
  ortho.far = safeR * 200 + 1000;
  ortho.updateProjectionMatrix();
}

/** Orthographic cameras use near/far differently — set generously. */
function applyClipping(near: number, far: number) {
  for (const cam of allCameras()) {
    if (isOrthoCam(cam)) {
      const ortho = cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera;
      const safeFar = Math.max(Math.abs(far), sceneRadius * 4, 2000);
      let changed = false;
      // Ortho can use a negative near plane safely — this eliminates
      // z-fighting on flat models and keeps geometry behind the eye visible.
      const nearTarget = -safeFar;
      if (Math.abs(ortho.near - nearTarget) > 1e-3) {
        ortho.near = nearTarget;
        changed = true;
      }
      if (Math.abs(ortho.far - safeFar) > 1e-3) {
        ortho.far = safeFar;
        changed = true;
      }
      if (changed) ortho.updateProjectionMatrix();
    } else {
      const c = cam as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
      let changed = false;
      if (Math.abs(c.near - near) > 1e-6) { c.near = near; changed = true; }
      if (Math.abs(c.far - far) > 1e-6) { c.far = far; changed = true; }
      if (changed) c.updateProjectionMatrix();
    }
  }
}

export function updateClipping() {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  const dist = Math.max(cam.position.distanceTo(sceneCenter), 0.05);
  const near = Math.max(0.005, (dist - sceneRadius) / 100);
  const far = (dist + sceneRadius) * 4 + 100;
  applyClipping(near, far);
}

function refreshBoundsInfo() {
  const size = new THREE.Vector3();
  lastSceneBox.getSize(size);
  const active: any = worldReady() ? ctx.world.camera.three : null;
  const isOrtho = active && isOrthoCam(active);
  const clip = isOrtho
    ? `Ortho zoom ${active.zoom?.toFixed(2) ?? "?"}`
    : `near ${active?.near?.toFixed(3) ?? "?"} / far ${active?.far?.toFixed(0) ?? "?"}`;
  boundsInfoEl.innerHTML = lastSceneBox.isEmpty()
    ? "Scene: empty"
    : `Scene: <b>${size.x.toFixed(1)} × ${size.y.toFixed(1)} × ${size.z.toFixed(1)} m</b><br>` +
      `Center: ${sceneCenter.x.toFixed(1)}, ${sceneCenter.y.toFixed(1)}, ${sceneCenter.z.toFixed(1)}<br>` +
      `Radius: ${sceneRadius.toFixed(1)} m · ${clip}`;
}

export function computeSceneBounds() {
  lastSceneBox.makeEmpty();
  try {
    for (const [, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
      lastSceneBox.union(new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(model.object));
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  try {
    const ab = (ctx.features as any).fileInterop?.getAuxBox?.();
    if (ab && !ab.isEmpty()) lastSceneBox.union(ab);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  if (lastSceneBox.isEmpty()) {
    sceneCenter.set(0, 0, 0);
    sceneRadius = 10;
  } else {
    lastSceneBox.getCenter(sceneCenter);
    sceneRadius = Math.max(
      lastSceneBox.getBoundingSphere(new THREE.Sphere()).radius,
      0.5,
    );
  }
  updateClipping();
  try {
    (ctx.world.camera.controls as any).maxDistance = Math.max(
      sceneRadius * 100,
      1000,
    );
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  refreshBoundsInfo();
  refreshBoundsHelpers();
}

function refreshBoundsHelpers() {
  while (boundsHelperGroup.children.length) {
    const ch = boundsHelperGroup.children[0] as any;
    boundsHelperGroup.remove(ch);
    ch.geometry?.dispose?.();
    ch.material?.dispose?.();
  }
  if (!showBounds) return;
  if (!lastSceneBox.isEmpty()) {
    boundsHelperGroup.add(
      new THREE.Box3Helper(lastSceneBox.clone(), new THREE.Color(0x22d3ee)),
    );
  }
  try {
    for (const [, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
      const b = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(model.object);
      if (!b.isEmpty()) {
        boundsHelperGroup.add(new THREE.Box3Helper(b, new THREE.Color(0xf59e0b)));
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

export function showBoundsHelpers(on: boolean) {
  showBounds = on;
  refreshBoundsHelpers();
}

function applySceneOffsetTo(modelId: string) {
  const model = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
  if (!model) return;
  const off = sceneOffset ?? new THREE.Vector3();
  model.object.position.set(-off.x, -off.y, -off.z);
}

export function establishSceneOffset(modelId: string) {
  const model = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
  if (!model) return;
  if (!recenterEnabled) return;
  if (!offsetEstablished) {
    offsetEstablished = true;
    const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(model.object);
    sceneOffset = box.isEmpty()
      ? new THREE.Vector3()
      : box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  }
  applySceneOffsetTo(modelId);
}

export function alignOriginToOrigin() {
  try {
    sceneOffset = new THREE.Vector3();
    offsetEstablished = true;
    for (const id of Array.from(ctx.fragments.list.keys())) {
      const model = ctx.fragments.list.get(id);
      if (!model) continue;
      model.object.position.set(0, 0, 0);
      model.object.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    }
    computeSceneBounds();
    fitAll();
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[placement] alignOriginToOrigin", err);
  }
}

export function recenterSceneNow() {
  try {
    const ids = Array.from(ctx.fragments.list.keys());
    if (!ids.length) return;
    const first = ctx.fragments.list.get(ids[0])!;
    const curPos = first.object.position.clone();
    const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(first.object);
    if (box.isEmpty()) return;
    sceneOffset = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()).sub(curPos);
    offsetEstablished = true;
    for (const id of ids) applySceneOffsetTo(id);
    computeSceneBounds();
    fitAll();
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[placement] recenterSceneNow", err);
  }
}

export function resetOffsets() {
  sceneOffset = new THREE.Vector3();
  offsetEstablished = true;
  try {
    for (const id of Array.from(ctx.fragments.list.keys())) applySceneOffsetTo(id);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  computeSceneBounds();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Projection
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let currentProjection: Projection = "perspective";

export function getSceneBox(): THREE.Box3 {
  return lastSceneBox.clone();
}
export function getProjection(): Projection {
  if (!worldReady()) return currentProjection;
  const cam: any = ctx.world.camera;
  const t = cam?.cameraType ?? cam?.projection?.current ?? cam?.projection;
  if (typeof t === "string") {
    if (/plan|ortho/i.test(t)) return "orthographic";
    if (/orbit|persp/i.test(t)) return "perspective";
  }
  return isOrthoCam(ctx.world.camera.three) ? "orthographic" : "perspective";
}

function afterProjectionChanged() {
  currentProjection = getProjection();
  try {
    for (const [, model] of ctx.fragments.list) model.useCamera(ctx.world.camera.three);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  try {
    ctx.fragments.core.update(true);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  if (currentProjection === "orthographic") {
    computeSceneBounds();
    const cam = ctx.world.camera.three as THREE.OrthographicCamera;
    if (isOrthoCam(cam)) fitOrthoFrustum(cam, sceneRadius);
  }
  updateClipping();
}

export function setProjection(mode: Projection): boolean {
  if (!worldReady()) {
    currentProjection = mode;
    return false;
  }
  const cam: any = ctx.world.camera;
  if (typeof cam.setCameraType === "function") {
    const attempts =
      mode === "perspective"
        ? ["Orbit", "OrbitCamera", "Perspective"]
        : ["Plan", "PlanCamera", "Orthographic"];
    for (const t of attempts) {
      try {
        cam.setCameraType(t as any);
        afterProjectionChanged();
        return true;
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    }
  }
  if (cam.projection?.set) {
    try {
      cam.projection.set(mode === "perspective" ? "Perspective" : "Orthographic");
      afterProjectionChanged();
      return true;
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }
  console.warn(
    "[projection] could not switch — unsupported camera API in this SDK version",
  );
  return false;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Navigation
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function getCamTarget(out: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector3 {
  if (!worldReady()) return out.copy(sceneCenter);
  const c: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
  try {
    if (c.target?.isVector3) return out.copy(c.target);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return out.copy(sceneCenter);
}

/**
 * Zoom by factor toward an optional world point (cursor focus).
 * factor > 1 = zoom out, factor < 1 = zoom in.
 */
/**
 * Pure zoom only — no orbit, no pan, no target shift (no vibration).
 * factor < 1 = zoom in, factor > 1 = zoom out.
 * Camera moves only along the current look axis; orientation stays fixed.
 */
export function zoomBy(factor: number, focusPoint?: THREE.Vector3) {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  if (!Number.isFinite(factor) || factor <= 0) return;
  factor = Math.min(4.0, Math.max(0.15, factor));

  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three as any;
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
  const target = getCamTarget(new THREE.Vector3());

  try { if (controls && controls.enabled === false) controls.enabled = true; } catch { /* */ }

  // ── ORTHOGRAPHIC ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (isOrthoCam(cam)) {
    const ortho = cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera;
    const oldZoom = Math.max(1e-3, ortho.zoom || 1);
    const newZoom = Math.max(0.01, Math.min(5000, oldZoom / factor));

    // Move target + camera so the cursor world point stays under the cursor.
    let delta = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (focusPoint && Number.isFinite(focusPoint.x)) {
      const viewDir = new THREE.Vector3();
      cam.getWorldDirection(viewDir);
      const offset = focusPoint.clone().sub(target);
      const along = offset.dot(viewDir);
      // Only the perpendicular component matters for screen anchoring.
      const perp = offset.clone().sub(viewDir.clone().multiplyScalar(along));
      // Cursor world point should land at the same screen position.
      // See derivation in header comment: delta = perp * (1 - 1/factor).
      delta = perp.multiplyScalar(1 - 1 / factor);
    }

    const newPos = cam.position.clone().add(delta);
    const newTarget = target.clone().add(delta);

    ortho.zoom = newZoom;
    ortho.updateProjectionMatrix();

    try {
      controls.setLookAt(
        newPos.x, newPos.y, newPos.z,
        newTarget.x, newTarget.y, newTarget.z,
        false,
      );
      try { controls.update?.(0); } catch { /* */ }
    } catch {
      cam.position.copy(newPos);
    }
    updateClipping();
    return;
  }

  // ── PERSPECTIVE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const offset = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(cam.position, target);
  const dist = offset.length();
  if (dist < 1e-6) return;
  const dir = offset.clone().multiplyScalar(1 / dist);
  const newDist = Math.max(0.05, dist * factor);
  let newPos = target.clone().add(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(newDist));
  let newTarget = target.clone();

  if (focusPoint && Number.isFinite(focusPoint.x)) {
    const viewN = dir.clone();
    const toFocus = focusPoint.clone().sub(target);
    const along = toFocus.dot(viewN);
    const focusOnPlane = focusPoint.clone().sub(viewN.clone().multiplyScalar(along));
    const lateral = focusOnPlane.clone().sub(target);
    const truck = lateral.multiplyScalar(1 - factor);
    newPos.add(truck);
    newTarget.add(truck);
  }

  try {
    controls.setLookAt(
      newPos.x, newPos.y, newPos.z,
      newTarget.x, newTarget.y, newTarget.z,
      false,
    );
  } catch {
    cam.position.copy(newPos);
    try { cam.lookAt(newTarget); } catch { /* */ }
  }
  try { controls.update?.(0); } catch { /* */ }
  updateClipping();
}

export function pickWorldPointUnderCursor(clientX: number, clientY: number): THREE.Vector3 | null {
  try {
    const host = ctx.rightHost;
    const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width < 1 || rect.height < 1) return null;
    const ndcX = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    const ndcY = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    raycaster.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(ndcX, ndcY), cam);

    // Stable plane through the current orbit target, facing the camera.
    // This is the primary anchor so zoom never drifts when the cursor is
    // over empty space or distant background.
    const target = getCamTarget(new THREE.Vector3());
    const normal = new THREE.Vector3();
    cam.getWorldDirection(normal);
    const plane = new THREE.Plane().setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(normal.clone().negate(), target);
    const planeHit = new THREE.Vector3();
    const hasPlane = raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(plane, planeHit);

    // Prefer a nearby mesh hit if it is in front of the camera and not far
    // behind the target plane (keeps zoom "on the model" when hovering it).
    try {
      const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(ctx.world.scene.three.children, true);
      const camPos = cam.position;
      const targetDist = camPos.distanceTo(target);
      for (const h of hits) {
        if (!h.point || !Number.isFinite(h.point.x)) continue;
        const d = camPos.distanceTo(h.point);
        if (d < 0.01) continue;
        // Accept hits roughly in front of / near the target depth.
        if (d < targetDist * 3 + 50) return h.point.clone();
      }
    } catch { /* */ }

    if (hasPlane && Number.isFinite(planeHit.x)) return planeHit;
  } catch { /* */ }
  return null;
}

export type ExactView = "top" | "bottom" | "front" | "back" | "right" | "left";

/**
 * Pure Revit-style cardinal view. Unlike gotoDir(), this deliberately ignores
 * Project North and the current camera rotation so Top really means +Y,
 * Front +Z, Right +X, etc. All cube-face and explicit view commands should use
 * this function to guarantee identical camera behavior.
 */
export function gotoExactView(view: ExactView): void {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  const target = getCamTarget(new THREE.Vector3());
  const table: Record<ExactView, { dir: THREE.Vector3; up: THREE.Vector3 }> = {
    top: { dir: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), up: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1) },
    bottom: { dir: new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0), up: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1) },
    front: { dir: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), up: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0) },
    back: { dir: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1), up: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0) },
    right: { dir: new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), up: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0) },
    left: { dir: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), up: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0) },
  };
  const spec = table[view];
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;

  // In ortho, distance does not affect visible size; keep the camera close
  // so near/far clipping stays small and precise.
  const isOrtho = isOrthoCam(cam);
  const dist = isOrtho
    ? Math.max(sceneRadius * 1.5, 5)
    : Math.max(sceneRadius * 2, 10);
  const pos = target.clone().add(spec.dir.clone().multiplyScalar(dist));

  cam.up.copy(spec.up);
  ctx.world.camera.controls.setLookAt(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, target.x, target.y, target.z, true);
  cam.up.copy(spec.up);
  cam.lookAt(target);

  if (isOrtho) {
    fitOrthoFrustum(cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera, sceneRadius);
  }
  updateClipping();
}

export function gotoDir(dir: THREE.Vector3) {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  const target = getCamTarget(new THREE.Vector3());
  const dist = Math.max(
    ctx.world.camera.three.position.distanceTo(target),
    sceneRadius,
    0.5,
  );
  const pos = target.clone().add(dir.clone().normalize().multiplyScalar(dist));
  if (Math.abs(dir.y) > 0.99) {
    pos.x += dist * 0.002;
    pos.z += dist * 0.002;
  }
  ctx.world.camera.controls.setLookAt(
    pos.x,
    pos.y,
    pos.z,
    target.x,
    target.y,
    target.z,
    true,
  );
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  if (isOrthoCam(cam)) fitOrthoFrustum(cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera, sceneRadius);
  updateClipping();
}

export function focusOnPoint(point: THREE.Vector3) {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  // Remember current camera so Focus does not jump back to the start/home view
  preFocusView = saveCameraSnapshot();
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;

  const camToTarget = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(cam.position, point);
  const horizontalDist = Math.hypot(camToTarget.x, camToTarget.z);
  let dir: THREE.Vector3;
  if (horizontalDist < 0.05) {
    dir = new THREE.Vector3(1.0, 0.7, 1.0).normalize();
  } else {
    const azimuth = Math.atan2(camToTarget.x, camToTarget.z);
    const pitchRaw = Math.atan2(camToTarget.y, horizontalDist);
    const pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      pitchRaw,
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-30),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(60),
    );
    const cosP = Math.cos(pitch);
    dir = new THREE.Vector3(
      Math.sin(azimuth) * cosP,
      Math.sin(pitch),
      Math.cos(azimuth) * cosP,
    ).normalize();
  }

  // Fit so the object fills ~60% of the view (Revit Focus)
  computeSceneBounds();
  const targetDist = Math.max(sceneRadius * 0.12, 1.5, 0.5);
  const pos = point.clone().add(dir.multiplyScalar(targetDist * 1.8));
  try {
    controls.setLookAt(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, point.x, point.y, point.z, true);
  } catch {
    cam.position.copy(pos);
    cam.lookAt(point);
  }
  if (isOrthoCam(cam)) {
    fitOrthoFrustum(cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera, Math.max(targetDist * 0.55, 0.8));
    cam.zoom = Math.max(cam.zoom || 1, 1.4);
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }
  updateClipping();
}

/** Focus a world-space box while preserving the current view direction. */

/**
 * Pin the orbit pivot to a world point without changing camera position.
 * Shift+MMB orbit will rotate around this point until the target is changed again.
 */
export function setOrbitPivot(point: THREE.Vector3): void {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  if (!point || !Number.isFinite(point.x)) return;
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
  if (!controls) return;
  const pos = cam.position.clone();

  // Direct write to the internal target first (works on all versions).
  try {
    if (controls.target?.isVector3) {
      controls.target.set(point.x, point.y, point.z);
    }
  } catch { /* */ }

  // Also tell camera-controls — this updates its interpolation endpoints.
  try {
    if (typeof controls.setTarget === "function") {
      controls.setTarget(point.x, point.y, point.z, false);
    }
  } catch { /* */ }

  // Force a look-at so the camera orientation matches the new target
  // even in versions where setTarget only updates the end state.
  try {
    if (typeof controls.setLookAt === "function") {
      controls.setLookAt(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, point.x, point.y, point.z, false);
    } else {
      cam.lookAt(point);
    }
  } catch { /* */ }

  try { controls.update?.(0); } catch { /* */ }
  try { updateClipping(); } catch { /* */ }
}

/**
 * Pan the camera so that `point` sits at the screen center, WITHOUT
 * changing view direction or zoom. Sets the orbit target to `point`.
 */
export function centerOnPoint(point: THREE.Vector3): void {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  if (!point || !Number.isFinite(point.x)) return;
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
  if (!controls) return;

  // Read current target
  const oldTarget = new THREE.Vector3();
  if (controls.target?.isVector3) oldTarget.copy(controls.target);
  else {
    const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
    cam.getWorldDirection(dir);
    oldTarget.copy(cam.position).add(dir.multiplyScalar(5));
  }

  // Pure translation: camera moves by delta, target becomes point.
  const delta = point.clone().sub(oldTarget);
  const newPos = cam.position.clone().add(delta);

  try {
    if (typeof controls.setLookAt === "function") {
      controls.setLookAt(newPos.x, newPos.y, newPos.z, point.x, point.y, point.z, true);
    } else {
      cam.position.copy(newPos);
      cam.lookAt(point);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[camera] centerOnPoint failed", err);
  }

  // After the smooth transition finishes, re-assert the pivot so
  // subsequent Shift+MMB orbits stay centered.
  setTimeout(() => {
    try { setOrbitPivot(point); } catch { /* */ }
  }, 220);

  try { updateClipping(); } catch { /* */ }
}

/** Resolve a sensible pivot from current fragment + authored selection. */
export async function pivotOnSelection(
  idMap?: Record<string, Set<number>> | null,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!worldReady()) return false;
  const box = new THREE.Box3();
  let found = false;

  // ── Fragment selection (use WORLD boxes, not local) ──
  try {
    const map = idMap && Object.keys(idMap).length
      ? idMap
      : (await import("./selection")).selection.snapshot();
    for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(map ?? {})) {
      const model: any = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
      if (!model || !ids || !(ids as Set<number>).size) continue;
      try {
        const wbs = await getElementWorldBoxes(model, [...(ids as Set<number>)], modelId);
        for (const wb of wbs) {
          if (wb?.box && !wb.box.isEmpty()) { box.union(wb.box); found = true; }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("[camera] pivot world-box read failed", modelId, err);
      }
    }
  } catch { /* */ }

  // ── Authored selection ──
  try {
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    const ids: string[] = auth?.getSelectedIds?.() ?? [];
    for (const id of ids) {
      const el = auth?.getElementById?.(id);
      if (!el) continue;
      const wb = auth?.getElementWorldBox?.(el);
      if (wb && !wb.isEmpty()) { box.union(wb); found = true; }
    }
  } catch { /* */ }

  if (!found || box.isEmpty()) return false;
  const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  setOrbitPivot(center);
  return true;
}

export function focusOnBox(box: THREE.Box3): void {
  if (!worldReady() || box.isEmpty()) return;
  preFocusView = saveCameraSnapshot();

  const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  const radius = Math.max(box.getBoundingSphere(new THREE.Sphere()).radius, 0.5);
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;

  const camToCenter = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(cam.position, center);
  const horizontalDist = Math.hypot(camToCenter.x, camToCenter.z);
  let dir: THREE.Vector3;
  if (horizontalDist < Math.max(radius * 0.15, 0.05)) {
    dir = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0.7, 1).normalize();
  } else {
    const azimuth = Math.atan2(camToCenter.x, camToCenter.z);
    const pitchRaw = Math.atan2(camToCenter.y, horizontalDist);
    const pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      pitchRaw,
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-30),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(60),
    );
    const cosP = Math.cos(pitch);
    dir = new THREE.Vector3(
      Math.sin(azimuth) * cosP,
      Math.sin(pitch),
      Math.cos(azimuth) * cosP,
    ).normalize();
  }

  if (isOrthoCam(cam)) {
    const dist = Math.max(radius * 1.5, 5);
    controls.setLookAt(
      center.x + dir.x * dist,
      center.y + dir.y * dist,
      center.z + dir.z * dist,
      center.x, center.y, center.z,
      true,
    );
    cam.up.set(0, 1, 0);
    cam.lookAt(center);
    fitOrthoFrustum(cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera, radius);
  } else {
    const persp = cam as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
    const vFov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(persp.fov ?? 60);
    const dist = (radius / Math.sin(Math.max(vFov, 0.3) / 2)) * 1.15;
    controls.setLookAt(
      center.x + dir.x * dist,
      center.y + dir.y * dist,
      center.z + dir.z * dist,
      center.x, center.y, center.z,
      true,
    );
  }
  updateClipping();
}

/**
 * Handles a stationary RMB on geometry. Returns true when an object was hit,
 * so the context menu can remain closed. A dragged RMB is handled separately
 * by the camera navigation / Ctrl-crossing selection gesture.
 */
export async function handleRightClickFocus(e: MouseEvent): Promise<boolean> {
  // Auto right-click focus disabled: explicit context-menu Focus preserves selection.
  void e;
  return false;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Home view
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let homeView: { pos: THREE.Vector3; target: THREE.Vector3; zoom?: number } | null = null;
let preFocusView: { pos: THREE.Vector3; target: THREE.Vector3; zoom?: number } | null = null;


export function saveCameraSnapshot(): { pos: THREE.Vector3; target: THREE.Vector3; zoom?: number } | null {
  if (!worldReady()) return null;
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three as any;
  return {
    pos: cam.position.clone(),
    target: getCamTarget(new THREE.Vector3()).clone(),
    zoom: isOrthoCam(cam) ? Number(cam.zoom) : undefined,
  };
}
export function restoreCameraSnapshot(snap: { pos: THREE.Vector3; target: THREE.Vector3; zoom?: number } | null): void {
  if (!snap || !worldReady()) return;
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three as any;
  try {
    controls.setLookAt(snap.pos.x, snap.pos.y, snap.pos.z, snap.target.x, snap.target.y, snap.target.z, true);
  } catch {
    cam.position.copy(snap.pos);
  }
  if (snap.zoom != null && isOrthoCam(cam)) {
    cam.zoom = snap.zoom;
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }
  updateClipping();
}

export function saveHome() {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  homeView = {
    pos: ctx.world.camera.three.position.clone(),
    target: getCamTarget(new THREE.Vector3()).clone(),
  };
}

export function goHome() {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  if (homeView) {
    ctx.world.camera.controls.setLookAt(
      homeView.pos.x,
      homeView.pos.y,
      homeView.pos.z,
      homeView.target.x,
      homeView.target.y,
      homeView.target.z,
      true,
    );
    const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
    if (isOrthoCam(cam)) fitOrthoFrustum(cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera, sceneRadius);
    updateClipping();
  } else fitAll();
}

export function fitAll() {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  computeSceneBounds();

  if (lastSceneBox.isEmpty()) {
    const modelCount = (() => { try { return ctx.fragments.list.size; } catch { return 0; } })();
    if (modelCount > 0) {
      console.warn(`[camera] fitAll: ${modelCount} model(s) present but scene bounds are empty — retrying in 200 ms.`);
      setTimeout(() => { try { fitAll(); } catch { /* */ } }, 200);
    }
    return;
  }

  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
  const dir = new THREE.Vector3(1.2, 0.7, 1.2).normalize();

  if (isOrthoCam(cam)) {
    // Orthographic: the frustum IS the fit. Position the camera a
    // comfortable distance from the scene center along the look dir.
    const ortho = cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera;
    const dist = Math.max(sceneRadius * 1.5, 5);
    controls.setLookAt(
      sceneCenter.x + dir.x * dist,
      sceneCenter.y + dir.y * dist,
      sceneCenter.z + dir.z * dist,
      sceneCenter.x, sceneCenter.y, sceneCenter.z,
      false,
    );
    cam.up.set(0, 1, 0);
    cam.lookAt(sceneCenter);
    fitOrthoFrustum(ortho, sceneRadius);
  } else {
    const persp = cam as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
    const vFov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(persp.fov ?? 60);
    const dist = (sceneRadius / Math.sin(Math.max(vFov, 0.3) / 2)) * 1.2;
    controls.setLookAt(
      sceneCenter.x + dir.x * dist,
      sceneCenter.y + dir.y * dist,
      sceneCenter.z + dir.z * dist,
      sceneCenter.x, sceneCenter.y, sceneCenter.z,
      false,
    );
  }

  updateClipping();
  refreshBoundsInfo();
  if (!homeView) saveHome();
}

/**
 * Zoom the camera to fit a specific set of elements.
 *
 * Uses the SDK-corrected world boxes from `world-box.ts` so the camera
 * lands on the geometry as rendered — not on the pre-alignment location.
 *
 * `modelId` is passed through to `getElementWorldBoxes` so that a stale
 * entry (worker no longer has the model) can be pruned by safe-query
 * instead of throwing "Fragments: Model not found".
 */
export async function fitToMap(map: OBC.ModelIdMap) {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  preFocusView = saveCameraSnapshot();

  const box = new THREE.Box3();

  for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(map)) {
    const model: any = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
    if (!model || !ids?.size) continue;
    try {
      const boxes = await getElementWorldBoxes(model, Array.from(ids), modelId);
      for (const wb of boxes) {
        if (!wb.box.isEmpty()) box.union(wb.box);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[camera] fitToMap box read failed", modelId, err);
    }
  }

  if (box.isEmpty()) {
    fitAll();
    return;
  }

  const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  const radius = Math.max(box.getBoundingSphere(new THREE.Sphere()).radius, 0.5);

  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;

  // Natural viewing direction: keep azimuth, clamp pitch.
  const camToCenter = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(cam.position, center);
  const horizontalDist = Math.hypot(camToCenter.x, camToCenter.z);
  let dir: THREE.Vector3;

  if (horizontalDist < Math.max(radius * 0.15, 0.05)) {
    dir = new THREE.Vector3(1.0, 0.7, 1.0).normalize();
  } else {
    const azimuth = Math.atan2(camToCenter.x, camToCenter.z);
    const pitchRaw = Math.atan2(camToCenter.y, horizontalDist);
    const pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      pitchRaw,
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-30),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(60),
    );
    const cosP = Math.cos(pitch);
    dir = new THREE.Vector3(
      Math.sin(azimuth) * cosP,
      Math.sin(pitch),
      Math.cos(azimuth) * cosP,
    ).normalize();
  }

  if (isOrthoCam(cam)) {
    fitOrthoFrustum(cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera, radius);
    const dist = radius * 4;
    ctx.world.camera.controls.setLookAt(
      center.x + dir.x * dist,
      center.y + dir.y * dist,
      center.z + dir.z * dist,
      center.x,
      center.y,
      center.z,
      true,
    );
  } else {
    const persp = cam as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
    const vFov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(persp.fov ?? 60);
    const dist = (radius / Math.sin(Math.max(vFov, 0.3) / 2)) * 1.15;
    ctx.world.camera.controls.setLookAt(
      center.x + dir.x * dist,
      center.y + dir.y * dist,
      center.z + dir.z * dist,
      center.x,
      center.y,
      center.z,
      true,
    );
  }

  updateClipping();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Recovery
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function recoverView(): void {
  try {
    const modelCount = ctx.fragments.list.size;
    computeSceneBounds();
    const boxSize = new THREE.Vector3();
    lastSceneBox.getSize(boxSize);

    const cam: any = ctx.world.camera.three;
    const isOrtho = isOrthoCam(cam);
    console.log(
      `[camera] recoverView · models=${modelCount} · ` +
        `scene ${boxSize.x.toFixed(1)}×${boxSize.y.toFixed(1)}×${boxSize.z.toFixed(1)} m · ` +
        `center (${sceneCenter.x.toFixed(1)}, ${sceneCenter.y.toFixed(1)}, ${sceneCenter.z.toFixed(1)}) · ` +
        `radius ${sceneRadius.toFixed(1)} · ` +
        `camera ${isOrtho ? "ortho" : "persp"} · ` +
        `position (${cam.position.x.toFixed(1)}, ${cam.position.y.toFixed(1)}, ${cam.position.z.toFixed(1)}) · ` +
        `near ${cam.near} · far ${cam.far}`,
    );

    if (lastSceneBox.isEmpty()) {
      console.warn("[camera] recoverView: scene bounds are empty.");
      return;
    }

    fitAll();
    try {
      ctx.fragments.core.update(true);
    } catch {
      /* */
    }

    const proj = new THREE.Matrix4().multiplyMatrices(
      cam.projectionMatrix,
      cam.matrixWorldInverse,
    );
    const ndc = sceneCenter.clone().applyMatrix4(proj);
    if (Math.abs(ndc.x) > 2 || Math.abs(ndc.y) > 2 || ndc.z < -2 || ndc.z > 2) {
      console.warn(
        `[camera] recoverView: scene center still outside frustum ` +
          `(ndc ${ndc.x.toFixed(2)}, ${ndc.y.toFixed(2)}, ${ndc.z.toFixed(2)}). ` +
          `Switching to a fresh isometric view.`,
      );

      const dist = Math.max(sceneRadius * 3, 5);
      const dir = new THREE.Vector3(1.2, 0.7, 1.2).normalize();
      ctx.world.camera.controls.setLookAt(
        sceneCenter.x + dir.x * dist,
        sceneCenter.y + dir.y * dist,
        sceneCenter.z + dir.z * dist,
        sceneCenter.x,
        sceneCenter.y,
        sceneCenter.z,
        false,
      );
      if (isOrtho) {
        fitOrthoFrustum(cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera, sceneRadius);
      }
      updateClipping();
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[camera] recoverView failed", err);
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Screenshot
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export interface ScreenshotOptions {
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  format?: "png" | "jpeg";
  quality?: number;
  filename?: string;
}

export type ScreenshotPreset = "current" | "hd" | "4k" | "8k";

const SCREENSHOT_PRESETS: Record<ScreenshotPreset, { w: number; h: number } | null> = {
  current: null,
  hd: { w: 1920, h: 1080 },
  "4k": { w: 3840, h: 2160 },
  "8k": { w: 7680, h: 4320 },
};

const SCREENSHOT_KEY = "obs.screenshot.preset";

let currentPreset: ScreenshotPreset = "hd";
try {
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(SCREENSHOT_KEY);
  if (raw === "current" || raw === "hd" || raw === "4k" || raw === "8k") {
    currentPreset = raw;
  }
} catch {
  /* */
}

export function getScreenshotPreset(): ScreenshotPreset {
  return currentPreset;
}

export function setScreenshotPreset(p: ScreenshotPreset): void {
  currentPreset = p;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(SCREENSHOT_KEY, p);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  const size = SCREENSHOT_PRESETS[p];
  console.log(`[screenshot] preset → ${p}${size ? ` (${size.w}×${size.h})` : ""}`);
}

export function takeScreenshot(opts: ScreenshotOptions = {}): void {
  console.log(`[screenshot] click · preset="${currentPreset}"`);
  if (!worldReady()) {
    console.warn("[screenshot] world not ready — nothing to capture");
    return;
  }
  const renderer = ctx.world.renderer.three as THREE.WebGLRenderer;
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  const scene = ctx.world.scene.three;
  if (!renderer || !cam || !scene) {
    console.warn("[screenshot] renderer/camera/scene missing");
    return;
  }

  const preset = SCREENSHOT_PRESETS[currentPreset];
  const targetW = Math.max(
    64,
    Math.round(opts.width ?? preset?.w ?? renderer.domElement.width),
  );
  const targetH = Math.max(
    64,
    Math.round(opts.height ?? preset?.h ?? renderer.domElement.height),
  );

  console.log(`[screenshot] rendering ${targetW}×${targetH}`);

  // ── Save camera state ──
  const prevPerspAspect = (cam as THREE.PerspectiveCamera).aspect;
  const prevOrtho =
    cam instanceof THREE.OrthographicCamera
      ? {
          left: cam.left,
          right: cam.right,
          top: cam.top,
          bottom: cam.bottom,
          zoom: cam.zoom,
        }
      : null;

  // ── Save renderer state ──
  const prevTarget = renderer.getRenderTarget();
  const prevAutoClear = renderer.autoClear;
  const prevClearColor = new THREE.Color();
  const prevClearAlpha = renderer.getClearAlpha();
  renderer.getClearColor(prevClearColor);

  const format = opts.format ?? "png";
  const mime = format === "jpeg" ? "image/jpeg" : "image/png";
  const quality = opts.quality ?? 0.95;

  let out: HTMLCanvasElement | null = null;
  let rt: THREE.WebGLRenderTarget | null = null;

  try {
    // ── Adjust camera aspect for the target resolution ──
    if (cam instanceof THREE.PerspectiveCamera) {
      cam.aspect = targetW / targetH;
      cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
    } else if (cam instanceof THREE.OrthographicCamera) {
      const h = cam.top - cam.bottom;
      const w = h * (targetW / targetH);
      const cx = (cam.left + cam.right) / 2;
      cam.left = cx - w / 2;
      cam.right = cx + w / 2;
      cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
    }

    // ── Offscreen render target ──
    // The main WebGL context was created without preserveDrawingBuffer,
    // so `renderer.domElement.toDataURL()` returns a black canvas on
    // Chrome / Edge. A render target is a texture we own; its contents
    // survive the render call and can be read back with readRenderTargetPixels.
    console.log("[screenshot] step 1/5 · creating render target");
    rt = new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(targetW, targetH, {
      format: THREE.RGBAFormat,
      type: THREE.UnsignedByteType,
      depthBuffer: true,
      stencilBuffer: false,
      minFilter: THREE.LinearFilter,
      magFilter: THREE.LinearFilter,
      generateMipmaps: false,
    });
    // Match the renderer's output color space so the pixels we read back
    // look the same as what's on screen. Without this, Three.js writes
    // linear values into the RT and the image looks washed out / dark.
    try {
      const outputCS = (renderer as any).outputColorSpace;
      if (outputCS) (rt.texture as any).colorSpace = outputCS;
    } catch {
      /* */
    }

    console.log("[screenshot] step 2/5 · rendering scene → RT");
    renderer.autoClear = true;
    renderer.setRenderTarget(rt);
    renderer.clear(true, true, true);
    renderer.render(scene, cam);

    console.log("[screenshot] step 3/5 · reading pixels back");
    const pixels = new Uint8Array(targetW * targetH * 4);
    renderer.readRenderTargetPixels(rt, 0, 0, targetW, targetH, pixels);

    // Restore renderer immediately.
    renderer.setRenderTarget(prevTarget);
    renderer.autoClear = prevAutoClear;
    renderer.setClearColor(prevClearColor, prevClearAlpha);
    rt.dispose();
    rt = null;

    // ── Sparse sanity scan ──
    const cx = targetW >> 1;
    const cy = targetH >> 1;
    const sample = (cy * targetW + cx) * 4;
    const r0 = pixels[sample];
    const g0 = pixels[sample + 1];
    const b0 = pixels[sample + 2];
    let nonBlack = 0;
    const stepX = Math.max(1, targetW >> 6);
    const stepY = Math.max(1, targetH >> 6);
    for (let y = 0; y < targetH; y += stepY) {
      for (let x = 0; x < targetW; x += stepX) {
        const i = (y * targetW + x) * 4;
        if (pixels[i] > 8 || pixels[i + 1] > 8 || pixels[i + 2] > 8) nonBlack++;
      }
    }
    if (nonBlack < 4) {
      console.warn(
        `[screenshot] render target appears entirely black (center ${r0},${g0},${b0}). ` +
          "Likely: no models loaded, or camera inside geometry.",
      );
    } else {
      console.log(`[screenshot] pixel sanity OK · ${nonBlack} non-black sample(s)`);
    }

    // ── Flip Y into a 2D canvas ──
    // readRenderTargetPixels returns rows bottom-up; a 2D canvas is top-down.
    console.log("[screenshot] step 4/5 · composing output canvas");
    out = document.createElement("canvas");
    out.width = targetW;
    out.height = targetH;
    const outCtx = out.getContext("2d");
    if (!outCtx) throw new Error("Could not acquire 2D context for output canvas.");

    const imgData = outCtx.createImageData(targetW, targetH);
    const rowBytes = targetW * 4;
    for (let y = 0; y < targetH; y++) {
      const src = (targetH - 1 - y) * rowBytes;
      imgData.data.set(pixels.subarray(src, src + rowBytes), y * rowBytes);
    }
    outCtx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);
  } catch (err) {
    if (rt) {
      try {
        renderer.setRenderTarget(prevTarget);
        renderer.autoClear = prevAutoClear;
        renderer.setClearColor(prevClearColor, prevClearAlpha);
        rt.dispose();
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    }
    console.error("[screenshot] capture failed", err);
    alert(
      "Screenshot failed.\n\n" +
        (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)) +
        "\n\nTry a smaller preset (HD or Native).",
    );
    return;
  } finally {
    // ── Restore camera ──
    try {
      if (
        cam instanceof THREE.PerspectiveCamera &&
        typeof prevPerspAspect === "number"
      ) {
        cam.aspect = prevPerspAspect;
        cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
      } else if (prevOrtho && cam instanceof THREE.OrthographicCamera) {
        cam.left = prevOrtho.left;
        cam.right = prevOrtho.right;
        cam.top = prevOrtho.top;
        cam.bottom = prevOrtho.bottom;
        cam.zoom = prevOrtho.zoom;
        cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
      }
      try {
        ctx.fragments.core.update(true);
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[screenshot] restore failed", err);
    }
  }

  if (!out) return;

  // ── Encode + download ──
  // We use toBlob rather than toDataURL because 4K and 8K PNGs exceed
  // Chrome's ~2 MB data-URL cap, which silently truncates the download.
  const date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace(/[:T]/g, "-");
  const filename =
    opts.filename ??
    `open-bim-studio-${targetW}x${targetH}-${date}.${opts.format ?? "png"}`;

  console.log("[screenshot] step 5/5 · encoding blob…");
  try {
    out.toBlob(
      (blob) => {
        if (!blob) {
          console.error("[screenshot] toBlob returned null — try a smaller preset");
          alert("Encoding failed. Try a smaller preset (HD or Native).");
          return;
        }
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = url;
        a.download = filename;
        a.style.display = "none";
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        setTimeout(() => {
          a.remove();
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        }, 5_000);
        console.log(
          `[screenshot] saved ${filename} · ${targetW}×${targetH} · ` +
            `${(blob.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`,
        );
      },
      mime,
      quality,
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[screenshot] toBlob threw", err);
    alert(
      "Screenshot encoding failed.\n\n" +
        (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)),
    );
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Setup
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function setupCameraTools() {
  ctx.world.scene.three.add(boundsHelperGroup);
  ctx.world.camera.controls.addEventListener("update", () => updateClipping());
  currentProjection = getProjection();
  applyClipping(0.1, 20000);

  // MMB / wheel / dbl-MMB owned by features/navigation.ts via input-router.
  try {
    const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
    if (controls) {
      if ("dollyToCursor" in controls) controls.dollyToCursor = false;
      if ("infinityDolly" in controls) controls.infinityDolly = true;
      if ("smoothTime" in controls) controls.smoothTime = 0.04;
      if ("draggingSmoothTime" in controls) controls.draggingSmoothTime = 0.02;
      if ("azimuthRotateSpeed" in controls) controls.azimuthRotateSpeed = 1.0;
      if ("polarRotateSpeed" in controls) controls.polarRotateSpeed = 1.0;
      if ("truckSpeed" in controls) controls.truckSpeed = 1.0;
      
      try { if ("dollySpeed" in controls) controls.dollySpeed = 0; } catch { /* */ }


      const ACTION = controls.constructor?.ACTION || (window as any).CameraControls?.ACTION;
      if (ACTION && controls.mouseButtons) {
        controls.mouseButtons.left = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
        controls.mouseButtons.middle = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
        controls.mouseButtons.right = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
        controls.mouseButtons.wheel = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[camera] mouse defaults", e);
  }

  // Re-assert after a tick — some OBC versions re-enable defaults asynchronously.
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      const controls: any = ctx.world?.camera?.controls;
      const ACTION = controls?.constructor?.ACTION || (window as any).CameraControls?.ACTION;
      if (ACTION && controls?.mouseButtons) {
        controls.mouseButtons.left = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
        controls.mouseButtons.middle = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
        controls.mouseButtons.right = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
        controls.mouseButtons.wheel = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
      }
      forceResumeCameraControls();
    } catch { /* */ }
  }, 0);

  (window as any).__obsRmbDragging = false;

  // Clipping is driven by the camera-controls "update" listener above.
  // Avoid a permanent rAF loop — it fights navigation and burns CPU.

  Object.assign(ctx.scene, {
    center: sceneCenter,
    box: lastSceneBox,
    computeBounds: computeSceneBounds,
    establishOffset: establishSceneOffset,
    recenter: recenterSceneNow,
    alignOriginToOrigin,
    resetOffsets,
    fitAll,
    fitToMap,
  });

  Object.assign(ctx.cam, {
    updateClipping,
    setProjection,
    zoomBy,
    gotoDir,
    saveHome,
    goHome,
    screenshot: takeScreenshot,
    screenshotPreset: getScreenshotPreset,
    setScreenshotPreset,
    recoverView,
  
    viewExact: (view: ExactView) => gotoExactView(view),
    fitAll,
});
  (ctx.features as any).viewExact = (view: ExactView) => gotoExactView(view);

  const cam: CameraService = {
    fitAll,
    fitToMap,
    focusOnPoint,
    focusOnBox,
    zoomBy,
    gotoDir,
    gotoExactView,
    setProjection,
    getProjection,
    saveHome,
    goHome,
    screenshot: takeScreenshot,
    getScreenshotPreset,
    setScreenshotPreset,
    computeSceneBounds,
    recoverView,
    updateClipping,
    scene: {
      center: sceneCenter,
      box: lastSceneBox,
      radius: () => sceneRadius,
    },
  };
  register("camera", cam);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * CDE panel — pick a provider, sign in, browse folders, download files,
 * push the current scene, push BCF issues.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { makeDockable, type DockHandle } from "./dockable";
import { fmtBytes, fmtRelative } from "../core/format";
import {
  listCdeProviders, getCdeProvider, getCdeProviderMeta,
} from "../modules/cde/registry";
```
