```ts
/**
 * Clash report export: rich HTML and Excel (XLS via HTML table).
 *
 * Both read the currently active clash run from clash.ts and produce a
 * self-contained document with summary, per-status breakdown, and a full
 * clash table with comments.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  listClashes,
  testNameInput,
  getClashState,
  type ClashStatus,
} from "./clash";
import { getCurrentProject } from "../modules/projects/projects";

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Shared data extraction
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

interface Row {
  index: number;
  kind: string;
  status: ClashStatus;
  modelA: string;
  idA: number;
  nameA: string;
  catA: string;
  modelB: string;
  idB: number;
  nameB: string;
  catB: string;
  depthVol: number;   // m³
  minGap: number;     // m
  precision: string;
  triPairs: number;
  comments: { author: string; date: number; text: string }[];
}

function collectRows(): Row[] {
  const clashes = listClashes();
  const out: Row[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < clashes.length; i++) {
    const c = clashes[i];
    const s = getClashState(c);
    out.push({
      index: i + 1,
      kind: c.kind,
      status: s.status,
      modelA: c.a.modelId,
      idA: c.a.localId,
      nameA: c.a.name,
      catA: c.a.cat,
      modelB: c.b.modelId,
      idB: c.b.localId,
      nameB: c.b.name,
      catB: c.b.cat,
      depthVol: c.depthVol,
      minGap: c.minGap,
      precision: c.precision,
      triPairs: c.triPairs,
      comments: s.comments.map((cm) => ({
        author: cm.author,
        date: cm.date,
        text: cm.text,
      })),
    });
  }
  return out;
}

function summarize(rows: Row[]) {
  const byStatus: Record<ClashStatus, number> = {
    new: 0, active: 0, reviewed: 0, approved: 0, resolved: 0,
  };
  const byKind: Record<string, number> = { intersect: 0, touching: 0, clearance: 0 };
  for (const r of rows) {
    byStatus[r.status]++;
    byKind[r.kind] = (byKind[r.kind] ?? 0) + 1;
  }
  return { byStatus, byKind, total: rows.length };
}

const esc = (s: string) =>
  String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);

const fmtDate = (t: number) => new Date(t).toLocaleString();

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   HTML report
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

export function buildClashReportHtml(): string {
  const rows = collectRows();
  const summary = summarize(rows);
  const project = getCurrentProject();
  const testName = testNameInput.value || "Clash Test";

  const statusColor: Record<ClashStatus, string> = {
    new: "#38BDF8",
    active: "#F59E0B",
    reviewed: "#C084FC",
    approved: "#22C55E",
    resolved: "#6B7280",
  };

  const kindColor: Record<string, string> = {
    intersect: "#EF4444",
    touching: "#F59E0B",
    clearance: "#38BDF8",
  };

  let html = `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Clash Report — ${esc(testName)}</title>
<style>
  body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
         background: #f5f6f8; color: #1a1d23; margin: 0; padding: 32px; }
  h1 { font-size: 22px; margin: 0 0 6px; }
  h2 { font-size: 15px; margin: 32px 0 10px; color: #3d4250;
       border-bottom: 1px solid #d5d8de; padding-bottom: 6px; }
  .meta { color: #6b7280; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
  .cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px,1fr));
           gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
  .card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e3e6ea; border-radius: 8px;
          padding: 12px 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04); }
  .card .label { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .6px;
                 color: #6b7280; }
  .card .value { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 4px;
                 font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; }
  table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #fff;
          border: 1px solid #e3e6ea; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;
          font-size: 11px; }
  th { background: #f0f2f5; text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px;
       font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase;
       letter-spacing: .4px; color: #4b5563; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e6ea;
       white-space: nowrap; }
  td { padding: 7px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef0f3; vertical-align: top; }
  tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
  tr:hover td { background: #fafbfc; }
  .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 3px;
           font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .3px;
           text-transform: uppercase; }
  .num { text-align: right; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; }
  .comment { border-left: 2px solid #e5e7eb; padding: 3px 8px; margin: 3px 0;
             background: #f9fafb; font-size: 10px; color: #4b5563; }
  .footer { margin-top: 40px; color: #9ca3af; font-size: 10px; text-align: center; }
  @media print {
    body { padding: 0; background: #fff; }
    .card, table { box-shadow: none; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<h1>${esc(testName)} — Clash Report</h1>
<div class="meta">
  ${project ? `Project: <b>${esc(project.name)}</b> · ` : ""}
  Generated: ${fmtDate(Date.now())} ·
  ${summary.total} clash${summary.total === 1 ? "" : "es"}
</div>

<div class="cards">
  <div class="card"><div class="label">Total</div><div class="value">${summary.total}</div></div>`;

  for (const s of ["new", "active", "reviewed", "approved", "resolved"] as ClashStatus[]) {
    html += `<div class="card"><div class="label" style="color:${statusColor[s]}">${s}</div>
             <div class="value" style="color:${statusColor[s]}">${summary.byStatus[s]}</div></div>`;
  }
  for (const k of ["intersect", "touching", "clearance"]) {
    html += `<div class="card"><div class="label" style="color:${kindColor[k]}">${k}</div>
             <div class="value" style="color:${kindColor[k]}">${summary.byKind[k] ?? 0}</div></div>`;
  }

  html += `</div>

<h2>Clashes</h2>
<table>
<thead><tr>
  <th>#</th><th>Kind</th><th>Status</th>
  <th>Model A</th><th>Element A</th>
  <th>Model B</th><th>Element B</th>
  <th>Gap / Overlap</th><th>Precision</th><th>Comments</th>
</tr></thead>
<tbody>`;

  if (!rows.length) {
    html += `<tr><td colspan="10" style="text-align:center;color:#9ca3af;padding:20px">
             No clashes. Run a test first.</td></tr>`;
  } else {
    for (const r of rows) {
      const gapText = r.kind === "intersect"
        ? `${(r.depthVol * 1e6).toFixed(1)} cm³`
        : `${(r.minGap * 1000).toFixed(1)} mm`;
      const cmt = r.comments.length
        ? r.comments.map((c) =>
            `<div class="comment"><b>${esc(c.author)}</b> · ${fmtDate(c.date)}<br/>${esc(c.text)}</div>`,
          ).join("")
        : `<span style="color:#9ca3af">—</span>`;

      html += `<tr>
        <td>${r.index}</td>
        <td><span class="badge" style="background:${kindColor[r.kind]};color:#fff">${r.kind}</span></td>
        <td><span class="badge" style="background:${statusColor[r.status]};color:#fff">${r.status}</span></td>
        <td style="color:#6b7280;font-size:10px">${esc(r.modelA)}</td>
        <td>${esc(r.nameA)}<br/><span style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:10px">${esc(r.catA)} · #${r.idA}</span></td>
        <td style="color:#6b7280;font-size:10px">${esc(r.modelB)}</td>
        <td>${esc(r.nameB)}<br/><span style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:10px">${esc(r.catB)} · #${r.idB}</span></td>
        <td class="num">${gapText}</td>
        <td style="font-size:10px;color:#6b7280">${r.precision}${r.triPairs ? ` · ${r.triPairs} pairs` : ""}</td>
        <td>${cmt}</td>
      </tr>`;
    }
  }

  html += `</tbody></table>

<div class="footer">
  Open BIM Studio · Clash Detective report · generated ${fmtDate(Date.now())}
</div>
</body></html>`;

  return html;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public: HTML download
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

export function exportClashReportHtml(): void {
  const rows = collectRows();
  if (!rows.length) {
    alert("No clashes to report. Run a test first.");
    return;
  }
  const html = buildClashReportHtml();
  const blob = new Blob([html], { type: "text/html;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `clash-report-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.html`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
}

/** Open the HTML report in a new tab, for previewing / printing. */
export function previewClashReportHtml(): void {
  const rows = collectRows();
  if (!rows.length) {
    alert("No clashes to report. Run a test first.");
    return;
  }
  const html = buildClashReportHtml();
  const w = window.open("", "_blank");
  if (!w) {
    alert("Popup blocked — allow popups to preview.");
    return;
  }
  w.document.write(html);
  w.document.close();
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Clash Review — a dedicated floating window for fast clash navigation.
 *
 * Opens over the viewport, focuses the first clash automatically, and lets
 * you walk through every clash with:
 *
 *   ▼ Next (or ↓ / J / PageDown)
 *   ▲ Previous (or ↑ / K / PageUp)
 *   I       → isolate the current pair
 *   F       → re-focus the current pair
 *   Space   → cycle the current clash's status
 *   Esc     → close the window
 *
 * The current pair is highlighted, cropped, and (optionally) isolated in the
 * viewport every time you navigate. The cursor is fully synced with
 * clash.ts's `activeClash`, so clicking a row in the left-panel list also
 * moves the review cursor.
 */
import { inputRouter } from "../core/input-router";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  listClashes,
  getActiveClashIndex,
  focusClashByIndex,
  isolateClashPair,
  getClashState,
  setClashStatus,
  addClashComment,
  type ClashStatus,
} from "./clash";
import type { ElementClash, ClashKind } from "./clash-engine";

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Constants
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const POS_KEY = "obs.clashReview.position";
const ISO_KEY = "obs.clashReview.autoIsolate";

const STATUS_ORDER: ClashStatus[] = ["new", "active", "reviewed", "approved", "resolved"];

const STATUS_COLOR: Record<ClashStatus, string> = {
  new: "#38bdf8",
  active: "#f59e0b",
  reviewed: "#c084fc",
  approved: "#22c55e",
  resolved: "#6b7280",
};

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<ClashStatus, string> = {
  new: "New",
  active: "Active",
  reviewed: "Reviewed",
  approved: "Approved",
  resolved: "Resolved",
};

const KIND_COLOR: Record<ClashKind, string> = {
  intersect: "#ef4444",
  touching: "#f59e0b",
  clearance: "#38bdf8",
  duplicate: "#a855f7",
};

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   State
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let panel: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let navLock = false;
let autoIsolate = true;
let pollTimer: number | null = null;
let lastRenderedIndex = -1;

try {
  const v = localStorage.getItem(ISO_KEY);
  if (v != null) autoIsolate = v === "1";
} catch { /* */ }

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Utilities
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const esc = (s: string) =>
  String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);

function shortCat(cat: string): string {
  return cat.replace(/^IFC/i, "").replace(/STANDARDCASE$/i, "") || cat;
}

function fmtMetric(c: ElementClash): string {
  if (c.kind === "intersect") {
    const cm3 = c.depthVol * 1e6;
    if (cm3 >= 1000) return `${(cm3 / 1000).toFixed(2)} dm³ overlap`;
    return `${cm3.toFixed(1)} cm³ overlap`;
  }
  if (c.kind === "duplicate") {
    return `Identical bounding box (Δ ≤ ${(c.minGap * 1000).toFixed(1)} mm)`;
  }
  const mm = c.minGap * 1000;
  if (mm >= 1000) return `Gap ${(mm / 1000).toFixed(2)} m`;
  return `Gap ${mm.toFixed(0)} mm`;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Panel construction
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function ensurePanel(): HTMLDivElement {
  if (panel) return panel;

  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = "obs-clash-review";
  panel.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;z-index:8000;width:440px;max-height:82vh;display:none;" +
    "flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:12px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.65);" +
    "font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);" +
    "overflow:hidden;user-select:none";
  panel.onmousedown = (e) => e.stopPropagation();

  /* Position */
  let px = 40, py = 120;
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(POS_KEY);
    if (stored) {
      const p = JSON.parse(stored);
      px = Number(p.x) || px;
      py = Number(p.y) || py;
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  panel.style.left = `${px}px`;
  panel.style.top = `${py}px`;

  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div id="ocr-header" style="
      display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;
      border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);
      background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);cursor:move;user-select:none">
      <span style="display:flex;color:var(--accent,#38bdf8);font-size:14px">◆</span>
      <div style="flex:1;font-weight:700;font-size:13px">Clash Review</div>
      <div id="ocr-count-pill" style="
        padding:2px 10px;border-radius:20px;font:600 11px var(--font-mono,monospace);
        background:var(--accent-dim,rgba(56,189,248,.14));color:var(--accent,#38bdf8)">
        0 / 0
      </div>
      <button id="ocr-close" title="Close (Esc)" style="
        padding:4px 8px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5);
        border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:5px;
        cursor:pointer;font-size:11px">✕</button>
    </div>

    <div id="ocr-nav" style="display:flex;gap:6px;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)">
      <button id="ocr-prev" style="
        flex:1;padding:12px;font:700 14px system-ui;cursor:pointer;
        background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);
        border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:8px;
        display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
        transition:background .12s">▲ Previous</button>
      <button id="ocr-next" style="
        flex:1;padding:12px;font:700 14px system-ui;cursor:pointer;
        background:var(--accent,#38bdf8);color:#0b0d12;border:none;
        border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
        transition:background .12s">Next ▼</button>
    </div>

    <div id="ocr-body" style="flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:12px"></div>

    <div id="ocr-progress" style="
      padding:8px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);
      background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px">
      <div style="height:4px;background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden">
        <div id="ocr-progress-bar" style="height:100%;width:0%;
          background:linear-gradient(90deg,#38bdf8,#818cf8);transition:width .2s"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;
        color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace)">
        <span id="ocr-progress-text">0 / 0</span>
        <span>↑↓ navigate · I isolate · F focus · Space cycle · Esc close</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  document.body.appendChild(panel);

  /* ── Wire controls ── */
  (panel.querySelector("#ocr-close") as HTMLElement).onclick = () => closeReview();
  (panel.querySelector("#ocr-prev") as HTMLElement).onclick = () => void navigate(-1);
  (panel.querySelector("#ocr-next") as HTMLElement).onclick = () => void navigate(+1);

  /* ── Draggable header ── */
  const header = panel.querySelector("#ocr-header") as HTMLElement;
  let dragging = false;
  let dragOffset = { x: 0, y: 0 };

  header.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).id === "ocr-close") return;
    dragging = true;
    const r = panel!.getBoundingClientRect();
    dragOffset = { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
    (e.target as Element).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    header.style.cursor = "grabbing";
  });
  header.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 80, e.clientX - dragOffset.x));
    const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 40, e.clientY - dragOffset.y));
    panel!.style.left = `${x}px`;
    panel!.style.top = `${y}px`;
  });
  header.addEventListener("pointerup", (e) => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    dragging = false;
    (e.target as Element).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    header.style.cursor = "move";
    try {
      const r = panel!.getBoundingClientRect();
      localStorage.setItem(POS_KEY, JSON.stringify({ x: r.left, y: r.top }));
    } catch { /* */ }
  });

  return panel;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Rendering
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function render(): void {
  if (!panel) return;
  const clashes = listClashes();
  const total = clashes.length;

  if (total === 0) {
    (panel.querySelector("#ocr-body") as HTMLElement).innerHTML =
      `<div style="padding:30px 20px;text-align:center;color:#6b7280;line-height:1.6">
         No clash results.<br>Run a clash test first.
       </div>`;
    (panel.querySelector("#ocr-count-pill") as HTMLElement).textContent = `0 / 0`;
    (panel.querySelector("#ocr-progress-text") as HTMLElement).textContent = `0 / 0`;
    (panel.querySelector("#ocr-progress-bar") as HTMLElement).style.width = "0%";
    return;
  }

  const idx = Math.max(0, getActiveClashIndex());
  const c = clashes[idx];
  if (!c) return;

  lastRenderedIndex = idx;

  (panel.querySelector("#ocr-count-pill") as HTMLElement).textContent =
    `${idx + 1} / ${total}`;
  (panel.querySelector("#ocr-progress-text") as HTMLElement).textContent =
    `${idx + 1} / ${total} · ${((idx + 1) / total * 100).toFixed(0)}%`;
  (panel.querySelector("#ocr-progress-bar") as HTMLElement).style.width =
    `${((idx + 1) / total) * 100}%`;

  const state = getClashState(c);
  const kindColor = KIND_COLOR[c.kind];

  const body = panel.querySelector("#ocr-body") as HTMLElement;
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px">
      <span style="background:${kindColor};color:#0f1117;padding:3px 8px;
        border-radius:4px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.4px">
        ${c.kind.toUpperCase()}
      </span>
      <span style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;
        background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#94a3b8;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace)">
        ${c.method}
      </span>
      <span style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;
        background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#94a3b8;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace)">
        ${c.precision}
      </span>
    </div>

    <div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:${kindColor};margin-bottom:12px">
      ${fmtMetric(c)}
    </div>

    <div style="border:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);border-radius:8px;
      overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:12px">
      <div style="padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(59,130,246,.10);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px">
          <span style="background:#3b82f6;color:#fff;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;
            font-size:9px;font-weight:800">A</span>
          <span style="font-size:10px;color:#93c5fd;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace)">
            ${esc(shortCat(c.a.cat))} · #${c.a.localId}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;word-break:break-word">
          ${esc(c.a.name)}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(234,179,8,.10)">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px">
          <span style="background:#eab308;color:#0f1117;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;
            font-size:9px;font-weight:800">B</span>
          <span style="font-size:10px;color:#fde047;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace)">
            ${esc(shortCat(c.b.cat))} · #${c.b.localId}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;word-break:break-word">
          ${esc(c.b.name)}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px">
      <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:11px;color:#a0a6b5">
        Status
      </label>
      <select id="ocr-status" style="flex:1;padding:5px 8px;background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);
        border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:5px;
        color:${STATUS_COLOR[state.status]};font:600 11px system-ui;cursor:pointer">
        ${STATUS_ORDER.map((s) =>
          `<option value="${s}" ${state.status === s ? "selected" : ""}>${STATUS_LABEL[s]}</option>`
        ).join("")}
      </select>
      <button id="ocr-isolate" style="padding:5px 12px;background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);
        color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);
        border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font:600 11px system-ui">🔍 Isolate</button>
      <button id="ocr-showall" style="padding:5px 12px;background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);
        color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);
        border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font:600 11px system-ui">👁 Show all</button>
    </div>

    <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;
      color:#a0a6b5;margin-bottom:12px;cursor:pointer">
      <input type="checkbox" id="ocr-auto-iso" ${autoIsolate ? "checked" : ""}
        style="cursor:pointer;margin:0">
      Auto-isolate each clash when navigating
    </label>

    ${state.comments.length ? `
      <div style="font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;
        color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:6px">Comments (${state.comments.length})</div>
      <div style="border-left:2px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);padding-left:8px;
        margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px">
        ${state.comments.map((cm) => `
          <div style="background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);border-radius:5px;padding:6px 8px">
            <div style="font-size:9.5px;color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:3px">
              <b style="color:#a0a6b5">${esc(cm.author)}</b> · ${new Date(cm.date).toLocaleString()}
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;word-break:break-word">${esc(cm.text)}</div>
          </div>
        `).join("")}
      </div>
    ` : ""}

    <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:4px">
      <input id="ocr-comment-input" type="text" placeholder="Add comment…"
        style="flex:1;padding:6px 9px;background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);
        border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:5px;
        color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:12px system-ui">
      <button id="ocr-comment-add" style="padding:6px 14px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;
        border:none;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font:600 11px system-ui">Add</button>
    </div>
  `;

  /* ── Body event wiring ── */
  (body.querySelector("#ocr-status") as HTMLSelectElement).onchange = (e) => {
    const v = (e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value as ClashStatus;
    setClashStatus(c, v);
    render();
  };
  (body.querySelector("#ocr-isolate") as HTMLElement).onclick = async () => {
    await isolateClashPair(c);
  };
  (body.querySelector("#ocr-showall") as HTMLElement).onclick = async () => {
    try {
      const hider: any = (await import("../core/context")).ctx.hider;
      if (typeof hider.show === "function") await hider.show();
      else if (typeof hider.set === "function") await hider.set(true);
    } catch { /* */ }
  };
  (body.querySelector("#ocr-auto-iso") as HTMLInputElement).onchange = (e) => {
    autoIsolate = (e.target as HTMLInputElement).checked;
    try { localStorage.setItem(ISO_KEY, autoIsolate ? "1" : "0"); } catch { /* */ }
  };
  (body.querySelector("#ocr-comment-add") as HTMLElement).onclick = () => {
    const inp = body.querySelector("#ocr-comment-input") as HTMLInputElement;
    if (!inp.value.trim()) return;
    addClashComment(c, inp.value);
    inp.value = "";
    render();
  };
  (body.querySelector("#ocr-comment-input") as HTMLInputElement).onkeydown = (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      (body.querySelector("#ocr-comment-add") as HTMLElement).click();
    }
    e.stopPropagation();
  };
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Navigation
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
async function navigate(delta: number): Promise<void> {
  if (navLock) return;
  const clashes = listClashes();
  if (!clashes.length) return;

  navLock = true;
  try {
    const idx = Math.max(0, getActiveClashIndex());
    const next = ((idx + delta) % clashes.length + clashes.length) % clashes.length;
    await focusClashByIndex(next);

    const c = clashes[next];
    if (autoIsolate && c) {
      try { await isolateClashPair(c); } catch { /* */ }
    }
    render();
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[clash-review] navigate failed", err);
  } finally {
    navLock = false;
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Keyboard
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function isOpen(): boolean {
  return !!panel && panel.style.display === "flex";
}

function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
  if (!isOpen()) return;

  // Don't steal keys while typing.
  const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
  if (t) {
    const tag = t.tagName?.toLowerCase();
    if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || t.isContentEditable) {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        (t as HTMLElement).blur();
        closeReview();
      }
      return;
    }
  }

  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();

  if (k === "escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    closeReview();
    return;
  }
  if (k === "arrowdown" || k === "j" || k === "pagedown") {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    void navigate(+1);
    return;
  }
  if (k === "arrowup" || k === "k" || k === "pageup") {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    void navigate(-1);
    return;
  }
  if (k === "i") {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    const c = listClashes()[getActiveClashIndex()];
    if (c) void isolateClashPair(c);
    return;
  }
  if (k === "f") {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    const idx = Math.max(0, getActiveClashIndex());
    void focusClashByIndex(idx);
    return;
  }
  if (k === " ") {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    const c = listClashes()[getActiveClashIndex()];
    if (c) {
      const s = getClashState(c);
      const i = STATUS_ORDER.indexOf(s.status);
      const next = STATUS_ORDER[(i + 1) % STATUS_ORDER.length];
      setClashStatus(c, next);
      render();
    }
    return;
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public API
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function openReview(): void {
  ensurePanel();
  if (!panel) return;
  panel.style.display = "flex";

  // Focus the first clash if nothing is active yet.
  if (getActiveClashIndex() < 0 && listClashes().length) {
    void focusClashByIndex(0).then(() => {
      const c = listClashes()[0];
      if (autoIsolate && c) void isolateClashPair(c).catch(() => {});
      render();
    });
  } else {
    render();
  }

  // Poll for changes to activeClash coming from elsewhere (left-panel list).
  if (pollTimer == null) {
    pollTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (!isOpen()) return;
      const idx = getActiveClashIndex();
      if (idx !== lastRenderedIndex) render();
    }, 300);
  }
}

export function closeReview(): void {
  if (panel) panel.style.display = "none";
  if (pollTimer != null) {
    clearInterval(pollTimer);
    pollTimer = null;
  }
}

export function toggleReview(): void {
  isOpen() ? closeReview() : openReview();
}

export function isReviewVisible(): boolean {
  return isOpen();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Setup
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function setupClashReview(): void {
  // Escape goes through the input-router cancel stack (LIFO, first-consume-wins).
  const unsubCancel = inputRouter.registerCancel(() => {
    if (!isOpen()) return false;
    const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    if (active && (active.tagName === "INPUT" || active.tagName === "TEXTAREA")) {
      active.blur();
    }
    closeReview();
    return true;
  });

  // Remaining navigation keys stay local — they only act when the review
  // panel is open, so they don't conflict with the router.
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") return; // owned by registerCancel
    onKeyDown(e);
  }, true);

  // Expose for the panel button and shortcuts.
  (window as any).__obs_openClashReview = openReview;
  (window as any).__obs_closeClashReview = closeReview;
  (window as any).__obs_toggleClashReview = toggleReview;

  (ctx.features as any).clashReview = { dispose: unsubCancel };

  console.log("[clash-review] ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Clash worker client.
 *
 * Spawns the worker once, reuses it, falls back to main-thread engine if
 * the worker cannot be created. Public API mirrors runClashEngine.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import {
  collectItems,
  runClashEngine,
  type ClashInput,
  type ClashRunOptions,
} from "./clash-engine";
import {
  DEFAULT_CLASH_RULES,
  type ClashMethod,
  type ClashProgress,
  type ClashRules,
  type ElementClash,
} from "../modules/clash/clash-core";
import type { ClashCoreItem } from "../modules/clash/clash-core";

// -- Unified cancel signal -----------------------------------------------
// Supports both W3C AbortSignal and the legacy { cancelled: boolean } shape
// used by older ClashRunOptions callers.
type CancelSignal =
  | { cancelled: boolean }
  | AbortSignal
  | undefined;

function isAbortSignal(s: CancelSignal): s is AbortSignal {
  return !!s && typeof (s as AbortSignal).addEventListener === "function";
}

function isCancelled(s: CancelSignal): boolean {
  if (!s) return false;
  if (isAbortSignal(s)) return s.aborted;
  return (s as { cancelled: boolean }).cancelled === true;
}

type InMessage =
  | { type: "progress"; requestId: string; progress: ClashProgress }
  | {
      type: "result";
      requestId: string;
      clashes: Array<{
        a: ElementClash["a"];
        b: ElementClash["b"];
        kind: ElementClash["kind"];
        method: ElementClash["method"];
        precision: ElementClash["precision"];
        depthVol: number;
        triPairs: number;
        minGap: number;
        boxA: [number, number, number, number, number, number];
        boxB: [number, number, number, number, number, number];
        point: [number, number, number] | null;
      }>;
    }
  | { type: "error"; requestId: string; message: string; stack?: string };

type OutMessage =
  | {
      type: "run";
      requestId: string;
      items: unknown[];
      groups: unknown;
      rules: ClashRules;
      method: ClashMethod;
      selfPairs: boolean;
    }
  | { type: "cancel"; requestId: string };

interface Pending {
  resolve: (clashes: ElementClash[]) => void;
  reject: (err: unknown) => void;
  onProgress?: (p: ClashProgress) => void;
}

let worker: Worker | null = null;
let workerFailed = false;
const pending = new Map<string, Pending>();
let nextRequestId = 0;

function spawnWorker(): Worker | null {
  if (worker) return worker;
  if (workerFailed) return null;
  try {
    worker = new Worker(new URL("../workers/clash.worker.ts", import.meta.url), {
      type: "module",
      name: "obs-clash-worker",
    });
    worker.addEventListener("message", onWorkerMessage);
    worker.addEventListener("error", onWorkerError);
    console.log("[clash-worker] spawned");
    return worker;
  } catch (err) {
    workerFailed = true;
    console.warn("[clash-worker] could not spawn — using main thread", err);
    return null;
  }
}

type SerializedClash = {
  a: ElementClash["a"];
  b: ElementClash["b"];
  kind: ElementClash["kind"];
  method: ElementClash["method"];
  precision: ElementClash["precision"];
  depthVol: number;
  triPairs: number;
  minGap: number;
  boxA: [number, number, number, number, number, number];
  boxB: [number, number, number, number, number, number];
  point: [number, number, number] | null;
};

function rehydrateClash(s: SerializedClash): ElementClash {
  const boxA = new THREE.Box3(
    new THREE.Vector3(s.boxA[0], s.boxA[1], s.boxA[2]),
    new THREE.Vector3(s.boxA[3], s.boxA[4], s.boxA[5]),
  );
  const boxB = new THREE.Box3(
    new THREE.Vector3(s.boxB[0], s.boxB[1], s.boxB[2]),
    new THREE.Vector3(s.boxB[3], s.boxB[4], s.boxB[5]),
  );
  const point = s.point
    ? new THREE.Vector3(s.point[0], s.point[1], s.point[2])
    : null;
  return {
    a: s.a,
    b: s.b,
    kind: s.kind,
    method: s.method,
    precision: s.precision,
    depthVol: s.depthVol,
    triPairs: s.triPairs,
    minGap: s.minGap,
    boxA,
    boxB,
    point,
  };
}

function onWorkerMessage(e: MessageEvent<InMessage>): void {
  const msg = e.data;
  const p = pending.get(msg.requestId);
  if (!p) return;

  if (msg.type === "progress") {
    p.onProgress?.(msg.progress);
    return;
  }
  if (msg.type === "result") {
    pending.delete(msg.requestId);
    p.resolve(msg.clashes.map(rehydrateClash));
    return;
  }
  if (msg.type === "error") {
    pending.delete(msg.requestId);
    console.error("[clash-worker] error from worker", msg.message, msg.stack);
    p.reject(new Error(msg.message));
  }
}

function onWorkerError(e: ErrorEvent): void {
  console.error("[clash-worker] fatal worker error", e.message, e.error);
  workerFailed = true;
  worker?.terminate();
  worker = null;
  const reason = new Error(`Clash worker crashed: ${e.message}`);
  for (const [, p] of pending) p.reject(reason);
  pending.clear();
}

function serializeItem(item: ClashCoreItem): {
  payload: unknown;
  transfer: Transferable[];
} {
  const min = item.box.min;
  const max = item.box.max;
  const box: [number, number, number, number, number, number] = [
    min.x, min.y, min.z, max.x, max.y, max.z,
  ];

  let positions: Float32Array | undefined;
  const transfer: Transferable[] = [];

  if (item.tris?.length) {
    const total = item.tris.length * 9;
    positions = new Float32Array(total);
    let n = 0;
    for (const t of item.tris) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) positions[n++] = t[i];
    }
    transfer.push(positions.buffer);
  }

  return {
    payload: {
      modelId: item.modelId,
      localId: item.localId,
      name: item.name,
      category: item.category,
      box,
      positions,
    },
    transfer,
  };
}

/**
 * Run clash detection, preferring the worker. Falls back to main thread.
 */
export async function runClashOffThread(
  inputs: ClashInput[],
  opts: ClashRunOptions = {},
): Promise<ElementClash[]> {
  if ((globalThis as any).__obs_forceMainThread) {
    return runClashEngine(inputs, opts);
  }

  const rules: ClashRules = { ...DEFAULT_CLASH_RULES, ...(opts.rules ?? {}) };
  const method: ClashMethod = opts.method ?? "hard-triangle";
  const allowSelfPairs = opts.allowSelfPairs ?? true;
  const onProg = opts.onProgress ?? (() => {});

  const w = spawnWorker();
  if (!w) {
    console.log("[clash-worker] fallback → main thread");
    return runClashEngine(inputs, opts);
  }

  onProg({ phase: "broadphase", current: 0, total: 0, found: 0 });
  const collected = await collectItems(inputs, opts);
  if (!collected.items.length) {
    onProg({ phase: "done", current: 0, total: 0, found: 0 });
    return [];
  }

  const payloadItems: unknown[] = [];
  const transfer: Transferable[] = [];
  for (const it of collected.items) {
    const { payload, transfer: t } = serializeItem(it);
    payloadItems.push(payload);
    for (const b of t) transfer.push(b);
  }

  const requestId = `cr-${++nextRequestId}-${Date.now()}`;

  return new Promise<ElementClash[]>((resolve, reject) => {
    // Immediate cancel path — works with both AbortSignal and the legacy
    // { cancelled: boolean } shape.
    const sendCancel = (): void => {
      try {
        const msg: OutMessage = { type: "cancel", requestId };
        w.postMessage(msg);
      } catch { /* worker already gone */ }
    };

    const signal = opts.signal as CancelSignal;

    if (isCancelled(signal)) {
      reject(new DOMException("Clash cancelled", "AbortError"));
      return;
    }

    // Only standard AbortSignal supports event-driven cancel; the legacy
    // shape is polled in onProgress below.
    const onAbort = (): void => sendCancel();
    if (isAbortSignal(signal)) {
      signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
    }

    const cleanup = (): void => {
      if (isAbortSignal(signal)) {
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
      }
    };

    pending.set(requestId, {
      resolve: (r) => { cleanup(); resolve(r); },
      reject:  (e) => { cleanup(); reject(e); },
      onProgress: (p) => {
        onProg(p);
        // Belt-and-braces for both shapes: poll for cancel between ticks.
        if (isCancelled(signal)) sendCancel();
      },
    });

    try {
      const runMsg: OutMessage = {
        type: "run",
        requestId,
        items: payloadItems,
        groups: collected.groups,
        rules,
        method,
        selfPairs: allowSelfPairs,
      };
      w.postMessage(runMsg, transfer);
    } catch (err) {
      pending.delete(requestId);
      console.warn("[clash-worker] postMessage failed — falling back", err);
      // A single postMessage failure (e.g. detached buffer) is NOT a worker
      // crash. Leave workerFailed alone so the next clash run still tries
      // the worker.
      void runClashEngine(inputs, opts).then(resolve, reject);
    }
  });
}

export function disposeClashWorker(): void {
  if (worker) {
    worker.removeEventListener("message", onWorkerMessage);
    worker.removeEventListener("error", onWorkerError);
    worker.terminate();
    worker = null;
  }
  for (const [, p] of pending) {
    p.reject(new Error("Clash worker disposed"));
  }
  pending.clear();
  // Reset the failure flag so a subsequent run can respawn a fresh worker.
  workerFailed = false;
}

// Vite HMR: tear the worker down when this module is hot-replaced.
if (import.meta.hot) {
  import.meta.hot.dispose(() => {
    try { disposeClashWorker(); } catch { /* HMR best-effort */ }
  });
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Command Palette — VSCode-style fuzzy command launcher.
 *
 *   Ctrl+P       open
 *   Type         fuzzy filter across label + category + hint
 *   ↑ / ↓        navigate
 *   Enter        run selected command
 *   Esc          close
 *
 * Commands are contributed by any module via `registerCommand()`; the palette
 * itself ships a bootstrap list of application commands on first setup.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { services } from "../core/services";
import { notify } from "../core/notify";
import {
  fitAll, goHome, gotoDir, takeScreenshot, setProjection, getProjection,
  recenterSceneNow, alignOriginToOrigin, resetOffsets,
} from "./camera-tools";
import { toggleMeasure, isMeasureEnabled } from "./measure";
import { toggleSection, isSectionOn } from "./section";
import { toggleIssuesPanel, isIssuesPanelVisible } from "./issues-panel";
import { toggleCostPanel, isCostPanelVisible, recalculateTakeoff } from "./cost-panel";
import { toggleIdsPanel, isIdsPanelVisible } from "./ids-panel";
import { toggleModelTreePanel, isModelTreePanelVisible } from "./model-tree-panel";
import { togglePlanView, isPlanViewVisible } from "./plan-view-panel";
import { toggleSchedules, isSchedulesVisible } from "./schedules-panel";
import { toggleWalkMode, isWalkModeEnabled } from "./walk-mode";
import { toggleSavedViewsPanel, isSavedViewsPanelVisible } from "./saved-views";
import {
  setAuthoringTool, getActiveTool,
  deleteSelectedElement, clearAllElements,
} from "./authoring";
import {
  runElementClashDetection, clearClash,
} from "./clash";
import { history } from "./history";
import { selection } from "./selection";
import { saveProject, createProject, getCurrentProject } from "../modules/projects/projects";
import { showHome } from "../shell/home-screen";
import { pickAndImport } from "./file-interop";

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Types
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export interface PaletteCommand {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  category?: string;
  hint?: string;
  kbd?: string;
  run: () => unknown;
  /** Return false to hide the command in the current state. */
  when?: () => boolean;
}

interface Ranked {
  cmd: PaletteCommand;
  score: number;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Fuzzy matcher — simple subsequence score
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function fuzzyScore(query: string, target: string): number {
  const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
  const t = target.toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return 1;
  let qi = 0;
  let score = 0;
  let streak = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < t.length && qi < q.length; i++) {
    if (t[i] === q[qi]) {
      qi++;
      streak++;
      score += 2 + streak;
      // Bonus: word boundary
      if (i === 0 || /[\s\-_./]/.test(t[i - 1])) score += 6;
    } else {
      streak = 0;
      score -= 0.2;
    }
  }
  return qi < q.length ? -1 : score;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Registry
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const commands = new Map<string, PaletteCommand>();

export function registerCommand(cmd: PaletteCommand): void {
  commands.set(cmd.id, cmd);
}
export function unregisterCommand(id: string): void {
  commands.delete(id);
}
export function listCommands(): PaletteCommand[] {
  return [...commands.values()];
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DOM
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let root: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let input: HTMLInputElement | null = null;
let listEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let results: Ranked[] = [];
let activeIndex = 0;
let open = false;

const T_BTN =
  "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;" +
  "cursor:pointer;font:12px/1.35 system-ui,sans-serif;color:inherit";

function ensureDOM(): void {
  if (root) return;

  root = document.createElement("div");
  root.id = "obs-command-palette";
  root.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9500;display:none;align-items:flex-start;" +
    "justify-content:center;padding-top:14vh;background:rgba(8,9,12,.55);" +
    "backdrop-filter:blur(3px)";

  const card = document.createElement("div");
  card.style.cssText =
    "width:min(640px,92vw);background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.55);overflow:hidden;" +
    "display:flex;flex-direction:column";

  const inputWrap = document.createElement("div");
  inputWrap.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px;" +
    "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)";

  const searchIcon = document.createElement("div");
  searchIcon.style.cssText = "color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);display:flex";
  searchIcon.innerHTML =
    `<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" ` +
    `stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">` +
    `<circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20 L16.65 16.65"/></svg>`;

  input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "text";
  input.placeholder = "Type a command…  (e.g. wall, clash, export)";
  input.style.cssText =
    "flex:1;background:transparent;border:none;outline:none;color:" +
    "var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:14px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif";
  input.autocomplete = "off";
  input.spellcheck = false;

  inputWrap.append(searchIcon, input);

  listEl = document.createElement("div");
  listEl.style.cssText =
    "max-height:52vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px;display:flex;" +
    "flex-direction:column;gap:2px";

  card.append(inputWrap, listEl);
  root.appendChild(card);

  // Click outside closes.
  root.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
    if (e.target === root) closePalette();
  });

  document.body.appendChild(root);

  input.addEventListener("input", () => updateResults());
  input.addEventListener("keydown", onInputKeyDown);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Filtering + rendering
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function filterCommands(query: string): Ranked[] {
  const out: Ranked[] = [];
  for (const cmd of commands.values()) {
    if (cmd.when && !cmd.when()) continue;
    const haystack = `${cmd.label} ${cmd.category ?? ""} ${cmd.hint ?? ""}`;
    const score = query ? fuzzyScore(query, haystack) : 1;
    if (score >= 0) out.push({ cmd, score });
  }
  out.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.cmd.label.localeCompare(b.cmd.label));
  return out.slice(0, 40);
}

function renderResults(): void {
  if (!listEl) return;
  listEl.innerHTML = "";

  if (!results.length) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.style.cssText =
      "padding:20px;text-align:center;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);" +
      "font:12px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif";
    empty.textContent = "No matching commands.";
    listEl.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < results.length; i++) {
    const { cmd } = results[i];
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText =
      T_BTN +
      (i === activeIndex
        ? ";background:var(--accent-dim,rgba(56,189,248,.14));color:var(--accent,#38bdf8)"
        : "");
    row.onmouseenter = () => {
      if (activeIndex === i) return;
      activeIndex = i;
      renderResults();
    };
    row.onclick = () => execute(i);

    const label = document.createElement("div");
    label.style.cssText = "flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px";
    const top = document.createElement("div");
    top.style.cssText = "font-weight:600";
    top.textContent = cmd.label;
    label.appendChild(top);
    if (cmd.category) {
      const cat = document.createElement("div");
      cat.style.cssText = "font-size:10.5px;opacity:.65;letter-spacing:.2px";
      cat.textContent = cmd.hint ? `${cmd.category} · ${cmd.hint}` : cmd.category;
      label.appendChild(cat);
    }

    row.appendChild(label);

    if (cmd.kbd) {
      const k = document.createElement("div");
      k.style.cssText =
        "font:10px/1 var(--font-mono,monospace);padding:3px 6px;border-radius:4px;" +
        "background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);" +
        "color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)";
      k.textContent = cmd.kbd;
      row.appendChild(k);
    }

    listEl.appendChild(row);
  }
}

function updateResults(): void {
  if (!input) return;
  results = filterCommands(input.value);
  activeIndex = 0;
  renderResults();
}

async function execute(index: number): Promise<void> {
  const r = results[index];
  if (!r) return;
  closePalette();
  try {
    await r.cmd.run();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[palette] command failed", r.cmd.id, err);
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Keyboard
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function onInputKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    closePalette();
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
    e.preventDefault();
    activeIndex = (activeIndex + 1) % Math.max(1, results.length);
    renderResults();
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
    e.preventDefault();
    activeIndex = (activeIndex - 1 + results.length) % Math.max(1, results.length);
    renderResults();
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === "Enter") {
    e.preventDefault();
    void execute(activeIndex);
    return;
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function isCommandPaletteOpen(): boolean {
  return open;
}

export function openPalette(): void {
  ensureDOM();
  if (!root || !input) return;
  open = true;
  root.style.display = "flex";
  input.value = "";
  results = filterCommands("");
  activeIndex = 0;
  renderResults();
  requestAnimationFrame(() => input?.focus());
}

export function closePalette(): void {
  if (!root) return;
  open = false;
  root.style.display = "none";
}

export function togglePalette(): void {
  open ? closePalette() : openPalette();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Bootstrap commands
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function bootstrapCommands(): void {
  // Project

  const tool = (name: string, tool: string, kbd?: string) =>
    registerCommand({
      id: `tool.${tool}`,
      label: `Tool: ${name}`,
      category: "Authoring tools",
      kbd,
      run: () => setAuthoringTool(tool as any),
      when: () => getActiveTool() !== (tool as any),
    });

  tool("Wall", "wall", "WA");
  tool("Slab / Floor", "slab", "SL");
  tool("Column", "column", "CM");
  tool("Beam", "beam", "BM");
  tool("Brace", "brace", "BR");
  tool("Truss", "truss", "TR");
  tool("Isolated Footing", "footing", "FT");

  tool("Door", "door", "DR");
  tool("Window", "window", "WN");
  tool("Duct", "duct", "DU");
  tool("Pipe", "pipe", "PP");
  tool("Cable Tray", "cable-tray");
  tool("Conduit", "conduit");
  tool("Equipment", "equipment");
  tool("Grid", "grid", "GR");
  tool("Level", "level", "LV");
  tool("Move", "move", "G");
  tool("Copy", "copy");
  tool("Rotate", "rotate", "R");
  tool("Mirror", "mirror");
  tool("Array", "array");
  tool("Offset", "offset");

  // Deactivate any active tool
  registerCommand({
    id: "tool.none",
    label: "Cancel active tool",
    category: "Authoring tools",
    kbd: "Esc",
    run: () => setAuthoringTool(null),
    when: () => getActiveTool() !== null,
  });

  // Edit
  registerCommand({ id: "edit.undo", label: "Undo", category: "Edit", kbd: "Ctrl+Z", run: () => void history.undo(), when: () => history.canUndo() });
  registerCommand({ id: "edit.redo", label: "Redo", category: "Edit", kbd: "Ctrl+Y", run: () => void history.redo(), when: () => history.canRedo() });
  registerCommand({ id: "edit.selectAll", label: "Select all elements", category: "Edit", kbd: "Ctrl+A", run: () => void selection.selectAll() });
  registerCommand({ id: "edit.clearSelection", label: "Clear selection", category: "Edit", run: async () => { selection.clear(); await selection.applyToHighlighter(); }, when: () => !selection.isEmpty() });
  registerCommand({ id: "edit.delete", label: "Delete selected authored elements", category: "Edit", kbd: "Del", run: () => deleteSelectedElement() });
  registerCommand({ id: "edit.clearAll", label: "Clear all authored elements", category: "Edit", run: () => clearAllElements() });

  // View
  registerCommand({ id: "view.fit", label: "Fit to view", category: "View", kbd: "F", run: () => fitAll() });
  registerCommand({ id: "view.home", label: "Go to home view", category: "View", kbd: "H", run: () => goHome() });
  registerCommand({ id: "view.top", label: "Top view", category: "View", run: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0)) });
  registerCommand({ id: "view.front", label: "Front view", category: "View", run: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1)) });
  registerCommand({ id: "view.isoNE", label: "Isometric NE", category: "View", run: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0.7, -1)) });
  registerCommand({ id: "view.isoNW", label: "Isometric NW", category: "View", run: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0.7, -1)) });
  registerCommand({ id: "view.perspective", label: "Perspective view", category: "View", run: () => setProjection("perspective"), when: () => getProjection() !== "perspective" });
  registerCommand({ id: "view.ortho", label: "Orthographic view", category: "View", run: () => setProjection("orthographic"), when: () => getProjection() !== "orthographic" });
  registerCommand({ id: "view.screenshot", label: "Take screenshot", category: "View", run: () => takeScreenshot() });

  // Tools
  registerCommand({ id: "tools.measure", label: toggleLabel("Measure", isMeasureEnabled), category: "Tools", kbd: "M", run: () => toggleMeasure() });
  registerCommand({ id: "tools.section", label: toggleLabel("Section plane", isSectionOn), category: "Tools", run: () => toggleSection() });
  registerCommand({ id: "tools.walk", label: toggleLabel("Walk mode", isWalkModeEnabled), category: "Tools", run: () => toggleWalkMode() });

  registerCommand({ id: "tools.clashClear", label: "Clear clash results", category: "Tools", run: () => void clearClash() });

  registerCommand({ id: "panel.schedules", label: toggleLabel("Schedules", isSchedulesVisible), category: "Panels", run: () => toggleSchedules() });

    .join(" ");
}

function registerClashCommands(): void {
  // Drop stale scenario commands before re-adding.
  for (const c of listCommands()) {
    if (c.id.startsWith("clash.scenario.")) unregisterCommand(c.id);
  }

  registerCommand({
    id: "clash.run",

  registerCommand({

  });
  registerCommand({

    label: "Mark all clashes resolved",

    run: () => services.tryUse("clash")?.setStatusForAll("resolved"),
  });
  registerCommand({
    id: "clash.exportCsv",
    label: "Export clash CSV",
    category: "Clash",
    run: () => services.tryUse("clash")?.exportCsv(),
  });
  registerCommand({
    id: "clash.groups.next",
    label: "Next clash group",
    category: "Clash",
    run: () => {
      const svc = services.tryUse("clash") as any;
      const groups = svc?.listGroups?.() ?? [];
      if (!groups.length) { notify("warn", "Run a test first"); return; }
      const cur = svc.getActiveGroupId?.();
      const i = groups.findIndex((g: any) => g.id === cur);
      const next = groups[(i + 1) % groups.length];
      svc.focusGroup?.(next.id);
    },
  });

  const clash = services.tryUse("clash");
  const scenarios = clash?.listScenarios() ?? [];
  for (const s of scenarios) {
    registerCommand({
      id: `clash.scenario.${s.id}`,
      label: `Run scenario: ${s.name}`,

      hint: `${(s as any).method ?? "hard-triangle"}`,
      run: async () => {
        const svc = services.tryUse("clash");
        if (!svc) return;
        await svc.loadScenario(s.id);
        await svc.run();
      },
    });
  }
}

export function setupCommandPalette(): void {
  bootstrapCommands();
  registerAuthoringCommands();
  registerPanelCommands();
  registerClashCommands();
  void import("../modules/schedules/schedule-templates")
    .then((m) => m.registerScheduleCommands?.())
    .catch(() => { /* schedules optional */ });

  window.addEventListener("obs-clash-scenarios-changed", () => {
    registerClashCommands();
  });

  // Ctrl+P globally. Capture phase, and stopImmediatePropagation so nothing
  // else (walk mode, ribbon) sees this keystroke.
  window.addEventListener(
    "keydown",
    (e) => {
      const mod = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;
      if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === "p") {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        togglePalette();
      }
    },
    true,
  );

  ctx.features.commandPalette = {
    open: openPalette,
    close: closePalette,
    toggle: togglePalette,
    isOpen: isCommandPaletteOpen,
    register: registerCommand,
    unregister: unregisterCommand,
    list: listCommands,
  };
}
```

--- FILE: src/features/constraint-solver.ts ---
```ts
// solver-mode: button-driven (no pointerup / no auto-rebuild race with placement)
// openingsForWall() in authoring.ts already re-clamps hosted offsets at READ time on
// the single rebuild the placement/move commit performs, so the solver must NOT also
// solve on pointerup. The [S] button calls solveHostedConstraints() deliberately.
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let solving = false;

function getFeatures(): Any {
  const c = ctx as Any;
  if (!c.features) c.features = {};
  return c.features as Any;
}

function getAuthoring(): Any | null {
  const f = getFeatures();
  return (f.authoring as Any) ?? (window as Any).__obsAuthoring ?? null;
}

function getElements(): Any[] {
  const a = getAuthoring();
  if (!a) return [];
  if (typeof a.getElements === "function") {
    try { return a.getElements() ?? []; } catch { return []; }
  }
  if (Array.isArray(a.elements)) return a.elements;
  return [];
}

function rebuildAuthoring(): void {
  const a = getAuthoring();
  if (!a) return;
  try {
    if (typeof a.rebuildAuthored === "function") a.rebuildAuthored();
    else if (typeof a.rebuild === "function") a.rebuild();
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  try {
    if (typeof a.markAuthoringDirty === "function") a.markAuthoringDirty();
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:authoring-changed", { detail: { reason: "constraint-solver" } }));
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

function pair(v: Any): [number, number] | null {
  if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length >= 2) return [Number(v[0]), Number(v[1])];
  if (v && typeof v === "object") {
    if ("x" in v && "z" in v) return [Number(v.x), Number(v.z)];
    if ("x" in v && "y" in v) return [Number(v.x), Number(v.y)];
  }
  return null;
}

export function solveHostedConstraints(): number {
  if (solving) return 0;
  solving = true;
  try {
    const elements = getElements();
    if (!elements.length) return 0;

    const hosts = new Map<string, Any>();
    for (const el of elements) {
      if (!el || !el.id || !el.params) continue;
      const t = String(el.type ?? "");
      if ((t === "wall" || t === "beam" || t === "line" || t === "mline") && el.params.start && el.params.end) {
        hosts.set(String(el.id), el);
      }
    }

    let changed = 0;
    for (const el of elements) {
      if (!el || !el.hostId || !el.params) continue;
      const t = String(el.type ?? "");
      if (t !== "door" && t !== "window" && t !== "opening" && t !== "fitting") continue;

      const host = hosts.get(String(el.hostId));
      if (!host || !host.params) continue;

      const p = el.params as Any;
      const hp = host.params as Any;
      const start = pair(hp.start);
      const end = pair(hp.end);
      if (!start || !end) continue;

      const ax = start[0], az = start[1], bx = end[0], bz = end[1];
      const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
      const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      if (!Number.isFinite(L) || L < 0.01) continue;

      const half = Number(p.width ?? p.WIDTH ?? 0.9) / 2;
      const current = Number(p.offsetAlongHost ?? p.offset ?? L / 2);
      const min = Math.min(half, L / 2);
      const max = Math.max(L - half, L / 2);
      const clamped = Math.max(min, Math.min(max, current));

      if (typeof p.offsetAlongHost !== "number" || Math.abs(clamped - current) > 1e-4) {
        p.offsetAlongHost = Math.round(clamped * 1000) / 1000;
        changed++;
      }
    }

    if (changed) rebuildAuthoring();
    return changed;
  } finally {
    solving = false;
  }
}

export function setupConstraintSolver(): void {
  const f = getFeatures();
  f.constraintSolver = { solve: solveHostedConstraints };
  (window as Any).__obsSolveHostedConstraints = solveHostedConstraints;
  console.log("[constraint-solver] button-driven ready (no pointerup auto-solve; openingsForWall clamps at read)");
}
```
