```ts
/**
 * Right-click context menu (Autodesk-style).
 *
 * Extended in v3.1 with:
 *   - Edit operations for authored selection (Move/Copy/Rotate/Mirror/Array/Offset/Delete)
 *   - Multi-select actions (Select all / Invert / Select similar / Clear)
 *   - Selection sets (save / load / delete)
 *   - Undo / Redo with live labels
 *   - Gizmo mode toggle
 *   - Snapping toggle
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import * as OBC from "@thatopen/components";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { inputRouter } from "../core/input-router";
import {
  fitToMap, focusOnPoint, focusOnBox, zoomBy, gotoDir, saveHome, goHome, fitAll, handleRightClickFocus,
  setOrbitPivot, pivotOnSelection,
  takeScreenshot, setProjection, getProjection,
} from "./camera-tools";
import { isMeasureEnabled, toggleMeasure } from "./measure";
import { isSectionOn, toggleSection } from "./section";
import { getItemMeta } from "./item-meta";
import { history } from "./history";
import { selection } from "./selection";
import { snapping } from "./snapping";
import { gizmo, type GizmoMode } from "./gizmo";
import {
  getActiveTool as getAuthoringTool,
  getSelectedIds as getAuthoredSelection,
  setAuthoringTool,
  deleteSelectedElement,
} from "./authoring";
import { beginEdit, beginEditFromSelection, openFragEditPanel } from "./frag-edit";
import { toggleBimObjectStudio } from "./bim-object-studio";

type MenuItem =
  | { type: "sep" }
  | { type: "label"; text: string }
  | {
      type: "action";
      text: string;
      icon?: string;
      onclick: () => void;
      disabled?: boolean;
      checked?: boolean;
    }
  | { type: "sub"; text: string; icon?: string; items: MenuItem[] };

type IdMap = Record<string, Set<number>>;

const ctxMenu = document.createElement("div");
ctxMenu.style.cssText =
  "position:absolute;z-index:100;display:none;min-width:260px;max-height:calc(100vh - 24px);overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:visible;overscroll-behavior:contain;background:var(--bg-floating,#1e1f26);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#3a3a4a);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.55);font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text-primary,#e2e8f0);padding:4px 0";
ctxMenu.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

function closeCtxMenu() {
  ctxMenu.style.display = "none";
}
const escapeHtml = (s: string) =>
  s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c],
  );
const truncate = (s: string, n: number) => (s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n) + "…" : s);

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Raycast extraction (SDK-version tolerant, unchanged from v3.0)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function isNumericSet(v: any): v is Set<number> {
  if (!(v instanceof Set) || v.size === 0) return false;
  for (const x of v) if (typeof x !== "number") return false;
  return true;
}

function scanForIdMaps(root: any, maxDepth = 4): IdMap {
  const out: IdMap = {};
  const visit = (node: any, depth: number) => {
    if (!node || depth > maxDepth) return;
    if (node instanceof Map) {
      for (const [k, v] of node) {
        if (isNumericSet(v)) out[String(k)] = v;
        else visit(v, depth + 1);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(node)) {
      for (const v of node) visit(v, depth + 1);
      return;
    }
    if (typeof node !== "object") return;
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(node)) {
      if (isNumericSet(v)) out[k] = v as Set<number>;
      else if (v && typeof v === "object") visit(v, depth + 1);
    }
  };
  visit(root, 0);
  return out;
}

function extractSelection(): { map: IdMap; debug: string } {
  const hl: any = ctx.highlighter;
  if (!hl) return { map: {}, debug: "no highlighter" };
  let map = scanForIdMaps(hl.selection, 4);
  if (Object.keys(map).length) return { map, debug: "from hl.selection" };
  for (const k of Object.keys(hl)) {
    if (/select|highlight|current/i.test(k)) {
      map = { ...map, ...scanForIdMaps(hl[k], 4) };
    }
  }
  if (Object.keys(map).length) return { map, debug: "from hl scan" };
  return {
    map: {},
    debug: `selection empty (hl keys: ${Object.keys(hl).slice(0, 12).join(",")})`,
  };
}

function extractFromRay(r: any): {
  localId?: number;
  modelId?: string;
  model?: any;
  debug: string;
} {
  if (!r) return { debug: "castRay returned null" };
  let localId: number | undefined;
  let modelId: string | undefined;
  let model: any;

  const tryModel = (m: any) => {
    if (!m || typeof m !== "object") return;
    if (!model) model = m;
    if (modelId === undefined) {
      if (typeof m.modelId === "string") modelId = m.modelId;
      else if (typeof m.id === "string") modelId = m.id;
    }
  };

  const visit = (node: any, depth: number) => {
    if (!node || typeof node !== "object" || depth > 3) return;
    if (node instanceof Map) {
      for (const v of node.values()) visit(v, depth + 1);
      return;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(node)) {
      for (const v of node) visit(v, depth + 1);
      return;
    }
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(node)) {
      if (localId === undefined && typeof v === "number" && /localid|local_id|itemid|expressid/i.test(k))
        localId = v;
      if (modelId === undefined && typeof v === "string" && /modelid|model_id/i.test(k))
        modelId = v;
      if (/model|fragment/i.test(k) && v && typeof v === "object") {
        if (Array.isArray(v)) v.forEach(tryModel);
        else {
          tryModel(v);
          visit(v, depth + 1);
        }
      } else if (v && typeof v === "object") {
        visit(v, depth + 1);
      }
    }
  };
  visit(r, 0);

  // ThatOpen Raycasters expose the selected model through fragments.modelId.
  // Prefer that canonical field before walking the object graph.
  if (modelId === undefined) {
    const direct = r?.fragments?.modelId ?? r?.fragments?.[0]?.modelId ?? r?.modelId;
    if (typeof direct === "string") modelId = direct;
  }

  if (model && (modelId === undefined || !ctx.fragments.list.has(modelId))) {
    for (const [id, m] of ctx.fragments.list as any) {
      if (m === model || m?.object === model || model.model === m) {
        modelId = id;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  const debug =
    `keys: [${Object.keys(r).join(", ")}]` +
    ` · localId=${localId ?? "?"} · modelId=${modelId ?? "?"}`;
  return { localId, modelId, model, debug };
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Hider (SDK fallbacks preserved)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
async function hideMap(map: IdMap) {
  const h: any = ctx.hider;
  if (!h) {
    alert("Hider component not available.");
    return;
  }
  if (typeof h.hide === "function") {
    try {
      await h.hide(map);
      return;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[hider.hide]", e);
    }
  }
  if (typeof h.set === "function") {
    try {
      await h.set(false, map);
      return;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[hider.set]", e);
    }
  }
  alert("Hide is not supported by this SDK version — see console.");
}

async function isolateMap(map: IdMap) {
  const h: any = ctx.hider;
  if (!h) {
    alert("Hider component not available.");
    return;
  }
  if (typeof h.isolate === "function") {
    try {
      await h.isolate(map);
      return;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[hider.isolate]", e);
    }
  }
  if (typeof h.set === "function") {
    try {
      await h.set(false);
      await h.set(true, map);
      return;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[hider.set isolate]", e);
    }
  }
  alert("Isolate is not supported by this SDK version — see console.");
}

async function showAllElements() {
  const h: any = ctx.hider;
  if (!h) return;
  if (typeof h.show === "function") {
    try {
      await h.show();
      return;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[hider.show]", e);
    }
  }
  if (typeof h.set === "function") {
    try {
      await h.set(true);
      return;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[hider.set show]", e);
    }
  }
  if (typeof h.reset === "function") {
    try {
      await h.reset();
      return;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[hider.reset]", e);
    }
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Menu rendering
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function renderMenuItems(container: HTMLElement, items: MenuItem[]) {
  for (const it of items) {
    if (it.type === "sep") {
      const d = document.createElement("div");
      d.style.cssText = "height:1px;background:var(--border-default,#3a3a4a);margin:4px 8px";
      container.appendChild(d);
      continue;
    }
    if (it.type === "label") {
      const d = document.createElement("div");
      d.style.cssText =
        "padding:4px 12px 2px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.5px;opacity:.55;white-space:nowrap";
      d.textContent = it.text;
      container.appendChild(d);
      continue;
    }
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    const disabled = it.type === "action" && it.disabled;
    row.style.cssText =
      "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 12px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;position:relative" +
      (disabled ? ";opacity:.35;pointer-events:none" : "");
    row.innerHTML =
      `<span style="width:18px;text-align:center">${it.type === "sub" ? (it.icon ?? "▸") : (it.icon ?? "")}</span>` +
      `<span style="flex:1">${escapeHtml(it.text)}</span>` +
      (it.type === "sub" ? `<span style="opacity:.6">▸</span>` : "") +
      (it.type === "action" && it.checked ? `<span style="color:#22c55e;font-weight:700">✓</span>` : "");

    if (it.type === "action") {
      row.onclick = () => {
        closeCtxMenu();
        it.onclick();
      };
    } else if (it.type === "sub") {
      const sub = document.createElement("div");
      sub.style.cssText =
        "display:none;position:absolute;top:-5px;min-width:220px;max-height:calc(100vh - 36px);overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:visible;background:var(--bg-floating,#1e1f26);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#3a3a4a);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.55);padding:4px 0;z-index:101";
      renderMenuItems(sub, it.items);
      let hideTimer = 0;
      row.onmouseenter = () => {
        clearTimeout(hideTimer);
        const hostRect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
        const rowRect = row.getBoundingClientRect();
        const openLeft = rowRect.right + 220 > hostRect.right;
        sub.style.left = openLeft ? "auto" : "calc(100% - 2px)";
        sub.style.right = openLeft ? "calc(100% - 2px)" : "auto";
        sub.style.display = "block";
      };
      row.onmouseleave = () => {
        hideTimer = window.setTimeout(() => { sub.style.display = "none"; }, 120);
      };
      sub.onmouseenter = () => clearTimeout(hideTimer);
      sub.onmouseleave = () => { sub.style.display = "none"; };
      row.appendChild(sub);
    }
    row.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
      row.style.background = "var(--bg-hover,#2c2d38)";
    });
    row.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      row.style.background = "transparent";
    });
    container.appendChild(row);
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Picking
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
type PickResult = {
  map?: IdMap;
  name?: string;
  point?: THREE.Vector3;
  debug: string;
  selDebug: string;
};

async function pickElementAt(): Promise<PickResult> {
  const selRes = extractSelection();
  let r: any = null;
  try {
    const caster = ctx.components.get(OBC.Raycasters).get(ctx.world);
    r = await caster.castRay();
  } catch (err) {
    return { debug: `castRay threw: ${String(err)}`, selDebug: selRes.debug };
  }
  if (!r) return { debug: "castRay: no hit", selDebug: selRes.debug };

  const point = r.point ? new THREE.Vector3().copy(r.point) : undefined;
  const ex = extractFromRay(r);

  if (ex.localId != null && ex.modelId != null && ctx.fragments.list.has(ex.modelId)) {
    try {
      const model = ctx.fragments.list.get(ex.modelId)!;
      const meta = await getItemMeta(model as any, ex.localId);
      return {
        map: { [ex.modelId]: new Set([ex.localId]) },
        name: meta.name,
        point,
        debug: `OK: ${meta.name}`,
        selDebug: selRes.debug,
      };
    } catch {
      /* fall through */
    }
  }
  return { point, debug: ex.debug, selDebug: selRes.debug };
}

let lastPickDebug: PickResult | null = null;

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Menu content
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function buildSelectionSetSubmenu(): MenuItem[] {
  const sets = selection.listSets();
  if (!sets.length) {
    return [{ type: "action", text: "No saved sets", onclick: () => {}, disabled: true }];
  }
  return sets.slice(0, 20).map<MenuItem>((s) => ({
    type: "action",
    text: `${truncate(s.name, 32)} (${Object.values(s.snapshot).reduce((a, arr) => a + arr.length, 0)})`,
    onclick: () => void selection.loadSet(s.id),
  }));
}

function buildGizmoSubmenu(): MenuItem[] {
  const m = gizmo.getMode();
  const set = (mode: GizmoMode) => {
    gizmo.setMode(mode);
    (window as any).__obs_setGizmo?.(mode);
  };
  return [
    { type: "action", text: "Move (G)", icon: "", checked: m === "move", onclick: () => set("move") },
    { type: "action", text: "Rotate (R)", icon: "", checked: m === "rotate", onclick: () => set("rotate") },
    { type: "action", text: "Scale (S)", icon: "", checked: m === "scale", onclick: () => set("scale") },
    { type: "sep" },
    { type: "action", text: "Off (Q)", icon: "", checked: m === "none", onclick: () => set("none") },
  ];
}

async function openCtxMenu(e: MouseEvent) {
  (window as any).__obsLastCtxEvent = e;
  const picked = await pickElementAt();
  lastPickDebug = picked;
  const sel = extractSelection().map;
  const managerSel = selection.snapshot();
  const selCount = Object.values(sel).reduce((a, v) => a + (v?.size ?? 0), 0);
  const managerCount = Object.values(managerSel).reduce((a, v) => a + (v?.size ?? 0), 0);
  const actionMap: IdMap = selCount > 0 ? sel : managerCount > 0 ? managerSel : (picked.map ?? {});
  const actionCount = Object.values(actionMap).reduce((a, v) => a + (v?.size ?? 0), 0);
  const editMap: IdMap = picked.map && Object.keys(picked.map).length ? picked.map : actionMap;
  const canHide = !!ctx.hider;

  const authoredIds = getAuthoredSelection();
  const hasAuthored = authoredIds.length > 0;
  const canFocus = actionCount > 0 || !!picked.point || hasAuthored;

  const items: MenuItem[] = [];

  // ── Header ──
  if (hasAuthored) {
    items.push({ type: "label", text: `Authored: ${authoredIds.length} element(s)` });
  } else if (picked.name) {
    items.push({ type: "label", text: `Element: ${truncate(picked.name, 30)}` });
  } else if (selCount > 0) {
    items.push({ type: "label", text: `Selection: ${selCount} item(s)` });
  }

  // ── Camera ──
  items.push({
            type: "action",
            text: "Focus",
            icon: "",
            onclick: () => {
              void (async () => {
                try {
                  const m: any = await import("./focus-service");
                  const ev: any = (window as any).__obsLastCtxEvent ?? null;
                  const ok = await m.focusSelected(ev);

                  if (!ok) {
                    try {
                      const n: any = await import("../core/notify");
                      n.toast?.("Nothing selected to focus.", "warn");
                    } catch {
                      /* notify optional */
                    }
                  }
                } catch (err) {
                  console.warn("[context-menu] Focus selected object failed", err);
                }
              })();
            },
          });
    items.push({ type: "action", text: "Zoom In", icon: "+", onclick: () => zoomBy(0.8) });
  items.push({ type: "action", text: "Zoom Out", icon: "", onclick: () => zoomBy(1.25) });
  items.push({ type: "sep" });

  // ── Authored edit operations ──
  if (hasAuthored) {
    const setTool = (t: string) => setAuthoringTool(t as any);
    const curTool = getAuthoringTool();
    items.push({
      type: "sub",
      text: "Modify",
      icon: "",
      items: [
        { type: "action", text: "Move", icon: "", checked: curTool === "move", onclick: () => setTool("move") },
        { type: "action", text: "Copy", icon: "", checked: curTool === "copy", onclick: () => setTool("copy") },
        { type: "action", text: "Rotate", icon: "", checked: curTool === "rotate", onclick: () => setTool("rotate") },
        { type: "action", text: "Mirror", icon: "", checked: curTool === "mirror", onclick: () => setTool("mirror") },
        { type: "action", text: "Array", icon: "", checked: curTool === "array", onclick: () => setTool("array") },
        { type: "action", text: "Offset", icon: "", checked: curTool === "offset", onclick: () => setTool("offset") },
        { type: "sep" },
        {
          type: "action",
          text: "Delete",
          icon: "",
          onclick: () => deleteSelectedElement(),
        },
      ],
    });
    items.push({ type: "sep" });
  }

  // ── OpenBIM authoring / Native Twin ──
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Make Editable Native Twin",
    icon: "",
    disabled: actionCount === 0,
    onclick: async () => {
      let created = 0;
      const source = Object.keys(editMap).length ? editMap : selection.snapshot();
      for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(source)) {
        for (const id of ids) {
          const twin = await beginEdit(modelId, id);
          if (twin) created++;
          else {
            try {
              window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
                detail: {
                  message: `Native Twin could not be created for ${modelId} / ${id}. The loaded source model returned no usable per-item geometry; no approximate object was created.`,
                  kind: "error",
                },
              }));
            } catch { /* */ }
          }
        }
      }
      if (!created) {
        const fallback = await beginEditFromSelection();
        created = fallback;
      }
      if (created) openFragEditPanel();
    },
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Properties",
    icon: "",
    disabled: actionCount === 0 && !picked.map && !hasAuthored,
    onclick: async () => {
      try {
        const pp: any = (ctx.features as any).propertyPalette;
        if (pp?.open) pp.open();
        if (picked.map) await (ctx.props.update as any)?.(picked.map);
      } catch { /* property palette is optional */ }
    },
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "BIM Object Studio",
    icon: "",
    onclick: () => toggleBimObjectStudio(),
  });
  items.push({ type: "sep" });

  // ── Selection ops ──
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Select Similar",
    icon: "",
    disabled: !picked.map || !picked.name,
    onclick: async () => {
      if (!picked.map) return;
      const first = Object.entries(picked.map)[0];
      if (!first) return;
      const [modelId, ids] = first;
      const localId = [...ids][0];
      await selection.selectSimilar(modelId, localId);
    },
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Select All",
    icon: "",
    onclick: () => void selection.selectAll(),
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Invert Selection",
    icon: "",
    onclick: () => void selection.invert(),
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Clear Selection",
    icon: "",
    disabled: selection.isEmpty() && !hasAuthored,
    onclick: async () => {
      selection.clear();
      await selection.applyToHighlighter();
    },
  });
  items.push({
    type: "sub",
    text: "Selection Sets",
    icon: "",
    items: [
      {
        type: "action",
        text: "Save current as set",
        icon: "",
        disabled: selection.isEmpty(),
        onclick: () => {
          const name = prompt("Name for selection set:", `Set ${selection.listSets().length + 1}`);
          if (!name) return;
          selection.saveSet(name);
        },
      },
      { type: "sep" },
      ...buildSelectionSetSubmenu(),
    ],
  });
  items.push({ type: "sep" });

  // ── Hide / Isolate ──
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: picked.name ? `Hide Element (${truncate(picked.name, 22)})` : "Hide Element",
    icon: "",
    disabled: !(picked.map && canHide),
    onclick: () => hideMap(picked.map!),
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Hide Selected",
    icon: "",
    disabled: selCount === 0 || !canHide,
    onclick: () => hideMap(sel),
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: picked.name ? `Isolate Element (${truncate(picked.name, 22)})` : "Isolate Element",
    icon: "",
    disabled: !(picked.map && canHide),
    onclick: () => isolateMap(picked.map!),
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Isolate Selection",
    icon: "",
    disabled: selCount === 0 || !canHide,
    onclick: () => isolateMap(sel),
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Show All Elements",
    icon: "",
    disabled: !canHide,
    onclick: () => showAllElements(),
  });
  items.push({ type: "sep" });

  // ── Undo / Redo ──
  const ul = history.undoLabel();
  const rl = history.redoLabel();
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: ul ? `Undo ${truncate(ul, 28)}` : "Undo",
    icon: "",
    disabled: !history.canUndo(),
    onclick: () => void history.undo(),
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: rl ? `Redo ${truncate(rl, 28)}` : "Redo",
    icon: "",
    disabled: !history.canRedo(),
    onclick: () => void history.redo(),
  });
  items.push({ type: "sep" });

  // ── Views ──
  items.push({ type: "action", text: "Set as Home View", icon: "+", onclick: () => saveHome() });
  items.push({ type: "action", text: "Go to Home View", icon: "", onclick: () => goHome() });
  items.push({ type: "action", text: "Fit to View", icon: "", onclick: () => fitAll() });
  items.push({
    type: "sub",
    text: "Standard Views",
    icon: "",
    items: [
      { type: "action", text: "Top", onclick: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0)) },
      { type: "action", text: "Bottom", onclick: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0)) },
      { type: "action", text: "Front", onclick: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1)) },
      { type: "action", text: "Back", onclick: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1)) },
      { type: "action", text: "Right", onclick: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0)) },
      { type: "action", text: "Left", onclick: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0)) },
      { type: "sep" },
      { type: "action", text: "Iso SE", onclick: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0.7, 1)) },
      { type: "action", text: "Iso SW", onclick: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0.7, 1)) },
      { type: "action", text: "Iso NE", onclick: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0.7, -1)) },
      { type: "action", text: "Iso NW", onclick: () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0.7, -1)) },
    ],
  });
  const proj = getProjection();
  items.push({
    type: "sub",
    text: "Projection",
    icon: "",
    items: [
      {
        type: "action",
        text: "Perspective",
        checked: proj === "perspective",
        onclick: () => setProjection("perspective"),
      },
      {
        type: "action",
        text: "Orthographic",
        checked: proj === "orthographic",
        onclick: () => setProjection("orthographic"),
      },
    ],
  });
  items.push({ type: "sep" });

  // ── Tools ──
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Measure",
    icon: "",
    checked: isMeasureEnabled(),
    onclick: () => toggleMeasure(),
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Section Plane",
    icon: "",
    checked: isSectionOn(),
    onclick: () => toggleSection(),
  });
  items.push({
    type: "sub",
    text: "Transform Gizmo",
    icon: "",
    items: buildGizmoSubmenu(),
  });
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Object Snapping",
    icon: "",
    checked: snapping.isEnabled(),
    onclick: () => snapping.setEnabled(!snapping.isEnabled()),
  });
  items.push({ type: "sep" });

  // ── Footer ──
  items.push({
    type: "action",
    text: "Screenshot",
    icon: "",
    onclick: () => takeScreenshot(),
  });

  // ── Debug (unchanged) ──
  if (!picked.name && !picked.map) {
    items.push({ type: "sep" });
    items.push({ type: "label", text: `⚠ pick → ${truncate(picked.debug, 44)}` });
    items.push({ type: "label", text: `⚠ sel → ${truncate(picked.selDebug, 44)}` });
    items.push({
      type: "action",
      text: "Debug: dump raw data",
      icon: "",
      onclick: () => {
        console.log("[TOC debug] last right-click:", lastPickDebug);
        const caster = ctx.components.get(OBC.Raycasters).get(ctx.world);
        caster
          .castRay()
          .then((r: any) => console.log("[TOC debug] fresh castRay:", r))
          .catch(() => {});
        console.log("[TOC debug] highlighter:", ctx.highlighter);
        console.log("[TOC debug] highlighter.selection:", (ctx.highlighter as any)?.selection);
        console.log("[TOC debug] hider:", ctx.hider);
      },
    });
  }

  // ── Layout ──
  ctxMenu.innerHTML = "";
  renderMenuItems(ctxMenu, items);
  ctxMenu.style.visibility = "hidden";
  ctxMenu.style.display = "block";
  const hostRect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = e.clientX - hostRect.left;
  let y = e.clientY - hostRect.top;
  if (x + ctxMenu.offsetWidth > hostRect.width - 8)
    x = Math.max(4, hostRect.width - ctxMenu.offsetWidth - 8);
  if (y + ctxMenu.offsetHeight > hostRect.height - 8)
    y = Math.max(4, hostRect.height - ctxMenu.offsetHeight - 8);
  ctxMenu.style.left = `${x}px`;
  ctxMenu.style.top = `${y}px`;
  ctxMenu.style.visibility = "visible";
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  Setup
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function setupContextMenu() {
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(ctxMenu);

  // Priority 20 — lower than gizmo and box-select, higher than authoring.
  const unsub = inputRouter.subscribe((g) => {
    if (g.kind !== "rmb-click") return false;
void (async () => {
  try {
    const selMod: any = await import("./selection");
    const auth: any = (ctx as any).features?.authoring;

    const authIdsRaw = auth?.getSelectedIds?.() ?? [];
    const authIds: string[] = Array.from(authIdsRaw as any).map((x: any) => String(x));

    const snap = selMod.selection?.snapshot?.() ?? {};
    const fragSelected: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};
    let fragCount = 0;

    for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(snap)) {
      if (ids instanceof Set && ids.size) {
        fragSelected[String(modelId)] = ids;
        fragCount += ids.size;
      }
    }

    const authoredIdRaw = auth?.pickAuthoredElementAt?.(g.event as MouseEvent) ?? null;
    const hit = authoredIdRaw ? null : await selMod.pickFragmentAtPointer?.();

    if (authoredIdRaw) {
      const id = String(authoredIdRaw);

      if (!authIds.includes(id) && fragCount === 0) {
        auth?.setSelectedAuthored?.([...authIds, id], "replace");
      }
    } else if (hit) {
      const modelKey = String(hit.modelId);
      const set = fragSelected[modelKey];
      const already = !!set && set.has(hit.localId);

      if (!already && authIds.length === 0) {
        selMod.selection.applyClick(hit.modelId, hit.localId, { ctrl: true });
        await selMod.selection.applyToHighlighter?.();
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[context-menu] right-click preserve selection failed", err);
  }

  await openCtxMenu(g.event);
})();
return true;
  }, 20);

  window.addEventListener(
    "mousedown",
    (e) => {
      if (e.button === 0 && !ctxMenu.contains(e.target as Node)) closeCtxMenu();
    },
    true,
  );
  window.addEventListener("wheel", () => closeCtxMenu(), { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") closeCtxMenu();
  });

  ctx.features.contextMenu = { close: closeCtxMenu, dispose: unsub };
}
```

```ts
/** 5D Cost floating panel: Takeoff | Cost Items | Summary + CSV export. */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  getItems, addCostItem, updateCostItem, deleteCostItem,
  getAssignment, setAssignment, setQtyOverride, computeLine, computeTotals, onCostChanged,
} from "../modules/cost/cost";
import { computeTakeoff, getRows } from "../modules/cost/quantities";
import type { CostItem, CostUnit, TakeoffRow } from "../modules/cost/types";

const UNITS: CostUnit[] = ["m", "m2", "m3", "pcs"];

const panel = document.createElement("div");
panel.style.cssText = "position:absolute;left:394px;top:14px;bottom:14px;width:680px;z-index:36;display:none;flex-direction:column;background:#171821;border:1px solid #2a2a35;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.55);font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#e2e8f0;overflow:hidden";
panel.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

const header = document.createElement("div");
header.style.cssText = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #24252f;background:#1b1c26";
const tabRow = document.createElement("div");
tabRow.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:4px;padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #24252f";
const body = document.createElement("div");
body.style.cssText = "flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:8px";
panel.append(header, tabRow, body);

const INP = "padding:3px 6px;background:#12131a;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:4px;color:#e2e8f0;font-size:11px";
const MINI = "padding:3px 8px;background:#24252f;color:#cbd5e1;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px";
const esc = (s: string) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]!));
const money = (n: number) => `${getCurrency()}${(n || 0).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
const num = (n: number) => (n || 0).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });

function getCurrency() { try { return localStorage.getItem("obs.currency") ?? "$"; } catch { return "$"; } }
function setCurrency(s: string) { try { localStorage.setItem("obs.currency", s || "$"); } catch { /* */ } }

let activeTab: "takeoff" | "items" | "summary" = "takeoff";
let recalculating = false;

function miniBtn(label: string, onclick: () => void, title = "") {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.textContent = label; b.title = title || label; b.style.cssText = MINI;
  b.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onclick(); };
  return b;
}

function renderHeader() {
  header.innerHTML = "";
  const t = document.createElement("span");
  t.textContent = "💰 5D Cost";
  t.style.cssText = "font-weight:700;flex:1";
  header.append(
    t,
    miniBtn("🔄 Recalculate", async () => { await refreshTakeoff(); renderBody(); }),
    miniBtn("⬇ CSV", () => exportCostCsv()),
    miniBtn("✕", () => toggleCostPanel()),
  );
}

function renderTabs() {
  tabRow.innerHTML = "";
  const tabs: [typeof activeTab, string][] = [["takeoff", "Takeoff"], ["items", "Cost Items"], ["summary", "Summary"]];
  for (const [id, label] of tabs) {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.textContent = label;
    b.style.cssText = "padding:5px 12px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:600 11px system-ui,sans-serif;border:1px solid #34353f;background:" + (activeTab === id ? "#16233a;color:#38bdf8" : "#1e1f28;color:#94a3b8");
    b.onclick = () => { activeTab = id; renderTabs(); renderBody(); };
    tabRow.appendChild(b);
  }
}

// ── Takeoff tab ──
function renderTakeoff() {
  const rows = getRows();
  if (recalculating) { body.innerHTML = `<div style="opacity:.6;padding:14px">Computing quantities…</div>`; return; }
  if (!rows.length) {
    body.innerHTML = `<div style="opacity:.55;text-align:center;padding:20px;border:1px dashed #34353f;border-radius:8px">
      No quantities yet. Import models or draw objects, then click <b>🔄 Recalculate</b>.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  const items = getItems();
  const table = document.createElement("table");
  table.style.cssText = "width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px";
  table.innerHTML = `<thead><tr style="position:sticky;top:0;background:#1b1c26">
    ${["Element / Category", "Info", "Pcs", "m", "m²", "m³", "Cost item", "Override qty", "Line"].map((h) =>
      `<th style="text-align:left;padding:5px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2a35;font-weight:600">${h}</th>`).join("")}
  </tr></thead>`;
  const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
  for (const row of rows) {
    const a = getAssignment(row.key);
    const line = computeLine(row);
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    tr.style.cssText = "border-bottom:1px solid #20212b";

    const tdLabel = document.createElement("td");
    tdLabel.style.cssText = "padding:4px 6px;font-weight:600";
    tdLabel.textContent = row.label;
    const srcDot = row.source === "authored" ? "🟩" : "🟦";
    tdLabel.prepend(document.createTextNode(srcDot + " "));

    const tdInfo = document.createElement("td");
    tdInfo.style.cssText = "padding:4px 6px;opacity:.55;font-size:10px";
    tdInfo.textContent = row.detail;

    const td = (v: number) => {
      const d = document.createElement("td");
      d.style.cssText = "padding:4px 6px";
      d.textContent = v ? num(v) : "—";
      return d;
    };

    const sel = document.createElement("select");
    sel.style.cssText = INP + ";max-width:150px";
    sel.innerHTML = `<option value="">— none —</option>` +
      items.map((i) => `<option value="${i.id}" ${a.costItemId === i.id ? "selected" : ""}>${esc(i.code)} · ${esc(i.name)} (${i.unit})</option>`).join("");
    sel.onchange = () => { setAssignment(row.key, sel.value || null); renderBody(); };

    const ov = document.createElement("input");
    ov.type = "number"; ov.style.cssText = INP + ";width:70px";
    ov.placeholder = "auto"; ov.value = a.qtyOverride != null ? String(a.qtyOverride) : "";
    ov.onchange = () => { setQtyOverride(row.key, ov.value === "" ? null : Number(ov.value)); renderBody(); };

    const tdLine = document.createElement("td");
    tdLine.style.cssText = "padding:4px 6px;font-weight:700;color:#22c55e";
    tdLine.textContent = line.item ? money(line.lineCost) : "—";
    if (line.item) tdLine.title = `${num(line.qty)} ${line.item.unit} × ${money(line.rate)}`;

    tr.append(tdLabel, tdInfo, td(row.count), td(row.length), td(row.area), td(row.volume));
    const tdSel = document.createElement("td"); tdSel.style.cssText = "padding:4px 6px"; tdSel.appendChild(sel);
    const tdOv = document.createElement("td"); tdOv.style.cssText = "padding:4px 6px"; tdOv.appendChild(ov);
    tr.append(tdSel, tdOv, tdLine);
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  }
  table.appendChild(tbody);
  body.innerHTML = "";
  body.appendChild(table);
  const legend = document.createElement("div");
  legend.style.cssText = "margin-top:8px;font-size:10px;opacity:.5";
  legend.textContent = "🟩 authored (exact) · 🟦 IFC (bbox approximation) — assign a cost item per row; override qty if the auto quantity isn't what you bill.";
  body.appendChild(legend);
}

// ── Cost items tab ──
function renderItems() {
  const items = getItems();
  body.innerHTML = "";

  const addBar = document.createElement("div");
  addBar.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px";
  const add = document.createElement("button");
  add.textContent = "＋ Add cost item";
  add.style.cssText = "padding:6px 12px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:11px";
  add.onclick = () => { addCostItem(); renderBody(); };
  addBar.appendChild(add);
  body.appendChild(addBar);

  if (!items.length) {
    body.innerHTML += `<div style="opacity:.55;text-align:center;padding:16px;border:1px dashed #34353f;border-radius:8px">No cost items yet — add one above (e.g. code C-001, "Ready-mix concrete C30", unit m³, rate 120).</div>`;
    return;
  }

  const table = document.createElement("table");
  table.style.cssText = "width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px";
  table.innerHTML = `<thead><tr style="background:#1b1c26">
    ${["Code", "Name", "Unit", "Rate", "Category", ""].map((h) =>
      `<th style="text-align:left;padding:5px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2a35">${h}</th>`).join("")}
  </tr></thead>`;
  const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
  for (const it of items) {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    tr.style.cssText = "border-bottom:1px solid #20212b";
    const cell = (v: string, on: (val: string) => void, width = "") => {
      const d = document.createElement("td"); d.style.cssText = "padding:3px 4px";
      const i = document.createElement("input");
      i.value = v; i.style.cssText = INP + (width ? `;width:${width}` : "");
      i.onchange = () => { on(i.value); };
      d.appendChild(i); return d;
    };
    tr.append(
      cell(it.code, (v) => updateCostItem(it.id, { code: v }), "60px"),
      cell(it.name, (v) => updateCostItem(it.id, { name: v }), "170px"),
      (() => {
        const d = document.createElement("td"); d.style.cssText = "padding:3px 4px";
        const s = document.createElement("select"); s.style.cssText = INP;
        s.innerHTML = UNITS.map((u) => `<option ${u === it.unit ? "selected" : ""}>${u}</option>`).join("");
        s.onchange = () => updateCostItem(it.id, { unit: s.value as CostUnit });
        d.appendChild(s); return d;
      })(),
      cell(String(it.rate), (v) => updateCostItem(it.id, { rate: Number(v) || 0 }), "80px"),
      cell(it.category, (v) => updateCostItem(it.id, { category: v }), "100px"),
      (() => {
        const d = document.createElement("td"); d.style.cssText = "padding:3px 4px";
        d.appendChild(miniBtn("🗑", () => { if (confirm(`Delete cost item "${it.code} ${it.name}"?`)) { deleteCostItem(it.id); renderBody(); } }));
        return d;
      })(),
    );
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  }
  table.appendChild(tbody);
  body.appendChild(table);
}

// ── Summary tab ──
function renderSummary() {
  const rows = getRows();
  const totals = computeTotals(rows);
  body.innerHTML = "";

  const curRow = document.createElement("div");
  curRow.style.cssText = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px";
  const curInp = document.createElement("input");
  curInp.value = getCurrency(); curInp.style.cssText = INP + ";width:44px;text-align:center";
  curInp.onchange = () => { setCurrency(curInp.value); renderBody(); };
  curRow.append("Currency symbol:", curInp);
  body.appendChild(curRow);

  const grandCard = document.createElement("div");
  grandCard.style.cssText = "padding:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#16233a,#1b1c26);border:1px solid #26466b;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:12px";
  grandCard.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:11px;opacity:.6">TOTAL PROJECT COST</div>
    <div style="font:800 26px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#38bdf8;margin-top:2px">${money(totals.grand)}</div>
    <div style="font-size:10px;opacity:.55;margin-top:4px">${totals.assignedRows} of ${totals.totalRows} rows assigned · ${getItems().length} cost items</div>`;
  body.appendChild(grandCard);

  const barSection = (title: string, data: { name: string; total: number }[]) => {
    const sec = document.createElement("div");
    sec.style.cssText = "margin-bottom:14px";
    sec.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px">${title}</div>`;
    if (!data.length) { sec.innerHTML += `<div style="opacity:.5;font-size:11px">No assigned costs yet.</div>`; body.appendChild(sec); return; }
    const max = Math.max(...data.map((d) => d.total), 1);
    for (const d of data.slice(0, 12)) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.cssText = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:4px 0";
      const label = document.createElement("div");
      label.style.cssText = "width:170px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px";
      label.textContent = d.name; label.title = d.name;
      const track = document.createElement("div");
      track.style.cssText = "flex:1;height:14px;background:#12131a;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden";
      const bar = document.createElement("div");
      bar.style.cssText = `height:100%;width:${Math.max(2, (d.total / max) * 100)}%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#38bdf8,#818cf8)`;
      track.appendChild(bar);
      const val = document.createElement("div");
      val.style.cssText = "width:110px;text-align:right;font-size:11px;color:#22c55e;font-weight:600";
      val.textContent = money(d.total);
      row.append(label, track, val);
      sec.appendChild(row);
    }
    body.appendChild(sec);
  };

  barSection("By cost category", totals.byCategory);
  barSection("By cost item", totals.byItem.map((x) => ({ name: `${x.item.code} · ${x.item.name}`, total: x.total })));
}

function renderBody() {
  if (activeTab === "takeoff") renderTakeoff();
  else if (activeTab === "items") renderItems();
  else renderSummary();
}

// ── CSV export (exported: used by the File menu too) ──
export function exportCostCsv() {
  const rows = getRows();
  if (!rows.length) { alert("Nothing to export — run Recalculate first."); return; }
  const q = (v: any) => `"${String(v ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  const lines: string[] = ["Source,Label,Detail,Count,Length_m,Area_m2,Volume_m3,CostCode,CostName,Unit,Qty,Rate,LineCost,CostCategory"];
  let grand = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    const { qty, rate, lineCost, item } = computeLine(row);
    grand += lineCost;
    lines.push([
      row.source, q(row.label), q(row.detail), row.count, row.length, row.area, row.volume,
      item ? q(item.code) : "", item ? q(item.name) : "", item?.unit ?? "",
      item ? qty.toFixed(3) : "", item ? rate.toFixed(2) : "", lineCost.toFixed(2),
      item ? q(item.category) : "",
    ].join(","));
  }
  lines.push(`,,,,,,,,,TOTAL,,${grand.toFixed(2)},`);
  const blob = new Blob(["\ufeff" + lines.join("\n")], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url; a.download = "open-bim-studio-cost.csv";
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
}

async function refreshTakeoff() {
  recalculating = true;
  try { renderBody(); await computeTakeoff(); }
  finally { recalculating = false; }
}

// ── Public API ──
export function toggleCostPanel() {
  panel.style.display = panel.style.display === "none" || !panel.style.display ? "flex" : "none";
  if (panel.style.display === "flex") {
    renderHeader(); renderTabs();
    void refreshTakeoff().then(renderBody);
  }
}
export function isCostPanelVisible() { return panel.style.display === "flex"; }
export async function recalculateTakeoff() {
  await refreshTakeoff();
  if (panel.style.display === "flex") renderBody();
}

export function setupCostPanel() {
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);
  onCostChanged(() => { if (panel.style.display === "flex") renderBody(); });
  ctx.features.costPanel = { toggle: toggleCostPanel, isVisible: isCostPanelVisible, recalculate: recalculateTakeoff };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Critical Gaps UI - bottom toolbar with one-click access to Revit-parity tools.
 * Extends the original advanced toolbar with Architecture / Modify / View actions.
 */

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let toolbar: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let styleInstalled = false;

function installStyle(): void {
  if (styleInstalled) return;
  styleInstalled = true;
  const css = `
.obs-adv-toolbar {
  position: fixed; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); bottom: 46px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 5px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center; max-width: calc(100vw - 40px); z-index: 10001;
  font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}
.obs-adv-btn {
  width: auto; min-width: 108px; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 9px;
  border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid #2a2e3a; background: #1e2029;
  color: #cbd5e1; font: 600 11px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
  cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
  transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease;
}
.obs-adv-btn:hover { background: #2a2e3a; color: #f8fafc; border-color: #38bdf8; }
.obs-adv-btn[data-active="1"] {
  background: rgba(56,189,248,.16); color: #7dd3fc; border-color: #38bdf8;
}
.obs-adv-btn[disabled] { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }
.obs-adv-sep {
  width: 1px; height: 28px; background: #2a2e3a; margin: 0 2px; align-self: center;
}
`;
  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.textContent = css;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
}

function makeButton(id: string, label: string, title: string, onClick: () => void): HTMLButtonElement {
  const btn = document.createElement("button");
  btn.className = "obs-adv-btn";
  btn.id = id;
  btn.type = "button";
  btn.textContent = label;
  btn.title = title;
  btn.addEventListener("click", onClick);
  return btn;
}

function flash(btn: HTMLButtonElement, msg: string, ms = 1400): void {
  const old = btn.textContent;
  btn.textContent = msg;
  window.setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = old; }, ms);
}

function sep(): HTMLDivElement {
  const d = document.createElement("div");
  d.className = "obs-adv-sep";
  return d;
}

export async function setupCriticalGapsUI(): Promise<void> {
  if (toolbar) return;
  installStyle();
  toolbar = document.createElement("div");
  toolbar.className = "obs-adv-toolbar";

  // -- Command Center (primary entry) --------------------------------
  const ccBtn = makeButton("obs-adv-cc", "Ctrl+ Command Center", "Open Revit Command Center (Ctrl+Shift+R)", () => {
    const cc = (window as Any).__obsRevitCC;
    if (cc?.toggle) cc.toggle();
    else window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "R", ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: true }));
  });
  ccBtn.style.minWidth = "148px";
  ccBtn.style.borderColor = "#38bdf8";
  ccBtn.style.color = "#7dd3fc";

  // -- Original advanced tools ---------------------------------------
  const draftBtn = makeButton("obs-adv-draft", "[D] 2D Draft", "Toggle 2D drafting overlay", () => {
    const d = (window as Any).__obsDrafting2D;
    if (!d) { flash(draftBtn, "[!] Draft"); return; }
    const active = !!d.getTool?.();
    d.setTool(active ? null : "line");
  });
  const refreshDraft = (): void => {
    const d = (window as Any).__obsDrafting2D;
    const active = !!d?.getTool?.();
    draftBtn.textContent = active ? "[D] Draft: ON" : "[D] 2D Draft";
    draftBtn.dataset.active = active ? "1" : "0";

  window.addEventListener("obs:draft-tool-changed", refreshDraft);

  const hostBtn = makeButton("obs-adv-hosts", "[H] Hosts", "Recompute wall openings", async () => {

  const solveBtn = makeButton("obs-adv-solve", "[S] Solve", "Hosted constraint solver", () => {

    flash(groupBtn, g ? "[OK]" : "[!]");

  // -- View ----------------------------------------------------------
  const hideBtn = makeButton("obs-adv-hide", "Hide", "Temporary hide selection", () => {

  const resetVisBtn = makeButton("obs-adv-resetvis", "Reset Vis", "Reset temp hide/isolate", () => {

  // -- Panels --------------------------------------------------------
  const phasesBtn = makeButton("obs-adv-phases", "Phases", "Open phasing panel", () => {

  });
  const roomsBtn = makeButton("obs-adv-rooms-panel", "Rooms", "Open rooms panel", () => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-open-panel", { detail: { id: "rooms" } }));
  });
  const optsBtn = makeButton("obs-adv-opts", "Options", "Design options panel", () => {

  });

  // -- LOD / Perf / Collab (kept) ------------------------------------
  const lodBtn = makeButton("obs-adv-lod", "[L] LOD", "Toggle LOD culling", () => {
    const l = (window as Any).__obsLodManager;
    if (!l) { flash(lodBtn, "[!]"); return; }
    const on = !!l.setEnabled?.(!l.isEnabled?.());
    lodBtn.textContent = on ? "[L] LOD: ON" : "[L] LOD: OFF";
    lodBtn.dataset.active = on ? "1" : "0";
  });
  const perfBtn = makeButton("obs-adv-perf", "[P] Perf", "Toggle frustum culling", () => {
    const p = (window as Any).__obsPerfOptimizer;
    if (!p) { flash(perfBtn, "[!]"); return; }
    const on = !!p.setEnabled?.(!p.isEnabled?.());
    perfBtn.textContent = on ? "[P] Perf: ON" : "[P] Perf: OFF";
    perfBtn.dataset.active = on ? "1" : "0";
  });

  toolbar.append(
    ccBtn,
    sep(),
    draftBtn, hostBtn, solveBtn,
    sep(),
    stairBtn, railBtn, cwBtn, roomBtn,
    sep(),
    alignBtn, matchBtn, matchApplyBtn, groupBtn,
    sep(),
    hideBtn, isoBtn, resetVisBtn,
    sep(),
    phasesBtn, roomsBtn, optsBtn,
    sep(),
    lodBtn, perfBtn,
  );

  document.body.appendChild(toolbar);
  // Migrated to top ribbon - keep buttons in DOM for programmatic click, hide bar
  toolbar.style.display = "none";
  toolbar.setAttribute("data-parity-ribbon-migrated", "1");
  refreshDraft();

  // Command palette extras
  try {
    const cp: Any = await import("./command-palette");
    const reg = cp.registerCommand;
    if (typeof reg === "function") {
      reg({ id: "advanced.draft2d", label: "2D Draft Overlay", category: "Advanced", run: () => draftBtn.click() });
      reg({ id: "advanced.updateHosts", label: "Update Hosted Openings", category: "Advanced", run: () => hostBtn.click() });
      reg({ id: "advanced.solveConstraints", label: "Solve Hosted Constraints", category: "Advanced", run: () => solveBtn.click() });
    }
  } catch { /* */ }

  console.log("[critical-gaps-ui] toolbar ready (hidden - tools in top ribbon)");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Cursor coordinate readout.
 *
 * Raycasts the pointer against loaded models + the ground plane; posts the
 * world X / Y / Z to the status bar. Throttled to one raycast per animation
 * frame so it never fights the render loop.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

let coordsEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
let rafPending = false;
let lastClientX = 0;
let lastClientY = 0;
let hasPosition = false;

const ndc = new THREE.Vector2();
const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();

function fmt(n: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return "—";
  const abs = Math.abs(n);
  if (abs >= 1000) return n.toFixed(1);
  if (abs >= 10) return n.toFixed(2);
  return n.toFixed(3);
}

function getTargets(): THREE.Object3D[] {
  const out: THREE.Object3D[] = [];
  try {
    for (const [, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
      if (model?.object) out.push(model.object);
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  if (ctx.groundPlane) out.push(ctx.groundPlane);
  return out;
}

function doRaycast(): void {
  rafPending = false;
  if (!coordsEl) return;
  const host = ctx.rightHost;
  if (!host) return;

  const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = lastClientX - rect.left;
  const y = lastClientY - rect.top;

  if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x > rect.width || y > rect.height) {
    coordsEl.textContent = "X —   Y —   Z —";
    hasPosition = false;
    return;
  }

  ndc.set((x / rect.width) * 2 - 1, -(y / rect.height) * 2 + 1);
  ray.setFromCamera(ndc, ctx.world.camera.three);

  const targets = getTargets();
  if (!targets.length) {
    coordsEl.textContent = "X —   Y —   Z —";
    hasPosition = false;
    return;
  }

  let hitPoint: THREE.Vector3 | null = null;
  try {
    const hits = ray.intersectObjects(targets, true);
    if (hits.length) hitPoint = hits[0].point.clone();
  } catch { /* */ }

  if (!hitPoint) {
    coordsEl.textContent = "X —   Y —   Z —";
    hasPosition = false;
    return;
  }

  hasPosition = true;
  // Revit axes: X/Y horizontal, Z vertical (elevation). Engine is Y-up Three.js.
  coordsEl.textContent =
    `X ${fmt(hitPoint.x)}   Y ${fmt(hitPoint.z)}   Z ${fmt(hitPoint.y)}`;
}

function onPointerMove(e: PointerEvent): void {
  lastClientX = e.clientX;
  lastClientY = e.clientY;
  if (rafPending) return;
  rafPending = true;
  requestAnimationFrame(doRaycast);
}

function onPointerLeave(): void {
  if (coordsEl) coordsEl.textContent = "X —   Y —   Z —";
  hasPosition = false;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Setup
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function setupCursorTracker(): void {
  // Reuse the status bar's coords slot if present; otherwise create one.
  coordsEl = document.querySelector("[data-obs-coords]") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!coordsEl) {
    // Create a floating readout in the bottom-right of the viewport as a
    // fallback so the feature still works even without a status-bar slot.
    coordsEl = document.createElement("div");
    coordsEl.dataset.obsCoords = "1";
    coordsEl.style.cssText =
      "position:absolute;right:14px;bottom:14px;z-index:55;" +
      "background:rgba(20,22,30,.85);color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);" +
      "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:6px;" +
      "padding:5px 10px;font:11px/1 var(--font-mono,monospace);" +
      "letter-spacing:.2px;pointer-events:none;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)";
    coordsEl.textContent = "X —   Y —   Z —";
    ctx.rightHost.appendChild(coordsEl);
  }

  ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
  ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("pointerleave", onPointerLeave);

  ctx.features.cursorTracker = {
    isActive: () => hasPosition,
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Double-click fit.
 *
 * When the user double-clicks an element in the 3D view, the camera
 * smoothly frames that element and sets it as the orbit pivot.
 *
 * Works for both:
 *   - authored elements (walls, slabs, columns you drew)
 *   - fragment elements (IFC / FRAG models loaded in the scene)
 *
 * If the double-click lands on empty space, nothing happens (no
 * camera move, no fit all) so it never surprises the user.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { inputRouter, type Gesture } from "../core/input-router";
import { fitToMap, focusOnBox, setOrbitPivot } from "./camera-tools";

let installed = false;

export function setupDblclickFit(): void {
  if (installed) { console.log("[dblclick-fit] already installed"); return; }
  installed = true;

  inputRouter.subscribe((g) => {
    if (g.kind !== "dblclick") return false;
    if (g.button !== 0) return false;               // left button only
    void fitUnderCursor(g.event);
    return true; // consume — nothing else should react
  }, 60); // priority 60 — before navigation (30) and context-menu (20)

  (ctx.features as any).dblclickFit = {
    fitUnderCursor,
  };
  console.log("[dblclick-fit] ready");
}

async function fitUnderCursor(e: PointerEvent): Promise<void> {
  // ── 1. Authored element first (no worker round-trip) ─────────────
  try {
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    const id: string | null = auth?.pickAuthoredElementAt?.(e) ?? null;
    if (id) {
      const el = auth.getElementById?.(id);
      const wb: THREE.Box3 | null = el ? auth.getElementWorldBox?.(el) : null;
      if (wb && !wb.isEmpty()) {
        focusOnBox(wb);
        try { setOrbitPivot(wb.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3())); } catch { /* */ }
        console.log("[dblclick-fit] authored:", el?.name ?? id);
        return;
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[dblclick-fit] authored pick failed", err);
  }

  // ── 2. Fragment element ───────────────────────────────────────────
  try {
    const selMod: any = await import("./selection");
    const hit = await selMod.pickFragmentAtPointer?.();
    if (!hit) return; // empty space -> no-op

    const map: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};
    map[hit.modelId] = new Set([hit.localId]);
    await fitToMap(map as any);

    // Set orbit pivot to fragment's world center
    try {
      const model: any = ctx.fragments.list.get(hit.modelId);
      if (model) {
        const wbMod: any = await import("../modules/geometry/world-box");
        const wbs = await wbMod.getElementWorldBoxes(model, [hit.localId], hit.modelId);
        const box = wbs?.[0]?.box as THREE.Box3 | undefined;
        if (box && !box.isEmpty()) {
          setOrbitPivot(box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()));
        }
      }
    } catch { /* */ }

    console.log("[dblclick-fit] fragment:", hit.modelId, "#" + hit.localId);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[dblclick-fit] fragment fit failed", err);
  }
}
```

--- FILE: src/features/dockable.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Dockable panel controller.
 *
 * Wraps an absolutely-positioned element with:
 *   • Drag by header (or by whole element if no header given)
 *   • Resize from any of 8 edges/corners
 *   • Dock to left / right / floating — snap when dragged near an edge
 *   • Persists size + position + dock state in localStorage per panel ID
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const dock = makeDockable(panelEl, {
 *     id: "property-palette",
 *     host: ctx.rightHost,
 *     header: panelHeaderEl,
 *     minWidth: 220, minHeight: 200,
 *     defaultDock: "right",
 *   });
 *   dock.toggle(); dock.dock("left"); dock.reset();
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

export type DockSide = "left" | "right" | "float";

export interface DockOptions {
  id: string;
  host?: HTMLElement;
  /** Optional drag handle. When omitted, the whole panel drags. */
  header?: HTMLElement;
  minWidth?: number;
  minHeight?: number;
  maxWidth?: number;
  maxHeight?: number;
  defaultDock?: DockSide;
  defaultWidth?: number;
  defaultHeight?: number;
  /** Gap from the host's edges when docked. */
  margin?: number;
  /** Distance from an edge at which a floating drag snaps to dock. */
  snapThreshold?: number;
  /**
   * Extra min/dock/close chrome injected into the header.
   * Default false — most panels already ship their own close/clear buttons;
   * enabling this stacks a second control row and fights header re-renders.
   */
  windowControls?: boolean | "close";
  /**
   * When true (default), only the header is a drag handle.
   * Whole-panel drag is only used when no header is provided.
   */
  headerDragOnly?: boolean;
}

interface PersistedState {
  dock: DockSide;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  /** Position relative to host (top-left). Only meaningful for "float". */
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

const STORAGE_PREFIX = "obs.dock.";

const RESIZE_CURSOR: Record<string, string> = {
  n: "ns-resize", s: "ns-resize",
  e: "ew-resize", w: "ew-resize",
  ne: "nesw-resize", sw: "nesw-resize",
  nw: "nwse-resize", se: "nwse-resize",
};

export interface DockHandle {
  /** Return the current dock side. */
  side(): DockSide;
  /** Programmatically change dock side. */
  dock(side: DockSide): void;
  /** Show / hide the panel. Does not change dock state. */
  show(): void;
  hide(): void;
  toggle(): void;
  isVisible(): boolean;
  /** Reset size + position to defaults and reapply stored dock side. */
  reset(): void;
  /** Cycle docked → floating → right, similar to Revit-style panel management. */
  cycleDock(): void;
  /** Collapse content while keeping the window header/controls visible. */
  minimize(): void;
  /** Update the header used for dragging (e.g. if you rebuild it). */
  setHeader(el: HTMLElement | null): void;
  /** Detach — removes listeners and resize handles. */
  dispose(): void;
}

export function makeDockable(panel: HTMLElement, opts: DockOptions): DockHandle {
  // Bubble-phase only: let target handlers run, then stop the event
  // from reaching legacy host listeners. Capture-phase filtering is
  // handled by input-router (isUiEventTarget).
  panel.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  panel.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  panel.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => e.stopPropagation(), { passive: true });

  const id = opts.id;
  const host = opts.host ?? ctx.rightHost;
  const margin = opts.margin ?? 8;
  const snapThreshold = opts.snapThreshold ?? 24;
  const minW = opts.minWidth ?? 200;
  const minH = opts.minHeight ?? 150;

  // If the host isn't positioned, panels will land in the wrong place.
  const hostPosition = getComputedStyle(host).position;
  if (hostPosition === "static") host.style.position = "relative";

  // ── Persisted state ──
  const key = STORAGE_PREFIX + id;
  let state: PersistedState = loadState();
  let minimized = false;
  let restoreHeight = state.height;
  let controlsHost: HTMLElement | null = null;
  let controlsObserver: MutationObserver | null = null;
  let updatingControls = false;

  function loadState(): PersistedState {
    const fallback: PersistedState = {
      dock: opts.defaultDock ?? "right",
      width: opts.defaultWidth ?? 300,
      height: opts.defaultHeight ?? 400,
      x: margin,
      y: margin,
    };
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (!raw) return fallback;
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return {
        dock: parsed.dock ?? fallback.dock,
        width: clamp(Number(parsed.width) || fallback.width, minW, opts.maxWidth ?? 1200),
        height: clamp(Number(parsed.height) || fallback.height, minH, opts.maxHeight ?? 2000),
        x: Number(parsed.x) || fallback.x,
        y: Number(parsed.y) || fallback.y,
      };
    } catch {
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  function saveState(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(state));
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }

  function clamp(v: number, lo: number, hi: number): number {
    return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));
  }

  // ── Apply state to the DOM ──
  function applyLayout(): void {
    const hostRect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    panel.style.position = "absolute";
    panel.style.boxSizing = "border-box";

    if (state.dock === "left") {
      panel.style.left = `${margin}px`;
      panel.style.right = "auto";
      panel.style.top = `${margin}px`;
      panel.style.width = `${Math.min(state.width, hostRect.width - margin * 2)}px`;
      panel.style.height = `${Math.min(state.height, hostRect.height - margin * 2)}px`;
    } else if (state.dock === "right") {
      panel.style.right = `${margin}px`;
      panel.style.left = "auto";
      panel.style.top = `${margin}px`;
      panel.style.width = `${Math.min(state.width, hostRect.width - margin * 2)}px`;
      panel.style.height = `${Math.min(state.height, hostRect.height - margin * 2)}px`;
    } else {
      // float — position is set by drag
      panel.style.left = `${state.x}px`;
      panel.style.right = "auto";
      panel.style.top = `${state.y}px`;
      panel.style.width = `${state.width}px`;
      panel.style.height = `${state.height}px`;
    }
  }

  // ── Resize handles ──
  const HANDLES: Array<"n" | "s" | "e" | "w" | "ne" | "nw" | "se" | "sw"> =
    ["n", "s", "e", "w", "ne", "nw", "se", "sw"];
  
const handleEls: HTMLDivElement[] = [];
  const SIZE = 6;
  for (const h of HANDLES) {
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.dataset.resizeHandle = h;
    el.style.cssText =
      `position:absolute;z-index:4;` +
      (h.includes("n") ? `top:0;height:${SIZE}px;` : "") +
      (h.includes("s") ? `bottom:0;height:${SIZE}px;` : "") +
      (h.includes("e") ? `right:0;width:${SIZE}px;` : "") +
      (h.includes("w") ? `left:0;width:${SIZE}px;` : "") +
      (h === "n" || h === "s" ? "left:6px;right:6px;" : "") +
      (h === "e" || h === "w" ? "top:6px;bottom:6px;" : "") +
      `cursor:${RESIZE_CURSOR[h]};` +
      (h.includes("n") && h.includes("w") ? "top:0;left:0;width:12px;height:12px;" : "") +
      (h.includes("n") && h.includes("e") ? "top:0;right:0;width:12px;height:12px;" : "") +
      (h.includes("s") && h.includes("w") ? "bottom:0;left:0;width:12px;height:12px;" : "") +
      (h.includes("s") && h.includes("e") ? "bottom:0;right:0;width:12px;height:12px;" : "");
    el.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => startResize(e, h));
    panel.appendChild(el);
    handleEls.push(el);
  }

  let resize: {
    dir: string;
    startX: number;
    startY: number;
    startW: number;
    startH: number;
    startL: number;
    startT: number;
    pointerId: number;
  } | null = null;

  function startResize(e: PointerEvent, dir: string): void {
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
    const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    const hostRect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    resize = {
      dir,
      startX: e.clientX,
      startY: e.clientY,
      startW: rect.width,
      startH: rect.height,
      startL: rect.left - hostRect.left,
      startT: rect.top - hostRect.top,
      pointerId: e.pointerId,
    };
    (e.target as Element).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    document.body.style.cursor = RESIZE_CURSOR[dir];
  }

  function onResizeMove(e: PointerEvent): void {
    if (!resize) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - resize.startX;
    const dy = e.clientY - resize.startY;
    let w = resize.startW;
    let h = resize.startH;
    let l = resize.startL;
    let t = resize.startT;

    if (resize.dir.includes("e")) w = resize.startW + dx;
    if (resize.dir.includes("s")) h = resize.startH + dy;
    if (resize.dir.includes("w")) {
      w = resize.startW - dx;
      l = resize.startL + dx;
    }
    if (resize.dir.includes("n")) {
      h = resize.startH - dy;
      t = resize.startT + dy;
    }
    w = clamp(w, minW, opts.maxWidth ?? 2000);
    h = clamp(h, minH, opts.maxHeight ?? 2000);

    state.width = w;
    state.height = h;
    if (state.dock === "float") {
      state.x = l;
      state.y = t;
    }
    applyLayout();
  }

  function onResizeUp(): void {
    if (!resize) return;
    resize = null;
    document.body.style.cursor = "";
    saveState();
  }

  window.addEventListener("pointermove", onResizeMove);
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", onResizeUp);

  // ── Drag ──
  let drag: {
    startX: number;
    startY: number;
    startL: number;
    startT: number;
    pointerId: number;
    moved: boolean;
  } | null = null;

  function onDragDown(e: PointerEvent): void {
    // Only primary button; ignore resize handles and interactive content.
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (!target) return;
    if (target.dataset?.resizeHandle) return;
    if (target.closest(
      "input,select,button,textarea,label,a,option," +
      "[contenteditable=true],[data-no-drag],.obs-no-drag," +
      "[data-obs-window-controls],pre,code",
    )) return;

    // If dragging from header, require the event to originate in the header
    // (not a nested scrollable body that somehow bubbled).
    if (opts.header && !opts.header.contains(target)) return;

    const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    const hostRect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    drag = {
      startX: e.clientX,
      startY: e.clientY,
      startL: rect.left - hostRect.left,
      startT: rect.top - hostRect.top,
      pointerId: e.pointerId,
      moved: false,
    };
    // Do NOT capture until the pointer actually moves — otherwise a click
    // or text-selection gesture on the header is stolen.
  }

  function onDragMove(e: PointerEvent): void {
    if (!drag) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - drag.startX;
    const dy = e.clientY - drag.startY;
    if (!drag.moved && Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) < 4) return;
    if (!drag.moved) {
      drag.moved = true;
      try {
        const handle = opts.header ?? panel;
        handle.setPointerCapture(drag.pointerId);
      } catch { /* */ }
    }

    // Escape a docked state into float on first drag.
    if (state.dock !== "float") {
      const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
      const hostRect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
      state.dock = "float";
      state.x = rect.left - hostRect.left;
      state.y = rect.top - hostRect.top;
      drag.startL = state.x;
      drag.startT = state.y;
      drag.startX = e.clientX;
      drag.startY = e.clientY;
      panel.style.right = "auto";
    }

    state.x = drag.startL + dx;
    state.y = drag.startT + dy;

    // Clamp inside host.
    const hostRect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    state.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(hostRect.width - state.width, state.x));
    state.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(hostRect.height - 40, state.y));

    applyLayout();
  }

  function onDragUp(e: PointerEvent): void {
    if (!drag) return;
    const moved = drag.moved;
    drag = null;
    if (!moved) return;

    // Snap to left / right if within threshold.
    const hostRect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    const rightEdge = state.x + state.width;
    if (state.x < snapThreshold) {
      state.dock = "left";
    } else if (rightEdge > hostRect.width - snapThreshold) {
      state.dock = "right";
    }
    applyLayout();
    saveState();
  }

  function makeControl(label: string, title: string, fn: () => void): HTMLButtonElement {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.type = "button"; b.textContent = label; b.title = title;
    b.style.cssText =
      "width:24px;height:22px;padding:0;margin-left:2px;border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.25);" +
      "border-radius:4px;background:rgba(15,23,42,.35);color:#cbd5e1;cursor:pointer;font:12px system-ui";
    b.onclick = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); fn(); };
    b.onmouseenter = () => { b.style.background = "rgba(56,189,248,.14)"; };
    b.onmouseleave = () => { b.style.background = "rgba(15,23,42,.35)"; };
    return b;
  }

  function applyMinimizedLayout(): void {
    if (!minimized) {
      panel.style.height = `${state.height}px`;
      for (const child of Array.from(panel.children)) {
        const el = child as HTMLElement;
        if (el === controlsHost || el === opts.header || el.dataset.resizeHandle) continue;
        el.style.display = el.dataset.obsPrevDisplay ?? "";
      }
      if (opts.header) opts.header.style.display = opts.header.dataset.obsPrevDisplay ?? "";
      return;
    }
    panel.style.height = `${Math.max(34, Math.min(46, restoreHeight))}px`;
    for (const child of Array.from(panel.children)) {
      const el = child as HTMLElement;
      if (el === controlsHost || el === opts.header || el.dataset.resizeHandle) continue;
      if (el.dataset.obsPrevDisplay == null) el.dataset.obsPrevDisplay = el.style.display;
      el.style.display = "none";
    }
  }

  function ensureWindowControls(): void {
    const header = opts.header;
    if (!header || updatingControls) return;

    // Default: no injected chrome. Panels own their header buttons.
    const mode = opts.windowControls ?? false;
    if (!mode) {
      if (controlsHost) {
        controlsHost.remove();
        controlsHost = null;
      }
      return;
    }

    updatingControls = true;
    try {
      if (!controlsHost || controlsHost.parentElement !== header) {
        controlsHost = document.createElement("div");
        controlsHost.style.cssText =
          "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;flex:none;margin-left:auto";
        controlsHost.dataset.obsWindowControls = "1";
        header.appendChild(controlsHost);
      }
      controlsHost.innerHTML = "";
      if (mode === true) {
        const minBtn = makeControl(minimized ? "□" : "—", minimized ? "Restore" : "Minimize", () => {
          if (!minimized) restoreHeight = state.height;
          minimized = !minimized;
          if (!minimized) state.height = Math.max(minH, restoreHeight);
          applyMinimizedLayout(); saveState(); ensureWindowControls();
        });
        const dockBtn = makeControl(
          state.dock === "float" ? "⇲" : "⇱",
          state.dock === "float" ? "Dock right" : "Float window",
          () => { dock(state.dock === "float" ? "right" : "float"); },
        );
        controlsHost.append(minBtn, dockBtn);
      }
      const closeBtn = makeControl("×", "Close", () => hide());
      controlsHost.append(closeBtn);
    } finally {
      updatingControls = false;
    }
  }

  function cycleDock(): void {
    dock(state.dock === "right" ? "float" : state.dock === "float" ? "left" : "right");
  }

  function minimize(): void {
    if (!minimized) restoreHeight = state.height;
    minimized = !minimized;
    if (!minimized) state.height = Math.max(minH, restoreHeight);
    applyMinimizedLayout(); ensureWindowControls(); saveState();
  }

  // Header-based drag if provided; otherwise whole-panel drag.
  const dragTarget = opts.header ?? panel;
  dragTarget.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDragDown);
  dragTarget.addEventListener("pointermove", onDragMove);
  dragTarget.addEventListener("pointerup", onDragUp);

  // Header cursor hint
  if (opts.header) opts.header.style.cursor = "grab";

  // ── Public handle ──
  let visible = panel.style.display !== "none";

  function show(): void {
    visible = true;
    panel.style.display = "flex";
    applyLayout();
    applyMinimizedLayout();
    ensureWindowControls();
  }
  function hide(): void {
    visible = false;
    panel.style.display = "none";
  }
  function toggle(): void {
    visible ? hide() : show();
  }
  function isVisible(): boolean {
    return visible && panel.style.display !== "none";
  }
  function dock(side: DockSide): void {
    state.dock = side;
    if (side === "float" && state.x === 0 && state.y === 0) { state.x = margin + 24; state.y = margin + 24; }
    applyLayout();
    applyMinimizedLayout();
    ensureWindowControls();
    saveState();
    show();
  }
  function reset(): void {
    minimized = false;
    state.width = opts.defaultWidth ?? 300;
    state.height = opts.defaultHeight ?? 400;
    restoreHeight = state.height;
    state.x = margin;
    state.y = margin;
    applyLayout();
    applyMinimizedLayout();
    ensureWindowControls();
    saveState();
  }
  function setHeader(el: HTMLElement | null): void {
    if (opts.header === el) { ensureWindowControls(); return; }
    if (controlsObserver) { controlsObserver.disconnect(); controlsObserver = null; }
    if (opts.header) {
      opts.header.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDragDown);
      opts.header.removeEventListener("pointermove", onDragMove);
      opts.header.removeEventListener("pointerup", onDragUp);
      opts.header.style.cursor = "";
    }
    opts.header = el ?? undefined;
    const target = opts.header ?? panel;
    target.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDragDown);
    target.addEventListener("pointermove", onDragMove);
    target.addEventListener("pointerup", onDragUp);
    if (opts.header) {
      opts.header.style.cursor = "grab";
      ensureWindowControls();
      if (opts.windowControls ?? false) {
        controlsObserver = new MutationObserver(() => { if (!updatingControls) ensureWindowControls(); });
        controlsObserver.observe(opts.header, { childList: true, subtree: false });
      }
    }
  }
  function dispose(): void {
    if (controlsObserver) { controlsObserver.disconnect(); controlsObserver = null; }
    window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onResizeMove);
    window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onResizeUp);
    for (const h of handleEls) h.remove();
    const target = opts.header ?? panel;
    target.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDragDown);
    target.removeEventListener("pointermove", onDragMove);
    target.removeEventListener("pointerup", onDragUp);
  }

  // Initial layout. Window chrome is opt-in (windowControls).
  if (visible) { applyLayout(); ensureWindowControls(); applyMinimizedLayout(); }
  else panel.style.display = "none";
  if (opts.header && (opts.windowControls ?? false)) {
    controlsObserver = new MutationObserver(() => { if (!updatingControls) ensureWindowControls(); });
    controlsObserver.observe(opts.header, { childList: true, subtree: false });
  }

  return { side: () => state.dock, dock, cycleDock, minimize, show, hide, toggle, isVisible, reset, setHeader, dispose };
}
```
