﻿/** Universal file opening: converts everything the browser can, guides for the rest. */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { computeSceneBounds, fitAll } from "./camera-tools";
import { loadIfcFiles, loadFragFiles } from "./importer";
import { markDirty } from "../modules/projects/projects";

export const ACCEPT_ALL =
  ".ifc,.ifczip,.zip,.frag,.obs.json,.json,.glb,.gltf,.obj,.stl,.ply,.fbx,.dae,.3ds,.rvt,.rfa,.dwg,.dxf,.skp";

const DESKTOP_ONLY: Record<string, string> = {
  rvt: "Revit files cannot be converted in the browser.\n\nIn Revit: File â†’ Export â†’ IFC â†’ export the model, then import the .ifc here.",
  rfa: "Revit families cannot be converted in the browser.\n\nLoad the family into a Revit project, then export the project as IFC and import it here.",
  dwg: "DWG cannot be converted in the browser.\n\nIn AutoCAD: save as DXF, or better export the model as IFC / OBJ, then import here.",
  skp: "SketchUp files cannot be converted in the browser.\n\nIn SketchUp: File â†’ Export â†’ IFC / OBJ / DAE (3D model), then import here.",
};

const auxGroup = new THREE.Group();
const auxIds: string[] = [];

const uid = () => (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `aux-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;

function pickFilesLocal(accept: string, cb: (files: File[]) => void) {
  const input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "file"; input.accept = accept; input.multiple = true;
  input.onchange = () => { if (input.files?.length) cb(Array.from(input.files)); };
  input.click();
}

function ext(name: string) { return (name.split(".").pop() ?? "").toLowerCase(); }

function download(blob: Blob, name: string) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url; a.download = name;
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
}

// â”€â”€ Aux object lifecycle â”€â”€
export function getAuxBox(): THREE.Box3 | null {
  if (!auxGroup.children.length) return null;
  return new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(auxGroup);
}
export function getAuxObjects(): THREE.Object3D[] { return auxGroup.children; }

export function clearAux() {
  while (auxGroup.children.length) {
    const ch = auxGroup.children[0];
    auxGroup.remove(ch);
    ch.traverse((m: any) => {
      m.geometry?.dispose?.();
      if (Array.isArray(m.material)) m.material.forEach((x: any) => x.dispose?.());
      else m.material?.dispose?.();
    });
  }
  auxIds.length = 0;
}

// â”€â”€â”€ Revit-style isometric view â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Positions the camera at 45Â° azimuth, ~35Â° elevation looking at
// the scene center. This mimics the default 3D View in Revit.
function applyRevitIsoView() {
  try {
    const cam = (ctx.world.scene as any).camera as THREE.PerspectiveCamera | THREE.OrthographicCamera;
    const controls = (ctx.world.scene as any).controls;
    if (!cam) return;

    // Compute bounding box of the scene (or aux group)
    const target =
      (typeof getAuxBox === "function" ? getAuxBox() : null) ||
      (() => {
        const box = new THREE.Box3();
        ctx.world.scene.three.children.forEach((c: any) => {
          if (c.visible) box.expandByObject(c);
        });
        return box;
      })();

    if (!target || target.isEmpty()) return;

    const center = new THREE.Vector3();
    const size = new THREE.Vector3();
    target.getCenter(center);
    target.getSize(size);

    const radius = Math.max(size.x, size.y, size.z) * 0.5 || 10;
    const dist = radius * 2.4; // pull back a bit for breathing room

    // Revit default 3D view: SE isometric. In a Y-up system this is:
    // +X to the right, +Z toward viewer, +Y up.
    // Azimuth 45Â°, elevation ~35.264Â° (true isometric).
    const az = Math.PI / 4;              // 45Â°
    const el = Math.atan(1 / Math.SQRT2); // â‰ˆ 35.26Â°

    const dx = Math.cos(el) * Math.sin(az);
    const dy = Math.sin(el);
    const dz = Math.cos(el) * Math.cos(az);

    const camPos = new THREE.Vector3(
      center.x + dist * dx,
      center.y + dist * dy,
      center.z + dist * dz
    );

    cam.position.copy(camPos);
    cam.up.set(0, 1, 0);
    cam.lookAt(center);
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();

    if (controls) {
      (controls as any).target?.copy(center);
      (controls as any).update?.();
    }

    // Notify the app that the camera changed (some features listen for this)
    try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:camera-changed")); } catch { /* */ }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[file-interop] applyRevitIsoView failed:", err);
  }
}
function addAuxObject(obj: THREE.Object3D, label: string) {
  obj.name = label;
  auxGroup.add(obj);
  computeSceneBounds();
  fitAll();
  // Override the default fit view with a Revit-style isometric view
  setTimeout(() => applyRevitIsoView(), 0);
  markDirty();
}

function geometryToMesh(geo: THREE.BufferGeometry, label: string): THREE.Mesh {
  geo.computeVertexNormals?.();
  return new THREE.Mesh(geo, new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xb9c2cc }));
}

/** Re-load a persisted aux blob (called by projects.openProject). */
export async function restoreAux(blob: Blob, name: string) {
  const buf = await blob.arrayBuffer();
  const obj = await parseModelBytes(buf, name);
  if (obj) addAuxObject(obj, name);
}

async function parseModelBytes(buf: ArrayBuffer, name: string): Promise<THREE.Object3D | null> {
  const e = ext(name);
  try {
    if (e === "glb" || e === "gltf") {
      const { GLTFLoader } = await import("three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js");
      const gltf = await new GLTFLoader().parseAsync(buf, "");
      return gltf.scene;
    }
    if (e === "obj") {
      const { OBJLoader } = await import("three/examples/jsm/loaders/OBJLoader.js");
      return new OBJLoader().parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buf));
    }
    if (e === "stl") {
      const { STLLoader } = await import("three/examples/jsm/loaders/STLLoader.js");
      return geometryToMesh(new STLLoader().parse(buf), name);
    }
    if (e === "ply") {
      const { PLYLoader } = await import("three/examples/jsm/loaders/PLYLoader.js");
      return geometryToMesh(new PLYLoader().parse(buf), name);
    }
    if (e === "fbx") {
      const { FBXLoader } = await import("three/examples/jsm/loaders/FBXLoader.js");
      return new FBXLoader().parse(buf, "");
    }
    if (e === "dae") {
      const { ColladaLoader } = await import("three/examples/jsm/loaders/ColladaLoader.js");
      const collada = new ColladaLoader().parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buf), "");
      return collada.scene;
    }
    if (e === "3ds") {
      const { TDSLoader } = await import("three/examples/jsm/loaders/TDSLoader.js");
      return new TDSLoader().parse(buf, "");
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    alert(`Could not parse "${name}":\n${err?.message ?? err}\n\nTip: .glb (binary, single file) is the most reliable mesh format.`);
  }
  return null;
}

// â”€â”€ Router â”€â”€
export async function importFiles(files: File[]) {
  for (const file of files) {
    const e = ext(file.name);
    try {
      if (e === "ifc") { loadIfcFiles([file]); continue; }
      if (e === "frag") { loadFragFiles([file]); continue; }

      if (e === "ifczip" || (e === "zip" && /\.ifczip$|\.zip$/i.test(file.name))) {
        const JSZip = (await import("jszip")).default;
        const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(file);
        const ifcPaths: string[] = [];
        zip.forEach((p) => { if (/\.ifc$/i.test(p)) ifcPaths.push(p); });
        if (!ifcPaths.length) { alert(`No .ifc entries inside "${file.name}".`); continue; }
        const converted: File[] = [];
        for (const p of ifcPaths) {
          const bytes = await zip.file(p)!.async("uint8array");
          converted.push(new File([bytes as any], p.split("/").pop() || `from-${file.name}.ifc`));
        }
        loadIfcFiles(converted);
        continue;
      }

      if (file.name.endsWith(".obs.json") || (e === "json" && file.size < 20_000_000)) {
        const text = await file.text();
        if (text.includes("\"elements\"") && text.includes("\"models\"")) {
          const { putProject } = await import("../modules/projects/store");
          const { openProject } = await import("../modules/projects/projects");
          const doc = JSON.parse(text);
          if (!doc?.id || !Array.isArray(doc.elements)) throw new Error("Not a valid Open BIM Studio project file.");
          await putProject(doc);
          await openProject(doc.id);
          continue;
        }
      }

      if (DESKTOP_ONLY[e]) { alert(DESKTOP_ONLY[e]); continue; }

      // Everything else â†’ try as a 3D model (glb/gltf/obj/stl/ply/fbx/dae/3ds)
      const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const obj = await parseModelBytes(buf, file.name);
      if (obj) {
        addAuxObject(obj, file.name);
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
        (ctx.features.projects as any)?.onModelImported?.(`aux-${uid()}`, file.name, bytes);
      } else {
        alert(`Unsupported file type: "${file.name}"\n\nSupported: ${ACCEPT_ALL}\n\n${Object.entries(DESKTOP_ONLY).map(([k, v]) => `.${k}: ${v.split("\n")[0]}`).join("\n")}`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("[file-interop]", err);
      alert(`Failed to open "${file.name}":\n${err?.message ?? err}`);
    }
  }
}

export function pickAndImport() { pickFilesLocal(ACCEPT_ALL, importFiles); }

// â”€â”€ Setup â”€â”€
export function setupFileInterop() {
  ctx.world.scene.three.add(auxGroup);
  ctx.features.fileInterop = {
    importFiles, pickAndImport, ACCEPT_ALL,
    getAuxBox, getAuxObjects, clearAux, restoreAux,
  };

  // ─── Autodesk dialog event bridge ────────────────────────────────
  // The "Import from Autodesk Viewer" dialog dispatches a CustomEvent
  // after a file drop. We catch it here and route it into importFiles().
  const dialogDropHandler = (evt: Event) => {
    const detail = (evt as CustomEvent<{ file?: File; blob?: Blob; name?: string }>).detail || {};
    const candidates: File[] = [];
    if (detail.file instanceof File) candidates.push(detail.file);
    if (detail.blob instanceof Blob) {
      const n = detail.name || "imported.glb";
      candidates.push(new File([detail.blob], n));
    }
    const evtAny = evt as any;
    if (evtAny.file instanceof File) candidates.push(evtAny.file);

    if (candidates.length) {
      void importFiles(candidates);
    } else {
      console.warn("[file-interop] dialog event had no usable file:", evt);
    }
  };

  const EVENT_NAMES = [
    "openbimstudio:load-geometry",
    "openbimstudio:load-glb",
    "openbimstudio:load-file",
    "obs:load-geometry",
    "obs:load-glb",
    "obs:load-file",
    "obs:import-file",
  ];
  for (const n of EVENT_NAMES) {
    window.addEventListener(n, dialogDropHandler as EventListener);
  }
  console.log("[file-interop] Autodesk dialog bridge installed.");
}

/** Revit-style File application menu: commands + Recent Documents. */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import * as store from "../modules/projects/store";
import { getCurrentProject, saveProject, openProject, deleteProjectById, isDirty, onProjectChanged } from "../modules/projects/projects";
import { showHome } from "../shell/home-screen";
import { captureThumbnail } from "../modules/issues/issues";
import { exportBCF } from "../modules/issues/bcf";
import { exportCostCsv } from "../features/cost-panel";
import { importFiles, pickAndImport, ACCEPT_ALL } from "../features/file-interop";
import { settingsBox } from "../features/importer";

const menu = document.createElement("div");
menu.style.cssText = "position:fixed;top:100px;left:10px;width:760px;max-width:calc(100vw - 20px);z-index:250;display:none;background:#1b1c26;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.6);color:#e2e8f0;font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden";
menu.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

const BTN = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:9px 12px;background:transparent;color:#dbe2ea;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:500 12.5px system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:left";
const BTN_H = BTN + ";background:#24252f";
const SECTION = "font:700 10px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#64748b;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;padding:10px 12px 4px";

const esc = (s: string) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]!));
const uid = () => (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `p-${Date.now()}`;

let built = false;

function item(icon: string, label: string, onclick: () => void, hint = "", danger = false): HTMLElement {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.style.cssText = BTN + (danger ? ";color:#fca5a5" : "");
  b.innerHTML = `<span style="width:20px;text-align:center;font-size:15px">${icon}</span><span style="flex:1">${esc(label)}</span>${hint ? `<span style="opacity:.45;font-size:10px">${esc(hint)}</span>` : ""}`;
  b.onmouseenter = () => (b.style.cssText = BTN_H + (danger ? ";color:#fca5a5" : ""));
  b.onmouseleave = () => (b.style.cssText = BTN + (danger ? ";color:#fca5a5" : ""));
  b.onclick = () => { closeFileMenu(); onclick(); };
  return b;
}

async function saveAs() {
  const cur = getCurrentProject();
  if (!cur) { alert("No project is open."); return; }
  const name = prompt("Save project as:", `${cur.name} (copy)`);
  if (!name) return;
  await saveProject();
  const copy: any = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cur));
  copy.id = uid();
  copy.name = name;
  copy.createdAt = copy.updatedAt = Date.now();
  await store.putProject(copy);
  const blobs = await store.getModelBlobs(cur.id);
  for (const b of blobs) await store.putModelBlob(copy.id, b.modelId, b.name, b.blob);
  await openProject(copy.id);
}

function exportProjectJson() {
  const cur = getCurrentProject();
  if (!cur) { alert("No project is open."); return; }
  void saveProject(true).then(() => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(getCurrentProject(), null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url; a.download = `${cur.name.replace(/[^\w-]+/g, "_")}.obs.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
  });
}

function printView() {
  const url = captureThumbnail(1800);
  const w = window.open("", "_blank");
  if (!w) { alert("Popup blocked — allow popups to print."); return; }
  w.document.write(`<html><head><title>Open BIM Studio — Print</title></head><body style="margin:0"><img src="${url}" style="width:100%" onload="window.print()"></body></html>`);
  w.document.close();
}

async function exportGlb() {
  if (!ctx.fragments.list.size && !(ctx.features as any).fileInterop?.getAuxObjects?.().length) {
    alert("Nothing to export — the scene is empty."); return;
  }
  try {
    const { GLTFExporter } = await import("three/examples/jsm/exporters/GLTFExporter.js");
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    for (const [, m] of ctx.fragments.list) g.add(m.object.clone(true));
    for (const o of (ctx.features as any).fileInterop.getAuxObjects()) g.add(o.clone(true));
    const cur = getCurrentProject();
    new (GLTFExporter as any).parse(g, (res: ArrayBuffer) => {
      const blob = new Blob([res], { type: "model/gltf-binary" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url; a.download = `${(cur?.name ?? "scene").replace(/[^\w-]+/g, "_")}.glb`;
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
    }, (err: any) => { console.error(err); alert("GLB export failed — see console."); }, { binary: true });
  } catch (err: any) { alert(`GLB export failed: ${err?.message ?? err}`); }
}

async function importProjectFile() {
  const input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "file"; input.accept = ".obs.json,.json";
  input.onchange = async () => {
    const f = input.files?.[0]; if (!f) return;
    try {
      const doc = JSON.parse(await f.text());
      if (!doc?.id || !Array.isArray(doc.elements)) throw new Error("Not a valid Open BIM Studio project file.");
      await store.putProject(doc);
      await openProject(doc.id);
    } catch (e: any) { alert(`Open project file failed: ${e?.message ?? e}`); }
  };
  input.click();
}

function closeProject() {
  const go = () => showHome();
  if (isDirty()) {
    if (confirm("Project has unsaved changes. Save before closing?")) void saveProject(true).then(go);
    else go();
  } else go();
}

function openOptions() {
  // Reuse the importer settings box inside a light modal
  const ov = document.createElement("div");
  ov.style.cssText = "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:300;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center";
  const card = document.createElement("div");
  card.style.cssText = "background:#1b1c26;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:10px;padding:16px;width:420px;max-height:80vh;overflow:auto;color:#e2e8f0;font:12px system-ui,sans-serif";
  const t = document.createElement("div");
  t.textContent = "Options";
  t.style.cssText = "font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px";
  const close = document.createElement("button");
  close.textContent = "Close";
  close.style.cssText = "margin-top:10px;padding:7px 14px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600";
  close.onclick = () => ov.remove();
  ov.onmousedown = (e) => { if (e.target === ov) ov.remove(); };
  card.append(t, settingsBox, close);
  ov.appendChild(card);
  document.body.appendChild(ov);
}

function build() {
  built = true;
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:0;min-height:380px";

  const left = document.createElement("div");
  left.style.cssText = "width:300px;flex:none;border-right:1px solid #24252f;padding:6px";
  left.append(
    Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { style: SECTION, textContent: "Application" }),
    item("🆕", "New", () => showHome(), "Ctrl+N"),
    item("📂", "Open Project…", () => showHome()),
    item("🧬", "Open File… (any format)", () => pickAndImport(), "IFC · GLB · OBJ · FBX …"),
    item("📑", "Open Project File…", () => importProjectFile(), ".obs.json"),
    Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { style: SECTION, textContent: "Save" }),
    item("💾", "Save", () => void saveProject(), "Ctrl+S"),
    item("📝", "Save As…", () => void saveAs()),
    Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { style: SECTION, textContent: "Export" }),
    item("🗣", "Issues → BCF", () => exportBCF()),
    item("💰", "Cost → CSV", () => exportCostCsv()),
    item("🧊", "Scene → GLB", () => void exportGlb()),
    item("🖼", "Project → JSON", () => exportProjectJson(), "backup"),
    Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { style: SECTION, textContent: "Document" }),
    item("🖨", "Print…", () => printView()),
    item("⚙️", "Options", () => openOptions()),
    item("🚪", "Close", () => closeProject()),
    item("⏻", "Exit", () => closeProject()),
  );

  const right = document.createElement("div");
  right.style.cssText = "flex:1;padding:10px 12px;overflow:auto";
  const rl = Object.assign(document.createElement("div"), { style: SECTION, textContent: "Recent Documents" });
  const list = document.createElement("div");
  list.id = "obs-filemenu-recent";
  list.style.cssText = "display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:4px";
  right.append(rl, list);

  row.append(left, right);
  menu.appendChild(row);
}

async function renderRecents() {
  const list = menu.querySelector("#obs-filemenu-recent") as HTMLElement;
  if (!list) return;
  list.innerHTML = `<div style="opacity:.5;padding:8px">Loading…</div>`;
  const docs = (await store.listProjectDocs()).sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt).slice(0, 12);
  list.innerHTML = "";
  if (!docs.length) {
    list.innerHTML = `<div style="opacity:.5;padding:10px;border:1px dashed #34353f;border-radius:8px;text-align:center">Files you open will show up here.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  for (const doc of docs) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;background:#171821;border:1px solid #24252f;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer";
    const info = document.createElement("div");
    info.style.cssText = "flex:1;min-width:0";
    info.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap">📄 ${esc(doc.name)}</div>
      <div style="opacity:.5;font-size:10px">${doc.elements?.length ?? 0} objects · ${doc.models?.length ?? 0} model(s) · ${new Date(doc.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}</div>`;
    const open = document.createElement("button");
    open.textContent = "Open";
    open.style.cssText = "padding:4px 10px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px;font-weight:600";
    open.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); closeFileMenu(); void openProject(doc.id); };
    const del = document.createElement("button");
    del.textContent = "🗑";
    del.style.cssText = "padding:4px 8px;background:#2a2a3a;border:1px solid #3a3a4a;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px";
    del.onclick = async (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (!confirm(`Remove "${doc.name}" from Recent Documents?`)) return;
      await deleteProjectById(doc.id);
      void renderRecents();
    };
    row.onclick = () => { closeFileMenu(); void openProject(doc.id); };
    row.append(info, open, del);
    list.appendChild(row);
  }
}

export function toggleFileMenu() {
  menu.style.display === "block" ? closeFileMenu() : openFileMenu();
}
export function isFileMenuVisible() { return menu.style.display === "block"; }
export function openFileMenu() {
  if (!built) build();
  void renderRecents();
  menu.style.display = "block";
}
export function closeFileMenu() { menu.style.display = "none"; }

export function setupFileMenu() {
  document.body.appendChild(menu);
  window.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
    if (menu.style.display === "block" && !menu.contains(e.target as Node)) closeFileMenu();
  });
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") closeFileMenu();
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "o") { e.preventDefault(); pickAndImport(); }
  });
  ctx.features.fileMenu = { toggle: toggleFileMenu, open: openFileMenu, close: closeFileMenu };
}

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

function w(): Any {
  return window as Any;
}

function c(): Any {
  return (ctx as Any) || w().__OBS_CTX__ || {};
}

function asSet(v: any): Set<number> {
  const out = new Set<number>();

  if (!v) return out;

  if (v instanceof Set) {
    for (const x of v) {
      const n = Number(x);
      if (Number.isFinite(n)) out.add(n);
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    for (const x of v) {
      const n = Number(x);
      if (Number.isFinite(n)) out.add(n);
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) {
    out.add(v);
  }

  return out;
}

function mergeMap(
  target: Record<string, Set<number>>,
  source: any,
): void {
  if (!source || typeof source !== "object") return;

  if (source instanceof Map) {
    for (const [modelId, value] of source.entries()) {
      const ids = asSet(value);
      if (!ids.size) continue;

      const key = String(modelId);

      if (!target[key]) {
        target[key] = new Set<number>();
      }

      for (const id of ids) {
        target[key].add(id);
      }
    }

    return;
  }

  for (const [modelId, value] of Object.entries(source)) {
    const ids = asSet(value);
    if (!ids.size) continue;

    const key = String(modelId);

    if (!target[key]) {
      target[key] = new Set<number>();
    }

    for (const id of ids) {
      target[key].add(id);
    }
  }
}

function getFragmentSelection(): Record<string, Set<number>> {
  const out: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};
  const cont = c();

  const sources: any[] = [
    cont.features?.selection,
    cont.selection,
    cont.highlighter,
    cont.highlighter?.selection,
    cont.features?.selectionManager,
    cont.selectionManager,
    w().__obsSelection,
    w().__obsSelectionManager,
  ];

  for (const s of sources) {
    if (!s) continue;

    let snap: any = null;

    if (typeof s.snapshot === "function") {
      try {
        snap = s.snapshot();
      } catch {
        snap = null;
      }
    }

    if (!snap && s.selection && typeof s.selection === "object") {
      snap = s.selection;
    }

    if (!snap && typeof s === "object" && !(s instanceof Map)) {
      const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(s);

      if (proto === Object.prototype || proto === null) {
        snap = s;
      }
    }

    if (snap) {
      mergeMap(out, snap);
    }
  }

  return out;
}

function getAuthoredSelection(): string[] {
  const cont = c();
  const auth = cont.features?.authoring || w().__obsAuthoring;

  const raw =
    auth?.getSelectedIds?.() ??
    auth?.selectedIds ??
    auth?.selection ??
    [];

  return Array.from(raw as any)
    .map((x: any) => String(x))
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function boxFromAnyBox(b: any): THREE.Box3 | null {
  if (!b) return null;

  if (b.isBox3) {
    return new THREE.Box3().copy(b);
  }

  if (b.min && b.max) {
    try {
      return new THREE.Box3(
        new THREE.Vector3(b.min.x, b.min.y, b.min.z),
        new THREE.Vector3(b.max.x, b.max.y, b.max.z),
      );
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function includeObject(obj: any, box: THREE.Box3): void {
  if (!obj) return;

  if (obj.isMesh) {
    const geo = obj.geometry;

    if (!geo) return;

    if (!geo.boundingBox) {
      try {
        geo.computeBoundingBox();
      } catch {
        return;
      }
    }

    const bb = geo.boundingBox;

    if (bb && !bb.isEmpty()) {
      box.union(bb.clone().applyMatrix4(obj.matrixWorld));
    }

    return;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(obj.children)) {
    for (const child of obj.children) {
      includeObject(child, box);
    }
  }
}

function getAuthoredBox(ids: string[]): THREE.Box3 | null {
  const cont = c();
  const auth = cont.features?.authoring || w().__obsAuthoring;

  if (!auth || !ids.length) return null;

  const elements = auth.getElements?.() ?? auth.elements ?? [];
  const box = new THREE.Box3();

  for (const id of ids) {
    const el = (elements as any[]).find(
      (x: any) => String(x?.id) === id,
    );

    if (!el) continue;

    const candidates = [
      auth.getElementWorldBox?.(el),
      auth.getWorldBox?.(el),
      auth.getBoundingBox?.(el),
      el.worldBox,
      el.box,
      el.boundingBox,
    ];

    let added = false;

    for (const cand of candidates) {
      const b = boxFromAnyBox(cand);

      if (b && !b.isEmpty()) {
        box.union(b);
        added = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!added) {
      includeObject(el.mesh ?? el.three ?? el.object ?? el, box);
    }
  }

  return box.isEmpty() ? null : box;
}

async function getFragmentBox(
  frag: Record<string, Set<number>>,
): Promise<THREE.Box3 | null> {
  const entries = Object.entries(frag).filter(
    ([, ids]) => ids instanceof Set && ids.size,
  );

  if (!entries.length) return null;

  const box = new THREE.Box3();
  const cont = c();

  try {
    const wbMod: any = await import("../modules/geometry/world-box");

    for (const [modelId, ids] of entries) {
      const model: any =
        cont.fragments?.list?.get?.(modelId) ??
        cont.fragments?.list?.get?.(String(modelId));

      if (!model) continue;

      const idList = [...ids]
        .map(Number)
        .filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n));

      if (!idList.length) continue;

      const wbs = await wbMod.getElementWorldBoxes?.(
        model,
        idList,
        modelId,
      );

      for (const item of wbs ?? []) {
        const b = boxFromAnyBox(item?.box ?? item);

        if (b && !b.isEmpty()) {
          box.union(b);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[focus-service] world-box failed", err);
  }

  if (!box.isEmpty()) return box;

  const scene: any = cont.world?.scene?.three ?? cont.world?.scene;

  if (scene && typeof scene.traverse === "function") {
    try {
      scene.updateMatrixWorld?.(true);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }

    const lookup = new Map<string, Set<string>>();

    for (const [modelId, ids] of entries) {
      const set = new Set<string>();

      for (const id of ids) {
        set.add(String(id));
      }

      if (set.size) {
        lookup.set(String(modelId), set);
      }
    }

    scene.traverse((obj: Any) => {
      const ud = obj?.userData || {};

      const mid = String(
        ud.modelID ??
          ud.modelId ??
          ud.model ??
          ud.fragmentModelID ??
          ud.ownerModelID ??
          "",
      );

      const lid = String(
        ud.expressID ??
          ud.localID ??
          ud.localId ??
          ud.id ??
          ud.elementID ??
          ud.instanceID ??
          "",
      );

      if (!mid || !lid) return;

      const set = lookup.get(mid);

      if (set?.has(lid)) {
        includeObject(obj, box);
      }
    });
  }

  return box.isEmpty() ? null : box;
}

function getCurrentTarget(cam: Any, controls: Any): THREE.Vector3 {
  const t = new THREE.Vector3();

  try {
    if (typeof controls?.getTarget === "function") {
      controls.getTarget(t);

      if (
        Number.isFinite(t.x) &&
        Number.isFinite(t.y) &&
        Number.isFinite(t.z)
      ) {
        return t;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  try {
    const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
    cam.getWorldDirection(dir);
    t.copy(cam.position).addScaledVector(dir, 10);
  } catch {
    t.set(0, 0, 0);
  }

  return t;
}

function focusBoxManual(box: THREE.Box3): boolean {
  const cont = c();
  const cam: Any = cont.world?.camera?.three;
  const controls: Any = cont.world?.camera?.controls;

  if (!cam || box.isEmpty()) return false;

  const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  const size = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
  const maxDim = Math.max(size.x, size.y, size.z, 0.001);

  const target = center.clone();
  const currentTarget = getCurrentTarget(cam, controls);

  const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(cam.position, currentTarget);

  if (!Number.isFinite(dir.lengthSq()) || dir.lengthSq() < 1e-8) {
    dir.set(0, 0.35, 1);
  }

  dir.normalize();

  let distance: number;

  if (cam.isOrthographicCamera) {
    distance = Math.max(maxDim * 2.5, 1);

    const height = Math.abs(Number(cam.top ?? 1) - Number(cam.bottom ?? -1));
    const width = Math.abs(Number(cam.right ?? 1) - Number(cam.left ?? -1));

    const zoomY = height / Math.max(maxDim * 1.35, 0.0001);
    const zoomX = width / Math.max(maxDim * 1.35, 0.0001);
    const zoom = Math.min(zoomX, zoomY);

    cam.zoom = Math.max(0.0001, Math.min(100000, Number(zoom) || 1));
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  } else {
    const fov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(Number(cam.fov) || 50);
    distance = ((maxDim / 2) / Math.tan(fov / 2)) * 1.75;
    distance = Math.max(distance, maxDim * 0.85);
  }

  const pos = target.clone().addScaledVector(dir, distance);

  try {
    if (typeof controls?.setLookAt === "function") {
      controls.setLookAt(
        pos.x,
        pos.y,
        pos.z,
        target.x,
        target.y,
        target.z,
        true,
      );

      controls.update?.(0);
    } else {
      cam.position.copy(pos);
      cam.lookAt(target);
    }
  } catch {
    cam.position.copy(pos);

    try {
      cam.lookAt(target);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:camera-changed"));
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  return true;
}

async function applyBox(box: THREE.Box3): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!box || box.isEmpty()) return false;

  try {
    const cam: any = await import("./camera-tools");

    if (typeof cam.focusOnBox === "function") {
      await cam.focusOnBox(box);
      return true;
    }
  } catch {
    /* fallback below */
  }

  return focusBoxManual(box);
}

async function tryFitToMap(frag: any): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const cam: any = await import("./camera-tools");

    if (typeof cam.fitToMap === "function") {
      await cam.fitToMap(frag);
      return true;
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  return false;
}

async function pickAndFocus(event: any): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!event) return false;

  const cont = c();
  const auth = cont.features?.authoring || w().__obsAuthoring;

  try {
    const authoredId = auth?.pickAuthoredElementAt?.(event);

    if (authoredId) {
      const ids = [String(authoredId)];
      auth?.setSelectedAuthored?.(ids, "replace");

      const box = getAuthoredBox(ids);

      if (box) {
        return await applyBox(box);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  try {
    const selMod: any = await import("./selection");
    const hit = await selMod.pickFragmentAtPointer?.();

    if (hit) {
      const lid = Number(hit.localId);

      selMod.selection?.applyClick?.(hit.modelId, hit.localId, {});
      await selMod.selection?.applyToHighlighter?.();

      if (Number.isFinite(lid)) {
        const frag: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};
        frag[String(hit.modelId)] = new Set<number>([lid]);

        const box = await getFragmentBox(frag);

        if (box) {
          return await applyBox(box);
        }

        return await tryFitToMap(frag);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }

  return false;
}

export async function focusSelected(event?: any): Promise<boolean> {
  const authIds = getAuthoredSelection();
  const frag = getFragmentSelection();

  const box = new THREE.Box3();
  let has = false;

  if (authIds.length) {
    const ab = getAuthoredBox(authIds);

    if (ab) {
      box.union(ab);
      has = true;
    }
  }

  if (Object.keys(frag).length) {
    const fb = await getFragmentBox(frag);

    if (fb) {
      box.union(fb);
      has = true;
    }
  }

  if (has && !box.isEmpty()) {
    return await applyBox(box);
  }

  if (Object.keys(frag).length) {
    const ok = await tryFitToMap(frag);

    if (ok) return true;
  }

  if (authIds.length) {
    try {
      const auth: any = c().features?.authoring;

      if (typeof auth?.focusSelected === "function") {
        await auth.focusSelected();
        return true;
      }
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

  return await pickAndFocus(event ?? (w() as Any).__obsLastCtxEvent ?? null);
}

(w() as Any).__obsFocusSelected = focusSelected;

(w() as Any).__obsFocusService = {
  focusSelected,
  getAuthoredSelection,
  getFragmentSelection,
};

console.log("[focus-service] ready");
