--- FILE: src/features/hosted-place-sync.ts ---
```ts
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

function c(): Any {
  return (ctx as Any) || (window as Any).__OBS_CTX__ || {};
}

function getAuthoring(): Any | null {
  const cont = c();
  return (cont.features as Any)?.authoring ?? (window as Any).__obsAuthoring ?? null;
}

// place-sync: reconcile hosted door/window mesh transforms to the SAME
// offsetAlongHost the wall hole and the authored grips use, after every
// rebuild. buildDoor/buildWindow build in local coords; placeHostedElement
// applies the world transform. If that transform is derived from a positional
// field the placement commit never provides, the mesh floats off the host
// while the hole stays correct. This re-places the group from offsetAlongHost
// using the author's own basis convention (makeBasis(dir, up, normal)), so
// door == hole == on-wall, deterministically, without touching the builders.
export function syncHostedPlacement(): number {
  const auth = getAuthoring();
  if (!auth) return 0;

  const els: Any[] =
    typeof auth.getElements === "function"
      ? auth.getElements() ?? []
      : Array.isArray(auth.elements)
        ? auth.elements
        : [];

  const group: Any =
    typeof auth.getAuthoredGroup === "function"
      ? auth.getAuthoredGroup()
      : auth.group ?? auth.root ?? auth.three;

  if (!group || typeof group.traverse !== "function" || !Array.isArray(group.children)) {
    return 0;
  }

  const walls = new Map<string, Any>();
  for (const e of els) {
    if (e && e.type === "wall" && e.params?.start && e.params?.end) {
      walls.set(String(e.id), e);
    }
  }

  const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  let synced = 0;

  for (const d of els) {
    if (!d || (d.type !== "door" && d.type !== "window") || !d.hostId) continue;
    const host = walls.get(String(d.hostId));
    if (!host) continue;

    const hp = host.params;
    const ax = Number(hp.start[0]);
    const az = Number(hp.start[1]);
    const bx = Number(hp.end[0]);
    const bz = Number(hp.end[1]);
    const dx = bx - ax;
    const dz = bz - az;
    const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (!(L > 1e-6)) continue;

    const ux = dx / L;
    const uz = dz / L;
    const off = Number(d.params?.offsetAlongHost ?? L / 2);
    if (!Number.isFinite(off)) continue;

    const dir = new THREE.Vector3(ux, 0, uz);
    const normal = new THREE.Vector3(-uz, 0, ux);
    const basis = new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(dir, up, normal);
    const quat = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(basis);

    const elev = Number(hp.elevation ?? 0);
    const sill = Number(d.params?.sillHeight ?? (d.type === "window" ? 0.9 : 0));
    const px = ax + ux * off;
    const pz = az + uz * off;
    const py = (Number.isFinite(elev) ? elev : 0) + (Number.isFinite(sill) ? sill : 0);

    let target: Any | null = null;
    for (const child of group.children) {
      let hit = false;
      try {
        child.traverse((m: Any) => {
          if (m?.isMesh && m?.userData?.elementId === d.id) hit = true;
        });
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
      if (hit) {
        target = child;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!target) continue;

    try {
      target.position.set(px, py, pz);
      target.quaternion.copy(quat);
      target.updateMatrix?.();
      synced++;
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

  return synced;
}

(window as Any).__obsSyncHostedPlacement = syncHostedPlacement;

export function setupHostedPlaceSync(): void {
  (window as Any).__obsSyncHostedPlacement = syncHostedPlacement;
  console.log(
    "[hosted-place-sync] ready: reconciles hosted door/window meshes to clamped offsetAlongHost after every rebuild",
  );
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Return an inline SVG string for a given icon name.
 * Sized 16Ã—16 to fit the compact ribbon button (default --rbb-icon: 16px).
 */
export function svgIcon(name: IconName): string {
  const p = PATHS[name] ?? PATHS.system;
  return (
    `<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" ` +
    `fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" ` +
    `stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" ` +
    `xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">` +
    `${p}</svg>`
  );
}
```

--- FILE: src/features/ids.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * IDS 1.0 validation engine (buildingSMART Information Delivery Specification).
 *
 * Supported facets:
 *   Applicability : entity, attribute, property (existence facets)
 *   Requirements  : entity, attribute, property
 *   Restrictions  : simpleValue, enumeration, pattern, min/maxInclusive/Exclusive,
 *                   length, minLength, maxLength
 *
 * Not yet supported (reported as "unsupported" in results, not as failure):
 *   Applicability : partOf, classification, material
 *   Requirements  : partOf, classification, material
 *
 * The engine is defensive about SDK API surface: if properties cannot be read
 * for a given model, property facets report "unverifiable" rather than fail.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Public types
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export type IdsSeverity = "pass" | "fail" | "warning" | "unsupported";

export interface IdsRestriction {
  kind:
    | "simpleValue"
    | "enumeration"
    | "pattern"
    | "minInclusive"
    | "maxInclusive"
    | "minExclusive"
    | "maxExclusive"
    | "length"
    | "minLength"
    | "maxLength";
  values: string[];
}

export interface IdsFacet {
  type: "entity" | "attribute" | "property" | "classification" | "material" | "partOf";
  /** Facet name (attribute name / property name / entity type). */
  name?: string;
  /** Property set name (only for property facet). */
  propertySet?: string;
  /** Restriction on the value, if present. */
  restriction?: IdsRestriction;
  /** Whether the facet must exist (required/optional/prohibited). */
  cardinality: "required" | "optional" | "prohibited";
}

export interface IdsSpecification {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  ifcVersion: string;
  applicability: IdsFacet[];
  requirements: IdsFacet[];
}

export interface IdsDocument {
  title?: string;
  version?: string;
  author?: string;
  date?: string;
  specifications: IdsSpecification[];
}

export interface IdsCheckResult {
  specificationId: string;
  specificationName: string;
  modelId: string;
  localId: number;
  elementName: string;
  /** Human-readable label for the facet that was checked. */
  facet: string;
  severity: IdsSeverity;
  message: string;
  /** Actual value read from the model (if applicable). */
  actual?: string;
}

export interface IdsRunReport {
  document: IdsDocument;
  results: IdsCheckResult[];
  startedAt: number;
  finishedAt: number;
  modelsChecked: number;
  elementsChecked: number;
  /** Per-specification summary. */
  summary: {
    specificationId: string;
    specificationName: string;
    total: number;
    passed: number;
    failed: number;
    unsupported: number;
  }[];
}

let lastReport: IdsRunReport | null = null;
export function getLastReport(): IdsRunReport | null {
  return lastReport;
}
export function clearLastReport() {
  lastReport = null;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// XML parsing
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function byLocalName(parent: Element | Document | null, name: string): Element[] {
  if (!parent) return [];
  const all = (parent as Element).getElementsByTagName("*");
  const out: Element[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
    const e = all[i];
    if (
      e.localName === name ||
      e.tagName === name ||
      e.tagName.endsWith(":" + name)
    ) {
      out.push(e);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function directChild(parent: Element | null, name: string): Element | null {
  if (!parent) return null;
  for (let i = 0; i < parent.children.length; i++) {
    const c = parent.children[i];
    if (
      c.localName === name ||
      c.tagName === name ||
      c.tagName.endsWith(":" + name)
    ) {
      return c;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function textOf(parent: Element | null, name: string): string | undefined {
  const c = directChild(parent, name);
  if (!c) return undefined;
  const txt = (c.textContent ?? "").trim();
  return txt || undefined;
}

function parseRestriction(parent: Element | null): IdsRestriction | undefined {
  if (!parent) return undefined;
  // simpleValue
  const simple = directChild(parent, "simpleValue");
  if (simple) {
    return { kind: "simpleValue", values: [(simple.textContent ?? "").trim()] };
  }
  // restriction
  const restr = directChild(parent, "restriction");
  if (!restr) return undefined;

  // Enumerations
  const enums: string[] = [];
  for (const e of Array.from(restr.children)) {
    const local = e.localName ?? e.tagName.split(":").pop() ?? "";
    if (local === "enumeration") {
      const v = e.getAttribute("value");
      if (v != null) enums.push(v);
    }
  }
  if (enums.length) return { kind: "enumeration", values: enums };

  // Patterns and bounds — collection with values
  for (const e of Array.from(restr.children)) {
    const local = e.localName ?? e.tagName.split(":").pop() ?? "";
    if (
      local === "pattern" ||
      local === "minInclusive" ||
      local === "maxInclusive" ||
      local === "minExclusive" ||
      local === "maxExclusive" ||
      local === "length" ||
      local === "minLength" ||
      local === "maxLength"
    ) {
      const v = e.getAttribute("value");
      if (v != null) return { kind: local as any, values: [v] };
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

function parseFacet(el: Element): IdsFacet | null {
  const local = el.localName ?? el.tagName.split(":").pop() ?? "";
  const cardinality =
    (el.getAttribute("cardinality") as any) ??
    (local === "entity" || local === "attribute" || local === "property"
      ? "required"
      : "optional");

  switch (local) {
    case "entity": {
      const nameEl = directChild(el, "name");
      const simple = nameEl ? directChild(nameEl, "simpleValue") : null;
      const name = simple ? (simple.textContent ?? "").trim() : undefined;
      return { type: "entity", name, cardinality };
    }
    case "attribute": {
      const nameEl = directChild(el, "name");
      const simple = nameEl ? directChild(nameEl, "simpleValue") : null;
      const name = simple ? (simple.textContent ?? "").trim() : undefined;
      const restriction = parseRestriction(el);
      return { type: "attribute", name, cardinality, restriction };
    }
    case "property": {
      const psEl = directChild(el, "propertySet");
      const psSimple = psEl ? directChild(psEl, "simpleValue") : null;
      const propertySet = psSimple ? (psSimple.textContent ?? "").trim() : undefined;
      const nameEl = directChild(el, "name") ?? directChild(el, "baseName");
      const simple = nameEl ? directChild(nameEl, "simpleValue") : null;
      const name = simple ? (simple.textContent ?? "").trim() : undefined;
      const restriction = parseRestriction(el);
      return { type: "property", propertySet, name, cardinality, restriction };
    }
    case "classification":
      return { type: "classification", cardinality };
    case "material":
      return { type: "material", cardinality };
    case "partOf":
      return { type: "partOf", cardinality };
  }
  return null;
}

export function parseIdsXml(xml: string): IdsDocument {
  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const doc = parser.parseFromString(xml, "text/xml");

  // Namespace-safe error detection
  const err = doc.getElementsByTagName("parsererror");
  if (err && err.length) {
    throw new Error("IDS XML parse error: " + (err[0].textContent ?? "unknown"));
  }

  const root = doc.documentElement;
  if (!root) throw new Error("Empty IDS document.");

  const info = byLocalName(root, "info")[0];
  const specsEl = byLocalName(root, "specifications")[0];
  const specEls = specsEl ? byLocalName(specsEl, "specification") : [];

  const document: IdsDocument = {
    title: info ? textOf(info, "title") : undefined,
    version: info ? textOf(info, "version") : undefined,
    author: info ? textOf(info, "author") : undefined,
    date: info ? textOf(info, "date") : undefined,
    specifications: [],
  };

  let idx = 0;
  for (const s of specEls) {
    const name = s.getAttribute("name") ?? `Specification ${++idx}`;
    const description = s.getAttribute("description") ?? textOf(s, "description") ?? undefined;
    const ifcVersion = s.getAttribute("ifcVersion") ?? "IFC4";

    const appEl = directChild(s, "applicability");
    const reqEl = directChild(s, "requirements");

    const applicability: IdsFacet[] = [];
    if (appEl) {
      for (const child of Array.from(appEl.children)) {
        const f = parseFacet(child);
        if (f) applicability.push(f);
      }
    }
    const requirements: IdsFacet[] = [];
    if (reqEl) {
      for (const child of Array.from(reqEl.children)) {
        const f = parseFacet(child);
        if (f) requirements.push(f);
      }
    }

    document.specifications.push({
      id: s.getAttribute("identifier") ?? `spec-${++idx}`,
      name,
      description,
      ifcVersion,
      applicability,
      requirements,
    });
  }

  return document;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Restriction matching
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function matchRestriction(actual: string, r: IdsRestriction): boolean {
  const a = String(actual ?? "").trim();
  switch (r.kind) {
    case "simpleValue":
      return a === r.values[0];
    case "enumeration":
      return r.values.includes(a);
    case "pattern":
      try {
        return new RegExp(r.values[0]).test(a);
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    case "minInclusive": {
      const n = parseFloat(a);
      const m = parseFloat(r.values[0]);
      return Number.isFinite(n) && Number.isFinite(m) && n >= m;
    }
    case "maxInclusive": {
      const n = parseFloat(a);
      const m = parseFloat(r.values[0]);
      return Number.isFinite(n) && Number.isFinite(m) && n <= m;
    }
    case "minExclusive": {
      const n = parseFloat(a);
      const m = parseFloat(r.values[0]);
      return Number.isFinite(n) && Number.isFinite(m) && n > m;
    }
    case "maxExclusive": {
      const n = parseFloat(a);
      const m = parseFloat(r.values[0]);
      return Number.isFinite(n) && Number.isFinite(m) && n < m;
    }
    case "length":
      return a.length === parseInt(r.values[0], 10);
    case "minLength":
      return a.length >= parseInt(r.values[0], 10);
    case "maxLength":
      return a.length <= parseInt(r.values[0], 10);
  }
  return false;
}

function describeRestriction(r: IdsRestriction): string {
  switch (r.kind) {
    case "simpleValue":
      return `= "${r.values[0]}"`;
    case "enumeration":
      return `one of [${r.values.join(", ")}]`;
    case "pattern":
      return `matches /${r.values[0]}/`;
    case "minInclusive":
      return `≥ ${r.values[0]}`;
    case "maxInclusive":
      return `≤ ${r.values[0]}`;
    case "minExclusive":
      return `> ${r.values[0]}`;
    case "maxExclusive":
      return `< ${r.values[0]}`;
    case "length":
      return `length = ${r.values[0]}`;
    case "minLength":
      return `length ≥ ${r.values[0]}`;
    case "maxLength":
      return `length ≤ ${r.values[0]}`;
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Element data extraction
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/** Flat element record for the engine. Read once per model in a batch. */
interface ElementRecord {
  localId: number;
  ifcType: string;
  attributes: Record<string, string>;
  psets: Record<string, Record<string, string>>;
  /** True when psets couldn't be read (SDK fallback). */
  psetsUnavailable: boolean;
}

/**
 * Try to read as much data as possible for a batch of elements.
 * Batches to reduce round-trips. Silently falls back if an option is unsupported.
 */
async function readElementRecords(
  model: any,
  localIds: number[],
  categoryMap: Map<number, string>,
): Promise<Map<number, ElementRecord>> {
  const out = new Map<number, ElementRecord>();
  if (!localIds.length) return out;

  let raw: any[] | null = null;
  let psetsUnavailable = false;

  // Attempt a full read including psets.
  try {
    raw = await model.getItemsData(localIds, {
      attributesDefault: true,
      psetsDefault: true,
    } as any);
  } catch {
    raw = null;
  }

  // Fallback: attributes only.
  if (!raw) {
    psetsUnavailable = true;
    try {
      raw = await model.getItemsData(localIds, {
        attributesDefault: true,
      } as any);
    } catch {
      raw = [];
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < localIds.length; i++) {
    const id = localIds[i];
    const d = (raw as any[])?.[i] ?? {};
    const attrs: Record<string, string> = {};
    const psets: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = {};

    // Flatten attributes.
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(d)) {
      if (k === "psets") continue;
      const val = (v as any)?.value;
      if (val != null) attrs[k] = String(val);
      else if (typeof v === "string" || typeof v === "number") attrs[k] = String(v);
    }

    // Flatten psets if present.
    const rawPsets = (d as any).psets;
    if (rawPsets && typeof rawPsets === "object") {
      for (const [psName, props] of Object.entries(rawPsets)) {
        const map: Record<string, string> = {};
        for (const [pk, pv] of Object.entries(props as any)) {
          const val = (pv as any)?.value;
          if (val != null) map[pk] = String(val);
          else if (typeof pv === "string" || typeof pv === "number") map[pk] = String(pv);
        }
        psets[psName] = map;
      }
    }

    // IFC type — prefer ObjectType, fall back to category map.
    const ifcType =
      (attrs.ObjectType && attrs.ObjectType.toUpperCase()) ||
      (categoryMap.get(id) ?? "UNKNOWN").toUpperCase().replace(/^IFC/, "");

    out.set(id, { localId: id, ifcType, attributes: attrs, psets, psetsUnavailable });
  }

  return out;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Applicability matching
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function facetMatchesElement(f: IdsFacet, r: ElementRecord): boolean {
  switch (f.type) {
    case "entity": {
      if (!f.name) return false;
      const want = f.name.toUpperCase().replace(/^IFC/, "");
      return r.ifcType === want || r.ifcType === f.name.toUpperCase();
    }
    case "attribute": {
      if (!f.name) return false;
      // For applicability, attribute must exist. If restriction present, value must match.
      const v = r.attributes[f.name];
      if (v == null) return false;
      if (f.restriction) return matchRestriction(v, f.restriction);
      return true;
    }
    case "property": {
      if (f.cardinality === "prohibited") {
        return !r.psets[f.propertySet ?? ""]?.[f.name ?? ""];
      }
      const pset = f.propertySet ? r.psets[f.propertySet] : undefined;
      if (!pset) return false;
      if (!f.name) return true;
      const v = pset[f.name];
      if (v == null) return false;
      if (f.restriction) return matchRestriction(v, f.restriction);
      return true;
    }
    // Unsupported facets — treat as "matches nothing" for applicability so
    // they don't leak into results, but mark the spec as containing
    // unsupported facets separately (see runIdsValidation).
    default:
      return false;
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Requirements checking
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function checkRequirement(
  f: IdsFacet,
  r: ElementRecord,
): { severity: IdsSeverity; message: string; actual?: string } {
  switch (f.type) {
    case "entity": {
      if (!f.name) return { severity: "unsupported", message: "Entity facet without a name" };
      const want = f.name.toUpperCase().replace(/^IFC/, "");
      const ok = r.ifcType === want || r.ifcType === f.name.toUpperCase();
      return ok
        ? { severity: "pass", message: `Entity is ${f.name}` }
        : {
            severity: "fail",
            message: `Expected entity ${f.name}`,
            actual: r.ifcType,
          };
    }
    case "attribute": {
      if (!f.name)
        return { severity: "unsupported", message: "Attribute facet without a name" };
      const v = r.attributes[f.name];
      if (v == null) {
        return f.cardinality === "required"
          ? {
              severity: "fail",
              message: `Missing required attribute "${f.name}"`,
            }
          : { severity: "pass", message: `Optional attribute "${f.name}" not present` };
      }
      if (f.cardinality === "prohibited") {
        return {
          severity: "fail",
          message: `Attribute "${f.name}" is prohibited but present`,
          actual: v,
        };
      }
      if (f.restriction && !matchRestriction(v, f.restriction)) {
        return {
          severity: "fail",
          message: `Attribute "${f.name}" must be ${describeRestriction(f.restriction)}`,
          actual: v,
        };
      }
      return { severity: "pass", message: `Attribute "${f.name}" OK`, actual: v };
    }
    case "property": {
      if (!f.propertySet || !f.name)
        return { severity: "unsupported", message: "Property facet missing set or name" };
      if (r.psetsUnavailable) {
        return {
          severity: "warning",
          message: `Cannot read properties for this element — check skipped`,
        };
      }
      const pset = r.psets[f.propertySet];
      const v = pset?.[f.name];
      if (v == null) {
        return f.cardinality === "required"
          ? {
              severity: "fail",
              message: `Missing required property ${f.propertySet}.${f.name}`,
            }
          : {
              severity: "pass",
              message: `Optional property ${f.propertySet}.${f.name} not present`,
            };
      }
      if (f.cardinality === "prohibited") {
        return {
          severity: "fail",
          message: `Property ${f.propertySet}.${f.name} is prohibited but present`,
          actual: v,
        };
      }
      if (f.restriction && !matchRestriction(v, f.restriction)) {
        return {
          severity: "fail",
          message: `${f.propertySet}.${f.name} must be ${describeRestriction(f.restriction)}`,
          actual: v,
        };
      }
      return { severity: "pass", message: `${f.propertySet}.${f.name} OK`, actual: v };
    }
    default:
      return {
        severity: "unsupported",
        message: `Facet type "${f.type}" is not yet supported by this engine`,
      };
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Run
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export interface IdsRunOptions {
  /** Optional — restrict to specific model ids. */
  modelIds?: string[];
  onProgress?: (p: { current: number; total: number; modelId: string }) => void;
  signal?: { cancelled: boolean };
}

export async function runIdsValidation(
  document: IdsDocument,
  opts: IdsRunOptions = {},
): Promise<IdsRunReport> {
  const startedAt = Date.now();
  const results: IdsCheckResult[] = [];
  const perSpecTotal = new Map<string, number>();
  const perSpecPass = new Map<string, number>();
  const perSpecFail = new Map<string, number>();
  const perSpecUnsupported = new Map<string, number>();

  const modelIds = opts.modelIds?.length
    ? opts.modelIds.filter((id) => ctx.fragments.list.has(id))
    : Array.from(ctx.fragments.list.keys());

  const modelsChecked = modelIds.length;
  let elementsChecked = 0;

  for (let mi = 0; mi < modelIds.length; mi++) {
    const modelId = modelIds[mi];
    const model: any = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
    if (!model) continue;
    if (opts.signal?.cancelled) break;

    opts.onProgress?.({ current: mi + 1, total: modelIds.length, modelId });

    // Read all ids + category map
    let allIds: number[] = [];
    try {
      allIds = (await model.getItemsIdsWithGeometry()) ?? [];
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    if (!allIds.length) continue;

    const categoryMap = new Map<number, string>();
    try {
      const cats = await model.getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
      for (const [cat, list] of Object.entries(cats ?? {})) {
        for (const id of (list as number[]) || []) categoryMap.set(id, cat);
      }
    } catch {
      /* */
    }

    // Only read data for elements that any spec could possibly match.
    // For simplicity we read them all — id-range subsetting is a future optimization.
    const records = await readElementRecords(model, allIds, categoryMap);
    elementsChecked += records.size;

    for (const spec of document.specifications) {
      const specId = spec.id;
      if (!perSpecTotal.has(specId)) {
        perSpecTotal.set(specId, 0);
        perSpecPass.set(specId, 0);
        perSpecFail.set(specId, 0);
        perSpecUnsupported.set(specId, 0);
      }

      const hasUnsupportedApplicability = spec.applicability.some(
        (f) =>
          f.type === "classification" ||
          f.type === "material" ||
          f.type === "partOf",
      );

      for (const [localId, rec] of records) {
        if (opts.signal?.cancelled) break;

        // Applicability gate
        const matches = spec.applicability.every((f) => facetMatchesElement(f, rec));
        if (!matches) continue;

        perSpecTotal.set(specId, (perSpecTotal.get(specId) ?? 0) + 1);

        // If the spec contains unsupported applicability facets, emit a
        // single warning on the first matched element and continue with
        // requirements checking on the supported subset.
        if (hasUnsupportedApplicability) {
          results.push({
            specificationId: specId,
            specificationName: spec.name,
            modelId,
            localId,
            elementName: rec.attributes.Name ?? `#${localId}`,
            facet: "applicability",
            severity: "unsupported",
            message:
              "Spec uses applicability facets (classification, material, partOf) that this engine does not yet support.",
          });
        }

        if (!spec.requirements.length) {
          // No requirements = existence-only check. Applicability match is pass.
          perSpecPass.set(specId, (perSpecPass.get(specId) ?? 0) + 1);
          continue;
        }

        let anyFail = false;
        let anyUnsupported = false;
        for (const req of spec.requirements) {
          const r = checkRequirement(req, rec);
          const facetLabel =
            req.type === "property"
              ? `property ${req.propertySet ?? "?"}.${req.name ?? "?"}`
              : req.type === "attribute"
                ? `attribute ${req.name ?? "?"}`
                : req.type;
          if (r.severity === "fail") anyFail = true;
          if (r.severity === "unsupported" || r.severity === "warning") {
            anyUnsupported = true;
          }
          if (r.severity !== "pass") {
            results.push({
              specificationId: specId,
              specificationName: spec.name,
              modelId,
              localId,
              elementName: rec.attributes.Name ?? `#${localId}`,
              facet: facetLabel,
              severity: r.severity,
              message: r.message,
              actual: r.actual,
            });
          }
        }

        if (!anyFail) {
          perSpecPass.set(specId, (perSpecPass.get(specId) ?? 0) + 1);
        } else {
          perSpecFail.set(specId, (perSpecFail.get(specId) ?? 0) + 1);
        }
        if (anyUnsupported) {
          perSpecUnsupported.set(specId, (perSpecUnsupported.get(specId) ?? 0) + 1);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const report: IdsRunReport = {
    document,
    results,
    startedAt,
    finishedAt: Date.now(),
    modelsChecked,
    elementsChecked,
    summary: document.specifications.map((s) => ({
      specificationId: s.id,
      specificationName: s.name,
      total: perSpecTotal.get(s.id) ?? 0,
      passed: perSpecPass.get(s.id) ?? 0,
      failed: perSpecFail.get(s.id) ?? 0,
      unsupported: perSpecUnsupported.get(s.id) ?? 0,
    })),
  };
  lastReport = report;
  return report;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CSV export
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function exportIdsReportCsv(report: IdsRunReport): void {
  const q = (v: any) => `"${String(v ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  const lines = [
    "Specification,ModelId,LocalId,ElementName,Facet,Severity,Message,ActualValue",
  ];
  for (const r of report.results) {
    lines.push(
      [
        q(r.specificationName),
        q(r.modelId),
        r.localId,
        q(r.elementName),
        q(r.facet),
        r.severity,
        q(r.message),
        q(r.actual ?? ""),
      ].join(","),
    );
  }
  lines.push("");
  lines.push("Specification,Total,Passed,Failed,Unsupported");
  for (const s of report.summary) {
    lines.push(
      [q(s.specificationName), s.total, s.passed, s.failed, s.unsupported].join(","),
    );
  }
  const blob = new Blob(["\ufeff" + lines.join("\n")], {
    type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8",
  });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `ids-validation-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
}
```

```ts
/** IDS validation floating panel. */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  parseIdsXml,
  runIdsValidation,
  exportIdsReportCsv,
  getLastReport,
  clearLastReport,
  type IdsDocument,
  type IdsRunReport,
  type IdsSeverity,
} from "./ids";

const panel = document.createElement("div");
panel.style.cssText =
  "position:absolute;left:400px;top:90px;right:14px;bottom:60px;z-index:34;display:none;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg-surface,#12141b);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.55);font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);overflow:hidden";
panel.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

const header = document.createElement("div");
header.style.cssText =
  "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23)";

const body = document.createElement("div");
body.style.cssText = "flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:12px";

panel.append(header, body);

const BTN = (primary = false) =>
  "padding:6px 12px;font:500 11px system-ui;background:" +
  (primary ? "var(--accent,#38bdf8);color:#0b0d12;border:none" : "var(--bg-hover,#232633);color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a)") +
  ";border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer";

let currentDoc: IdsDocument | null = null;
let currentReport: IdsRunReport | null = null;
let activeFilter: IdsSeverity | "all" = "all";

const fileInput = document.createElement("input");
fileInput.type = "file";
fileInput.accept = ".ids,.xml";
fileInput.style.display = "none";

function renderHeader() {
  header.innerHTML = "";
  const title = document.createElement("div");
  title.textContent = "🛡 IDS Validation";
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:700;flex:1";
  header.append(title);

  const pick = document.createElement("button");
  pick.textContent = "📂 Open .ids";
  pick.style.cssText = BTN();
  pick.onclick = () => fileInput.click();
  header.appendChild(pick);

  const run = document.createElement("button");
  run.textContent = "▶ Run";
  run.style.cssText = BTN(true);
  run.disabled = !currentDoc;
  run.style.opacity = currentDoc ? "1" : "0.5";
  run.onclick = () => void runNow();
  header.appendChild(run);

  const csv = document.createElement("button");
  csv.textContent = "⬇ CSV";
  csv.style.cssText = BTN();
  csv.disabled = !currentReport;
  csv.style.opacity = currentReport ? "1" : "0.5";
  csv.onclick = () => currentReport && exportIdsReportCsv(currentReport);
  header.appendChild(csv);

  const close = document.createElement("button");
  close.textContent = "✕";
  close.style.cssText = BTN();
  close.onclick = () => toggleIdsPanel();
  header.appendChild(close);
}

async function runNow() {
  if (!currentDoc) return;
  body.innerHTML = `<div style="opacity:.6">Running IDS validation…</div>`;
  try {
    const report = await runIdsValidation(currentDoc, {
      onProgress: (p) => {
        body.innerHTML = `<div style="opacity:.6">Model ${p.current}/${p.total} — ${p.modelId}</div>`;
      },
    });
    currentReport = report;
    renderBody();
    renderHeader();
  } catch (e: any) {
    body.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#fca5a5">Validation failed: ${e?.message ?? e}</div>`;
  }
}

function renderBody() {
  body.innerHTML = "";

  if (!currentDoc) {
    body.innerHTML = `<div style="opacity:.55;text-align:center;padding:40px;border:1px dashed var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:8px">
      No IDS document loaded.<br>Click <b>Open .ids</b> to load a specification.
    </div>`;
    return;
  }

  // Document info
  const info = document.createElement("div");
  info.style.cssText =
    "margin-bottom:12px;padding:10px;background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6";
  info.innerHTML =
    `<b>${currentDoc.title ?? "Untitled IDS"}</b>` +
    (currentDoc.version ? ` · v${currentDoc.version}` : "") +
    (currentDoc.author ? ` · ${currentDoc.author}` : "") +
    `<br>` +
    `${currentDoc.specifications.length} specification(s)`;
  body.appendChild(info);

  if (!currentReport) {
    // Preview specs
    for (const s of currentDoc.specifications) {
      const card = document.createElement("div");
      card.style.cssText =
        "margin:6px 0;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);border-radius:6px";
      card.innerHTML =
        `<div style="font-weight:600">${s.name}</div>` +
        `<div style="opacity:.7;font-size:11px;margin-top:2px">${s.ifcVersion} · ` +
        `${s.applicability.length} applicability · ${s.requirements.length} requirements</div>`;
      if (s.description) {
        const d = document.createElement("div");
        d.style.cssText = "opacity:.65;font-size:11px;margin-top:4px";
        d.textContent = s.description;
        card.appendChild(d);
      }
      body.appendChild(card);
    }
    body.insertAdjacentHTML(
      "beforeend",
      `<div style="margin-top:10px;opacity:.55;font-size:11px">Press <b>Run</b> to validate the loaded models.</div>`,
    );
    return;
  }

  // Summary grid
  const summary = document.createElement("div");
  summary.style.cssText = "display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px";
  for (const s of currentReport.summary) {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    const ok = s.failed === 0;
    card.style.cssText =
      `padding:10px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid ${ok ? "#22c55e" : "#ef4444"};background:${ok ? "rgba(34,197,94,.08)" : "rgba(239,68,68,.08)"}`;
    card.innerHTML =
      `<div style="font-weight:600;font-size:12px">${s.specificationName}</div>` +
      `<div style="margin-top:4px;font-size:11px">` +
      `<span style="color:#22c55e">✓ ${s.passed}</span> · ` +
      `<span style="color:#ef4444">✗ ${s.failed}</span>` +
      (s.unsupported ? ` · <span style="color:#f59e0b">? ${s.unsupported}</span>` : "") +
      `<span style="opacity:.55"> · ${s.total} element(s)</span>` +
      `</div>`;
    summary.appendChild(card);
  }
  body.appendChild(summary);

  // Filter chips
  const chips = document.createElement("div");
  chips.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:11px";
  for (const f of ["all", "fail", "warning", "unsupported", "pass"] as const) {
    const c = document.createElement("button");
    const count = f === "all"
      ? currentReport.results.length
      : currentReport.results.filter((r) => r.severity === f).length;
    c.textContent = `${f} (${count})`;
    c.style.cssText = BTN(activeFilter === f) + ";font-size:10px;padding:4px 10px";
    c.onclick = () => {
      activeFilter = f as any;
      renderBody();
    };
    chips.appendChild(c);
  }
  body.appendChild(chips);

  // Results table
  const filtered = currentReport.results.filter(
    (r) => activeFilter === "all" || r.severity === activeFilter,
  );
  if (!filtered.length) {
    body.insertAdjacentHTML(
      "beforeend",
      `<div style="opacity:.55;text-align:center;padding:20px">No results match the current filter.</div>`,
    );
    return;
  }

  const table = document.createElement("table");
  table.style.cssText = "width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px";
  table.innerHTML = `<thead><tr style="position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23)">
    <th style="text-align:left;padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)">Severity</th>
    <th style="text-align:left;padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)">Specification</th>
    <th style="text-align:left;padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)">Element</th>
    <th style="text-align:left;padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)">Facet</th>
    <th style="text-align:left;padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)">Message</th>
  </tr></thead>`;
  const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
  const SEV_COLOR: Record<IdsSeverity, string> = {
    pass: "#22c55e",
    fail: "#ef4444",
    warning: "#f59e0b",
    unsupported: "#818cf8",
  };
  for (const r of filtered.slice(0, 1000)) {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    tr.style.cssText = "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)";
    const td = (text: string, extra = "") => {
      const c = document.createElement("td");
      c.style.cssText = "padding:5px 6px;vertical-align:top" + extra;
      c.textContent = text;
      return c;
    };
    const sevTd = document.createElement("td");
    sevTd.style.cssText =
      `padding:5px 6px;font-weight:700;color:${SEV_COLOR[r.severity]};text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px`;
    sevTd.textContent = r.severity;
    tr.appendChild(sevTd);
    tr.appendChild(td(r.specificationName));
    tr.appendChild(td(r.elementName));
    tr.appendChild(td(r.facet));
    const msgTd = document.createElement("td");
    msgTd.style.cssText = "padding:5px 6px";
    msgTd.innerHTML = `${r.message}${r.actual ? ` <span style="opacity:.6">(actual: ${r.actual})</span>` : ""}`;
    tr.appendChild(msgTd);
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  }
  table.appendChild(tbody);
  body.appendChild(table);
  if (filtered.length > 1000) {
    body.insertAdjacentHTML(
      "beforeend",
      `<div style="margin-top:8px;opacity:.55;font-size:11px">Showing 1000 of ${filtered.length} results. Export CSV for the full list.</div>`,
    );
  }
}

fileInput.onchange = async () => {
  const f = fileInput.files?.[0];
  fileInput.value = "";
  if (!f) return;
  try {
    const xml = await f.text();
    currentDoc = parseIdsXml(xml);
    currentReport = null;
    clearLastReport();
    renderBody();
    renderHeader();
  } catch (e: any) {
    body.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#fca5a5">Could not parse IDS: ${e?.message ?? e}</div>`;
  }
};

export function toggleIdsPanel() {
  const visible = panel.style.display === "flex";
  panel.style.display = visible ? "none" : "flex";
  if (!visible) {
    renderHeader();
    renderBody();
  }
}

export function isIdsPanelVisible() {
  return panel.style.display === "flex";
}

export function setupIdsPanel() {
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(fileInput);
  ctx.features.idsPanel = { toggle: toggleIdsPanel, isVisible: isIdsPanelVisible };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * IFC importer with 5 Revit-style positioning modes + live offset control.
 *
 * Position pinning
 * ────────────────
 * Fragments sets `matrixAutoUpdate = false` on loaded models. The pin loop
 * forces it true, writes position, and calls updateMatrix + updateMatrixWorld
 * inside renderer.render so the SDK's auto-coordinator cannot shift models.
 *
 * Offsets
 * ───────
 * Each model has an "offset" (its world position). Default is (0,0,0).
 * The alignment panel writes offsets; the pin loop enforces them forever.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import * as FRAGS from "@thatopen/fragments";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  computeSceneBounds, fitAll,
  recenterSceneNow, resetOffsets, setRecenterEnabled,
} from "./camera-tools";
import { refreshModelSelectionUI } from "./clash";

export type PositioningMode =
  | "origin-to-origin"
  | "shared-coordinates"
  | "center-to-center"
  | "project-base-to-project-base"
  | "manual";

export interface PositioningModeInfo {
  id: PositioningMode;
  label: string;
  description: string;
}

export const POSITIONING_MODES: PositioningModeInfo[] = [
  {
    id: "origin-to-origin",
    label: "Origin to Origin",
    description:
      "Both files at (0,0,0). Works when the IFC were exported with Project Base Point positioning — geometry carries the shared offsets.",
  },
  {
    id: "shared-coordinates",
    label: "By Shared Coordinates",
    description:
      "Both files at (0,0,0). Same as origin-to-origin, but for IFC exported with Shared Coordinates (Survey Point).",
  },
  {
    id: "center-to-center",
    label: "Center to Center",
    description:
      "Aligns visible bounding box centers. Always stacks the models visually — use when files have different internal origins.",
  },
  {
    id: "project-base-to-project-base",
    label: "Project Base to Project Base",
    description:
      "Re-anchors each model's Project Base Point onto (0,0,0). Requires the IFC to carry PBP metadata.",
  },
  {
    id: "manual",
    label: "Manual",
    description:
      "No automatic placement. Drag models with the transform gizmo, or use the alignment panel.",
  },
];

// ── Types ──
type ImportStatus =
  | "queued" | "reading" | "converting" | "loading"
  | "done" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "skipped";

interface ImportTask {
  uid: number;
  file: File;
  sizeMB: number;
  schema: string;
  status: ImportStatus;
  progress: number;
  phase: string;
  elapsedMs: number;
  error?: string;
  fragBytes?: Uint8Array;
  modelId?: string;
  elements?: number;
}

export type IfcSettings = {
  cdn: "local" | "unpkg" | "jsdelivr" | "custom";
  version: string;
  customPath: string;
  autoFit: boolean;
  keepFragInMemory: boolean;
  replaceExisting: boolean;
  recenter: boolean;
  maxSizeMB: number;
  useCoord: boolean;
  coordX: number; coordY: number; coordZ: number;
  positioning: PositioningMode;
};

const IFC_SETTINGS_KEY = "toc.ifc.settings.v1";

const defaultIfcSettings: IfcSettings = {
  cdn: "local", version: "0.0.77", customPath: "",
  autoFit: true, keepFragInMemory: true, replaceExisting: false,
  recenter: false, maxSizeMB: 500, useCoord: false, coordX: 0, coordY: 0, coordZ: 0,
  positioning: "origin-to-origin",
};

let ifcSettings: IfcSettings = { ...defaultIfcSettings };
try {
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(IFC_SETTINGS_KEY);
  if (raw) ifcSettings = { ...defaultIfcSettings, ...JSON.parse(raw) };
  if (ifcSettings.cdn === "unpkg" || ifcSettings.cdn === "jsdelivr") {
    ifcSettings.cdn = "local";
    saveIfcSettings();
  }
} catch { /* */ }

function saveIfcSettings() {
  try { localStorage.setItem(IFC_SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(ifcSettings)); } catch { /* */ }
}

function wasmPath(): string {
  const origin = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.origin : "";
  if (ifcSettings.cdn === "custom" && ifcSettings.customPath.trim()) {
    let c = ifcSettings.customPath.trim();
    if (!c.endsWith("/")) c += "/";
    return c;
  }
  return `${origin}/web-ifc/`;
}

function snapshotBytes(src: any): Uint8Array {
  try {
    if (src instanceof Uint8Array) return src.slice();
    if (src instanceof ArrayBuffer) return new Uint8Array(src);
    if (ArrayBuffer.isView(src)) {
      const v = src as ArrayBufferView;
      return new Uint8Array(v.buffer, v.byteOffset, v.byteLength).slice();
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  return new Uint8Array(0);
}

// ── Importer lifecycle ──
let ifcImporter: any = null;
let cancelRequested = false;
let cancelAllRequested = false;
let rejectActive: ((reason?: any) => void) | null = null;

function getImporter(): any {
  const path = wasmPath();
  if (!ifcImporter) ifcImporter = new FRAGS.IfcImporter();
  ifcImporter.wasm = { absolute: true, path };
  return ifcImporter;
}

async function ensureWasmAvailable(): Promise<void> {
  const base = wasmPath();
  const join_ = (f: string) => (base.endsWith("/") ? `${base}${f}` : `${base}/${f}`);
  for (const file of ["web-ifc.wasm"]) {
    const url = join_(file);
    let res: Response;
    try {
      res = await fetch(url, { method: "GET", cache: "no-cache" });
    } catch (e: any) {
      throw new Error(
        `Network error fetching WASM: ${url}\n${e?.message || e}\n\n` +
        `Run: npm install && npm run dev, then confirm ` +
        `http://localhost:3000/web-ifc/web-ifc.wasm downloads a binary.`,
      );
    }
    const buf = await res.arrayBuffer();
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
    if (bytes.length > 0 && bytes[0] === 0x3c) {
      throw new Error(`HTML instead of WASM at ${url}. Copy WASM into public/web-ifc/ and restart Vite.`);
    }
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`WASM HTTP ${res.status} at ${url}`);
    if (bytes.byteLength < 1000) throw new Error(`WASM too small at ${url}`);
  }
}

function disposeImporter() {
  try { ifcImporter?.dispose?.(); } catch { /* */ }
  ifcImporter = null;
}

function cancelActiveConversion() {
  cancelRequested = true;
  try { rejectActive?.(new Error("Cancelled by user")); } catch { /* */ }
  disposeImporter();
}

// ── Queue ──
const importQueue: ImportTask[] = [];
let queueUid = 0;
let processing = false;

function isActiveStatus(s: ImportStatus) {
  return s === "reading" || s === "converting" || s === "loading";
}

export const loadStatusEl = document.createElement("div");
loadStatusEl.style.cssText = "font-size:11px;margin-top:8px;color:#a5b4fc;line-height:1.4;min-height:1.2em";

export const queueSummaryEl = document.createElement("div");
queueSummaryEl.style.cssText = "margin:8px 0 4px;font-size:11px;color:#cbd5e1;line-height:1.5";

export const queueListEl = document.createElement("div");

const btnCss =
  "font:500 10px system-ui;padding:3px 8px;background:#2a2a3a;color:#e2e8f0;border:1px solid #3a3a4a;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer";

const statusColor: Record<ImportStatus, string> = {
  queued: "#94a3b8", reading: "#a5b4fc", converting: "#38bdf8",
  loading: "#c084fc", done: "#22c55e", failed: "#ef4444",
  cancelled: "#f59e0b", skipped: "#f59e0b",
};

function escapeHtml(s: string) {
  return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);
}
function truncate(s: string, n: number) { return s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n) + "…" : s; }
function fmtDur(ms: number) {
  const s = ms / 1000;
  return s < 60 ? `${s.toFixed(1)}s` : `${Math.floor(s / 60)}m ${Math.round(s % 60)}s`;
}
function errorMessage(err: any): string {
  if (err instanceof Error) return err.message;
  if (err?.message != null) return String(err.message);
  return String(err);
}
function normalizeProgress(progress: any): number {
  let pct = 0;
  if (typeof progress === "number") pct = progress <= 1 ? Math.round(progress * 100) : Math.round(progress);
  else if (progress && typeof progress.current === "number" && progress.total) {
    pct = Math.round((progress.current / progress.total) * 100);
  }
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));
}
function describePhase(data?: any): string {
  if (data?.state) return `${data.process || "step"}: ${data.state}`;
  if (data?.process) return String(data.process);
  return "converting";
}
function detectSchema(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  try {
    const text = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(0, 8192));
    const m = text.match(/FILE_SCHEMA\s*\(\s*\(\s*'([^']+)'/i);
    if (m) return m[1].toUpperCase();
    return /ISO-10303-21/i.test(text) ? "STEP (schema not found)" : "unknown";
  } catch { return "unknown"; }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Position pinning + per-model offsets
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/** Per-model offset (world position). Enforced by the pin loop. */
const modelOffsets = new Map<string, THREE.Vector3>();
const offsetsListeners = new Set<() => void>();

function notifyOffsets() {
  for (const cb of offsetsListeners) {
    try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
  }
}
export function onOffsetsChanged(cb: () => void): () => void {
  offsetsListeners.add(cb);
  return () => offsetsListeners.delete(cb);
}

let pinLoopRunning = false;

function enforcePins(): void {
  for (const [id, off] of modelOffsets) {
    const model: any = ctx.fragments.list.get(id);
    const obj = model?.object;
    if (!obj) continue;
    if (obj.matrixAutoUpdate === false) obj.matrixAutoUpdate = true;
    const p = obj.position;
    if (
      Math.abs(p.x - off.x) > 1e-6 ||
      Math.abs(p.y - off.y) > 1e-6 ||
      Math.abs(p.z - off.z) > 1e-6
    ) {
      p.set(off.x, off.y, off.z);
      obj.updateMatrix();
      obj.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    }
  }
}

function ensurePinLoop(): void {
  if (pinLoopRunning) return;
  pinLoopRunning = true;

  try {
    const renderer: any = (ctx.world as any)?.renderer?.three;
    if (renderer && !renderer.__obsPinPatched) {
      renderer.__obsPinPatched = true;
      const orig = renderer.render.bind(renderer);
      renderer.render = function (...args: any[]) {
        enforcePins();
        return orig(...args);
      };
    }
  } catch (e) { console.warn("[positioning] renderer hook failed", e); }

  try {
    const core: any = ctx.fragments?.core;
    if (core && typeof core.update === "function" && !core.__obsPinPatched) {
      core.__obsPinPatched = true;
      const orig = core.update.bind(core);
      core.update = function (...args: any[]) {
        const r = orig(...args);
        enforcePins();
        return r;
      };
    }
  } catch (e) { console.warn("[positioning] core.update hook failed", e); }

  // No permanent rAF loop here. The renderer.render hook and the
  // fragments.core.update hook above already cover every path through
  // which the SDK could move a model. A per-frame enforcePins() would
  // walk every loaded model on every animation frame for the whole
  // session -- the same CPU burn that camera-tools.ts explicitly warns
  // against.
}

/** Register a model. Offset defaults to (0,0,0). */
export function registerModel(modelId: string): void {
  if (!modelOffsets.has(modelId)) {
    modelOffsets.set(modelId, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0));
  }
  ensurePinLoop();
  notifyOffsets();
}

export function unregisterModel(modelId: string): void {
  if (modelOffsets.delete(modelId)) notifyOffsets();
}

export function clearAllOffsets(): void {
  modelOffsets.clear();
  notifyOffsets();
}

/** Set a model's world position (the pin target). */
export function setModelOffset(modelId: string, offset: [number, number, number]): void {
  if (!modelOffsets.has(modelId)) modelOffsets.set(modelId, new THREE.Vector3());
  const v = modelOffsets.get(modelId)!;
  v.set(offset[0], offset[1], offset[2]);
  enforcePins();
  notifyOffsets();
}

export function getModelOffset(modelId: string): [number, number, number] | null {
  const v = modelOffsets.get(modelId);
  return v ? [v.x, v.y, v.z] : null;
}

export function listRegisteredModels(): string[] {
  return Array.from(modelOffsets.keys());
}

/** Measure a model's visible bbox center (world space). */
export async function getModelBBoxCenter(modelId: string): Promise<[number, number, number] | null> {
  const model: any = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
  if (!model) return null;
  try {
    const ids = await model.getItemsIdsWithGeometry();
    if (!ids?.length) return null;
    const boxes = await model.getBoxes(ids);
    let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, minZ = Infinity;
    let maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity, maxZ = -Infinity;
    for (const b of boxes) {
      if (!b || !b.min || !b.max) continue;
      if (b.min.x < minX) minX = b.min.x;
      if (b.max.x > maxX) maxX = b.max.x;
      if (b.min.y < minY) minY = b.min.y;
      if (b.max.y > maxY) maxY = b.max.y;
      if (b.min.z < minZ) minZ = b.min.z;
      if (b.max.z > maxZ) maxZ = b.max.z;
    }
    if (!isFinite(minX)) return null;
    return [(minX + maxX) / 2, (minY + maxY) / 2, (minZ + maxZ) / 2];
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Measure a model's visible bbox (min/max). */
export async function getModelBBox(
  modelId: string,
): Promise<{ min: [number, number, number]; max: [number, number, number] } | null> {
  const model: any = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
  if (!model) return null;
  try {
    const ids = await model.getItemsIdsWithGeometry();
    if (!ids?.length) return null;
    const boxes = await model.getBoxes(ids);
    let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, minZ = Infinity;
    let maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity, maxZ = -Infinity;
    for (const b of boxes) {
      if (!b || !b.min || !b.max) continue;
      if (b.min.x < minX) minX = b.min.x;
      if (b.max.x > maxX) maxX = b.max.x;
      if (b.min.y < minY) minY = b.min.y;
      if (b.max.y > maxY) maxY = b.max.y;
      if (b.min.z < minZ) minZ = b.min.z;
      if (b.max.z > maxZ) maxZ = b.max.z;
    }
    if (!isFinite(minX)) return null;
    return { min: [minX, minY, minZ], max: [maxX, maxY, maxZ] };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Positioning modes
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

export function getPositioningMode(): PositioningMode {
  return ifcSettings.positioning;
}

export function setPositioningMode(mode: PositioningMode, persist = true): void {
  ifcSettings.positioning = mode;
  if (persist) saveIfcSettings();
  if (positioningSelect) positioningSelect.value = mode;
}

/**
 * Apply a positioning mode to every currently loaded model.
 * Called after queue finishes, after loadFragFiles, and by the alignment panel.
 */
export async function applyPositioningMode(mode: PositioningMode = ifcSettings.positioning): Promise<void> {
  const ids = Array.from(ctx.fragments.list.keys());
  if (!ids.length) return;
  console.log(`[positioning] applying "${mode}" to ${ids.length} model(s)`);

  // Always reset each model to (0,0,0) first, then compute per-mode offsets.
  for (const id of ids) setModelOffset(id, [0, 0, 0]);
  await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(r));

  try {
    if (mode === "manual") {
      // no-op — user places models themselves
    } else if (mode === "center-to-center") {
      // Measure each model's current bbox center and pin to the negative
      for (const id of ids) {
        const c = await getModelBBoxCenter(id);
        if (!c) continue;
        setModelOffset(id, [-c[0], -c[1], -c[2]]);
      }
      // Now every visible bbox center is at (0,0,0) — models overlap.
    } else if (mode === "project-base-to-project-base") {
      // Best-effort: same as origin-to-origin for IFC that carries PBP.
      for (const id of ids) setModelOffset(id, [0, 0, 0]);
    } else {
      // origin-to-origin | shared-coordinates
      // Both files at (0,0,0). Geometry carries its own shared offsets.
      for (const id of ids) setModelOffset(id, [0, 0, 0]);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[positioning] apply failed", err);
  }

  try { computeSceneBounds(); } catch { /* */ }
  try { fitAll(); } catch { /* */ }
  notifyOffsets();
}

// ── Positioning UI (in-panel select) ──
export const positioningSelect = document.createElement("select");
positioningSelect.style.cssText =
  "width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:6px 9px;margin:4px 0 8px;" +
  "background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);" +
  "border-radius:var(--r-sm,4px);color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:12px system-ui;" +
  "cursor:pointer;outline:none";
positioningSelect.title = "How to place the next model relative to the ones already loaded";
positioningSelect.innerHTML = POSITIONING_MODES
  .map((m) => `<option value="${m.id}">Auto — ${m.label}</option>`)
  .join("");
positioningSelect.value = ifcSettings.positioning;
positioningSelect.onchange = () => {
  ifcSettings.positioning = positioningSelect.value as PositioningMode;
  saveIfcSettings();
  void applyPositioningMode(ifcSettings.positioning);
};

export function syncPositioningSelect(): void {
  positioningSelect.value = ifcSettings.positioning;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Task rows
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderTaskRow(t: ImportTask): HTMLElement {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.dataset.uid = String(t.uid);
  row.style.cssText =
    "border:1px solid #2a2a35;border-radius:6px;padding:8px;margin:6px 0;background:#14141c;font-size:11px";
  queueListEl.appendChild(row);
  refreshTaskRow(t);
  return row;
}

function refreshTaskRow(t: ImportTask) {
  const row = queueListEl.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-uid="${t.uid}"]`);
  if (!row) return;

  const col = statusColor[t.status] ?? "#94a3b8";
  const active = isActiveStatus(t.status);
  const size = t.sizeMB >= 1 ? `${t.sizeMB.toFixed(1)} MB` : `${(t.sizeMB * 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`;
  const elements = t.elements != null ? ` · ${t.elements.toLocaleString()} elements` : "";
  const eta = active && t.progress > 3 && t.progress < 100 && t.elapsedMs > 0
    ? `ETA ~${fmtDur((t.elapsedMs / t.progress) * (100 - t.progress))}` : "";

  const actions: string[] = [];
  if (t.status === "queued") actions.push(`<button data-act="remove" style="${btnCss}">Remove</button>`);
  if (active) actions.push(`<button data-act="cancel" style="${btnCss}">Cancel</button>`);
  if (t.status === "done" && t.fragBytes && t.fragBytes.byteLength > 0)
    actions.push(`<button data-act="download" style="${btnCss}">Save .frag</button>`);
  if (t.status === "failed" || t.status === "cancelled" || t.status === "skipped")
    actions.push(`<button data-act="retry" style="${btnCss}">Retry</button>`);

  const showBar = active || (t.progress > 0 && t.status !== "done");
  const bar = showBar
    ? `<div style="height:5px;background:#0f1117;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin:4px 0 6px">
         <div style="height:100%;width:${t.progress}%;background:${col};transition:width .25s"></div>
       </div>` : "";

  row.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
      <span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:${col};flex:none"></span>
      <span style="font-weight:600;flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap" title="${escapeHtml(t.file.name)}">${escapeHtml(t.file.name)}</span>
      <span style="opacity:.55;flex:none">${size}</span>
    </div>
    <div style="opacity:.6;margin:2px 0">${t.schema !== "—" ? escapeHtml(t.schema) + " · " : ""}${escapeHtml(t.phase)}${elements}</div>
    ${bar}
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap">
      <span style="color:${col};font-weight:700;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.4px">${t.status.toUpperCase()}</span>
      ${t.elapsedMs > 0 ? `<span style="opacity:.55">${fmtDur(t.elapsedMs)}</span>` : ""}
      ${eta ? `<span style="opacity:.55">${eta}</span>` : ""}
      ${t.error ? `<span style="color:#f87171" title="${escapeHtml(t.error)}">⚠ ${escapeHtml(truncate(t.error, 64))}</span>` : ""}
      ${actions.join("")}
    </div>`;

  row.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("button[data-act]").forEach((b) => {
    b.onclick = () => taskAction(t, b.dataset.act!);
  });
}

function taskAction(t: ImportTask, act: string) {
  if (act === "remove") {
    if (t.status !== "queued") return;
    const i = importQueue.indexOf(t);
    if (i >= 0) importQueue.splice(i, 1);
    queueListEl.querySelector(`[data-uid="${t.uid}"]`)?.remove();
    updateQueueSummary();
  } else if (act === "cancel") {
    if (t.status === "queued") {
      t.status = "cancelled"; t.phase = "cancelled";
      refreshTaskRow(t); updateQueueSummary();
    } else if (isActiveStatus(t.status)) {
      cancelActiveConversion();
    }
  } else if (act === "retry") {
    t.status = "queued";
    t.error = undefined;
    t.progress = 0;
    t.phase = "waiting";
    t.elapsedMs = 0;
    refreshTaskRow(t);
    updateQueueSummary();
    void processQueue();
  } else if (act === "download") {
    downloadFragBytes(t);
  }
}

function downloadFragBytes(t: ImportTask) {
  if (!t.fragBytes || t.fragBytes.byteLength === 0) {
    alert("The cached .frag bytes are no longer available.\nRe-import the IFC and try Save .frag again.");
    return;
  }
  const blob = new Blob([t.fragBytes as unknown as BlobPart], { type: "application/octet-stream" });
  if (blob.size === 0) {
    alert("Could not export: the byte cache was released.\nRe-import the IFC and try again.");
    return;
  }
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `${t.modelId || "model"}.frag`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10000);
}

function updateQueueSummary() {
  const q = importQueue.filter((t) => t.status === "queued").length;
  const act = importQueue.filter((t) => isActiveStatus(t.status)).length;
  const done = importQueue.filter((t) => t.status === "done").length;
  const bad = importQueue.filter((t) => ["failed", "skipped", "cancelled"].includes(t.status)).length;
  const total = importQueue.reduce((a, t) => a + t.elapsedMs, 0);
  queueSummaryEl.innerHTML =
    `Queue: <b>${q}</b> pending · <b style="color:#38bdf8">${act}</b> active · ` +
    `<b style="color:#22c55e">${done}</b> done · <b style="color:#ef4444">${bad}</b> failed` +
    (total > 0 ? ` · total ${fmtDur(total)}` : "");
}

function clearFinishedTasks() {
  for (let i = importQueue.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const t = importQueue[i];
    if (["done", "failed", "cancelled", "skipped"].includes(t.status)) {
      importQueue.splice(i, 1);
      queueListEl.querySelector(`[data-uid="${t.uid}"]`)?.remove();
    }
  }
  updateQueueSummary();
}

function cancelQueueAll() {
  cancelAllRequested = true;
  for (const t of importQueue) {
    if (t.status === "queued") {
      t.status = "cancelled"; t.phase = "cancelled";
      refreshTaskRow(t);
    }
  }
  cancelActiveConversion();
  updateQueueSummary();
}

async function nextModelId(fileName: string): Promise<string> {
  const base = fileName.replace(/\.ifc$/i, "").replace(/\.frag$/i, "").trim() || `model-${Date.now()}`;
  if (ifcSettings.replaceExisting) {
    const existing = ctx.fragments.list.get(base);
    if (existing) { try { await (existing as any).dispose?.(); } catch { /* */ } }
    return base;
  }
  if (!ctx.fragments.list.has(base)) return base;
  let i = 2;
  while (ctx.fragments.list.has(`${base} (${i})`)) i++;
  return `${base} (${i})`;
}

function enqueueIfc(files: File | File[]) {
  const list = Array.isArray(files) ? files : [files];
  for (const file of list) {
    if (!/\.ifc$/i.test(file.name)) continue;
    const sizeMB = file.size / (1024 * 1024);
    const t: ImportTask = {
      uid: ++queueUid, file, sizeMB, schema: "—",
      status: "queued", progress: 0, phase: "waiting in queue", elapsedMs: 0,
    };
    if (sizeMB > ifcSettings.maxSizeMB) {
      t.status = "skipped";
      t.error = `File is ${sizeMB.toFixed(0)} MB (limit ${ifcSettings.maxSizeMB} MB).`;
    }
    importQueue.push(t);
    renderTaskRow(t);
  }
  updateQueueSummary();
  void processQueue();
}

async function processQueue() {
  if (processing) return;
  processing = true;
  cancelAllRequested = false;

  const loader = (ctx.features as any).appLoader;
  const total = importQueue.filter((x) => x.status === "queued").length;
  if (total) {
    loader?.begin?.(`Importing ${total} file(s)…`, {
      cancellable: true,
      onCancel: () => cancelQueueAll(),
    });
  }

  try {
    for (;;) {
      const t = importQueue.find((x) => x.status === "queued");
      if (!t) break;
      if (cancelAllRequested) {
        for (const x of importQueue) {
          if (x.status === "queued") { x.status = "cancelled"; x.phase = "cancelled"; refreshTaskRow(x); }
        }
        break;
      }
      await runTask(t);
    }
  } finally {
    processing = false;
    updateQueueSummary();

    // Linking sequence from working OpenBIMStudio: apply positioning, then
    // origin-to-origin identity placement (no forced recenter) — same as Revit links.
    try { await applyPositioningMode(ifcSettings.positioning); } catch (e) { console.warn(e); }
    try {
      if (ifcSettings.positioning === "origin-to-origin" || ifcSettings.positioning === "shared-coordinates") {
        const { alignOriginToOrigin } = await import("./camera-tools");
        alignOriginToOrigin();
      }
    } catch (e) { console.warn("[link-seq] alignOriginToOrigin", e); }

    if (importQueue.some((t) => t.status === "done") && ifcSettings.autoFit) {
      // Wait for the worker to stream geometry before measuring bounds.
      void (async () => {
        for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
          computeSceneBounds();
          const { getSceneBox, fitAll } = await import("./camera-tools");
          const b = getSceneBox?.();
          if (b && !b.isEmpty()) { fitAll(); return; }
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
        }
        fitAll();
      })();
    }
    else computeSceneBounds();
    try { refreshModelSelectionUI(); } catch { /* */ }

    setTimeout(() => {
      try { (ctx.cam as any)?.recoverView?.(); } catch { /* */ }
    }, 400);

    loader?.finish?.();
  }
}

async function runTask(t: ImportTask) {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  cancelRequested = false;
  const loader = (ctx.features as any).appLoader;

  try {
    t.status = "reading"; t.progress = 0; t.phase = "reading file…";
    refreshTaskRow(t);
    loader?.set?.(`Reading ${t.file.name}…`, 0.05);

    const buffer = await t.file.arrayBuffer();
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
    t.schema = detectSchema(bytes);
    refreshTaskRow(t);

    t.status = "converting"; t.phase = "checking WASM…"; refreshTaskRow(t);
    loader?.set?.("Checking WASM…", 0.1);
    await ensureWasmAvailable();

    t.phase = "starting web-ifc worker…"; refreshTaskRow(t);
    loader?.set?.("Converting IFC → FRAG…", 0.15);

    const cancelPromise = new Promise<never>((_, rej) => { rejectActive = rej; });

    const settings: any = {
      bytes,
      progressCallback: (progress: any, data?: any) => {
        t.progress = normalizeProgress(progress);
        t.phase = describePhase(data);
        t.elapsedMs = performance.now() - t0;
        refreshTaskRow(t);
        loader?.set?.(`${t.phase} · ${t.progress}%`, 0.15 + 0.7 * (t.progress / 100));
      },
    };
    if (ifcSettings.useCoord) {
      settings.coordToPlace = [ifcSettings.coordX, ifcSettings.coordY, ifcSettings.coordZ];
    }

    const processPromise = getImporter().process(settings);
    processPromise.catch(() => { /* handled via race */ });
    const rawResult: any = await Promise.race([processPromise, cancelPromise]);
    rejectActive = null;

    if (cancelRequested) throw new Error("Cancelled by user");

    const fragBytes: Uint8Array = snapshotBytes(rawResult);
    if (!fragBytes.byteLength) {
      throw new Error("Converter returned empty data — try a different web-ifc version.");
    }

    const projectBytes: Uint8Array = snapshotBytes(fragBytes);
    if (ifcSettings.keepFragInMemory) t.fragBytes = snapshotBytes(fragBytes);

    t.status = "loading"; t.progress = 100; t.phase = "loading fragments into scene…";
    refreshTaskRow(t);
    loader?.set?.("Loading fragments into scene…", 0.9);

    const modelId = await nextModelId(t.file.name);
    t.modelId = modelId;

    await ctx.fragments.core.load(fragBytes, { modelId });

    registerModel(modelId);

    try { computeSceneBounds(); } catch { /* */ }

    try {
      (ctx.features.projects as any)?.onModelImported?.(modelId, t.file.name, projectBytes);
    } catch (e) { console.warn("[ifc] project persistence hook failed", e); }

    t.elapsedMs = performance.now() - t0;
    t.status = "done"; t.phase = "done";
    refreshTaskRow(t);

    const model: any = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
    (model as any)?.getItemsIdsWithGeometry?.()
      ?.then((ids: number[]) => { t.elements = ids?.length ?? undefined; refreshTaskRow(t); })
      .catch(() => { /* */ });
  } catch (err: any) {
    rejectActive = null;
    const msg = errorMessage(err);
    const cancelled = cancelRequested || msg.toLowerCase().includes("cancel");
    t.elapsedMs = performance.now() - t0;
    if (cancelled) { t.status = "cancelled"; t.phase = "cancelled by user"; }
    else {
      console.error("[ifc-import]", err);
      t.status = "failed"; t.phase = "failed";
      t.error = msg;
    }
    refreshTaskRow(t);
    disposeImporter();
  } finally {
    rejectActive = null;
    updateQueueSummary();
  }
}

// ── Settings ──
const inpCss =
  "width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:4px 6px;background:#1a1a24;border:1px solid #3a3a4a;border-radius:4px;color:#e2e8f0;font-size:11px";

export const settingsBox = document.createElement("details");
settingsBox.style.cssText =
  "margin:8px 0;border:1px solid #2a2a35;border-radius:6px;padding:8px;background:#14141c;font-size:11px";
settingsBox.innerHTML = `
  <summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;opacity:.85">Importer settings</summary>
  <div style="margin-top:8px;display:grid;gap:8px">
    <label style="display:grid;gap:2px">WASM source
      <select id="ifcCdn" style="${inpCss}">
        <option value="local">Local (recommended)</option>
        <option value="unpkg">unpkg.com</option>
        <option value="jsdelivr">cdn.jsdelivr.net</option>
        <option value="custom">Custom path…</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label style="display:grid;gap:2px">web-ifc version
      <input id="ifcVer" style="${inpCss}" placeholder="0.0.77">
    </label>
    <label id="ifcCustomRow" style="display:none;gap:2px">Custom WASM folder URL (must end with /)
      <input id="ifcCustom" style="${inpCss}" placeholder="https://my-cdn/web-ifc/">
    </label>
    <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px"><input type="checkbox" id="ifcRecenter"> Recenter first model to origin</label>
    <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px"><input type="checkbox" id="ifcKeep"> Keep converted .frag in memory</label>
    <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px"><input type="checkbox" id="ifcReplace"> Replace existing model with same name</label>
    <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px"><input type="checkbox" id="ifcFit"> Auto-fit camera after import</label>
    <label style="display:grid;gap:2px">Max file size (MB)
      <input id="ifcMax" type="number" min="1" style="${inpCss}">
    </label>
  </div>`;

function syncSettingsUI() {
  const $ = (id: string) => settingsBox.querySelector(`#${id}`) as any;
  $("ifcCdn").value = ifcSettings.cdn;
  $("ifcVer").value = ifcSettings.version;
  $("ifcCustom").value = ifcSettings.customPath;
  $("ifcCustomRow").style.display = ifcSettings.cdn === "custom" ? "grid" : "none";
  $("ifcRecenter").checked = !!ifcSettings.recenter;
  $("ifcKeep").checked = ifcSettings.keepFragInMemory;
  $("ifcReplace").checked = ifcSettings.replaceExisting;
  $("ifcFit").checked = ifcSettings.autoFit;
  $("ifcMax").value = String(ifcSettings.maxSizeMB);
}

settingsBox.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
  const el = e.target as HTMLInputElement;
  const rebuild = () => disposeImporter();
  switch (el.id) {
    case "ifcCdn": ifcSettings.cdn = el.value as IfcSettings["cdn"]; syncSettingsUI(); rebuild(); break;
    case "ifcVer": ifcSettings.version = el.value.trim() || "0.0.77"; rebuild(); break;
    case "ifcCustom": ifcSettings.customPath = el.value.trim(); rebuild(); break;
    case "ifcRecenter":
      ifcSettings.recenter = el.checked;
      setRecenterEnabled(el.checked);
      if (el.checked) recenterSceneNow(); else resetOffsets();
      break;
    case "ifcKeep": ifcSettings.keepFragInMemory = el.checked; break;
    case "ifcReplace": ifcSettings.replaceExisting = el.checked; break;
    case "ifcFit": ifcSettings.autoFit = el.checked; break;
    case "ifcMax": ifcSettings.maxSizeMB = Math.max(1, Number(el.value) || 500); break;
  }
  saveIfcSettings();
});

export const queueButtons = document.createElement("div");
queueButtons.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:4px";
queueButtons.innerHTML = `
  <button data-qa="cancelCurrent" style="${btnCss}">Cancel current</button>
  <button data-qa="cancelAll" style="${btnCss}">Cancel all</button>
  <button data-qa="clearFinished" style="${btnCss}">Clear finished</button>`;

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PUBLIC LOADERS
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export async function loadFragFiles(files: FileList | File[]) {
  const list = Array.from(files);
  if (!list.length) return;

  const loader = (ctx.features as any).appLoader;
  loader?.begin?.(`Loading ${list.length} .frag file(s)…`, { cancellable: false });

  try {
    let i = 0;
    for (const file of list) {
      i++;
      loader?.set?.(`Loading ${i} / ${list.length} · ${file.name}`, i / list.length);
      try {
        if (file.size === 0) {
          alert(`"${file.name}" is empty (0 bytes).`);
          continue;
        }
        const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
        const projectBytes = new Uint8Array(buffer.slice(0));

        const modelId = file.name.replace(/\.frag$/i, "").trim() || `model-${Date.now()}`;
        let id = modelId;
        try { if (ctx.fragments.list.has(id)) id = await nextModelId(file.name); }
        catch { id = modelId; }

        await ctx.fragments.core.load(buffer, { modelId: id });
        registerModel(id);

        try {
          (ctx.features.projects as any)?.onModelImported?.(id, file.name, projectBytes);
        } catch (e) { console.warn("[frag-load] project persistence hook failed", e); }
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.error("[frag-load]", err);
        alert(`Failed: ${file.name}\n${errorMessage(err)}`);
      }
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
    }

    // Linking sequence (old OpenBIMStudio FRAG linker): load as-is, apply mode,
    // then origin-to-origin so federated models stay coordinated.
    try { await applyPositioningMode(ifcSettings.positioning); } catch (e) { console.warn(e); }
    try {
      if (ifcSettings.positioning === "origin-to-origin" || ifcSettings.positioning === "shared-coordinates") {
        const { alignOriginToOrigin } = await import("./camera-tools");
        alignOriginToOrigin();
      }
    } catch (e) { console.warn("[link-seq] alignOriginToOrigin", e); }

    try { computeSceneBounds(); } catch { /* */ }
    try { fitAll(); } catch { /* */ }
    try { refreshModelSelectionUI(); } catch { /* */ }

    setTimeout(() => {
      try { (ctx.cam as any)?.recoverView?.(); } catch { /* */ }
    }, 400);
  } finally {
    loader?.finish?.();
  }
}

export function loadIfcFiles(files: FileList | File[]) {
  const list = Array.from(files).filter((f) => /\.ifc$/i.test(f.name));
  if (!list.length) { alert("Please select one or more .ifc files."); return; }
  enqueueIfc(list);
}

export function pickFiles(
  accept: string,
  multiple: boolean,
  handler: (files: FileList) => void,
) {
  const input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "file";
  input.accept = accept;
  input.multiple = multiple;
  input.onchange = () => { if (input.files?.length) handler(input.files); };
  input.click();
}

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Setup
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function setupImporter() {
  setRecenterEnabled(!!ifcSettings.recenter);
  syncSettingsUI();
  syncPositioningSelect();

  queueButtons.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const act = (e.target as HTMLElement).dataset?.qa;
    if (act === "cancelCurrent") cancelActiveConversion();
    else if (act === "cancelAll") cancelQueueAll();
    else if (act === "clearFinished") clearFinishedTasks();
  });

  const dropHint = document.createElement("div");
  dropHint.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;" +
    "background:rgba(56,189,248,.08);border:2px dashed #38bdf8;z-index:50;" +
    "pointer-events:none;color:#38bdf8;font:600 16px system-ui,sans-serif";
  dropHint.textContent = "Drop .ifc / .frag files to import";
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(dropHint);

  let dragDepth = 0;
  ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("dragenter", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    dragDepth++;
    dropHint.style.display = "flex";
  });
  ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("dragover", (e) => e.preventDefault());
  ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("dragleave", () => {
    dragDepth = Math.max(0, dragDepth - 1);
    if (!dragDepth) dropHint.style.display = "none";
  });
  ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("drop", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    dragDepth = 0;
    dropHint.style.display = "none";
    const files = Array.from(e.dataTransfer?.files ?? []);
    if (!files.length) return;
    const fragFiles = files.filter((f) => /\.frag$/i.test(f.name));
    const ifcFiles = files.filter((f) => /\.ifc$/i.test(f.name));
    if (fragFiles.length) void loadFragFiles(fragFiles);
    if (ifcFiles.length) enqueueIfc(ifcFiles);
  });

  ctx.features.importer = {
    loadIfcFiles, loadFragFiles, cancelActiveConversion,
    getPositioningMode, setPositioningMode, applyPositioningMode,
    registerModel, unregisterModel, clearAllOffsets,
    setModelOffset, getModelOffset, listRegisteredModels,
    getModelBBox, getModelBBoxCenter,
    onOffsetsChanged,
  };

  console.log("[importer] ready · positioning modes + live offset control");
}
```
