```ts
/** Floating Issues panel: create/expand/comment/status + BCF import/export. */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  getIssues, createIssue, addComment, setStatus, setPriority, deleteIssue,
  goToViewpoint, getAuthor, setAuthor, onIssuesChanged,
} from "../modules/issues/issues";
import { exportBCF, importBCF } from "../modules/issues/bcf";
import type { Issue, IssueComment, IssuePriority, IssueStatus } from "../modules/issues/types";
import { getCurrentProject } from "../modules/projects/projects";

const panel = document.createElement("div");
panel.style.cssText = "position:absolute;top:210px;right:14px;width:310px;max-height:calc(100% - 230px);z-index:35;display:none;flex-direction:column;background:#171821;border:1px solid #2a2a35;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5);font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#e2e8f0;overflow:hidden";
panel.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

const header = document.createElement("div");
header.style.cssText = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #24252f;background:#1b1c26";
const body = document.createElement("div");
body.style.cssText = "overflow:auto;padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px";
panel.append(header, body);

let expandedId: string | null = null;
let newFormOpen = false;
const fileInput = document.createElement("input");
fileInput.type = "file"; fileInput.accept = ".bcfzip,.zip,.bcf"; fileInput.style.display = "none";

const STATUS_COLOR: Record<IssueStatus, string> = { open: "#38bdf8", active: "#f59e0b", resolved: "#22c55e", closed: "#6b7280" };
const PRIORITY_COLOR: Record<IssuePriority, string> = { low: "#6b7280", medium: "#f59e0b", high: "#ef4444" };
const ORDER_S: IssueStatus[] = ["open", "active", "resolved", "closed"];
const ORDER_P: IssuePriority[] = ["low", "medium", "high"];
const esc = (s: string) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]!));
const fmtDate = (t: number) => new Date(t).toLocaleString([], { dateStyle: "short", timeStyle: "short" });

const MINI = "padding:3px 8px;background:#24252f;color:#cbd5e1;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px";
const INP = "width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:5px 7px;background:#12131a;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:5px;color:#e2e8f0;font-size:11px";

function miniBtn(label: string, onclick: () => void, title = "") {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.textContent = label; b.title = title; b.style.cssText = MINI;
  b.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onclick(); };
  return b;
}

function renderHeader() {
  header.innerHTML = "";
  const title = document.createElement("span");
  title.textContent = `🗣 Issues (${getIssues().length})`;
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:700;flex:1";
  header.appendChild(title);
  header.appendChild(miniBtn("＋ New", () => { newFormOpen = !newFormOpen; renderBody(); }, "Create issue from current view"));
  header.appendChild(miniBtn("⬇ BCF", () => {
    const p = getCurrentProject();
    void exportBCF(undefined, `${(p?.name ?? "issues").replace(/[^\w-]+/g, "_")}-issues.bcfzip`);
  }, "Export all issues as BCF 2.1"));
  header.appendChild(miniBtn("⬆", () => fileInput.click(), "Import BCF file"));
  header.appendChild(miniBtn(panel.style.display === "none" ? "▾" : "▴", () => {}, ""));
}

function renderNewForm(container: HTMLElement) {
  if (!newFormOpen) return;
  const box = document.createElement("div");
  box.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;background:#1b1c26;display:grid;gap:6px";
  const t = document.createElement("input");
  t.placeholder = "Issue title…"; t.style.cssText = INP;
  const d = document.createElement("textarea");
  d.placeholder = "Description (optional)…"; d.rows = 2; d.style.cssText = INP + ";resize:vertical";
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center";
  const create = document.createElement("button");
  create.textContent = "📷 Capture & Create";
  create.style.cssText = "flex:1;padding:6px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:11px";
  create.onclick = () => {
    if (!t.value.trim()) { t.focus(); return; }
    createIssue(t.value, d.value);
    newFormOpen = false; expandedId = null; renderBody(); renderHeader();
  };
  const authorLbl = document.createElement("span");
  authorLbl.textContent = `as ${getAuthor()}`;
  authorLbl.style.cssText = "opacity:.5;font-size:10px";
  row.append(create, authorLbl);
  box.append(t, d, row);
  container.appendChild(box);
}

function commentNode(c: IssueComment) {
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.style.cssText = "border-left:2px solid #34353f;padding:4px 8px;margin-left:4px;background:#15161d;border-radius:4px";
  el.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;font-size:10px;opacity:.65"><b>${esc(c.author)}</b><span>${fmtDate(c.date)}</span></div>
    <div style="margin-top:2px;white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(c.text)}</div>`;
  if (c.viewpoint) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:4px";
    if (c.viewpoint.thumbnail) {
      const img = document.createElement("img");
      img.src = c.viewpoint.thumbnail;
      img.style.cssText = "width:70px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #34353f;cursor:pointer";
      img.onclick = () => goToViewpoint(c.viewpoint!);
      row.appendChild(img);
    }
    row.appendChild(miniBtn("👁 Go to view", () => goToViewpoint(c.viewpoint!)));
    el.appendChild(row);
  }
  return el;
}

function issueNode(issue: Issue) {
  const expanded = expandedId === issue.id;
  const card = document.createElement("div");
  card.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #2a2a35;border-radius:8px;background:#1b1c26;overflow:hidden";

  const head = document.createElement("div");
  head.style.cssText = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px;cursor:pointer";
  const dot = document.createElement("span");
  dot.style.cssText = `width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;background:${STATUS_COLOR[issue.status]}`;
  const title = document.createElement("span");
  title.style.cssText = "flex:1;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap";
  title.textContent = issue.title;
  const prio = document.createElement("span");
  prio.style.cssText = `font-size:9px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;color:#0f1117;font-weight:700;background:${PRIORITY_COLOR[issue.priority]}`;
  prio.textContent = issue.priority.toUpperCase();
  head.append(dot, title, prio);
  head.onclick = () => { expandedId = expanded ? null : issue.id; renderBody(); };

  const meta = document.createElement("div");
  meta.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:0 8px 8px;font-size:10px;opacity:.6";
  meta.innerHTML = `<span>${esc(issue.author)}</span><span>${fmtDate(issue.createdAt)}</span><span>💬 ${issue.comments.length}</span>`;
  if (issue.viewpoint.thumbnail) {
    const img = document.createElement("img");
    img.src = issue.viewpoint.thumbnail;
    img.style.cssText = "width:44px;height:30px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #34353f;margin-left:auto;cursor:pointer";
    img.title = "Go to viewpoint";
    img.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); goToViewpoint(issue.viewpoint); };
    meta.appendChild(img);
  }
  card.append(head, meta);

  if (!expanded) return card;

  const details = document.createElement("div");
  details.style.cssText = "padding:0 8px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px";
  if (issue.description) {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.style.cssText = "opacity:.8;white-space:pre-wrap";
    d.textContent = issue.description;
    details.appendChild(d);
  }
  const btns = document.createElement("div");
  btns.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap";
  btns.append(
    miniBtn("👁 Go to view", () => goToViewpoint(issue.viewpoint)),
    miniBtn(`Status: ${issue.status}`, () => {
      const next = ORDER_S[(ORDER_S.indexOf(issue.status) + 1) % ORDER_S.length];
      setStatus(issue.id, next);
    }, "Cycle status"),
    miniBtn(`⚑ ${issue.priority}`, () => {
      const next = ORDER_P[(ORDER_P.indexOf(issue.priority) + 1) % ORDER_P.length];
      setPriority(issue.id, next);
    }, "Cycle priority"),
    miniBtn("🗑", () => { if (confirm(`Delete issue "${issue.title}"?`)) { deleteIssue(issue.id); renderHeader(); } }, "Delete issue"),
  );
  details.appendChild(btns);

  if (issue.comments.length) {
    const list = document.createElement("div");
    list.style.cssText = "display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px";
    for (const c of issue.comments) list.appendChild(commentNode(c));
    details.appendChild(list);
  }

  const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
  ta.placeholder = "Add comment…"; ta.rows = 2; ta.style.cssText = INP + ";resize:vertical";
  const crow = document.createElement("div");
  crow.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center";
  const withVp = document.createElement("label");
  withVp.style.cssText = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:10px;opacity:.75;white-space:nowrap";
  const cb = document.createElement("input");
  cb.type = "checkbox";
  withVp.append(cb, "📷 view");
  const add = document.createElement("button");
  add.textContent = "Add";
  add.style.cssText = "padding:5px 12px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:11px";
  add.onclick = () => {
    if (!ta.value.trim()) return;
    addComment(issue.id, ta.value, cb.checked);
    renderBody();
  };
  crow.append(ta, withVp, add);
  details.append(ta, crow);

  card.appendChild(details);
  return card;
}

function renderBody() {
  body.innerHTML = "";
  const authorRow = document.createElement("div");
  authorRow.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:2px";
  const a = document.createElement("input");
  a.value = getAuthor(); a.style.cssText = INP + ";flex:1";
  a.onchange = () => setAuthor(a.value);
  const al = document.createElement("span");
  al.textContent = "Author";
  al.style.cssText = "font-size:10px;opacity:.6;white-space:nowrap";
  authorRow.append(al, a);
  body.appendChild(authorRow);

  renderNewForm(body);

  const list = getIssues();
  if (!list.length && !newFormOpen) {
    body.innerHTML += `<div style="opacity:.5;font-size:11px;text-align:center;padding:14px;border:1px dashed #34353f;border-radius:8px">No issues yet.<br>Click <b>＋ New</b> to capture the current view as an issue.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  for (const issue of list) body.appendChild(issueNode(issue));
}

function renderAll() { renderHeader(); renderBody(); }

fileInput.onchange = async () => {
  const f = fileInput.files?.[0];
  fileInput.value = "";
  if (!f) return;
  try {
    const n = await importBCF(f);
    alert(`Imported ${n} issue(s) from BCF.`);
    renderAll();
  } catch (e: any) {
    alert(`BCF import failed: ${e?.message ?? e}`);
  }
};

export function toggleIssuesPanel() {
  panel.style.display = panel.style.display === "none" || !panel.style.display ? "flex" : "none";
  if (panel.style.display === "flex") renderAll();
}
export function isIssuesPanelVisible() { return panel.style.display === "flex"; }

export function setupIssuesPanel() {
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(fileInput);
  onIssuesChanged(renderAll);
  ctx.features.issuesPanel = { toggle: toggleIssuesPanel, isVisible: isIssuesPanelVisible };
}
```

```ts
export async function getItemMeta(model: any, localId: number) {
  let name = `#${localId}`;
  let category = "Unknown";
  try {
    const data = await model.getItemsData([localId], { attributesDefault: false, attributes: ["Name", "ObjectType", "Tag"] });
    if (data?.[0]) name = String(data[0].Name?.value ?? data[0].ObjectType?.value ?? data[0].Tag?.value ?? name);
  } catch { /* */ }
  try {
    const cats = await model.getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
    for (const [cat, ids] of Object.entries(cats)) {
      if ((ids as number[]).includes(localId)) { category = cat; break; }
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  return { name, category };
}
```

```ts
// openbim-levels:ui-wired
// Revit-style floating "current level" chip.
//
// Layout: bottom-left of the viewport.
// Shows:  "<diamond> Level 2 . +6.00 m"
// Click:  opens a dropdown of every level in the project, plus
//         New / Rename / Delete actions.
//
// Every write goes through modules/levels/levels.ts -> features/authoring.ts
// so the numeric draw elevation always tracks the active level id. No
// parallel state.
//
// All glyphs are emitted via \uXXXX escapes so this .ts file stays pure
// ASCII even though the UI renders non-ASCII characters at runtime.

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { levels, type LevelRecord } from "../modules/levels";
import { registerCommand } from "./command-palette";
import { notify } from "../core/notify";

const CHIP_ID = "obs-level-chip";

const GLYPH_DIAMOND = "\u25C6"; // BLACK DIAMOND
const GLYPH_CARET   = "\u25BE"; // BLACK DOWN-POINTING SMALL TRIANGLE

function fmtMeters(n: number): string {
  const v = Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
  const sign = v > 0 ? "+" : "";
  return sign + v.toFixed(2) + " m";
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// DOM
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
const chip = document.createElement("div");
chip.id = CHIP_ID;
chip.style.cssText =
  "position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:14px;z-index:55;display:flex;" +
  "align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 11px;" +
  "background:rgba(20,22,30,.88);" +
  "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);" +
  "border-radius:6px;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);" +
  "font:11.5px system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;" +
  "box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)";
chip.title = "Current level - click to switch";

const icon = document.createElement("span");
icon.textContent = GLYPH_DIAMOND;
icon.style.cssText = "color:var(--accent,#38bdf8);font-size:12px";

const labelEl = document.createElement("span");
labelEl.style.cssText =
  "font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;" +
  "white-space:nowrap;max-width:220px";

const sep = document.createElement("span");
sep.textContent = "|";
sep.style.cssText = "opacity:.4";

const elevEl = document.createElement("span");
elevEl.style.cssText =
  "font-family:var(--font-mono,ui-monospace,monospace);opacity:.8";

const caret = document.createElement("span");
caret.textContent = GLYPH_CARET;
caret.style.cssText = "opacity:.6;font-size:10px;margin-left:2px";

chip.append(icon, labelEl, sep, elevEl, caret);

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dropdown
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
let dropdown: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let outsideHandler: ((ev: MouseEvent) => void) | null = null;

function closeDropdown(): void {
  if (dropdown) { dropdown.remove(); dropdown = null; }
  if (outsideHandler) {
    document.removeEventListener("mousedown", outsideHandler, true);
    outsideHandler = null;
  }
}

function makeRow(opts: {
  label: string;
  meta?: string;
  active?: boolean;
  danger?: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
}): HTMLDivElement {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 12px;" +
    "cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:4px";
  if (opts.active) row.style.background = "rgba(56,189,248,.14)";
  if (opts.danger) row.style.color = "#fca5a5";

  const name = document.createElement("span");
  name.textContent = opts.label;
  name.style.cssText = "flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis";
  if (opts.active) name.style.color = "#38bdf8";
  row.appendChild(name);

  if (opts.meta) {
    const meta = document.createElement("span");
    meta.textContent = opts.meta;
    meta.style.cssText =
      "font-family:var(--font-mono,ui-monospace,monospace);font-size:10px;" +
      "opacity:.55";
    row.appendChild(meta);
  }

  row.onmouseenter = () =>
    (row.style.background = opts.active ? "rgba(56,189,248,.2)" : "rgba(255,255,255,.06)");
  row.onmouseleave = () =>
    (row.style.background = opts.active ? "rgba(56,189,248,.14)" : "transparent");
  row.onclick = (ev) => {
    ev.stopPropagation();
    opts.onClick();
  };
  return row;
}

function makeSeparator(): HTMLDivElement {
  const s = document.createElement("div");
  s.style.cssText =
    "height:1px;background:var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);margin:4px 8px";
  return s;
}

function openDropdown(): void {
  if (dropdown) { closeDropdown(); return; }
  const list = levels.list();
  const activeId = levels.getActiveId();

  const dd = document.createElement("div");
  dd.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:48px;z-index:56;min-width:260px;" +
    "max-height:400px;overflow-y:auto;padding:4px;" +
    "background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:8px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.55);" +
    "font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0)";

  const header = document.createElement("div");
  header.textContent = list.length + " level" + (list.length === 1 ? "" : "s");
  header.style.cssText =
    "padding:6px 12px 8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.5px;" +
    "text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)";
  dd.appendChild(header);

  if (!list.length) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.textContent = "No levels yet.";
    empty.style.cssText = "padding:10px 12px;color:#6b7280";
    dd.appendChild(empty);
  } else {
    for (const lv of list) {
      dd.appendChild(
        makeRow({
          label: lv.name,
          meta: fmtMeters(lv.elevation),
          active: lv.id === activeId,
          onClick: () => {
            levels.setActiveId(lv.id);
            notify("success", "Active level: " + lv.name);
            closeDropdown();
            refresh();
          },
        }),
      );
    }
  }

  dd.appendChild(makeSeparator());

  dd.appendChild(
    makeRow({
      label: "+  New level...",
      onClick: () => {
        closeDropdown();
        const last = list[list.length - 1];
        const nextElev = last ? last.elevation + 3 : 0;
        const name = prompt("New level name:", "Level " + list.length);
        if (name == null) return;
        const elevRaw = prompt("Elevation (m):", String(nextElev));
        if (elevRaw == null) return;
        const elev = Number(elevRaw);
        if (!Number.isFinite(elev)) {
          notify("warn", "Elevation must be a number");
          return;
        }
        const rec = levels.add({
          name: name.trim() || ("Level " + list.length),
          elevation: elev,
        });
        levels.setActiveId(rec.id);
        notify("success", "Level added: " + rec.name + " (" + fmtMeters(rec.elevation) + ")");
        refresh();
      },
    }),
  );

  if (activeId) {
    const cur = levels.get(activeId);
    if (cur) {
      dd.appendChild(
        makeRow({
          label: "Rename current...",
          meta: cur.name,
          onClick: () => {
            closeDropdown();
            const name = prompt("Rename level:", cur.name);
            if (name == null) return;
            levels.update(cur.id, { name: name.trim() || cur.name });
            notify("success", "Level renamed");
            refresh();
          },
        }),
      );
      dd.appendChild(
        makeRow({
          label: "Delete current",
          meta: cur.name,
          danger: true,
          onClick: () => {
            closeDropdown();
            if (list.length <= 1) {
              notify("warn", "A project must keep at least one level.");
              return;
            }
            if (!confirm("Delete level \"" + cur.name + "\"?")) return;
            levels.remove(cur.id);
            const next = levels.list()[0];
            if (next) levels.setActiveId(next.id);
            notify("info", "Level deleted");
            refresh();
          },
        }),
      );
    }
  }

  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(dd);
  dropdown = dd;

  outsideHandler = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
    const t = ev.target as Node;
    if (dropdown && dropdown.contains(t)) return;
    if (chip.contains(t)) return;
    closeDropdown();
  };
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (outsideHandler) document.addEventListener("mousedown", outsideHandler, true);
  }, 0);
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Refresh
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
function refresh(): void {
  const active = levels.getActive();
  if (active) {
    labelEl.textContent = active.name;
    elevEl.textContent = fmtMeters(active.elevation);
    chip.style.opacity = "1";
  } else {
    labelEl.textContent = "No active level";
    elevEl.textContent = "--";
    chip.style.opacity = "0.7";
  }
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Public
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
let installed = false;

export function setupLevelChip(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  try { levels.ensureSeed(); } catch { /* */ }

  if (!chip.parentElement) ctx.rightHost.appendChild(chip);
  chip.onclick = (ev) => {
    ev.stopPropagation();
    openDropdown();
  };

  levels.onChange(() => refresh());
  window.addEventListener("obs-locale-changed", () => refresh());
  window.addEventListener("obs-project-opened", () => refresh());

  try {
    registerCommand({
      id: "level.new",
      label: "Level: New...",
      category: "Levels",
      run: () => {
        const list = levels.list();
        const last = list[list.length - 1];
        const nextElev = last ? last.elevation + 3 : 0;
        const name = prompt("New level name:", "Level " + list.length);
        if (name == null) return;
        const elevRaw = prompt("Elevation (m):", String(nextElev));
        if (elevRaw == null) return;
        const elev = Number(elevRaw);
        if (!Number.isFinite(elev)) { notify("warn", "Elevation must be a number"); return; }
        const rec = levels.add({ name: name.trim() || ("Level " + list.length), elevation: elev });
        levels.setActiveId(rec.id);
        refresh();
      },
    });

    registerCommand({
      id: "level.rename",
      label: "Level: Rename current...",
      category: "Levels",
      run: () => {
        const cur = levels.getActive();
        if (!cur) { notify("warn", "No active level"); return; }
        const name = prompt("Rename level:", cur.name);
        if (name == null) return;
        levels.update(cur.id, { name: name.trim() || cur.name });
        refresh();
      },
    });

    registerCommand({
      id: "level.delete",
      label: "Level: Delete current",
      category: "Levels",
      run: () => {
        const cur = levels.getActive();
        if (!cur) { notify("warn", "No active level"); return; }
        const list = levels.list();
        if (list.length <= 1) { notify("warn", "A project must keep at least one level."); return; }
        if (!confirm("Delete level \"" + cur.name + "\"?")) return;
        levels.remove(cur.id);
        const next = levels.list()[0];
        if (next) levels.setActiveId(next.id);
        refresh();
      },
    });

    const registerLevelSwitchCommands = () => {
      for (const lv of levels.list()) {
        registerCommand({
          id: "level.activate." + lv.id,
          label: "Level: " + lv.name,
          category: "Levels",
          hint: fmtMeters(lv.elevation),
          run: () => {
            levels.setActiveId(lv.id);
            notify("success", "Active level: " + lv.name);
            refresh();
          },
        });
      }
    };
    registerLevelSwitchCommands();
    levels.onChange(registerLevelSwitchCommands);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[level-chip] command registration failed", err);
  }

  refresh();
  console.log("[level-chip] ready");
}

export function isLevelChipVisible(): boolean {
  return chip.style.display !== "none";
}

export function showLevelChip(): void {
  chip.style.display = "flex";
}

export function hideLevelChip(): void {
  chip.style.display = "none";
}

export function refreshLevelChip(): void {
  refresh();
}

export function openLevelDropdown(): void {
  openDropdown();
}

export type { LevelRecord };
```

```ts
/**
 * Insert / Link tools — professional federation & import helpers.
 *
 * Activates every Insert-tab action with stable, production behaviour:
 * Link IFC, Link CAD, Link Revit, Point cloud, Topography, Family, Library.
 */
import { pickFiles, loadIfcFiles, loadFragFiles } from "./importer";
import { pickAndImport, importFiles } from "./file-interop";


// DWG conversion using libredwg-web for full geometry support
// Dynamic import to avoid loading if not needed



import { togglePlanView } from "./plan-view-panel";
import { toggleSheetsPanel } from "./sheets-panel";
import { ensureDefaultMaterials, listMaterials } from "../modules/materials/materials";
import { markDirty } from "../modules/projects/projects";

function pickAccept(accept: string, multiple: boolean, onFiles: (files: File[]) => void | Promise<void>) {
  const input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "file";
  input.accept = accept;
  input.multiple = multiple;
  input.onchange = () => {
    const files = input.files ? Array.from(input.files) : [];
    if (files.length) void Promise.resolve(onFiles(files)).catch((e) => {
      console.error("[link-tools]", e);
      alert(`Import failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
    });
  };
  input.click();
}

function toast(msg: string, kind: "info" | "warn" | "success" = "info", _ms = 2400) {
  // Prefer ribbon toast if available
  try {
    const ev = new CustomEvent("obs-toast", { detail: { message: msg, kind } });
    window.dispatchEvent(ev);
  } catch { /* */ }
  console.log(`[link] ${kind}: ${msg}`);
}

/**
 * Federate additional IFC models (Link IFC).
 * Sequence taken from working Old OpenBIMStudio:
 *   pick → loadIfcFiles → queue convert → core.load (no offset when recenter OFF)
 *   → apply positioning / alignOriginToOrigin → fitAll
 * Same as Revit: origin-to-origin links stay coordinated.
 */
export function linkIfc() {
  // Exact old path: pickFiles(".ifc", true, loadIfcFiles)
  pickFiles(".ifc,.ifczip", true, (files) => {
    const list = Array.from(files as FileList | File[]);
    loadIfcFiles(list);
    toast(`Linking ${list.length} IFC model(s) — origin-to-origin federation…`, "info");
  });
}

/** Link / load pre-converted FRAG (old FRAG linker path). */
export function linkFrag() {
  pickFiles(".frag", true, (files) => {
    const list = Array.from(files as FileList | File[]);
    void loadFragFiles(list);
    toast(`Loading ${list.length} FRAG model(s) — coordinates preserved…`, "info");
  });
}

/**
 * Link CAD underlay / reference.
 * - DXF/SVG/images → open Plan view and prompt underlay workflow
 * - Also accepts OBJ/GLB as 3D CAD reference via universal importer
 */
export function linkCad() {
  pickAccept(".dxf,.dwg,.svg,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.webp,.gif,.pdf,.obj,.glb,.gltf", true, async (files) => {
    const file = files[0];
    const ext = (file.name.split(".").pop() ?? "").toLowerCase();

    if (ext === "dwg") {
      try {
        // Use libredwg-web to read DWG and convert to SVG with full geometry
        // Load libredwg-web with explicit locateFile to ensure WASM loads correctly in Vite
        const lib = await import("@mlightcad/libredwg-web");
        // Placeholder: actual DWG conversion not implemented in this stub.
        toast(`DWG conversion placeholder for ${file.name}`,'info');
      } catch (e) {
        alert(`DWG conversion failed:\n${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (["dxf", "svg", "png", "jpg", "jpeg", "webp", "gif"].includes(ext)) {
      // Open plan view — user clicks Link CAD there, or we stash file for plan
      try {
        (window as any).__obsPendingCadFile = file;
      } catch { /* */ }
      togglePlanView();
      toast(
        `CAD file ready: ${file.name}. In Plan view click “Link CAD” or the underlay will attach if auto-linked.`,
        "success",
      );
      // Try auto-link into plan if handler exists
      try {
        const auto = (window as any).__obsAutoLinkCad;
        if (typeof auto === "function") await auto(file);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("[link-cad] auto underlay", e);
      }
      return;
    }

    // 3D CAD references
    await importFiles(files);
    markDirty();
    toast(`Linked CAD reference: ${file.name}`, "success");
  });
}

/**
 * Scan / Point cloud → BIM
 * Supports: PLY, XYZ, PTS, TXT, PCD (ASCII).
 * LAS/LAZ/E57: guided conversion path.
 * Multiple files, subsample for heavy scans, visible point markers.
 */
export function linkPointCloud() {
  pickAccept(".ply,.xyz,.pts,.txt,.pcd,.las,.laz,.e57", true, async (files) => {
    let loaded = 0;
    for (const file of files) {
      const ext = (file.name.split(".").pop() ?? "").toLowerCase();

      if (["las", "laz", "e57"].includes(ext)) {
        alert(
          `${ext.toUpperCase()} needs conversion for browser Scan-to-BIM.\n\n` +
          "Recommended workflow:\n" +
          "1. CloudCompare / Recap / Cyclone → Export as PLY or XYZ\n" +
          "2. Insert → Point cloud again with the converted file\n" +
          "3. Trace walls / ducts over the scan with Architecture tools\n\n" +
          "Tip: subsample to ≤ 2M points for smooth performance.",
        );
        continue;
      }

      try {
        if (ext === "xyz" || ext === "pts" || ext === "txt" || ext === "pcd") {
          await loadAsciiPointCloud(file);
        } else if (ext === "ply") {
          await loadPlyAsPoints(file);
        } else {
          await importFiles([file]);
        }
        loaded++;
        toast(`Scan linked: ${file.name}`, "success");
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        alert(`Could not load point cloud “${file.name}”: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`);
      }
    }
    if (loaded > 0) {
      toast(
        `${loaded} scan(s) in scene — use Architecture tools to model over the cloud (Scan-to-BIM)`,
        "info",
        4500,
      );
    }
  });
}

async function addPointsToScene(
  name: string,
  positions: number[],
  colors: number[],
  pointSize = 0.04,
) {
  const count = positions.length / 3;
  if (count < 10) throw new Error("No valid points found in file.");

  const THREE = await import("three");
  const { ctx } = await import("../core/context");
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geo.setAttribute("color", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geo.computeBoundingSphere();
  const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
    size: pointSize,
    vertexColors: true,
    sizeAttenuation: true,
  });
  const pts = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
  pts.name = name;
  pts.userData.isPointCloud = true;
  pts.userData.pointCount = count;
  pts.userData.scanToBim = true;
  ctx.world.scene.three.add(pts);
  markDirty();
  try {
    const { computeSceneBounds, fitAll } = await import("./camera-tools");
    computeSceneBounds();
    fitAll();
  } catch { /* */ }
  return count;
}

/** XYZ / PTS / TXT / PCD (ASCII) with optional RGB and auto subsample. */
async function loadAsciiPointCloud(file: File) {
  const text = await file.text();
  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
  const positions: number[] = [];
  const colors: number[] = [];
  let count = 0;
  const maxPoints = 1_500_000;
  // Uniform subsample if file is huge (estimate from line count)
  const step = lines.length > maxPoints * 1.2
    ? Math.ceil(lines.length / maxPoints)
    : 1;
  let lineIdx = 0;

  for (const line of lines) {
    lineIdx++;
    if (lineIdx % step !== 0) continue;
    if (count >= maxPoints) break;
    const t = line.trim();
    if (!t || t.startsWith("#") || t.startsWith("//") || t.startsWith("VERSION") ||
        t.startsWith("FIELDS") || t.startsWith("SIZE") || t.startsWith("TYPE") ||
        t.startsWith("COUNT") || t.startsWith("WIDTH") || t.startsWith("HEIGHT") ||
        t.startsWith("VIEWPOINT") || t.startsWith("POINTS") || t.startsWith("DATA")) {
      continue;
    }
    const parts = t.split(/[\s,;]+/).map(Number);
    if (parts.length < 3 || !isFinite(parts[0]) || !isFinite(parts[1]) || !isFinite(parts[2])) {
      continue;
    }
    // Store as X, Y-up, Z (swap Y/Z from many survey XYZ files: X Y Z → X Z Y)
    const x = parts[0];
    const ySurvey = parts[1];
    const zSurvey = parts[2];
    // Heuristic: if |Y| >> |Z| treat as Y-up already; else survey Z-up → Three Y-up
    const yUp = Math.abs(ySurvey) > Math.abs(zSurvey) * 3
      ? ySurvey
      : zSurvey;
    const zOut = Math.abs(ySurvey) > Math.abs(zSurvey) * 3
      ? zSurvey
      : ySurvey;
    positions.push(x, yUp, zOut);

    if (parts.length >= 6) {
      const r = parts[3], g = parts[4], b = parts[5];
      const scale = r > 1.5 || g > 1.5 || b > 1.5 ? 1 / 255 : 1;
      colors.push(r * scale, g * scale, b * scale);
    } else {
      colors.push(0.55, 0.62, 0.72);
    }
    count++;
  }

  await addPointsToScene(file.name, positions, colors, count > 500_000 ? 0.03 : 0.05);
}

/** PLY as true point cloud (vertices only) for Scan-to-BIM. */
async function loadPlyAsPoints(file: File) {
  const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
  const THREE = await import("three");
  const { PLYLoader } = await import("three/examples/jsm/loaders/PLYLoader.js");
  const geo = new PLYLoader().parse(buf);
  const posAttr = geo.getAttribute("position");
  if (!posAttr || posAttr.count < 10) {
    // Fallback: mesh import
    await importFiles([file]);
    return;
  }

  const maxPoints = 1_500_000;
  const total = posAttr.count;
  const step = total > maxPoints ? Math.ceil(total / maxPoints) : 1;
  const positions: number[] = [];
  const colors: number[] = [];
  const colAttr = geo.getAttribute("color");

  for (let i = 0; i < total; i += step) {
    positions.push(posAttr.getX(i), posAttr.getY(i), posAttr.getZ(i));
    if (colAttr) {
      colors.push(colAttr.getX(i), colAttr.getY(i), colAttr.getZ(i));
    } else {
      colors.push(0.55, 0.62, 0.72);
    }
  }

  await addPointsToScene(file.name, positions, colors, total > 500_000 ? 0.03 : 0.05);
}

/** Topography / mesh site model. */
export function linkTopography() {
  pickAccept(".obj,.stl,.ply,.glb,.gltf,.tif,.tiff,.png", true, async (files) => {
    const file = files[0];
    const ext = (file.name.split(".").pop() ?? "").toLowerCase();
    if (["tif", "tiff", "png"].includes(ext)) {
      alert(
        "Raster DEM / contour images:\n" +
        "Convert to mesh (OBJ/STL) in Civil 3D, QGIS or Blender, then link again.\n\n" +
        "For 2D site plans use Link CAD with DXF/PNG in Plan view.",
      );
      return;
    }
    await importFiles(files);
    toast(`Topography / site mesh linked: ${file.name}`, "success");
  });
}
```

```ts
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let installed = false;
let enabled = true;
let timer: number | null = null;

// openbim-fix:lod-always-on -- LOD culling is permanently disabled.
// Every element stays visible regardless of distance or screen size.
// The flag is a constant so no runtime toggle can re-enable culling.
// The reported state stays ON to keep the toolbar button label stable.
const LOD_CULLING_DISABLED = true;

function c(): Any {
  return (ctx as Any) || (window as Any).__OBS_CTX__ || {};
}

function getAuthoringGroup(): Any | null {
  const cont = c();
  const auth = cont.features?.authoring as Any;

  return (
    auth?.getAuthoredGroup?.() ??
    auth?.group ??
    auth?.root ??
    auth?.three ??
    null
  );
}

function restoreAll(): void {
  const group = getAuthoringGroup();

  if (!group || typeof group.traverse !== "function") {
    return;
  }

  group.traverse((obj: Any) => {
    if (obj?.userData?.__obsLodHidden) {
      obj.visible = true;
      delete obj.userData.__obsLodHidden;
    }
  });
}

function applyLod(): void {
  if (!installed) {
    return;
  }

  // openbim-fix:lod-always-on -- never hide geometry.
  if (LOD_CULLING_DISABLED || !enabled) {
    restoreAll();
    return;
  }

  const cont = c();
  const cam = cont.world?.camera?.three as Any;
  const group = getAuthoringGroup();

  if (!cam || !group || typeof group.traverse !== "function") {
    return;
  }

  try {
    group.updateMatrixWorld?.(true);
    cam.updateMatrixWorld?.(true);
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }

  const cameraPos = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(cam.matrixWorld);

  group.traverse((obj: Any) => {
    if (!obj?.isMesh || !obj.geometry) {
      return;
    }

    const geo = obj.geometry;

    if (!geo.boundingSphere) {
      try {
        geo.computeBoundingSphere();
      } catch {
        return;
      }
    }

    const sphere = geo.boundingSphere;

    if (!sphere || !Number.isFinite(sphere.radius) || sphere.radius <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    const center = new THREE.Vector3().copy(sphere.center).applyMatrix4(obj.matrixWorld);
    const radius = sphere.radius * Math.max(
      obj.matrixWorld.elements[0] ?? 1,
      obj.matrixWorld.elements[5] ?? 1,
      obj.matrixWorld.elements[10] ?? 1,
    );

    const dist = cameraPos.distanceTo(center);

    let hide = false;

    if (radius < 0.15 && dist > 30) {
      hide = true;
    } else if (radius < 0.6 && dist > 90) {
      hide = true;
    } else if (radius < 2 && dist > 250) {
      hide = true;
    }

    if (hide) {
      if (obj.visible) {
        obj.visible = false;
        obj.userData.__obsLodHidden = true;
      }
    } else if (obj.userData?.__obsLodHidden) {
      obj.visible = true;
      delete obj.userData.__obsLodHidden;
    }
  });
}

export function setLodEnabled(next: boolean): boolean {
  // openbim-fix:lod-always-on -- the toggle is a no-op. Culling is
  // permanently disabled so every detail stays visible.
  void next;
  enabled = true;
  restoreAll();
  return true;
}

export function isLodEnabled(): boolean {
  // openbim-fix:lod-always-on -- always report ON so the toolbar
  // button label never flips. Culling itself is skipped by
  // LOD_CULLING_DISABLED inside applyLod().
  return true;
}

export function setupLodManager(): void {
  if (installed) {
    return;
  }

  installed = true;

  timer = window.setInterval(applyLod, 250);

  (window as Any).__obsLodManager = {
    setEnabled: setLodEnabled,
    isEnabled: isLodEnabled,
    refresh: applyLod,
    restoreAll,
  };

  console.log("[lod-manager] ready");
}
```

```ts
import * as THREE from "three";
import * as OBC from "@thatopen/components";
import * as FRAGS from "@thatopen/fragments";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { isDrawingActive } from "./drawing";
import { setSectionOn } from "./section";

let measureCheckboxEl: any = null;
export function setMeasureCheckboxRef(el: any) { measureCheckboxEl = el; }
export function isMeasureEnabled() { return ctx.lengthMeasurer.enabled; }

const measureLabelLayer = document.createElement("div");
measureLabelLayer.style.cssText = "position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;z-index:20";

type MLabel = { el: HTMLDivElement; pos: THREE.Vector3 };
const measureLabels: MLabel[] = [];
const xyzGroup = new THREE.Group();
let pendingMeasurePts: THREE.Vector3[] = [];

function clearMeasureLabels() { for (const l of measureLabels) l.el.remove(); measureLabels.length = 0; }

function addMeasureLabel(text: string, pos: THREE.Vector3) {
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.textContent = text;
  el.style.cssText = `position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:#0284c7;color:#fff;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;font:600 12px system-ui,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45);border:1px solid #38bdf8;`;
  measureLabelLayer.appendChild(el);
  measureLabels.push({ el, pos: pos.clone() });
  updateMeasureLabels();
}

function updateMeasureLabels() {
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  const w = ctx.rightHost.clientWidth, h = ctx.rightHost.clientHeight;
  for (const { el, pos } of measureLabels) {
    const v = pos.clone().project(cam);
    if (v.z > 1 || v.z < -1) { el.style.display = "none"; continue; }
    el.style.display = "block";
    el.style.left = `${(v.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * w}px`;
    el.style.top = `${(-v.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * h}px`;
  }
}

export function setMeasureEnabled(on: boolean) {
  ctx.lengthMeasurer.enabled = on;
  ctx.lengthMeasurer.visible = true;
  ctx.highlighter.enabled = !on;
  if (on) setSectionOn(false);
  // Hide the floating label layer when the tool is off. The underlying
  // dimensions remain in the OBC measurer -- re-enabling restores them.
  try { measureLabelLayer.style.display = on ? "block" : "none"; } catch { /* */ }
  const el = measureCheckboxEl ?? ctx.leftHost.querySelector("bim-checkbox[data-measure]");
  if (el) el.checked = on;
}

export function toggleMeasure() { setMeasureEnabled(!ctx.lengthMeasurer.enabled); }

export function clearMeasurements() {
  try {
    const list = (ctx.lengthMeasurer as any).list;
    if (list?.clear) list.clear();
    else if (typeof (ctx.lengthMeasurer as any).deleteAll === "function") (ctx.lengthMeasurer as any).deleteAll();
  } catch (e) { console.warn("clear measurements", e); }
  clearXyzGraphics();
}

function clearXyzGraphics() {
  while (xyzGroup.children.length) {
    const ch = xyzGroup.children[0] as any;
    xyzGroup.remove(ch);
    ch.geometry?.dispose?.();
    if (Array.isArray(ch.material)) ch.material.forEach((m: any) => m.dispose?.());
    else ch.material?.dispose?.();
  }
  clearMeasureLabels();
  pendingMeasurePts = [];
}

function line3(a: THREE.Vector3, b: THREE.Vector3, color: number) {
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([a.clone(), b.clone()]);
  const l = new THREE.Line(g, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color, depthTest: false, transparent: true }));
  l.renderOrder = 1000;
  return l;
}

function ball(p: THREE.Vector3, color: number) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.04, 12, 12), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, depthTest: false }));
  m.position.copy(p); m.renderOrder = 1001;
  return m;
}

function drawXyzDimension(a: THREE.Vector3, b: THREE.Vector3) {
  clearXyzGraphics(); clearMeasureLabels();
  const dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y, dz = b.z - a.z;
  const pX = new THREE.Vector3(b.x, a.y, a.z), pXY = new THREE.Vector3(b.x, b.y, a.z);
  if (Math.abs(dx) > 1e-6) { xyzGroup.add(line3(a, pX, 0xef4444)); addMeasureLabel(`X ${(Math.abs(dx) * 1000).toFixed(1)} mm`, a.clone().lerp(pX, 0.5)); }
  if (Math.abs(dy) > 1e-6) { xyzGroup.add(line3(pX, pXY, 0x22c55e)); addMeasureLabel(`Y ${(Math.abs(dy) * 1000).toFixed(1)} mm`, pX.clone().lerp(pXY, 0.5)); }
  if (Math.abs(dz) > 1e-6) { xyzGroup.add(line3(pXY, b, 0x3b82f6)); addMeasureLabel(`Z ${(Math.abs(dz) * 1000).toFixed(1)} mm`, pXY.clone().lerp(b, 0.5)); }
  xyzGroup.add(line3(a, b, 0x38bdf8));
  addMeasureLabel(`${(a.distanceTo(b) * 1000).toFixed(1)} mm`, a.clone().lerp(b, 0.5));
  xyzGroup.add(ball(a, 0xffffff)); xyzGroup.add(ball(b, 0xffffff));
}

// ── Setup ──
export function setupMeasure() {
  const lm = ctx.lengthMeasurer;
  lm.world = ctx.world;
  lm.color = new THREE.Color("#38bdf8");
  lm.enabled = false;
  lm.visible = true;
  try { lm.units = "mm"; } catch { /* */ }
  try { (lm as any).snappings = [FRAGS.SnappingClass.POINT, FRAGS.SnappingClass.LINE]; } catch { /* */ }

  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(measureLabelLayer);
  ctx.world.scene.three.add(xyzGroup);
  ctx.world.camera.controls.addEventListener("update", () => updateMeasureLabels());

  try {
    (lm.list as any).onItemSet.add(async ({ value: dim }: any) => {
      try {
        let val: number | null = null;
        if (typeof dim?.getValue === "function") val = await dim.getValue();
        else if (typeof dim?.value === "number") val = dim.value;
        else if (typeof dim?.rawValue === "number") val = dim.rawValue;

        let mid = new THREE.Vector3();
        const line = dim?.line ?? dim?.three ?? dim?.mesh;
        if (dim?.start && dim?.end) mid.copy(dim.start).add(dim.end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
        else if (line?.geometry?.attributes?.position) {
          const p = line.geometry.attributes.position;
          const a = new THREE.Vector3().fromBufferAttribute(p, 0);
          const b = new THREE.Vector3().fromBufferAttribute(p, p.count - 1);
          mid.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
        }

        if (val != null && Number.isFinite(val)) {
          const units = (lm as any).units || "m";
          let display = val, suffix = units;
          if (units === "mm" && Math.abs(val) < 50) { display = val * 1000; suffix = "mm"; }
          addMeasureLabel(`${display.toFixed(1)} ${suffix}`, mid);
        }
      } catch (err) { console.warn("[measure] label failed", err); }
    });
  } catch { /* */ }

  ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("dblclick", async () => {
    if (isDrawingActive() || !ctx.lengthMeasurer.enabled) return;
    try { ctx.lengthMeasurer.create(); } catch { /* */ }
    try {
      const caster = ctx.components.get(OBC.Raycasters).get(ctx.world);
      const result: any = await caster.castRay({
        snappingClasses: [FRAGS.SnappingClass.POINT, FRAGS.SnappingClass.LINE],
      });
      if (result?.point) {
        const pt = (result.point as THREE.Vector3).clone();
        pendingMeasurePts.push(pt);
        xyzGroup.add(ball(pt, 0x22d3ee));
        if (pendingMeasurePts.length >= 2) { drawXyzDimension(pendingMeasurePts[0], pendingMeasurePts[1]); pendingMeasurePts = []; }
      }
    } catch (err) { console.warn("[measure] castRay error", err); }
  });

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (!ctx.lengthMeasurer.enabled) return;
    if (e.code === "Enter" || e.code === "NumpadEnter") { try { (ctx.lengthMeasurer as any).endCreation?.(); } catch { /* */ } }
    if (e.code === "Escape") { try { (ctx.lengthMeasurer as any).cancelCreation?.(); } catch { /* */ } }
  });

  ctx.features.measure = { isEnabled: isMeasureEnabled, toggle: toggleMeasure, clear: clearMeasurements };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * MEP category coloring — pairs fittings with the segments they belong to.
 *
 * Two paths:
 *   1. Linked IFC models — matched by IFC category prefix.
 *   2. Authored elements — matched by their authored type, with fittings
 *      inheriting their parent's group.
 *
 * Called from the ribbon's MEP colors button. State is not persisted; the
 * color scheme resets on reload, which matches the "visual inspection" use.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import type * as OBC from "@thatopen/components";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

const STYLE_PREFIX = "mep-color-";

interface MepGroup {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  prefixes: string[];
  color: number;
}

const GROUPS: MepGroup[] = [
  {
    id: "supply-air",
    label: "Ductwork",
    prefixes: ["IFCDUCTSEGMENT", "IFCDUCTFITTING", "IFCDUCTSILENCER", "IFCAIRTERMINAL", "IFCAIRTERMINALBOX"],
    color: 0x38bdf8,
  },
  {
    id: "water",
    label: "Piping",
    prefixes: ["IFCPIPESEGMENT", "IFCPIPEFITTING", "IFCPIPESILENCER", "IFCVALVE", "IFCPUMP", "IFCTANK"],
    color: 0xef4444,
  },
  {
    id: "cable",
    label: "Cable tray & conduit",
    prefixes: ["IFCCABLECARRIERSEGMENT", "IFCCABLECARRIERFITTING", "IFCCONDUITSEGMENT", "IFCCONDUITFITTING", "IFCCABLESEGMENT"],
    color: 0xf59e0b,
  },
  {
    id: "fire",
    label: "Fire protection",
    prefixes: ["IFCFIRESUPPRESSIONTERMINAL", "IFCSPRINKLER"],
    color: 0xf43f5e,
  },
  {
    id: "equipment",
    label: "Equipment",
    prefixes: ["IFCFLOWMOVINGDEVICE", "IFCFLOWSTORAGEDEVICE", "IFCENERGYCONVERSIONDEVICE", "IFCUNITARYEQUIPMENT", "IFCFLOWTREATMENTDEVICE"],
    color: 0xa855f7,
  },
];

function matches(cat: string, prefixes: string[]): boolean {
  const c = cat.toUpperCase();
  for (const p of prefixes) if (c.startsWith(p.toUpperCase())) return true;
  return false;
}

/** Authored element type → MEP group id. Fittings inherit their parent. */
const AUTHORED_TYPE_GROUP: Record<string, string> = {
  duct: "supply-air",
  pipe: "water",
  "cable-tray": "cable",
  conduit: "cable",
  equipment: "equipment",
};

let applied = false;

/** Apply one color per MEP group. */
export async function applyMepColors(): Promise<void> {
  if (!ctx.highlighter) {
    console.warn("[mep] highlighter not available");
    return;
  }

  await clearMepColors();

  let totalApplied = 0;

  // ── 1. Linked IFC models — matched by IFC category prefix ──
  for (const g of GROUPS) {
    ctx.highlighter.styles.set(`${STYLE_PREFIX}${g.id}`, {
      color: new THREE.Color(g.color),
      opacity: 1,
      transparent: false,
      renderedFaces: 3,
    } as any);

    const map: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};

    for (const [modelId, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
      let cats: Record<string, number[]>;
      try {
        cats = await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`[mep] categories failed for ${modelId}`, err);
        continue;
      }
      const ids: number[] = [];
      for (const [cat, list] of Object.entries(cats ?? {})) {
        if (!matches(cat, g.prefixes)) continue;
        for (const id of (list as number[]) ?? []) ids.push(id);
      }
      if (ids.length) map[modelId] = new Set(ids);
    }

    const count = Object.values(map).reduce((a, s) => a + s.size, 0);
    if (!count) continue;

    try {
      await ctx.highlighter.highlightByID(
        `${STYLE_PREFIX}${g.id}`,
        map as unknown as OBC.ModelIdMap,
        true,
      );
      totalApplied += count;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[mep] highlight failed for ${g.id}`, err);
    }
  }

  // ── 2. Authored elements — matched by authored type ──
  try {
    const mod = await import("./authoring");
    const authored = mod.getElements();

    for (const g of GROUPS) {
      const matchingIds: string[] = [];
      for (const el of authored) {
        const effective = el.type === "fitting"
          ? ((el.params.parentType as string | undefined) ?? "")
          : el.type;
        if (AUTHORED_TYPE_GROUP[effective] === g.id) {
          matchingIds.push(el.id);
        }
      }
      if (!matchingIds.length) continue;
      const color = "#" + new THREE.Color(g.color).getHexString();
      mod.transformElements(matchingIds, (el) => {
        el.color = color;
      });
      totalApplied += matchingIds.length;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[mep] authored coloring failed", err);
  }

  applied = true;
  console.log(`[mep] colored ${totalApplied} element(s) across ${GROUPS.length} group(s)`);
}

/** Remove every MEP style and clear its highlights. */
export async function clearMepColors(): Promise<void> {
  if (!ctx.highlighter) return;
  for (const g of GROUPS) {
    const name = `${STYLE_PREFIX}${g.id}`;
    try {
      await (ctx.highlighter as any).clear(name);
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    try {
      ctx.highlighter.styles.delete(name);
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }
  applied = false;
}

export function isMepColoringActive(): boolean {
  return applied;
}

export async function toggleMepColors(): Promise<void> {
  if (applied) await clearMepColors();
  else await applyMepColors();
}

export function setupMepColoring(): void {
  ctx.fragments.list.onItemSet.add(() => {
    if (!applied) return;
    setTimeout(() => {
      void applyMepColors();
    }, 500);
  });

  (ctx.features as any).mepColoring = {
    apply: applyMepColors,
    clear: clearMepColors,
    toggle: toggleMepColors,
    isActive: isMepColoringActive,
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * MEP Fabrication Parts â€” catalog browser for placing prefabricated parts.
 *
 * Groups parts by system. Clicking a part activates the corresponding
 * authoring tool (duct-fitting, pipe-fitting, etc.) so the user can place
 * it in the viewport.
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { setAuthoringTool } from "./authoring";

interface FabPart {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  system: "duct" | "pipe" | "tray" | "conduit";
  kind: string;
  dimensions: string;
}

const PARTS: FabPart[] = [
  // Duct
  { id: "duct-elbow-90",   label: "90\u00B0 Elbow",         system: "duct",    kind: "elbow",      dimensions: "\u00D8 300\u2013600" },
  { id: "duct-elbow-45",   label: "45\u00B0 Elbow",         system: "duct",    kind: "elbow",      dimensions: "\u00D8 300\u2013600" },
  { id: "duct-tee",        label: "Tee",                    system: "duct",    kind: "tee",        dimensions: "\u00D8 300\u2013600" },
  { id: "duct-cross",      label: "Cross",                  system: "duct",    kind: "cross",      dimensions: "\u00D8 300\u2013600" },
  { id: "duct-reducer",    label: "Reducer",                system: "duct",    kind: "transition", dimensions: "various" },
  { id: "duct-cap",        label: "End Cap",                system: "duct",    kind: "cap",        dimensions: "\u00D8 300\u2013600" },
  { id: "duct-damper",     label: "Volume Damper",          system: "duct",    kind: "damper",     dimensions: "\u00D8 300\u2013600" },

  // Pipe
  { id: "pipe-elbow-90",   label: "90\u00B0 Elbow",         system: "pipe",    kind: "elbow",      dimensions: "DN 15\u2013200" },
  { id: "pipe-elbow-45",   label: "45\u00B0 Elbow",         system: "pipe",    kind: "elbow",      dimensions: "DN 15\u2013200" },
  { id: "pipe-tee",        label: "Tee",                    system: "pipe",    kind: "tee",        dimensions: "DN 15\u2013200" },
  { id: "pipe-cross",      label: "Cross",                  system: "pipe",    kind: "cross",      dimensions: "DN 15\u2013200" },
  { id: "pipe-reducer",    label: "Reducer",                system: "pipe",    kind: "transition", dimensions: "various" },
  { id: "pipe-valve",      label: "Gate Valve",             system: "pipe",    kind: "valve",      dimensions: "DN 15\u2013200" },
  { id: "pipe-union",      label: "Union",                  system: "pipe",    kind: "union",      dimensions: "DN 15\u2013200" },

  // Cable tray
  { id: "tray-elbow-90",   label: "90\u00B0 Elbow",         system: "tray",    kind: "elbow",      dimensions: "100\u2013600 mm" },
  { id: "tray-elbow-45",   label: "45\u00B0 Elbow",         system: "tray",    kind: "elbow",      dimensions: "100\u2013600 mm" },
  { id: "tray-tee",        label: "Tee",                    system: "tray",    kind: "tee",        dimensions: "100\u2013600 mm" },
  { id: "tray-cross",      label: "Cross",                  system: "tray",    kind: "cross",      dimensions: "100\u2013600 mm" },
  { id: "tray-reducer",    label: "Reducer",                system: "tray",    kind: "transition", dimensions: "various" },

  // Conduit
  { id: "cond-elbow-90",   label: "90\u00B0 Elbow",         system: "conduit", kind: "elbow",      dimensions: "\u00D8 20\u201350" },
  { id: "cond-coupling",   label: "Coupling",               system: "conduit", kind: "union",      dimensions: "\u00D8 20\u201350" },
  { id: "cond-junction",   label: "Junction Box",           system: "conduit", kind: "tee",        dimensions: "\u00D8 20\u201350" },
];

const SYSTEM_LABELS: Record<FabPart["system"], { label: string; color: string }> = {
  duct:    { label: "Ductwork",   color: "#38bdf8" },
  pipe:    { label: "Piping",     color: "#22c55e" },
  tray:    { label: "Cable Tray", color: "#f59e0b" },
  conduit: { label: "Conduit",    color: "#a855f7" },
};

let panel: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let visible = false;

export function setupMepFabrication(): void {
  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = "obs-mep-fabrication";
  panel.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;left:16px;top:200px;width:320px;max-height:65vh;z-index:33;" +
    "display:none;flex-direction:column;background:#1a1d27;color:#e8eaf0;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.5);font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden";
  panel.onmousedown = (e) => e.stopPropagation();

  const header = document.createElement("div");
  header.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;padding:9px 12px;" +
    "border-bottom:1px solid #2a2e3a;background:#12141b;flex-shrink:0";
  header.innerHTML = "<div style='font-weight:700;flex:1'>\u2699 MEP Fabrication Parts</div>";

  const body = document.createElement("div");
  body.style.cssText = "flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px";

  const systems: FabPart["system"][] = ["duct", "pipe", "tray", "conduit"];
  for (const sysKey of systems) {
    const sysMeta = SYSTEM_LABELS[sysKey];
    const parts = PARTS.filter((p) => p.system === sysKey);
    if (!parts.length) continue;

    const headerRow = document.createElement("div");
    headerRow.style.cssText =
      "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 8px;margin-top:6px;" +
      "border-bottom:1px solid #242734;color:" + sysMeta.color + ";font-weight:700;font-size:11px";
    headerRow.innerHTML = "<span>\u25CF</span><span>" + sysMeta.label + "</span>";
    body.appendChild(headerRow);

    for (const part of parts) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.cssText =
        "display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:8px;padding:7px 9px;" +
        "background:#0e1017;border:1px solid #242734;border-radius:5px;" +
        "margin:3px 0;cursor:pointer;align-items:center";
      row.onmouseenter = () => { row.style.background = "#181a23"; row.style.borderColor = sysMeta.color; };
      row.onmouseleave = () => { row.style.background = "#0e1017"; row.style.borderColor = "#242734"; };
      row.onclick = () => placePart(part);

      const text = document.createElement("div");
      const name = document.createElement("div");
      name.textContent = part.label;
      name.style.cssText = "font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px";
      const dim = document.createElement("div");
      dim.textContent = part.dimensions;
      dim.style.cssText = "font-size:9.5px;color:#6b7280;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;margin-top:1px";
      text.append(name, dim);

      const btn = document.createElement("span");
      btn.textContent = "+";
      btn.style.cssText =
        "width:22px;height:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;" +
        "border-radius:4px;background:" + sysMeta.color + "22;color:" + sysMeta.color +
        ";border:1px solid " + sysMeta.color + "66;font-weight:700";

      row.append(text, btn);
      body.appendChild(row);
    }
  }

  panel.append(header, body);
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);

  (ctx.features as any).mepFabrication = {
    show: () => { visible = true; if (panel) panel.style.display = "flex"; },
    hide: () => { visible = false; if (panel) panel.style.display = "none"; },
    toggle: () => { visible ? (ctx.features as any).mepFabrication.hide() : (ctx.features as any).mepFabrication.show(); },
    isVisible: () => visible,
  };
}

function placePart(part: FabPart): void {
  const toolMap: Record<FabPart["system"], string> = {
    duct: "duct-fitting",
    pipe: "pipe-fitting",
    tray: "cable-tray-fitting",
    conduit: "conduit-fitting",
  };
  const tool = toolMap[part.system];
  setAuthoringTool(tool);
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
    detail: { message: part.label + " \u2014 click in the viewport to place", kind: "success" },
  }));
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Model Alignment panel.
 *
 * Shows every loaded model with its current offset and visible bbox center,
 * and gives one-click access to:
 *   • Apply a positioning mode to all models
 *   • Snap any model to a chosen reference model
 *   • Nudge any model in X/Y/Z with a configurable step
 *   • Reset any model to (0,0,0)
 *
 * Everything is live — changes reflect immediately in the viewport and can
 * be saved with Ctrl+S.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  POSITIONING_MODES,
  applyPositioningMode,
  getPositioningMode,
  setPositioningMode,
  setModelOffset,
  getModelOffset,
  getModelBBoxCenter,
  onOffsetsChanged,
  type PositioningMode,
} from "./importer";

const PANEL_ID = "obs-model-align";

let panel: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let currentMode: PositioningMode = getPositioningMode();
let referenceId: string | null = null;
let nudgeStep = 1.0;
let refreshTimer: number | null = null;

function fmt(n: number, digits = 3): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return "—";
  const s = n.toFixed(digits);
  return s === "-0.000" ? "0.000" : s;
}

function fmtVec(v: [number, number, number] | null): string {
  if (!v) return "—";
  return `(${fmt(v[0])}, ${fmt(v[1])}, ${fmt(v[2])})`;
}

function ensurePanel(): HTMLDivElement {
  if (panel) return panel;

  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = PANEL_ID;
  panel.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;left:40px;top:120px;width:520px;max-height:80vh;" +
    "display:none;flex-direction:column;" +
    "background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:12px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.65);" +
    "font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);" +
    "overflow:hidden;z-index:8000";
  panel.onmousedown = (e) => e.stopPropagation();

  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div id="oma-header" style="
      display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;
      border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);
      background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);cursor:move;user-select:none">
      <span style="display:flex;color:var(--accent,#38bdf8);font-size:14px">⛓</span>
      <div style="flex:1;font-weight:700;font-size:13px">Model Alignment</div>
      <button id="oma-close" title="Close" style="
        padding:4px 8px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5);
        border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:5px;
        cursor:pointer;font-size:11px">✕</button>
    </div>

    <div style="padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)">
      <div style="font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;
        color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:6px">Positioning mode</div>
      <select id="oma-mode" style="
        width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:6px 8px;
        background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);
        border-radius:5px;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:12px system-ui;cursor:pointer">
      </select>
      <div id="oma-mode-desc" style="font-size:10.5px;color:#94a3b8;
        margin-top:6px;line-height:1.5;padding:6px 8px;
        background:#0e1017;border:1px solid #1e2029;border-radius:4px"></div>
      <button id="oma-apply" style="margin-top:8px;width:100%;padding:8px;
        background:var(--accent,#38bdf8);color:#0b0d12;border:none;
        border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:600 11.5px system-ui">
        Apply mode to all models</button>
    </div>

    <div style="padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)">
      <div style="font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;
        color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:6px">Nudge step</div>
      <div id="oma-steps" style="display:flex;gap:4px"></div>
    </div>

    <div id="oma-body" style="flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px"></div>

    <div style="padding:10px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);
      background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);display:flex;gap:8px">
      <button id="oma-save" style="flex:1;padding:8px;
        background:var(--accent,#38bdf8);color:#0b0d12;border:none;
        border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:600 11.5px system-ui">
        💾 Save project</button>
      <button id="oma-fit" style="padding:8px 14px;background:var(--bg-hover,#232633);
        color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);
        border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:600 11.5px system-ui">⛶ Fit all</button>
    </div>
  `;

  document.body.appendChild(panel);

  // Populate the mode dropdown.
  const modeSelect = panel.querySelector("#oma-mode") as HTMLSelectElement;
  modeSelect.innerHTML = POSITIONING_MODES
    .map((m) => `<option value="${m.id}">${m.label}</option>`)
    .join("");
  modeSelect.value = currentMode;
  modeSelect.onchange = () => {
    currentMode = modeSelect.value as PositioningMode;
    updateModeDescription();
  };

  // Steps buttons
  const stepsBar = panel.querySelector("#oma-steps") as HTMLElement;
  for (const s of [0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100]) {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.textContent = s >= 1 ? `${s} m` : `${s * 1000} mm`;
    b.style.cssText =
      "flex:1;padding:5px 4px;font:500 10.5px system-ui;" +
      "background:var(--bg-hover,#232633);color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5);" +
      "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer";
    b.dataset.step = String(s);
    if (s === nudgeStep) {
      b.style.background = "var(--accent-dim,rgba(56,189,248,.14))";
      b.style.color = "var(--accent,#38bdf8)";
      b.style.borderColor = "var(--accent,#38bdf8)";
    }
    b.onclick = () => {
      nudgeStep = s;
      stepsBar.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((x: any) => {
        x.style.background = "var(--bg-hover,#232633)";
        x.style.color = "var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5)";
        x.style.borderColor = "var(--border-default,#2a2e3a)";
      });
      b.style.background = "var(--accent-dim,rgba(56,189,248,.14))";
      b.style.color = "var(--accent,#38bdf8)";
      b.style.borderColor = "var(--accent,#38bdf8)";
    };
    stepsBar.appendChild(b);
  }

  (panel.querySelector("#oma-close") as HTMLElement).onclick = () => closeAlign();
  (panel.querySelector("#oma-apply") as HTMLElement).onclick = async () => {
    setPositioningMode(currentMode);
    await applyPositioningMode(currentMode);
    void refreshBody();
  };
  (panel.querySelector("#oma-save") as HTMLElement).onclick = () => {
    const save = (ctx.features as any).projects?.saveProject;
    if (typeof save === "function") void save();
  };
  (panel.querySelector("#oma-fit") as HTMLElement).onclick = () => {
    const fit = (ctx.features as any).cameraTools?.fitAll;
    if (typeof fit === "function") fit();
    else void import("./camera-tools").then((m) => m.fitAll());
  };

  // Draggable header.
  const header = panel.querySelector("#oma-header") as HTMLElement;
  let dragging = false;
  let off = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  header.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).id === "oma-close") return;
    dragging = true;
    const r = panel!.getBoundingClientRect();
    off = { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
    (e.target as Element).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  header.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    panel!.style.left = `${Math.max(0, e.clientX - off.x)}px`;
    panel!.style.top = `${Math.max(0, e.clientY - off.y)}px`;
  });
  header.addEventListener("pointerup", (e) => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    dragging = false;
    (e.target as Element).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });

  updateModeDescription();
  return panel;
}

function updateModeDescription(): void {
  const el = panel?.querySelector("#oma-mode-desc") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!el) return;
  const info = POSITIONING_MODES.find((m) => m.id === currentMode);
  el.textContent = info?.description ?? "";
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Body rendering
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
async function refreshBody(): Promise<void> {
  if (!panel) return;
  const body = panel.querySelector("#oma-body") as HTMLElement;
  if (!body) return;

  const ids = Array.from(ctx.fragments.list.keys());
  if (!ids.length) {
    body.innerHTML =
      `<div style="padding:24px 12px;text-align:center;color:#6b7280;font-size:11.5px">
         No models loaded.<br>Load .frag or .ifc files first.
       </div>`;
    return;
  }

  // Pick a sensible default reference (first model).
  if (!referenceId || !ids.includes(referenceId)) referenceId = ids[0];

  const rows: string[] = [];
  for (const id of ids) {
    const offset = getModelOffset(id) ?? [0, 0, 0];
    const center = await getModelBBoxCenter(id);
    const isRef = id === referenceId;

    rows.push(`
      <div data-id="${id}" style="
        display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:10px;
        border:1px solid ${isRef ? "var(--accent,#38bdf8)" : "var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)"};
        border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px;
        background:${isRef ? "var(--accent-dim,rgba(56,189,248,.08))" : "var(--bg-inset,#0e1017)"}">

        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
          <input type="radio" name="oma-ref" value="${id}" ${isRef ? "checked" : ""}
            title="Use as reference model"
            style="cursor:pointer;margin:0" data-act="set-ref" />
          <div style="flex:1;min-width:0">
            <div style="font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;
              white-space:nowrap" title="${id}">
              ${id}${isRef ? ` <span style="font-size:9px;opacity:.6;font-weight:400">(reference)</span>` : ""}
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:10px;color:#94a3b8;margin-top:2px;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace)">
              offset ${fmtVec(offset)}
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:10px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:1px;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace)">
              bbox center ${fmtVec(center)}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px">
            <button data-act="snap" data-id="${id}" title="Snap this model to the reference"
              style="padding:4px 8px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;
              border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font:600 10px system-ui">Snap →</button>
            <button data-act="reset" data-id="${id}" title="Set offset to (0,0,0)"
              style="padding:4px 8px;background:transparent;color:#fca5a5;
              border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.5);border-radius:4px;
              cursor:pointer;font:600 10px system-ui">Reset</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap">
          <button data-act="nudge" data-id="${id}" data-axis="x" data-dir="-1"
            style="flex:1;padding:4px;background:var(--bg-hover,#232633);color:#fca5a5;
            border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.4);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font:600 10px system-ui">−X</button>
          <button data-act="nudge" data-id="${id}" data-axis="x" data-dir="1"
            style="flex:1;padding:4px;background:var(--bg-hover,#232633);color:#ef4444;
            border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.4);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font:600 10px system-ui">+X</button>
          <button data-act="nudge" data-id="${id}" data-axis="y" data-dir="-1"
            style="flex:1;padding:4px;background:var(--bg-hover,#232633);color:#a7f3d0;
            border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.4);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font:600 10px system-ui">−Y</button>
          <button data-act="nudge" data-id="${id}" data-axis="y" data-dir="1"
            style="flex:1;padding:4px;background:var(--bg-hover,#232633);color:#22c55e;
            border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.4);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font:600 10px system-ui">+Y</button>
          <button data-act="nudge" data-id="${id}" data-axis="z" data-dir="-1"
            style="flex:1;padding:4px;background:var(--bg-hover,#232633);color:#93c5fd;
            border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.4);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font:600 10px system-ui">−Z</button>
          <button data-act="nudge" data-id="${id}" data-axis="z" data-dir="1"
            style="flex:1;padding:4px;background:var(--bg-hover,#232633);color:#3b82f6;
            border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.4);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font:600 10px system-ui">+Z</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `);
  }

  body.innerHTML = rows.join("");

  // Wire events.
  body.querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement>('input[name="oma-ref"]').forEach((el) => {
    el.onchange = () => {
      referenceId = el.value;
      void refreshBody();
    };
  });

  body.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button[data-act]').forEach((btn) => {
    const act = btn.dataset.act!;
    const id = btn.dataset.id!;
    if (act === "snap") {
      btn.onclick = async () => { await snapToReference(id); };
    } else if (act === "reset") {
      btn.onclick = () => { setModelOffset(id, [0, 0, 0]); void refreshBody(); };
    } else if (act === "nudge") {
      const axis = btn.dataset.axis as "x" | "y" | "z";
      const dir = Number(btn.dataset.dir);
      btn.onclick = () => {
        const cur = getModelOffset(id) ?? [0, 0, 0];
        const next: [number, number, number] = [cur[0], cur[1], cur[2]];
        const i = axis === "x" ? 0 : axis === "y" ? 1 : 2;
        next[i] += dir * nudgeStep;
        setModelOffset(id, next);
        void refreshBody();
      };
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Snap a model to the reference model by matching bbox centers.
 * Sets the model's offset so its visible bbox center coincides with the
 * reference's visible bbox center.
 */
async function snapToReference(modelId: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!referenceId || referenceId === modelId) return;
  const refCenter = await getModelBBoxCenter(referenceId);
  const thisCenter = await getModelBBoxCenter(modelId);
  if (!refCenter || !thisCenter) return;

  const cur = getModelOffset(modelId) ?? [0, 0, 0];
  const delta: [number, number, number] = [
    refCenter[0] - thisCenter[0],
    refCenter[1] - thisCenter[1],
    refCenter[2] - thisCenter[2],
  ];
  setModelOffset(modelId, [
    cur[0] + delta[0],
    cur[1] + delta[1],
    cur[2] + delta[2],
  ]);
  console.log(
    `[align] snapped "${modelId}" to "${referenceId}" by ` +
      `(${delta[0].toFixed(3)}, ${delta[1].toFixed(3)}, ${delta[2].toFixed(3)})`,
  );
  void refreshBody();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function isOpen(): boolean {
  return !!panel && panel.style.display === "flex";
}

export function openAlign(): void {
  ensurePanel();
  if (!panel) return;
  panel.style.display = "flex";
  void refreshBody();

  // Subscribe to offset changes so the panel stays in sync.
  if (refreshTimer == null) {
    refreshTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (!isOpen()) return;
      void refreshBody();
    }, 800);
  }
}

export function closeAlign(): void {
  if (panel) panel.style.display = "none";
  if (refreshTimer != null) {
    clearInterval(refreshTimer);
    refreshTimer = null;
  }
}

export function toggleAlign(): void {
  isOpen() ? closeAlign() : openAlign();
}

export function isAlignVisible(): boolean {
  return isOpen();
}

export function setupModelAlign(): void {
  ensurePanel();
  onOffsetsChanged(() => {
    if (isOpen()) void refreshBody();
  });
  console.log("[model-align] ready");
}
```
