--- FILE: src/features/model-health.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Model Health — BIM QA dashboard.
 *
 * Read-only audits over every loaded model, with clickable findings that
 * select and focus the offending element in the viewport.
 *
 * Audits:
 *   • Duplicate GlobalIds across the federation
 *   • Missing Name on IfcRoot subtypes
 *   • Elements with no property sets attached
 *   • Empty IfcPropertySingleValue (no NominalValue)
 *   • Sub-millimetre geometry (likely noise)
 *   • Very large elements (> 500 m on any axis)
 *   • Products with no ObjectPlacement (orphan heuristic)
 *
 * Every finding is clickable: click selects the element and fits the camera.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { makeDockable, type DockHandle } from "./dockable";
import { selection } from "./selection";
import { services, tryUse } from "../core/services";
import { notify } from "../core/notify";
import { getElementWorldBoxes } from "../modules/geometry/world-box";

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Types
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

type Severity = "error" | "warning" | "info";

interface Finding {
  id: string;
  audit: string;
  severity: Severity;
  message: string;
  modelId: string;
  localId?: number;
  elementName?: string;
  elementCategory?: string;
  detail?: string;
}

interface AuditResult {
  name: string;
  severity: Severity;
  findings: Finding[];
  durationMs: number;
}

interface AuditContext {
  modelId: string;
  model: any;
  ids: number[];
  data: any[];
  idToCat: Map<number, string>;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Constants
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const SEV_COLOR: Record<Severity, string> = {
  error: "#ef4444",
  warning: "#f59e0b",
  info: "#38bdf8",
};

const MIN_DIM_METERS = 0.001; // 1 mm
const MAX_DIM_METERS = 500;   // 500 m

/** Categories we skip when auditing "missing psets" — they legitimately
 *  carry no property sets and are noise in the QA report. */
const PSetSilentCategories = new RegExp(
  "^IFC(" +
  "CARTESIAN|DIRECTION|PLACEMENT|POINT|VECTOR|POLYLINE|" +
  "SHAPE|REPRESENTATION|STYLE|COLOUR|AXIS|LOCAL|" +
  "GEOMETRIC|CURVE|SURFACE|SOLID|FACE|EDGE|VERTEX|" +
  "POLY|TRIANGULATED|INDEXED|BOUNDING|CONNECTED|CLOSED|OPEN" +
  ")",
);

/** Categories we treat as "products" when auditing orphan placement. */
const ProductCategory = new RegExp(
  "^IFC(" +
  "WALL|SLAB|DOOR|WINDOW|COLUMN|BEAM|MEMBER|FOOTING|PILE|" +
  "RAMP|RAILING|STAIR|ROOF|COVERING|CURTAINWALL|PLATE|" +
  "PIPE|DUCT|ELEMENTASSEMBLY|BUILDINGELEMENTPROXY|FURNITURE|" +
  "SPACE|FLOW|VALVE|PUMP|FAN|CHILLER|BOILER|TANK|" +
  "AIRTERMINAL|SANITARYTERMINAL|ELECTRIC|LIGHTING|OUTLET|" +
  "SWITCH|SENSOR|ALARM|CONTROLLER|ACTUATOR|PROTECTIVEDEVICE|" +
  "TRANSFORMER|MOTOR|GENERATOR|CONVEYOR|VEHICLE" +
  ")",
);

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Helpers
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

let findingSeq = 0;

function fid(prefix: string): string {
  findingSeq += 1;
  return `${prefix}-${findingSeq}`;
}

function esc(s: unknown): string {
  return String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as Record<string, string>)[c] ?? c,
  );
}

function catOf(ctxA: AuditContext, localId: number): string {
  return ctxA.idToCat.get(localId) ?? "";
}

function shortName(v: unknown): string {
  const s = String(v ?? "").trim();
  return s.length ? s : "";
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Individual audits
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function auditDuplicateGlobalId(all: AuditContext[]): Finding[] {
  interface Hit { modelId: string; localId: number; name: string; cat: string; }
  const map = new Map<string, Hit[]>();

  for (const a of all) {
    for (let i = 0; i < a.ids.length; i++) {
      const d = a.data[i] as any;
      const guid = d?.GlobalId?.value;
      if (!guid || typeof guid !== "string") continue;
      const arr = map.get(guid) ?? [];
      arr.push({
        modelId: a.modelId,
        localId: a.ids[i],
        name: shortName(d?.Name?.value) || `#${a.ids[i]}`,
        cat: catOf(a, a.ids[i]),
      });
      map.set(guid, arr);
    }
  }

  const out: Finding[] = [];
  for (const [guid, hits] of map) {
    if (hits.length < 2) continue;
    const summary = hits.map((h) => `${h.modelId}/${h.localId}`).join(", ");
    for (const h of hits) {
      out.push({
        id: fid("dup"),
        audit: "Duplicate GlobalId",
        severity: "error",
        message: `GlobalId ${guid} appears ${hits.length} times in the federation`,
        modelId: h.modelId,
        localId: h.localId,
        elementName: h.name,
        elementCategory: h.cat,
        detail: summary,
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function auditMissingName(a: AuditContext): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < a.ids.length; i++) {
    const d = a.data[i] as any;
    // Only flag when the attribute exists but is empty — we do not have
    // schema info here to know whether the entity even carries Name.
    if (d?.Name === undefined) continue;
    const name = d.Name?.value;
    if (name == null || String(name).trim() === "") {
      out.push({
        id: fid("noname"),
        audit: `Missing name · ${a.modelId}`,
        severity: "warning",
        message: "Element has an empty Name attribute",
        modelId: a.modelId,
        localId: a.ids[i],
        elementCategory: catOf(a, a.ids[i]),
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function auditMissingPsets(a: AuditContext): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < a.ids.length; i++) {
    const d = a.data[i] as any;
    const has = d?.psets && typeof d.psets === "object" && Object.keys(d.psets).length > 0;
    if (has) continue;

    const cat = catOf(a, a.ids[i]);
    if (PSetSilentCategories.test(cat.toUpperCase())) continue;

    out.push({
      id: fid("nopset"),
      audit: `No property sets · ${a.modelId}`,
      severity: "info",
      message: "Element has no property sets attached",
      modelId: a.modelId,
      localId: a.ids[i],
      elementCategory: cat,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

function auditEmptyPropertyValues(a: AuditContext): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < a.ids.length; i++) {
    const d = a.data[i] as any;
    if (!d?.psets || typeof d.psets !== "object") continue;

    for (const psetName of Object.keys(d.psets)) {
      const props = d.psets[psetName];
      if (!props || typeof props !== "object") continue;

      for (const key of Object.keys(props)) {
        const raw = (props as any)[key];
        const value = raw?.value;
        if (value == null || String(value).trim() === "") {
          out.push({
            id: fid("emptyprop"),
            audit: `Empty property values · ${a.modelId}`,
            severity: "info",
            message: `${psetName}.${key} is empty`,
            modelId: a.modelId,
            localId: a.ids[i],
            elementCategory: catOf(a, a.ids[i]),
            detail: psetName,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

async function auditGeometry(a: AuditContext): Promise<Finding[]> {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const CHUNK = 800;
  const size = new THREE.Vector3();

  for (let i = 0; i < a.ids.length; i += CHUNK) {
    const slice = a.ids.slice(i, i + CHUNK);

    let boxes: Array<{ id: number; box: THREE.Box3 }> = [];
    try {
      boxes = await getElementWorldBoxes(a.model, slice, a.modelId);
    } catch {
      continue;
    }

    for (const wb of boxes) {
      if (!wb?.box || wb.box.isEmpty()) continue;
      wb.box.getSize(size);
      const dx = size.x;
      const dy = size.y;
      const dz = size.z;

      if (dx < MIN_DIM_METERS && dy < MIN_DIM_METERS && dz < MIN_DIM_METERS) {
        out.push({
          id: fid("tiny"),
          audit: `Sub-millimetre geometry · ${a.modelId}`,
          severity: "info",
          message: "Bounding box is smaller than 1 mm on every axis",
          modelId: a.modelId,
          localId: wb.id,
          elementCategory: catOf(a, wb.id),
          detail:
            `${(dx * 1000).toFixed(2)} × ` +
            `${(dy * 1000).toFixed(2)} × ` +
            `${(dz * 1000).toFixed(2)} mm`,
        });
        continue;
      }

      if (dx > MAX_DIM_METERS || dy > MAX_DIM_METERS || dz > MAX_DIM_METERS) {
        out.push({
          id: fid("huge"),
          audit: `Very large element · ${a.modelId}`,
          severity: "warning",
          message: "Bounding box exceeds 500 m on at least one axis",
          modelId: a.modelId,
          localId: wb.id,
          elementCategory: catOf(a, wb.id),
          detail: `${dx.toFixed(1)} × ${dy.toFixed(1)} × ${dz.toFixed(1)} m`,
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function auditOrphanProducts(a: AuditContext): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < a.ids.length; i++) {
    const cat = catOf(a, a.ids[i]);
    if (!ProductCategory.test(cat.toUpperCase())) continue;

    const d = a.data[i] as any;
    const hasPlacement = d?.ObjectPlacement?.value != null;
    if (hasPlacement) continue;

    out.push({
      id: fid("orphan"),
      audit: `Orphan products · ${a.modelId}`,
      severity: "info",
      message: "Product has no ObjectPlacement (orphan heuristic)",
      modelId: a.modelId,
      localId: a.ids[i],
      elementCategory: cat,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Context gathering
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

async function gatherContexts(): Promise<AuditContext[]> {
  const out: AuditContext[] = [];

  for (const entry of ctx.fragments.list as unknown as Iterable<[string, any]>) {
    const [modelId, model] = entry;
    if (!model) continue;

    let ids: number[] = [];
    try {
      ids = ((await (model as any).getItemsIdsWithGeometry?.()) as number[]) ?? [];
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    if (!ids.length) continue;

    let data: any[] = [];
    try {
      data = await (model as any).getItemsData(ids, {
        attributesDefault: true,
        psetsDefault: false,
      });
    } catch {
      // Shape mismatch is fine — audits skip missing attributes.
    }

    let catMap: Record<string, number[]> = {};
    try {
      catMap = (await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/])) as Record<string, number[]>;
    } catch {
      // Category audit silently degrades to "unknown".
    }

    const idToCat = new Map<number, string>();
    for (const cat of Object.keys(catMap)) {
      const list = catMap[cat];
      if (!Array.isArray(list)) continue;
      for (const id of list) idToCat.set(id, cat);
    }

    out.push({ modelId, model, ids, data, idToCat });
  }

  return out;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Orchestrator
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

let running = false;

export async function runModelHealth(): Promise<AuditResult[]> {
  if (running) {
    // Calling twice in a row is a UI bug, not a runtime failure. Return
    // an empty result set so the caller's `await` resolves cleanly.
    return [];
  }
  running = true;
  findingSeq = 0;

  try {
    const contexts = await gatherContexts();
    if (!contexts.length) {
      notify("warn", "No models loaded — nothing to audit.");
      return [];
    }

    const results: AuditResult[] = [];

    const run = async (
      name: string,
      severity: Severity,
      fn: () => Promise<Finding[]> | Finding[],
    ): Promise<void> => {
      const t0 = performance.now();
      let findings: Finding[] = [];
      try {
        findings = await fn();
      } catch (err) {
        findings = [{
          id: fid("auditfail"),
          audit: name,
          severity: "error",
          message: `Audit failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`,
          modelId: "",
        }];
      }
      results.push({
        name,
        severity,
        findings,
        durationMs: performance.now() - t0,
      });
    };

    // Global audits first — they look across the federation.
    await run("Duplicate GlobalId", "error", () => auditDuplicateGlobalId(contexts));

    // Per-model audits.
    for (const a of contexts) {
      await run(`Missing name · ${a.modelId}`, "warning", () => auditMissingName(a));
      await run(`No property sets · ${a.modelId}`, "info", () => auditMissingPsets(a));
      await run(`Empty property values · ${a.modelId}`, "info", () => auditEmptyPropertyValues(a));
      await run(`Geometry · ${a.modelId}`, "warning", () => auditGeometry(a));
      await run(`Orphan products · ${a.modelId}`, "info", () => auditOrphanProducts(a));
    }

    return results;
  } finally {
    running = false;
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Panel — DOM
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const panel = document.createElement("div");
panel.id = "obs-model-health";

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Panel — state
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

let dock: DockHandle | null = null;
let visible = false;
let lastResults: AuditResult[] = [];
let activeSeverity: Severity | "all" = "all";

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Panel — rendering
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function renderIdle(): void {
  headerSummary.textContent = "idle";
  headerSummary.style.color = "var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)";

  body.innerHTML =
    `<div style="text-align:center;padding:30px;color:#6b7280;line-height:1.6">` +
    `<p style="margin:0 0 12px">Run a health check to audit the loaded federated models.</p>` +
    `<button data-act="run" style="padding:8px 16px;background:#22c55e;color:#0b0d12;` +
    `border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:600 12px system-ui">` +
    `▶ Run Model Health Check</button>` +
    `</div>`;

  body.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-act="run"]')?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    void run();
  });
}

function summarize(results: AuditResult[]): {
  total: number;
  bySeverity: Record<Severity, number>;
} {
  const bySeverity: Record<Severity, number> = { error: 0, warning: 0, info: 0 };
  let total = 0;
  for (const r of results) {
    for (const f of r.findings) {
      bySeverity[f.severity] += 1;
      total += 1;
    }
  }
  return { total, bySeverity };
}

function makeFilterButton(
  label: string,
  value: Severity | "all",
  active: boolean,
  onClick: () => void,
): HTMLButtonElement {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.textContent = label;
  b.dataset.sev = value;
  b.style.cssText =
    "padding:4px 10px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;" +
    (active
      ? "background:rgba(56,189,248,.14);color:#38bdf8;"
      : "background:transparent;color:#a0a6b5;");
  b.addEventListener("click", onClick);
  return b;
}

function renderFindingRow(f: Finding): HTMLElement {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.style.cssText =
    "display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:8px;" +
    "padding:6px 8px;margin-bottom:3px;align-items:center;" +
    "background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);" +
    "border-radius:5px;font-size:10.5px;" +
    (f.localId ? "cursor:pointer;" : "");

  if (f.localId) {
    row.addEventListener("click", () => {
      selection.replace({ [f.modelId]: new Set([f.localId!]) });
      void selection.applyToHighlighter();
      services.ready("camera").then((cam) => {
        void cam.fitToMap({ [f.modelId]: new Set([f.localId!]) } as any);
      }).catch(() => { /* camera service optional */ });
    });
  }

  // Severity badge
  const badge = document.createElement("span");
  badge.textContent = f.severity.toUpperCase();
  badge.style.cssText =
    `background:${SEV_COLOR[f.severity]};color:#0b0d12;` +
    `padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;font:700 9px ui-monospace,monospace;` +
    `flex:none`;
  row.appendChild(badge);

  // Message text
  const text = document.createElement("div");
  text.style.cssText = "min-width:0";

  const catPrefix = f.elementCategory ? `[${esc(f.elementCategory)}] ` : "";
  const namePrefix = f.elementName ? `${esc(f.elementName)} — ` : "";

  const primary = document.createElement("div");
  primary.innerHTML = `${catPrefix}${namePrefix}${esc(f.message)}`;
  text.appendChild(primary);

  if (f.detail) {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.textContent = f.detail;
    d.style.cssText = "color:#6b7280;font-size:9.5px;margin-top:2px";
    text.appendChild(d);
  }

  if (f.modelId) {
    const loc = document.createElement("div");
    loc.textContent = f.localId
      ? `${f.modelId} / #${f.localId}`
      : f.modelId;
    loc.style.cssText = "color:#6b7280;font-size:9px;margin-top:2px";
    text.appendChild(loc);
  }

  row.appendChild(text);

  // Trailing arrow (only when clickable)
  const arrow = document.createElement("span");
  arrow.textContent = f.localId ? "→" : "";
  arrow.style.cssText = "color:#6b7280;flex:none";
  row.appendChild(arrow);

  return row;
}

function renderFindings(): void {
  const container = document.getElementById("obs-health-findings");
  if (!container) return;
  container.innerHTML = "";

  // Collect + filter.
  const all: Finding[] = [];
  for (const r of lastResults) {
    for (const f of r.findings) {
      if (activeSeverity !== "all" && f.severity !== activeSeverity) continue;
      all.push(f);
    }
  }

  if (!all.length) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.style.cssText =
      "text-align:center;padding:20px;color:#6b7280;font-size:11px";
    empty.textContent = "No findings match this filter.";
    container.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }

  // Group by audit name (preserving the audit order from lastResults).
  const order: string[] = [];
  const byAudit = new Map<string, Finding[]>();
  for (const r of lastResults) {
    for (const f of r.findings) {
      if (activeSeverity !== "all" && f.severity !== activeSeverity) continue;
      if (!byAudit.has(r.name)) {
        byAudit.set(r.name, []);
        order.push(r.name);
      }
      byAudit.get(r.name)!.push(f);
    }
  }

  for (const auditName of order) {
    const items = byAudit.get(auditName) ?? [];
    if (!items.length) continue;

    const sec = document.createElement("section");
    sec.style.cssText = "margin-bottom:14px";

    const worst: Severity = items.some((f) => f.severity === "error")
      ? "error"
      : items.some((f) => f.severity === "warning")
        ? "warning"
        : "info";

    const h = document.createElement("div");
    h.style.cssText =
      "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;" +
      "font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px";
    h.innerHTML =
      `<span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;` +
      `background:${SEV_COLOR[worst]}"></span>` +
      `<span>${esc(auditName)}</span>` +
      `<span style="color:#6b7280;font-weight:400;font-size:10px">` +
      `(${items.length})</span>`;
    sec.appendChild(h);

    const shown = items.slice(0, 60);
    for (const f of shown) sec.appendChild(renderFindingRow(f));

    if (items.length > shown.length) {
      const more = document.createElement("div");
      more.textContent = `+ ${items.length - shown.length} more…`;
      more.style.cssText = "color:#6b7280;font-size:10px;padding:3px 8px";
      sec.appendChild(more);
    }

    container.appendChild(sec);
  }
}

function renderResults(): void {
  const summary = summarize(lastResults);
  headerSummary.textContent = `${summary.total} finding(s)`;
  headerSummary.style.color =
    summary.bySeverity.error > 0 ? "#ef4444"
    : summary.bySeverity.warning > 0 ? "#f59e0b"
    : "#38bdf8";

  body.innerHTML = "";

  // Toolbar
  const bar = document.createElement("div");
  bar.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center";

  const runBtn = document.createElement("button");
  runBtn.textContent = "↻ Re-run";
  runBtn.style.cssText =
    "padding:5px 12px;background:#22c55e;color:#0b0d12;border:none;" +
    "border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font:600 11px system-ui";
  runBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { void run(); });
  bar.appendChild(runBtn);

  const filterRow = document.createElement("div");
  filterRow.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap";

  const filters: Array<{ label: string; value: Severity | "all" }> = [
    { label: `All (${summary.total})`, value: "all" },
    { label: `Errors (${summary.bySeverity.error})`, value: "error" },
    { label: `Warnings (${summary.bySeverity.warning})`, value: "warning" },
    { label: `Info (${summary.bySeverity.info})`, value: "info" },
  ];

  for (const f of filters) {
    filterRow.appendChild(
      makeFilterButton(f.label, f.value, activeSeverity === f.value, () => {
        activeSeverity = f.value;
        renderResults();
      }),
    );
  }
  bar.appendChild(filterRow);
  body.appendChild(bar);

  // Findings container
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.id = "obs-health-findings";
  body.appendChild(container);

  renderFindings();
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Panel — run
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

async function run(): Promise<void> {
  // Disable the trigger while running.
  const btn = body.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-act="run"], button');
  if (btn) {
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = "Running…";
  }

  const loader = tryUse("appLoader");
  loader?.begin?.("Model Health — scanning");
  try {
    loader?.set?.("Reading models", 0.1);
    lastResults = await runModelHealth();
    loader?.set?.("Done", 1);
    activeSeverity = "all";
    if (lastResults.length) renderResults();
    else renderIdle();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[model-health] run failed", err);
    notify("error", `Model Health failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : err}`);
  } finally {
    loader?.finish?.();
    const btn2 = body.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-act="run"]');
    if (btn2) { btn2.disabled = false; btn2.textContent = "▶ Run Model Health Check"; }
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public API
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

export function openModelHealth(): void {
  visible = true;
  if (!panel.parentElement) ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);
  panel.style.display = "flex";

  if (!dock) {
    dock = makeDockable(panel, {
      id: "model-health",
      host: ctx.rightHost,
      header,
      minWidth: 420,
      minHeight: 320,
      defaultDock: "right",
      defaultWidth: 520,
      defaultHeight: 680,
    });
  }
  dock.show();

  if (lastResults.length) renderResults();
  else { renderIdle(); void run(); }
}

export function closeModelHealth(): void {
  visible = false;
  dock?.hide();
  panel.style.display = "none";
}

export function toggleModelHealth(): void {
  if (visible) closeModelHealth();
  else openModelHealth();
}

export function isModelHealthVisible(): boolean {
  return visible;
}

export function getLastHealthResults(): readonly AuditResult[] {
  return lastResults;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Setup
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

export function setupModelHealth(): void {
  if (panel.parentElement !== ctx.rightHost) {
    ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);
  }

  dock = makeDockable(panel, {
    id: "model-health",
    host: ctx.rightHost,
    header,
    minWidth: 420,
    minHeight: 320,
    defaultDock: "right",
    defaultWidth: 520,
    defaultHeight: 680,
  });
  panel.style.display = "none";

  const svc = {
    open: openModelHealth,
    close: closeModelHealth,
    toggle: toggleModelHealth,
    isVisible: isModelHealthVisible,
    run: async () => {
      const res = await runModelHealth();
      lastResults = res;
      return res;
    },
    getLastResults: getLastHealthResults,
  };
  (ctx.features as any).modelHealth = svc;

  // Also expose as a panel service so the ribbon and command palette
  // can toggle it without knowing the shape of the health-specific API.
  (ctx.features as any).modelHealthPanel = {
    toggle: toggleModelHealth,
    isVisible: isModelHealthVisible,
  };

  console.log("[model-health] ready");
}
```

```ts
/**

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const panel = document.createElement("div");
panel.style.cssText =
  "position:absolute;left:400px;top:14px;bottom:14px;width:340px;z-index:35;display:none;flex-direction:column;" +
  "background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:10px;" +

panel.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

const header = document.createElement("div");

const searchRow = document.createElement("div");

const searchInput = document.createElement("input");

searchInput.style.cssText =
  "width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:6px 9px;background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);" +
  "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:6px;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:12px system-ui;outline:none";
searchRow.appendChild(searchInput);

const body = document.createElement("div");

const expandedSet = new Set<string>();
const visibilityMemo = new Map<number, boolean>(); // not used yet — placeholder
let searchQuery = "";
let searchHits: { item: TreeItem; path: string[] }[] = [];

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Icons
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function iconForCategory(cat: string): string {
  const c = cat.toUpperCase();
  if (c.includes("WALL")) return "🧱";
  if (c.includes("DOOR")) return "🚪";
  if (c.includes("WINDOW")) return "🪟";
  if (c.includes("SLAB") || c.includes("COVERING")) return "▭";
  if (c.includes("BEAM")) return "▬";
  if (c.includes("COLUMN")) return "▮";
  if (c.includes("FOOTING") || c.includes("PILE")) return "▤";
  if (c.includes("RAILING")) return "〰";
  if (c.includes("STAIR")) return "🪜";
  if (c.includes("ROOF")) return "⌂";
  if (c.includes("SPACE")) return "◌";
  if (c.includes("PIPE")) return "○";
  if (c.includes("DUCT")) return "⬚";
  if (c.includes("CABLE") || c.includes("CONDUIT")) return "⚡";
  if (c.includes("FURNITURE")) return "🪑";
  if (c.includes("SITE")) return "🌍";
  if (c.includes("BUILDING")) return "🏢";
  if (c.includes("LEVEL") || c.includes("STOREY")) return "═";
  return "◾";
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Header render
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const BTN = "display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:24px;height:24px;" +
  "border-radius:5px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5);border:1px solid transparent;" +
  "cursor:pointer;font-size:14px";

function miniBtn(icon: string, title: string, onclick: () => void): HTMLButtonElement {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.style.cssText = BTN;
  b.title = title;
  b.textContent = icon;
  b.onclick = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    onclick();
  };
  b.onmouseenter = () => (b.style.background = "var(--bg-hover,#232633)");
  b.onmouseleave = () => (b.style.background = "transparent");
  return b;
}

function renderHeader() {
  header.innerHTML = "";
  const title = document.createElement("div");
  title.textContent = "🌲 Model Tree";
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:700;flex:1";
  header.appendChild(title);

  const expandBtn = miniBtn("⊞", "Expand all", () => {
    for (const t of getTrees()) expandAll(t.root);
    renderBody();
  });
  const collapseBtn = miniBtn("⊟", "Collapse all", () => {
    expandedSet.clear();
    renderBody();
  });
  const refreshBtn = miniBtn("⟲", "Rebuild tree", () => {
    void buildAllTrees().then(() => renderBody());
  });
  const closeBtn = miniBtn("✕", "Close", () => toggleModelTreePanel());

  header.append(expandBtn, collapseBtn, refreshBtn, closeBtn);
}

function expandAll(node: TreeItem) {
  if (node.children.length) {
    expandedSet.add(node.id);
    for (const c of node.children) expandAll(c);
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Row rendering
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function renderRow(
  item: TreeItem,
  depth: number,
  container: HTMLElement,
): void {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.dataset.nodeId = item.id;
  row.style.cssText =
    `display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 6px 3px ${6 + depth * 14}px;` +
    "cursor:pointer;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap;min-height:22px;font-size:12px";

  // Expand toggle
  const toggle = document.createElement("span");
  toggle.style.cssText =
    "width:14px;text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);flex:none";
  if (item.children.length) {
    toggle.textContent = expandedSet.has(item.id) ? "▼" : "▶";
    toggle.onclick = (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (expandedSet.has(item.id)) expandedSet.delete(item.id);
      else expandedSet.add(item.id);
      renderBody();
    };
  } else {
    toggle.textContent = "·";
    toggle.style.opacity = "0.3";
  }

  // Visibility eye (only meaningful for element / category / spatial with geometry)
  const eye = document.createElement("span");
  eye.style.cssText =
    "width:16px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;flex:none;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);cursor:pointer";
  eye.textContent = "◉";
  eye.title = "Hide / show";
  eye.onclick = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    void toggleVisibility(item);
  };

  // Icon
  const icon = document.createElement("span");
  icon.style.cssText = "width:16px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;flex:none";
  icon.textContent =
    item.kind === "model"
      ? "📄"
      : item.kind === "category"
        ? "📁"
        : iconForCategory(item.category);

  // Name + optional category suffix
  const label = document.createElement("span");
  label.style.cssText =
    "flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap";
  if (item.kind === "element") {
    label.textContent = item.name;
    const cat = document.createElement("span");
    cat.style.cssText =
      "opacity:.5;font-size:10px;margin-left:6px;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace)";
    cat.textContent = prettyCategoryName(item.category);
    label.appendChild(cat);
  } else {
    label.textContent = item.name;
  }

  // Element count badge
  const count = document.createElement("span");
  count.style.cssText =
    "flex:none;font:500 10px var(--font-mono,monospace);color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);padding:0 6px";
  if (item.elementCount > 0 && item.kind !== "element") {
    count.textContent = String(item.elementCount);
  }

  // Selection marker
  const marker = document.createElement("span");
  marker.style.cssText = "width:6px;flex:none;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;height:6px";
  if (isSelected(item)) {
    marker.style.background = "var(--accent,#38bdf8)";
    marker.style.boxShadow = "0 0 6px var(--accent,#38bdf8)";
  }

  row.append(toggle, eye, icon, label, count, marker);

  row.onclick = (e) => {
    handleRowClick(item, e);
  };
  row.oncontextmenu = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    openNodeContextMenu(item, e);
  };
  row.onmouseenter = () => (row.style.background = "var(--bg-hover,#232633)");
  row.onmouseleave = () => (row.style.background = "transparent");

  container.appendChild(row);

  // Children if expanded
  if (expandedSet.has(item.id) && item.children.length) {
    for (const c of item.children) renderRow(c, depth + 1, container);
  }
}

function isSelected(item: TreeItem): boolean {
  if (item.kind === "element") {
    return selection.has(item.modelId, item.localId);
  }
  // For containers, check any descendant
  for (const [, s] of Object.entries(selection.snapshot())) {
    // selection.snapshot() returns new objects each call, so just look at byLocalId
    const tree = getTree(item.modelId);
    if (!tree) continue;
    for (const id of s) {
      const it = tree.byLocalId.get(id);
      if (it && isDescendant(it, item)) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function isDescendant(needle: TreeItem, hay: TreeItem): boolean {
  if (needle.id === hay.id) return true;
  let p: TreeItem | undefined = undefined;
  // We didn't store parent pointers; walk by searching the hay subtree
  const walk = (it: TreeItem): boolean => {
    if (it.id === needle.id) return true;
    for (const c of it.children) if (walk(c)) return true;
    return false;
  };
  return walk(hay);
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Body render
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function renderBody() {
  body.innerHTML = "";

  const trees = getTrees();
  if (!trees.length) {
    body.innerHTML =
      '<div style="opacity:.55;text-align:center;padding:24px;border:1px dashed var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);margin:10px;border-radius:8px">' +
      "No models loaded.</div>";
    return;
  }

  // Search mode — flat list of hits
  if (searchQuery.trim()) {
    searchHits = [];
    for (const t of trees) {
      const hits = searchTree(t, searchQuery, 200);
      for (const h of hits) searchHits.push(h);
    }
    if (!searchHits.length) {
      body.innerHTML =
        '<div style="opacity:.55;text-align:center;padding:20px">No matching elements.</div>';
      return;
    }
    const hint = document.createElement("div");
    hint.style.cssText = "padding:4px 12px;font-size:10px;opacity:.6;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px";
    hint.textContent = `${searchHits.length} match${searchHits.length === 1 ? "" : "es"}`;
    body.appendChild(hint);

    for (const hit of searchHits) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.cssText =
        "padding:5px 12px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)";
      row.onclick = (e) => handleRowClick(hit.item, e);
      row.onmouseenter = () => (row.style.background = "var(--bg-hover,#232633)");
      row.onmouseleave = () => (row.style.background = "transparent");
      const pathStr = hit.path.slice(-3).join(" › ");
      row.innerHTML =
        `<div style="font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap">` +
        `<span style="opacity:.5;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace);font-size:10px">${iconForCategory(hit.item.category)}</span> ` +
        `${escapeHtml(hit.item.name)}</div>` +
        `<div style="font-size:10px;opacity:.55;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap">${escapeHtml(pathStr)}</div>`;
      body.appendChild(row);
    }
    return;
  }

  // Tree mode
  for (const t of trees) {
    // Auto-expand top-level for readability
    if (expandedSet.size === 0) {
      expandedSet.add(t.root.id);
    }
    renderRow(t.root, 0, body);
  }
}

function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return String(s).replace(
    /[&<>"']/g,
    (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c],
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Interactions
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function handleRowClick(item: TreeItem, e: MouseEvent) {
  if (item.kind === "model" || item.kind === "spatial") {
    // Toggle expand on container click
    if (item.children.length) {
      if (expandedSet.has(item.id)) expandedSet.delete(item.id);
      else expandedSet.add(item.id);
      renderBody();
    }
    return;
  }

  const ids = collectLocalIds(item);
  if (!ids.length) return;

  const ctrl = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;
  const shift = e.shiftKey;
  const alt = e.altKey;

  if (alt) {
    selection.removeMany(item.modelId, ids);
  } else if (shift) {
    for (const id of ids) selection.toggle(item.modelId, id);
  } else if (ctrl) {
    selection.addMany(item.modelId, ids);
  } else {
    selection.replace({ [item.modelId]: new Set(ids) });
  }
  void selection.applyToHighlighter();
  renderBody();
}

async function toggleVisibility(item: TreeItem) {
  const ids = collectLocalIds(item);
  if (!ids.length) return;
  try {
    const hider: any = ctx.hider;
    // Best-effort: hide this subtree
    const map = { [item.modelId]: new Set(ids) };
    if (typeof hider.hide === "function") await hider.hide(map);
    else if (typeof hider.set === "function") await hider.set(false, map);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[model-tree] toggle visibility failed", e);
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Node context menu
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const ctxMenu = document.createElement("div");
ctxMenu.style.cssText =
  "position:fixed;z-index:200;min-width:180px;background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);" +
  "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg,0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.45));" +
  "padding:4px 0;font:12px system-ui;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);display:none";
document.body.appendChild(ctxMenu);

function ctxItem(label: string, icon: string, onclick: () => void, disabled = false) {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap" +
    (disabled ? ";opacity:.4;pointer-events:none" : "");
  row.innerHTML = `<span style="width:14px;text-align:center">${icon}</span><span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span>`;
  row.onmouseenter = () => (row.style.background = "var(--bg-hover,#232633)");
  row.onmouseleave = () => (row.style.background = "transparent");
  row.onclick = () => {
    ctxMenu.style.display = "none";
    onclick();
  };
  return row;
}

function openNodeContextMenu(item: TreeItem, e: MouseEvent) {
  ctxMenu.innerHTML = "";
  const ids = collectLocalIds(item);
  const map = { [item.modelId]: new Set(ids) };
  const hasIds = ids.length > 0;

  ctxMenu.appendChild(
    ctxItem("Zoom to node", "🎯", () => {
      void fitToMap(map as any);
    }, !hasIds),
  );
  ctxMenu.appendChild(
    ctxItem("Select subtree", "⬛", () => {
      selection.replace(map as any);
      void selection.applyToHighlighter();
      renderBody();
    }, !hasIds),
  );
  const sep = document.createElement("div");
  sep.style.cssText = "height:1px;background:var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);margin:4px 8px";
  ctxMenu.appendChild(sep);

  ctxMenu.appendChild(
    ctxItem("Hide", "🙈", async () => {
      try {
        const hider: any = ctx.hider;
        if (typeof hider.hide === "function") await hider.hide(map);
        else if (typeof hider.set === "function") await hider.set(false, map);
      } catch { /* */ }
    }, !hasIds),
  );
  ctxMenu.appendChild(
    ctxItem("Isolate", "🚧", async () => {
      try {
        const hider: any = ctx.hider;
        if (typeof hider.isolate === "function") await hider.isolate(map);
        else if (typeof hider.set === "function") {
          await hider.set(false);
          await hider.set(true, map);
        }
      } catch { /* */ }
    }, !hasIds),
  );
  ctxMenu.appendChild(
    ctxItem("Show all", "👁", async () => {
      try {
        const hider: any = ctx.hider;
        if (typeof hider.show === "function") await hider.show();
        else if (typeof hider.set === "function") await hider.set(true);
      } catch { /* */ }
    }),
  );

  ctxMenu.style.left = `${e.clientX}px`;
  ctxMenu.style.top = `${e.clientY}px`;
  ctxMenu.style.display = "block";
}

// Close context menu on any click outside
window.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
  if (!ctxMenu.contains(e.target as Node)) ctxMenu.style.display = "none";
});
window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Escape") ctxMenu.style.display = "none";
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Search
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
searchInput.oninput = () => {
  searchQuery = searchInput.value;
  renderBody();
};
searchInput.onkeydown = (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    searchInput.value = "";
    searchQuery = "";
    searchInput.blur();
    renderBody();
  }
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Sync with selection
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
selection.onChange(() => {
  if (panel.style.display !== "flex") return;
  // Refresh row markers (cheap: rerender body)
  renderBody();
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Public
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function toggleModelTreePanel() {
  const visible = panel.style.display === "flex";
  panel.style.display = visible ? "none" : "flex";
  if (!visible) {
    renderHeader();
    renderBody();
    if (!getTrees().length) void buildAllTrees().then(renderBody);
  }
}
export function isModelTreePanelVisible() {
  return panel.style.display === "flex";
}

export function setupModelTreePanel() {
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);
  onModelTreeChanged(() => {
    if (panel.style.display === "flex") renderBody();
  });
  ctx.features.modelTreePanel = {
    toggle: toggleModelTreePanel,
    isVisible: isModelTreePanelVisible,
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Own MMB orbit when a selection exists, pivoting about selection COG.
 * Priority 80 > navigation (30), so this handler claims the gesture first.
 * Also fixes orthographic wheel zoom about that same pivot.
 * Draws a small 3D crosshair at the active pivot so you can verify it.
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { inputRouter, type Gesture } from "../core/input-router";
import { forceResumeCameraControls } from "../core/camera-gate";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let installed = false;
let cog = new THREE.Vector3();
let hasCog = false;
let lastSelKey = "";

type OrbitState = {
  startX: number;
  startY: number;
  pivot: THREE.Vector3;
  startSpherical: THREE.Spherical;
  pixelsToRadians: number;
} | null;

let orbit: OrbitState = null;
let pivotHelper: THREE.Group | null = null;

function worldReady(): boolean {
  try {
    return !!(ctx as Any).world?.camera?.three;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function camera(): Any {
  return (ctx as Any).world.camera.three;
}

function controls(): Any {
  return (ctx as Any).world.camera.controls;
}

/* -- Selection COG ------------------------------------------------------- */

async function refreshCOG(): Promise<boolean> {
  const box = new THREE.Box3();
  let any = false;

  // Fragment selection
  try {
    const sel = (ctx.features as Any)?.selection;
    if (sel?.boundingBox) {
      const b = await sel.boundingBox();
      if (b && !b.isEmpty()) {
        box.union(b);
        any = true;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // Authored selection - try every known API
  try {
    const a = (ctx.features as Any)?.authoring;
    if (a) {
      let ids: string[] = [];
      if (typeof a.getSelectedIds === "function") ids = a.getSelectedIds() || [];
      else if (Array.isArray(a.selectedIds)) ids = a.selectedIds;
      else if (a.selection?.ids) ids = [...a.selection.ids];

      for (const id of ids) {
        const el =
          a.getElementById?.(id) ??
          a.getElement?.(id) ??
          (Array.isArray(a.elements) ? a.elements.find((e: Any) => e.id === id) : null);

        if (!el) continue;

        // World box helper
        const wb = a.getElementWorldBox?.(el);
        if (wb && !wb.isEmpty?.()) {
          box.union(wb);
          any = true;
          continue;
        }

        // Mesh / Object3D
        const mesh =
          el.mesh ??
          el.object3d ??
          el.object ??
          el.group ??
          el.root;
        if (mesh && mesh.isObject3D) {
          mesh.updateWorldMatrix?.(true, true);
          const b = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(mesh as THREE.Object3D);
          if (!b.isEmpty()) {
            box.union(b);
            any = true;
            continue;
          }
        }

        // Placement
        const p = el.params ?? el;
        const x = Number(p.x ?? p.origin?.x ?? el.position?.x);
        const y = Number(p.y ?? p.origin?.y ?? el.position?.y);
        const z = Number(p.z ?? p.origin?.z ?? el.position?.z);
        if ([x, y, z].every((n) => Number.isFinite(n))) {
          box.expandByPoint(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z));
          // Expand a bit so single points still form a box
          box.expandByScalar(0.05);
          any = true;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // Highlighted / selected THREE objects in the scene
  try {
    const scene = (ctx as Any).world?.scene?.three as THREE.Scene | undefined;
    if (scene) {
      scene.traverse((o: Any) => {
        if (
          o.userData?.selected ||
          o.userData?.obsSelected ||
          o.userData?.isSelected ||
          o.userData?.highlight
        ) {
          const b = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(o as THREE.Object3D);
          if (!b.isEmpty()) {
            box.union(b);
            any = true;
          }
        }
      });
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  if (!any || box.isEmpty()) {
    hasCog = false;
    hidePivotHelper();
    (window as Any).__OBS_HAS_SELECTION_PIVOT = false;
    (window as Any).__OBS_ORBIT_PIVOT = null;
    return false;
  }

  box.getCenter(cog);
  hasCog = true;
  (window as Any).__OBS_HAS_SELECTION_PIVOT = true;
  (window as Any).__OBS_ORBIT_PIVOT = cog.clone();
  showPivotHelper(cog);
  return true;
}

function selectionKey(): string {
  try {
    const sel = (ctx.features as Any)?.selection;
    const a = (ctx.features as Any)?.authoring;
    const frag = sel?.size?.() ?? 0;
    const ids = a?.getSelectedIds?.() ?? a?.selectedIds ?? [];
    return `${frag}|${Array.isArray(ids) ? ids.join(",") : ""}`;
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

/* -- Visible pivot marker ------------------------------------------------ */

function showPivotHelper(p: THREE.Vector3): void {
  try {
    const scene = (ctx as Any).world?.scene?.three as THREE.Scene | undefined;
    if (!scene) return;
    if (!pivotHelper) {
      pivotHelper = new THREE.Group();
      pivotHelper.name = "obs-sel-cog-pivot";
      const makeAxis = (dir: THREE.Vector3, color: number) => {
        const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
          dir.clone().multiplyScalar(-0.4),
          dir.clone().multiplyScalar(0.4),
        ]);
        const mat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
          color,
          depthTest: false,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.95,
        });
        const line = new THREE.Line(geo, mat);
        line.renderOrder = 999;
        return line;
      };
      pivotHelper.add(makeAxis(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), 0xff4466));
      pivotHelper.add(makeAxis(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0x44ff88));
      pivotHelper.add(makeAxis(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), 0x4488ff));
      // small sphere
      const sph = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.08, 12, 12),
        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: 0xffcc00,
          depthTest: false,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.9,
        }),
      );
      sph.renderOrder = 1000;
      pivotHelper.add(sph);
      scene.add(pivotHelper);
    }
    pivotHelper.visible = true;
    pivotHelper.position.copy(p);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

function hidePivotHelper(): void {
  if (pivotHelper) pivotHelper.visible = false;
}

/* -- Orbit about COG (we own the gesture) -------------------------------- */

function beginOrbit(e: PointerEvent, pivot: THREE.Vector3): void {
  const cam = camera();
  const camToPivot = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(cam.position, pivot);
  const spherical = new THREE.Spherical().setFromVector3(camToPivot);
  const host = (ctx as Any).rightHost as HTMLElement;
  const rect = host?.getBoundingClientRect?.() ?? { height: 600 };
  orbit = {
    startX: e.clientX,
    startY: e.clientY,
    pivot: pivot.clone(),
    startSpherical: spherical,
    pixelsToRadians: (Math.PI * 2) / Math.max(rect.height, 400),
  };
  try {
    forceResumeCameraControls();
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  if (host) host.style.cursor = "grabbing";
}

function applyOrbit(dx: number, dy: number): void {
  if (!orbit) return;
  const cam = camera();
  const c = controls();
  const sph = orbit.startSpherical.clone();
  sph.theta -= dx * orbit.pixelsToRadians;
  sph.phi += dy * orbit.pixelsToRadians;
  sph.phi = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(Math.PI - 0.05, sph.phi));

  // Keep radius stable; for ortho radius is less meaningful but position still moves
  if (cam.isOrthographicCamera) {
    sph.radius = Math.max(sph.radius, 1);
  }

  const newPos = orbit.pivot
    .clone()
    .add(new THREE.Vector3().setFromSpherical(sph));

  try {
    if (c && c.enabled === false) c.enabled = true;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  try {
    c.setLookAt(
      newPos.x,
      newPos.y,
      newPos.z,
      orbit.pivot.x,
      orbit.pivot.y,
      orbit.pivot.z,
      false,
    );
    try {
      c.update?.(0);
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  } catch {
    cam.position.copy(newPos);
    cam.lookAt(orbit.pivot);
  }

  // Keep controls target locked on pivot
  try {
    if (c?.target?.isVector3) c.target.copy(orbit.pivot);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

function endOrbit(): void {
  orbit = null;
  try {
    const host = (ctx as Any).rightHost as HTMLElement;
    if (host) host.style.cursor = "";
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  try {
    forceResumeCameraControls();
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

function onGesture(g: Gesture): boolean {
  // Only claim when we have a selection COG and user wants orbit (Shift/Ctrl+MMB)
  // or always on MMB orbit-style with shift
  if (g.kind === "drag-start" && g.button === 1) {
    if (!hasCog) return false;
    const wantOrbit =
      g.mods.shift || g.mods.ctrl || g.mods.meta;
    // Also claim plain MMB orbit if user holds shift on keyboard
    // For Revit: Shift+MMB = orbit. Plain MMB = pan (leave to navigation).
    if (!wantOrbit) {
      // Still update target for pan consistency
      try {
        const c = controls();
        if (c?.target?.isVector3) c.target.copy(cog);
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
      return false; // let navigation pan
    }
    beginOrbit(g.event, cog);
    return true; // claim gesture - navigation will NOT receive it
  }

  if (g.kind === "drag-move" && g.button === 1) {
    if (!orbit) return false;
    applyOrbit(g.dx, g.dy);
    return true;
  }

  if (g.kind === "drag-end" && g.button === 1) {
    if (!orbit) return false;
    endOrbit();
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

/* -- Ortho zoom about COG ------------------------------------------------ */

function zoomAboutPivot(factor: number): void {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  const cam = camera();
  const c = controls();
  const pivot = hasCog ? cog.clone() : new THREE.Vector3();
  if (!hasCog) {
    if (c?.target?.isVector3) pivot.copy(c.target);
    else {
      const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
      cam.getWorldDirection(dir);
      pivot.copy(cam.position).addScaledVector(dir, 10);
    }
  }

  if (cam.isOrthographicCamera) {
    const z = Math.max(1e-4, Number(cam.zoom) || 1);
    cam.zoom = Math.max(0.01, Math.min(8000, z * factor));
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
    try {
      c?.setLookAt?.(
        cam.position.x,
        cam.position.y,
        cam.position.z,
        pivot.x,
        pivot.y,
        pivot.z,
        false,
      );
      c?.update?.(0);
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  } else {
    const offset = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(cam.position, pivot);
    const dist = offset.length();
    if (dist < 1e-6) return;
    const newDist = Math.max(1e-4, dist / factor);
    offset.normalize().multiplyScalar(newDist);
    const np = pivot.clone().add(offset);
    try {
      c?.setLookAt?.(np.x, np.y, np.z, pivot.x, pivot.y, pivot.z, false);
      c?.update?.(0);
    } catch {
      cam.position.copy(np);
      cam.lookAt(pivot);
    }
  }
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:camera-changed"));
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

function installWheel(): void {
  window.addEventListener(
    "wheel",
    (e: WheelEvent) => {
      try {
        if ((window as Any).__OBS_MMB_HELD) return;
        const cam = camera();
        if (!cam) return;

        // Keep target on COG for any zoom
        if (hasCog) {
          const c = controls();
          if (c?.target?.isVector3) c.target.copy(cog);
        }

        // Own zoom when: orthographic OR selection COG active
        const own = cam.isOrthographicCamera || hasCog;
        if (!own) return;

        const host = (ctx as Any).rightHost as HTMLElement | undefined;
        if (host && e.target && host.contains(e.target as Node) === false) {
          const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
          if (t.closest?.("#obs-parity-tabs,input,textarea,button")) return;
        }

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();

        let dy = e.deltaY;
        if (e.deltaMode === 1) dy *= 16;
        if (e.deltaMode === 2) dy *= 400;
        const zoomIn = dy < 0;
        const base = e.shiftKey ? 1.28 : 1.12;
        zoomAboutPivot(zoomIn ? base : 1 / base);
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    },
    { capture: true, passive: false },
  );
}

/* -- Setup --------------------------------------------------------------- */

export function setupNavCogForce(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  // Priority 80 > navigation 30
  try {
    inputRouter.subscribe(onGesture, 80);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[nav-cog-force] inputRouter subscribe failed", e);
  }

  installWheel();

  // Selection watch
  const tick = () => {
    const k = selectionKey();
    if (k !== lastSelKey) {
      lastSelKey = k;
      void refreshCOG();
    }
  };
  window.setInterval(tick, 200);
  window.addEventListener("obs:selection-changed", () => void refreshCOG());
  window.addEventListener("obs:authoring-selection-changed", () => void refreshCOG());
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", () => {
    window.setTimeout(() => void refreshCOG(), 30);
  });

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (t?.closest?.("input,textarea,[contenteditable],select")) return;
    if (e.key === "+" || e.key === "=") {
      e.preventDefault();
      zoomAboutPivot(e.shiftKey ? 1.35 : 1.18);
    } else if (e.key === "-" || e.key === "_") {
      e.preventDefault();
      zoomAboutPivot(e.shiftKey ? 1 / 1.35 : 1 / 1.18);
    }
  });

  (window as Any).__obsNavCog = {
    refresh: refreshCOG,
    zoomIn: () => zoomAboutPivot(1.2),
    zoomOut: () => zoomAboutPivot(1 / 1.2),
    hasCog: () => hasCog,
    getCog: () => (hasCog ? cog.clone() : null),
  };

  console.log(
    "[nav-cog-force] PRIORITY 80 orbit about selection COG + ortho zoom + pivot marker",
  );
}
```

```ts
// openbim-fix:v3:applied -- do not re-apply the earlier fix scripts
/**
 * Revit-class 3D Navigation (reset / hardened)
 *
 * Canonical Revit mouse map:
 *   MMB drag              Pan
 *   Shift + MMB drag      Orbit (around target)
 *   Ctrl + MMB drag       Orbit around selection
 *   Wheel                 Zoom to cursor
 *   Shift + Wheel         Zoom x3
 *   Double-click MMB      Zoom to fit
 *   LMB click             Select
 *   LMB drag L->R         Window select
 *   LMB drag R->L         Crossing select
 *   RMB                   Context menu
 *
 * CameraControls mouse/touch are forced OFF so only this module drives the view.
 * Every gesture ends with forceResumeCameraControls to prevent 3D hang-ups.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { inputRouter, type Gesture, type Mods } from "../core/input-router";
import { fitAll, zoomBy, pickWorldPointUnderCursor } from "./camera-tools";
import { forceResumeCameraControls } from "../core/camera-gate";

type NavState =
  | { kind: "idle" }
  | {
      kind: "pan";
      startX: number;
      startY: number;
      startTarget: THREE.Vector3;
      startCam: THREE.Vector3;
      right: THREE.Vector3;
      up: THREE.Vector3;
      worldPerPx: number;
    }
  | {
      kind: "orbit";
      startX: number;
      startY: number;
      pivot: THREE.Vector3;
      startSpherical: THREE.Spherical;
      pixelsToRadians: number;
    }
  | {
      kind: "box-select";
      startX: number;
      startY: number;
      mode: "window" | "crossing";
    };

let state: NavState = { kind: "idle" };
let shiftHeld = false;
let ctrlHeld = false;

const blockers: Array<() => boolean> = [];

export function whenNavigationBlocked(fn: () => boolean): () => void {
  blockers.push(fn);
  return () => {
    const i = blockers.indexOf(fn);
    if (i >= 0) blockers.splice(i, 1);
  };
}

function blocked(): boolean {
  for (const b of blockers) {
    try {
      if (b()) return true;
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  }
  try {
    if ((window as any).__obsPlanVisible?.()) return true;
    if (ctx.features?.drawing?.isActive?.()) return true;
    if (ctx.features?.walkMode?.isEnabled?.()) return true;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return false;
}

export type ClickDelegate = (m: Mods, e: PointerEvent) => boolean;
export type DragDelegate = (g: Extract<Gesture, { kind: "drag-move" }>) => boolean;

const clickDelegates: ClickDelegate[] = [];
const dragDelegates: DragDelegate[] = [];

export function onNavClick(fn: ClickDelegate): () => void {
  clickDelegates.push(fn);
  return () => {
    const i = clickDelegates.indexOf(fn);
    if (i >= 0) clickDelegates.splice(i, 1);
  };
}

export function onNavDrag(fn: DragDelegate): () => void {
  dragDelegates.push(fn);
  return () => {
    const i = dragDelegates.indexOf(fn);
    if (i >= 0) dragDelegates.splice(i, 1);
  };
}

function controls(): any {
  return ctx.world.camera.controls;
}

function camera(): THREE.PerspectiveCamera | THREE.OrthographicCamera {
  return ctx.world.camera.three as any;
}

function getTarget(out = new THREE.Vector3()): THREE.Vector3 {
  const c = controls();
  if (c?.target?.isVector3) return out.copy(c.target);
  return out.set(0, 0, 0);
}

function beginPan(e: PointerEvent): void {
  const cam = camera();
  const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (rect.height < 1) return;

  const target = getTarget();
  const dist = cam.position.distanceTo(target);
  const isOrtho = (cam as any).isOrthographicCamera;
  let worldPerPx: number;
  if (isOrtho) {
    // In ortho, world-per-pixel depends on the frustum height and the
    // current zoom factor: (top - bottom) / zoom / viewportHeight.
    const o = cam as THREE.OrthographicCamera;
    const z = Math.max(1e-3, o.zoom || 1);
    worldPerPx = ((o.top - o.bottom) / z) / rect.height;
  } else {
    const vFov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad((cam as THREE.PerspectiveCamera).fov ?? 60);
    worldPerPx = (2 * Math.tan(vFov / 2) * Math.max(dist, 0.01)) / rect.height;
  }

  const right = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixColumn(cam.matrixWorld, 0);
  const up = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixColumn(cam.matrixWorld, 1);

  state = {
    kind: "pan",
    startX: e.clientX,
    startY: e.clientY,
    startTarget: target.clone(),
    startCam: cam.position.clone(),
    right,
    up,
    worldPerPx,
  };
}

function applyPan(dxTotal: number, dyTotal: number): void {
  if (state.kind !== "pan") return;
  const cam = camera();
  const c = controls();

  const offset = state.right
    .clone()
    .multiplyScalar(-dxTotal * state.worldPerPx)
    .add(state.up.clone().multiplyScalar(dyTotal * state.worldPerPx));

  const newPos = state.startCam.clone().add(offset);
  const newTarget = state.startTarget.clone().add(offset);

  try {
    if (c && c.enabled === false) c.enabled = true;
  } catch { /* */ }

  try {
    c.setLookAt(newPos.x, newPos.y, newPos.z, newTarget.x, newTarget.y, newTarget.z, false);
    try { c.update?.(0); } catch { /* */ }
  } catch {
    cam.position.copy(newPos);
    try { cam.lookAt(newTarget); } catch { /* */ }
  }
  try { ctx.cam.updateClipping(); } catch { /* */ }
}

function beginOrbitSync(e: PointerEvent, pivot: THREE.Vector3): void {
  const cam = camera();
  const camToPivot = cam.position.clone().sub(pivot);
  const spherical = new THREE.Spherical().setFromVector3(camToPivot);
  const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pixelsToRadians = (Math.PI * 2) / Math.max(rect.height, 400);

  state = {
    kind: "orbit",
    startX: e.clientX,
    startY: e.clientY,
    pivot,
    startSpherical: spherical,
    pixelsToRadians,
  };
}

async function selectionCenter(): Promise<THREE.Vector3> {
  try {
    const box = await (ctx.features as any)?.selection?.boundingBox?.();
    if (box && !box.isEmpty()) return box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  const auth = (ctx.features as any)?.authoring;
  if (auth?.getSelectedIds?.()?.length) {
    const ids = auth.getSelectedIds() as string[];
    const b = new THREE.Box3();
    for (const id of ids) {
      const el = auth.getElementById?.(id);
      if (!el) continue;
      const wb = auth.getElementWorldBox?.(el);
      if (wb && !wb.isEmpty()) b.union(wb);
    }
    if (!b.isEmpty()) return b.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  }
  return getTarget();
}

function applyOrbit(dxTotal: number, dyTotal: number): void {
  if (state.kind !== "orbit") return;
  const cam = camera();
  const c = controls();

  const sph = state.startSpherical.clone();
  sph.theta -= dxTotal * state.pixelsToRadians * 1.4;
  sph.phi -= dyTotal * state.pixelsToRadians * 1.4;
  sph.phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(sph.phi, 0.02, Math.PI - 0.02);

  // In ortho, the visible size is controlled by zoom, so any radius
  // works — but keep it close for stable near/far clipping.
  const isOrtho = (cam as any).isOrthographicCamera;
  if (isOrtho) {
    sph.radius = Math.max(sph.radius, __obsGetSceneRadiusFallback() * 1.5);
  }

  const newPos = state.pivot.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3().setFromSpherical(sph));

  try { if (c && c.enabled === false) c.enabled = true; } catch { /* */ }

  try {
    c.setLookAt(newPos.x, newPos.y, newPos.z, state.pivot.x, state.pivot.y, state.pivot.z, false);
    try { c.update?.(0); } catch { /* */ }
  } catch {
    cam.position.copy(newPos);
    cam.lookAt(state.pivot);
  }
  try { ctx.cam.updateClipping(); } catch { /* */ }
}

export function zoomAtCursor(deltaY: number, mods: Mods, focus: THREE.Vector3 | null): void {
  const multiplier = mods.shift ? 2.5 : 1;
  const discrete = mods.ctrl || mods.meta ? Math.sign(deltaY || 1) * 0.2 : 0;
  const raw = (deltaY || 0) * 0.0012 * multiplier;
  let factor = Math.exp(raw + discrete);
  if (!Number.isFinite(factor) || factor <= 0) return;
  if (Math.abs(factor - 1) < 0.002) return;
  zoomBy(factor, focus ?? undefined);
}

let overlay: HTMLDivElement | null = null;

function ensureOverlay(): HTMLDivElement {
  if (overlay) return overlay;
  overlay = document.createElement("div");
  overlay.id = "obs-nav-box";
  overlay.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;pointer-events:none;z-index:70;display:none;" +
    "box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:1px";
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(overlay);
  return overlay;
}

function renderBox(
  mode: "window" | "crossing",
  ax: number,
  ay: number,
  bx: number,
  by: number,
): void {
  const el = ensureOverlay();
  const x1 = Math.min(ax, bx);
  const y1 = Math.min(ay, by);
  const x2 = Math.max(ax, bx);
  const y2 = Math.max(ay, by);
  el.style.left = `${x1}px`;
  el.style.top = `${y1}px`;
  el.style.width = `${Math.max(1, x2 - x1)}px`;
  el.style.height = `${Math.max(1, y2 - y1)}px`;
  el.style.display = "block";
  if (mode === "window") {
    el.style.background = "rgba(56,189,248,0.14)";
    el.style.border = "1px solid #38bdf8";
  } else {
    el.style.background = "rgba(34,197,94,0.14)";
    el.style.border = "1px dashed #22c55e";
  }
}

function hideBox(): void {
  if (overlay) overlay.style.display = "none";
}

function attachModifierTracking(): void {
  window.addEventListener(
    "keydown",
    (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Shift") shiftHeld = true;
      else if (e.key === "Control" || e.key === "Meta") ctrlHeld = true;
    },
    true,
  );
  window.addEventListener(
    "keyup",
    (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Shift") shiftHeld = false;
      else if (e.key === "Control" || e.key === "Meta") ctrlHeld = false;
    },
    true,
  );
  window.addEventListener("blur", () => {
    shiftHeld = false;
    ctrlHeld = false;
  });
}

function isUiTarget(e: Event): boolean {
  const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!t || !t.closest) return false;
  if (t.tagName === "CANVAS") return false;
  return !!t.closest(
    "input,select,textarea,button,label,a,[contenteditable]," +
      ".obs-revit-options,.obs-revit-contextual,.obs-revit-viewbar," +
      ".obs-plan-overlay,#obs-ai-chat,#obs-command-palette,#obs-viewcube," +
      "[data-obs-panel],.obs-panel,.bb-status,.obs-toast-host",
  );
}

export function setupNavigation(): void {
  ensureOverlay();
  attachModifierTracking();
  disableNativeCameraMouse();
  try { forceResumeCameraControls(); } catch { /* */ }

  const safetyEnd = () => {
    endNavGesture();
  };
  window.addEventListener("pointercancel", safetyEnd, true);
  window.addEventListener("blur", safetyEnd);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (document.hidden) safetyEnd();
  });

  inputRouter.registerCancel(() => {
    if (state.kind === "idle") return false;
    endNavGesture();
    return true;
  });

  inputRouter.subscribe((g) => {
    if (g.kind === "drag-start" && g.button === 1) {
      if (blocked() || isUiTarget(g.event)) return false;
      disableNativeCameraMouse();
      try { forceResumeCameraControls(); } catch { /* */ }
      const wantOrbit = shiftHeld || ctrlHeld || g.mods.shift || g.mods.ctrl || g.mods.meta;
      if (wantOrbit) {
        beginOrbitSync(g.event, getTarget());
        ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = "grabbing";
        if (g.mods.ctrl || g.mods.meta || ctrlHeld) {
          void selectionCenter().then((pivot) => {
            if (state.kind === "orbit") {
              beginOrbitSync(g.event, pivot);
            }
          });
        }
      } else {
        beginPan(g.event);
        ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = "move";
      }
      return true;
    }

    if (g.kind === "drag-move" && g.button === 1) {
      const wantOrbit = shiftHeld || g.mods.shift || ctrlHeld || g.mods.ctrl || g.mods.meta;
      if (wantOrbit && state.kind === "pan") {
        beginOrbitSync(g.event, getTarget());
        ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = "grabbing";
      }
      if (state.kind === "pan") {
        applyPan(g.dx, g.dy);
        return true;
      }
      if (state.kind === "orbit") {
        applyOrbit(g.dx, g.dy);
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }

    if (g.kind === "drag-end" && g.button === 1) {
      if (state.kind === "pan" || state.kind === "orbit") {
        endNavGesture();
        return true;
      }
      try { forceResumeCameraControls(); } catch { /* */ }
      return false;
    }

    if (g.kind === "drag-start" && g.button === 0) {
      if (blocked() || isUiTarget(g.event)) return false;
      const probe: Extract<Gesture, { kind: "drag-move" }> = {
        kind: "drag-move",
        button: 0,
        mods: g.mods,
        dx: 0,
        dy: 0,
        event: g.event,
      };
      for (const d of dragDelegates) {
        try {
          if (d(probe)) return false;
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("[navigation] drag delegate threw", err);
        }
      }
      state = {
        kind: "box-select",
        startX: g.event.clientX,
        startY: g.event.clientY,
        mode: "window",
      };
      ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = "crosshair";
      return true;
    }

    if (g.kind === "drag-move" && state.kind === "box-select") {
      for (const d of dragDelegates) {
        try {
          if (d(g)) {
            hideBox();
            state = { kind: "idle" };
            ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = "";
            return false;
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("[navigation] drag delegate threw", err);
        }
      }
      const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mode: "window" | "crossing" =
        g.event.clientX >= (state as any).startX ? "window" : "crossing";
      (state as any).mode = mode;
      renderBox(
        mode,
        (state as any).startX - rect.left,
        (state as any).startY - rect.top,
        g.event.clientX - rect.left,
        g.event.clientY - rect.top,
      );
      return true;
    }

    if (g.kind === "drag-end" && g.button === 0 && state.kind === "box-select") {
      const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x1 = state.startX - rect.left;
      const y1 = state.startY - rect.top;
      const x2 = g.event.clientX - rect.left;
      const y2 = g.event.clientY - rect.top;
      hideBox();
      state = { kind: "idle" };
      try { ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = ""; } catch { /* */ }
      try { forceResumeCameraControls(); } catch { /* */ }

      if (Math.abs(x2 - x1) < 3 && Math.abs(y2 - y1) < 3) return false;

      const mode: "window" | "crossing" = x2 >= x1 ? "window" : "crossing";
      void (ctx.features as any).boxSelection?.commit?.(
        {
          x1: Math.min(x1, x2),
          y1: Math.min(y1, y2),
          x2: Math.max(x1, x2),
          y2: Math.max(y1, y2),
        },
        mode,
      );
      return true;
    }

    if (g.kind === "click" && g.button === 0) {
      if (blocked()) return false;
      for (const d of clickDelegates) {
        try {
          if (d(g.mods, g.event)) return true;
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("[navigation] click delegate threw", err);
        }
      }
      return false;
    }

    if (g.kind === "wheel") {
      if ((window as any).__OBS_MMB_HELD) return true;
      if (blocked() || isUiTarget(g.event)) return false;
      const mods: Mods = g.mods ?? {
        ctrl: g.event.ctrlKey,
        shift: g.event.shiftKey,
        alt: g.event.altKey,
        meta: g.event.metaKey,
      };
      // openbim-fix: navigation.ts -- check wheel authority before raycasting
      if ((window as any).__OBS_WHEEL_AUTHORITY) return false;
      const focus = pickWorldPointUnderCursor(g.event.clientX, g.event.clientY);
      zoomAtCursor(g.event.deltaY, mods, focus);
      return true;
    }

    if (g.kind === "dblclick" && g.button === 1) {
      if (blocked() || isUiTarget(g.event)) return false;
      fitAll();
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }, 30);

  ctx.rightHost.addEventListener(
    "wheel",
    (e) => {
      if (!isUiTarget(e)) e.preventDefault();
    },
    { passive: false },
  );

  (ctx.features as any).navigation = {
    getState: () => state,
    whenBlocked: whenNavigationBlocked,
    onNavClick,
    onNavDrag,
  };

  console.log("[navigation] Revit-style navigation active");
}

export function getNavigationState(): NavState {
  return state;
}

export function cancelNavigationGesture(): void {
  state = { kind: "idle" };
  hideBox();
  try { ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = ""; } catch { /* */ }
  try { forceResumeCameraControls(); } catch { /* */ }
}

function disableNativeCameraMouse(): void {
  try {
    const c: any = controls();
    if (!c) return;
    const ACTION = c.constructor?.ACTION || (window as any).CameraControls?.ACTION;
    if (c.mouseButtons && ACTION) {
      c.mouseButtons.left = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
      c.mouseButtons.middle = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
      c.mouseButtons.right = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
      c.mouseButtons.wheel = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
    }
    if (c.touches && ACTION) {
      try {
        c.touches.one = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
        c.touches.two = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
        c.touches.three = ACTION.NONE ?? 0;
      } catch { /* */ }
    }
    /* dampingFactor deprecated; smoothTime is used instead */
    try { if ("draggingSmoothTime" in c) c.draggingSmoothTime = 0; } catch { /* */ }
    try { if ("azimuthRotateSpeed" in c) c.azimuthRotateSpeed = 1; } catch { /* */ }
    try { if ("polarRotateSpeed" in c) c.polarRotateSpeed = 1; } catch { /* */ }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[navigation] disableNativeCameraMouse", e);
  }
}

function endNavGesture(resetCursor = true): void {
  state = { kind: "idle" };
  hideBox();
  if (resetCursor) {
    try { ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = ""; } catch { /* */ }
  }
  try { forceResumeCameraControls(); } catch { /* */ }
}

function __obsGetSceneRadiusFallback(): number {
  try {
    const c: any = (window as any).__OBS_CTX__;
    const box = c?.scene?.box;

    if (box && typeof box.isEmpty === "function" && !box.isEmpty()) {
      const min = box.min;
      const max = box.max;

      if (min && max) {
        const dx = Number(max.x) - Number(min.x);
        const dy = Number(max.y) - Number(min.y);
        const dz = Number(max.z) - Number(min.z);

        const r = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);

        if (Number.isFinite(r) && r > 0) {
          return r;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore and use fallback radius.
  }

  return 100;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Navigation Bar â€” floating view-control toolbar.
 *
 * Positioned under the ViewCube on the right side of the viewport.
 * Provides Home, Fit, Walk, Orbit, Pan, Zoom buttons that mirror the
 * 3D navigation commands. Visibility toggled from the User Interface menu.
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  fitAll, goHome, gotoDir, setProjection, getProjection, takeScreenshot,
} from "./camera-tools";
import { toggleWalkMode, isWalkModeEnabled } from "./walk-mode";
import * as THREE from "three";

let bar: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let visible = false;

function mkBtn(label: string, title: string, onClick: () => void): HTMLButtonElement {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.textContent = label;
  b.title = title;
  b.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:34px;height:34px;" +
    "border-radius:6px;background:#1c1e28;color:#cbd5e1;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;" +
    "cursor:pointer;font:600 15px system-ui;transition:background .12s";
  b.onmouseenter = () => { b.style.background = "#232633"; b.style.color = "#e8eaf0"; };
  b.onmouseleave = () => { b.style.background = "#1c1e28"; b.style.color = "#cbd5e1"; };
  b.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); };
  return b;
}

export function setupNavigationBar(): void {
  bar = document.createElement("div");
  bar.id = "obs-navigation-bar";
  bar.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;z-index:35;display:none;" +
    "flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:5px;" +
    "background:rgba(20,22,30,.85);border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)";
  bar.onmousedown = (e) => e.stopPropagation();

  // View directions (2x2 grid)
  const dirGrid = document.createElement("div");
  dirGrid.style.cssText = "display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px";
  dirGrid.append(
    mkBtn("\u2191", "Top view", () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0))),
    mkBtn("\u2193", "Bottom view", () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0))),
    mkBtn("\u2190", "Left view", () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0))),
    mkBtn("\u2192", "Right view", () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0))),
  );
  bar.appendChild(dirGrid);

  // Separator
  const sep = document.createElement("div");
  sep.style.cssText = "height:1px;background:#2a2e3a;margin:2px 0";
  bar.appendChild(sep);

  // Action buttons
  const actions = document.createElement("div");
  actions.style.cssText = "display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px";
  actions.append(
    mkBtn("\u2302", "Home view", () => goHome()),
    mkBtn("\u26F6", "Fit all", () => fitAll()),
    mkBtn("\u2318", "Toggle Ortho / Perspective", () => {
      const next = getProjection() === "orthographic" ? "perspective" : "orthographic";
      setProjection(next);
    }),
    mkBtn("\u2317", "Screenshot", () => takeScreenshot()),
  );
  bar.appendChild(actions);

  // Walk mode row
  const walkRow = document.createElement("div");
  walkRow.style.cssText = "display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:2px";
  const walkBtn = mkBtn("\u{1F6B6}", "Walk mode (Ctrl+W)", () => toggleWalkMode());
  walkBtn.style.width = "72px";
  walkBtn.id = "obs-nav-walk-btn";
  walkRow.appendChild(walkBtn);
  bar.appendChild(walkRow);

  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(bar);

  (ctx.features as any).navigationBar = {
    show: () => { visible = true; if (bar) bar.style.display = "flex"; },
    hide: () => { visible = false; if (bar) bar.style.display = "none"; },
    toggle: () => { visible ? (ctx.features as any).navigationBar.hide() : (ctx.features as any).navigationBar.show(); },
    isVisible: () => visible,
  };
}
```

--- FILE: src/features/nav-selection-pivot-patch.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Patch: when a selection pivot is active, Shift+MMB orbit always uses
 * the selection center of gravity (not only Ctrl+MMB).
 * Does not rewrite navigation.ts - observes drag-start and re-seeds pivot.
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let installed = false;

function reseedPivotFromFlag(): void {
  try {
    if (!(window as Any).__OBS_HAS_SELECTION_PIVOT) return;
    const pivot = (window as Any).__OBS_ORBIT_PIVOT as THREE.Vector3 | null;
    if (!pivot || !Number.isFinite(pivot.x)) return;
    const controls: Any = (ctx as Any).world?.camera?.controls;
    if (!controls) return;
    if (controls.target?.isVector3) {
      controls.target.copy(pivot);
    }
    if (typeof controls.setTarget === "function") {
      controls.setTarget(pivot.x, pivot.y, pivot.z, false);
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

export function setupNavSelectionPivotPatch(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  // On MMB drag start with Shift (orbit), force target = selection COG
  window.addEventListener(
    "pointerdown",
    (e) => {
      if (e.button !== 1) return; // MMB
      if (!e.shiftKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey) return;
      reseedPivotFromFlag();
    },
    true,
  );

  // Also keep target locked during orbit moves when selection active
  window.addEventListener(
    "pointermove",
    (e) => {
      if (!(window as Any).__OBS_MMB_HELD) return;
      if (!e.shiftKey && !e.ctrlKey) return;
      if (!(window as Any).__OBS_HAS_SELECTION_PIVOT) return;
      reseedPivotFromFlag();
    },
    true,
  );

  console.log("[nav-selection-pivot-patch] Shift/Ctrl+MMB orbit uses selection COG");
}
```
