--- FILE: src/features/ortho-hook.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Ortho hook.
 *
 * Whenever the camera switches to or from orthographic, re-fit the
 * frustum so the visible size stays consistent. Without this, switching
 * PERSP → ORTHO leaves the frustum sized for whatever the previous
 * ortho zoom was, which may be wildly off.
 *
 * Also cleans up any stale DOM overlay from features that draw inside
 * the viewport (e.g. the AccuDraw compass leftovers) on projection
 * changes.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { fitAll, getProjection, computeSceneBounds } from "./camera-tools";

let installed = false;
let lastProjection = "perspective";

export function setupOrthoHook(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  try { lastProjection = getProjection(); } catch { /* */ }

  // Poll every 500 ms — cheap, avoids hooking into every projection-change
  // path in camera-tools.
  setInterval(() => {
    let cur = "perspective";
    try { cur = getProjection(); } catch { return; }
    if (cur === lastProjection) return;
    const was = lastProjection;
    lastProjection = cur;

    // Refit the frustum for the new projection.
    try {
      computeSceneBounds();
      fitAll();
    } catch { /* */ }

    // Clean up stray overlays that may have been left behind.
    try {
      const stray = ctx.rightHost.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-obs-stale-overlay="1"]');
      stray.forEach((el) => el.remove());
    } catch { /* */ }

    console.log("[ortho-hook]", was, "→", cur, "· frustum refit");
  }, 500);

  console.log("[ortho-hook] ready");
}
```

```ts
          <bim-button label="🎯  Recenter at origin" @click=${() => recenterSceneNow()}></bim-button>
          <bim-button label="↺  Reset offsets" @click=${() => resetOffsets()}></bim-button>
          <bim-checkbox label="Show scene bounds (debug)"
            @change=${({ target }: any) => showBoundsHelpers(target.checked)}></bim-checkbox>
          ${boundsInfoEl}
        </bim-panel-section>

        <bim-panel-section label="Controls" icon="mdi:help-circle-outline" collapsed>
          <div style="font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.75;opacity:0.85;padding:0 10px 10px">
            <b>Navigation</b><br>
            Left drag – Rotate · Right drag – Pan · Scroll – Zoom<br>
            <b>Right-click</b> viewport → full context menu<br>
            <b>ViewCube</b> → click faces / edges / corners; right-click for Roll<br><br>
            <b>Authoring</b><br>
            Pick a tool → click on the model to place points<br>
            <b>AccuDraw:</b> Shift ortho · X / Z / Y axis · A angle · type distance<br>
            <b>Doors &amp; Windows:</b> click any wall to insert<br><br>
            <b>Shortcuts</b><br>
            Ctrl+S save · Ctrl+O open · Ctrl+P palette<br>
            Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Y redo · F5 clash · Ctrl+Shift+C review<br>
            Ctrl+Shift+V saved views
          </div>
        </bim-panel-section>
      </bim-panel>
    `;
  });

  ctx.leftHost.appendChild(panel);

  // Collapsed-section sync — BUI does not mirror the `collapsed` property
  // to a `data-collapsed` attribute, and our CSS uses that to hide slotted
  // plain divs. Mirror it on every toggle.
  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.textContent = `
    bim-panel-section {
      --bim-ui_bg-contrast-20: var(--bg-elevated);
    }
    bim-panel-section + bim-panel-section { margin-top: 0; }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(style);

  const syncSections = () => {
    ctx.leftHost.querySelectorAll("bim-panel-section").forEach((sec: any) => {
      if (sec.collapsed) sec.setAttribute("data-collapsed", "");
      else sec.removeAttribute("data-collapsed");
    });
  };
  ctx.leftHost.addEventListener("click", () => setTimeout(syncSections, 0));
  syncSections();
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Lightweight dockable panels for Rooms, Phases, Design Options, Groups.
 * Opened via obs-open-panel custom events from the UI registry patch.
 */

import { roomsStore } from "../../modules/rooms/rooms";
import { phasesStore } from "../../modules/phases/phases";
import { designOptionsStore } from "../../modules/design-options/design-options";
import { groupsStore } from "../../modules/groups/groups";
import { copyMonitorStore } from "../../modules/copy-monitor/copy-monitor";

type PanelId = "rooms" | "phases" | "design-options" | "groups" | "copy-monitor";

const panels = new Map<PanelId, HTMLDivElement>();

function esc(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c],
  );
}

function shell(title: string, bodyHtml: string): HTMLDivElement {
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;top:100px;right:16px;width:320px;max-height:calc(100vh - 140px);" +
    "overflow:auto;z-index:8500;background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.5);color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);" +
    "font:12px/1.4 system-ui;display:none;";
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
      padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);
      background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);cursor:grab;user-select:none;">
      <b style="font-size:13px">${esc(title)}</b>
      <button data-close style="background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border-default);
        color:var(--text-secondary);border-radius:5px;padding:2px 8px;cursor:pointer">-</button>
    </div>
    <div data-body style="padding:10px 12px">${bodyHtml}</div>
  `;
  el.querySelector("[data-close]")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    el.style.display = "none";
  });
  // Drag
  const hdr = el.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
  let dragging = false, sx = 0, sy = 0, ox = 0, oy = 0;
  hdr.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest("button")) return;
    dragging = true;
    sx = e.clientX; sy = e.clientY;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    ox = r.left; oy = r.top;
    (e.target as Element).setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
  });
  hdr.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    el.style.left = `${ox + e.clientX - sx}px`;
    el.style.top = `${oy + e.clientY - sy}px`;
    el.style.right = "auto";
  });
  hdr.addEventListener("pointerup", () => { dragging = false; });
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  return el;
}

function renderRooms(): string {
  const rooms = roomsStore.listRooms();
  const areas = roomsStore.listAreas();
  if (!rooms.length && !areas.length) {
    return `<p style="color:var(--text-tertiary)">No rooms or areas yet.</p>
      <button data-action="add-room" style="margin-top:8px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;
        background:var(--accent-dim);color:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent);cursor:pointer">
        + Sample Room</button>`;
  }
  let html = `<div style="font:700 10px monospace;color:var(--text-tertiary);margin-bottom:6px">ROOMS (${rooms.length})</div>`;
  for (const r of rooms) {
    html += `<div style="padding:6px 8px;margin-bottom:4px;background:var(--bg-inset);border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border-subtle)">
      <b>${esc(r.number)}</b> ${esc(r.name)}
      <div style="color:var(--text-tertiary);font-size:11px">${r.area.toFixed(1)} m- - ${r.perimeter.toFixed(1)} m</div>
    </div>`;
  }
  if (areas.length) {
    html += `<div style="font:700 10px monospace;color:var(--text-tertiary);margin:10px 0 6px">AREAS (${areas.length})</div>`;
    for (const a of areas) {
      html += `<div style="padding:6px 8px;margin-bottom:4px;background:var(--bg-inset);border-radius:6px">
        <b>${esc(a.number)}</b> ${esc(a.name)} <span style="opacity:.6">(${a.areaType})</span>
        <div style="color:var(--text-tertiary);font-size:11px">${a.area.toFixed(1)} m-</div>
      </div>`;
    }
  }
  html += `<button data-action="add-room" style="margin-top:8px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;
    background:var(--bg-hover);border:1px solid var(--border-default);color:var(--text-primary);cursor:pointer">
    + Room</button>`;
  return html;
}

function renderPhases(): string {
  const phases = phasesStore.list();
  const cur = phasesStore.getCurrent();
  const filter = phasesStore.getFilter();
  let html = `<div style="margin-bottom:8px">
    <label style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-tertiary)">Active phase</label>
    <select data-phase style="width:100%;margin-top:4px;padding:6px;background:var(--bg-inset);
      border:1px solid var(--border-default);border-radius:6px;color:var(--text-primary)">
      ${phases.map((p) => `<option value="${p.id}" ${p.id === cur?.id ? "selected" : ""}>${esc(p.name)}</option>`).join("")}
    </select>
  </div>
  <div style="margin-bottom:8px">
    <label style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-tertiary)">Phase filter</label>
    <select data-filter style="width:100%;margin-top:4px;padding:6px;background:var(--bg-inset);
      border:1px solid var(--border-default);border-radius:6px;color:var(--text-primary)">
      <option value="show-complete" ${filter === "show-complete" ? "selected" : ""}>Show Complete</option>
      <option value="show-new" ${filter === "show-new" ? "selected" : ""}>Show New</option>
      <option value="show-previous" ${filter === "show-previous" ? "selected" : ""}>Show Previous</option>
      <option value="show-previous-and-new" ${filter === "show-previous-and-new" ? "selected" : ""}>Previous + New</option>
      <option value="show-demo" ${filter === "show-demo" ? "selected" : ""}>Show Demolished</option>
      <option value="show-all" ${filter === "show-all" ? "selected" : ""}>Show All</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div style="font:700 10px monospace;color:var(--text-tertiary);margin:8px 0 4px">PHASES</div>`;
  for (const p of phases) {
    html += `<div style="padding:5px 8px;margin-bottom:3px;border-radius:5px;
      background:${p.id === cur?.id ? "var(--accent-dim)" : "var(--bg-inset)"}">
      ${esc(p.name)} <span style="opacity:.5">#${p.order}</span>
    </div>`;
  }
  html += `<button data-action="add-phase" style="margin-top:8px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;
    background:var(--bg-hover);border:1px solid var(--border-default);cursor:pointer">+ Phase</button>`;
  return html;
}

function renderDesignOptions(): string {
  const sets = designOptionsStore.listSets();
  if (!sets.length) {
    return `<p style="color:var(--text-tertiary)">No design option sets.</p>
      <button data-action="add-set" style="margin-top:8px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;
        background:var(--accent-dim);color:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent);cursor:pointer">
        + Option Set</button>`;
  }
  let html = "";
  for (const s of sets) {
    html += `<div style="margin-bottom:10px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--border-subtle);border-radius:8px">
      <b>${esc(s.name)}</b>
      <div style="margin-top:6px">`;
    for (const o of s.options) {
      const active = s.activeOptionId === o.id;
      html += `<button data-set="${s.id}" data-opt="${o.id}" style="display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;
        padding:5px 8px;margin-bottom:3px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;
        background:${active ? "var(--accent-dim)" : "var(--bg-inset)"};
        border:1px solid ${active ? "var(--accent)" : "var(--border-subtle)"};
        color:var(--text-primary)">
        ${esc(o.name)}${o.isPrimary ? " (Primary)" : ""}${active ? " -" : ""}
      </button>`;
    }
    html += `</div></div>`;
  }
  html += `<button data-action="add-set" style="padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;
    background:var(--bg-hover);border:1px solid var(--border-default);cursor:pointer">+ Option Set</button>`;
  return html;
}

function renderGroups(): string {
  const types = groupsStore.listTypes();
  const instances = groupsStore.listInstances();
  if (!types.length) {
    return `<p style="color:var(--text-tertiary)">No groups. Select elements and create a group from the ribbon.</p>`;
  }
  let html = `<div style="font:700 10px monospace;color:var(--text-tertiary);margin-bottom:6px">TYPES (${types.length})</div>`;
  for (const t of types) {
    const count = instances.filter((i) => i.typeId === t.id).length;
    html += `<div style="padding:6px 8px;margin-bottom:4px;background:var(--bg-inset);border-radius:6px">
      <b>${esc(t.name)}</b> ${t.shared ? "- shared" : ""}
      <div style="color:var(--text-tertiary);font-size:11px">${t.memberIds.length} members - ${count} instance(s)</div>
    </div>`;
  }
  return html;
}

function renderCopyMonitor(): string {
  const rules = copyMonitorStore.listRules();
  const summary = copyMonitorStore.summary();
  let html = `<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:4px;margin-bottom:10px">
    <div style="text-align:center;padding:6px;background:var(--bg-inset);border-radius:6px"><b>${summary.total}</b><div style="font-size:9px;opacity:.6">Total</div></div>
    <div style="text-align:center;padding:6px;background:var(--bg-inset);border-radius:6px"><b style="color:#38bdf8">${summary.new}</b><div style="font-size:9px;opacity:.6">New</div></div>
    <div style="text-align:center;padding:6px;background:var(--bg-inset);border-radius:6px"><b style="color:#f59e0b">${summary.modified}</b><div style="font-size:9px;opacity:.6">Mod</div></div>
    <div style="text-align:center;padding:6px;background:var(--bg-inset);border-radius:6px"><b style="color:#ef4444">${summary.deleted}</b><div style="font-size:9px;opacity:.6">Del</div></div>
  </div>`;
  if (!rules.length) {
    html += `<p style="color:var(--text-tertiary)">No monitoring rules. Add a rule for a linked model.</p>`;
  } else {
    for (const r of rules) {
      html += `<div style="padding:6px 8px;margin-bottom:4px;background:var(--bg-inset);border-radius:6px">
        <b>${esc(r.name)}</b>
        <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-tertiary)">${esc(r.sourceModelId)} ${r.categoryFilter ? "- " + esc(r.categoryFilter) : ""}</div>
      </div>`;
    }
  }
  html += `<button data-action="ack-all" style="margin-top:8px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;
    background:var(--bg-hover);border:1px solid var(--border-default);cursor:pointer">Acknowledge All</button>`;
  return html;
}

function bindPanel(id: PanelId, el: HTMLDivElement): void {
  const body = el.querySelector("[data-body]") as HTMLElement;

  body.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
    const action = t.getAttribute("data-action");
    if (action === "add-room") {
      roomsStore.createRoom({
        name: "Room",
        boundary: [
          { x: 0, z: 0 },
          { x: 4, z: 0 },
          { x: 4, z: 3 },
          { x: 0, z: 3 },
        ],
      });
      refresh(id);
    }
    if (action === "add-phase") {
      const name = window.prompt("Phase name:", "Phase") ?? "";
      if (name) {
        phasesStore.create(name);
        refresh(id);
      }
    }
    if (action === "add-set") {
      const name = window.prompt("Option set name:", "Design Options") ?? "";
      if (name) {
        designOptionsStore.createSet(name);
        refresh(id);
      }
    }
    if (action === "ack-all") {
      copyMonitorStore.acknowledgeAll();
      refresh(id);
    }
    const setId = t.getAttribute("data-set");
    const optId = t.getAttribute("data-opt");
    if (setId && optId) {
      designOptionsStore.setActive(setId, optId);
      refresh(id);
    }
  });

  body.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
    const t = e.target as HTMLSelectElement;
    if (t.matches("[data-phase]")) {
      phasesStore.setCurrent(t.value);
      refresh(id);
    }
    if (t.matches("[data-filter]")) {
      phasesStore.setFilter(t.value as any);
      refresh(id);
    }
  });
}

function refresh(id: PanelId): void {
  const el = panels.get(id);
  if (!el) return;
  const body = el.querySelector("[data-body]") as HTMLElement;
  if (id === "rooms") body.innerHTML = renderRooms();
  if (id === "phases") body.innerHTML = renderPhases();
  if (id === "design-options") body.innerHTML = renderDesignOptions();
  if (id === "groups") body.innerHTML = renderGroups();
  if (id === "copy-monitor") body.innerHTML = renderCopyMonitor();
}

function openPanel(id: PanelId): void {
  let el = panels.get(id);
  if (!el) {
    const titles: Record<PanelId, string> = {
      rooms: "Rooms & Areas",
      phases: "Phasing",
      "design-options": "Design Options",
      groups: "Model Groups",
      "copy-monitor": "Copy / Monitor",
    };
    el = shell(titles[id], "");
    panels.set(id, el);
    bindPanel(id, el);
  }
  refresh(id);
  el.style.display = "block";
}

export function setupGapPanels(): void {
  window.addEventListener("obs-open-panel", ((e: CustomEvent) => {
    const id = e.detail?.id as PanelId;
    if (id && ["rooms", "phases", "design-options", "groups", "copy-monitor"].includes(id)) {
      openPanel(id);
    }
  }) as EventListener);
  console.log("[gap-panels] ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Panel wiring — one place that connects Federation, Standards and CDE
 * panels to the command palette and the typed service registry.
 *
 * Panels boot at different phases; every command resolves the target
 * feature lazily at call time, so this can be installed early.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { registerCommand, unregisterCommand, listCommands } from "./command-palette";
import { register, type PanelService } from "../core/services";
import { notify } from "../core/notify";

interface PanelModule {
  open?: () => void;
  close?: () => void;
  toggle?: () => void;
  isVisible?: () => boolean;
}

interface PanelSpec {
  key: string;
  serviceKey: "federationPanel" | "standardsPanel" | "cdePanel";
  label: string;
  kbd?: string;
  aliases: string[];
}

const PANELS: PanelSpec[] = [
  {
    key: "federationPanel",
    serviceKey: "federationPanel",
    label: "Federation",
    kbd: "Ctrl+Shift+F",
    aliases: ["federation", "federate", "models", "combine", "align"],
  },
  {
    key: "standardsPanel",
    serviceKey: "standardsPanel",
    label: "Standards",
    kbd: "Ctrl+Shift+D",
    aliases: ["standards", "code", "compliance", "rule", "check", "ids"],
  },
  {
    key: "cdePanel",
    serviceKey: "cdePanel",
    label: "Common Data Environment",
    kbd: "Ctrl+Shift+E",
    aliases: ["cde", "acc", "bim360", "cloud", "sharepoint", "onedrive", "drive"],
  },
];

function toService(mod: PanelModule): PanelService & { open(): void; close(): void } {
  return {
    toggle: () => { mod.toggle?.(); },
    isVisible: () => !!mod.isVisible?.(),
    open: () => { mod.open?.(); },
    close: () => { mod.close?.(); },
  };
}

function lookup(spec: PanelSpec): PanelModule | undefined {
  return (ctx.features as Record<string, unknown>)[spec.key] as PanelModule | undefined;
}

function installCommand(spec: PanelSpec): void {
  registerCommand({
    id: `panel.${spec.key}.toggle`,
    label: `Toggle ${spec.label}`,
    category: "Panels",
    kbd: spec.kbd,
    hint: spec.aliases.join(", "),
    run: () => {
      const mod = lookup(spec);
      if (!mod?.toggle) {
        notify("warn", `${spec.label} panel is not loaded yet`);
        return;
      }
      mod.toggle();
    },
  });

  registerCommand({
    id: `panel.${spec.key}.open`,
    label: `Open ${spec.label}`,
    category: "Panels",
    run: () => {
      const mod = lookup(spec);
      if (!mod?.open) { notify("warn", `${spec.label} panel is not loaded`); return; }
      mod.open();
    },
  });

  registerCommand({
    id: `panel.${spec.key}.close`,
    label: `Close ${spec.label}`,
    category: "Panels",
    run: () => lookup(spec)?.close?.(),
  });
}

function installServiceFacade(spec: PanelSpec): void {
  const mod = lookup(spec);
  if (!mod) return;
  try {
    register(spec.serviceKey, toService(mod) as PanelService);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[panel-wiring] could not register service", spec.serviceKey, err);
  }
}

export function setupPanelWiring(): void {
  // Idempotent — re-registering a command overwrites.
  for (const spec of PANELS) installCommand(spec);

  // If a panel loads after us, its feature lands on ctx.features. Poll
  // briefly (500 ms × 20 = 10 s) then stop — this avoids a permanent timer.
  let ticks = 0;
  const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
    ticks++;
    let allReady = true;
    for (const spec of PANELS) {
      const mod = lookup(spec);
      if (!mod) { allReady = false; continue; }
      installServiceFacade(spec);
    }
    if (allReady || ticks >= 20) window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, 500);

  // Allow panels to announce themselves by dispatching an event.
  window.addEventListener("obs-panel-registered", (e) => {
    const detail = (e as CustomEvent).detail as { key?: string } | undefined;
    if (!detail?.key) return;
    const spec = PANELS.find((p) => p.key === detail.key);
    if (spec) installServiceFacade(spec);
  });

  console.log("[panel-wiring] federation / standards / CDE commands installed");

  // Also expose a tiny fan-out for the ribbon: "Panels" group button.
  (ctx.features as any).panelWiring = {
    toggleFederation: () => lookup(PANELS[0])?.toggle?.(),
    toggleStandards: () => lookup(PANELS[1])?.toggle?.(),
    toggleCde: () => lookup(PANELS[2])?.toggle?.(),
    list: () => listCommands().filter((c) => c.id.startsWith("panel.")),
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Parametric Family Panel - clear UI to inspect/edit family parameters,
 * formulas, constraints, and rebuild geometry (Revit family types feel).
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let panel: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let styleOk = false;
let selectedFamilyId: string | null = null;
let selectedTypeId: string | null = null;

function familySvc(): Any {
  return (
    (window as Any).__obsFamilyParametric ??
    (window as Any).__obsFamily ??
    (ctx.features as Any)?.family ??
    {}
  );
}

function toast(kind: string, msg: string): void {
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("obs-toast", { detail: { kind, message: msg, timeout: 2000 } }),
    );
  } catch {
    console.log(`[param-panel] ${msg}`);
  }
}

function installStyle(): void {
  if (styleOk) return;
  styleOk = true;
  const s = document.createElement("style");
  s.textContent = `
#obs-param-family-panel {
  position: fixed; top: 100px; right: 16px; width: 340px; z-index: 8650;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 140px); overflow: auto;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg,#1a1d27,#12141c);
  border: 1px solid #2a2e3a; border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  color: #e8eaf0; font: 12px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
  display: none;
}
#obs-param-family-panel.is-open { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-hdr {
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 12px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #1e2029;background:#181a23;cursor:grab;
  border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;
}
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-hdr b {
  flex:1;font-size:13px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e8eaf0,#34d399);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-close {
  width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;
  background:transparent;color:#94a3b8;cursor:pointer;
}
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-body { padding:10px 12px 14px; }
#obs-param-family-panel select, #obs-param-family-panel input {
  width:100%;padding:6px 8px;margin:4px 0 8px;
  background:#0e1017;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:6px;
  color:#e8eaf0;font:12px Inter,system-ui;
}
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-row {
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 100px;gap:6px;align-items:center;
  margin-bottom:6px;
}
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-row label {
  color:#94a3b8;font-size:11px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;
}
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-row label .formula {
  display:block;color:#34d399;font:10px ui-monospace,monospace;
}
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-actions {
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-top:10px;
}
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-btn {
  padding:8px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;
  background:#1e2029;color:#e8eaf0;cursor:pointer;font:600 11px Inter,system-ui;
}
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-btn:hover { border-color:#34d399; }
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-status {
  margin-top:8px;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:6px;
  background:rgba(52,211,153,.08);border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,.2);
  color:#6ee7b7;font-size:11px;
}
#obs-param-family-panel .pf-sec {
  font:700 9px/1 Inter,system-ui;letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#6b7280;margin:10px 0 6px;
}
`;
  document.head.appendChild(s);
}

function buildPanel(): void {
  if (panel) return;
  installStyle();
  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = "obs-param-family-panel";
  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="pf-hdr">
      <b>Parametric Families</b>
      <button class="pf-close" type="button">-</button>
    </div>
    <div class="pf-body">
      <div class="pf-sec">Family</div>
      <select data-family></select>
      <div class="pf-sec">Type</div>
      <select data-type></select>
      <div class="pf-sec">Parameters</div>
      <div data-params></div>
      <div class="pf-actions">
        <button class="pf-btn" data-act="rebuild" type="button">Rebuild geometry</button>
        <button class="pf-btn" data-act="place" type="button">Place instance</button>
        <button class="pf-btn" data-act="apply-type" type="button">Save type values</button>
        <button class="pf-btn" data-act="constraints" type="button">Show constraints</button>
      </div>
      <div class="pf-status" data-status>Select a family to edit parameters.</div>
    </div>
  `;
  document.body.appendChild(panel);

  panel.querySelector(".pf-close")?.addEventListener("click", () => closeParamFamilyPanel());

  panel.querySelector("[data-family]")?.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
    selectedFamilyId = (e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value || null;
    selectedTypeId = null;
    refreshTypes();
    refreshParams();
  });
  panel.querySelector("[data-type]")?.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
    selectedTypeId = (e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value || null;
    refreshParams();
  });

  panel.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const act = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest("[data-act]")?.getAttribute("data-act");
    if (!act) return;
    const svc = familySvc();
    if (act === "rebuild") {
      if (!selectedFamilyId) return;
      if (typeof svc.buildParametric === "function") {
        const result = svc.buildParametric(selectedFamilyId, selectedTypeId);
        const err = result?.errors?.length ? result.errors.join("; ") : "";
        const status = panel!.querySelector("[data-status]") as HTMLElement;
        if (result?.object) {
          // Add preview to scene
          try {
            const scene = (ctx as Any).world?.scene?.three;
            if (scene) {
              let g = scene.getObjectByName("obs-param-preview");
              if (g) scene.remove(g);
              result.object.name = "obs-param-preview";
              result.object.position.set(0, 0, 0);
              scene.add(result.object);
            }
          } catch { /* */ }
          status.textContent = err
            ? `Built with warnings: ${err}`
            : `Geometry built - ${Object.keys(result.params ?? {}).length} params`;
          toast("success", "Parametric geometry rebuilt");
        } else {
          status.textContent = err || "Build failed";
          toast("warn", "Build failed");
        }
      } else if (typeof svc.buildGeometry === "function") {
        const obj = svc.buildGeometry(selectedFamilyId, selectedTypeId);
        toast(obj ? "success" : "warn", obj ? "Geometry built" : "Build failed");
      }
    }
    if (act === "place") {
      const fam = svc.get?.(selectedFamilyId);
      if (!fam) return;
      try {
        const a = (ctx.features as Any)?.authoring;
        if (a?.setAuthoringTool && fam.sourceElementType) {
          a.setAuthoringTool(fam.sourceElementType);
          if (a.setActiveFamily) a.setActiveFamily(fam.id, selectedTypeId);
          toast("info", `Place tool: ${fam.sourceElementType}`);
        } else {
          toast("info", "Use Family Browser to place - or Rebuild for 3D preview");
        }
      } catch {
        toast("info", "Rebuild for preview; place via Family Browser");
      }
    }
    if (act === "apply-type") {
      if (!selectedFamilyId || !selectedTypeId) {
        toast("info", "Select a type first");
        return;
      }
      const values = readParamInputs();
      svc.updateType?.(selectedFamilyId, selectedTypeId, { values });
      toast("success", "Type values saved");
      refreshParams();
    }
    if (act === "constraints") {
      const list = svc.getConstraints?.(selectedFamilyId) ?? [];
      const status = panel!.querySelector("[data-status]") as HTMLElement;
      status.textContent = list.length
        ? `Constraints: ${list.map((c: Any) => c.kind).join(", ")}`
        : "No constraints on this family";
    }
  });

  // Drag
  const hdr = panel.querySelector(".pf-hdr") as HTMLElement;
  let dragging = false, sx = 0, sy = 0, ox = 0, oy = 0;
  hdr.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest("button")) return;
    dragging = true;
    sx = e.clientX;
    sy = e.clientY;
    const r = panel!.getBoundingClientRect();
    ox = r.left;
    oy = r.top;
    hdr.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  hdr.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    if (!dragging || !panel) return;
    panel.style.left = `${ox + e.clientX - sx}px`;
    panel.style.top = `${oy + e.clientY - sy}px`;
    panel.style.right = "auto";
  });
  hdr.addEventListener("pointerup", () => {
    dragging = false;
  });
}

function readParamInputs(): Record<string, any> {
  const values: Record<string, any> = {};
  panel?.querySelectorAll("[data-param]").forEach((el) => {
    const name = (el as HTMLElement).getAttribute("data-param")!;
    const input = el as HTMLInputElement;
    if (input.type === "checkbox") values[name] = input.checked;
    else if (input.type === "number") values[name] = Number(input.value);
    else values[name] = input.value;
  });
  return values;
}

function refreshFamilies(): void {
  const sel = panel?.querySelector("[data-family]") as HTMLSelectElement | null;
  if (!sel) return;
  const list = familySvc().list?.() ?? [];
  sel.innerHTML =
    `<option value="">- select -</option>` +
    list
      .map(
        (f: Any) =>
          `<option value="${f.id}" ${f.id === selectedFamilyId ? "selected" : ""}>${escapeHtml(
            f.name,
          )} (${f.category ?? "?"})</option>`,
      )
      .join("");
}

function refreshTypes(): void {
  const sel = panel?.querySelector("[data-type]") as HTMLSelectElement | null;
  if (!sel) return;
  const fam = selectedFamilyId ? familySvc().get?.(selectedFamilyId) : null;
  const types = fam?.types ?? [];
  if (!selectedTypeId && types[0]) selectedTypeId = types[0].id;
  sel.innerHTML =
    `<option value="">- default -</option>` +
    types
      .map(
        (t: Any) =>
          `<option value="${t.id}" ${t.id === selectedTypeId ? "selected" : ""}>${escapeHtml(
            t.name,
          )}</option>`,
      )
      .join("");
}

function refreshParams(): void {
  const host = panel?.querySelector("[data-params]") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!host) return;
  const svc = familySvc();
  const fam = selectedFamilyId ? svc.get?.(selectedFamilyId) : null;
  if (!fam) {
    host.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#6b7280">No family selected.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  const values =
    svc.resolveParametric?.(selectedFamilyId, selectedTypeId) ??
    svc.resolveParams?.(selectedFamilyId, selectedTypeId) ??
    {};

  host.innerHTML = (fam.parameters ?? [])
    .map((p: Any) => {
      const v = values[p.name] ?? p.default;
      const isFormula = !!p.formula;
      const readonly = isFormula || p.editable === false;
      if (p.type === "boolean") {
        return `<div class="pf-row">
          <label>${escapeHtml(p.name)}${
            isFormula ? `<span class="formula">= ${escapeHtml(p.formula)}</span>` : ""
          }</label>
          <input data-param="${escapeHtml(p.name)}" type="checkbox" ${v ? "checked" : ""} ${
            readonly ? "disabled" : ""
          }/>
        </div>`;
      }
      const inputType = p.type === "text" ? "text" : "number";
      return `<div class="pf-row">
        <label>${escapeHtml(p.name)}${
          isFormula ? `<span class="formula">= ${escapeHtml(String(p.formula))}</span>` : ""
        }</label>
        <input data-param="${escapeHtml(p.name)}" type="${inputType}" value="${escapeHtml(
          String(v ?? ""),
        )}" step="any" ${readonly ? "readonly" : ""}/>
      </div>`;
    })
    .join("");
}

function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as Any)[c],
  );
}

export function openParamFamilyPanel(): void {
  buildPanel();
  refreshFamilies();
  refreshTypes();
  refreshParams();
  panel?.classList.add("is-open");
}

export function closeParamFamilyPanel(): void {
  panel?.classList.remove("is-open");
}

export function toggleParamFamilyPanel(): void {
  if (panel?.classList.contains("is-open")) closeParamFamilyPanel();
  else openParamFamilyPanel();
}

export function setupParametricFamilyPanel(): void {
  const launch = document.createElement("button");
  launch.id = "obs-param-launch";
  launch.type = "button";
  launch.title = "Parametric Families (Ctrl+Shift+F)";
  launch.textContent = "FAM";
  launch.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;left:168px;bottom:52px;z-index:10002;width:44px;height:40px;" +
    "border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #34d399;background:rgba(52,211,153,.14);" +
    "color:#6ee7b7;font:700 11px Inter,system-ui;cursor:pointer;" +
    "box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);";
  launch.onclick = () => toggleParamFamilyPanel();
  document.body.appendChild(launch);

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && (e.key === "F" || e.key === "f")) {
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
      if (t?.closest?.("input,textarea,[contenteditable]")) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleParamFamilyPanel();
    }
  });

  void (async () => {
    try {
      const cp: Any = await import("./command-palette");
      cp.registerCommand?.({
        id: "parametric.familyPanel",
        label: "Parametric Families Panel",
        category: "Architecture",
        kbd: "Ctrl+Shift+F",
        run: () => toggleParamFamilyPanel(),
      });
    } catch { /* */ }
  })();

  (window as Any).__obsParamFamilyPanel = {
    open: openParamFamilyPanel,
    close: closeParamFamilyPanel,
    toggle: toggleParamFamilyPanel,
  };

  console.log("[parametric-family-panel] ready - FAM button or Ctrl+Shift+F");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Parity Tab Bar - docks all floating tools into bottom tabbed ribbon.
 * Tabs: Home | Architecture | Modify | View | CAD | Drawings | Families | Project
 */

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let installed = false;
let root: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let activeTab = "home";

interface TabDef {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  buttons: Array<{ id: string; label: string; title?: string; run: () => void }>;
}

function hideFloaters(): void {
  const ids = [
    "obs-rc-launch",
    "obs-cad-launch",
    "obs-dwg-launch",
    "obs-param-launch",
    "obs-adv-toolbar",
  ];
  for (const id of ids) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) {
      el.style.display = "none";
      el.setAttribute("data-parity-hidden", "1");
    }
  }
  // Hide any leftover floating parity launchers
  document.querySelectorAll("[id^=obs-][id$=-launch]").forEach((el) => {
    (el as HTMLElement).style.display = "none";
  });
}

function run(fn: () => void): void {
  try {
    fn();
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[parity-tabs]", e);
  }
}

function tabs(): TabDef[] {
  return [
    {
      id: "home",

        },
        {
          id: "hosts",
          label: "[H] Hosts",
          run: () => document.getElementById("obs-adv-hosts")?.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("click")),

        {

        {
          id: "stair",

function render(): void {
  if (!root) return;
  const list = tabs();
  const tabRow = list
    .map(
      (t) =>
        `<button type="button" class="pt-tab${t.id === activeTab ? " is-active" : ""}" data-tab="${t.id}">${t.label}</button>`,
    )
    .join("");
  const current = list.find((t) => t.id === activeTab) ?? list[0];
  const btns = current.buttons
    .map(
      (b) =>
        `<button type="button" class="pt-btn" data-run="${b.id}" title="${b.title ?? b.label}">${b.label}</button>`,
    )
    .join("");

  root.innerHTML = `
    <div class="pt-tabs">${tabRow}</div>
    <div class="pt-tools">${btns}</div>
  `;

  root.querySelectorAll("[data-tab]").forEach((el) => {
    el.addEventListener("click", () => {
      activeTab = (el as HTMLElement).getAttribute("data-tab") || "home";
      render();
    });
  });

  const map = new Map(current.buttons.map((b) => [b.id, b]));
  root.querySelectorAll("[data-run]").forEach((el) => {
    el.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const id = (el as HTMLElement).getAttribute("data-run") || "";
      const b = map.get(id);
      if (b) run(b.run);
    });
  });
}

function installStyle(): void {
  if (document.getElementById("obs-parity-tabs-style")) return;
  const s = document.createElement("style");
  s.id = "obs-parity-tabs-style";
  s.textContent = `
#obs-parity-tabs {

#obs-parity-tabs .pt-tab.is-active {
  color: #e8eaf0;
  background: #243044;
  border-color: #3b82f6;
}
#obs-parity-tabs .pt-btn {
  border: 1px solid #2a2e3a;
  background: #1a1d27;
  color: #e8eaf0;
  font: 600 11px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 7px 11px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
#obs-parity-tabs .pt-btn:hover {
  border-color: #3b82f6;
  background: #232633;
}
`;
  document.head.appendChild(s);
}

export function setupParityTabBar(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;
  // Migrated to top ribbon - do not show bottom tab bar
  const RIBBON_MIGRATED = true;
  if (RIBBON_MIGRATED) {
    const kill = () => {
      const el = document.getElementById("obs-parity-tabs");
      if (el) el.style.display = "none";
    };
    kill();
    window.setTimeout(kill, 500);
    console.log("[parity-tab-bar] skipped UI - tools moved to top ribbon");
    return;
  }
  installStyle();

  root = document.createElement("div");
  root.id = "obs-parity-tabs";
  document.body.appendChild(root);
  render();

  // Hide floaters after other modules create them
  hideFloaters();
  window.setTimeout(hideFloaters, 500);
  window.setTimeout(hideFloaters, 1500);
  window.setTimeout(hideFloaters, 3000);

  // Observe new floaters
  const mo = new MutationObserver(() => hideFloaters());
  mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  (window as Any).__obsParityTabs = {
    setTab: (id: string) => {
      activeTab = id;
      render();
    },
    showFloaters: () => {
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-parity-hidden]").forEach((el) => {
        (el as HTMLElement).style.display = "";
        el.removeAttribute("data-parity-hidden");
      });
    },
  };

  console.log("[parity-tab-bar] tabbed ribbon ready (floaters hidden)");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * P&ID Modeler â€” 2D Process & Instrumentation Diagram sketch pad.
 *
 * A lightweight SVG canvas where the user can place P&ID symbols
 * (pumps, valves, tanks, instruments) and connect them with process
 * lines. Data is stored per project via localStorage.
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";

const SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
const STORE_KEY = "obs.pid.diagram.v1";

type SymbolKind = "pump" | "valve" | "tank" | "instrument" | "line";

interface PidSymbol {
  id: string;
  kind: SymbolKind;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  label: string;
}

interface PidDiagram {
  symbols: PidSymbol[];
  lines: Array<{ id: string; x1: number; y1: number; x2: number; y2: number }>;
}

let panel: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let canvasHost: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let currentTool: SymbolKind = "pump";
let visible = false;
let diagram: PidDiagram = { symbols: [], lines: [] };
let selectedId: string | null = null;
let pendingLineStart: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;

function loadDiagram(): void {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY);
    if (raw) diagram = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch { /* */ }
}
function saveDiagram(): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(diagram)); } catch { /* */ }
}

export function setupPidModeler(): void {
  loadDiagram();

  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = "obs-pid-modeler";
  panel.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;left:400px;top:120px;right:20px;bottom:60px;z-index:33;" +
    "display:none;flex-direction:column;background:#1a1d27;color:#e8eaf0;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.5);font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden";
  panel.onmousedown = (e) => e.stopPropagation();

  // Header + toolbar
  const header = document.createElement("div");
  header.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 12px;flex-wrap:wrap;" +
    "border-bottom:1px solid #2a2e3a;background:#12141b;flex-shrink:0";
  header.innerHTML = "<div style='font-weight:700'>\u2699 P&ID Modeler</div>";

  const toolDefs: Array<{ kind: SymbolKind; label: string; color: string }> = [
    { kind: "pump",       label: "Pump",      color: "#38bdf8" },
    { kind: "valve",      label: "Valve",     color: "#22c55e" },
    { kind: "tank",       label: "Tank",      color: "#a855f7" },
    { kind: "instrument", label: "Instrument", color: "#f59e0b" },
    { kind: "line",       label: "Process Line", color: "#94a3b8" },
  ];

  const toolButtons = new Map<SymbolKind, HTMLButtonElement>();
  function refreshTools(): void {
    for (const [k, b] of toolButtons) {
      const active = k === currentTool;
      b.style.background = active ? "#38bdf8" : "transparent";
      b.style.color = active ? "#0b0d12" : "#cbd5e1";
      b.style.borderColor = active ? "#38bdf8" : "#2a2e3a";
    }
  }

  for (const t of toolDefs) {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.textContent = t.label;
    b.style.cssText =
      "padding:4px 10px;background:transparent;color:#cbd5e1;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;" +
      "border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font:11px system-ui";
    b.onclick = () => { currentTool = t.kind; pendingLineStart = null; refreshTools(); };
    toolButtons.set(t.kind, b);
    header.appendChild(b);
  }
  refreshTools();

  const spacer = document.createElement("div");
  spacer.style.cssText = "flex:1";
  header.appendChild(spacer);

  const clearBtn = document.createElement("button");
  clearBtn.textContent = "Clear";
  clearBtn.style.cssText =
    "padding:4px 10px;background:transparent;color:#fca5a5;border:1px solid #ef4444;" +
    "border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font:11px system-ui";
  clearBtn.onclick = () => {
    if (!confirm("Clear the P&ID diagram?")) return;
    diagram = { symbols: [], lines: [] };
    saveDiagram();
    render();
  };
  header.appendChild(clearBtn);

  const exportBtn = document.createElement("button");
  exportBtn.textContent = "Export SVG";
  exportBtn.style.cssText =
    "padding:4px 10px;background:transparent;color:#cbd5e1;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;" +
    "border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font:11px system-ui";
  exportBtn.onclick = exportSvg;
  header.appendChild(exportBtn);

  canvasHost = document.createElement("div");
  canvasHost.style.cssText = "flex:1;overflow:auto;background:#f7f7f5;position:relative";

  panel.append(header, canvasHost);
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);

  (ctx.features as any).pidModeler = {
    show: () => { visible = true; if (panel) panel.style.display = "flex"; render(); },
    hide: () => { visible = false; if (panel) panel.style.display = "none"; },
    toggle: () => { visible ? (ctx.features as any).pidModeler.hide() : (ctx.features as any).pidModeler.show(); },
    isVisible: () => visible,
  };
}

function render(): void {
  if (!canvasHost) return;
  canvasHost.innerHTML = "";

  const svg = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "svg");
  svg.setAttribute("width", "100%");
  svg.setAttribute("height", "100%");
  svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 1000 700");
  svg.style.cssText = "display:block;background:#f7f7f5;cursor:crosshair";

  // Grid
  for (let x = 0; x <= 1000; x += 20) {
    const line = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "line");
    line.setAttribute("x1", String(x));
    line.setAttribute("y1", "0");
    line.setAttribute("x2", String(x));
    line.setAttribute("y2", "700");
    line.setAttribute("stroke", x % 100 === 0 ? "#d1d5db" : "#eceff3");
    line.setAttribute("stroke-width", x % 100 === 0 ? "1" : "0.5");
    svg.appendChild(line);
  }
  for (let y = 0; y <= 700; y += 20) {
    const line = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "line");
    line.setAttribute("x1", "0");
    line.setAttribute("y1", String(y));
    line.setAttribute("x2", "1000");
    line.setAttribute("y2", String(y));
    line.setAttribute("stroke", y % 100 === 0 ? "#d1d5db" : "#eceff3");
    line.setAttribute("stroke-width", y % 100 === 0 ? "1" : "0.5");
    svg.appendChild(line);
  }

  // Lines
  for (const line of diagram.lines) {
    const el = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "line");
    el.setAttribute("x1", String(line.x1));
    el.setAttribute("y1", String(line.y1));
    el.setAttribute("x2", String(line.x2));
    el.setAttribute("y2", String(line.y2));
    el.setAttribute("stroke", "#111827");
    el.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
    svg.appendChild(el);
  }

  // Symbols
  for (const sym of diagram.symbols) {
    const g = drawSymbol(sym);
    g.setAttribute("data-symbol-id", sym.id);
    g.style.cursor = "move";
    const isSelected = sym.id === selectedId;
    if (isSelected) {
      const ring = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "circle");
      ring.setAttribute("cx", String(sym.x));
      ring.setAttribute("cy", String(sym.y));
      ring.setAttribute("r", "26");
      ring.setAttribute("fill", "none");
      ring.setAttribute("stroke", "#38bdf8");
      ring.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
      ring.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "4 2");
      g.appendChild(ring);
    }
    g.addEventListener("mousedown", (ev) => {
      ev.stopPropagation();
      selectedId = sym.id;
      render();
    });
    svg.appendChild(g);
  }

  // Click to place / start line
  svg.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
    const rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = Math.round(((ev.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 1000 / 10) * 10;
    const y = Math.round(((ev.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 700 / 10) * 10;
    placeAt(x, y);
  });

  canvasHost.appendChild(svg);
}

function placeAt(x: number, y: number): void {
  if (currentTool === "line") {
    if (!pendingLineStart) {
      pendingLineStart = { x, y };
    } else {
      diagram.lines.push({
        id: "l-" + Date.now().toString(36),
        x1: pendingLineStart.x,
        y1: pendingLineStart.y,
        x2: x,
        y2: y,
      });
      pendingLineStart = null;
      saveDiagram();
      render();
    }
    return;
  }

  const label = currentTool === "instrument"
    ? prompt("Instrument tag (e.g. FT-101):", "FT-101")
    : prompt("Symbol label:", currentTool.toUpperCase());
  if (label == null) return;

  diagram.symbols.push({
    id: "s-" + Date.now().toString(36),
    kind: currentTool,
    x, y,
    label: label || currentTool,
  });
  saveDiagram();
  render();
}

function drawSymbol(sym: PidSymbol): SVGGElement {
  const g = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "g");
  const cx = sym.x;
  const cy = sym.y;

  if (sym.kind === "pump") {
    const circle = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "circle");
    circle.setAttribute("cx", String(cx));
    circle.setAttribute("cy", String(cy));
    circle.setAttribute("r", "18");
    circle.setAttribute("fill", "white");
    circle.setAttribute("stroke", "#111827");
    circle.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
    g.appendChild(circle);
    const tri = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "polygon");
    tri.setAttribute("points", (cx - 8) + "," + (cy - 8) + " " + (cx + 8) + "," + cy + " " + (cx - 8) + "," + (cy + 8));
    tri.setAttribute("fill", "none");
    tri.setAttribute("stroke", "#111827");
    tri.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
    g.appendChild(tri);
  } else if (sym.kind === "valve") {
    const poly = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "polygon");
    poly.setAttribute("points", (cx - 14) + "," + (cy - 10) + " " + (cx + 14) + "," + (cy - 10) + " " + cx + "," + cy + " " + (cx + 14) + "," + (cy + 10) + " " + (cx - 14) + "," + (cy + 10) + " " + cx + "," + cy);
    poly.setAttribute("fill", "white");
    poly.setAttribute("stroke", "#111827");
    poly.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
    g.appendChild(poly);
  } else if (sym.kind === "tank") {
    const rect = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "rect");
    rect.setAttribute("x", String(cx - 24));
    rect.setAttribute("y", String(cy - 20));
    rect.setAttribute("width", "48");
    rect.setAttribute("height", "40");
    rect.setAttribute("rx", "6");
    rect.setAttribute("fill", "white");
    rect.setAttribute("stroke", "#111827");
    rect.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
    g.appendChild(rect);
  } else if (sym.kind === "instrument") {
    const circle = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "circle");
    circle.setAttribute("cx", String(cx));
    circle.setAttribute("cy", String(cy));
    circle.setAttribute("r", "18");
    circle.setAttribute("fill", "white");
    circle.setAttribute("stroke", "#111827");
    circle.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
    g.appendChild(circle);
    const line = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "line");
    line.setAttribute("x1", String(cx - 18));
    line.setAttribute("y1", String(cy));
    line.setAttribute("x2", String(cx + 18));
    line.setAttribute("y2", String(cy));
    line.setAttribute("stroke", "#111827");
    line.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
    g.appendChild(line);
  }

  const label = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "text");
  label.setAttribute("x", String(cx));
  label.setAttribute("y", String(cy + 34));
  label.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
  label.setAttribute("font-family", "ui-monospace, monospace");
  label.setAttribute("font-size", "11");
  label.setAttribute("fill", "#374151");
  label.setAttribute("font-weight", "600");
  label.textContent = sym.label;
  g.appendChild(label);

  return g;
}

function exportSvg(): void {
  if (!canvasHost) return;
  const svg = canvasHost.querySelector("svg");
  if (!svg) return;
  const xml = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svg);
  const blob = new Blob(["<?xml version=\"1.0\"?>\n" + xml], { type: "image/svg+xml" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = "pid-diagram.svg";
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
}
```

```ts
  const sel = (window as any).__obsPlanSelectedEl;
  if (selectedEls.length > 1) {

    const info = document.createElement("div");
    info.style.cssText = "padding:12px;color:#374151;line-height:1.5";

    planPropsBody.appendChild(info);

  }
  if (sel) {
    el = sel;

  }

  }

  const schema = getSchema(typeKey);
  const title = el
    ? `${schema?.label ?? typeKey} — ${el.name ?? el.id}`
    : `${schema?.label ?? typeKey} (type defaults)`;

  if (!schema) {
    planPropsBody.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:12px;color:#6b7280">No schema for ${typeKey}</div>`;
    return;

  for (const group of schema.groups) {
    const fields = schema.fields.filter((f) => f.group === group);
    if (!fields.length) continue;
    const gh = document.createElement("div");
    gh.style.cssText =
      "padding:6px 12px;background:#dbeafe;color:#1e3a8a;font-weight:600;font-size:11px;border-bottom:1px solid #bfdbfe";
    gh.textContent = group;
    planPropsBody.appendChild(gh);

    for (const field of fields) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.cssText =
        "display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e7eb;min-height:28px";

      lab.textContent = field.label + (field.unit ? ` (${field.unit})` : "");
      const cell = document.createElement("div");

        const sel = document.createElement("select");
        sel.style.cssText = "width:100%;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:3px;font:12px system-ui;background:#fff";
        for (const o of field.options) {
          const opt = document.createElement("option");
          opt.value = o.value;
          opt.textContent = o.label;
          if (o.value === val) opt.selected = true;
          sel.appendChild(opt);
        }
        sel.onchange = () => applyPlanField(field, sel.value, el, typeKey);
        input = sel;
      } else if (field.type === "boolean") {
        const cb = document.createElement("input");
        cb.type = "checkbox";
        cb.checked = val === "true" || val === "1";
        cb.onchange = () => applyPlanField(field, cb.checked ? "true" : "false", el, typeKey);
        input = cb;
      } else if (field.type === "color") {
        const c = document.createElement("input");
        c.type = "color";
        c.value = val && val.startsWith("#") ? val : "#94a3b8";
        c.oninput = () => applyPlanField(field, c.value, el, typeKey);
        input = c;
      } else {
        const inp = document.createElement("input");
        inp.type = field.type === "number" ? "number" : "text";
        if (field.step) inp.step = String(field.step);
        if (field.min != null) inp.min = String(field.min);
        inp.value = val;
        inp.style.cssText = "width:100%;border:1px solid transparent;padding:3px 4px;font:12px system-ui;background:transparent";
        inp.onfocus = () => { inp.style.borderColor = "#2563eb"; inp.style.background = "#eff6ff"; };
        inp.onblur = () => {
          inp.style.borderColor = "transparent";
          inp.style.background = "transparent";
          applyPlanField(field, inp.value, el, typeKey);
        };
        inp.onchange = () => applyPlanField(field, inp.value, el, typeKey);
        input = inp;
      }
      cell.appendChild(input);
      row.append(lab, cell);
      planPropsBody.appendChild(row);
    }
  }
}

async function applyPlanField(field: PropertyField, raw: string, el: any, typeKey: string) {
  try {
    if (!el) {
      // Type defaults → placement options
      if (field.key === "thickness") {
        planWidth = Number(raw) || planWidth;
        const wi = widthInp.querySelector("input") as HTMLInputElement | null;
        if (wi) wi.value = String(Math.round(planWidth * 1000));
      }
      if (field.key === "height") {
        planHeight = Number(raw) || planHeight;
        const hi = heightInp.querySelector("input") as HTMLInputElement | null;
        if (hi) hi.value = String(Math.round(planHeight * 1000));
      }
      if (field.key === "elevation") {
        planElevOffset = Number(raw) || 0;
        const ei = elevInp.querySelector("input") as HTMLInputElement | null;
        if (ei) ei.value = String(Math.round(planElevOffset * 1000));
      }
      // Persist type defaults
      try {
        const auth = await import("./authoring");
        if ((auth as any).setTypeDefault) {
          (auth as any).setTypeDefault(typeKey, field.key, field.type === "number" ? Number(raw) : raw, field.target);
        }
      } catch { /* */ }
      return;
    }
    // Edit selected element
    if (field.target === "root") (el as any)[field.key] = field.type === "number" ? Number(raw) : raw;
    else if (field.target === "params") {
      (el.params as any)[field.key] = field.type === "number" ? Number(raw) : raw;
      if (field.key === "thickness") planWidth = Number(raw) || planWidth;
      if (field.key === "height") planHeight = Number(raw) || planHeight;
    } else {
      if (!el.properties) el.properties = {};
      el.properties[field.key] = field.type === "number" ? Number(raw) : raw;
    }
    const auth = await import("./authoring");
    auth.rebuildAuthored?.();
    await regenerate();
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[plan] apply field", err);
  }
}

applyBtn.onclick = () => {
  renderPlanProperties();
  footerStatus("Properties applied");
};

function setPlanSelectedElement(el: any | null, mode: "replace" | "add" | "toggle" = "replace") {
  if (mode === "replace") {
    planSelectedIds.clear();
    if (el?.id) planSelectedIds.add(el.id);
  } else if (el?.id && mode === "add") {
    planSelectedIds.add(el.id);
  } else if (el?.id && mode === "toggle") {
    if (planSelectedIds.has(el.id)) planSelectedIds.delete(el.id);
    else planSelectedIds.add(el.id);
  }
  planSelectedId = planSelectedIds.size === 1 ? [...planSelectedIds][0] : null;
  const selected = (((window as any).__obsAuthoredElements ?? []) as any[]).filter((x) => planSelectedIds.has(x.id));
  (window as any).__obsPlanSelectedEl = selected.length === 1 ? selected[0] : null;
  (window as any).__obsPlanSelectedEls = selected;
  try {
    (window as any).__obsAuthoredSelectionBridge?.(selected.map((x) => x.id));
  } catch { /* selection bridge optional */ }
  renderPlanProperties();
  if (currentPlan) renderPlan(currentPlan);
}

(window as any).__obsAuthoredSelectionBridge = (ids: string[]) => {
  try { void import("./authoring").then((m) => m.setSelectedAuthored(ids, "replace")); } catch { /* optional */ }
};

function nearestAuthoredAt(hit: { x: number; z: number }): { element: any | null; distance: number } {
  const els = ((window as any).__obsAuthoredElements ?? []) as any[];
  let best: any = null;
  let bestD = 1.25; // meters — generous so thick ducts/walls are easy to click
  for (const el of els) {
    const p = el?.params ?? {};
    const half = Math.max(0.04, Number(p.thickness ?? p.width ?? 0.2) * 0.55);
    if (p.start && p.end) {
      const ax = p.start[0], az = p.start[1], bx = p.end[0], bz = p.end[1];
      const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
      const l2 = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1;
      let t = ((hit.x - ax) * dx + (hit.z - az) * dz) / l2;
      t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
      const px = ax + t * dx, pz = az + t * dz;
      const d = Math.hypot(hit.x - px, hit.z - pz) - half;
      if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = el; }
    } else if (p.point) {
      const d = Math.hypot(hit.x - p.point[0], hit.z - p.point[1]) - half;
      if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = el; }
    } else if (Array.isArray(p.polygon) && p.polygon.length) {
      // Point in / near polygon bbox
      let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minZ = Infinity, maxZ = -Infinity;
      for (const v of p.polygon) {
        if (v[0] < minX) minX = v[0]; if (v[0] > maxX) maxX = v[0];
        if (v[1] < minZ) minZ = v[1]; if (v[1] > maxZ) maxZ = v[1];
      }
      if (hit.x >= minX - half && hit.x <= maxX + half && hit.z >= minZ - half && hit.z <= maxZ + half) {
        const cx = (minX + maxX) / 2, cz = (minZ + maxZ) / 2;
        const d = Math.hypot(hit.x - cx, hit.z - cz);
        if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = el; }
      }
    }
  }
  if (bestD > 0.85) return { element: null, distance: bestD };
  return { element: best, distance: Math.max(0, bestD) };
}



function linearBoundaryCandidate(el: any, point: { x: number; z: number }) {
  const p = el?.params ?? {};
  if (!p.start || !p.end) return null;
  const [ax, az] = p.start, [bx, bz] = p.end;
  const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
  const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  if (L < 1e-6) return null;
  const ux = dx / L, uz = dz / L;
  const nx = -uz, nz = ux;
  const half = Math.max(0.01, Number(p.thickness ?? p.width ?? 0.2) / 2);
  const qx = point.x - ax, qz = point.z - az;
  const tRaw = (qx * ux + qz * uz) / L;
  const nRaw = qx * nx + qz * nz;
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tRaw));
  const sideT = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, tRaw));
  const sideLeft = { x: ax + ux * (sideT * L) + nx * half, z: az + uz * (sideT * L) + nz * half };
  const sideRight = { x: ax + ux * (sideT * L) - nx * half, z: az + uz * (sideT * L) - nz * half };
  const startN = Math.max(-half, Math.min(half, nRaw));
  const startPt = { x: ax + nx * startN, z: az + nz * startN };
  const endPt = { x: bx + nx * startN, z: bz + nz * startN };
  const cands = [
    { point: sideLeft, distance: Math.hypot(point.x - sideLeft.x, point.z - sideLeft.z), ref: { elementId: String(el.id), kind: "linear-side" as const, t: sideT, side: "left" as const } },
    { point: sideRight, distance: Math.hypot(point.x - sideRight.x, point.z - sideRight.z), ref: { elementId: String(el.id), kind: "linear-side" as const, t: sideT, side: "right" as const } },
    { point: startPt, distance: Math.hypot(point.x - startPt.x, point.z - startPt.z), ref: { elementId: String(el.id), kind: "linear-cap" as const, t: 0, n: startN, side: "start" as const } },
    { point: endPt, distance: Math.hypot(point.x - endPt.x, point.z - endPt.z), ref: { elementId: String(el.id), kind: "linear-cap" as const, t: 1, n: startN, side: "end" as const } },
  ];
  cands.sort((a,b)=>a.distance-b.distance);
  return cands[0] ?? null;
}

function pointBoundaryCandidate(el: any, point: { x: number; z: number }) {
  const p = el?.params ?? {};
  if (!p.point) return null;
  const cx = Number(p.point[0]), cz = Number(p.point[1]);
  const halfW = Math.max(0.01, Number(p.width ?? p.thickness ?? 0.3) / 2);
  const halfD = Math.max(0.01, Number(p.depth ?? p.thickness ?? p.width ?? 0.3) / 2);
  const cands = [
    { point: {x: cx-halfW,z: cz}, distance: Math.hypot(point.x-(cx-halfW),point.z-cz), ref: {elementId:String(el.id),kind:"point-edge" as const,dx:-halfW,dz:0,side:"left" as const}},
    { point: {x: cx+halfW,z: cz}, distance: Math.hypot(point.x-(cx+halfW),point.z-cz), ref: {elementId:String(el.id),kind:"point-edge" as const,dx:halfW,dz:0,side:"right" as const}},
    { point: {x: cx,z: cz-halfD}, distance: Math.hypot(point.x-cx,point.z-(cz-halfD)), ref: {elementId:String(el.id),kind:"point-edge" as const,dx:0,dz:-halfD,side:"bottom" as const}},
    { point: {x: cx,z: cz+halfD}, distance: Math.hypot(point.x-cx,point.z-(cz+halfD)), ref: {elementId:String(el.id),kind:"point-edge" as const,dx:0,dz:halfD,side:"top" as const}},
    { point: {x: cx-halfW,z: cz-halfD}, distance: Math.hypot(point.x-(cx-halfW),point.z-(cz-halfD)), ref: {elementId:String(el.id),kind:"point-corner" as const,dx:-halfW,dz:-halfD}},
    { point: {x: cx+halfW,z: cz-halfD}, distance: Math.hypot(point.x-(cx+halfW),point.z-(cz-halfD)), ref: {elementId:String(el.id),kind:"point-corner" as const,dx:halfW,dz:-halfD}},
    { point: {x: cx+halfW,z: cz+halfD}, distance: Math.hypot(point.x-(cx+halfW),point.z-(cz+halfD)), ref: {elementId:String(el.id),kind:"point-corner" as const,dx:halfW,dz:halfD}},
    { point: {x: cx-halfW,z: cz+halfD}, distance: Math.hypot(point.x-(cx-halfW),point.z-(cz+halfD)), ref: {elementId:String(el.id),kind:"point-corner" as const,dx:-halfW,dz:halfD}},
  ];
  cands.sort((a,b)=>a.distance-b.distance);
  return cands[0] ?? null;
}

let __synthSnapCache: { at: number; els: any[] } | null = null;

function findDimensionBoundary(point: { x: number; z: number }) {
  const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
  let els: any[] = [];
  try {
    if (auth?.getElements) els = auth.getElements();
  } catch { /* */ }
  if (!els.length) {
    els = ((window as any).__obsAuthoredElements ?? []) as any[];
  }

  if (!els.length && currentPlan && currentPlan.segments.length) {
    if (!__synthSnapCache || __synthSnapCache.at !== currentPlan.generatedAt) {
      const synth: any[] = [];
      let sid = 0;
      for (const seg of currentPlan.segments) {
        if (seg.kind === "grid") continue;
        synth.push({
          id: "synth-" + (sid++),
          type: "wall",
          name: "IFC segment",
          params: {
            start: [seg.x1, seg.z1],
            end: [seg.x2, seg.z2],
            height: 0,
            thickness: 0.15,
            elevation: 0,
          },
        });
      }
      __synthSnapCache = { at: currentPlan.generatedAt, els: synth };
    }
    els = __synthSnapCache.els;
  }

  if (els.length) {
    (window as any).__obsAuthoredElements = els;
  }

  if (!els.length) return null;

  const view = currentPlan;
  const zoomW = view ? ((view.bounds.maxX - view.bounds.minX) + 6) / currentZoom : 20;
  const pixelWorldTol = zoomW / 800;
  const featureTol = Math.max(0.15, pixelWorldTol * 14);

  const hit = findPlanFeatureSnap(els, point.x, point.z, featureTol);
  if (hit && hit.ref) {
    return {
      point: { x: hit.x, z: hit.z },
      ref: hit.ref,
      distance: hit.distance,
      kind: hit.kind,
      label: hit.label,
      color: hit.color,
    };
  }

  let best: { point: { x: number; z: number }; ref: PlanDimensionRef; distance: number } | null = null;
  const tol = Math.max(0.18, 0.008 * Math.max(currentPlan?.bounds.maxX ?? 10, currentPlan?.bounds.maxZ ?? 10));
  for (const el of els) {
    if (!el?.id) continue;
    const c = el.params?.start && el.params?.end
      ? linearBoundaryCandidate(el, point)
      : pointBoundaryCandidate(el, point);
    if (!c || c.distance > tol) continue;
    if (!best || c.distance < best.distance) best = c as any;
  }
  if (!best && currentPlan) {
    for (const seg of currentPlan.segments) {
      if (seg.kind === "grid") continue;
      const ax = seg.x1, az = seg.z1, bx = seg.x2, bz = seg.z2;
      const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az, L2 = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1;
      let t = ((point.x - ax) * dx + (point.z - az) * dz) / L2;
      t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
      const q = { x: ax + t * dx, z: az + t * dz };
      const d = Math.hypot(point.x - q.x, point.z - q.z);
      if (d <= tol && (!best || d < best.distance)) {
        best = { point: q, distance: d, ref: { kind: "static-boundary", x: q.x, z: q.z } as any };
      }
    }
  }
  return best;
}
function capturePlanDimensionRef(point: {x:number;z:number}): PlanDimensionRef | undefined {
  return findDimensionBoundary(point)?.ref;
}

function resolvePlanDimensionRef(ref?: PlanDimensionRef): {x:number;z:number} | null {
  if (!ref) return null;
  if (ref.kind === "static-boundary" && ref.x != null && ref.z != null) {
    return {x:Number(ref.x),z:Number(ref.z)};
  }
  if (!ref.elementId) return null;
  const els=((window as any).__obsAuthoredElements ?? []) as any[];
  const el=els.find((e)=>String(e?.id)===String(ref.elementId));
  if (!el?.params) return null;
  const p=el.params;
  if (ref.kind === "linear-side" || ref.kind === "linear-cap") {
    if (!p.start || !p.end) return null;
    const [ax,az]=p.start,[bx,bz]=p.end;
    const dx=bx-ax,dz=bz-az,L=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;
    const ux=dx/L,uz=dz/L,nx=-uz,nz=ux;
    const half=Math.max(0.01,Number(p.thickness ?? p.width ?? 0.2)/2);
    if (ref.kind === "linear-side") {
      const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(ref.t ?? 0)));
      const side=ref.side === "right" ? -1 : 1;
      return {x:ax+dx*t+nx*half*side,z:az+dz*t+nz*half*side};
    }
    const n=Math.max(-half,Math.min(half,Number(ref.n ?? 0)));
    const t=ref.side === "end" ? 1 : 0;
    return {x:ax+dx*t+nx*n,z:az+dz*t+nz*n};
  }
  if (p.point && ref.dx != null && ref.dz != null) {
    return {x:Number(p.point[0])+Number(ref.dx),z:Number(p.point[1])+Number(ref.dz)};
  }
  return null;
}

function formatPlanDimension(meters: number, style = getDimensionStyle()): string {
  const factor = style.unit === "m" ? 1 : style.unit === "cm" ? 100 : 1000;
  const value = meters * factor;
  return value.toFixed(style.precision) + (style.unit === "mm" ? "" : ` ${style.unit}`);
}

/** Revit-like annotation paper scale: a 2.5 mm text at 1:100 is 0.25 m in model space. */
function paperMmToWorld(mm: number): number {
  return (Math.max(0.1, mm) / 1000) * Math.max(1, planViewScale);
}

function dimensionWorldTextSize(style = getDimensionStyle()): number {
  return paperMmToWorld(style.textSize);
}

function dimensionWorldStroke(style = getDimensionStyle()): number {
  return Math.max(0.0015, paperMmToWorld(style.textSize * 0.18));
}

function makeSvgText(x: number, y: number, text: string, style: DimensionStyle, _dimScale: number): SVGTextElement {
  const lab = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
  lab.setAttribute("x", String(x)); lab.setAttribute("y", String(y));
  lab.setAttribute("fill", style.color);
  lab.setAttribute("font-size", String(dimensionWorldTextSize(style)));
  lab.setAttribute("font-family", "Arial, system-ui, sans-serif");
  lab.setAttribute("font-weight", "500");
  lab.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
  lab.setAttribute("dominant-baseline", "middle");
  lab.textContent = text;
  return lab;
}

function renderTemporaryDimensions(g: SVGGElement, dimScale: number, b: any) {
  const el = (window as any).__obsPlanSelectedEl;
  if (!el || !el.params) return;
  const style = getDimensionStyle();
  const p = el.params;
  const drawTemp = (x1:number,z1:number,x2:number,z2:number,offset:number) => {
    const dx=x2-x1, dz=z2-z1, len=Math.hypot(dx,dz); if(len<1e-6)return;
    const ux=dx/len, uz=dz/len, nx=-uz, nz=ux;
    const a0x=x1+nx*offset,a0z=z1+nz*offset,a1x=x2+nx*offset,a1z=z2+nz*offset;
    const a=screen(a0x,a0z), bb=screen(a1x,a1z);
    const sw=dimensionWorldStroke(style);
    const wl1=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","line");
    const p0=screen(x1,z1), q0=screen(a0x,a0z);
    wl1.setAttribute("x1",String(p0.x));wl1.setAttribute("y1",String(p0.y));wl1.setAttribute("x2",String(q0.x));wl1.setAttribute("y2",String(q0.y));wl1.setAttribute("stroke",style.color);wl1.setAttribute("stroke-width",String(sw*0.65));wl1.setAttribute("opacity","0.6");g.appendChild(wl1);
    const wl2=wl1.cloneNode() as SVGLineElement; const p1=screen(x2,z2), q1=screen(a1x,a1z);
    wl2.setAttribute("x1",String(p1.x));wl2.setAttribute("y1",String(p1.y));wl2.setAttribute("x2",String(q1.x));wl2.setAttribute("y2",String(q1.y)); g.appendChild(wl2);
    const dl=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","line"); dl.setAttribute("x1",String(a.x));dl.setAttribute("y1",String(a.y));dl.setAttribute("x2",String(bb.x));dl.setAttribute("y2",String(bb.y));dl.setAttribute("stroke",style.color);dl.setAttribute("stroke-width",String(sw));dl.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray","0.16 0.12");dl.setAttribute("opacity","0.72");g.appendChild(dl);
    const mid=screen((a0x+a1x)/2+nx*0.14,(a0z+a1z)/2+nz*0.14);
    g.appendChild(makeSvgText(mid.x,mid.y,formatPlanDimension(len),style,dimScale));
  };
  if(p.start && p.end){
    drawTemp(p.start[0],p.start[1],p.end[0],p.end[1],paperMmToWorld(16));
  } else if (p.point) {
    const x=p.point[0],z=p.point[1];
    const w=Number(p.width ?? p.thickness ?? 0.3), d=Number(p.depth ?? p.thickness ?? 0.3);
    drawTemp(x-w/2,z,x+w/2,z,paperMmToWorld(16));
    drawTemp(x,z-d/2,x,z+d/2,paperMmToWorld(20));
  }
  void b;
}

function compactSelect(options: Array<[string, string]>, width = 150): HTMLSelectElement {
  const sel = document.createElement("select");
  sel.style.cssText = `padding:5px 7px;background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:11px system-ui;max-width:${width}px`;
  for (const [value, label] of options) {
    const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = value; o.textContent = label; sel.appendChild(o);
  }
  return sel;
}

const btn = (label: string, onclick: () => void, primary = false) => {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.textContent = label;
  b.style.cssText =
    `padding:6px 12px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font:12px system-ui;` +
    (primary
      ? "background:var(--accent,#38bdf8);color:#0b0d12;border:1px solid var(--accent,#38bdf8)"
      : "background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a)");
  b.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onclick(); };
  return b;
};

type PlanBoundaryKind = "linear-side" | "linear-cap" | "point-edge" | "point-corner" | "static-boundary";

export interface PlanDimensionRef {
  elementId?: string;
  x?: number;
  z?: number;
  kind: PlanBoundaryKind;
  /** For linear-side/linear-cap references: normalized position along element. */
  t?: number;
  /** For linear-cap references: offset across the end cap, in world metres. */

  /** For point-edge/corner references: local boundary offset. */
  dx?: number;
  dz?: number;

}
/** Revit dimension kinds — placement sequence differs per style. */
type PlanDimKind =
  | "aligned"      // 2 refs: distance along connecting line
  | "linear"       // 2 refs: force H or V
  | "angular"      // 2 segments: interior angle at intersection
  | "radial"       // center + edge: R = …
  | "diameter"     // edge through center: ⌀ = …
  | "arc"          // 2 points along arc length
  | "elevation"    // 1 click: spot elevation
  | "coordinate";  // 1 click: spot X / Z

interface PlanDimension {
  x1: number; z1: number; x2: number; z2: number;
  style: PlanDimKind;
  /** Stored in paper mm so changing the view scale also changes annotation scale. */
  offsetMm?: number;
  ref1?: PlanDimensionRef;
  ref2?: PlanDimensionRef;
  /** Angular: degrees; Radial/Diameter: radius metres; Arc: arc length metres */
  value?: number;
  /** Spot labels override numeric format */
  label?: string;
  /** Angular vertex (intersection) when known */
  vx?: number;
  vz?: number;
}
const planDims: PlanDimension[] = [];

let planDimChain = false;
interface PlanDimPending {
  ref1: PlanDimensionRef;
  ref2: PlanDimensionRef;
  x1: number; z1: number; x2: number; z2: number;
  kind: PlanDimKind;
}

/** Angular placement: first segment endpoints */
let planDimSeg1: { x1: number; z1: number; x2: number; z2: number } | null = null;
const DIM_OFFSET_MM = 12; // paper-space offset from geometry; converted by view scale

interface PlanTag {
  x: number;
  z: number;

const SNAP_TOL = 0.35; // meters

/** Nearest authored linear segment for Angular / Arc dimension picks. */
function findNearestSegment(point: { x: number; z: number }, tol = 0.8): {
  x1: number; z1: number; x2: number; z2: number; elementId?: string; distance: number;
} | null {
  const els = ((window as any).__obsAuthoredElements ?? []) as any[];
  let best: { x1: number; z1: number; x2: number; z2: number; elementId?: string; distance: number } | null = null;
  for (const el of els) {
    const p = el?.params;
    if (!p?.start || !p?.end) continue;
    const ax = p.start[0], az = p.start[1], bx = p.end[0], bz = p.end[1];
    const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az;
    const L2 = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1;
    let t = ((point.x - ax) * dx + (point.z - az) * dz) / L2;
    t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    const px = ax + t * dx, pz = az + t * dz;
    const d = Math.hypot(point.x - px, point.z - pz);
    if (d <= tol && (!best || d < best.distance)) {
      best = { x1: ax, z1: az, x2: bx, z2: bz, elementId: String(el.id), distance: d };
    }
  }
  // Fallback: plan segments (IFC cut)
  if (currentPlan) {
    for (const s of currentPlan.segments) {
      const dx = s.x2 - s.x1, dz = s.z2 - s.z1;
      const L2 = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1;
      let t = ((point.x - s.x1) * dx + (point.z - s.z1) * dz) / L2;
      t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
      const px = s.x1 + t * dx, pz = s.z1 + t * dz;
      const d = Math.hypot(point.x - px, point.z - pz);
      if (d <= tol && (!best || d < best.distance)) {
        best = { x1: s.x1, z1: s.z1, x2: s.x2, z2: s.z2, distance: d };
      }
    }
  }
  return best;
}

function segmentAngleDeg(s1: { x1: number; z1: number; x2: number; z2: number },
                         s2: { x1: number; z1: number; x2: number; z2: number }): {
  deg: number; vx: number; vz: number;
} {
  const a1 = Math.atan2(s1.z2 - s1.z1, s1.x2 - s1.x1);
  const a2 = Math.atan2(s2.z2 - s2.z1, s2.x2 - s2.x1);
  let deg = Math.abs((a2 - a1) * 180 / Math.PI);
  if (deg > 180) deg = 360 - deg;
  // Approximate vertex: midpoint of closest endpoints
  const ends1 = [{ x: s1.x1, z: s1.z1 }, { x: s1.x2, z: s1.z2 }];
  const ends2 = [{ x: s2.x1, z: s2.z1 }, { x: s2.x2, z: s2.z2 }];
  let bestD = Infinity, vx = (s1.x1 + s1.x2) / 2, vz = (s1.z1 + s1.z2) / 2;
  for (const p of ends1) for (const q of ends2) {
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.z - q.z);
    if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; vx = (p.x + q.x) / 2; vz = (p.z + q.z) / 2; }
  }
  return { deg, vx, vz };
}

function findNearestPointElement(point: { x: number; z: number }, tol = 1.0): {
  x: number; z: number; elev: number; elementId?: string; distance: number;
} | null {
  const els = ((window as any).__obsAuthoredElements ?? []) as any[];
  let best: { x: number; z: number; elev: number; elementId?: string; distance: number } | null = null;
  for (const el of els) {
    const p = el?.params;
    if (p?.point) {
      const d = Math.hypot(point.x - p.point[0], point.z - p.point[1]);
      if (d <= tol && (!best || d < best.distance)) {
        best = { x: p.point[0], z: p.point[1], elev: Number(p.elevation ?? p.point[2] ?? 0), elementId: String(el.id), distance: d };
      }
    } else if (p?.start && p?.end) {
      const mx = (p.start[0] + p.end[0]) / 2, mz = (p.start[1] + p.end[1]) / 2;
      const d = Math.hypot(point.x - mx, point.z - mz);
      if (d <= tol && (!best || d < best.distance)) {
        best = { x: mx, z: mz, elev: Number(p.elevation ?? 0), elementId: String(el.id), distance: d };
      }
    }
  }
  return best;
}


function collectSnapPoints(): { x: number; z: number; kind: string }[] {
  const pts: { x: number; z: number; kind: string }[] = [];
  if (!currentPlan) return pts;
  for (const s of currentPlan.segments) {
    pts.push({ x: s.x1, z: s.z1, kind: "End" });
    pts.push({ x: s.x2, z: s.z2, kind: "End" });
    pts.push({ x: (s.x1 + s.x2) / 2, z: (s.z1 + s.z2) / 2, kind: "Mid" });
  }
  // Grid 1 m
  const b = currentPlan.bounds;
  if (isFinite(b.minX)) {
    for (let x = Math.floor(b.minX) - 2; x <= Math.ceil(b.maxX) + 2; x++) {
      for (let z = Math.floor(b.minZ) - 2; z <= Math.ceil(b.maxZ) + 2; z++) {
        pts.push({ x, z, kind: "Grid" });
      }
    }
  }
  return pts;
}

function findPlanSnap(wx: number, wz: number): { x: number; z: number; kind: string } | null {
  const priority: Record<string, number> = { End: 0, Mid: 1, Ortho: 2, Grid: 3 };
  let best: { x: number; z: number; kind: string } | null = null;
  let bestScore = 1e9;
  const consider = (p: { x: number; z: number; kind: string }, tol: number) => {
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - wx, p.z - wz);
    if (d > tol) return;
    const score = (priority[p.kind] ?? 5) * 10 + d;
    if (score < bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = p; }
  };
  for (const p of collectSnapPoints()) {
    const tol = p.kind === "Grid" ? 0.15 : SNAP_TOL;
    if (p.kind === "Grid") continue; // only grid near cursor via separate pass
    consider(p, tol);
  }
  // Ortho to start
  if (planDrawStart) {
    consider({ x: planDrawStart.x, z: wz, kind: "Ortho" }, SNAP_TOL);
    consider({ x: wx, z: planDrawStart.z, kind: "Ortho" }, SNAP_TOL);
  }
  // Grid only if nothing better
  if (!best) {
    const gx = Math.round(wx);
    const gz = Math.round(wz);
    consider({ x: gx, z: gz, kind: "Grid" }, 0.2);
  }
  return best;
}

/* ── CAD / DWG underlay for tracing & modeling ─────────────────────────── */
let cadUnderlayUrl: string | null = null;
let cadUnderlayOpacity = 0.45;
let cadImageEl: SVGImageElement | null = null;

async function loadCadFileAsUnderlay(file: File) {
  if (cadUnderlayUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(cadUnderlayUrl);
  const ext = (file.name.split(".").pop() ?? "").toLowerCase();
```
