```ts
    renderPlan(plan);
    applyCadUnderlay();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[plan] generation failed", err);
    alert("Plan generation failed — see console. Check model is loaded.");
  } finally {
    generating = false;
    loading.style.display = "none";
    cancelHandle = null;
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Level dropdown population
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function populateLevels() {
  const levels = listAvailableLevels();
  levelSelect.innerHTML = levels
    .map((l, i) => `<option value="${i}">${l.name} (+${l.elevation.toFixed(2)} m)</option>`)
    .join("");
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Print / Export
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function printPlan() {
  if (!currentPlan) {
    alert("Generate a plan first.");
    return;
  }
  const svgMarkup = svg.outerHTML;
  const html = `
    <!doctype html><html><head><title>Plan — ${currentPlan.level.name}</title>
    <style>
      body { margin:0; padding:16px; font:12px system-ui; background:#fff; }
      svg { width:100%; height:auto; max-height:calc(100vh - 60px); }
      @page { size: A3 landscape; margin: 8mm; }
    </style>
    </head><body>${svgMarkup}
    <script>window.onload = () => setTimeout(() => window.print(), 300);</script>
    </body></html>`;
  const w = window.open("", "_blank");
  if (!w) {
    alert("Popup blocked. Allow popups to print.");
    return;
  }
  w.document.write(html);
  w.document.close();
}

function exportSvg() {
  if (!currentPlan) {
    alert("Generate a plan first.");
    return;
  }
  // Build a clean SVG that keeps the current viewBox
  const svgMarkup = svg.outerHTML;
  const blob = new Blob(
    [`<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n${svgMarkup}`],
    { type: "image/svg+xml" },
  );
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `plan-${currentPlan.level.name.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}-${Date.now()}.svg`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function layoutUnderRibbon() {
  // Measure ribbon so plan viewport sits exactly under tabs (like Revit).
  // Respects minimized (flat) ribbon: only tabs height remains.
  try {
    const ribbon = document.querySelector(".obs-ribbon") as HTMLElement | null;
    const h = ribbon ? ribbon.getBoundingClientRect().height : 88;
    // When minimized, height is ~32px (tabs only); keep a small minimum
    overlay.style.top = `${Math.max(28, Math.round(h))}px`;
    overlay.style.left = "0";
  } catch {
    overlay.style.top = "88px";
  }
}

// Keep plan aligned when ribbon is minimized / restored
window.addEventListener("obs-ribbon-resize", () => {
  if (isPlanViewVisible()) layoutUnderRibbon();
});
window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
  if (isPlanViewVisible()) layoutUnderRibbon();
});

export function togglePlanView() {
  const visible = overlay.style.display === "flex";
  if (visible) {
    overlay.style.display = "none";
    try {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
        detail: { message: "3D View", kind: "info" },
      }));
    } catch { /* */ }
  } else {
    layoutUnderRibbon();
    overlay.style.display = "flex";
    populateLevels();
    planMode = "select";
    planDrawStart = null;
    planChain = [];
    canvasWrap.style.cursor = "default";
    toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Select — click object · drag box · Delete · Ctrl+Z";
    // Sync from 3D model into 2D
    void regenerate();
    renderPlanProperties();
    try {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
        detail: {
          message: "Floor Plan — Properties on the left · ribbon tools model in plan",
          kind: "success",
        },
      }));
    } catch { /* */ }
  }
}

export function isPlanViewVisible() {
  return overlay.style.display === "flex";
}

/** Called when user picks Architecture Wall etc. while plan is open. */
export function setPlanToolFromRibbon(tool: string) {
  if (!isPlanViewVisible()) return;
  planDrawStart = null;
  planSnap = null;
  const linear = [
    "wall", "beam", "strip", "duct", "pipe", "cable-tray", "conduit", "mline",
    "brace", "truss",
  ];
  const points: Record<string, { type: PointKind; preset?: string }> = {
    column: { type: "column" },
    footing: { type: "footing" },
    pile: { type: "footing" },
    equipment: { type: "equipment" },
    terminal: { type: "equipment", preset: "air-terminal" },
    accessory: { type: "equipment" },
    fitting: { type: "equipment", preset: "fitting" },
    elbow: { type: "equipment", preset: "elbow" },
    tee: { type: "equipment", preset: "tee" },
    cross: { type: "equipment", preset: "cross" },
    flex: { type: "equipment" },
    equip: { type: "equipment" },
    fixture: { type: "equipment" },
    pump: { type: "equipment", preset: "pump" },
    main: { type: "equipment" },
    outlet: { type: "equipment", preset: "outlet" },
    switch: { type: "equipment", preset: "switch" },
    panel: { type: "equipment", preset: "panel" },
    "junction-box": { type: "equipment", preset: "junction-box" },
    "lighting-fixture": { type: "equipment", preset: "lighting-fixture" },
    sprinkler: { type: "equipment", preset: "sprinkler" },
    "air-terminal": { type: "equipment", preset: "air-terminal" },
    transformer: { type: "equipment", preset: "transformer" },
    generator: { type: "equipment", preset: "generator" },
    door: { type: "equipment", preset: "door" },
    window: { type: "equipment", preset: "window" },
  };
  // Remember for Backspace repeat
  try {
    import("./authoring").then((m) => {
      if (tool && tool !== "select") m.setLastCommand?.(tool);
    }).catch(() => {});
  } catch { /* */ }

  if (linear.includes(tool)) {
    planMode = "linear";
    planLinearType = (tool === "brace" || tool === "truss" ? "beam" : tool) as LinearKind;
    if (tool === "brace" || tool === "truss") planLinearType = "beam";
    else planLinearType = tool as LinearKind;
    planChain = [];
    planDrawStart = null;
    applyDefaultSizeForTool(tool === "brace" || tool === "truss" ? "beam" : tool);
    canvasWrap.style.cursor = "crosshair";
    // Revit Place order: Type active → click start → click end → continue chain
    toolHint.textContent = `Modify | Place ${tool} · Enter finish path · Esc cancel · Space repeat`;
    footerStatus(`Place ${tool}: click to enter start point · snaps ON`);
    setPlanSelectedElement(null);
    renderPlanProperties();
    try {
      // Show wall location-line / chain only for walls; always show W/H/Elev for linear
      showWallOpts(tool === "wall");
    } catch { /* */ }
  } else if (points[tool]) {
    planMode = "point";
    planPointType = points[tool].type;
    planPointPreset = points[tool].preset ?? null;
    canvasWrap.style.cursor = "crosshair";
    toolHint.textContent = `${tool} — click to place · Esc cancel · Backspace repeat`;
    footerStatus(`Plan ${tool}: click to place`);
    setPlanSelectedElement(null);
    renderPlanProperties();
    try { showWallOpts(false); } catch { /* */ }
  } else if (tool === "pan" || tool === "navigate") {
    // Revit Pan: only changes navigation mode — NEVER resets zoom/fit
    planMode = "navigate";
    planChain = [];
    planDrawStart = null;
    canvasWrap.style.cursor = "grab";
    toolHint.textContent = "Pan — drag to pan · wheel zoom · view kept";
    footerStatus("Pan mode — view is not reset");
    try { showWallOpts(false); } catch { /* */ }
  } else if (tool === "select" || tool === "copy") {
    planMode = "select";
    planChain = [];
    planDrawStart = null;
    canvasWrap.style.cursor = "default";
    toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Select — click · drag box · Ctrl add · Delete remove";
    footerStatus("Select — ready · L→R window · R→L crossing");
    try { showWallOpts(false); } catch { /* */ }
  } else if (tool === "move") {
    planMode = "move";
    planChain = [];
    planDrawStart = null;
    canvasWrap.style.cursor = "move";
    toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Move — drag selected elements in plan";
    footerStatus(planSelectedIds.size ? `Move ${planSelectedIds.size} element(s) — drag` : "Select elements first, then Move");
    try { showWallOpts(false); } catch { /* */ }
  } else if (
    tool === "dim-aligned" || tool === "measure" ||
    tool === "dim-linear" || tool === "dim-horizontal" || tool === "dim-vertical" ||
    tool === "dim-angular" || tool === "dim-radial" || tool === "dim-diameter" ||
    tool === "dim-arc" || tool === "arc-length" ||
    tool === "spot-elev" || tool === "elevation" ||
    tool === "spot-coord" || tool === "coordinate"
  ) {
    planMode = "dim";
    planDrawStart = null;
    planDimStartRef = null;
    planDimSeg1 = null;
    planChain = [];
    canvasWrap.style.cursor = "crosshair";
    try { showWallOpts(false); } catch { /* */ }

    if (tool === "dim-linear" || tool === "dim-horizontal" || tool === "dim-vertical") {
      planDimStyle = "linear";
      toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Place Linear Dimension — 2 boundaries · H/V";
      footerStatus("Linear: pick first model boundary");
    } else if (tool === "dim-angular") {
      planDimStyle = "angular";
      toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Place Angular Dimension — 2 edges";
      footerStatus("Angular: pick first line / wall edge");
    } else if (tool === "dim-radial") {
      planDimStyle = "radial";
      toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Place Radial Dimension — center then edge";
      footerStatus("Radial: pick center point");
    } else if (tool === "dim-diameter") {
      planDimStyle = "diameter";
      toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Place Diameter Dimension — center then edge";
      footerStatus("Diameter: pick center point");
    } else if (tool === "dim-arc" || tool === "arc-length") {
      planDimStyle = "arc";
      toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Place Arc Length Dimension — 2 points on arc";
      footerStatus("Arc length: pick first point on edge");
    } else if (tool === "spot-elev" || tool === "elevation") {
      planDimStyle = "elevation";
      toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Spot Elevation — click a point";
      footerStatus("Spot Elevation: click model point or free location");
    } else if (tool === "spot-coord" || tool === "coordinate") {
      planDimStyle = "coordinate";
      toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Spot Coordinate — click a point";
      footerStatus("Spot Coordinate: click to place X / Z label");
    } else {
      planDimStyle = "aligned";
      toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Place Aligned Dimension — 2 boundaries · snaps ON";
      footerStatus("Aligned: pick first model boundary");
    }
  } else if (tool === "tag" || tool === "room-tag" || tool === "tag-all" || tool === "material-tag") {
    planMode = "tag";
    (window as any).__obsPlanTagMode = tool === "room-tag" ? "room" : tool === "material-tag" ? "material" : "category";
    canvasWrap.style.cursor = "crosshair";
    toolHint.textContent = `${tool === "room-tag" ? "Room Tag" : tool === "material-tag" ? "Material Tag" : "Tag"} — click near element`;
  } else if (tool === "text" || tool === "model-text" || tool === "text-3d") {
    planMode = "text";
    canvasWrap.style.cursor = "crosshair";
    toolHint.textContent = "Text — click to place note";
  } else if (tool === "clear-annotations" || tool === "clear") {
    planDims.length = 0;
    planTags.length = 0;
    planNotes.length = 0;
    if (currentPlan) renderPlan(currentPlan);
    footerStatus("Annotations cleared");
  }
}

export function setupPlanViewPanel() {

// Keep the authored element cache fresh for snap lookups.
try {
  if (!(window as any).__obsAuthoredElementsRefreshTimer) {
    (window as any).__obsAuthoredElementsRefreshTimer = setInterval(() => {
      try {
        const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
        if (auth?.getElements) {
          (window as any).__obsAuthoredElements = auth.getElements();
        }
      } catch { /* */ }
    }, 500);
  }
} catch { /* */ }

  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  planBody.append(planProps, canvasWrap);
  overlay.append(header, planBody, footer);
  renderPlanProperties();

  // Flag for 3D handlers to defer when plan is open
  (window as any).__obsPlanVisible = () => isPlanViewVisible();

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (!isPlanViewVisible()) return;
    const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement)?.tagName?.toLowerCase();
    if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea") return;

    // Enter — finish continuous path
    if (e.key === "Enter" && planMode === "linear" && planChain.length > 0) {
      finishPlanChain();
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      return;
    }

    // Space — repeat last command (Revit). Backspace repeats only if nothing selected.
    if (e.key === " " || (e.key === "Backspace" && planSelectedIds.size === 0)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      void (async () => {
        try {
          const { getLastCommand } = await import("./authoring");
          const cmd = getLastCommand();
          if (!cmd) {
            footerStatus("No previous command to repeat");
            return;
          }
          setPlanToolFromRibbon(cmd);
          footerStatus(`Repeat last: ${cmd}`);
          try {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
              detail: { message: `Repeat: ${cmd}`, kind: "success" },
            }));
          } catch { /* */ }
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn("[plan] Space/Backspace repeat", err);
        }
      })();
      return;
    }

    // Delete / Backspace on selection — remove selected authored elements
    if ((e.key === "Delete" || e.key === "Backspace") && planSelectedIds.size > 0 && planMode !== "linear") {
      // Backspace also used for repeat when nothing selected — handled above when size==0
      if (e.key === "Backspace" && planSelectedIds.size === 0) {
        /* fall through to repeat */
      } else {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        void (async () => {
          try {
            const { deleteSelectedElement, getElements, setSelectedAuthored } = await import("./authoring");
            const n = planSelectedIds.size;
            // Prefer multi-delete via selection sync
            setSelectedAuthored([...planSelectedIds], "replace");
            deleteSelectedElement();
            planSelectedIds.clear();
            renderPlanProperties();
            footerStatus(`Deleted ${n} element(s) · Ctrl+Z undo`);
            void regenerate();
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn("[plan] delete", err);
          }
        })();
        return;
      }
    }

    // Esc — Revit order cancel:
    //  1) Cancel in-progress path (discard unfinished chain) stay in tool if had segments
    //  2) Exit tool → Modify / Select
    //  3) Already Select → close Floor Plan
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      // 1) In-progress linear path: discard unfinished and return to idle Place mode
      if (planMode === "linear" && (planChain.length > 0 || planDrawStart)) {
        const hadSegments = planChain.length > 1;
        planChain = [];
        planDrawStart = null;
        planCursor = null;
        planSnap = null;
        void import("./authoring").then((m) => m.clearLastPlanLinear?.()).catch(() => {});
        if (currentPlan) renderPlan(currentPlan);
        if (hadSegments) {
          // Revit: Esc after some segments keeps Place Wall active
          footerStatus(`Place ${planLinearType}: cancelled path — click start of next · Esc = Modify`);
          toolHint.textContent = `Modify | Place ${planLinearType} · Esc cancel · Space repeat`;
        } else {
          // No segments yet → exit to Select
          planMode = "select";
          canvasWrap.style.cursor = "default";
          toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Select — click · box · Delete · Ctrl+Z";
          footerStatus("Cancelled — Select");
          try { showWallOpts(false); } catch { /* */ }
        }
        return;
      }
      // 2) Cancel active tool (dim/point/tag/text/linear idle) → Select
      if (planMode !== "pan" || planDrawStart) {
        planMode = "select";
        planDrawStart = null;
        planDimStartRef = null;
        planDimSeg1 = null;
        planChain = [];
        planSnap = null;
        planCursor = null;
        canvasWrap.style.cursor = "default";
        toolHint.textContent = "Modify | Select — click · box · Delete · Ctrl+Z";
        footerStatus("Cancelled — Select");
        try { showWallOpts(false); } catch { /* */ }
        try {
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
            detail: { message: "Cancelled — Select", kind: "info" },
          }));
        } catch { /* */ }
        return;
      }
      // 3) Already Select → close Floor Plan (back to 3D)
      togglePlanView();
    }
  }, true);

  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    if (isPlanViewVisible()) layoutUnderRibbon();
  });

  // 3D → 2D live sync when authored geometry changes
  try {
    import("./authoring").then(({ onAuthoringChange }) => {
      onAuthoringChange(() => {
        if (!isPlanViewVisible() || generating) return;
        // Debounce regenerate
        const t = (window as any).__obsPlanSyncTimer;
        if (t) clearTimeout(t);
        (window as any).__obsPlanSyncTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          void regenerate();
        }, 400);
      });
    }).catch(() => {});
  } catch { /* */ }

  window.addEventListener("obs-history", () => {
    if (!isPlanViewVisible()) return;
    // Rebuild plan after undo/redo without resetting zoom/pan
    void regenerate();
  });

  ctx.features.planView = {
    toggle: togglePlanView,
    isVisible: isPlanViewVisible,
    regenerate: () => void regenerate(),
    setTool: setPlanToolFromRibbon,
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * SketchUp-style primitives: Rectangle and Circle.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { inputRouter, type Gesture } from "../core/input-router";
import { history } from "./history";
import { notify } from "../core/notify";

type PrimitiveKind = "rectangle" | "circle";
interface Pt { x: number; z: number; }

class PrimitivesManager {
  private kind: PrimitiveKind | null = null;
  private first: Pt | null = null;
  private cursor: Pt | null = null;
  private previewLine: THREE.Line | null = null;
  private unsubGesture: (() => void) | null = null;
  private unsubCancel: (() => void) | null = null;
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();

  init(): void {
    if (this.unsubGesture) return;
    this.unsubGesture = inputRouter.subscribe((g) => this.handle(g), 85);
    this.unsubCancel = inputRouter.registerCancel(() => {
      if (!this.kind) return false;
      this.cancel();
      return true;
    });
    console.log("[primitives] ready");
  }

  isActive(): boolean { return this.kind !== null; }
  activateRectangle(): void { this.activate("rectangle"); }
  activateCircle(): void { this.activate("circle"); }

  cancel(): void {
    this.kind = null;
    this.first = null;
    this.cursor = null;
    this.clearPreview();
    ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = "";
    this.emit();
  }

  onChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  private emit(): void {
    for (const cb of this.listeners) { try { cb(); } catch {} }
  }

  private activate(kind: PrimitiveKind): void {
    try { (ctx.features as any).authoring?.setAuthoringTool?.("select"); } catch {}
    this.kind = kind;
    this.first = null;
    this.cursor = null;
    this.clearPreview();
    ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = "crosshair";
    notify("info", kind === "rectangle"
      ? "Rectangle - click first corner, then opposite corner"
      : "Circle - click center, then pick a radius");
    this.emit();
  }

  private groundPoint(e: PointerEvent): Pt | null {
    const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width < 1) return null;
    const ndc = new THREE.Vector2(
      ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
      -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1,
    );
    const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
    ray.setFromCamera(ndc, ctx.world.camera.three);
    const hits = ray.intersectObjects([ctx.groundPlane], false);
    if (!hits.length) return null;
    const p = hits[0].point;
    return { x: Math.round(p.x * 200) / 200, z: Math.round(p.z * 200) / 200 };
  }

  private ensurePreviewGroup(): THREE.Group {
    let g = (ctx.world.scene.three as any).__obsPrimitivesPreview as THREE.Group | undefined;
    if (g) return g;
    g = new THREE.Group();
    g.name = "__obsPrimitivesPreview";
    (ctx.world.scene.three as any).__obsPrimitivesPreview = g;
    ctx.world.scene.three.add(g);
    return g;
  }

  private clearPreview(): void {
    if (this.previewLine) {
      try {
        this.previewLine.geometry.dispose();
        (this.previewLine.material as THREE.Material).dispose?.();
        this.previewLine.parent?.remove(this.previewLine);
      } catch {}
      this.previewLine = null;
    }
  }

  private drawPreview(): void {
    this.clearPreview();
    if (!this.first || !this.cursor) return;
    const g = this.ensurePreviewGroup();
    const mat = new THREE.LineDashedMaterial({
      color: 0x38bdf8, dashSize: 0.3, gapSize: 0.2, transparent: true,
    });
    const pts: THREE.Vector3[] = [];
    if (this.kind === "rectangle") {
      const a = this.first;
      const b = this.cursor;
      pts.push(
        new THREE.Vector3(a.x, 0.02, a.z),
        new THREE.Vector3(b.x, 0.02, a.z),
        new THREE.Vector3(b.x, 0.02, b.z),
        new THREE.Vector3(a.x, 0.02, b.z),
        new THREE.Vector3(a.x, 0.02, a.z),
      );
    } else {
      const r = Math.hypot(this.cursor.x - this.first.x, this.cursor.z - this.first.z);
      const N = 48;
      for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
        const a = (i / N) * Math.PI * 2;
        pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(
          this.first.x + Math.cos(a) * r,
          0.02,
          this.first.z + Math.sin(a) * r,
        ));
      }
    }
    const line = new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts), mat);
    line.computeLineDistances();
    line.renderOrder = 999;
    g.add(line);
    this.previewLine = line;
  }

  private stamp(): string {
    const d = new Date();
    return String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")
      + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")
      + String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
  }

  private async createSlab(poly: [number, number][], name: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const authoring: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
      const els = authoring?.getElements?.() as any[] | undefined;
      if (!Array.isArray(els)) { notify("warn", "Authoring module not ready"); return; }
      const el = {
        id: (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? ("slab-" + Date.now()),
        type: "slab",
        name,
        color: "#94a3b8",
        params: { polygon: poly, height: 0.2, thickness: 0.2, elevation: 0 },
      };
      els.push(el as any);
      authoring?.rebuildAuthored?.();
      try { (ctx.features as any).projects?.markDirty?.(); } catch {}
      history.push({
        label: "Create " + name,
        apply: () => {
          if (!els.includes(el as any)) els.push(el as any);
          authoring?.rebuildAuthored?.();
        },
        revert: () => {
          const i = els.indexOf(el as any);
          if (i >= 0) els.splice(i, 1);
          authoring?.rebuildAuthored?.();
        },
      });
      notify("success", name + " created - use Push/Pull to extrude");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[primitives] create slab failed", err);
      notify("error", "Could not create primitive - see console");
    }
  }

  private handle = (g: Gesture): boolean => {
    if (!this.kind) return false;
    if (g.kind === "click" && g.button === 0) {
      const p = this.groundPoint(g.event);
      if (!p) return false;
      if (!this.first) {
        this.first = p;
        this.cursor = p;
        notify("info", this.kind === "rectangle"
          ? "Rectangle - click opposite corner"
          : "Circle - click radius point");
        return true;
      }
      const a = this.first;
      const b = p;
      const kind = this.kind;
      this.cancel();
      if (kind === "rectangle") {
        void this.createSlab([
          [a.x, a.z], [b.x, a.z], [b.x, b.z], [a.x, b.z],
        ], "Rectangle " + this.stamp());
      } else {
        const r = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
        if (r < 0.05) { notify("warn", "Radius too small"); return true; }
        const N = 32;
        const poly: [number, number][] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
          const ang = (i / N) * Math.PI * 2;
          poly.push([a.x + Math.cos(ang) * r, a.z + Math.sin(ang) * r]);
        }
        void this.createSlab(poly, "Circle " + this.stamp());
      }
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  };

  installHover(): void {
    ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
      if (!this.kind || !this.first) return;
      const p = this.groundPoint(e as PointerEvent);
      if (!p) return;
      this.cursor = p;
      this.drawPreview();
    });
  }
}

export const primitives = new PrimitivesManager();

export function setupPrimitives(): void {
  primitives.init();
  primitives.installHover();
  (ctx.features as any).primitives = {
    activateRectangle: () => primitives.activateRectangle(),
    activateCircle: () => primitives.activateCircle(),
    cancel: () => primitives.cancel(),
    isActive: () => primitives.isActive(),
    onChange: (cb: () => void) => primitives.onChange(cb),
  };
  console.log("[primitives] setup complete");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Project Browser — Revit-class project organization panel.
 *
 * Hierarchy:
 *   Views (all)          → 3D, Plan, Saved views
 *   Schedules/Quantities → schedule templates
 *   Sheets (all)         → production sheets
 *   Families             → materials / types
 *   Models & Links       → federated IFC / FRAG / aux
 *   Groups               → selection sets
 *   4D Phases            → construction phases
 *
 * Professional dark UI, expandable tree, double-click to open,
 * right-click actions. Competes with Revit Project Browser presentation.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { listSheets, createSheet, createDefaultSheetSet } from "../modules/sheets/sheets";
import { listMaterials, ensureDefaultMaterials } from "../modules/materials/materials";
import { listPhases, createDefaultPhases } from "../modules/timeline/timeline";
import { listSavedViews, restoreView, saveCurrentView } from "./saved-views";
import { selection } from "./selection";
import { togglePlanView } from "./plan-view-panel";
import { toggleSchedules } from "./schedules-panel";
import { toggleSheetsPanel } from "./sheets-panel";
import { toggleTimelinePanel } from "./timeline-panel";
import { togglePropertyPalette, isPropertyPaletteVisible } from "./property-palette";
import { toggleModelTreePanel } from "./model-tree-panel";
import { fitAll, goHome } from "./camera-tools";

type NodeKind =
  | "root" | "views" | "view-3d" | "view-plan" | "view-saved"
  | "schedules" | "schedule"
  | "sheets" | "sheet"
  | "families" | "material"
  | "links" | "link"
  | "groups" | "group"
  | "phases" | "phase";

interface BrowserNode {
  id: string;
  kind: NodeKind;
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  count?: number;
  children?: BrowserNode[];
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

let panel: HTMLElement | null = null;
let visible = false;
let expanded = new Set<string>(["views", "sheets", "links", "schedules"]);
let selectedNodeId: string | null = null;

function esc(s: string) {
  return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);
}

function buildTree(): BrowserNode[] {
  // Models / links
  const links: BrowserNode[] = [];
  try {
    if (ctx.fragments?.list) {
      for (const [id, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
        const name = (model as any)?.object?.name || (model as any)?.name || id;
        links.push({
          id: `link-${id}`,
          kind: "link",
          label: String(name).split("/").pop() || id,
          icon: "📦",
          meta: { modelId: id },
        });
      }
    }
  } catch { /* */ }

  // Saved views
  const saved = listSavedViews().map((v) => ({
    id: `view-${v.id}`,
    kind: "view-saved" as const,
    label: v.name,
    icon: "📷",
    meta: { viewId: v.id },
  }));

  // Sheets
  const sheets = listSheets().map((s) => ({
    id: `sheet-${s.id}`,
    kind: "sheet" as const,
    label: `${s.number} — ${s.name}`,
    icon: "📄",
    meta: { sheetId: s.id },
  }));

  // Materials / families
  ensureDefaultMaterials();
  const mats = listMaterials().map((m) => ({
    id: `mat-${m.id}`,
    kind: "material" as const,
    label: m.name,
    icon: "🧱",
    meta: { materialId: m.id },
  }));

  // Selection sets as groups
  const groups: BrowserNode[] = [];
  try {
    const sets = selection.listSets() ?? [];
    for (const s of sets) {
      groups.push({
        id: `grp-${s.id}`,
        kind: "group",
        label: s.name,
        icon: "🧩",
        meta: { setId: s.id },
      });
    }
  } catch { /* */ }

  // 4D phases
  const phases = listPhases().map((p) => ({
    id: `phase-${p.id}`,
    kind: "phase" as const,
    label: p.name,
    icon: "⏱",
    count: p.elementIds.length,
    meta: { phaseId: p.id },
  }));

  return [
    {
      id: "views",
      kind: "views",
      label: "Views (all)",
      icon: "🗂",
      children: [
        { id: "view-3d", kind: "view-3d", label: "3D View", icon: "🔲" },
        { id: "view-plan", kind: "view-plan", label: "Floor Plan", icon: "📐" },
        ...saved,
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "schedules",
      kind: "schedules",
      label: "Schedules/Quantities (all)",
      icon: "📊",
      children: [
        { id: "sch-open", kind: "schedule", label: "Open Schedules panel", icon: "📋" },
        { id: "sch-cost", kind: "schedule", label: "Cost / QTO", icon: "💰" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "sheets",
      kind: "sheets",
      label: "Sheets (all)",
      icon: "📑",
      count: sheets.length,
      children: sheets.length
        ? sheets
        : [{ id: "sheet-empty", kind: "sheet", label: "(no sheets — create default set)", icon: "＋" }],
    },
    {
      id: "families",
      kind: "families",
      label: "Families",
      icon: "🏗",
      count: mats.length,
      children: mats.slice(0, 40),
    },
    {
      id: "links",
      kind: "links",
      label: "Models & Links",
      icon: "🔗",
      count: links.length,
      children: links.length
        ? links
        : [{ id: "link-empty", kind: "link", label: "(no models — Insert → Link IFC)", icon: "＋" }],
    },
    {
      id: "groups",
      kind: "groups",
      label: "Groups",
      icon: "📁",
      count: groups.length,
      children: groups.length
        ? groups
        : [{ id: "grp-empty", kind: "group", label: "(save a selection set first)", icon: "＋" }],
    },
    {
      id: "phases",
      kind: "phases",
      label: "4D Phases",
      icon: "📅",
      count: phases.length,
      children: phases.length
        ? phases
        : [{ id: "phase-empty", kind: "phase", label: "(create default phases)", icon: "＋" }],
    },
  ];
}

function onActivate(node: BrowserNode) {
  selectedNodeId = node.id;
  try {
    switch (node.kind) {
      case "view-3d":
        goHome();
        fitAll();
        break;
      case "view-plan":
        togglePlanView();
        break;
      case "view-saved":
        if (node.meta?.viewId) restoreView(String(node.meta.viewId));
        break;
      case "schedule":
        if (node.id === "sch-cost") {
          import("./cost-panel").then((m) => m.toggleCostPanel()).catch(() => {});
        } else {
          toggleSchedules();
        }
        break;
      case "schedules":
        toggleSchedules();
        break;
      case "sheets":
      case "sheet":
        if (node.id === "sheet-empty") {
          createDefaultSheetSet();
          render();
        }
        toggleSheetsPanel();
        break;
      case "families":
      case "material":
        ensureDefaultMaterials();
        if (!isPropertyPaletteVisible()) togglePropertyPalette();
        break;
      case "links":
      case "link":
        toggleModelTreePanel();
        break;
      case "groups":
      case "group":
        if (node.meta?.setId) {
          void selection.loadSet(String(node.meta.setId));
        }
        break;
      case "phases":
      case "phase":
        if (node.id === "phase-empty") {
          createDefaultPhases();
          render();
        }
        toggleTimelinePanel();
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[project-browser] activate", e);
  }
  render();
}

function renderNode(node: BrowserNode, depth: number): string {
  const hasKids = !!(node.children && node.children.length);
  const isExp = expanded.has(node.id);
  const isSel = selectedNodeId === node.id;
  const pad = 8 + depth * 14;
  const chevron = hasKids ? (isExp ? "▼" : "▶") : "·";
  const count = node.count != null ? `<span class="pb-count">${node.count}</span>` : "";

  let html = `
    <div class="pb-row ${isSel ? "is-sel" : ""}" data-id="${esc(node.id)}" data-kind="${esc(node.kind)}"
         style="padding-left:${pad}px" title="${esc(node.label)}">
      <span class="pb-chev" data-toggle="${esc(node.id)}">${chevron}</span>
      <span class="pb-icon">${node.icon}</span>
      <span class="pb-label">${esc(node.label)}</span>
      ${count}
    </div>`;

  if (hasKids && isExp) {
    for (const c of node.children!) html += renderNode(c, depth + 1);
  }
  return html;
}

function render() {
  if (!panel) return;
  const tree = buildTree();
  const body = panel.querySelector(".pb-body");
  if (!body) return;
  body.innerHTML = tree.map((n) => renderNode(n, 0)).join("");

  body.querySelectorAll(".pb-row").forEach((el) => {
    el.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const id = (el as HTMLElement).dataset.id!;
      const kind = (el as HTMLElement).dataset.kind as NodeKind;
      // Toggle expand on chevron
      const t = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest("[data-toggle]") as HTMLElement | null;
      if (t) {
        const tid = t.dataset.toggle!;
        if (expanded.has(tid)) expanded.delete(tid);
        else expanded.add(tid);
        render();
        return;
      }
      // Find node
      const find = (nodes: BrowserNode[]): BrowserNode | null => {
        for (const n of nodes) {
          if (n.id === id) return n;
          if (n.children) {
            const f = find(n.children);
            if (f) return f;
          }
        }
        return null;
      };
      const node = find(tree);
      if (node) onActivate(node);
    });
    el.addEventListener("dblclick", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const id = (el as HTMLElement).dataset.id!;
      const find = (nodes: BrowserNode[]): BrowserNode | null => {
        for (const n of nodes) {
          if (n.id === id) return n;
          if (n.children) {
            const f = find(n.children);
            if (f) return f;
          }
        }
        return null;
      };
      const node = find(tree);
      if (node) onActivate(node);
    });
  });
}

function ensurePanel() {
  if (panel) return panel;
  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.className = "obs-project-browser";
  panel.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;left:12px;top:52px;width:280px;bottom:48px;z-index:8200;" +
    "display:none;flex-direction:column;background:#1a1d27;color:#e8eaf0;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);" +
    "font:12px/1.35 system-ui,Segoe UI,sans-serif;overflow:hidden";

  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="pb-header">
      <span class="pb-title">Project Browser</span>
      <div class="pb-actions">
        <button type="button" data-act="refresh" title="Refresh">⟲</button>
        <button type="button" data-act="props" title="Properties">☰</button>
        <button type="button" data-act="close" title="Close">✕</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pb-toolbar">
      <button type="button" data-act="new-view">+ View</button>
      <button type="button" data-act="new-sheet">+ Sheet</button>
      <button type="button" data-act="expand">Expand</button>
    </div>
    <div class="pb-body"></div>
    <div class="pb-footer">Open BIM Studio · Project</div>
  `;

  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.textContent = `
    .obs-project-browser .pb-header {
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
      padding:8px 10px;background:#12141b;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2e3a;
      font-weight:600;font-size:12px;user-select:none;
    }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-actions button {
      background:transparent;border:none;color:#94a3b8;cursor:pointer;
      font-size:13px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;
    }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-actions button:hover { background:#2a2e3a;color:#e2e8f0; }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-toolbar {
      display:flex;gap:4px;padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #1e2029;
    }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-toolbar button {
      flex:1;background:#252836;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;color:#cbd5e1;
      border-radius:4px;padding:4px 6px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;
    }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-toolbar button:hover { background:#2f3344; }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-body {
      flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:4px 0;
    }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-row {
      display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 8px 4px 8px;
      cursor:pointer;border-left:2px solid transparent;
    }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-row:hover { background:#222533; }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-row.is-sel {
      background:#1e3a5f;border-left-color:#38bdf8;
    }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-chev {
      width:12px;font-size:9px;color:#64748b;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-icon { flex-shrink:0;font-size:12px; }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-label {
      flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-count {
      font-size:10px;color:#64748b;background:#12141b;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:8px;
    }
    .obs-project-browser .pb-footer {
      padding:5px 10px;font-size:10px;color:#64748b;border-top:1px solid #1e2029;
      background:#12141b;
    }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
  document.body.appendChild(panel);

  panel.querySelectorAll("[data-act]").forEach((el) => {
    el.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const act = (el as HTMLElement).dataset.act;
      if (act === "close") setVisible(false);
      if (act === "refresh") render();
      if (act === "props") {
        if (!isPropertyPaletteVisible()) togglePropertyPalette();
      }
      if (act === "new-view") {
        saveCurrentView();
        render();
      }
      if (act === "new-sheet") {
        createSheet();
        toggleSheetsPanel();
        render();
      }
      if (act === "expand") {
        for (const n of buildTree()) expanded.add(n.id);
        render();
      }
    });
  });

  return panel;
}

export function setVisible(on: boolean) {
  visible = on;
  const el = ensurePanel();
  el.style.display = on ? "flex" : "none";
  if (on) render();
}

export function toggleProjectBrowser() {
  setVisible(!visible);
}

export function isProjectBrowserVisible() {
  return visible;
}

export function setupProjectBrowser() {
  ensurePanel();
  // Refresh when models load
  try {
    window.addEventListener("obs-toast", () => {
      if (visible) setTimeout(render, 200);
    });
  } catch { /* */ }
  // openbim-fix:workspace-layout -- expose the panel via the feature
  // registry so workspace-layout can save/restore its open state.
  (ctx.features as any).projectBrowser = {
    open: () => setVisible(true),
    close: () => setVisible(false),
    toggle: toggleProjectBrowser,
    isVisible: isProjectBrowserVisible,
  };
  // openbim-fix:workspace-layout -- expose the panel via the feature
  // registry so workspace-layout can save/restore its open state.
  ctx.features.projectBrowser = {
    open: () => setVisible(true),
    close: () => setVisible(false),
    toggle: toggleProjectBrowser,
    isVisible: isProjectBrowserVisible,
  };
}
```

```ts
/** Project control center — professional project metadata and delivery settings. */
import { getCurrentProject, isDirty, saveProject, updateProjectMeta } from "../modules/projects/projects";
import type { ProjectStatus, ProjectUnits } from "../modules/projects/types";

let open = false;
let overlay: HTMLDivElement | null = null;

const esc = (s: unknown) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>\"']/g, (c) =>
  ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", "\"": "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as Record<string, string>)[c],
);

function field(label: string, id: string, value: string, placeholder = ""): string {
  return `
    <label class="obs-meta-field">
      <span>${esc(label)}</span>
      <input id="${id}" value="${esc(value)}" placeholder="${esc(placeholder)}" autocomplete="off" />
    </label>`;
}

function build(): HTMLDivElement {
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "obs-modal-overlay";
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="obs-modal obs-project-info" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="obs-project-info-title">
      <div class="obs-modal__header">
        <div>
          <div class="obs-modal__eyebrow">PROJECT CONTROL CENTER</div>
          <h2 id="obs-project-info-title">Project Information</h2>
          <p>Keep project identity, delivery stage and model units consistent across the BIM workspace.</p>
        </div>
        <button class="obs-modal__close" id="obs-project-info-close" aria-label="Close">×</button>
      </div>
      <div class="obs-modal__body">
        <section class="obs-meta-section">
          <div class="obs-meta-section__title">Project identity</div>
          <div class="obs-meta-grid obs-meta-grid--2">
            ${field("Project name", "obs-meta-name", "", "e.g. HSR PK3 MEP Stations")}
            ${field("Project number", "obs-meta-number", "", "e.g. PK3-MEP-001")}
            ${field("Client / owner", "obs-meta-client", "", "Client or JV")}
            ${field("Delivery phase", "obs-meta-phase", "", "Design / Construction / As-built")}
          </div>
          <label class="obs-meta-field">
            <span>Project description</span>
            <textarea id="obs-meta-description" rows="3" placeholder="Purpose, scope and key delivery notes"></textarea>
          </label>
        </section>
        <section class="obs-meta-section">
          <div class="obs-meta-section__title">Delivery settings</div>
          <div class="obs-meta-grid obs-meta-grid--2">
            <label class="obs-meta-field">
              <span>Status</span>
              <select id="obs-meta-status">
                <option value="active">Active</option>
                <option value="on-hold">On hold</option>
                <option value="complete">Complete</option>
                <option value="archived">Archived</option>
              </select>
            </label>
            <label class="obs-meta-field">
              <span>Project units</span>
              <select id="obs-meta-units">
                <option value="metric">Metric (m / mm)</option>
                <option value="imperial">Imperial (ft / in)</option>
              </select>
            </label>
            ${field("Project owner", "obs-meta-owner", "", "Team / company")}
            <div class="obs-meta-facts" id="obs-meta-facts"></div>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
      <div class="obs-modal__footer">
        <span class="obs-modal__dirty" id="obs-meta-dirty"></span>
        <div class="obs-modal__actions">
          <button class="obs-btn" id="obs-project-info-cancel">Cancel</button>
          <button class="obs-btn obs-btn--primary" id="obs-project-info-save">Save project settings</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  el.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    if (e.target === el) closeProjectInfo();
  });
  el.querySelector("#obs-project-info-close")?.addEventListener("click", closeProjectInfo);
  el.querySelector("#obs-project-info-cancel")?.addEventListener("click", closeProjectInfo);
  el.querySelector("#obs-project-info-save")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const project = getCurrentProject();
    if (!project) return;
    updateProjectMeta({
      name: value("obs-meta-name"),
      projectNumber: value("obs-meta-number"),
      client: value("obs-meta-client"),
      phase: value("obs-meta-phase"),
      description: value("obs-meta-description"),
      owner: value("obs-meta-owner"),
      status: selectValue("obs-meta-status") as ProjectStatus,
      units: selectValue("obs-meta-units") as ProjectUnits,
    });
    void saveProject();
    closeProjectInfo();
  });
  return el;
}

function value(id: string): string {
  return String((document.getElementById(id) as HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement | null)?.value ?? "");
}
function selectValue(id: string): string {
  return String((document.getElementById(id) as HTMLSelectElement | null)?.value ?? "");
}

function refresh(): void {
  const project = getCurrentProject();
  if (!project || !overlay) return;
  (overlay.querySelector("#obs-meta-name") as HTMLInputElement).value = project.name ?? "";
  (overlay.querySelector("#obs-meta-number") as HTMLInputElement).value = project.projectNumber ?? "";
  (overlay.querySelector("#obs-meta-client") as HTMLInputElement).value = project.client ?? "";
  (overlay.querySelector("#obs-meta-phase") as HTMLInputElement).value = project.phase ?? "";
  (overlay.querySelector("#obs-meta-owner") as HTMLInputElement).value = project.owner ?? "";
  (overlay.querySelector("#obs-meta-description") as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = project.description ?? "";
  (overlay.querySelector("#obs-meta-status") as HTMLSelectElement).value = project.status ?? "active";
  (overlay.querySelector("#obs-meta-units") as HTMLSelectElement).value = project.units ?? "metric";

  const facts = overlay.querySelector("#obs-meta-facts");
  if (facts) {
    const models = project.models?.length ?? 0;
    const elements = project.elements?.length ?? 0;
    const issues = project.issues?.length ?? 0;
    facts.innerHTML = `
      <div><span>Linked models</span><b>${models}</b></div>
      <div><span>Authored elements</span><b>${elements}</b></div>
      <div><span>Coordination issues</span><b>${issues}</b></div>`;
  }

  const dirty = overlay.querySelector("#obs-meta-dirty");
  if (dirty) dirty.textContent = isDirty() ? "Unsaved project changes" : "All project data saved";
}

export function openProjectInfo(): void {
  if (!getCurrentProject()) return;
  if (!overlay) {
    overlay = build();
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  }
  refresh();
  overlay.classList.add("is-open");
  open = true;
  const input = overlay.querySelector("#obs-meta-name") as HTMLInputElement | null;
  input?.focus();
  input?.select();
}

export function closeProjectInfo(): void {
  overlay?.classList.remove("is-open");
  open = false;
}

export function isProjectInfoOpen(): boolean { return open; }
```

```ts
/**
 * Revit-style Properties palette.
 *
 * Two modes:
 *   • defaults — a tool is active; edits set the values applied to the next
 *     element placed.
 *   • edit    — one element is selected; edits apply live to that element.
 *
 * The palette is draggable, resizable, and dockable via the generic
 * `dockable.ts` controller. Position and size persist per panel ID.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  getActiveTool,
  getSelectedIds,
  getElements,
  getTypeDefaults,
  setTypeDefault,
  getPaletteTarget,
  setPaletteTarget,
  onAuthoringChange,
  rebuildAuthored,
  markAuthoringDirty,
} from "./authoring";
import { getSchema, type PropertyField, type FieldTarget } from "./property-schema";
import { svgIcon, type IconName } from "./icon-set";
import { levels } from "../modules/levels";
import { makeDockable, type DockHandle } from "./dockable";
import { selection } from "./selection";
import type { AuthoredElement } from "../modules/projects/types";

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Panel shell
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const panel = document.createElement("div");
panel.id = "obs-property-palette";
panel.style.cssText =
  "z-index:60;" +
  "display:none;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);" +
  "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:10px;" +
  "box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.55);font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;" +
  "color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);overflow:hidden";
panel.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

const header = document.createElement("div");
header.style.cssText =
  "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 10px;" +
  "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);" +
  "background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);cursor:move;user-select:none";

const body = document.createElement("div");
body.style.cssText = "flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:4px 0;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-width:auto";

panel.append(header, body);

let expanded = true;
let visible = false;
let dockHandle: DockHandle | null = null;

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Field I/O
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function readValue(
  target: FieldTarget,
  element: AuthoredElement | null,
  typeKey: string,
  key: string,
): string | number | boolean {
  if (target === "root") {
    if (element) return (element as any)[key] ?? "";
    const d = getTypeDefaults(typeKey);
    return (d as any)[key] ?? "";
  }
  if (element) {
    if (target === "params") {
      const v = (element.params as any)[key];
      return v ?? "";
    }
    return (element.properties?.[key] as any) ?? "";
  }
  const d = getTypeDefaults(typeKey);
  if (target === "params") return (d.params as any)?.[key] ?? "";
  return (d.properties as any)?.[key] ?? "";
}

function writeValue(
  target: FieldTarget,
  element: AuthoredElement | null,
  typeKey: string,
  key: string,
  value: string | number | boolean,
): void {
  if (element) {
    if (target === "root") {
      (element as any)[key] = value;
    } else if (target === "params") {
      (element.params as any)[key] = value;
    } else {
      element.properties = { ...(element.properties ?? {}), [key]: value };
    }
    rebuildAuthored();
    markAuthoringDirty();
  } else {
    setTypeDefault(typeKey, target, key, value);
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Input builders
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const INPUT_CSS =
  "width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:4px 6px;background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);" +
  "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:4px;" +
  "color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:12px system-ui;outline:none";

function fieldRow(
  field: PropertyField,
  getValue: () => any,
  setValue: (v: any) => void,
): HTMLElement {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.style.cssText = "display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:3px 12px";

  const label = document.createElement("label");
  label.textContent = field.label;
  label.style.cssText = "font-size:11px;color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5)";
  if (field.helpText) label.title = field.helpText;

  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center";

  let input: HTMLElement;

  switch (field.type) {
    case "number": {
      const i = document.createElement("input");
      i.type = "number";
      i.step = String(field.step ?? 0.1);
      if (field.min != null) i.min = String(field.min);
      if (field.max != null) i.max = String(field.max);
      i.value = String(getValue() ?? "");
      i.style.cssText = INPUT_CSS + ";text-align:right";
      i.onchange = () => {
        let v = Number(i.value);
        if (!Number.isFinite(v)) v = 0;
        if (field.min != null) v = Math.max(field.min, v);
        if (field.max != null) v = Math.min(field.max, v);
        i.value = String(v);
        setValue(v);
      };
      input = i;
      break;
    }
    case "text": {
      const i = document.createElement("input");
      i.type = "text";
      i.value = String(getValue() ?? "");
      i.style.cssText = INPUT_CSS;
      i.onchange = () => setValue(i.value);
      input = i;
      break;
    }
    case "select": {
      const s = document.createElement("select");
      s.style.cssText = INPUT_CSS + ";cursor:pointer";
      const cur = String(getValue() ?? field.default ?? "");
      s.innerHTML =
        `<option value="">—</option>` +
        (field.options ?? [])
          .map(
            (o) =>
              `<option value="${o.value}" ${o.value === cur ? "selected" : ""}>${o.label}</option>`,
          )
          .join("");
      s.onchange = () => setValue(s.value);
      input = s;
      break;
    }
    case "boolean": {
      const c = document.createElement("input");
      c.type = "checkbox";
      c.checked = !!getValue();
      c.style.cssText = "cursor:pointer";
      c.onchange = () => setValue(c.checked);
      input = c;
      break;
    }
    case "color": {
      const i = document.createElement("input");
      i.type = "color";
      i.value = String(getValue() || "#cccccc");
      i.style.cssText = "width:100%;height:22px;background:none;border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer";
      i.oninput = () => setValue(i.value);
      input = i;
      break;
    }
  }

  wrap.appendChild(input);
  if (field.unit) {
    const u = document.createElement("span");
    u.textContent = field.unit;
    u.style.cssText = "font-size:10px;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);min-width:16px";
    wrap.appendChild(u);
  }

  row.append(label, wrap);
  return row;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Collapsible sections
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const sectionState = new Map<string, boolean>();

function sectionBlock(
  groupName: string,
  fields: PropertyField[],
  element: AuthoredElement | null,
  typeKey: string,
): HTMLElement {
  const key = `${typeKey}:${groupName}`;
  const open = sectionState.get(key) ?? true;

  const block = document.createElement("div");
  block.style.cssText = "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)";

  const headerRow = document.createElement("div");
  headerRow.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 12px;cursor:pointer;" +
    "background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);user-select:none";

  const caret = document.createElement("span");
  caret.textContent = open ? "▾" : "▸";
  caret.style.cssText = "width:10px;font-size:9px;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)";

  const title = document.createElement("span");
  title.textContent = groupName;
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.2px";

  headerRow.append(caret, title);

  const list = document.createElement("div");
  list.style.cssText = "padding:4px 0;display:" + (open ? "block" : "none");

  for (const f of fields) {
    list.appendChild(
      fieldRow(
        f,
        () => readValue(f.target, element, typeKey, f.key),
        (v) => writeValue(f.target, element, typeKey, f.key, v),
      ),
    );
  }

  headerRow.onclick = () => {
    const now = !(sectionState.get(key) ?? true);
    sectionState.set(key, now);
    caret.textContent = now ? "▾" : "▸";
    list.style.display = now ? "block" : "none";
  };

  block.append(headerRow, list);
  return block;
}

// openbim-families:instance-wiring
//
// "Family identity" block. Shown when the selected element carries a
// familyId. Lets the user switch the element's type; every instance of
// the new type is re-synced from its parametric definition.
//
// Writes:
//   element.familyTypeId = selected type id
//   then authoring.syncFamilyInstances(famId, newTypeId) re-resolves
//   params for every element carrying that type.
function makeFamilyIdentityBlock(element: AuthoredElement): HTMLElement {
  const block = document.createElement("div");
  block.style.cssText = "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)";

  const headerRow = document.createElement("div");
  headerRow.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 12px;" +
    "background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);user-select:none";
  const caret = document.createElement("span");
  caret.textContent = "\u25BE";
  caret.style.cssText = "width:10px;font-size:9px;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)";
  const title = document.createElement("span");
  title.textContent = "Family";
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.2px";
  headerRow.append(caret, title);

  const list = document.createElement("div");
  list.style.cssText = "padding:4px 0";

  const familyService: any = (ctx.features as any).family;
  const fam = familyService?.get?.(element.familyId);

  if (!fam) {
    const warn = document.createElement("div");
    warn.textContent = "Family not found: " + element.familyId;
    warn.style.cssText = "padding:4px 12px;font-size:11px;color:var(--obs-pp-warn-fg, #fca5a5)";
    list.appendChild(warn);
    block.append(headerRow, list);
    return block;
  }

  const rowFam = document.createElement("div");
  rowFam.style.cssText =
    "display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:3px 12px";
  const lblFam = document.createElement("label");
  lblFam.textContent = "Family";
  lblFam.style.cssText = "font-size:11px;color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5)";
  const valFam = document.createElement("span");
  valFam.textContent = fam.name;
  valFam.style.cssText = "font-size:12px;color:#e8eaf0";
  rowFam.append(lblFam, valFam);
  list.appendChild(rowFam);

  const rowType = document.createElement("div");
  rowType.style.cssText = rowFam.style.cssText;
  const lblType = document.createElement("label");
  lblType.textContent = "Type";
  lblType.style.cssText = "font-size:11px;color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5)";
  const selType = document.createElement("select");
  selType.style.cssText =
    "width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:4px 6px;" +
    "background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);" +
    "border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:12px system-ui;cursor:pointer";
  selType.innerHTML = fam.types.map(
    (t: any) =>
      "<option value=\"" + t.id + "\">" + t.name + "</option>",
  ).join("");
  selType.value = element.familyTypeId ?? (fam.types[0]?.id ?? "");
  selType.onchange = () => {
    const newTypeId = selType.value || null;
    const prevType = element.familyTypeId ?? null;
    if (newTypeId === prevType) return;
    element.familyTypeId = newTypeId ?? undefined;
    try {
      const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
      const n = auth?.syncFamilyInstances?.(fam.id, newTypeId) ?? 0;
      if (n > 0) {
        console.log(
          "[property-palette] synced " + n + " instance(s) of type " + newTypeId,
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[property-palette] sync after type change failed", err);
    }
    markAuthoringDirty();
    render();
  };
  rowType.append(lblType, selType);
  list.appendChild(rowType);

  // openbim-family-placement: instance-scope parameters edit this element
  // directly; type-scope parameters update the family type and re-sync
  // every instance of that type. This is the Revit Type/Instance split.
  try {
    const resolvedNow = familyService.resolveParams(
      fam.id,
      element.familyTypeId ?? null,
      undefined,
    ) ?? {};

    if (fam.parameters.length > 0) {
      const paramHeader = document.createElement("div");
      paramHeader.textContent = "Parameters";
      paramHeader.style.cssText =
        "font-weight:600;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);" +
        "padding:8px 12px 2px;letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase";
      list.appendChild(paramHeader);

      for (const p of fam.parameters) {
        const current = (resolvedNow as any)[p.name];
        if (current === undefined) continue;

        const row = document.createElement("div");
        row.style.cssText =
          "display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 22px;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:3px 12px";

        const lbl = document.createElement("label");
        lbl.textContent = p.label ?? p.name;
        lbl.style.cssText = "font-size:11px;color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5)";

        const inp = document.createElement("input");
        inp.type = typeof current === "number" ? "number" : "text";
        if (typeof current === "number") inp.step = String(p.step ?? 0.01);
        inp.value = String(current);
        inp.style.cssText =
          "width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:4px 6px;text-align:right;" +
          "background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);" +
          "border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:12px system-ui";
        inp.onchange = () => {
          const isNum = typeof current === "number";
          const v = isNum ? Number(inp.value) : inp.value;
          if (isNum && !Number.isFinite(v)) { inp.value = String(current); return; }
          void (async () => {
            try {
              const mod: any = await import("../modules/families/placement");
              const res = mod.editFamilyParameter(element, p.name, v);
              if (res.applied === "type" && res.instancesSynced > 0) {
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
                  detail: {
                    message: "Updated " + res.instancesSynced + " instance(s)",
                    kind: "success",
                  },
                }));
              }
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn("[property-palette] family param edit failed", err);
            }
            markAuthoringDirty();
            render();
          })();
        };

        const scope = document.createElement("span");
        scope.textContent = p.scope === "type" ? "T" : "I";
        scope.title = p.scope === "type" ? "Type parameter" : "Instance parameter";
        scope.style.cssText =
          "font:700 10px ui-monospace,monospace;text-align:center;" +
          "border-radius:3px;padding:2px 0;" +
          (p.scope === "type"
            ? "background:var(--obs-pp-type-bg, rgba(56,189,248,.14));color:var(--obs-pp-type-fg, #7dd3fc)"
            : "background:var(--obs-pp-inst-bg, rgba(168,85,247,.14));color:var(--obs-pp-inst-fg, #c4b5fd)");

        row.append(lbl, inp, scope);
        list.appendChild(row);
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[property-palette] family parameter table failed", err);
  }

  block.append(headerRow, list);
  return block;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Header
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderHeader(mode: "defaults" | "edit", typeLabel: string, elementName?: string) {
  header.innerHTML = "";

  const icon = document.createElement("span");
  icon.style.cssText = "display:flex;color:var(--accent,#38bdf8)";
  try {
    icon.innerHTML = svgIcon("component" as IconName);
  } catch {
    icon.textContent = "◧";
  }

  const text = document.createElement("div");
  text.style.cssText = "flex:1;min-width:0";

  const title = document.createElement("div");
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:700;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap";
  title.textContent =
    mode === "defaults"
      ? `${typeLabel} — defaults`
      : elementName
        ? elementName
        : `${typeLabel} — instance`;

  const sub = document.createElement("div");
  sub.style.cssText = "font-size:10px;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);margin-top:1px";
  sub.textContent =
    mode === "defaults"
      ? "Applied to the next element you place"
      : "Edit the selected element";

  text.append(title, sub);

  const collapseBtn = document.createElement("button");
  collapseBtn.textContent = expanded ? "▾" : "▸";
  collapseBtn.title = "Collapse / expand";
  collapseBtn.style.cssText =
    "padding:2px 6px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px";
  collapseBtn.onclick = () => {
    expanded = !expanded;
    body.style.display = expanded ? "block" : "none";
    render();
  };

  header.append(icon, text, collapseBtn);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Render
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function render() {
  const target = getPaletteTarget();

  if (!target) {
    // Keep open if user explicitly opened Properties — show view properties
    if (visible) {
      if (dockHandle) dockHandle.show();
      else panel.style.display = "flex";
      renderViewProperties();
    } else {
      if (dockHandle) dockHandle.hide();
      else panel.style.display = "none";
    }
    return;
  }

  visible = true;
  if (dockHandle) dockHandle.show();
  else panel.style.display = "flex";

  const schema = getSchema(target.type);
  if (!schema) {
    header.innerHTML = "";
    const t = document.createElement("div");
    t.textContent = `${target.type} — no editable properties`;
    t.style.cssText = "font-weight:600;flex:1";
    header.appendChild(t);
    body.innerHTML = "";
    return;
  }

  let element: AuthoredElement | null = null;
  if (target.mode === "edit") {
    element = getElements().find((e) => e.id === target.elementId) ?? null;
    if (!element) {
      // Element deleted underneath us — fall back to tool defaults.
      setPaletteTarget(
        getActiveTool() ? { mode: "defaults", type: getActiveTool() as any } : null,
      );
      return;
    }
  }

  renderHeader(
    target.mode,
    schema.label,
    element ? element.name : undefined,
  );

  body.innerHTML = "";
  body.style.display = expanded ? "block" : "none";

  const byGroup = new Map<string, PropertyField[]>();
  for (const f of schema.fields) {
    const arr = byGroup.get(f.group) ?? [];
    arr.push(f);
    byGroup.set(f.group, arr);
  }

  for (const g of schema.groups) {
    const fields = byGroup.get(g);
    if (!fields || !fields.length) continue;
    body.appendChild(sectionBlock(g, fields, element, schema.type));
  }

  // openbim-levels:ui-wired:property-palette
  if (element && LEVEL_CONSTRAINED_TYPES.has(schema.type)) {
    try { body.appendChild(makeLevelConstraintsBlock(element)); }
    catch (err) { console.warn("[property-palette] level constraints failed", err); }
  }

  // openbim-families:instance-wiring
  if (element && element.familyId) {
    try { body.appendChild(makeFamilyIdentityBlock(element)); }
    catch (err) { console.warn("[property-palette] family identity failed", err); }
  }
}

/** Element types that carry a Revit-style "Base Constraint" (level). */
const LEVEL_CONSTRAINED_TYPES = new Set<string>([
  "wall", "slab", "column", "beam", "brace", "truss",
  "footing", "strip",
  "door", "window",
  "duct", "pipe", "cable-tray", "conduit", "equipment",
]);

/**
 * Build a "Constraints" block bound to `element.levelId`.
 *
 * Writes:
 *   element.levelId          = selected level id
 *   element.params.elevation = level.elevation + baseOffset
 *
 * baseOffset is derived on read as
 *   (element.params.elevation - level.elevation)
 * so a user who edited elevation manually sees a stable offset.
 */
function makeLevelConstraintsBlock(element: AuthoredElement): HTMLElement {
  const block = document.createElement("div");
  block.style.cssText = "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)";

  const headerRow = document.createElement("div");
  headerRow.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 12px;" +
    "background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);user-select:none";
  const caret = document.createElement("span");
  caret.textContent = "\u25BE";
  caret.style.cssText = "width:10px;font-size:9px;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)";
  const title = document.createElement("span");
  title.textContent = "Constraints";
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.2px";
  headerRow.append(caret, title);

  const list = document.createElement("div");
  list.style.cssText = "padding:4px 0";

  const all = levels.list();

  const rowBase = document.createElement("div");
  rowBase.style.cssText =
    "display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:3px 12px";
  const lblBase = document.createElement("label");
  lblBase.textContent = "Base Constraint";
  lblBase.style.cssText = "font-size:11px;color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5)";
  const selBase = document.createElement("select");
  selBase.style.cssText =
    "width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:4px 6px;" +
    "background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);" +
    "border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:12px system-ui;cursor:pointer";
  selBase.innerHTML =
    "<option value=\"\">-- none --</option>" +
    all.map((l) =>
      "<option value=\"" + l.id + "\">" + l.name + " (" + l.elevation.toFixed(2) + " m)</option>",
    ).join("");
  selBase.value = element.levelId ?? "";
  selBase.onchange = () => {
    const id = selBase.value || null;
    const before = {
      levelId: element.levelId,
      elevation: element.params.elevation,
    };
    const target = id ? all.find((l) => l.id === id) ?? null : null;
    element.levelId = id ?? undefined;
    if (target) {
      element.params.elevation = target.elevation;
    } else {
      element.params.elevation = before.elevation;
    }
    rebuildAuthored();
    markAuthoringDirty();
    const after = {
      levelId: element.levelId,
      elevation: element.params.elevation,
    };
    try {
      const hist = (ctx.features as any).history;
      hist?.push?.({
        label: "Base Constraint - " + element.name,
        apply: () => {
          element.levelId = after.levelId;
          element.params.elevation = after.elevation;
          rebuildAuthored(); markAuthoringDirty();
        },
        revert: () => {
          element.levelId = before.levelId;
          element.params.elevation = before.elevation;
          rebuildAuthored(); markAuthoringDirty();
        },
      });
    } catch { /* history optional */ }
    render();
  };
  rowBase.append(lblBase, selBase);
  list.appendChild(rowBase);

  const activeLevel = element.levelId
    ? all.find((l) => l.id === element.levelId) ?? null
    : null;
  const offsetVal = activeLevel
    ? element.params.elevation - activeLevel.elevation
    : 0;

  const rowOff = document.createElement("div");
  rowOff.style.cssText = rowBase.style.cssText;
  const lblOff = document.createElement("label");
  lblOff.textContent = "Base Offset";
  lblOff.style.cssText = "font-size:11px;color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5)";
  const offWrap = document.createElement("div");
  offWrap.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center";
  const inpOff = document.createElement("input");
  inpOff.type = "number";
  inpOff.step = "0.05";
  inpOff.value = offsetVal.toFixed(3);
  inpOff.disabled = !activeLevel;
  inpOff.style.cssText =
    "flex:1;box-sizing:border-box;padding:4px 6px;text-align:right;" +
    "background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);" +
    "border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:12px system-ui";
  if (!activeLevel) inpOff.style.opacity = "0.5";
  inpOff.onchange = () => {
    if (!activeLevel) return;
    const v = Number(inpOff.value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(v)) { inpOff.value = offsetVal.toFixed(3); return; }
    const before = element.params.elevation;
    const after = activeLevel.elevation + v;
    element.params.elevation = after;
    rebuildAuthored(); markAuthoringDirty();
    try {
      const hist = (ctx.features as any).history;
      hist?.push?.({
        label: "Base Offset - " + element.name,
        apply: () => { element.params.elevation = after; rebuildAuthored(); markAuthoringDirty(); },
        revert: () => { element.params.elevation = before; rebuildAuthored(); markAuthoringDirty(); },
      });
    } catch { /* */ }
    render();
  };
  const unit = document.createElement("span");
  unit.textContent = "m";
  unit.style.cssText = "font-size:10px;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);min-width:16px";
  offWrap.append(inpOff, unit);
  rowOff.append(lblOff, offWrap);
  list.appendChild(rowOff);

  block.append(headerRow, list);
  return block;
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function openPropertyPalette() {
  visible = true;
  if (dockHandle) dockHandle.show();
  else panel.style.display = "flex";
  if (!getPaletteTarget()) renderViewProperties();
  else render();
}
export function closePropertyPalette() {
  visible = false;
  if (dockHandle) dockHandle.hide();
  else panel.style.display = "none";
}
export function isPropertyPaletteVisible(): boolean {
  return visible;
}
export function togglePropertyPalette() {
  if (visible) closePropertyPalette();
  else openPropertyPalette();
}

/** Revit-style view / graphics properties when no element is selected. */
function renderViewProperties() {
  try {
    renderHeader("defaults", "3D View", "Project view");
  } catch {
    header.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:700;flex:1">3D View — Properties</div>`;
  }
  body.innerHTML = "";
  body.style.display = "block";

  const section = (title: string, rows: { label: string; value: string }[]) => {
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.style.cssText = "padding:6px 10px 10px";
    const h = document.createElement("div");
    h.style.cssText =
      "font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;" +
      "color:#64748b;margin:4px 0 6px;padding-bottom:4px;border-bottom:1px solid #1e2029";
    h.textContent = title;
    wrap.appendChild(h);
    for (const r of rows) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.cssText =
        "display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:4px 0;gap:8px";
      const lab = document.createElement("span");
      lab.style.cssText = "color:#94a3b8";
      lab.textContent = r.label;
      const val = document.createElement("span");
      val.style.cssText =
        "color:#e2e8f0;background:#12141b;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:4px;" +
        "padding:2px 8px;min-width:72px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums";
      val.textContent = r.value;
      row.append(lab, val);
      wrap.appendChild(row);
    }
    return wrap;
  };

  body.appendChild(section("Identity", [
    { label: "View name", value: "3D View" },
    { label: "View type", value: "3D" },
    { label: "Discipline", value: "Coordination" },
  ]));
  body.appendChild(section("Graphics", [
    { label: "View scale", value: "1 : 100" },
    { label: "Scale value", value: "100" },
    { label: "Detail level", value: "Medium" },
    { label: "Parts visibility", value: "Show original" },
    { label: "Show hidden lines", value: "By discipline" },
  ]));
  body.appendChild(section("Extents", [
    { label: "Crop region", value: "Off" },
    { label: "Annotation crop", value: "Off" },
    { label: "Far clip", value: "No clip" },
  ]));

  const tip = document.createElement("div");
  tip.style.cssText = "padding:8px 12px;font-size:11px;color:#64748b;line-height:1.4";
  tip.textContent =
    "Select an authored element or activate a modeling tool to edit instance / type properties.";
  body.appendChild(tip);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Setup
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
// openbim-fix:pp-theme
//
// Injects a small :root block mapping palette-local tokens to app
// theme tokens. The palette's inline styles then use
// var(--obs-pp-*, <fallback>) so a theme override anywhere in the app
// (dark/light toggle, high-contrast, brand palette) automatically
// reaches the Properties palette.
//
// The <style> element is added once (guard on its id). All fallbacks
// are the previous hard-coded values, so visual output is unchanged
// until a theme overrides one of the tokens.
function installPaletteTheme(): void {
  const STYLE_ID = "obs-pp-theme";
  if (document.getElementById(STYLE_ID)) return;
  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.id = STYLE_ID;
  style.textContent = [
    ":root {",
    "  --obs-pp-warn-fg:       var(--danger-soft, #fca5a5);",
    "  --obs-pp-type-bg:       var(--accent-dim, rgba(56,189,248,.14));",
    "  --obs-pp-type-fg:       var(--accent-soft, #7dd3fc);",
    "  --obs-pp-inst-bg:       var(--alt-dim, rgba(168,85,247,.14));",
    "  --obs-pp-inst-fg:       var(--alt-soft, #c4b5fd);",
    "  --obs-pp-active-border: var(--accent, #38bdf8);",
    "  --obs-pp-row-bg:        var(--bg-base, #0b0d12);",
    "  --obs-pp-row-border:    var(--border-subtle, #1e2029);",
    "  --obs-pp-row-fg:        var(--text-secondary, #cbd5e1);",
    "}",
  ].join("\n");
  document.head.appendChild(style);
}
export function setupPropertyPalette(): void {
  installPaletteTheme();
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);

  dockHandle = makeDockable(panel, {
    id: "property-palette",
    host: ctx.rightHost,
    header,
    minWidth: 260,
    minHeight: 280,
    defaultDock: "right",
    defaultWidth: 320,
    defaultHeight: 520,
    margin: 8,
    snapThreshold: 28,
  });

  // openbim-fix:property-palette-closed-by-default
  // Refresh the palette contents when authoring changes, but DO NOT
  // force it open. The palette stays closed unless the user opened it
  // via the ribbon, User Interface menu, Ctrl+1, the command palette,
  // or openPropertyPalette().
  onAuthoringChange(() => {
    if (!visible) return;
    render();
  });

  // Keep palette visible and on top when selection changes.
  try {
    selection.onChange(() => {
      if (!visible) return;
      render();
    });
  } catch { /* */ }

  // Show at top/right by default — not hidden behind other chrome.
  closePropertyPalette();
  try { dockHandle.dock("right"); } catch { /* */ }
  render();

  ctx.features.propertyPalette = {
    open: openPropertyPalette,
    close: closePropertyPalette,
    isVisible: isPropertyPaletteVisible,
    rerender: render,
    dock: (side: "left" | "right" | "float") => dockHandle?.dock(side),
    resetLayout: () => dockHandle?.reset(),
  };
}
```
