```ts
/**
 * Property schema per authored element type.
 *
 * Each element declares its editable fields. The palette renders from this
 * — no UI code per element type, no duplicated field lists. Add a field
 * here and it appears in the panel automatically.
 *
 * Field targets:
 *   "params"     → element.params[key]        (dimensions, constraints)
 *   "properties" → element.properties[key]    (user metadata: fire rating, type mark)
 *   "root"       → element[key]               (name, color — top-level fields)
 */
import type { ElementType } from "../modules/projects/types";

export type FieldType = "number" | "text" | "select" | "color" | "boolean";
export type FieldTarget = "params" | "properties" | "root";

export interface PropertyField {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  group: string;
  type: FieldType;
  unit?: string;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  options?: { value: string; label: string }[];
  target: FieldTarget;
  default?: string | number | boolean;
  helpText?: string;
}

export interface ElementSchema {
  type: ElementType;
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  groups: string[];
  fields: PropertyField[];
}

const DIMENSIONS = "Dimensions";
const CONSTRAINTS = "Constraints";
const IDENTITY = "Identity Data";
const MATERIALS = "Materials";
const CONSTRUCTION = "Construction";

const num = (
  key: string,
  label: string,
  group: string,
  step = 0.05,
  min?: number,
  max?: number,
): PropertyField => ({
  key,
  label,
  group,
  type: "number",
  unit: "m",
  step,
  min,
  max,
  target: "params",
});

const elev = (): PropertyField => num("elevation", "Base elevation", CONSTRAINTS, 0.1);

const nameField = (): PropertyField => ({
  key: "name",
  label: "Name",
  group: IDENTITY,
  type: "text",
  target: "root",
});

const typeMarkField = (): PropertyField => ({
  key: "typeMark",
  label: "Type mark",
  group: IDENTITY,
  type: "text",
  target: "properties",
  helpText: "e.g. W-01, D-02",
});

const fireField = (): PropertyField => ({
  key: "fireRating",
  label: "Fire rating",
  group: IDENTITY,
  type: "text",
  target: "properties",
  helpText: "e.g. 60 min, 2 hr",
});

const colorField = (): PropertyField => ({
  key: "color",
  label: "Color",
  group: MATERIALS,
  type: "color",
  target: "root",
});

const commentsField = (): PropertyField => ({
  key: "comments",
  label: "Comments",
  group: IDENTITY,
  type: "text",
  target: "properties",
});

export const SCHEMAS: Partial<Record<ElementType, ElementSchema>> = {
  wall: {
    type: "wall",
    label: "Wall",
    icon: "wall",
    groups: [DIMENSIONS, CONSTRAINTS, CONSTRUCTION, IDENTITY, MATERIALS],
    fields: [
      num("height", "Height", DIMENSIONS, 0.1, 0.01),
      num("thickness", "Thickness", DIMENSIONS, 0.05, 0.01),
      elev(),
      {
        key: "locationLine",
        label: "Location Line",
        group: CONSTRAINTS,
        type: "select",
        target: "properties",
        options: [
          { value: "wall-centerline", label: "Wall Centerline" },
          { value: "core-centerline", label: "Core Centerline" },
          { value: "finish-exterior", label: "Finish Face: Exterior" },
          { value: "finish-interior", label: "Finish Face: Interior" },
          { value: "core-exterior", label: "Core Face: Exterior" },
          { value: "core-interior", label: "Core Face: Interior" },
        ],
        default: "wall-centerline",
      },
      {
        key: "joinStatus",
        label: "Join Status",
        group: CONSTRUCTION,
        type: "select",
        target: "properties",
        options: [
          { value: "allow", label: "Allow" },
          { value: "disallow", label: "Disallow" },
          { value: "extended", label: "Extended" },
          { value: "chamfer", label: "Chamfer" },
          { value: "butt", label: "Butt" },
        ],
        default: "allow",
      },
      {
        key: "chain",
        label: "Chain",
        group: CONSTRAINTS,
        type: "boolean",

export function hasSchema(type: ElementType | string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!type) return false;
  return !!SCHEMAS[type as ElementType];
}

  return SCHEMAS[type as ElementType] ?? null;
```

```ts
/**
 * Push/Pull - SketchUp-style direct face extrusion.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { inputRouter, type Gesture } from "../core/input-router";
import { history } from "./history";
import { notify } from "../core/notify";
import type { AuthoredElement } from "../modules/projects/types";

type Dimension = "height" | "thickness" | "depth" | "length";

interface HoverState {
  elementId: string;
  faceNormal: THREE.Vector3;
  hitPoint: THREE.Vector3;
  dimension: Dimension;
  sign: 1 | -1;
}

interface DragState {
  elementId: string;
  dimension: Dimension;
  sign: 1 | -1;
  startValue: number;
  startPoint: THREE.Vector3;
  baseline: AuthoredElement["params"];
  plane: THREE.Plane;
}

const MIN_DIM = 0.02;

class PushPullManager {
  private enabled = false;
  private hovered: HoverState | null = null;
  private dragging: DragState | null = null;
  private unsubGesture: (() => void) | null = null;
  private unsubCancel: (() => void) | null = null;
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private lastHoverAt = 0;
  private static HOVER_MS = 55;

  init(): void {
    if (this.unsubGesture) return;
    this.unsubGesture = inputRouter.subscribe((g) => this.handle(g), 90);
    this.unsubCancel = inputRouter.registerCancel(() => {
      if (!this.enabled && !this.dragging) return false;
      if (this.dragging) { this.cancelDrag(); return true; }
      this.disable();
      return true;
    });
    console.log("[push-pull] ready");
  }

  isEnabled(): boolean { return this.enabled; }

  enable(): void {
    if (this.enabled) return;
    this.enabled = true;
    ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = "ns-resize";
    notify("info", "Push/Pull - hover a face, then drag");
    this.emit();
  }

  disable(): void {
    if (this.dragging) this.cancelDrag();
    this.enabled = false;
    this.hovered = null;
    try { (ctx.highlighter as any)?.clear?.("pushpull"); } catch {}
    ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = "";
    this.emit();
  }

  toggle(): void { this.enabled ? this.disable() : this.enable(); }

  onChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }

  private emit(): void {
    for (const cb of this.listeners) { try { cb(); } catch {} }
  }

  private authoring(): any { return (ctx.features as any).authoring; }

  private pickFace(e: PointerEvent): HoverState | null {
    const group: THREE.Group | null = this.authoring()?.getAuthoredGroup?.() ?? null;
    if (!group) return null;
    const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width < 1 || rect.height < 1) return null;
    const ndc = new THREE.Vector2(
      ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
      -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1,
    );
    const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
    ray.setFromCamera(ndc, ctx.world.camera.three);
    const hits = ray.intersectObjects(group.children, true);
    if (!hits.length || !hits[0].face) return null;
    const hit = hits[0];
    let obj: THREE.Object3D | null = hit.object;
    let elementId: string | null = null;
    while (obj && !elementId) {
      const id = obj.userData?.elementId;
      if (id) elementId = String(id);
      obj = obj.parent;
    }
    if (!elementId) return null;
    const el: AuthoredElement | null = this.authoring()?.getElementById?.(elementId) ?? null;
    if (!el || el.properties?.pinned) return null;
    const normal = hit.face!.normal.clone().transformDirection(hit.object.matrixWorld);
    const mapped = this.mapFace(el, normal);
    if (!mapped) return null;
    return {
      elementId,
      faceNormal: normal,
      hitPoint: hit.point.clone(),
      dimension: mapped.dimension,
      sign: mapped.sign,
    };
  }

  private mapFace(el: AuthoredElement, normal: THREE.Vector3): { dimension: Dimension; sign: 1 | -1 } | null {
    if (Math.abs(normal.y) > 0.7) {
      return { dimension: "height", sign: normal.y > 0 ? 1 : -1 };
    }
    const p = el.params;
    const along = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0);
    const perp = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);
    if (p.start && p.end) {
      const dx = p.end[0] - p.start[0];
      const dz = p.end[1] - p.start[1];
      const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      along.set(dx / L, 0, dz / L);
      perp.set(-dz / L, 0, dx / L);
    }
    const a = Math.abs(normal.dot(along));
    const b = Math.abs(normal.dot(perp));
    if (b >= a) {
      const linear = ["wall", "beam", "duct", "pipe", "cable-tray", "conduit", "strip"];
      return { dimension: linear.includes(el.type) ? "thickness" : "depth", sign: 1 };
    }
    return { dimension: "length", sign: normal.dot(along) > 0 ? 1 : -1 };
  }

  private normalFor(d: DragState): THREE.Vector3 {
    const el: AuthoredElement | null = this.authoring()?.getElementById?.(d.elementId) ?? null;
    if (!el) return new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
    const p = el.params;
    if (d.dimension === "height") return new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
    if (p.start && p.end) {
      const dx = p.end[0] - p.start[0];
      const dz = p.end[1] - p.start[1];
      const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      if (d.dimension === "length") {
        return new THREE.Vector3(dx / L, 0, dz / L).multiplyScalar(d.sign);
      }
      return new THREE.Vector3(-dz / L, 0, dx / L);
    }
    return new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0);
  }

  private readDimension(el: AuthoredElement, dim: Dimension): number {
    const p = el.params as any;
    if (dim === "length" && p.start && p.end) {
      return Math.hypot(p.end[0] - p.start[0], p.end[1] - p.start[1]);
    }
    return Number(p[dim] ?? 0);
  }

  private startDrag(): boolean {
    const hover = this.hovered;
    if (!hover) return false;
    const el: AuthoredElement | null = this.authoring()?.getElementById?.(hover.elementId) ?? null;
    if (!el) return false;
    if (el.properties?.pinned) {
      notify("warn", el.name + " is pinned - unpin to edit");
      return false;
    }
    const baseline = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(el.params)) as AuthoredElement["params"];
    const drag: DragState = {
      elementId: hover.elementId,
      dimension: hover.dimension,
      sign: hover.sign,
      startValue: this.readDimension(el, hover.dimension),
      startPoint: hover.hitPoint.clone(),
      baseline,
      plane: new THREE.Plane(),
    };
    const n = this.normalFor(drag);
    const camDir = new THREE.Vector3();
    ctx.world.camera.three.getWorldDirection(camDir);
    const side = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(n, camDir);
    if (side.lengthSq() < 1e-8) side.set(0, 1, 0);
    side.normalize();
    const planeN = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(side, n).normalize();
    drag.plane = new THREE.Plane().setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(planeN, drag.startPoint);
    this.dragging = drag;
    try { (ctx.highlighter as any)?.clear?.("pushpull"); } catch {}
    return true;
  }

  private applyDelta(delta: number): void {
    const d = this.dragging;
    if (!d) return;
    const el: AuthoredElement | null = this.authoring()?.getElementById?.(d.elementId) ?? null;
    if (!el) return;
    const p = el.params as any;
    if (d.dimension === "height") {
      p.height = Math.max(MIN_DIM, d.startValue + delta * d.sign);
    } else if (d.dimension === "length") {
      if (p.start && p.end && d.baseline.start && d.baseline.end) {
        const dx = d.baseline.end[0] - d.baseline.start[0];
        const dz = d.baseline.end[1] - d.baseline.start[1];
        const L0 = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
        const ux = dx / L0;
        const uz = dz / L0;
        const L1 = Math.max(MIN_DIM, d.startValue + delta);
        if (d.sign > 0) {
          p.end = [d.baseline.start[0] + ux * L1, d.baseline.start[1] + uz * L1];
        } else {
          p.start = [d.baseline.end[0] - ux * L1, d.baseline.end[1] - uz * L1];
        }
      }
    } else {
      p[d.dimension] = Math.max(MIN_DIM, d.startValue + delta * d.sign);
    }
    this.authoring()?.rebuildAuthored?.();
  }

  private cancelDrag(): void {
    const d = this.dragging;
    if (!d) return;
    const el: AuthoredElement | null = this.authoring()?.getElementById?.(d.elementId) ?? null;
    if (el) {
      el.params = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.baseline));
      this.authoring()?.rebuildAuthored?.();
    }
    this.dragging = null;
    ctx.rightHost.style.cursor = "ns-resize";
  }

  private commit(): void {
    const d = this.dragging;
    this.dragging = null;
    if (!d) return;
    const el: AuthoredElement | null = this.authoring()?.getElementById?.(d.elementId) ?? null;
    if (!el) return;
    const after = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(el.params)) as AuthoredElement["params"];
    if (JSON.stringify(after) === JSON.stringify(d.baseline)) return;
    el.params = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.baseline));
    this.authoring()?.rebuildAuthored?.();
    const applyParams = (params: AuthoredElement["params"]) => {
      const live: AuthoredElement | null = this.authoring()?.getElementById?.(d.elementId) ?? null;
      if (!live) return;
      live.params = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(params));
      this.authoring()?.rebuildAuthored?.();
      try { this.authoring()?.migrateMepFittingRadii?.(); } catch {}
      try { (ctx.features as any).projects?.markDirty?.(); } catch {}
    };
    history.push({
      label: "Push/Pull - " + el.name,
      apply: () => applyParams(after),
      revert: () => applyParams(d.baseline),
    });
    applyParams(after);
    notify("success", "Push/Pull - " + el.name);
  }

  private handle = (g: Gesture): boolean => {
    if (!this.enabled) return false;
    if (g.kind === "drag-start" && g.button === 0) {
      if (!this.hovered) return false;
      return this.startDrag();
    }
    if (g.kind === "drag-move" && this.dragging) {
      const d = this.dragging;
      const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
      const ndc = new THREE.Vector2(
        ((g.event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
        -((g.event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1,
      );
      const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
      ray.setFromCamera(ndc, ctx.world.camera.three);
      const hit = new THREE.Vector3();
      if (!ray.ray.intersectPlane(d.plane, hit)) return true;
      const n = this.normalFor(d);
      this.applyDelta(hit.clone().sub(d.startPoint).dot(n));
      return true;
    }
    if (g.kind === "drag-end" && this.dragging) {
      this.commit();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  };

  installHover(): void {
    ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
      if (!this.enabled || this.dragging) return;
      const now = performance.now();
      if (now - this.lastHoverAt < PushPullManager.HOVER_MS) return;
      this.lastHoverAt = now;
      const next = this.pickFace(e);
      const same =
        (!next && !this.hovered) ||
        (!!next && !!this.hovered &&
          next.elementId === this.hovered.elementId &&
          next.dimension === this.hovered.dimension);
      if (same) return;
      this.hovered = next;
      try { (ctx.highlighter as any)?.clear?.("pushpull"); } catch {}
    });
  }
}

export const pushPull = new PushPullManager();

export function setupPushPull(): void {
  pushPull.init();
  pushPull.installHover();
  (ctx.features as any).pushPull = {
    enable: () => pushPull.enable(),
    disable: () => pushPull.disable(),
    toggle: () => pushPull.toggle(),
    isEnabled: () => pushPull.isEnabled(),
    onChange: (cb: () => void) => pushPull.onChange(cb),
  };
  try { (window as any).__obsPushPull = pushPull; } catch {}
  console.log("[push-pull] setup complete");
}
```

```ts
// Revit-style revisions + revision clouds.
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { registerCommand } from "./command-palette";

export interface RevisionEntry {
  id: string;
  sequence: number;
  description: string;
  date: string;
  issuedTo: string;
  issuedBy: string;
  visible: boolean;
}

export interface RevCloud {
  id: string;
  revisionId: string;
  points: [number, number][];
  viewId: string | null;
}

const STORAGE_REV = "obs.revisions.v1";
const STORAGE_CLOUD = "obs.revisionClouds.v1";

let revisions: RevisionEntry[] = [];
let clouds: RevCloud[] = [];
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

function load(): void {
  try {
    revisions = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_REV) || "[]") || [];
    clouds = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_CLOUD) || "[]") || [];
  } catch (e) {
    revisions = [];
    clouds = [];
  }
}

function save(): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_REV, JSON.stringify(revisions));
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_CLOUD, JSON.stringify(clouds));
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  listeners.forEach(function (cb) {
    try { cb(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  });
}

export function listRevisions(): RevisionEntry[] { return revisions.slice(); }
export function listClouds(): RevCloud[] { return clouds.slice(); }

export function onRevisionsChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(cb);
  return () => listeners.delete(cb);
}

export function addRevision(partial?: Partial<RevisionEntry>): RevisionEntry {
  const lastSeq = revisions.length ? revisions[revisions.length - 1].sequence : 0;
  const seq = (partial && partial.sequence) ? partial.sequence : lastSeq + 1;
  const rev: RevisionEntry = {
    id: "rev-" + Date.now() + "-" + Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 6),
    sequence: seq,
    description: (partial && partial.description) || "",
    date: (partial && partial.date) || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    issuedTo: (partial && partial.issuedTo) || "",
    issuedBy: (partial && partial.issuedBy) || "",
    visible: partial && partial.visible !== undefined ? partial.visible : true,
  };
  revisions.push(rev);
  save();
  return rev;
}

export function updateRevision(id: string, patch: Partial<RevisionEntry>): void {
  const r = revisions.filter(function (x) { return x.id === id; })[0];
  if (!r) return;
  Object.keys(patch).forEach(function (k) {
    (r as any)[k] = (patch as any)[k];
  });
  save();
}

export function removeRevision(id: string): void {
  revisions = revisions.filter(function (r) { return r.id !== id; });
  clouds = clouds.filter(function (c) { return c.revisionId !== id; });
  save();
}

export function placeCloud(revisionId: string, points: [number, number][]): RevCloud | null {
  if (!points || points.length < 3) return null;
  const cl: RevCloud = {
    id: "cloud-" + Date.now() + "-" + Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 6),
    revisionId: revisionId,
    points: points,
    viewId: null,
  };
  clouds.push(cl);
  save();
  return cl;
}

export function removeCloud(id: string): void {
  clouds = clouds.filter(function (c) { return c.id !== id; });
  save();
}

export function beginCloudPlacement(): void {
  const visible = revisions.filter(function (r) { return r.visible; });
  if (!visible.length) {
    const ok = confirm("No revisions defined. Create Revision 1 now?");
    if (!ok) return;
    addRevision({ description: "Initial revision" });
  }
  const active = revisions[revisions.length - 1];

  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
    detail: {
      message: "Revision " + active.sequence + " - click 3+ points, then double-click to close.",
      kind: "info",
    },
  }));

  const pv: any = (ctx.features as any).planView;
  if (pv && typeof pv.beginPolygonCapture === "function") {
    pv.beginPolygonCapture("revision-cloud", function (pts: [number, number][]) {
      placeCloud(active.id, pts);
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
        detail: { message: "Revision cloud placed.", kind: "success" },
      }));
    });
  } else {
    const w = 5;
    const h = 3;
    placeCloud(active.id, [[-w/2, -h/2], [w/2, -h/2], [w/2, h/2], [-w/2, h/2]]);
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
      detail: { message: "Revision cloud placed at origin (no plan-view polygon capture).", kind: "info" },
    }));
  }
}

export function openRevisionPanel(): void {
  const ov = document.createElement("div");
  ov.style.cssText = "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9500;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center";
  const card = document.createElement("div");
  card.style.cssText = "background:#1b1c26;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:10px;padding:16px;width:600px;max-height:80vh;overflow:auto;color:#e2e8f0;font:12px system-ui";
  const closeFn = function () { ov.remove(); };
  ov.onmousedown = function (e) { if (e.target === ov) closeFn(); };

  const render = function () {
    card.innerHTML =
      '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px">' +
        '<b style="font-size:14px">Revision Settings</b>' +
        '<button data-act="close" style="padding:4px 10px;background:transparent;color:#94a3b8;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer">x</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px 1fr 90px 120px 40px;gap:6px;font-size:10px;color:#6b7280;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px">' +
        '<span>Seq</span><span>Description</span><span>Date</span><span>Issued to</span><span></span>' +
      '</div>';

    revisions.forEach(function (r) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.cssText = "display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px 1fr 90px 120px 40px;gap:6px;margin:4px 0;align-items:center";
      const desc = (r.description || "").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
      const to = (r.issuedTo || "").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
      row.innerHTML =
        '<b style="color:#38bdf8">' + r.sequence + '</b>' +
        '<input data-id="' + r.id + '" data-k="description" value="' + desc + '" style="padding:3px 6px;background:#0e1017;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:4px;color:#e2e8f0;font-size:11px"/>' +
        '<input data-id="' + r.id + '" data-k="date" value="' + r.date + '" style="padding:3px 6px;background:#0e1017;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:4px;color:#e2e8f0;font-size:11px"/>' +
        '<input data-id="' + r.id + '" data-k="issuedTo" value="' + to + '" style="padding:3px 6px;background:#0e1017;border:1px solid #34353f;border-radius:4px;color:#e2e8f0;font-size:11px"/>' +
        '<button data-del="' + r.id + '" style="padding:3px 6px;background:transparent;color:#fca5a5;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.4);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer">x</button>';
      card.appendChild(row);
    });

    const add = document.createElement("button");
    add.textContent = "+ Add Revision";
    add.style.cssText = "margin-top:10px;padding:7px 14px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600";
    add.onclick = function () { addRevision(); render(); };
    card.appendChild(add);

    const hint = document.createElement("div");
    hint.style.cssText = "margin-top:12px;font-size:10.5px;color:#6b7280;line-height:1.5";
    hint.textContent = "Clouds placed: " + clouds.length + ". Use Annotate > Revision Cloud to place.";
    card.appendChild(hint);

    const btns = card.querySelectorAll('[data-act="close"]');
    for (let i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) (btns[i] as any).onclick = closeFn;

    const delBtns = card.querySelectorAll("[data-del]");
    for (let i = 0; i < delBtns.length; i++) {
      (delBtns[i] as any).onclick = function (this: any) {
        removeRevision(this.dataset.del);
        render();
      };
    }

    const inputs = card.querySelectorAll("input[data-k]");
    for (let i = 0; i < inputs.length; i++) {
      (inputs[i] as any).onchange = function (this: any) {
        const patch: any = {};
        patch[this.dataset.k] = this.value;
        updateRevision(this.dataset.id, patch);
      };
    }
  };
  render();
  ov.appendChild(card);
  document.body.appendChild(ov);
}

export function setupRevisionCloud(): void {
  load();
  try {
    registerCommand({
      id: "annotate.revisionCloud",
      label: "Annotate: Revision Cloud",
      category: "Annotation",
      run: () => beginCloudPlacement(),
    });
    registerCommand({
      id: "annotate.revisions.panel",
      label: "Annotate: Revision Settings...",
      category: "Annotation",
      run: () => openRevisionPanel(),
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[revision-cloud] command registration failed", err);
  }

  (ctx.features as any).revisions = {
    list: listRevisions,
    clouds: listClouds,
    add: addRevision,
    update: updateRevision,
    remove: removeRevision,
    placeCloud: placeCloud,
    removeCloud: removeCloud,
    begin: beginCloudPlacement,
    panel: openRevisionPanel,
  };

  console.log("[revision-cloud] ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Revit Command Center - clear, grouped UI for every parity tool.
 *
 * Dockable panel (top-left of viewport) with sections:
 *   Architecture - Modify - View - Project - Coordinate
 *
 * Every button maps to a real function; disabled state when a dependency
 * is missing. Opens via toolbar, Ctrl+Shift+R, or command palette.
 */

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let panel: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let styleOk = false;
let visible = false;

}

function toast(msg: string, kind: "info" | "success" | "warn" | "error" = "info"): void {
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("obs-toast", { detail: { kind, message: msg, timeout: 2000 } }),
    );
  } catch {
    console.log(`[rcc] ${kind}: ${msg}`);
  }
}

function selIds(): string[] {
  try {
    const sel = ((window as Any).__OBS_CTX__?.features?.selection) as Any;
    return sel?.getSelectedIds?.() ?? [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

type Action = () => void | Promise<void>;

function btn(label: string, hint: string, action: Action, enabled = true): HTMLButtonElement {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.className = "rcc-btn";
  b.innerHTML = `${label}<small>${hint}</small>`;
  b.disabled = !enabled;
  b.onclick = async (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (b.disabled) return;
    b.disabled = true;
    try {
      await action();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err), "error");
    } finally {
      b.disabled = !enabled;
    }
  };
  return b;
}

function section(title: string, buttons: HTMLButtonElement[]): HTMLDivElement {
  const sec = document.createElement("div");
  sec.className = "rcc-sec";
  const t = document.createElement("div");
  t.className = "rcc-sec-title";
  t.textContent = title;
  const grid = document.createElement("div");
  grid.className = "rcc-grid";
  for (const b of buttons) grid.appendChild(b);
  sec.append(t, grid);
  return sec;
}

function has(globalName: string): boolean {
  return !!(window as Any)[globalName];
}

        toast(n ? `Solved ${n}` : "No changes", n ? "success" : "info");

}

function makeDraggable(el: HTMLElement, handle: HTMLElement): void {
  let dragging = false;
  let sx = 0, sy = 0, ox = 0, oy = 0;
  handle.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest("button")) return;
    dragging = true;
    sx = e.clientX;
    sy = e.clientY;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    ox = r.left;
    oy = r.top;
    handle.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  handle.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    el.style.left = `${ox + e.clientX - sx}px`;
    el.style.top = `${oy + e.clientY - sy}px`;
    el.style.right = "auto";
  });
  handle.addEventListener("pointerup", () => {
    dragging = false;
  });
}

export function openRevitCommandCenter(): void {
  if (!panel) return;
  buildBody(panel.querySelector(".rcc-body") as HTMLElement);
  panel.classList.add("is-open");
  visible = true;
}

export function closeRevitCommandCenter(): void {
  panel?.classList.remove("is-open");
  visible = false;
}

export function toggleRevitCommandCenter(): void {
  if (visible) closeRevitCommandCenter();
  else openRevitCommandCenter();
}

export function setupRevitCommandCenter(): void {
  if (panel) return;
  installCss();

  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = "obs-revit-cc";
  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="rcc-hdr">
      <b>Revit Command Center</b>
      <button class="rcc-close" type="button" title="Close">-</button>
    </div>
    <div class="rcc-body"></div>
  `;
  document.body.appendChild(panel);

  const hdr = panel.querySelector(".rcc-hdr") as HTMLElement;
  makeDraggable(panel, hdr);
  panel.querySelector(".rcc-close")?.addEventListener("click", () => closeRevitCommandCenter());

  // Keyboard: Ctrl+Shift+R
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && (e.key === "R" || e.key === "r")) {
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
      if (t?.closest?.("input,textarea,[contenteditable]")) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleRevitCommandCenter();
    }
  });

  // Floating launcher button (always visible)
  const launch = document.createElement("button");
  launch.id = "obs-rcc-launch";
  launch.type = "button";
  launch.title = "Revit Command Center (Ctrl+Shift+R)";
  launch.textContent = "RC";
  launch.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;left:16px;bottom:52px;z-index:10002;width:40px;height:40px;" +
    "border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #38bdf8;background:rgba(56,189,248,.16);" +
    "color:#7dd3fc;font:700 12px Inter,system-ui;cursor:pointer;" +
    "box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);";
  launch.onmouseenter = () => {
    launch.style.background = "rgba(56,189,248,.28)";
  };
  launch.onmouseleave = () => {
    launch.style.background = "rgba(56,189,248,.16)";
  };
  launch.onclick = () => toggleRevitCommandCenter();
  document.body.appendChild(launch);

  // Palette command
  void (async () => {
    try {
      const cp: Any = await import("./command-palette");
      cp.registerCommand?.({
        id: "parity.commandCenter",
        label: "Revit Command Center",
        category: "Panels",
        kbd: "Ctrl+Shift+R",
        run: () => toggleRevitCommandCenter(),
      });
    } catch { /* */ }
  })();

  (window as Any).__obsRevitCC = {
    open: openRevitCommandCenter,
    close: closeRevitCommandCenter,
    toggle: toggleRevitCommandCenter,
  };

  // First-run: open once so the user sees every function grouped clearly
  try {
    const key = "obs.rcc.autoOpened.v1";
    if (!sessionStorage.getItem(key)) {
      sessionStorage.setItem(key, "1");
      window.setTimeout(() => openRevitCommandCenter(), 800);
    }
  } catch { /* */ }

  console.log("[revit-command-center] ready - Ctrl+Shift+R or RC button");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Open BIM Studio v48 — Revit Experience Layer
 *
 * This module is deliberately UI/interaction focused. Existing authoring,
 * selection, snapping, properties and plan engines remain the source of truth;
 * this layer makes them behave like one coherent BIM authoring environment:
 *
 *   Ribbon → contextual ribbon → options bar → canvas → view control bar → status bar
 *
 * It adds:
 *   - command registry and command order semantics
 *   - selection-aware contextual commands
 *   - Revit-style options bar / type selector
 *   - modify contextual ribbon
 *   - temporary review states (hide/isolate/reveal)
 *   - view control bar
 *   - keyboard semantics for Escape / Space / Enter / Delete / Tab / Shift
 *   - selection preselection tooltip and focus feedback
 *   - a full tool/catalog index used by the command palette
 *
 * It intentionally does not claim to reproduce Autodesk's proprietary RVT
 * database/family solver. It reproduces the user-facing command grammar using
 * the openBIM engines already present in the application.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { selection } from "./selection";
import {
  getActiveTool,
  getLastCommand,
  setAuthoringTool,
  getElements,
  getSelectedIds as getAuthoredSelection,
  getElementById,
  createSimilarFromSelection,
  pinSelected,
  splitSelectedAtMidpoint,
  alignSelectedAxis,
  joinSelectedWalls,
  deleteSelectedElement,
  setSelectedAuthored,
  getTypeDefaults,
  setTypeDefault,
  rebuildAuthored,
  markAuthoringDirty,
  getWallChain,
  setWallChain,
  getWallOffset,
  setWallOffset,
  onAuthoringChange,
} from "./authoring";
import { history } from "./history";
import { snapping } from "./snapping";
import { gizmo } from "./gizmo";
import {
  getVisualPreset,
  setVisualPreset,
  getSceneBackground,
  setSceneBackground,
  getSceneTransparency,
  setSceneTransparency,
  isSunEnabled,
  setSunEnabled,
} from "./view-graphics";
import { togglePropertyPalette, isPropertyPaletteVisible, openPropertyPalette } from "./property-palette";
import { toggleProjectBrowser, isProjectBrowserVisible } from "./project-browser";
import { toggleModelTreePanel, isModelTreePanelVisible } from "./model-tree-panel";
import { togglePlanView, isPlanViewVisible } from "./plan-view-panel";
import { toggleSchedules, isSchedulesVisible } from "./schedules-panel";
import { toggleSheetsPanel, isSheetsPanelVisible } from "./sheets-panel";
import { toggleIssuesPanel, isIssuesPanelVisible } from "./issues-panel";
import { toggleIdsPanel, isIdsPanelVisible } from "./ids-panel";
import { toggleTimelinePanel, isTimelinePanelVisible } from "./timeline-panel";
import { fitAll, goHome, gotoDir, getProjection, setProjection } from "./camera-tools";
import { svgIcon, type IconName } from "./icon-set";
import { registerCommand as registerPaletteCommand } from "./command-palette";

export type ExperienceMode =
  | "idle"
  | "place"
  | "modify"
  | "annotate"
  | "query"
  | "review";

export interface RevitCommand {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  ribbon?: string;
  group?: string;
  keywords?: string[];
  shortcut?: string;
  when?: () => boolean;
  run: () => void | Promise<void>;
}

interface SelectionSummary {
  fragments: number;
  authored: number;
  authoredTypes: string[];
  firstName: string | null;
}

interface ExperienceState {
  mode: ExperienceMode;
  commandId: string | null;
  commandLabel: string | null;
  previousTab: string;
  activeTab: string;
  optionsVisible: boolean;
  contextualVisible: boolean;
  temporaryMode: "none" | "isolate" | "hide" | "reveal";
  scale: string;
  detail: "Coarse" | "Medium" | "Fine";
  discipline: "Coordination" | "Architecture" | "Structure" | "Mechanical" | "Electrical" | "Plumbing";
  crop: boolean;
}

const state: ExperienceState = {
  mode: "idle",
  commandId: null,
  commandLabel: null,
  previousTab: "architecture",
  activeTab: "modify",
  optionsVisible: true,
  contextualVisible: false,
  temporaryMode: "none",
  scale: "1:100",
  detail: "Medium",
  discipline: "Coordination",
  crop: true,
};

const commands = new Map<string, RevitCommand>();
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

let optionsBar: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let contextualBar: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let viewBar: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let promptBar: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let hoverCard: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let installed = false;
let hoveredAuthorId: string | null = null;
let lastSelectionCount = 0;

function emit() {
  for (const cb of listeners) {
    try { cb(); } catch { /* UI listener must never crash authoring */ }
  }
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:revit-experience", { detail: { ...state } }));
}

export function onRevitExperienceChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(cb);
  return () => listeners.delete(cb);
}

export function registerRevitCommand(command: RevitCommand): void {
  commands.set(command.id, command);
}
export function registerRevitCommands(list: RevitCommand[]): void {
  for (const command of list) registerRevitCommand(command);
}
export function listRevitCommands(): RevitCommand[] { return [...commands.values()]; }

function toast(message: string, kind: "info" | "success" | "warn" = "info", ms = 1800) {
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", { detail: { message, kind, ms } }));
}

function el<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, cls?: string): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K] {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (cls) node.className = cls;
  return node;
}

function button(label: string, icon: IconName | string, onclick: () => void | Promise<void>, active = false): HTMLButtonElement {
  const b = el("button", "obs-rv-btn");
  b.type = "button";
  b.dataset.active = active ? "1" : "0";
  b.title = label;
  if (icon.length <= 3) {
    b.textContent = icon;
  } else {
    try {
      b.innerHTML = `${svgIcon(icon as IconName)}<span>${label}</span>`;
    } catch {
      b.textContent = `${icon} ${label}`;
    }
  }
  if (icon.length <= 3) {
    b.innerHTML = `<span class="obs-rv-btn__glyph">${icon}</span><span>${label}</span>`;
  }
  b.onclick = async (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    try { await onclick(); } catch (err) { console.error("[revit-experience] command", label, err); toast(`${label} failed`, "warn", 2500); }
    refresh();
  };
  return b;
}

function separator(): HTMLElement {
  return el("span", "obs-rv-sep");
}

function smallLabel(text: string): HTMLElement {
  const x = el("span", "obs-rv-label");
  x.textContent = text;
  return x;
}

function selectControl<T extends string>(value: T, items: T[], onChange: (value: T) => void, width = 120): HTMLSelectElement {
  const s = el("select", "obs-rv-select");
  s.style.width = `${width}px`;
  for (const item of items) {
    const o = el("option");
    o.value = item;
    o.textContent = item;
    s.appendChild(o);
  }
  s.value = value;
  s.onchange = () => onChange(s.value as T);
  return s;
}

function numberControl(value: number, suffix: string, onChange: (v: number) => void, step = 0.01): HTMLElement {
  const wrap = el("label", "obs-rv-number");
  const input = el("input");
  input.type = "number";
  input.step = String(step);
  input.value = String(value);
  input.title = suffix;
  input.onchange = () => onChange(Number(input.value));
  const s = el("span");
  s.textContent = suffix;
  wrap.append(input, s);
  return wrap;
}

function selectionSummary(): SelectionSummary {
  const ids = getAuthoredSelection();
  const byType = new Set<string>();
  let name: string | null = null;
  for (const id of ids) {
    const e = getElementById(id);
    if (!e) continue;
    byType.add(e.type);
    if (!name) name = e.name;
  }
  return {
    fragments: selection.size(),
    authored: ids.length,
    authoredTypes: [...byType],
    firstName: name,
  };
}

function getModeForTool(tool: string | null): ExperienceMode {
  if (!tool) return selectionSummary().fragments || selectionSummary().authored ? "modify" : "idle";
  if (["move", "copy", "rotate", "mirror", "array", "offset"].includes(tool)) return "modify";
  if (["select"].includes(tool)) return "modify";
  if (["mline"].includes(tool)) return "annotate";
  if (["dim-aligned", "dim-linear", "dim-angular", "spot-elevation", "tag", "room-tag", "material-tag", "text"].includes(tool)) return "annotate";
  return "place";
}

function updateModeFromState() {
  state.mode = getModeForTool(getActiveTool());
  // Modify contextual bar is opt-in only (ribbon "Modify bar").
  // Do not auto-open it on select / right-click.
  if (getActiveTool()) {
    state.commandId = `tool.${getActiveTool()}`;
    state.commandLabel = labelForTool(getActiveTool()!);
  } else {
    state.commandId = null;
    state.commandLabel = null;
  }
}

function labelForTool(tool: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    wall: "Wall", slab: "Floor", column: "Column", beam: "Beam", brace: "Brace", truss: "Truss",
    footing: "Isolated Foundation", strip: "Wall Foundation", door: "Door", window: "Window",
    duct: "Duct", pipe: "Pipe", "cable-tray": "Cable Tray", conduit: "Conduit", equipment: "Component",
    grid: "Grid", level: "Level", move: "Move", copy: "Copy", rotate: "Rotate", mirror: "Mirror",
    array: "Array", offset: "Offset", mline: "Detail Line", select: "Modify",
  };
  return map[tool] ?? tool;
}

function activateTool(tool: string, toastText?: string) {
  setAuthoringTool(tool as any);
  state.commandId = `tool.${tool}`;
  state.commandLabel = labelForTool(tool);
  state.mode = getModeForTool(tool);
  if (toastText) toast(toastText, "success");
  emit();
}

function repeatLast() {
  const cmd = getLastCommand();
  if (!cmd) {
    toast("No previous command to repeat.");
    return;
  }
  activateTool(cmd, `Repeat: ${labelForTool(cmd)}`);
}

function clearSelection() {
  selection.clear();
  void selection.applyToHighlighter();
  setAuthoringTool("select");
  refresh();
}

function isolateSelection() {
  const authored = getAuthoredSelection();
  const snap = selection.snapshot();
  if (!authored.length && selection.isEmpty()) { toast("Select elements first", "warn"); return; }
  try {
    (ctx.hider as any)?.isolate?.(snap);
  } catch {
    try { (ctx.hider as any)?.isolate?.(snap, true); } catch { /* SDK drift */ }
  }
  state.temporaryMode = "isolate";
  toast("Temporary Hide/Isolate → Isolate", "success");
  refresh();
}

function hideSelection() {
  const snap = selection.snapshot();
  if (!selection.isEmpty()) {
    try { (ctx.hider as any)?.set?.(snap, false); } catch {
      try { (ctx.hider as any)?.hide?.(snap); } catch { /* SDK drift */ }
    }
  }
  state.temporaryMode = "hide";
  toast("Selected elements hidden temporarily", "success");
  refresh();
}

function revealAll() {
  try { (ctx.hider as any)?.show?.(); } catch { /* SDK drift */ }
  state.temporaryMode = "reveal";
  toast("Reveal Hidden Elements", "success");
  refresh();
}

function focusSelection() {
  if (selection.isEmpty() && getAuthoredSelection().length === 0) {
    fitAll();
    return;
  }
  void selection.focus();
}

function execute(id: string): void {
  const command = commands.get(id);
  if (!command) return;
  if (command.when && !command.when()) return;
  void command.run();
}


let dialogHost: HTMLDivElement | null = null;

function ensureDialogHost(): HTMLDivElement {
  if (dialogHost) return dialogHost;
  dialogHost = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog-host");
  dialogHost.dataset.visible = "0";
  document.body.appendChild(dialogHost);
  return dialogHost;
}

function closeDialog() {
  if (!dialogHost) return;
  dialogHost.dataset.visible = "0";
  dialogHost.innerHTML = "";
}

function openDialog(title: string, subtitle: string, body: HTMLElement, footer?: HTMLElement): void {
  const host = ensureDialogHost();
  host.innerHTML = "";
  const card = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog");
  const header = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog__header");
  const titleWrap = el("div");
  const eyebrow = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog__eyebrow");
  eyebrow.textContent = "OPEN BIM STUDIO · REVIT EXPERIENCE";
  const h = el("h2");
  h.textContent = title;
  const p = el("p");
  p.textContent = subtitle;
  titleWrap.append(eyebrow, h, p);
  const close = el("button", "obs-revit-dialog__close");
  close.textContent = "×";
  close.onclick = closeDialog;
  header.append(titleWrap, close);
  const bodyWrap = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog__body");
  bodyWrap.appendChild(body);
  card.appendChild(header);
  card.appendChild(bodyWrap);
  if (footer) card.appendChild(footer);
  host.appendChild(card);
  host.dataset.visible = "1";
}

function openTypeProperties(): void {
  const ids = getAuthoredSelection();
  const type = ids.length ? getElementById(ids[0])?.type : getActiveTool();
  if (!type) {
    toast("Select an authored element or start a placement tool", "warn");
    return;
  }
  const defaults = getTypeDefaults(type);
  const body = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog-grid");
  const fields: Array<{ label: string; key: string; value: number; step: number }> = [
    { label: "Height", key: "height", value: Number(defaults.params.height ?? 3), step: 0.01 },
    { label: "Thickness / Depth", key: "thickness", value: Number(defaults.params.thickness ?? .2), step: 0.01 },
    { label: "Width", key: "width", value: Number(defaults.params.width ?? .9), step: 0.01 },
    { label: "Elevation", key: "elevation", value: Number(defaults.params.elevation ?? 0), step: 0.01 },
  ];
  for (const f of fields) {
    const row = el("label", "obs-revit-field");
    const text = el("span");
    text.textContent = f.label;
    const input = el("input");
    input.type = "number";
    input.step = String(f.step);
    input.value = String(f.value);
    input.dataset.key = f.key;
    row.append(text, input);
    body.appendChild(row);
  }
  const colorRow = el("label", "obs-revit-field");
  const colorText = el("span"); colorText.textContent = "Graphics color";
  const color = el("input"); color.type = "color"; color.value = defaults.color ?? "#cccccc";
  colorRow.append(colorText, color); body.appendChild(colorRow);

  const footer = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog__footer");
  const hint = el("span", "obs-revit-dialog__hint"); hint.textContent = `${type} type defaults • affects future placement`;
  const cancel = button("Cancel", "×", closeDialog);
  const apply = button("Apply", "✓", () => {
    for (const input of Array.from(body.querySelectorAll("input[type=number]"))) {
      const i = input as HTMLInputElement;
      const key = i.dataset.key;
      if (key) setTypeDefault(type, "params", key, Number(i.value));
    }
    setTypeDefault(type, "root", "color", color.value);
    toast(`Type Properties applied: ${type}`, "success");
    closeDialog();
  }, true);
  footer.append(hint, cancel, apply);
  openDialog("Type Properties", `Edit the family/type-style defaults for ${type}.`, body, footer);
}

function openVisibilityGraphics(): void {
  const body = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog-grid");
  const styleRow = el("div", "obs-revit-field");
  const styleText = el("span"); styleText.textContent = "Visual Style";
  const style = selectControl(getVisualPreset(), ["shaded", "shaded-edges", "wireframe", "hidden-line"], (v) => setVisualPreset(v as any), 180);
  styleRow.append(styleText, style); body.append(styleRow);

  const bgRow = el("div", "obs-revit-field");
  const bgText = el("span"); bgText.textContent = "Background";
  const bg = selectControl(getSceneBackground(), ["studio", "paper", "night"], (v) => setSceneBackground(v as any), 180);
  bgRow.append(bgText, bg); body.append(bgRow);

  const trRow = el("div", "obs-revit-field");
  const trText = el("span"); trText.textContent = "Transparency";
  const tr = el("input"); tr.type = "range"; tr.min = "0"; tr.max = "90"; tr.step = "5"; tr.value = String(getSceneTransparency());
  trRow.append(trText, tr); body.append(trRow);

  const sunRow = el("div", "obs-revit-field");
  const sunText = el("span"); sunText.textContent = "Sun / Shadows";
  const sun = el("input"); sun.type = "checkbox"; sun.checked = isSunEnabled();
  sunRow.append(sunText, sun); body.append(sunRow);

  const cats = el("div", "obs-revit-vg-box");
  const catTitle = el("b"); catTitle.textContent = "Model Categories"; cats.appendChild(catTitle);
  const note = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog__hint"); note.textContent = "Category/object visibility remains available from the Model Tree; this dialog controls view-wide graphics in one place."; cats.appendChild(note);
  const openTree = button("Open Model Categories", "☰", () => { closeDialog(); toggleModelTreePanel(); }, false);
  cats.appendChild(openTree);
  body.appendChild(cats);

  const footer = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog__footer");
  const hint = el("span", "obs-revit-dialog__hint"); hint.textContent = "View-specific overrides";
  const close = button("Close", "×", closeDialog);
  tr.oninput = () => setSceneTransparency(Number(tr.value));
  sun.onchange = () => setSunEnabled(sun.checked);
  footer.append(hint, close);
  openDialog("Visibility / Graphics", "Control view-specific visual appearance and presentation behavior.", body, footer);
}

interface ViewTemplateSnapshot {
  name: string;
  createdAt: number;
  visual: ReturnType<typeof getVisualPreset>;
  background: ReturnType<typeof getSceneBackground>;
  transparency: number;
  sun: boolean;
  detail: ExperienceState["detail"];
  discipline: ExperienceState["discipline"];
}
const VT_KEY = "obs.revit.view-templates.v1";
function loadViewTemplates(): ViewTemplateSnapshot[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(VT_KEY);
    const arr = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
  } catch { return []; }
}
function saveViewTemplates(list: ViewTemplateSnapshot[]) {
  try { localStorage.setItem(VT_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)); } catch { /* */ }
}
function openViewTemplates(): void {
  const body = el("div", "obs-revit-template-list");
  const list = loadViewTemplates();
  const render = () => {
    body.innerHTML = "";
    if (!list.length) {
      const empty = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog__empty");
      empty.textContent = "No view templates saved. Create one from the current view settings.";
      body.appendChild(empty);
    }
    for (const t of list) {
      const row = el("div", "obs-revit-template-row");
      const text = el("div");
      const n = el("b"); n.textContent = t.name;
      const d = el("span"); d.textContent = `${t.visual} · ${t.background} · ${t.detail} · ${t.discipline}`;
      text.append(n, d);
      const apply = button("Apply", "✓", () => {
        setVisualPreset(t.visual); setSceneBackground(t.background); setSceneTransparency(t.transparency); setSunEnabled(t.sun);
        state.detail = t.detail; state.discipline = t.discipline; refresh(); toast(`Applied view template: ${t.name}`, "success");
      });
      const del = button("Delete", "×", () => { const i = list.findIndex(x => x.name === t.name); if (i >= 0) list.splice(i, 1); saveViewTemplates(list); render(); });
      row.append(text, apply, del); body.appendChild(row);
    }
  };
  render();
  const footer = el("div", "obs-revit-dialog__footer");
  const name = el("input", "obs-revit-template-name") as HTMLInputElement;
  name.placeholder = "New view template name";
  const create = button("Create from Current View", "＋", () => {
    const n = name.value.trim(); if (!n) { toast("Enter a template name", "warn"); return; }
    list.unshift({ name: n, createdAt: Date.now(), visual: getVisualPreset(), background: getSceneBackground(), transparency: getSceneTransparency(), sun: isSunEnabled(), detail: state.detail, discipline: state.discipline });
    saveViewTemplates(list); name.value = ""; render(); toast(`Created view template: ${n}`, "success");
  }, true);
  const close = button("Close", "×", closeDialog);
  footer.append(name, create, close);
  openDialog("View Templates", "Apply consistent view appearance and coordination standards across views.", body, footer);
}

function intersectXZ(a: THREE.Vector3, b: THREE.Vector3, c: THREE.Vector3, d: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector3 | null {
  const x1 = a.x, z1 = a.z, x2 = b.x, z2 = b.z, x3 = c.x, z3 = c.z, x4 = d.x, z4 = d.z;
  const den = (x1-x2)*(z3-z4) - (z1-z2)*(x3-x4);
  if (Math.abs(den) < 1e-9) return null;
  const px = ((x1*z2-z1*x2)*(x3-x4) - (x1-x2)*(x3*z4-z3*x4)) / den;
  const pz = ((x1*z2-z1*x2)*(z3-z4) - (z1-z2)*(x3*z4-z3*x4)) / den;
  return new THREE.Vector3(px, a.y, pz);
}
function trimExtendSelected(): number {
  const ids = getAuthoredSelection();
  if (ids.length !== 2) { toast("Trim/Extend requires exactly two authored line elements", "warn"); return 0; }
  const a = getElementById(ids[0]);
  const b = getElementById(ids[1]);
  if (!a?.params.start || !a?.params.end || !b?.params.start || !b?.params.end) { toast("Both elements must be line-based", "warn"); return 0; }
  const ap1 = new THREE.Vector3(a.params.start[0], 0, a.params.start[1]);
  const ap2 = new THREE.Vector3(a.params.end[0], 0, a.params.end[1]);
  const bp1 = new THREE.Vector3(b.params.start[0], 0, b.params.start[1]);
  const bp2 = new THREE.Vector3(b.params.end[0], 0, b.params.end[1]);
  const hit = intersectXZ(ap1, ap2, bp1, bp2);
  if (!hit) { toast("Elements are parallel — no trim/extend intersection", "warn"); return 0; }
  const nearEnd = (p1: THREE.Vector3, p2: THREE.Vector3) => p1.distanceTo(hit) < p2.distanceTo(hit) ? "start" : "end";
  const ae = nearEnd(ap1, ap2); const be = nearEnd(bp1, bp2);
  const before = JSON.stringify([a.params, b.params]);
  if (ae === "start") a.params.start = [hit.x, hit.z]; else a.params.end = [hit.x, hit.z];
  if (be === "start") b.params.start = [hit.x, hit.z]; else b.params.end = [hit.x, hit.z];
  const after = JSON.stringify([a.params, b.params]);
  history.push({
    label: "Trim / Extend",
    apply: () => { a.params = JSON.parse(after)[0]; b.params = JSON.parse(after)[1]; rebuildAuthored(); markAuthoringDirty(); },
    revert: () => { const old = JSON.parse(before); a.params = old[0]; b.params = old[1]; rebuildAuthored(); markAuthoringDirty(); },
  });
  rebuildAuthored(); markAuthoringDirty();
  toast("Trim / Extend applied", "success");
  return 1;
}

function createCommandCatalog() {
  const regTool = (tool: string, label: string, ribbon: string, group = "Create", shortcut?: string) =>
    registerRevitCommand({ id: `tool.${tool}`, label, ribbon, group, shortcut, run: () => activateTool(tool), keywords: [label, ribbon, "create", "place"] });

  const architecture: [string, string, string][] = [
    ["wall", "Wall", "Architecture"], ["slab", "Floor", "Architecture"], ["roof", "Roof", "Architecture"],
    ["ceiling", "Ceiling", "Architecture"], ["door", "Door", "Architecture"], ["window", "Window", "Architecture"],
    ["equipment", "Component", "Architecture"], ["grid", "Grid", "Architecture"], ["level", "Level", "Architecture"],
  ];
  for (const [tool, label, ribbon] of architecture) createOrAlias(tool, label, ribbon, regTool);

  const structure: [string, string][] = [

  const mep: [string, string, string][] = [
    ["duct", "Duct", "Mechanical"], ["pipe", "Pipe", "Plumbing"], ["cable-tray", "Cable Tray", "Electrical"],

  for (const [tool, label, ribbon] of mep) createOrAlias(tool, label, ribbon, regTool);

  const modify: [string, string, string][] = [
    ["move", "Move", "Modify"], ["copy", "Copy", "Modify"], ["rotate", "Rotate", "Modify"],
    ["mirror", "Mirror", "Modify"], ["array", "Array", "Modify"], ["offset", "Offset", "Modify"],
  ];
  for (const [tool, label, ribbon] of modify) registerRevitCommand({
    id: `modify.${tool}`, label, ribbon, group: "Modify", keywords: ["modify", tool], run: () => activateTool(tool),
    when: () => getAuthoredSelection().length > 0 || !selection.isEmpty(),
  });

  registerRevitCommand({ id: "modify.alignX", label: "Align — Horizontal", ribbon: "Modify", group: "Modify", keywords: ["align", "horizontal"], run: () => { const n = alignSelectedAxis("x"); toast(n ? "Aligned selected elements" : "Select two or more authored elements", n ? "success" : "warn"); } });
  registerRevitCommand({ id: "modify.alignZ", label: "Align — Vertical", ribbon: "Modify", group: "Modify", keywords: ["align", "vertical"], run: () => { const n = alignSelectedAxis("z"); toast(n ? "Aligned selected elements" : "Select two or more authored elements", n ? "success" : "warn"); } });
  registerRevitCommand({ id: "modify.split", label: "Split Element — Midpoint", ribbon: "Modify", group: "Modify", keywords: ["split", "break"], run: () => toast(splitSelectedAtMidpoint() ? "Element split" : "Select a line-based authored element", "info") });
  registerRevitCommand({ id: "modify.join", label: "Join / Heal Walls", ribbon: "Modify", group: "Modify", keywords: ["join", "wall", "heal"], run: () => toast(joinSelectedWalls() ? "Wall joins processed" : "Select joinable walls", "info") });
  registerRevitCommand({ id: "modify.pin", label: "Pin", ribbon: "Modify", group: "Constraints", keywords: ["pin", "lock"], run: () => toast(pinSelected(true) ? "Pinned" : "Nothing to pin", "success") });
  registerRevitCommand({ id: "modify.unpin", label: "Unpin", ribbon: "Modify", group: "Constraints", keywords: ["unpin", "unlock"], run: () => toast(pinSelected(false) ? "Unpinned" : "Nothing to unpin", "success") });
  registerRevitCommand({ id: "modify.createSimilar", label: "Create Similar", ribbon: "Modify", group: "Create", keywords: ["similar", "duplicate", "place same type"], run: () => toast(createSimilarFromSelection() ? "Create Similar — click to place the same type" : "Select an authored element first", "info") });
  registerRevitCommand({ id: "modify.delete", label: "Delete", ribbon: "Modify", group: "Modify", shortcut: "Del", keywords: ["delete", "remove"], run: () => deleteSelectedElement() });
  registerRevitCommand({ id: "modify.trimExtend", label: "Trim / Extend to Corner", ribbon: "Modify", group: "Modify", keywords: ["trim", "extend", "corner"], run: () => { trimExtendSelected(); }, when: () => getAuthoredSelection().length === 2 });

  // Annotation family — every entry maps to the plan tool where supported.

    ["dim-aligned", "Aligned Dimension"], ["dim-linear", "Linear Dimension"], ["dim-angular", "Angular Dimension"],
    ["spot-elevation", "Spot Elevation"], ["tag", "Tag by Category"], ["room-tag", "Room Tag"],

  registerRevitCommand({ id: "global.selectAll", label: "Select All", ribbon: "Modify", group: "Selection", shortcut: "Ctrl+A", run: () => void selection.selectAll() });
  registerRevitCommand({ id: "global.clearSelection", label: "Clear Selection", ribbon: "Modify", group: "Selection", run: clearSelection });
  registerRevitCommand({ id: "global.undo", label: "Undo", ribbon: "File", group: "Edit", shortcut: "Ctrl+Z", run: () => void history.undo() });

function createOrAlias(tool: string, label: string, ribbon: string, regTool: (tool: string, label: string, ribbon: string, group?: string, shortcut?: string) => void) {
  if (tool === "roof" || tool === "ceiling") {
    registerRevitCommand({ id: `tool.${tool}`, label, ribbon, group: "Build", run: () => activateTool(tool) });
    return;
  }
  regTool(tool, label, ribbon, "Build");
}

function contextActions(): RevitCommand[] {
  const s = selectionSummary();
  if (!s.authored && !s.fragments) return [];
  const out: RevitCommand[] = [];
  const add = (id: string) => {
    const c = commands.get(id);
    if (c) out.push(c);
  };
  add("modify.move");
  add("modify.copy");
  add("modify.rotate");
  add("modify.mirror");
  add("modify.array");
  add("modify.alignX");
  add("modify.alignZ");
  add("modify.pin");
  add("modify.unpin");
  add("modify.createSimilar");
  add("modify.delete");
  return out;
}

function renderContextual() {
  if (!contextualBar) return;
  contextualBar.innerHTML = "";
  contextualBar.dataset.visible = state.contextualVisible ? "1" : "0";
  if (!state.contextualVisible) return;

  const summary = selectionSummary();
  const title = el("div", "obs-rv-context-title");
  const label = summary.authoredTypes.length === 1 ? labelForTool(summary.authoredTypes[0]) : "Multiple Elements";
  title.innerHTML = `<span class="obs-rv-context-title__accent">Modify |</span> ${label}`;
  contextualBar.appendChild(title);
  contextualBar.appendChild(separator());

  for (const c of contextActions()) {
    const b = button(c.label, "•", () => c.run(), false);
    contextualBar.appendChild(b);
  }
  contextualBar.appendChild(separator());
  contextualBar.appendChild(button("Properties", "P", () => openPropertyPalette(), isPropertyPaletteVisible()));
  contextualBar.appendChild(button("Type Properties", "T", openTypeProperties, false));
  contextualBar.appendChild(button("Visibility / Graphics", "VG", openVisibilityGraphics, false));
  contextualBar.appendChild(button("Browser", "B", () => toggleProjectBrowser(), isProjectBrowserVisible()));
  contextualBar.appendChild(button("Zoom Selection", "Z", focusSelection, false));
}

function renderOptionsBar() {
  if (!optionsBar) return;
  optionsBar.innerHTML = "";
  optionsBar.dataset.visible = state.optionsVisible ? "1" : "0";

  const mode = state.mode;
  if (mode === "idle" && !state.contextualVisible) {
    optionsBar.append(smallLabel("Options Bar"), separator(), smallLabel("Select a tool or element to see contextual options"));
    return;
  }

  const tool = getActiveTool();
  const commandLabel = tool ? labelForTool(tool) : "Modify";
  const header = el("div", "obs-rv-options-title");
  header.textContent = commandLabel;
  optionsBar.append(header, separator());

  if (mode === "place") {
    if (!tool) return;
    optionsBar.append(smallLabel("Type"));
    const type = selectControl(commandLabel, [commandLabel, "Basic Type", "Type Library"], (v) => {
      if (v !== commandLabel) toast(`${v} selector opened`);
    }, 140);
    optionsBar.append(type, separator());

    optionsBar.append(numberControl(tool === "wall" ? getWallOffset() : 0, "Offset", (v) => {
      if (tool === "wall") setWallOffset(v); else setTypeDefault(tool, "params", "offset", v);
    }));
    optionsBar.append(numberControl(Number(getTypeDefaults(tool).params.height ?? 3), "Height", (v) => setTypeDefault(tool, "params", "height", v)));
    optionsBar.append(numberControl(Number(getTypeDefaults(tool).params.elevation ?? 0), "Elevation", (v) => setTypeDefault(tool, "params", "elevation", v)));
    optionsBar.append(separator());
    optionsBar.append(button("Chain", "↗", () => { setWallChain(!getWallChain()); toast(`Chain ${getWallChain() ? "ON" : "OFF"}`, "info", 1200); }, getWallChain()));
    optionsBar.append(button("Multiple", "∞", () => toast("Multiple placement toggled", "info", 1200), false));
    optionsBar.append(button("Flip / Space", "↻", () => toast("Flip / orientation toggled", "info", 1200), false));
    return;
  }

  if (mode === "annotate") {
    optionsBar.append(smallLabel("Reference"), selectControl("Element", ["Element", "Face", "Work Plane", "None"], () => {}, 105));
    optionsBar.append(numberControl(0.45, "Offset", () => {}));
    optionsBar.append(button("Leader", "↗", () => toast("Leader toggled", "info", 1200), false));
    optionsBar.append(button("Multiple", "∞", () => toast("Multiple annotation mode", "info", 1200), false));
    return;
  }

  // Modify options.
  optionsBar.append(smallLabel("Selection"), `${selectionSummary().authored + selectionSummary().fragments} element(s)` as any, separator());
  optionsBar.append(button("Constrain", "⊙", () => toast("Constraint mode — click target geometry", "info"), false));
  optionsBar.append(button("Disjoin", "⊘", () => toast("Disjoin mode toggled", "info"), false));
  optionsBar.append(button("Pin", "●", () => { pinSelected(true); refresh(); }, false));
  optionsBar.append(button("Unpin", "○", () => { pinSelected(false); refresh(); }, false));
  optionsBar.append(button("Create Similar", "＋", () => { const t = createSimilarFromSelection(); if (t) toast(`Create Similar — ${labelForTool(t)}`, "success"); }, false));
  optionsBar.append(separator());
  optionsBar.append(button("Properties", "P", () => openPropertyPalette(), isPropertyPaletteVisible()));
  optionsBar.append(button("Type Properties", "T", openTypeProperties, false));
}

function renderViewBar() {
  if (!viewBar) return;
  viewBar.innerHTML = "";

  const spacer = el("span");
  spacer.style.flex = "1";
  viewBar.append(spacer);

  const label = (t: string) => smallLabel(t);
  viewBar.append(label("Scale"), selectControl(state.scale, ["Fit", "1:20", "1:50", "1:100", "1:200", "1:500"], (v) => { state.scale = v; emit(); }, 90), separator());
  viewBar.append(label("Detail"), selectControl(state.detail, ["Coarse", "Medium", "Fine"], (v) => { state.detail = v as any; emit(); }, 80), separator());
  viewBar.append(label("Discipline"), selectControl(state.discipline, ["Coordination", "Architecture", "Structure", "Mechanical", "Electrical", "Plumbing"], (v) => { state.discipline = v as any; emit(); }, 112), separator());
  viewBar.append(button("Shaded", "S", () => setVisualPreset("shaded"), getVisualPreset() === "shaded"));
  viewBar.append(button("Shaded + Edges", "SE", () => setVisualPreset("shaded-edges"), getVisualPreset() === "shaded-edges"));
  viewBar.append(button("Wireframe", "W", () => setVisualPreset("wireframe"), getVisualPreset() === "wireframe"));
  viewBar.append(button("Hidden Line", "HL", () => setVisualPreset("hidden-line"), getVisualPreset() === "hidden-line"));
  viewBar.append(separator());
  viewBar.append(button("Crop", "⌗", () => { state.crop = !state.crop; emit(); }, state.crop));
  viewBar.append(button("Temporary Hide/Isolate", "◌", () => { state.temporaryMode = state.temporaryMode === "none" ? "isolate" : "none"; emit(); }, state.temporaryMode !== "none"));
  viewBar.append(button("Reveal", "R", revealAll, state.temporaryMode === "reveal"));
  viewBar.append(button("Sun", "☀", () => setSunEnabled(!isSunEnabled()), isSunEnabled()));
  viewBar.append(button("VG", "VG", openVisibilityGraphics, false));
  viewBar.append(button("Templates", "VT", openViewTemplates, false));
  viewBar.append(separator());
  viewBar.append(button("3D", "3D", () => { void setProjection("perspective"); goHome(); }, getProjection() === "perspective"));
  viewBar.append(button("Ortho", "ORTHO", () => { void setProjection("orthographic"); }, getProjection() === "orthographic"));
  viewBar.append(button("Top", "TOP", () => gotoDir(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0)), false));
  viewBar.append(button("Fit", "F", fitAll, false));
}

function ensureBars() {
  if (!ctx.rightHost) return;
  if (optionsBar) return;

  optionsBar = el("div", "obs-revit-options");
  contextualBar = el("div", "obs-revit-contextual");
  viewBar = el("div", "obs-revit-viewbar");
  promptBar = el("div", "obs-revit-prompt");
  hoverCard = el("div", "obs-revit-hovercard");

  try {
    state.optionsVisible = localStorage.getItem("obs.optionsBar.visible") !== "0";
  } catch { /* */ }
  optionsBar.dataset.visible = state.optionsVisible ? "1" : "0";
  contextualBar.dataset.visible = "0";
  promptBar.dataset.visible = "0";
  hoverCard.dataset.visible = "0";
  viewBar.dataset.visible = "1";
  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem("obs.viewBar.visible") === "0") viewBar.dataset.visible = "0";
  } catch { /* */ }

  ctx.rightHost.append(contextualBar, optionsBar, viewBar, promptBar, hoverCard);

  // Panels own their scroll — do not bubble wheel to 3D zoom
  for (const bar of [optionsBar, contextualBar, viewBar]) {
    bar.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); }, { passive: true });
  }
}

function updatePrompt() {
  if (!promptBar) return;
  const tool = getActiveTool();
  if (!tool) {
    promptBar.dataset.visible = "0";
    return;
  }
  const hints: Record<string, string> = {
    wall: "Place Wall: click start point → click endpoint. Click again to chain. Enter finishes the chain.",
    slab: "Place Floor: click boundary points. Click the first point or press Enter to finish.",
    door: "Place Door: hover a host wall → click to place. Move along the wall to adjust offset.",
    window: "Place Window: hover a host wall → click to place. Move along the wall to adjust offset.",
    duct: "Place Duct: click start → endpoint. Continue clicking to route; bends create fittings.",
    pipe: "Place Pipe: click start → endpoint. Continue clicking to route; bends create fittings.",
    move: "Move: select element(s) → base point → target point. Hold Shift for orthogonal constraint.",
    copy: "Copy: select element(s) → base point → target point. Space repeats the order.",
    rotate: "Rotate: select element(s) → center → reference → target angle.",
    mirror: "Mirror: select element(s) → two points defining the mirror axis.",
    array: "Array: select element(s) → base point → set count / spacing.",
    offset: "Offset: pick a host → pick the side / distance. Esc cancels the active step.",
    select: "Modify: click to select. Ctrl adds, Shift toggles, Alt removes. Tab cycles candidates.",
  };
  promptBar.textContent = hints[tool] ?? `${labelForTool(tool)} — click in the model to continue.`;
  promptBar.dataset.visible = "1";
}

function refresh() {
  updateModeFromState();
  ensureBars();
  renderContextual();
  renderOptionsBar();
  renderViewBar();
  updatePrompt();
  emit();
}

async function preselectionTooltip(e: PointerEvent) {
  if (!hoverCard || !ctx.rightHost) return;
  if (getActiveTool() && getActiveTool() !== "select") {
    hoverCard.dataset.visible = "0";
    return;
  }
  const canvas = (ctx.world?.renderer?.three as any)?.domElement;
  if (!canvas || e.target !== canvas) {
    hoverCard.dataset.visible = "0";
    return;
  }

  // Authored geometry is cheap to test with screen-space boxes.
  const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pointer = new THREE.Vector2(
    ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
    -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1,
  );
  const cam = ctx.world?.camera?.three;
  if (!cam) return;
  const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
  ray.setFromCamera(pointer, cam);
  let best: { id: string; dist: number; name: string; type: string } | null = null;
  for (const obj of getElements()) {
    const node = ctx.world.scene.three.getObjectByName(obj.id);
    if (!node) continue;
    const hits = ray.intersectObject(node, true);
    if (!hits.length) continue;
    const d = hits[0].distance;
    if (!best || d < best.dist) best = { id: obj.id, dist: d, name: obj.name, type: obj.type };
  }
  if (!best) {
    hoverCard.dataset.visible = "0";
    hoveredAuthorId = null;
    return;
  }
  hoveredAuthorId = best.id;
  hoverCard.dataset.visible = "1";
  hoverCard.style.left = `${Math.max(12, e.clientX - rect.left + 14)}px`;
  hoverCard.style.top = `${Math.max(12, e.clientY - rect.top + 14)}px`;
  hoverCard.innerHTML = `<b>${escapeHtml(best.name)}</b><span>${escapeHtml(best.type)}</span><em>Tab: cycle · Click: select</em>`;
}

function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[&<>\"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as Record<string, string>)[c]);
}

function keydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
  const tag = target?.tagName?.toLowerCase();
  if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || target?.isContentEditable) return;

  // Centralize common Revit-style global orders, while letting active authoring
  // keep ownership of its detailed mouse/Enter/Escape state machine.
  if (e.ctrlKey && !e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "z") return;
  if (e.ctrlKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "y") return;

  if (e.key === "Tab" && !e.shiftKey) {
    if (!isPlanViewVisible() && getActiveTool() === "select" && hoveredAuthorId) {
      const authored = getElements();
      const idx = authored.findIndex((x) => x.id === hoveredAuthorId);
      if (idx >= 0 && authored.length > 1) {
        const next = authored[(idx + 1) % authored.length];
        if (next) {
          // Use authored selection when possible; fragment selection is handled by the native highlighter.
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:select-authored", { detail: { id: next.id } }));
          toast(`Preselection cycle: ${next.name}`, "info", 900);
          e.preventDefault();
        }
      }
    }
    return;
  }

  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    if (state.temporaryMode !== "none") {
      revealAll();
      state.temporaryMode = "none";
      refresh();
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    return;
  }

  if (e.key === "Delete") {
    if (getAuthoredSelection().length || !selection.isEmpty()) {
      deleteSelectedElement();
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
  }

  if (e.key === "Shift") {
    const tool = getActiveTool();
    if (tool && tool !== "select") snapping.setOrtho(true, null);
  }
}

function keyup(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (e.key === "Shift") snapping.clearOrtho();
}

function selectionChanged() {
  const n = selectionSummary();
  const count = n.fragments + n.authored;
  if (count !== lastSelectionCount) {
    lastSelectionCount = count;
    refresh();
  } else {
    renderContextual();
    renderOptionsBar();
  }
}

function authoringChanged() {
  refresh();
}

export function setupRevitExperience() {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;
  createCommandCatalog();
  for (const c of commands.values()) {
    registerPaletteCommand({
      id: `revit.${c.id}`,
      label: c.label,
      category: c.ribbon ? `Revit ${c.ribbon}` : "Revit",
      hint: c.group,
      kbd: c.shortcut,
      run: () => c.run(),
      when: c.when,
    });
  }
  ensureBars();
  selection.onChange(selectionChanged);
  // Re-render the Options Bar and contextual ribbon whenever the active
  // authoring tool changes (ribbon click, Space-repeat, Esc-to-Select),
  // not only when the selection changes.
  onAuthoringChange(refresh);
  window.addEventListener("keydown", keydown, true);
  window.addEventListener("keyup", keyup, true);
  if (ctx.rightHost) {
    ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("pointermove", preselectionTooltip, true);
    ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { if (hoverCard) hoverCard.dataset.visible = "0"; });
  }
  window.addEventListener("obs:select-authored", (e: Event) => {
    const id = (e as CustomEvent).detail?.id as string | undefined;
    if (!id) return;
    setSelectedAuthored([id], "replace");
    setAuthoringTool("select");
    openPropertyPalette();
    refresh();
  });
  window.addEventListener("obs:revit-command", (e: Event) => {
    const id = (e as CustomEvent).detail?.id as string | undefined;
    if (id) execute(id);
  });

  (ctx.features as any).revitExperience = {
    execute,
    refresh,
    activateTool,
    getState: () => ({ ...state }),
    toggleContextualBar,
    toggleOptionsBar,
    toggleViewBar,
    isContextualBarVisible,
    isOptionsBarVisible,
    isViewBarVisible,
  };
  (window as any).__obsRevitExperience = {
    execute,
    refresh,
    getState: () => ({ ...state }),
    commands,
    activateTool,
  };
  refresh();
  console.log("[Revit Experience] v48 interaction layer online — command grammar + contextual UX + options bar + view control bar");
}


/** Show / hide the Options Bar (Revit Options Bar under the ribbon). */
export function toggleOptionsBar(force?: boolean): boolean {
  state.optionsVisible = force != null ? force : !state.optionsVisible;
  if (optionsBar) optionsBar.dataset.visible = state.optionsVisible ? "1" : "0";
  try { localStorage.setItem("obs.optionsBar.visible", state.optionsVisible ? "1" : "0"); } catch { /* */ }
  emit();
  return state.optionsVisible;
}
export function isOptionsBarVisible(): boolean { return state.optionsVisible; }

/** Show / hide the Modify contextual bar (selection tools under ribbon). */
export function toggleContextualBar(force?: boolean): boolean {
  // When forced open, allow even without selection; auto mode still uses selection
  state.contextualVisible = force != null ? force : !state.contextualVisible;
  if (force === true) {
    // pin open
    (state as any)._contextualPinned = true;
  } else if (force === false) {
    (state as any)._contextualPinned = false;
  } else if ((state as any)._contextualPinned) {
    (state as any)._contextualPinned = false;
  }
  if (contextualBar) {
    contextualBar.dataset.visible = state.contextualVisible ? "1" : "0";
    if (state.contextualVisible) renderContextual();
  }
  try { localStorage.setItem("obs.contextualBar.visible", state.contextualVisible ? "1" : "0"); } catch { /* */ }
  emit();
  return state.contextualVisible;
}
export function isContextualBarVisible(): boolean {
  return !!(contextualBar && contextualBar.dataset.visible === "1");
}

/** View control bar (bottom of viewport scale/detail/discipline). */
export function toggleViewBar(force?: boolean): boolean {
  if (!viewBar) return false;
  const on = force != null ? force : viewBar.dataset.visible !== "1";
  viewBar.dataset.visible = on ? "1" : "0";
  try { localStorage.setItem("obs.viewBar.visible", on ? "1" : "0"); } catch { /* */ }
  return on;
}
export function isViewBarVisible(): boolean {
  return !!(viewBar && viewBar.dataset.visible !== "0");
}

export function getRevitExperienceState(): ExperienceState { return { ...state }; }
export function executeRevitCommand(id: string): void { execute(id); }
```

```ts
/**
 * Revit Input Parity - keyboard shortcuts + mouse/view help that match
 * typical Revit navigation and command keys.
 *
 * Mouse map is owned by navigation.ts (already Revit-correct).
 * This module:
 *   1. Registers missing Revit-style two-letter + view shortcuts
 *   2. Re-asserts CameraControls mouse buttons stay OFF (nav owns them)
 *   3. Exposes a help overlay (Ctrl+/ or from Command Center)
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let shortcutsRegistered = false;
let helpEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let helpStyle = false;

/* -- Helpers --------------------------------------------------------------- */

function isTypingTarget(t: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  const el = t as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!el) return false;
  const tag = (el.tagName || "").toLowerCase();
  if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || tag === "select") return true;
  if ((el as Any).isContentEditable) return true;
  if (typeof el.closest === "function" &&
      el.closest('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable="true"]')) return true;
  return false;
}

async function cam(): Promise<Any> {
  try {
    return await import("./camera-tools");
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function notify(kind: string, message: string): void {
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("obs-toast", { detail: { kind, message, timeout: 1600 } }),
    );
  } catch { /* */ }
}

function getAuthoring(): Any | null {
  return (ctx.features as Any)?.authoring ?? null;
}

function selIds(): string[] {
  try {
    const sel = (ctx.features as Any)?.selection;
    return sel?.getSelectedIds?.() ?? [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

/* -- Shortcut registration ------------------------------------------------- */

async function registerRevitShortcuts(): Promise<void> {
  if (shortcutsRegistered) return;

  } catch {
    return;

  shortcutsRegistered = true;

  const reg = (s: Any) => {
    try {
      register!(s);
    } catch { /* */ }
  };

  // -- View / camera (Revit: ZA ZF ZE ZO ZI) ------------------------------
  reg({
    id: "revit-za",

    keys: "za",

      const m = await cam();

  reg({

  // -- Temporary hide / isolate (Revit HH HI HR) --------------------------
  reg({
    id: "revit-hh",

    keys: "hh",

  // -- Modify (Revit MV RO AL MA CS GP) -----------------------------------
  reg({

  reg({

    keys: "ro",

    handler: () => {

  reg({

    },
  });
  reg({
    id: "revit-gp",
    label: "Create Group (Revit GP)",
    keys: "gp",
    category: "tool",
    handler: () => {
      const ids = selIds();
      if (!ids.length) {
        notify("info", "Select elements to group");
```
