```ts
      }
      const name = window.prompt("Group name:", "Group") ?? "Group";
      (window as Any).__obsGroups?.createFromSelection?.(name, ids, true);
      notify("success", `Group "${name}"`);
    },
  });

  // -- Architecture extras (Revit-like) -----------------------------------
  const tool = (keys: string, id: string, label: string, type: string) => {
    reg({
      id,
      label,
      keys,
      category: "tool",
      handler: () => {
        const a = getAuthoring();
        if (a?.setAuthoringTool) {
          a.setAuthoringTool(type);
          notify("info", label);
        } else {
          notify("warn", "Authoring not ready");
        }
      },
    });
  };
  // Already in default-shortcuts: WA SL CM BM DR WN GR LV ...
  // Add a few more Revit-common ones if missing from defaults
  tool("rf", "revit-tool-roof", "Roof (Revit RF)", "roof");
  tool("cl", "revit-tool-ceiling", "Ceiling (Revit CL)", "ceiling");
  tool("rm", "revit-tool-room", "Room (Revit RM)", "room");
  tool("st", "revit-tool-stairs", "Stairs (Revit ST)", "stairs");
  tool("ra", "revit-tool-railing", "Railing (Revit RA)", "railing");
  tool("cw", "revit-tool-curtain", "Curtain Wall (Revit CW)", "curtain-wall");

  // -- Help overlay -------------------------------------------------------
  reg({
    id: "revit-help-input",
    label: "Mouse & Keyboard Help (Revit map)",
    keys: "ctrl+/",
    category: "app",
    handler: () => toggleInputHelp(),
  });

  console.log("[revit-input-parity] Revit shortcuts registered");
}

/* -- Mouse / CameraControls guard ------------------------------------------ */

function enforceNavOwnership(): void {
  try {
    const controls = (ctx as Any).world?.camera?.controls;
    if (!controls) return;
    const ctor: Any = (controls as Any).constructor;
    const ACTION = (controls as Any).ACTION ?? (ctor && ctor.ACTION);
    const mb = controls.mouseButtons;
    if (mb && ACTION) {
      // Force CameraControls mouse off - navigation.ts is sole driver
      if (ACTION.NONE != null) {
        mb.left = ACTION.NONE;
        mb.middle = ACTION.NONE;
        mb.right = ACTION.NONE;
        mb.wheel = ACTION.NONE;
      }
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
}

}

export function openInputHelp(): void {
  installHelpStyle();
  if (!helpEl) {
    helpEl = document.createElement("div");
    helpEl.id = "obs-input-help";
    helpEl.innerHTML = buildHelpHtml();
    document.body.appendChild(helpEl);
    helpEl.querySelector(".ih-close")?.addEventListener("click", () => closeInputHelp());
    helpEl.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (e.target === helpEl) closeInputHelp();
    });
  }
  helpEl.classList.add("is-open");
}

export function closeInputHelp(): void {
  helpEl?.classList.remove("is-open");
}

export function toggleInputHelp(): void {
  if (helpEl?.classList.contains("is-open")) closeInputHelp();
  else openInputHelp();
}

/* -- Setup ----------------------------------------------------------------- */

export function setupRevitInputParity(): void {
  void registerRevitShortcuts();

  // Re-assert nav ownership after boot (CameraControls can re-enable)
  enforceNavOwnership();
  window.setInterval(enforceNavOwnership, 4000);

  // Esc closes help
  window.addEventListener(
    "keydown",
    (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && helpEl?.classList.contains("is-open")) {
        closeInputHelp();
      }
    },
    true,
  );

  (window as Any).__obsRevitInput = {
    openHelp: openInputHelp,
    closeHelp: closeInputHelp,
    toggleHelp: toggleInputHelp,
    enforceNav: enforceNavOwnership,
  };

  // Command palette
  void (async () => {
    try {
      const cp: Any = await import("./command-palette");
      cp.registerCommand?.({
        id: "parity.inputHelp",
        label: "Mouse & Keyboard Help (Revit map)",
        category: "View",
        kbd: "Ctrl+/",
        run: () => toggleInputHelp(),
      });
    } catch { /* */ }
  })();

  console.log("[revit-input-parity] ready - Ctrl+/ for mouse & keyboard map");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Revit Parity Bridge - single integration layer that:
 *   1. Registers palette / toolbox commands for every gap-closure module
 *   2. Places stairs, railings, curtain walls into the live THREE scene
 *   3. Hooks selection - temporary dimensions
 *   4. Applies visibility filter on authoring rebuild events
 *   5. Exposes Match Properties + Create Similar helpers
 *
 * Call setupRevitParityBridge() from critical-gaps-boot (already wired).
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { notify } from "../core/notify";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

function scene(): THREE.Scene | null {
  return (ctx as Any).world?.scene?.three ?? null;
}

function getAuthoring(): Any | null {
  return (ctx.features as Any)?.authoring ?? (window as Any).__obsAuthoring ?? null;
}

function getSelectionIds(): string[] {
  const sel = (ctx.features as Any)?.selection;
  try {
    if (sel?.getSelectedIds) return sel.getSelectedIds() ?? [];
    if (sel?.ids) return [...sel.ids()];
    if (sel?.size && sel.size() && sel.get) {
      // fallback
    }
  } catch { /* */ }
  return [];
}

function getElements(): Any[] {
  const a = getAuthoring();
  if (!a) return [];
  try {
    if (typeof a.getElements === "function") return a.getElements() ?? [];
    if (Array.isArray(a.elements)) return a.elements;
  } catch { /* */ }
  return [];
}

function rebuild(): void {
  const a = getAuthoring();
  if (!a) return;
  try {
    if (typeof a.rebuildAuthored === "function") a.rebuildAuthored();
    else if (typeof a.rebuild === "function") a.rebuild();
    if (typeof a.markAuthoringDirty === "function") a.markAuthoringDirty();
  } catch { /* */ }
}

/* -- Geometry placement helpers ------------------------------------------ */

const placedGroupName = "obs-parity-placed";

function placedRoot(): THREE.Group | null {
  const s = scene();
  if (!s) return null;
  let g = s.getObjectByName(placedGroupName) as THREE.Group | undefined;
  if (!g) {
    g = new THREE.Group();
    g.name = placedGroupName;
    s.add(g);
  }
  return g;
}

function placeObject(obj: THREE.Object3D, label: string): void {
  const root = placedRoot();
  if (!root) {
    notify("warn", "Scene not ready");
    return;
  }
  obj.userData.parityPlaced = true;
  obj.userData.label = label;
  root.add(obj);
  notify("success", `Placed ${label}`, { timeout: 1600 });
}

async function placeStair(runType: "straight" | "l-shape" | "u-shape" = "straight"): Promise<void> {
  const m = await import("../modules/stairs/stairs");
  const result = m.buildStair({
    totalRise: 3.0,
    width: 1.2,
    runType,
    origin: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
  });
  const comfort = m.stairComfort(result.riserHeight, 0.28);
  placeObject(result.object, `Stair (${runType}, ${result.riserCount} risers)`);
  if (!comfort.ok) notify("warn", comfort.message, { timeout: 3000 });
}

async function placeRailing(): Promise<void> {
  const m = await import("../modules/railings/railings");
  const result = m.buildRailing({
    path: [
      { x: 0, z: 0 },
      { x: 4, z: 0 },
      { x: 4, z: 3 },
    ],
    height: 1.1,
    balusterSpacing: 0.12,
  });
  placeObject(result.object, `Railing (${result.balusterCount} balusters)`);
}

async function placeCurtainWall(): Promise<void> {
  const m = await import("../modules/curtain-wall/curtain-wall");
  const result = m.buildCurtainWall({
    width: 6,
    height: 3.5,
    vDivisions: 4,
    hDivisions: 2,
    origin: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
  });
  placeObject(result.object, `Curtain wall (${result.panelCount} panels)`);
}

/* -- Match Properties ---------------------------------------------------- */

let matchSourceId: string | null = null;

function matchPropertiesPickSource(): void {
  const ids = getSelectionIds();
  if (ids.length !== 1) {
    notify("info", "Select exactly one element as the property source");
    return;
  }
  matchSourceId = ids[0];
  notify("info", "Match Properties: source set - select targets and run Apply", { timeout: 2500 });
}

function matchPropertiesApply(): number {
  if (!matchSourceId) {
    notify("warn", "No source - run Match Properties (Pick Source) first");
    return 0;
  }
  const elements = getElements();
  const source = elements.find((e) => e.id === matchSourceId);
  if (!source) {
    notify("warn", "Source element no longer exists");
    matchSourceId = null;
    return 0;
  }
  const targets = getSelectionIds().filter((id) => id !== matchSourceId);
  if (!targets.length) {
    notify("info", "Select target elements to paint properties onto");
    return 0;
  }

  // Copy type-level visual / identity properties (not geometry params)
  const paintKeys = ["color", "familyId", "familyTypeId"];
  const paintProps = source.properties ? { ...source.properties } : {};
  let n = 0;
  for (const id of targets) {
    const el = elements.find((e) => e.id === id);
    if (!el) continue;
    for (const k of paintKeys) {
      if (k in source) (el as Any)[k] = (source as Any)[k];
    }
    el.properties = { ...(el.properties ?? {}), ...paintProps };
    // Phase / design option
    if ((source as Any).phaseCreated != null) (el as Any).phaseCreated = (source as Any).phaseCreated;
    if ((source as Any).designOptionId != null) (el as Any).designOptionId = (source as Any).designOptionId;
    n++;
  }
  rebuild();
  notify("success", `Matched properties onto ${n} element(s)`, { timeout: 1800 });
  return n;
}

/* -- Create Similar ------------------------------------------------------ */

function createSimilar(): void {
  const a = getAuthoring();
  if (!a) return;
  if (typeof a.createSimilarFromSelection === "function") {
    a.createSimilarFromSelection();
    return;
  }
  const ids = getSelectionIds();
  if (ids.length !== 1) {
    notify("info", "Select one element to create similar");
    return;
  }
  const el = getElements().find((e) => e.id === ids[0]);
  if (!el) return;
  if (typeof a.setAuthoringTool === "function") {
    a.setAuthoringTool(el.type);
    if (el.familyId && typeof a.setActiveFamily === "function") {
      a.setActiveFamily(el.familyId, el.familyTypeId ?? null);
    }
    notify("success", `Tool: ${el.type} (similar)`, { timeout: 1600 });
  }
}

/* -- Selection - temp dims ----------------------------------------------- */

function hookTempDims(): void {
  const sel = (ctx.features as Any)?.selection;
  if (!sel?.onChange) return;
  sel.onChange(() => {
    const td = (ctx.features as Any)?.tempDimensions ?? (window as Any).__obsTempDims;
    if (!td?.autoForElement) return;
    const ids = getSelectionIds();
    if (ids.length !== 1) {
      td.clear?.();
      return;
    }
    const el = getElements().find((e) => e.id === ids[0]);
    if (el) td.autoForElement(el);
  });
}

/* -- Visibility on authoring-changed ------------------------------------- */

function hookVisibility(): void {
  window.addEventListener("obs:authoring-changed", () => {
    const vis = (window as Any).__obsVisibility;
    if (!vis?.isVisible) return;
    // Soft filter: mark userData; full mesh hide is left to authoring rebuild consumers
    const elements = getElements();
    for (const el of elements) {
      const visible = vis.isVisible({
        id: el.id,
        category: el.type,
        phaseCreated: (el as Any).phaseCreated ?? el.properties?.phaseCreated,
        phaseDemolished: (el as Any).phaseDemolished ?? el.properties?.phaseDemolished,
        designOptionId: (el as Any).designOptionId ?? el.properties?.designOptionId,
      });
      (el as Any)._visHidden = !visible;
    }
  });
}

/* -- Command palette registration ---------------------------------------- */

async function registerCommands(): Promise<void> {
  let register: ((cmd: Any) => void) | null = null;
  try {
    const cp = await import("./command-palette");
    register = (cp as Any).registerCommand ?? null;

  const cmds: Any[] = [

      label: "Phasing Panel",
      category: "Panels",
      run: () => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-open-panel", { detail: { id: "phases" } })),
    },
    {
      id: "parity.panel.options",
      label: "Design Options Panel",
      category: "Panels",
      run: () => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-open-panel", { detail: { id: "design-options" } })),

      },
    },
  ];

  for (const c of cmds) {
    try {
      register(c);

/* -- Setup --------------------------------------------------------------- */

export function setupRevitParityBridge(): void {
  hookTempDims();
  hookVisibility();
  void registerCommands();

  (ctx.features as Any).revitParity = {
    placeStair,
    placeRailing,
    placeCurtainWall,
    matchPropertiesPickSource,
    matchPropertiesApply,
    createSimilar,
  };
  (window as Any).__obsRevitParity = (ctx.features as Any).revitParity;

  console.log("[revit-parity-bridge] ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Parametric ribbon tab + parity tools.
 * Adds a top-level "Parametric" tab to .obs-ribbon with:
 *   Families | Constraints | Architecture generators | CAD 2D | Drawings DXF/DWG
 * Hides bottom parity bars.
 */

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let installed = false;
let stripObserver: MutationObserver | null = null;
let parametricActive = false;
let savedStrip: Node[] | null = null;

function hideBottomBars(): void {
  const hide = (el: Element | null) => {
    if (!el) return;
    const h = el as HTMLElement;
    h.style.display = "none";
    h.setAttribute("data-parity-ribbon-migrated", "1");
  };
  hide(document.getElementById("obs-parity-tabs"));
  hide(document.getElementById("obs-adv-toolbar"));
  document.querySelectorAll(".obs-adv-toolbar").forEach(hide);
  document.querySelectorAll("[id^=obs-][id$=-launch]").forEach(hide);
}

function clickAdv(id: string): void {
  document.getElementById(id)?.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("click", { bubbles: true }));
}

function esc(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as Any)[c],
  );
}

function makeBtn(label: string, title: string, onClick: () => void): HTMLButtonElement {
  const el = document.createElement("button");
  el.className = "obs-rb";
  el.type = "button";
  el.title = title || label;
  el.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
  el.dataset.parityInject = "1";
  el.dataset.parametric = "1";
  el.innerHTML =
    `<span class="obs-rb__icon" style="font:700 10px/1 ui-monospace,monospace;opacity:.85">${esc(
      label.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
    )}</span>` + `<span class="obs-rb__label">${esc(label)}</span>`;
  el.onclick = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    try {
      onClick();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[parametric-tab]", err);
    }
  };
  return el;
}

function sep(): HTMLElement {
  const d = document.createElement("div");
  d.className = "obs-rb-sep";
  d.dataset.parityInject = "1";
  d.dataset.parametric = "1";
  d.style.cssText = "width:1px;align-self:stretch;background:#2a2e3a;margin:4px 6px";
  return d;
}

function groupLabel(text: string): HTMLElement {
  const s = document.createElement("span");
  s.className = "obs-rb-group";
  s.dataset.parityInject = "1";
  s.dataset.parametric = "1";
  s.textContent = text;
  s.style.cssText =
    "font:700 9px/1 Inter,system-ui;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6b7280;padding:0 4px;align-self:center";
  return s;
}

function parametricTools(): HTMLElement[] {
  const out: HTMLElement[] = [];

  // Families / parametric engine
  out.push(groupLabel("Families"));
  out.push(
    makeBtn("Family Panel", "Parametric families (Ctrl+Shift+F)", () =>
      (window as Any).__obsParamFamilyPanel?.toggle?.(),
    ),
  );
  out.push(
    makeBtn("Place Door", "Sample parametric door", () =>
      (window as Any).__obsParamFamilyPanel?.placeSample?.() ??
      clickAdv("obs-adv-stair"),
    ),
  );
  out.push(
    makeBtn("Solve", "Constraint / formula solver", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-solve")),
  );
  out.push(
    makeBtn("Hosts", "Recompute hosted openings", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-hosts")),
  );

  out.push(sep());
  out.push(groupLabel("Architecture"));
  out.push(makeBtn("Stair", "Parametric stair", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-stair")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Railing", "Parametric railing", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-rail")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Curtain", "Curtain wall system", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-cw")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Room", "Create room", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-room")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Rooms", "Rooms panel", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-rooms-panel")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Phases", "Phases", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-phases")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Options", "Design options", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-opts")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Group", "Model group", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-group")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Align", "Align", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-align")));

  out.push(sep());
  out.push(groupLabel("2D CAD"));
  out.push(
    makeBtn("CAD Tools", "CAD command panel (Ctrl+Shift+D)", () =>
      (window as Any).__obsCad?.open?.() ?? (window as Any).__obsCad?.toggle?.(),
    ),
  );
  out.push(makeBtn("Line", "CAD line", () => (window as Any).__obsCad?.setTool?.("line")));
  out.push(
    makeBtn("PLine", "Polyline", () => (window as Any).__obsCad?.setTool?.("polyline")),
  );
  out.push(makeBtn("Rect", "Rectangle", () => (window as Any).__obsCad?.setTool?.("rect")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Circle", "Circle", () => (window as Any).__obsCad?.setTool?.("circle")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Offset", "Offset", () => (window as Any).__obsCad?.setTool?.("offset")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Trim", "Trim", () => (window as Any).__obsCad?.setTool?.("trim")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Extend", "Extend", () => (window as Any).__obsCad?.setTool?.("extend")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Fillet", "Fillet", () => (window as Any).__obsCad?.setTool?.("fillet")));
  out.push(makeBtn("Mirror", "Mirror", () => (window as Any).__obsCad?.setTool?.("mirror")));
  out.push(
    makeBtn("Draft 2D", "2D drafting overlay", () => clickAdv("obs-adv-draft")),
  );

  out.push(sep());
  out.push(groupLabel("Drawings"));
  out.push(
    makeBtn("DXF / DWG", "Drawings panel (Ctrl+Shift+G)", () =>
      (window as Any).__obsDrawingsPanel?.toggle?.(),
    ),
  );
  out.push(
    makeBtn("Export DXF", "Export CAD as DXF", () =>
      (window as Any).__obsDrawings?.exportCadAsDxf?.(),
    ),
  );
  out.push(
    makeBtn("Import DXF", "Import DXF drawing", () =>
      (window as Any).__obsDrawingsPanel?.open?.(),
    ),
  );

  out.push(sep());
  out.push(groupLabel("View"));
  out.push(
    makeBtn("3D Ortho", "Toggle orthographic (VO)", () =>
      (window as Any).__obsSelPivot?.toggleOrtho?.(),
    ),
  );
  out.push(
    makeBtn("Zoom Sel", "Zoom to selection (ZO)", () =>
      void (window as Any).__obsSelPivot?.zoomToSelection?.(),
    ),
  );
  out.push(
    makeBtn("Cmd Center", "Revit Command Center", () =>
      (window as Any).__obsRevitCommandCenter?.toggle?.(),
    ),
  );

  return out;
}

function ensureParametricTab(): HTMLButtonElement | null {
  const tabsRow = document.querySelector(".obs-ribbon__tabs") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!tabsRow) return null;

  let tab = tabsRow.querySelector('[data-tab="parametric"]') as HTMLButtonElement | null;
  if (tab) return tab;

  tab = document.createElement("button");
  tab.type = "button";
  tab.className = "obs-ribbon__tab";
  tab.dataset.tab = "parametric";
  tab.textContent = "Parametric";
  tab.title = "Parametric families, CAD 2D, Drawings DXF/DWG";
  tab.style.cssText = ""; // inherit ribbon tab styles

  // Place after Architecture if present, else append
  const arch = Array.from(tabsRow.querySelectorAll("button")).find((b) =>
    /architecture/i.test(b.textContent || ""),
  );
  if (arch && arch.nextSibling) {
    tabsRow.insertBefore(tab, arch.nextSibling);
  } else {
    tabsRow.appendChild(tab);
  }

  tab.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    activateParametricTab();
  });

  return tab;
}

function clearActiveTabs(): void {
  document.querySelectorAll(".obs-ribbon__tabs button").forEach((b) => {
    const el = b as HTMLElement;
    el.removeAttribute("data-active");
    el.dataset.active = "";
    el.classList.remove("is-active", "active");
  });
}

function activateParametricTab(): void {
  parametricActive = true;
  clearActiveTabs();
  const tab = ensureParametricTab();
  if (tab) {
    tab.dataset.active = "1";
    tab.setAttribute("data-active", "1");
    tab.classList.add("is-active");
  }

  const strip = document.querySelector(".obs-ribbon__strip") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!strip) return;

  // Clear strip and show parametric tools only
  strip.innerHTML = "";
  for (const el of parametricTools()) strip.appendChild(el);
}

function deactivateParametricIfOtherTab(e: Event): void {
  const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
  if (!t) return;
  const btn = t.closest?.(".obs-ribbon__tabs button") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!btn) return;
  if (btn.getAttribute("data-tab") === "parametric") return;
  // Other tab clicked - leave parametric mode; ribbon will re-render its strip
  parametricActive = false;
  const tab = document.querySelector('.obs-ribbon__tabs [data-tab="parametric"]') as HTMLElement | null;
  if (tab) {
    tab.removeAttribute("data-active");
    tab.dataset.active = "";
    tab.classList.remove("is-active");
  }
}

function inject(): void {
  hideBottomBars();
  ensureParametricTab();

  if (parametricActive) {
    activateParametricTab();
    return;
  }

  // Do not inject parity tools into other tabs anymore - they live under Parametric
  const strip = document.querySelector(".obs-ribbon__strip") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (strip) {
    strip.querySelectorAll("[data-parity-inject]").forEach((n) => n.remove());
  }
}

function watchRibbon(): void {
  const root = document.querySelector(".obs-ribbon") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!root) {
    window.setTimeout(watchRibbon, 500);
    return;
  }

  root.addEventListener("click", deactivateParametricIfOtherTab, true);
  root.addEventListener(
    "click",
    () => {
      window.setTimeout(inject, 40);
      window.setTimeout(inject, 150);
    },
    true,
  );

  const strip = root.querySelector(".obs-ribbon__strip");
  if (strip && !stripObserver) {
    stripObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if (parametricActive) {
        // Ribbon may wipe strip on re-render - restore parametric tools
        if (!strip.querySelector("[data-parametric]")) {
          window.setTimeout(() => activateParametricTab(), 20);
        }
      }
    });
    stripObserver.observe(strip, { childList: true });
  }

  inject();
  window.setTimeout(inject, 600);
  window.setTimeout(inject, 1800);
}

export function setupRibbonParityInject(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  hideBottomBars();
  watchRibbon();

  const mo = new MutationObserver(() => hideBottomBars());
  mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  (window as Any).__obsRibbonParity = {
    inject,
    hideBottomBars,
    openParametric: activateParametricTab,
  };
  (window as Any).__obsParametricTab = { open: activateParametricTab };

  console.log(
    "[ribbon-parity-inject] Parametric tab ready (families + CAD 2D + DXF/DWG)",
  );
}
```

```ts
// openbim-fix:ribbon-persist
//
// Remembers the ribbon's active tab and every panel group's collapse
// state across page reloads.
//
// Implementation strategy: observe the ribbon from the outside so this
// module never has to know the ribbon's internal class names, tab ids,
// or collapse mechanism. That means it works today, works after any
// future refactor of shell/ribbon.ts, and cannot break the existing
// regression guard.
//
//   1. A MutationObserver watches for the .obs-ribbon element.
//   2. Once found, it scans for the currently active tab and for every
//      collapsible group. Both are identified by a small set of
//      fallback selectors, so a change of class name degrades to
//      "feature disabled" rather than "feature broken".
//   3. A capturing click listener records every tab / group-header
//      click.
//   4. State is written to localStorage["obs.ribbon.state.v1"] on
//      click and on beforeunload.
//   5. On boot, the saved state is reapplied.

const STORAGE_KEY = "obs.ribbon.state.v1";

export interface RibbonState {
  activeTab: string | null;
  collapsedGroups: string[];
}

// Selectors tried in order. First match wins. Kept short on purpose --
// the goal is generic discovery, not perfect capture of every style.
const TAB_SELECTORS = [
  ".obs-ribbon__tab",
  "[data-ribbon-tab]",
  "[data-tab]",
  "button[role='tab']",
];

const GROUP_SELECTORS = [
  "bim-panel-section",
  "[data-ribbon-group]",
  ".obs-ribbon__group",
  ".obs-ribbon__panel",
];

function pickSelector(root: ParentNode, list: string[]): {
  selector: string;
  nodes: Element[];
} {
  for (const sel of list) {
    const nodes = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(sel));
    if (nodes.length) return { selector: sel, nodes };
  }
  return { selector: "", nodes: [] };
}

function readState(): RibbonState {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return { activeTab: null, collapsedGroups: [] };
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<RibbonState>;
    return {
      activeTab: typeof parsed.activeTab === "string" ? parsed.activeTab : null,
      collapsedGroups: Array.isArray(parsed.collapsedGroups)
        ? parsed.collapsedGroups.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string")
        : [],
    };
  } catch {
    return { activeTab: null, collapsedGroups: [] };
  }
}

function writeState(s: RibbonState): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(s)); }
  catch { /* storage unavailable -- not fatal */ }
}

function isGroupCollapsed(node: Element): boolean {
  // Three common collapse conventions, all treated as equivalent.
  if (node.hasAttribute("collapsed")) return true;
  if (node.getAttribute("data-collapsed") === "1") return true;
  if (node.getAttribute("data-open") === "0") return true;
  // If the group contains a body whose display is none, treat as collapsed.
  const body = node.querySelector("[data-ribbon-group-body], .obs-ribbon__group-body, .obs-ribbon__panel-body");
  if (body && (body as HTMLElement).style.display === "none") return true;
  return false;
}

function setGroupCollapsed(node: Element, collapsed: boolean): void {
  // Mirror the same three conventions on write.
  if (collapsed) node.setAttribute("collapsed", "");
  else node.removeAttribute("collapsed");
  node.setAttribute("data-collapsed", collapsed ? "1" : "0");

  // Also drive the body if one exists.
  const body = node.querySelector("[data-ribbon-group-body], .obs-ribbon__group-body, .obs-ribbon__panel-body") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (body) body.style.display = collapsed ? "none" : "";
}

function tabIdOf(el: Element): string | null {
  const explicit =
    el.getAttribute("data-ribbon-tab") ??
    el.getAttribute("data-tab") ??
    el.getAttribute("data-id");
  if (explicit) return explicit;
  const text = (el.textContent ?? "").trim();
  return text ? text.slice(0, 40) : null;
}

function groupIdOf(el: Element, index: number): string {
  const explicit =
    el.getAttribute("data-ribbon-group") ??
    el.getAttribute("data-group") ??
    el.getAttribute("data-id") ??
    el.getAttribute("label");
  if (explicit) return explicit;
  const head = el.querySelector("header, [data-ribbon-group-head], .obs-ribbon__group-head");
  const text = (head?.textContent ?? el.textContent ?? "").trim();
  return text ? text.slice(0, 40) + "#" + index : "group#" + index;
}

let installed = false;

export function setupRibbonPersist(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  const applyTo = (ribbon: Element): void => {
    const saved = readState();

    // Restore active tab.
    if (saved.activeTab) {
      const tabs = pickSelector(ribbon, TAB_SELECTORS);
      for (const t of tabs.nodes) {
        if (tabIdOf(t) === saved.activeTab) {
          try { (t as HTMLElement).click(); } catch { /* */ }
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // Restore collapsed groups.
    const groups = pickSelector(ribbon, GROUP_SELECTORS);
    const wanted = new Set(saved.collapsedGroups);
    groups.nodes.forEach((g, i) => {
      const id = groupIdOf(g, i);
      const shouldCollapse = wanted.has(id);
      if (shouldCollapse !== isGroupCollapsed(g)) {
        setGroupCollapsed(g, shouldCollapse);
      }
    });

    console.log(
      "[ribbon-persist] restored Â· tab=" + (saved.activeTab ?? "default") +
      " Â· collapsed=" + saved.collapsedGroups.length,
    );
  };

  const onRibbonClick = (ev: MouseEvent): void => {
    const target = ev.target as Element | null;
    if (!target) return;
    const ribbon = target.closest(".obs-ribbon");
    if (!ribbon) return;

    // Tab click?
    const tabSel = TAB_SELECTORS.join(",");
    const tab = target.closest(tabSel);
    if (tab) {
      const state = readState();
      const next = tabIdOf(tab);
      if (next && next !== state.activeTab) {
        state.activeTab = next;
        writeState(state);
      }
      return;
    }

    // Group header click? We accept a click anywhere on the group and
    // re-scan afterwards so we do not have to know where the header is.
    const groupSel = GROUP_SELECTORS.join(",");
    const group = target.closest(groupSel);
    if (group) {
      // Read fresh collapse states for every group after the click lands.
      // A microtask is enough because the ribbon updates synchronously.
      Promise.resolve().then(() => {
        const groups = pickSelector(ribbon, GROUP_SELECTORS);
        const state = readState();
        const collapsed: string[] = [];
        groups.nodes.forEach((g, i) => {
          if (isGroupCollapsed(g)) collapsed.push(groupIdOf(g, i));
        });
        state.collapsedGroups = collapsed;
        writeState(state);
      });
    }
  };

  // Install a MutationObserver that finds the ribbon the first time it
  // appears and then disconnects.
  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
    const ribbon = document.querySelector(".obs-ribbon");
    if (!ribbon) return;
    observer.disconnect();
    applyTo(ribbon);
  });
  observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  // If the ribbon is already mounted, apply right now.
  const existing = document.querySelector(".obs-ribbon");
  if (existing) {
    observer.disconnect();
    applyTo(existing);
  }

  // Global capture listener for tab + group clicks.
  document.addEventListener("click", onRibbonClick, true);

  // Save on unload.
  window.addEventListener("beforeunload", () => {
    const ribbon = document.querySelector(".obs-ribbon");
    if (!ribbon) return;
    const state = readState();
    const groups = pickSelector(ribbon, GROUP_SELECTORS);
    const collapsed: string[] = [];
    groups.nodes.forEach((g, i) => {
      if (isGroupCollapsed(g)) collapsed.push(groupIdOf(g, i));
    });
    state.collapsedGroups = collapsed;
    writeState(state);
  });

  (window as any).__obsRibbonPersist = {
    save: () => {
      const ribbon = document.querySelector(".obs-ribbon");
      if (!ribbon) return null;
      const groups = pickSelector(ribbon, GROUP_SELECTORS);
      const collapsed: string[] = [];
      groups.nodes.forEach((g, i) => {
        if (isGroupCollapsed(g)) collapsed.push(groupIdOf(g, i));
      });
      const state = readState();
      state.collapsedGroups = collapsed;
      writeState(state);
      return state;
    },
    restore: () => {
      const ribbon = document.querySelector(".obs-ribbon");
      if (!ribbon) return;
      applyTo(ribbon);
    },
    reset: () => {
      try { localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch { /* */ }
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
          detail: { message: "Ribbon layout reset", kind: "success" },
        }));
      } catch { /* */ }
    },
    read: readState,
  };

  console.log("[ribbon-persist] ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Saved views — named camera positions, persisted per project.
 *
 * A floating panel lists saved views. Each row shows the name, creation date,
 * and buttons to restore or delete. Saving captures the current camera
 * position, orbit target, and projection mode.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { getProjection, setProjection, updateClipping } from "./camera-tools";
import { getCurrentProject, onProjectChanged } from "../modules/projects/projects";

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Types + storage
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export interface SavedView {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  pos: [number, number, number];
  target: [number, number, number];
  projection: "perspective" | "orthographic";
  createdAt: number;
}

const STORAGE_PREFIX = "obs.saved-views.";

function storageKey(): string {
  const p = getCurrentProject();
  return STORAGE_PREFIX + (p?.id ?? "__global__");
}

function loadViews(): SavedView[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey());
    if (!raw) return [];
    const arr = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
  } catch { return []; }
}

function persistViews(list: SavedView[]): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey(), JSON.stringify(list)); } catch { /* */ }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public API
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function listSavedViews(): SavedView[] {
  return loadViews();
}

export function saveCurrentView(name?: string): SavedView | null {
  const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
  const target = new THREE.Vector3();
  if (controls?.target?.isVector3) target.copy(controls.target);
  else {
    const d = new THREE.Vector3();
    cam.getWorldDirection(d);
    target.copy(cam.position).add(d.multiplyScalar(5));
  }

  const autoName = name?.trim() ||
    `View ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}`;

  const view: SavedView = {
    id: (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `v-${Date.now()}`,
    name: autoName,
    pos: [cam.position.x, cam.position.y, cam.position.z],
    target: [target.x, target.y, target.z],
    projection: getProjection(),
    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };

  const list = loadViews();
  list.unshift(view);
  persistViews(list.slice(0, 64));
  renderPanel();
  return view;
}

export function restoreView(id: string): void {
  const view = loadViews().find((v) => v.id === id);
  if (!view) return;

  if (view.projection !== getProjection()) {
    try { setProjection(view.projection); } catch { /* */ }
  }

  const controls: any = ctx.world.camera.controls;
  if (controls && typeof controls.setLookAt === "function") {
    try {
      controls.setLookAt(
        view.pos[0], view.pos[1], view.pos[2],
        view.target[0], view.target[1], view.target[2],
        true,   // smooth transition
      );
    } catch { /* */ }
  } else {
    const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
    cam.position.set(view.pos[0], view.pos[1], view.pos[2]);
    cam.lookAt(new THREE.Vector3(...view.target));
  }

  updateClipping();
  try { ctx.fragments.core.update(true); } catch { /* */ }
}

export function deleteView(id: string): void {
  const list = loadViews().filter((v) => v.id !== id);
  persistViews(list);
  renderPanel();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Panel
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let panelEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let listContainer: HTMLDivElement | null = null;

function ensurePanel(): HTMLDivElement {
  if (panelEl) return panelEl;

  panelEl = document.createElement("div");
  panelEl.id = "obs-saved-views";
  panelEl.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;right:14px;top:210px;width:270px;max-height:60vh;z-index:34;" +
    "display:none;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.55);font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;" +
    "color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);overflow:hidden";

  const header = document.createElement("div");
  header.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:9px 10px;" +
    "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);" +
    "background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23)";
  header.innerHTML = `<span style="font-weight:700;flex:1">📌 Saved Views</span>`;

  const saveBtn = document.createElement("button");
  saveBtn.textContent = "Save current";
  saveBtn.style.cssText =
    "padding:4px 10px;background:var(--accent,#38bdf8);color:#0b0d12;" +
    "border:none;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font:600 11px system-ui";
  saveBtn.onclick = () => {
    const name = prompt("View name:", `View ${listSavedViews().length + 1}`);
    if (name == null) return;
    saveCurrentView(name);
  };

  const closeBtn = document.createElement("button");
  closeBtn.textContent = "✕";
  closeBtn.style.cssText =
    "padding:4px 8px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default);border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px";
  closeBtn.onclick = () => closeSavedViewsPanel();

  header.append(saveBtn, closeBtn);

  listContainer = document.createElement("div");
  listContainer.style.cssText = "overflow-y:auto;padding:6px";

  panelEl.append(header, listContainer);
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panelEl);
  return panelEl;
}

function renderPanel(): void {
  if (!listContainer) return;
  listContainer.innerHTML = "";

  const list = loadViews();
  if (!list.length) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.style.cssText =
      "padding:18px;text-align:center;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);" +
      "font:11.5px/1.5 system-ui;border:1px dashed var(--border-default);" +
      "border-radius:6px";
    empty.textContent = "No saved views. Click Save current to capture the camera.";
    listContainer.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }

  for (const v of list) {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText =
      "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:6px;" +
      "margin:2px 0;cursor:pointer;transition:background .12s";
    row.onmouseenter = () => (row.style.background = "rgba(255,255,255,.04)");
    row.onmouseleave = () => (row.style.background = "transparent");
    row.onclick = () => restoreView(v.id);

    const info = document.createElement("div");
    info.style.cssText = "flex:1;min-width:0";
    const name = document.createElement("div");
    name.style.cssText = "font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap";
    name.textContent = v.name;
    name.title = v.name;
    const meta = document.createElement("div");
    meta.style.cssText = "font-size:10px;color:var(--text-tertiary);margin-top:1px";
    meta.textContent = `${v.projection === "orthographic" ? "Ortho" : "Persp"} · ${new Date(v.createdAt).toLocaleString()}`;
    info.append(name, meta);

    const del = document.createElement("button");
    del.textContent = "🗑";
    del.title = "Delete this view";
    del.style.cssText =
      "padding:3px 7px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary);" +
      "border:1px solid var(--border-default);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px;flex:none";
    del.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); deleteView(v.id); };

    row.append(info, del);
    listContainer.appendChild(row);
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Panel visibility
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function isSavedViewsPanelVisible(): boolean {
  return !!panelEl && panelEl.style.display === "flex";
}

export function openSavedViewsPanel(): void {
  ensurePanel();
  if (!panelEl) return;
  panelEl.style.display = "flex";
  renderPanel();
}

export function closeSavedViewsPanel(): void {
  if (panelEl) panelEl.style.display = "none";
}

export function toggleSavedViewsPanel(): void {
  isSavedViewsPanelVisible() ? closeSavedViewsPanel() : openSavedViewsPanel();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Setup
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function setupSavedViews(): void {
  onProjectChanged(() => {
    if (isSavedViewsPanelVisible()) renderPanel();
  });

  // Ctrl+Shift+V to toggle
  window.addEventListener(
    "keydown",
    (e) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "v") {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        toggleSavedViewsPanel();
      }
    },
    true,
  );

  ctx.features.savedViews = {
    open: openSavedViewsPanel,
    close: closeSavedViewsPanel,
    toggle: toggleSavedViewsPanel,
    isVisible: isSavedViewsPanelVisible,
    list: listSavedViews,
    save: saveCurrentView,
    restore: restoreView,
    remove: deleteView,
  };
}
```

```ts
 *   • Edit dialog — rename, choose columns, change grouping
 *   • Template gallery (unchanged)

 */

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const loadingText = document.createElement("div");

cancelBtn.textContent = "Cancel";
cancelBtn.style.cssText =

cancelBtn.onclick = () => {

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const btn = (label: string, onclick: () => void, primary = false) => {

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Header

function renderHeader(): void {
  header.innerHTML = "";

  const saved = listSavedSchedules();
  savedSel.innerHTML =
    `<option value="">— My schedules (${saved.length}) —</option>` +
    saved.map((s) => `<option value="${s.id}">${s.name}</option>`).join("");
  savedSel.value = saved.some((s) => s.id === currentDefinition.id) ? currentDefinition.id : "";
  savedSel.onchange = () => {
    const s = savedSel.value ? getSavedSchedule(savedSel.value) : null;
    if (!s) return;
    currentDefinition = s;
    visibleColumns = new Set(currentDefinition.columns.filter((c) => !c.hidden).map((c) => c.key));
    void regenerate();
  };

  // Template gallery
  const tplSel = document.createElement("select");
  tplSel.style.cssText = savedSel.style.cssText;
  tplSel.innerHTML =
    `<option value="">— Templates (${BUILT_IN_TEMPLATES.length}) —</option>` +
    BUILT_IN_TEMPLATES.map((t) => `<option value="${t.id}">${t.name}</option>`).join("");
  tplSel.value = "";
  tplSel.onchange = () => {
    const tpl = getTemplate(tplSel.value);
    if (!tpl) return;
    currentDefinition = cloneTemplate(tpl);
    visibleColumns = new Set(currentDefinition.columns.filter((c) => !c.hidden).map((c) => c.key));
    void regenerate();
  };

  const spacer = document.createElement("div");
  spacer.style.cssText = "flex:1";

  const runBtn = btn("⟳ Run", () => void regenerate(), true);
  const newBtn = btn("＋ New", () => openNewDialog());
  const saveBtn = btn("💾 Save", () => saveCurrent());
  const snapshotBtn = btn("📷 Snapshot", takeSnapshotNow);
  const diffBtn = btn("⇄ Diff", showLatestDiff);
  const closeBtn = btn("✕", () => toggleSchedules());

  header.append(
    title, divider(),
    savedSel, tplSel,
    spacer,
    runBtn, newBtn, saveBtn, snapshotBtn, diffBtn, closeBtn,
  );
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   New schedule dialog
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function openNewDialog(): void {
  const back = document.createElement("div");
  back.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:400;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);" +
    "display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center";
  back.onmousedown = (e) => {
    if (e.target === back) back.remove();
  };

  const card = document.createElement("div");
  card.style.cssText =
    "background:var(--bg-floating,#1c1e28);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);" +
    "border-radius:10px;padding:16px;width:480px;max-width:92vw;max-height:88vh;overflow:auto;" +
    "color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:12px system-ui";

  const t = document.createElement("div");
  t.textContent = "New schedule";
  t.style.cssText = "font:700 14px system-ui;margin-bottom:12px";

  const row = (label: string, control: HTMLElement): HTMLElement => {
    const r = document.createElement("div");
    r.style.cssText =
      "display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px";
    const l = document.createElement("label");
    l.textContent = label;
    l.style.cssText = "color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5)";
    r.append(l, control);
    return r;
  };

  const INP =
    "width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:5px 8px;background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:5px;" +
    "color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);font:12px system-ui";

  const nameInput = document.createElement("input");
  nameInput.type = "text";
  nameInput.placeholder = "e.g. Doors on Level 2";
  nameInput.style.cssText = INP;

  // Category picker grouped by discipline
  const catSel = document.createElement("select");
  catSel.style.cssText = INP + ";cursor:pointer";
  const opts: string[] = [`<option value="">— All categories —</option>`];
  for (const d of listDisciplines()) {
    const group = CATEGORY_CATALOG.filter((c) => c.discipline === d.key);
    if (!group.length) continue;
    opts.push(`<optgroup label="${d.label}">`);
    for (const c of group) {
      opts.push(`<option value="${c.ifc}">${c.label} (${c.ifc})</option>`);
    }
    opts.push(`</optgroup>`);
  }
  catSel.innerHTML = opts.join("");

  const colsPreview = document.createElement("div");
  colsPreview.style.cssText =
    "font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);line-height:1.5;" +
    "padding:6px 8px;background:var(--bg-inset,#0e1017);border-radius:5px;" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);margin-top:4px;min-height:40px";
  colsPreview.textContent = "Category defaults will be used.";

  catSel.onchange = () => {
    const cat = CATEGORY_CATALOG.find((c) => c.ifc === catSel.value);
    if (!cat) {
      colsPreview.textContent = "Multi-category schedule. Columns: type, level, count.";
      return;
    }
    colsPreview.textContent =
      `Default columns: ${cat.defaultColumns.join(", ")}\n` +
      `Default grouping: ${cat.defaultGrouping.join(" > ") || "none"}`;
    colsPreview.style.whiteSpace = "pre-wrap";
  };

  const actions = document.createElement("div");
  actions.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:12px";

  const cancel = document.createElement("button");
  cancel.textContent = "Cancel";
  cancel.style.cssText =
    "padding:6px 14px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font:12px system-ui";
  cancel.onclick = () => back.remove();

  const create = document.createElement("button");
  create.textContent = "Create & save";
  create.style.cssText =
    "padding:6px 14px;background:var(--accent,#38bdf8);color:#0b0d12;border:none;" +
    "border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font:600 12px system-ui";
  create.onclick = () => {
    const name = nameInput.value.trim() || "New schedule";
    const spec: ScheduleSpec = {
      name,
      category: catSel.value || null,
    };
    const def = buildSchedule(spec);
    const stored = saveSchedule(def);
    currentDefinition = stored;
    visibleColumns = new Set(currentDefinition.columns.filter((c) => !c.hidden).map((c) => c.key));
    back.remove();
    void regenerate();
    renderHeader();
  };

  actions.append(cancel, create);
  card.append(
    t,
    row("Name", nameInput),
    row("Category", catSel),
    colsPreview,
    actions,
  );
  back.appendChild(card);
  document.body.appendChild(back);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Save current
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function saveCurrent(): void {
  const existing = listSavedSchedules().find((s) => s.id === currentDefinition.id);
  if (existing) {
    const stored = saveSchedule(currentDefinition);
    currentDefinition = stored;
    alert(`Saved "${stored.name}".`);
    renderHeader();
    return;
  }
  const name = prompt("Save schedule as:", currentDefinition.name || "New schedule");
  if (name == null) return;
  const named = { ...currentDefinition, name: name.trim() || currentDefinition.name };
  const stored = saveSchedule(named);
  currentDefinition = stored;
  alert(`Saved as "${stored.name}".`);
  renderHeader();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Controls
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderControls(): void {
  controls.innerHTML = "";

  const lbl = (text: string) => {
    const s = document.createElement("span");
    s.textContent = text;
    s.style.cssText = "font:11px system-ui;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);white-space:nowrap";
    return s;
  };

  controls.appendChild(lbl("Columns:"));

  for (const col of currentDefinition.columns) {
    if (col.hidden) continue;
    const chip = document.createElement("button");
    chip.textContent = col.header + (col.format === "formula" ? " ƒ" : "");
    const isOn = visibleColumns.has(col.key);
    chip.style.cssText =
      `padding:3px 8px;border-radius:4px;font:11px system-ui;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;` +
      (isOn
        ? "background:var(--accent-dim,rgba(56,189,248,.14));color:var(--accent,#38bdf8);border:1px solid var(--accent,#38bdf8)"
        : "background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5);border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a)");
    chip.title = col.help ?? col.header;
    chip.onclick = () => {
      if (visibleColumns.has(col.key)) visibleColumns.delete(col.key);
      else visibleColumns.add(col.key);
      renderControls();
      renderTable();
    };
    controls.appendChild(chip);
  }

  controls.appendChild(divider());
  controls.appendChild(lbl("Group:"));

  const groups: GroupLevel[] = currentDefinition.grouping ?? [];
  for (let i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
    const g = groups[i];
    const chip = document.createElement("span");
    chip.textContent = `${g.key} ✕`;
    chip.title = "Remove grouping level";
    chip.style.cssText =
      "padding:3px 8px;border-radius:4px;font:11px system-ui;cursor:pointer;" +
      "background:rgba(168,85,247,.14);color:#c084fc;border:1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.4)";
    chip.onclick = () => {
      currentDefinition.grouping = groups.filter((_, j) => j !== i);
      void regenerate();
    };
    controls.appendChild(chip);
  }

  const addGroup = document.createElement("button");
  addGroup.textContent = "+";
  addGroup.title = "Add a grouping level";
  addGroup.style.cssText =
    "padding:3px 10px;border-radius:4px;font:11px system-ui;cursor:pointer;" +
    "background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5);" +
    "border:1px dashed var(--border-default,#2a2e3a)";
  addGroup.onclick = () => {
    const key = prompt(
      "Group by column key (e.g. level, category, systemType, material, type):",
      "level",
    );
    if (!key) return;
    currentDefinition.grouping = [...(currentDefinition.grouping ?? []), { key, subtotal: true }];
    void regenerate();
  };
  controls.appendChild(addGroup);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Formatting
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function formatCell(col: ScheduleColumn, value: string | number | null): string {
  if (value == null || value === "") return "";
  if (col.format === "text" || col.format === "date") return String(value);
  const n = typeof value === "number" ? value : parseFloat(String(value));
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return String(value);
  if (col.format === "count") return String(Math.round(n));
  if (col.format === "currency") return n.toFixed(2);
  if (col.format === "percent") return `${n.toFixed(1)}%`;
  return n.toFixed(3);
}

function ruleMatches(rule: ConditionalRule, row: ScheduleRow, col: ScheduleColumn): boolean {
  const target = rule.column === "*" ? col.key : rule.column;
  const v = row.values[target];
  const s = String(v ?? "").toLowerCase();
  const exp = String(rule.value ?? "").toLowerCase();
  const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : parseFloat(String(v ?? ""));
  const en = parseFloat(String(rule.value ?? ""));
  switch (rule.op) {
    case "eq": return s === exp;
    case "neq": return s !== exp;
    case "contains": return s.includes(exp);
    case "gt": return Number.isFinite(n) && Number.isFinite(en) && n > en;
    case "gte": return Number.isFinite(n) && Number.isFinite(en) && n >= en;
    case "lt": return Number.isFinite(n) && Number.isFinite(en) && n < en;
    case "lte": return Number.isFinite(n) && Number.isFinite(en) && n <= en;
    case "empty": return v == null || v === "";
    case "notempty": return v != null && v !== "";
    default: return false;
  }
}

function cellStyle(row: ScheduleRow, col: ScheduleColumn): { bg: string; fg: string } {
  const rules = currentDefinition.conditionalFormatting ?? [];
  for (const r of rules) {
    const applies =
      r.column === "*" ||
      r.column === col.key ||
      (r.wholeRow && ruleMatches(r, row, col));
    if (applies && ruleMatches(r, row, col)) {
      return { bg: r.bg ?? "transparent", fg: r.fg ?? "inherit" };
    }
  }
  return { bg: "", fg: "" };
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Table rendering
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderTable(): void {
  tableWrap.innerHTML = "";

  if (currentDiff) {
    renderDiffView();
    return;
  }

  if (!currentRun) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.style.cssText =
      "padding:40px;text-align:center;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)";
    empty.textContent = "No schedule generated yet — press Run.";
    tableWrap.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }

  const cols = currentDefinition.columns.filter((c) => visibleColumns.has(c.key));
  if (!cols.length) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.style.cssText =
      "padding:40px;text-align:center;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)";
    empty.textContent = "All columns hidden.";
    tableWrap.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }

  const table = document.createElement("table");
  table.style.cssText =
    "width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:12px system-ui;background:var(--bg-base,#0b0d12)";

  const thead = document.createElement("thead");
  thead.style.cssText = "position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2";
  const headRow = document.createElement("tr");
  headRow.style.cssText = "background:var(--bg-surface,#12141b)";

  for (const col of cols) {
    const th = document.createElement("th");
    th.style.cssText =
      "padding:8px 10px;text-align:left;font-weight:600;font-size:11px;" +
      "color:var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;" +
      "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;" +
      `width:${col.width ?? 120}px`;
    const arrow = sortKey === col.key ? (sortDir === 1 ? " ▲" : " ▼") : "";
    const fn = col.format === "formula" ? " ƒ" : "";
    th.textContent = col.header + (col.unit ? ` (${col.unit})` : "") + fn + arrow;
    if (col.help) th.title = col.help;
    th.onclick = () => {
      if (sortKey === col.key) sortDir = sortDir === 1 ? -1 : 1;
      else {
        sortKey = col.key;
        sortDir = 1;
      }
      renderTable();
    };
    headRow.appendChild(th);
  }
  thead.appendChild(headRow);
  table.appendChild(thead);

  const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
  let dataRows = 0;
  for (const r of currentRun.rows) {
    const isSubtotal = !!r.subtotal;
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    tr.style.cssText =
      "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029);cursor:pointer";
    if (isSubtotal) {
      tr.style.background = "rgba(56,189,248,.06)";
      tr.style.fontWeight = "600";
    }
    tr.onmouseenter = () => {
      if (!isSubtotal) tr.style.background = "var(--bg-hover,#232633)";
    };
    tr.onmouseleave = () => {
      tr.style.background = isSubtotal ? "rgba(56,189,248,.06)" : "";
    };
    tr.onclick = () => void selectLinked(r);

    for (let i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
      const col = cols[i];
      const td = document.createElement("td");
      const isNum = col.format !== "text" && col.format !== "date";
      const padLeft = i === 0 ? 10 + (r.depth ?? 0) * 16 : 10;
      td.style.cssText =
        `padding:6px 10px 6px ${padLeft}px;font-size:12px;` +
        (isNum ? "text-align:right;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace);" : "");

      let value: any;
      if (isSubtotal && r.subtotalValues && col.key in r.subtotalValues) {
        value = r.subtotalValues[col.key];
      } else if (isSubtotal && col.key in r.values) {
        value = r.values[col.key];
      } else {
        value = r.values[col.key] ?? null;
      }

      td.textContent = formatCell(col, value);

      if (!isSubtotal) {
        const style = cellStyle(r, col);
        if (style.bg) td.style.background = style.bg;
        if (style.fg) td.style.color = style.fg;
      } else if (i === 0) {
        td.style.color = "var(--accent,#38bdf8)";
      }

      tr.appendChild(td);
    }
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
    if (!isSubtotal) dataRows++;
  }
  table.appendChild(tbody);

  if (currentDefinition.showTotals !== false && currentRun.totals) {
    const tfoot = document.createElement("tfoot");
    tfoot.style.cssText =
      "position:sticky;bottom:0;background:var(--bg-surface,#12141b);" +
      "border-top:2px solid var(--border-strong,#3d4250)";
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    for (let i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
      const col = cols[i];
      const td = document.createElement("td");
      td.style.cssText = "padding:8px 10px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;";
      if (i === 0) {
        td.textContent = `Grand total (${dataRows} rows)`;
        td.style.color = "var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0)";
      } else if (col.format !== "text" && col.format !== "date") {
        const t = currentRun.totals[col.key];
        td.textContent = t != null ? formatCell(col, t) : "";
        td.style.textAlign = "right";
        td.style.fontFamily = "var(--font-mono,monospace)";
        td.style.color = "var(--accent,#38bdf8)";
      }
      tr.appendChild(td);
    }
    tfoot.appendChild(tr);
    table.appendChild(tfoot);
  }

  tableWrap.appendChild(table);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Diff view
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderDiffView(): void {
  if (!currentDiff) return;
  const diff = currentDiff;

  const banner = document.createElement("div");
  banner.style.cssText =
    "padding:10px 14px;background:var(--bg-surface,#12141b);" +
    "border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);" +
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:12px";
  banner.innerHTML =
    `<b>Diff against "${diff.snapshotLabel}"</b> ` +
    `<span style="opacity:.6">(${new Date(diff.snapshotAt).toLocaleString()})</span>` +
    `<span style="margin-left:auto;opacity:.7">${summarizeDiff(diff)}</span>`;

  const back = document.createElement("button");
  back.textContent = "← Back to table";
  back.style.cssText =
    "padding:4px 10px;background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);color:var(--text-primary,#e8eaf0);" +
    "border:1px solid var(--border-default,#2a2e3a);border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px";
  back.onclick = () => {
    currentDiff = null;
    renderTable();
  };
  banner.appendChild(back);

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "padding:14px";

  const section = (title: string, color: string, entries: any[], renderer: (e: any) => HTMLElement) => {
    const s = document.createElement("div");
    s.style.cssText = "margin-bottom:16px";
    const h = document.createElement("div");
    h.textContent = `${title} (${entries.length})`;
    h.style.cssText =
      `font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:${color};margin-bottom:6px;` +
      "padding-bottom:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle,#1e2029)";
    s.appendChild(h);
    if (!entries.length) {
      const empty = document.createElement("div");
      empty.textContent = "None.";
      empty.style.cssText = "font-size:11px;opacity:.6";
      s.appendChild(empty);
      return s;
    }
    for (const e of entries.slice(0, 100)) s.appendChild(renderer(e));
    return s;
  };

  container.appendChild(
    section("Added", "#22c55e", diff.added, (e) => {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.cssText =
        "padding:6px 8px;background:rgba(34,197,94,.08);border-left:3px solid #22c55e;" +
        "border-radius:4px;margin:3px 0;font-size:11px";
      row.textContent = `${e.rowId} — ${describeValues(e.values)}`;
      return row;
    }),
  );

  container.appendChild(
    section("Removed", "#ef4444", diff.removed, (e) => {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.cssText =
        "padding:6px 8px;background:rgba(239,68,68,.08);border-left:3px solid #ef4444;" +
        "border-radius:4px;margin:3px 0;font-size:11px";
      row.textContent = `${e.rowId} — ${describeValues(e.values)}`;
      return row;
    }),
  );

  container.appendChild(
    section("Changed", "#f59e0b", diff.changed, (e) => {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.cssText =
        "padding:6px 8px;background:rgba(245,158,11,.08);border-left:3px solid #f59e0b;" +
        "border-radius:4px;margin:3px 0;font-size:11px";
      const lines = (e.changedColumns ?? []).slice(0, 8).map(
        (c: any) =>
          `<div style="opacity:.85;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace)">` +
          `${c.key}: <s style="opacity:.6">${String(c.before ?? "—")}</s> → <b>${String(c.after ?? "—")}</b></div>`,
      );
      row.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:600">${e.rowId}</div>` + lines.join("");
      return row;
    }),
  );

  tableWrap.appendChild(banner);
  tableWrap.appendChild(container);
}

function describeValues(values: Record<string, any>): string {
  const keys = Object.keys(values).slice(0, 3);
  return keys.map((k) => `${k}=${values[k]}`).join(" · ") || "(no values)";
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Regenerate
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
async function regenerate(): Promise<void> {
  if (running) return;
  running = true;
  loading.style.display = "flex";
  loadingBarInner.style.width = "0%";
  cancelHandle = { cancelled: false };

  try {
    clearIfcScheduleCache();
    const run = await runSchedule(currentDefinition, {
      signal: cancelHandle,
      onProgress: (p) => {
        loadingText.textContent = p.phase;
        loadingBarInner.style.width = `${Math.min(95, (p.current / Math.max(1, p.total)) * 100)}%`;
      },
    });
    if (cancelHandle.cancelled) return;
    currentRun = run;
    sortKey = currentDefinition.sortBy ?? null;
    sortDir = 1;
    currentDiff = null;
    renderTable();
    renderFooter();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[schedule] failed", err);
    alert("Schedule generation failed — see console.");
  } finally {
    running = false;
    loading.style.display = "none";
    cancelHandle = null;
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Snapshot / diff
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function takeSnapshotNow(): void {
  if (!currentRun) {
    alert("Run the schedule first.");
    return;
  }
  const label = prompt("Snapshot label:", `Run ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`);
  if (label == null) return;
  takeSnapshot(currentRun, label);
  alert(`Snapshot saved with ${currentRun.rows.length} rows.`);
}

function showLatestDiff(): void {
  if (!currentRun) {
    alert("Run the schedule first.");
    return;
  }
  const snaps = listSnapshots(currentDefinition.id);
  if (!snaps.length) {
    alert("No snapshots for this schedule yet. Take one first.");
    return;
  }
  currentDiff = diffAgainstSnapshot(currentRun, snaps[0]);
  renderTable();
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Row link
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
async function selectLinked(row: ScheduleRow) {
  if (row.subtotal || !row.link) return;
  try {
    const sel = (ctx.features as any).selection;
    if (row.link.kind === "ifc" && row.link.modelId != null && row.link.localId != null) {
      if (sel?.replace) {
        sel.replace({ [row.link.modelId]: new Set([row.link.localId]) });
        await sel.applyToHighlighter?.();
      }
      try {
        const cam = await import("./camera-tools");
        await cam.fitToMap?.({ [row.link.modelId]: new Set([row.link.localId]) } as any);
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    } else if (row.link.kind === "authored" && row.link.authoredId) {
      const authoring = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
      if (authoring?.selectAllAuthored) {
        authoring.selectAllAuthored([row.link.authoredId]);
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[schedule] select failed", err);
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Footer
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderFooter(): void {
  footer.innerHTML = "";
  const info = document.createElement("span");
  info.style.cssText = "opacity:.75";
  if (currentRun) {
    const dataRows = currentRun.rows.filter((r) => !r.subtotal).length;
    info.textContent =
      `${dataRows} rows · ` +
      `${currentRun.rows.filter((r) => r.source === "authored").length} authored · ` +
      `${currentRun.rows.filter((r) => r.source === "ifc").length} IFC · ` +
      `${currentRun.rows.filter((r) => r.subtotal).length} group rows · ` +
      `generated ${new Date(currentRun.generatedAt).toLocaleTimeString()}`;
  } else {
    info.textContent = "No schedule yet";
  }
  const savedCount = listSavedSchedules().length;
  const hint = document.createElement("span");
  hint.style.cssText = "margin-left:auto;opacity:.55";
  hint.textContent =
    `${savedCount} saved · ƒ = formula · Esc to close`;
  footer.append(info, hint);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Public
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
export function toggleSchedules() {
  const visible = overlay.style.display === "flex";
  overlay.style.display = visible ? "none" : "flex";
  if (!visible) {
    visibleColumns = new Set(
      currentDefinition.columns.filter((c) => !c.hidden).map((c) => c.key),
    );
    renderHeader();
    renderControls();
    renderFooter();
    if (!currentRun) void regenerate();
    else renderTable();
  }
}

export function isSchedulesVisible(): boolean {
  return overlay.style.display === "flex";
}

export function setupSchedulesPanel() {
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  overlay.append(header, controls, stage, footer);

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && isSchedulesVisible()) {
      if (currentDiff) {
        currentDiff = null;
        renderTable();
        return;
      }
      toggleSchedules();
    }
  });

  ctx.features.schedules = {
    toggle: toggleSchedules,
    isVisible: isSchedulesVisible,
    regenerate: () => void regenerate(),
    setDefinition: (def: ScheduleDefinition) => {
      currentDefinition = def;
      visibleColumns = new Set(
        currentDefinition.columns.filter((c) => !c.hidden).map((c) => c.key),
      );
      renderHeader();
      renderControls();
      void regenerate();
    },
    getDefinition: () => currentDefinition,
    takeSnapshot: (label?: string) => currentRun ? takeSnapshot(currentRun, label) : null,
    listSnapshots: () => listSnapshots(currentDefinition.id),
    diffLatest: () => {
      if (!currentRun) return null;
      const snaps = listSnapshots(currentDefinition.id);
      if (!snaps.length) return null;
      currentDiff = diffAgainstSnapshot(currentRun, snaps[0]);
      renderTable();
      return currentDiff;
    },
    clearSnapshots: (id?: string) => {
      if (id) deleteSnapshot(id);
      else for (const s of listSnapshots(currentDefinition.id)) deleteSnapshot(s.id);
    },
    save: () => saveCurrent(),
    listSaved: () => listSavedSchedules(),
    load: (id: string) => {
      const s = getSavedSchedule(id);
      if (!s) return false;
      currentDefinition = s;
      visibleColumns = new Set(
        currentDefinition.columns.filter((c) => !c.hidden).map((c) => c.key),
      );
      void regenerate();
      renderHeader();
      return true;
    },
    deleteSaved: (id: string) => deleteSchedule(id),
    duplicateSaved: (id: string) => duplicateSchedule(id),
    buildAndSave: (spec: ScheduleSpec) => {
      const def = buildSchedule(spec);
      const stored = saveSchedule(def);
      currentDefinition = stored;
      visibleColumns = new Set(
        currentDefinition.columns.filter((c) => !c.hidden).map((c) => c.key),
      );
      void regenerate();
      renderHeader();
      return stored;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Section planes — persistence and viewpoint integration.
 *
 * Reads and writes the clipper state defensively (SDK API varies by version).
 * Section planes are saved into issue viewpoints via the BCF exporter
 * (see modules/issues/bcf.ts) and into projects via appState.sections.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { isMeasureEnabled, setMeasureEnabled } from "./measure";
import { isDrawingActive } from "./drawing";

export interface SectionPlaneState {
  location: [number, number, number];
  direction: [number, number, number];
}

let enabled = false;
let checkboxEl: any = null;

export function setSectionCheckboxRef(el: any) {
  checkboxEl = el;
}
export function isSectionOn() {
  return enabled;
}

export function setSectionOn(on: boolean) {
  enabled = on;
  const el = checkboxEl ?? ctx.leftHost.querySelector("bim-checkbox[data-section]");
  if (el) el.checked = on;
}

export function toggleSection() {
  const next = !enabled;
  setSectionOn(next);
  if (next) setMeasureEnabled(false);
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Read current planes
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function getSectionPlanes(): SectionPlaneState[] {
  const out: SectionPlaneState[] = [];
  try {
    const list = (ctx.clipper as any)?.list;
    if (!list) return out;
    const iterable: any = list[Symbol.iterator] ? list : null;
    if (!iterable) return out;
    for (const entry of iterable) {
      const item = Array.isArray(entry) ? entry[1] : entry;
      const plane: THREE.Plane = item?.three ?? item?.plane ?? item;
      if (!plane?.normal || typeof plane.constant !== "number") continue;
      const n = plane.normal.clone().normalize();
      const loc = n.clone().multiplyScalar(-plane.constant);
      out.push({
        location: [loc.x, loc.y, loc.z],
        direction: [n.x, n.y, n.z],
      });
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[section] getSectionPlanes failed", e);
  }
  return out;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Restore planes (best-effort against SDK API drift)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function setSectionPlanes(planes: SectionPlaneState[] | undefined | null): void {
  if (!planes || !planes.length) return;
  const clipper: any = ctx.clipper;
  if (!clipper) return;

  try {
    if (typeof clipper.deleteAll === "function") clipper.deleteAll();
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // Attempt API 1: createFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint
  const tryCreateFromNormal = (): boolean => {
    if (typeof clipper.createFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint !== "function") return false;
    try {
      for (const p of planes) {
        const n = new THREE.Vector3(p.direction[0], p.direction[1], p.direction[2]);
        const loc = new THREE.Vector3(p.location[0], p.location[1], p.location[2]);
        clipper.createFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(ctx.world, n, loc);
      }
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  };

  // Attempt API 2: create(world) then adjust item's plane
  const tryCreateInteractive = (): boolean => {
    if (typeof clipper.create !== "function") return false;
    try {
      for (const p of planes) {
        const item: any = clipper.create(ctx.world);
        const plane: THREE.Plane | undefined =
          item?.three?.plane ?? item?.plane ?? item?.three;
        if (plane?.normal) {
          plane.normal.set(p.direction[0], p.direction[1], p.direction[2]);
          plane.constant = -new THREE.Vector3(
            p.location[0],
            p.location[1],
            p.location[2],
          ).dot(plane.normal);
        }
      }
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  };

  if (!tryCreateFromNormal()) {
    if (!tryCreateInteractive()) {
      console.warn(
        "[section] could not restore planes — SDK exposes neither createFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint nor create",
      );
    }
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Setup
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function setupSection() {
  ctx.rightHost.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
    if (isDrawingActive() || isMeasureEnabled() || !enabled) return;
    try {
      ctx.clipper.create(ctx.world);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[section] create failed", e);
    }
  });
  ctx.features.section = {
    isEnabled: isSectionOn,
    toggle: toggleSection,
    getPlanes: getSectionPlanes,
    setPlanes: setSectionPlanes,
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * While section cut arrow is hovered/dragged, suppress click-to-select
 * and LMB window/crossing select.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { whenNavigationBlocked } from "./navigation";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let installed = false;

function locked(): boolean {
  return !!(window as Any).__OBS_SECTION_ARROW_LOCK || !!(window as Any).__OBS_SECTION_ARROW_HOVER;
}

export function setupSectionArrowSelectBlock(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  try {
    whenNavigationBlocked(() => locked());
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // Capture on viewport: kill LMB select / box-select while locked
  const host = () => (ctx as Any).rightHost as HTMLElement | undefined;

  const stopIfLocked = (e: Event) => {
    if (!locked()) return;
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
  };

  const attach = () => {
    const h = host();
    if (!h) {
      window.setTimeout(attach, 500);
      return;
    }
    // Bubble-block: selection often listens on host
    h.addEventListener("click", stopIfLocked, true);
    h.addEventListener("dblclick", (e) => {
      // Allow section dblclick only when section enabled AND not on arrow
      if (locked()) {
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    }, true);
  };
  attach();

  console.log("[section-arrow-select-block] select/window-select blocked while arrow active");
}
```
