```ts
// Revit-style live Section Box with 6-face crop and reset.
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { getSceneBox } from "./camera-tools";
import { registerCommand } from "./command-palette";

let box: THREE.Box3 | null = null;
let helper: THREE.Box3Helper | null = null;
let enabled = false;

function clipper(): any { return (ctx as any).clipper; }

export function isSectionBoxActive(): boolean { return enabled; }

export function toggleSectionBox(): boolean {
  if (enabled) disableSectionBox(); else enableSectionBox();
  return enabled;
}

export function enableSectionBox(padding = 1.0): void {
  if (enabled) return;
  const scene = getSceneBox();
  if (!scene || scene.isEmpty()) {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
      detail: { message: "Load a model first.", kind: "warn" },
    }));
    return;
  }
  box = scene.clone().expandByScalar(padding);
  buildHelper();
  applyClipping();
  enabled = true;
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
    detail: { message: "Section Box ON - drag to crop", kind: "success" },
  }));
}

export function disableSectionBox(): void {
  if (!enabled) return;
  try { clipper()?.deleteAll?.(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  if (helper) {
    ctx.world.scene.three.remove(helper);
    try { helper.geometry?.dispose?.(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    const mat = helper.material as THREE.Material | THREE.Material[] | undefined;
    if (Array.isArray(mat)) mat.forEach((m) => m.dispose?.());
    else mat?.dispose?.();
    helper = null;
  }
  box = null;
  enabled = false;
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
    detail: { message: "Section Box OFF", kind: "info" },
  }));
}

export function resetSectionBox(): void {
  if (!enabled) return;
  const scene = getSceneBox();
  if (scene && !scene.isEmpty()) box = scene.clone().expandByScalar(1.0);
  if (helper && box) {
    helper.box.copy(box);
    helper.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  }
  applyClipping();
}

function buildHelper(): void {
  if (!box) return;
  helper = new THREE.Box3Helper(box, new THREE.Color(0x22d3ee));
  helper.renderOrder = 999;
  const m = helper.material as THREE.LineBasicMaterial;
  if (m) m.depthTest = false;
  ctx.world.scene.three.add(helper);
}

function applyClipping(): void {
  if (!box) return;
  const c = clipper();
  if (!c) return;
  try {
    c.deleteAll?.();
    const min = box.min;
    const max = box.max;
    const planes = [
      new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0), max.x),
      new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3( 1, 0, 0), -min.x),
      new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0), max.y),
      new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0,  1, 0), -min.y),
      new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1), max.z),
      new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0,  1), -min.z),
    ];
    for (const p of planes) c.create?.(p);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[section-box] clipping failed", err);
  }
}

export function setupSectionBox(): void {
  (ctx.features as any).sectionBox = {
    enable: enableSectionBox,
    disable: disableSectionBox,
    toggle: toggleSectionBox,
    reset: resetSectionBox,
    isActive: isSectionBoxActive,
    getBox: () => box ? box.clone() : null,
    setBox: (b: THREE.Box3) => {
      box = b.clone();
      if (helper) helper.box.copy(box);
      applyClipping();
    },
  };

  try {
    registerCommand({
      id: "view.sectionBox",
      label: "View: Section Box (on/off)",
      category: "View",
      run: () => toggleSectionBox(),
    });
    registerCommand({
      id: "view.sectionBox.reset",
      label: "View: Reset Section Box",
      category: "View",
      run: () => resetSectionBox(),
      when: () => isSectionBoxActive(),
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[section-box] command registration failed", err);
  }

  console.log("[section-box] ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Section cut interaction
 *
 * Double-click a model face -> section plane PARALLEL to that face.
 * Uses ThatOpen OBC.Raycasters (same path as selection) so IFC/fragment
 * geometry is detected correctly without BufferAttribute crashes.
 *
 * Hover cut arrow -> only arrow move; orbit/select blocked.
 * Press-drag arrow -> move plane; release -> stop.
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import * as OBC from "@thatopen/components";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { forceResumeCameraControls } from "../core/camera-gate";
import { whenNavigationBlocked } from "./navigation";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let installed = false;
let dragging = false;
let hoverArrow = false;
let dragPlane: Any | null = null;
let dragPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
let pointerId: number | null = null;
let unblockNav: (() => void) | null = null;

function toast(msg: string): void {
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
        detail: { kind: "info", message: msg, timeout: 1600 },
      }),
    );
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

function hostEl(): HTMLElement | null {
  try {
    return (ctx as Any).rightHost as HTMLElement;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function camera(): THREE.Camera | null {
  try {
    return (ctx as Any).world?.camera?.three as THREE.Camera;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function isSectionEnabled(): boolean {
  try {
    return !!(ctx.features as Any)?.section?.isEnabled?.();
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function releaseEverything(e?: PointerEvent | null): void {
  dragging = false;
  dragPlane = null;
  pointerId = null;
  try {
    forceResumeCameraControls();
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  const host = hostEl();
  if (host) {
    host.style.cursor = hoverArrow ? "grab" : "";
    if (e) {
      try {
        host.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    }
  }
  try {
    const target = host ?? document.body;
    target.dispatchEvent(
      new PointerEvent("pointerup", {
        bubbles: true,
        cancelable: true,
        pointerId: e?.pointerId ?? 1,
        clientX: e?.clientX ?? 0,
        clientY: e?.clientY ?? 0,
        button: 0,
        buttons: 0,
      }),
    );
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

/* -- Face pick via OBC Raycasters + safe mesh fallback --------------------- */

interface FaceHit {
  point: THREE.Vector3;
  normal: THREE.Vector3;
}

function viewFacingNormal(): THREE.Vector3 {
  const n = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);
  const cam = camera();
  if (cam) {
    cam.getWorldDirection(n);
    n.negate();
  }
  if (n.lengthSq() < 1e-10) n.set(0, 0, 1);
  return n.normalize();
}

function normalFromRayResult(r: Any, point: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector3 {
  // ThatOpen / three ray results expose normal in several shapes
  const candidates = [
    r?.normal,
    r?.faceNormal,
    r?.face?.normal,
    r?.hitNormal,
    r?.worldNormal,
  ];
  for (const c of candidates) {
    if (!c) continue;
    if (c.isVector3 || (typeof c.x === "number" && typeof c.y === "number")) {
      const n = new THREE.Vector3(c.x, c.y, c.z);
      if (n.lengthSq() > 1e-10) return n.normalize();
    }
    if (Array.isArray(c) && c.length >= 3) {
      const n = new THREE.Vector3(c[0], c[1], c[2]);
      if (n.lengthSq() > 1e-10) return n.normalize();
    }
  }

  // Fragment mesh may include object + face index - try face normal transform
  try {
    const face = r?.face;
    const obj = r?.object ?? r?.mesh;
    if (face?.normal && obj?.matrixWorld) {
      const n = face.normal.clone();
      const nm = new THREE.Matrix3().getNormalMatrix(obj.matrixWorld);
      n.applyMatrix3(nm).normalize();
      if (n.lengthSq() > 1e-10) return n;
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // Approximate: from camera to point (plane faces camera) - last resort
  void point;
  return viewFacingNormal();
}

async function pickFaceOBC(): Promise<FaceHit | null> {
  try {
    const components = (ctx as Any).components;
    if (!components?.get) return null;
    const raycasters = components.get(OBC.Raycasters);
    const caster = raycasters?.get?.((ctx as Any).world);
    if (!caster?.castRay) return null;

    const r: Any = await caster.castRay();
    if (!r) return null;

    // World hit point
    let point: THREE.Vector3 | null = null;
    if (r.point?.isVector3) point = r.point.clone();
    else if (r.point && typeof r.point.x === "number") {
      point = new THREE.Vector3(r.point.x, r.point.y, r.point.z);
    } else if (Array.isArray(r.point) && r.point.length >= 3) {
      point = new THREE.Vector3(r.point[0], r.point[1], r.point[2]);
    } else if (r.position?.isVector3) point = r.position.clone();

    if (!point) return null;

    const normal = normalFromRayResult(r, point);
    return { point, normal };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[section-cut] OBC castRay failed", err);
    return null;
  }
}

function isSafeMesh(obj: Any): boolean {
  try {
    if (!obj?.isMesh) return false;
    if (obj.userData?.isSectionHelper || obj.userData?.isClipperHelper) return false;
    const name = String(obj.name || "");
    if (/clip|gizmo|helper|axis|arrow|section|grid/i.test(name)) return false;
    const pos = obj.geometry?.attributes?.position;
    if (!pos?.array || pos.count < 3) return false;
    try {
      const x = pos.getX(0);
      if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return false;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function pickFaceMesh(clientX: number, clientY: number): FaceHit | null {
  try {
    const cam = camera();
    const host = hostEl();
    const scene = (ctx as Any).world?.scene?.three as THREE.Scene | undefined;
    if (!cam || !host || !scene) return null;

    const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width < 1 || rect.height < 1) return null;
    const ndc = new THREE.Vector2(
      ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
      -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1,
    );
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, cam);

    const targets: THREE.Object3D[] = [];
    scene.traverse((o) => {
      if (isSafeMesh(o as Any)) targets.push(o);
    });

    let hits: THREE.Intersection[] = [];
    try {
      hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(targets, false);
    } catch {
      for (const mesh of targets) {
        try {
          hits.push(...raycaster.intersectObject(mesh, false));
        } catch {
          /* */
        }
      }
      hits.sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance);
    }

    if (!hits.length) return null;
    const h = hits[0];
    const normal = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (h.face?.normal) {
      normal.copy(h.face.normal);
      try {
        const nm = new THREE.Matrix3().getNormalMatrix(h.object.matrixWorld);
        normal.applyMatrix3(nm).normalize();
      } catch {
        normal.normalize();
      }
    } else {
      normal.copy(viewFacingNormal());
    }
    return { point: h.point.clone(), normal };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function pickModelFace(clientX: number, clientY: number): Promise<FaceHit | null> {
  // 1) ThatOpen fragment raycaster - primary for IFC models
  const obc = await pickFaceOBC();
  if (obc) return obc;

  // 2) Safe THREE mesh raycast - authored solids
  const mesh = pickFaceMesh(clientX, clientY);
  if (mesh) return mesh;

  return null;
}

/* -- Clipper create / move ------------------------------------------------- */

function createPlaneAt(point: THREE.Vector3, normal: THREE.Vector3): void {
  const clipper: Any = (ctx as Any).clipper;
  if (!clipper) {
    toast("Clipper not ready");
    return;
  }
  const n = normal.clone().normalize();
  const p = point.clone();

  try {
    if (typeof clipper.createFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint === "function") {
      clipper.createFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(ctx.world, n, p);
      return;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[section-cut] createFromNormal failed", e);
  }

  try {
    const item = clipper.create?.(ctx.world);
    const plane: THREE.Plane | undefined =
      item?.three?.plane ?? item?.plane ?? item?.three;
    if (plane?.normal) {
      plane.normal.copy(n);
      plane.constant = -p.dot(n);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[section-cut] create failed", e);
  }
}

function getPlaneFromItem(item: Any): THREE.Plane | null {
  try {
    const p = item?.three?.plane ?? item?.plane ?? (item?.three?.isPlane ? item.three : null);
    if (p?.normal && typeof p.constant === "number") return p as THREE.Plane;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return null;
}

function collectClipperHelpers(): Array<{ item: Any; objects: THREE.Object3D[] }> {
  const out: Array<{ item: Any; objects: THREE.Object3D[] }> = [];
  try {
    const list = (ctx as Any).clipper?.list;
    if (!list) return out;
    const entries: Any[] = list[Symbol.iterator] ? [...list] : Object.values(list);
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const item = Array.isArray(entry) ? entry[1] : entry;
      if (!item) continue;
      const objects: THREE.Object3D[] = [];
      const push = (o: Any) => {
        if (o?.isObject3D) objects.push(o as THREE.Object3D);
        if (o?.object?.isObject3D) objects.push(o.object as THREE.Object3D);
      };
      for (const key of ["helper", "arrow", "mesh", "object", "three", "root", "group", "controls"]) {
        push(item[key]);
      }
      for (const o of objects) {
        o.traverse((ch) => {
          (ch as Any).userData = (ch as Any).userData || {};
          (ch as Any).userData.isClipperHelper = true;
        });
      }
      if (objects.length) out.push({ item, objects });
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return out;
}

function pickClipperHandle(
  clientX: number,
  clientY: number,
): { item: Any; point: THREE.Vector3 } | null {
  try {
    const cam = camera();
    const host = hostEl();
    if (!cam || !host) return null;
    const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    const ndc = new THREE.Vector2(
      ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
      -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1,
    );
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, cam);
    for (const g of collectClipperHelpers()) {
      try {
        const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(g.objects, true);
        if (hits.length && hits[0].point) {
          return { item: g.item, point: hits[0].point.clone() };
        }
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return null;
}

function movePlaneAlongNormal(item: Any, clientX: number, clientY: number): void {
  const plane = getPlaneFromItem(item);
  const cam = camera();
  if (!plane || !cam) return;
  const host = hostEl();
  if (!host) return;
  const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
  const ndc = new THREE.Vector2(
    ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
    -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1,
  );
  const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
  raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, cam);
  const n = plane.normal.clone().normalize();
  const camDir = new THREE.Vector3();
  cam.getWorldDirection(camDir);
  const viewPlane = new THREE.Plane().setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(
    camDir.clone().negate(),
    dragPoint,
  );
  const hit = new THREE.Vector3();
  if (!raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(viewPlane, hit)) return;
  const dist = hit.clone().sub(dragPoint).dot(n);
  plane.constant -= dist;
  dragPoint.addScaledVector(n, dist);
  try {
    if (item.helper?.position) item.helper.position.addScaledVector(n, dist);
    if (typeof item.update === "function") item.update();
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

/* -- Hover lock ------------------------------------------------------------ */

function isArrowMode(): boolean {
  return hoverArrow || dragging;
}

/** Block select / window-select / box / authoring while arrow is live. */
function installGlobalMouseLock(): void {
  // Bubble-phase blockers on host: after our capture handlers run,
  // prevent selection / window-select from seeing click & LMB drag.
  // Do NOT use window capture stopImmediate on pointer* or our arrow drag breaks.
  const killSelectGestures = (e: Event) => {
    if (!isArrowMode()) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  };

  const attach = () => {
    const host = hostEl();
    if (!host) {
      window.setTimeout(attach, 400);
      return;
    }
    // These fire in bubble after our capture handlers - kill select/box-select
    host.addEventListener("click", killSelectGestures, false);
    host.addEventListener("dblclick", killSelectGestures, false);
    host.addEventListener("contextmenu", killSelectGestures, true);
    host.addEventListener("wheel", killSelectGestures, true);

    // Mark pointerdown so box-select can check the flag
    host.addEventListener(
      "pointerdown",
      () => {
        if (isArrowMode()) {
          (window as Any).__OBS_BLOCK_BOX_SELECT = true;
          (window as Any).__OBS_BLOCK_SELECT = true;
        }
      },
      true,
    );
  };
  attach();
}

function setArrowHover(on: boolean): void {
  if (hoverArrow === on) return;
  hoverArrow = on;
  const host = hostEl();
  if (on) {
    try {
      if (!unblockNav) unblockNav = whenNavigationBlocked(() => true);
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    try {
      const c = (ctx as Any).world?.camera?.controls;
      if (c) c.enabled = false;
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    if (host) {
      host.style.cursor = "grab";
      host.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
    }
    // Flags consumed by selection / box-select / navigation guards
    (window as Any).__OBS_SECTION_ARROW_HOVER = true;
    (window as Any).__OBS_SECTION_ARROW_LOCK = true;
    (window as Any).__OBS_BLOCK_SELECT = true;
    (window as Any).__OBS_BLOCK_BOX_SELECT = true;
  } else if (!dragging) {
    try {
      unblockNav?.();
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    unblockNav = null;
    try {
      forceResumeCameraControls();
      const c = (ctx as Any).world?.camera?.controls;
      if (c) c.enabled = true;
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
    if (host) host.style.cursor = "";
    (window as Any).__OBS_SECTION_ARROW_HOVER = false;
    (window as Any).__OBS_SECTION_ARROW_LOCK = false;
    (window as Any).__OBS_BLOCK_SELECT = false;
    (window as Any).__OBS_BLOCK_BOX_SELECT = false;
  }
}

/* -- Events ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

async function onDblClick(e: MouseEvent): Promise<void> {
  if (!isSectionEnabled()) return;
  try {
    if ((ctx.features as Any)?.drawing?.isActive?.()) return;
    if ((ctx.features as Any)?.measure?.isEnabled?.()) return;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();

  const face = await pickModelFace(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  if (!face) {
    toast("No model face under cursor");
    releaseEverything(e as unknown as PointerEvent);
    return;
  }

  // Parallel to the detected element face
  createPlaneAt(face.point, face.normal);

  window.setTimeout(() => releaseEverything(e as unknown as PointerEvent), 0);
  window.setTimeout(() => releaseEverything(null), 40);
  window.setTimeout(() => releaseEverything(null), 120);

  toast("Section parallel to face");
}

function onPointerMove(e: PointerEvent): void {
  if (!isSectionEnabled()) {
    if (hoverArrow) setArrowHover(false);
    return;
  }
  if (dragging && dragPlane) {
    if (pointerId != null && e.pointerId !== pointerId) return;
    movePlaneAlongNormal(dragPlane, e.clientX, e.clientY);
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    return;
  }
  const handle = pickClipperHandle(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  setArrowHover(!!handle);
}

function onPointerDown(e: PointerEvent): void {
  if (!isSectionEnabled()) return;
  if (e.button !== 0) return;
  const handle = pickClipperHandle(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  if (!handle) return;
  setArrowHover(true);
  dragging = true;
  (window as Any).__OBS_SECTION_ARROW_LOCK = true;
  (window as Any).__OBS_BLOCK_SELECT = true;
  (window as Any).__OBS_BLOCK_BOX_SELECT = true;
  dragPlane = handle.item;
  dragPoint.copy(handle.point);
  pointerId = e.pointerId;
  try {
    hostEl()?.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  const host = hostEl();
  if (host) host.style.cursor = "grabbing";
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();
  e.stopImmediatePropagation();
}

function onPointerUp(e: PointerEvent): void {
  if (!dragging) return;
  if (pointerId != null && e.pointerId !== pointerId) return;
  releaseEverything(e);
  setArrowHover(!!pickClipperHandle(e.clientX, e.clientY));
}

export function setupSectionCutInteraction(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  const host = hostEl();
  if (!host) {
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      installed = false;
      setupSectionCutInteraction();
    }, 800);
    return;
  }

  host.addEventListener(
    "dblclick",
    (e) => {
      void onDblClick(e);
    },
    true,
  );
  host.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown, true);
  window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, true);
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", onPointerUp, true);
  window.addEventListener("pointercancel", onPointerUp, true);

  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      if (dragging) releaseEverything(null);
      setArrowHover(false);
    }
  });

  try {
    void import("../core/input-router").then((mod: Any) => {
      // Priority 200 - above gizmo(100), box-select(50), selection/authoring
      mod.inputRouter?.subscribe?.((g: Any) => {
        if (!hoverArrow && !dragging) return false;
        // Claim EVERY gesture so select / window-select / pan / orbit cannot run
        return true;
      }, 200);
    });
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  installGlobalMouseLock();

  // Also block selection feature if it exposes a gate
  try {
    const sel = (ctx.features as Any)?.selection;
    if (sel && typeof sel.setSuspended !== "function") {
      (window as Any).__obsSelectionSuspended = () => isArrowMode();
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  (window as Any).__obsSectionCut = {
    release: () => releaseEverything(null),
    createAt: createPlaneAt,
    pickFace: pickModelFace,
  };

  console.log(
    "[section-cut-interaction] OBC face pick + parallel cut; hover arrow = move only",
  );
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Unified select-all.
 *
 * The Fragment selection manager handles model elements; authored elements
 * are tracked separately in authoring.ts. This module selects both in one
 * call so a user pressing Ctrl+A (or clicking the ribbon button) gets
 * everything visible — model elements from every loaded model AND every
 * natively drawn element.
 */
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { selection } from "./selection";
import { getElements, selectAllAuthored } from "./authoring";

export interface SelectAllResult {
  fragments: number;
  authored: number;
  models: number;
}

export async function selectAllObjects(): Promise<SelectAllResult> {
  let fragments = 0;
  let models = 0;

  // ── 1. Every element in every loaded fragments model ──
  try {
    await selection.selectAll();
    fragments = selection.size();
    models = selection.modelCount();
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[select-all] fragments failed", err);
  }

  // ── 2. Every authored element ──
  let authored = 0;
  try {
    const ids = getElements().map((e) => e.id);
    selectAllAuthored(ids);
    authored = ids.length;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[select-all] authored failed", err);
  }

  return { fragments, authored, models };
}

/** Clear both selection systems in one call. */
export async function clearAllSelection(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    selection.clear();
    await selection.applyToHighlighter();
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  try {
    selectAllAuthored([]);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

/**
 * Select only the authored elements (all of them). Handy for cost takeoff
 * workflows where you want to see only what was drawn in-app.
 */
export function selectAllAuthoredOnly(): number {
  const ids = getElements().map((e) => e.id);
  selectAllAuthored(ids);
  return ids.length;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Central selection manager.
 *
 * Multi-select across models (Ctrl add, Shift toggle, Alt remove).
 * Two-way bridge to the OBC highlighter (source of truth for rendering).
 * Named selection sets, persisted in localStorage.
 * Click-to-select for fragments wired via setupClickToSelect().
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import * as OBC from "@thatopen/components";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { register, tryUse, type SelectionService } from "../core/services";

export interface SelectionSnapshot {
  [modelId: string]: Set<number>;
}

export interface SelectionSet {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  createdAt: number;
  updatedAt: number;
  snapshot: Record<string, number[]>;
}

const SETS_KEY = "obs.selection-sets.v1";

class SelectionManager {
  private map: SelectionSnapshot = {};
  private listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  private filter: Set<string> | null = null;
  private highlightStyle = "select";

  onChange(cb: () => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(cb);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(cb);
  }
  private emit() {
    for (const cb of this.listeners) {
      try { cb(); } catch { /* */ }
    }
  }

  // ── Read ──
  snapshot(): SelectionSnapshot {
    const out: SelectionSnapshot = {};
    for (const [m, s] of Object.entries(this.map)) {
      if (s.size) out[m] = new Set(s);
    }
    return out;
  }
  isEmpty(): boolean {
    for (const s of Object.values(this.map)) if (s.size) return false;
    return true;
  }
  size(): number {
    let n = 0;
    for (const s of Object.values(this.map)) n += s.size;
    return n;
  }
  has(modelId: string, localId: number): boolean {
    return !!this.map[modelId]?.has(localId);
  }
  modelCount(): number {
    return Object.keys(this.map).filter((m) => (this.map[m]?.size ?? 0) > 0).length;
  }

  // ── Mutate ──
  add(modelId: string, localId: number): void {
    if (!this.map[modelId]) this.map[modelId] = new Set();
    this.map[modelId].add(localId);
    this.emit();
  }
  addMany(modelId: string, ids: Iterable<number>): void {
    if (!this.map[modelId]) this.map[modelId] = new Set();
    for (const id of ids) this.map[modelId].add(id);
    this.emit();
  }
  remove(modelId: string, localId: number): void {
    this.map[modelId]?.delete(localId);
    if (this.map[modelId]?.size === 0) delete this.map[modelId];
    this.emit();
  }
  removeMany(modelId: string, ids: Iterable<number>): void {
    const s = this.map[modelId];
    if (!s) return;
    for (const id of ids) s.delete(id);
    if (s.size === 0) delete this.map[modelId];
    this.emit();
  }
  toggle(modelId: string, localId: number): void {
    if (this.has(modelId, localId)) this.remove(modelId, localId);
    else this.add(modelId, localId);
  }
  replace(snap: SelectionSnapshot): void {
    this.map = {};
    for (const [m, s] of Object.entries(snap)) {
      if (s.size) this.map[m] = new Set(s);
    }
    this.emit();
  }
  clear(): void {
    this.map = {};
    this.emit();
  }

  applyClick(
    modelId: string,
    localId: number,
    mods: { ctrl?: boolean; shift?: boolean; alt?: boolean },
  ): void {
    // Revit-style selection modifiers:
    //   plain click  = replace
    //   Ctrl/Cmd     = add
    //   Shift        = remove
    //   Alt          = remove (kept as a useful accessibility/legacy alias)
    if (mods.alt || mods.shift) {
      this.remove(modelId, localId);
    } else if (mods.ctrl) {
      this.add(modelId, localId);
    } else {
      this.replace({ [modelId]: new Set([localId]) });
    }
  }

  // ── Filter ──
  setFilter(categories: string[] | null): void {
    this.filter = categories && categories.length ? new Set(categories) : null;
    this.emit();
  }
  getFilter(): string[] | null {
    return this.filter ? [...this.filter] : null;
  }
  hasFilter(): boolean {
    return this.filter != null && this.filter.size > 0;
  }

  // ── Bulk operations ──
  async selectAll(): Promise<void> {
    this.map = {};
    for (const [modelId, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
      try {
        const ids = (await (model as any).getItemsIdsWithGeometry()) as number[];
        if (!ids?.length) continue;
        if (this.filter) {
          const cats = await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
          const keep = new Set<number>();
          for (const [cat, list] of Object.entries(cats ?? {})) {
            if (this.filter.has(cat)) for (const id of (list as number[]) || []) keep.add(id);
          }
          if (keep.size) this.map[modelId] = keep;
        } else {
          this.map[modelId] = new Set(ids);
        }
      } catch { /* */ }
    }
    this.emit();
    await this.applyToHighlighter();
  }

  async selectSimilar(modelId: string, localId: number): Promise<void> {
    const model = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
    if (!model) return;
    try {
      const cats = await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
      let cat: string | null = null;
      for (const [c, list] of Object.entries(cats ?? {})) {
        if (((list as number[]) || []).includes(localId)) { cat = c; break; }
      }
      if (!cat) return;
      const ids = ((cats as any)[cat] as number[]) || [];
      const merged: SelectionSnapshot = this.snapshot();
      if (!merged[modelId]) merged[modelId] = new Set();
      for (const id of ids) merged[modelId].add(id);
      this.replace(merged);
      await this.applyToHighlighter();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[selection] selectSimilar failed", e);
    }
  }

  async invert(): Promise<void> {
    for (const [modelId, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
      try {
        const all = (await (model as any).getItemsIdsWithGeometry()) as number[];
        if (!all?.length) continue;
        const cur = this.map[modelId] ?? new Set<number>();
        const inv = new Set<number>();
        for (const id of all) if (!cur.has(id)) inv.add(id);
        if (inv.size) this.map[modelId] = inv;
        else delete this.map[modelId];
      } catch { /* */ }
    }
    this.emit();
    await this.applyToHighlighter();
  }

  // ── Rendering bridge ──
  async applyToHighlighter(style = this.highlightStyle): Promise<void> {
    try { await (ctx.highlighter as any).clear(style); } catch { /* */ }
    if (this.isEmpty()) return;
    const map: OBC.ModelIdMap = {};
    for (const [m, s] of Object.entries(this.map)) {
      if (s.size) map[m] = new Set(s);
    }
    try {
      await (ctx.highlighter as any).highlightByID(style, map, true);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[selection] highlighter", e);
    }
  }

  adoptFromHighlighter(): void {
    const hl = ctx.highlighter as any;
    const candidates: any[] = [hl?.selection, hl?.styles, hl];
    const snap: SelectionSnapshot = {};
    const isNumericSet = (v: any): v is Set<number> => {
      if (!(v instanceof Set) || !v.size) return false;
      for (const x of v) if (typeof x !== "number") return false;
      return true;
    };
    const scan = (node: any, depth: number) => {
      if (!node || depth > 4) return;
      if (node instanceof Map) {
        for (const [k, v] of node) {
          if (isNumericSet(v)) {
            if (!snap[String(k)]) snap[String(k)] = new Set();
            for (const id of v) snap[String(k)]!.add(id);
          } else scan(v, depth + 1);
        }
        return;
      }
      if (Array.isArray(node)) {
        for (const v of node) scan(v, depth + 1);
        return;
      }
      if (typeof node !== "object") return;
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(node)) {
        if (isNumericSet(v)) {
          if (!snap[k]) snap[k] = new Set();
          for (const id of v) snap[k]!.add(id);
        } else if (v && typeof v === "object") {
          scan(v, depth + 1);
        }
      }
    };
    for (const c of candidates) scan(c, 0);
    if (Object.keys(snap).length) this.replace(snap);
  }

  // ── Selection sets ──
  listSets(): SelectionSet[] {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(SETS_KEY);
      if (!raw) return [];
      const arr = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
    } catch { return []; }
  }
  private persistSets(list: SelectionSet[]) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(SETS_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)); } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[selection] set save failed", e);
    }
  }
  saveSet(name: string): SelectionSet {
    const snap: Record<string, number[]> = {};
    for (const [m, s] of Object.entries(this.map)) snap[m] = [...s];
    const set: SelectionSet = {
      id: (crypto as any).randomUUID?.() ?? `ss-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
      name: name.trim() || "Set",
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
      snapshot: snap,
    };
    const list = this.listSets();
    list.unshift(set);
    this.persistSets(list);
    this.emit();
    return set;
  }
  async loadSet(id: string): Promise<void> {
    const set = this.listSets().find((s) => s.id === id);
    if (!set) return;
    const snap: SelectionSnapshot = {};
    for (const [m, arr] of Object.entries(set.snapshot)) snap[m] = new Set(arr);
    this.replace(snap);
    await this.applyToHighlighter();
  }
  deleteSet(id: string): void {
    this.persistSets(this.listSets().filter((s) => s.id !== id));
    this.emit();
  }

  async focus(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.isEmpty()) return;
    try {
      const mod = await import("./camera-tools");
      const map: any = {};
      for (const [m, s] of Object.entries(this.map)) map[m] = s;
      await mod.fitToMap(map);
    } catch { /* */ }
  }

  async boundingBox(): Promise<THREE.Box3 | null> {
    const box = new THREE.Box3();
    let any = false;
    for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(this.map)) {
      const model: any = ctx.fragments.list.get(modelId);
      if (!model || !ids.size) continue;
      try {
        const boxes: THREE.Box3[] = await model.getBoxes([...ids]);
        const mw = model.object.matrixWorld?.clone?.() ?? new THREE.Matrix4();
        for (const b of boxes ?? []) {
          if (!b || b.isEmpty()) continue;
          const w = b.clone().applyMatrix4(mw);
          box.union(w);
          any = true;
        }
      } catch { /* */ }
    }
    return any ? box : null;
  }
}


export const selection = new SelectionManager();

/** Typed service registration (Week 3). */
{
  const svc: SelectionService = {
    snapshot: () => selection.snapshot(),
    size: () => selection.size(),
    modelCount: () => selection.modelCount(),
    isEmpty: () => selection.isEmpty(),
    replace: (m) => selection.replace(m),
    clear: () => selection.clear(),
    addMany: (m, ids) => selection.addMany(m, ids),
    removeMany: (m, ids) => selection.removeMany(m, ids),
    selectAll: () => selection.selectAll(),
    invert: () => selection.invert(),
    selectSimilar: (m, id) => selection.selectSimilar(m, id),
    applyClick: (m, id, mods) => selection.applyClick(m, id, mods),
    adoptFromHighlighter: () => selection.adoptFromHighlighter(),
    applyToHighlighter: () => selection.applyToHighlighter(),
    focus: () => selection.focus(),
    boundingBox: () => selection.boundingBox(),
    saveSet: (n) => selection.saveSet(n),
    listSets: () => selection.listSets(),
    loadSet: (id) => selection.loadSet(id),
    onChange: (cb) => selection.onChange(cb),
  };
  register("selection", svc);
}


/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Click-to-select wiring for fragments
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let clickToSelectInstalled = false;
let highlighterSyncInstalled = false;
let hoverPending = false;
let hoveredMap: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};

function anyBlockingToolActive(): boolean {
  try {
    if ((tryUse("authoring") as any)?.isActive?.()) return true;
    if ((ctx.features as any).drawing?.isActive?.()) return true;
    if ((ctx.features as any).measure?.isEnabled?.()) return true;
    if ((ctx.features as any).section?.isEnabled?.()) return true;
    if ((ctx.features as any).walkMode?.isEnabled?.()) return true;
    return false;
  } catch { return false; }
}

function normalizeRaycastResult(r: any): { modelId: string; localId: number } | null {
  if (!r) return null;
  const localCandidate = r.localId ?? r.localIds?.[0] ?? r.fragments?.localId ?? r.fragments?.localIds?.[0] ?? r.itemId;
  const localId = typeof localCandidate === "number" ? localCandidate : Number(localCandidate);
  const model = r.model ?? r.fragment?.model ?? r.fragments?.model ?? r.fragments?.[0]?.model;
  let modelId: string | null =
    typeof r.modelId === "string" ? r.modelId :
    typeof r.fragments?.modelId === "string" ? r.fragments.modelId :
    typeof r.fragments?.[0]?.modelId === "string" ? r.fragments[0].modelId :
    typeof model?.modelId === "string" ? model.modelId :
    typeof model?.id === "string" ? model.id : null;
  if (modelId == null && model) {
    for (const [id, m] of ctx.fragments.list as any) {
      if (m === model || (m as any)?.object === model || (model as any)?.model === m) { modelId = id; break; }
    }
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(localId) || modelId == null || !ctx.fragments.list.has(modelId)) return null;
  return { modelId, localId };
}

function clearAuthoredSelection(): void {
  try {
    const authoring: any = tryUse("authoring") as any;
    authoring?.setSelectedAuthored?.([], "replace");
  } catch { /* optional authoring bridge */ }
}

function clearFragmentSelection(): void {
  try {
    selection.replace({});
    void selection.applyToHighlighter();
  } catch { /* */ }
}

export async function pickFragmentAtPointer(): Promise<{ modelId: string; localId: number } | null> {
  try {
    const caster: any = ctx.components.get(OBC.Raycasters).get(ctx.world);
    return normalizeRaycastResult(await caster.castRay());
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[selection] fragment raycast failed", err);
    return null;
  }
}

async function clearHover(): Promise<void> {
  if (!ctx.highlighter) return;
  try { await (ctx.highlighter as any).clear("preselect"); } catch { /* */ }
  hoveredMap = {};
}

async function updateHover(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): Promise<void> {
  if (hoverPending) return;
  hoverPending = true;
  try {
    const caster: any = ctx.components.get(OBC.Raycasters).get(ctx.world);
    const r: any = await caster.castRay();
    const localId = r?.localId ?? r?.localIds?.[0] ?? r?.itemId ?? r?.id;
    const modelId = r?.modelId ?? r?.fragments?.modelId ?? r?.fragments?.[0]?.modelId ?? r?.model?.modelId ?? r?.model?.id;
    if (typeof localId !== "number" || typeof modelId !== "string" || !ctx.fragments.list.has(modelId)) {
      await clearHover();
      return;
    }
    const next = { [modelId]: new Set([localId]) };
    const same = Object.keys(hoveredMap).length === 1 && hoveredMap[modelId]?.size === 1 && hoveredMap[modelId].has(localId);
    if (same) return;
    await clearHover();
    hoveredMap = next;
    await (ctx.highlighter as any).highlightByID("preselect", next, true, false);
    void canvas;
  } catch {
    await clearHover();
  } finally {
    hoverPending = false;
  }
}

export function setupClickToSelect(): void {
  if (clickToSelectInstalled) return;
  clickToSelectInstalled = true;

  if (!highlighterSyncInstalled) {
    highlighterSyncInstalled = true;
    try {
      const selectEvents = (ctx.highlighter as any)?.events?.select;
      selectEvents?.onHighlight?.add((map: any) => {
        const snap: SelectionSnapshot = {};
        for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(map ?? {})) {
          const set = ids instanceof Set ? ids : new Set<number>(Array.isArray(ids) ? ids : []);
          if (set.size) snap[modelId] = new Set(set);
        }
        if (Object.keys(snap).length) (selection as any).replace(snap);
      });
      selectEvents?.onClear?.add((map: any) => {
        if (map && Object.keys(map).length) {
          const snap = selection.snapshot();
          for (const [modelId, ids] of Object.entries(map)) {
            const current = snap[modelId];
            if (!current) continue;
            for (const id of ids as Set<number>) current.delete(id);
            if (!current.size) delete snap[modelId];
          }
          (selection as any).replace(snap);
        }
      });
    } catch { /* event bridge is optional */ }
  }

  const canvasForHover = (ctx.world.renderer.three as THREE.WebGLRenderer)?.domElement as HTMLCanvasElement | null;
  if (canvasForHover) {
    canvasForHover.addEventListener("pointermove", () => { void updateHover(canvasForHover); }, { passive: true });
    canvasForHover.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { void clearHover(); }, { passive: true });
  }

  let downPos: { x: number; y: number; target: EventTarget | null } | null = null;

  ctx.rightHost.addEventListener(
    "mousedown",
    (e) => {
      if (e.button !== 0) return;
      downPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, target: e.target };
    },
    true,
  );

  ctx.rightHost.addEventListener(
    "pointerup",
    async (e) => {
      const d = downPos;
      downPos = null;
      if (e.button !== 0 || !d) return;

      // Ctrl+LeftClick is multi-selection in both 3D and Floor Plan.
      // box-selection.ts only commits when the pointer actually drags, so a
      // stationary Ctrl click reaches this handler and adds the element.

      // The click must have started on the raw canvas, not on a floating panel.
      const canvas = (ctx.world.renderer.three as THREE.WebGLRenderer)?.domElement;
      if (!canvas || d.target !== canvas) return;

      // Reject drags and gizmo drags.
      const moved = Math.hypot(e.clientX - d.x, e.clientY - d.y);
      if (moved > 4) return;
      if ((ctx.features as any).gizmo?.isDragging?.()) return;
      if (anyBlockingToolActive()) return;

      const hit = await pickFragmentAtPointer();

      // If the authored-element handler already owns this click, do not let
      // the fragment selector clear that selection.
      if (!hit) {
        try {
          const authoring: any = tryUse("authoring") as any;
          const authoredHit = authoring?.pickAuthoredElementAt?.(e as MouseEvent);
          if (authoredHit) return;
        } catch { /* optional authoring bridge */ }

        // Empty click — clear unless a modifier is held.
        await clearHover();
        if (!e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.shiftKey && !e.altKey) {
          selection.replace({});
          await selection.applyToHighlighter();
          clearAuthoredSelection();
        }
        return;
      }

      await clearHover();
      // A 3D viewport has one selection set: selecting a linked/fragment
      // element clears any authored selection, just like Revit.
      clearAuthoredSelection();
      selection.applyClick(hit.modelId, hit.localId, {
        ctrl: e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey,
        shift: e.shiftKey,
        alt: e.altKey,
      });
      await selection.applyToHighlighter();
    },
    true,
  );

  console.log("[selection] click-to-select installed");
}

/** Programmatic pick — returns the element under the last cursor position. */
export async function pickUnderCursor(): Promise<{ modelId: string; localId: number } | null> {
  return pickFragmentAtPointer();
}
```

```ts
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

/*
 * Thin selection-orbit helper.
 *
 * IMPORTANT: this module intentionally does NOT register any input-router
 * gesture handler and does NOT listen to middle-mouse or wheel. The canonical
 * Revit navigation in src/features/navigation.ts is the SOLE owner of:
 *   MMB drag = pan, Shift/Ctrl+MMB = orbit, Wheel = zoom-to-cursor.
 *
 * Duplicating those here was the cause of "view rotates / zooms out on MMB
 * release": two handlers fought over the same gesture and the losing one
 * applied a stale orbit/recenter when the gesture ended.
 *
 * All this file does now: after a LEFT-click selection settles, re-center the
 * orbit pivot on the current selection (the documented "focus on select"
 * behaviour), using camera-tools helpers via the global context. No MMB, no
 * wheel, no drag.
 */

let installed = false;

function camTools(): Any {
  const c = ctx as Any;
  return (c.cam as Any) ?? (window as Any).__OBS_CAMERA_TOOLS ?? {};
}

// Debounce so rapid left-clicks through a coordination model do not queue
// dozens of overlapping Fragments worker round-trips (getElementWorldBoxes
// is async and slow on large models).
let pendingPivot: number | null = null;

function schedulePivotOnSelection(): void {
  if (pendingPivot !== null) {
    window.clearTimeout(pendingPivot);
  }
  pendingPivot = window.setTimeout(() => {
    pendingPivot = null;
    pivotOnSelectionSafe();
  }, 40);
}

function pivotOnSelectionSafe(): void {
  try {
    const t = camTools();
    if (typeof t.pivotOnSelection === "function") {
      void t.pivotOnSelection();
    }
  } catch {
    /* camera-tools not ready yet; ignore */
  }
}

function setPivotSafe(point: Any): void {
  try {
    const t = camTools();
    if (typeof t.setOrbitPivot === "function") {
      t.setOrbitPivot(point);
    }
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

export function setupSelectionOrbit(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  // LEFT click only -> recenter orbit pivot on the resulting selection.
  const onClick = (e: MouseEvent): void => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;            // never react to MMB / RMB
    const tgt = e.target as Any;
    if (tgt && typeof tgt.closest === "function" &&
        tgt.closest('button, input, select, textarea, [contenteditable="true"], .obs-ribbon, .obs-panel, .obs-property, .obs-dialog, .obs-adv-toolbar')) {
      return;                              // ignore UI chrome clicks
    }
    // let the highlighter / selection commit first, then recenter
    schedulePivotOnSelection();
  };

  window.addEventListener("click", onClick, true);

  // Explicit focus requests from other modules (e.g. "Zoom to Selection").
  window.addEventListener("obs:focus-selection", () => pivotOnSelectionSafe());
  window.addEventListener("obs:selection-changed", () => {
    // soft recenter only when something is actually selected
    window.setTimeout(pivotOnSelectionSafe, 60);
  });

  (window as Any).__obsSelectionOrbit = {
    enabled: true,
    setPivot: setPivotSafe,
    pivotOnSelection: pivotOnSelectionSafe,
  };

  console.log(
    "[selection-orbit] thin mode active: pivot-on-left-click only; " +
    "MMB pan/orbit and wheel zoom are owned exclusively by navigation.ts",
  );
}

// Compatibility aliases (in case any importer used a different entry name).
export function installSelectionOrbit(): void { setupSelectionOrbit(); }
export function setupOrbit(): void { setupSelectionOrbit(); }
export function enableSelectionOrbit(): void { /* no-op, always on */ }
export function disableSelectionOrbit(): void { /* no-op */ }
export function isSelectionOrbitEnabled(): boolean { return true; }
```

```ts
/**
 * Selection orbit pivot + Ortho zoom fix
 *
 * When elements are selected, camera orbit / pan / zoom revolve around the
 * selection center of gravity (bounding-box center). Matches Revit:
 *   - With selection: rotate, pan, zoom about selection COG
 *   - Without selection: existing target / cursor zoom
 *   - Orthographic: zoom via camera.zoom (works); orbit still about pivot
 *
 * Shortcuts:
 *   VO / O          Toggle orthographic <-> perspective
 *   + / =           Zoom in  (toward selection COG if any)
 *   - / _           Zoom out
 *   ZO / ZS         Zoom to selection (fit box)
 *   Ctrl+Shift+O    Toggle ortho
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

let installed = false;
let lastPivot = new THREE.Vector3();
let hasPivot = false;
let selectionListener: (() => void) | null = null;

function toast(kind: string, msg: string): void {
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("obs-toast", { detail: { kind, message: msg, timeout: 1600 } }),
    );
  } catch {
    console.log(`[sel-pivot] ${msg}`);
  }
}

function worldReady(): boolean {
  try {
    return !!(ctx as Any).world?.camera?.three;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** Compute center of gravity of current selection (authored + fragments). */
export async function computeSelectionCOG(): Promise<THREE.Vector3 | null> {
  const box = new THREE.Box3();
  let any = false;

  // 1) Fragment selection (IFC models)
  try {
    const sel = (ctx.features as Any)?.selection ?? (await import("./selection")).selection;
    if (sel?.boundingBox) {
      const b: THREE.Box3 | null = await sel.boundingBox();
      if (b && !b.isEmpty()) {
        box.union(b);
        any = true;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // 2) Authored elements selection
  try {
    const a = (ctx.features as Any)?.authoring;
    const ids: string[] =
      a?.getSelectedIds?.() ??
      a?.selectedIds ??
      (a?.getSelection?.() ?? []).map((e: Any) => e?.id).filter(Boolean) ??
      [];
    const elements =
      a?.getElements?.() ??
      a?.elements ??
      (ctx as Any).authoring?.elements ??
      [];
    const byId = new Map<string, Any>();
    if (Array.isArray(elements)) {
      for (const el of elements) if (el?.id) byId.set(el.id, el);
    } else if (elements && typeof elements === "object") {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(elements)) byId.set(k, v as Any);
    }

    for (const id of ids) {
      const el = byId.get(id);
      if (!el) continue;
      // Prefer mesh bounds
      const mesh = el.mesh ?? el.object3d ?? el.object;
      if (mesh && mesh.isObject3D) {
        const b = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(mesh as THREE.Object3D);
        if (!b.isEmpty()) {
          box.union(b);
          any = true;
          continue;
        }
      }
      // Fallback: placement origin
      const p = el.params ?? el;
      const x = Number(p.x ?? p.origin?.x ?? el.position?.x);
      const y = Number(p.y ?? p.origin?.y ?? el.position?.y);
      const z = Number(p.z ?? p.origin?.z ?? el.position?.z);
      if ([x, y, z].every(Number.isFinite)) {
        box.expandByPoint(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z));
        any = true;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // 3) THREE scene objects marked selected
  try {
    const scene = (ctx as Any).world?.scene?.three as THREE.Scene | undefined;
    if (scene) {
      scene.traverse((o: Any) => {
        if (o.userData?.selected || o.userData?.obsSelected) {
          const b = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(o as THREE.Object3D);
          if (!b.isEmpty()) {
            box.union(b);
            any = true;
          }
        }
      });
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  if (!any || box.isEmpty()) return null;
  return box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
}

export async function computeSelectionBox(): Promise<THREE.Box3 | null> {
  const cog = await computeSelectionCOG();
  if (!cog) return null;
  // Rebuild box for fit - reuse similar logic simplified via COG expansion
  const box = new THREE.Box3();
  try {
    const sel = (ctx.features as Any)?.selection;
    if (sel?.boundingBox) {
      const b = await sel.boundingBox();
      if (b && !b.isEmpty()) box.union(b);
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  try {
    const a = (ctx.features as Any)?.authoring;
    const ids: string[] = a?.getSelectedIds?.() ?? [];
    for (const id of ids) {
      const el = a?.getElement?.(id) ?? a?.elements?.find?.((e: Any) => e.id === id);
      const mesh = el?.mesh ?? el?.object3d;
      if (mesh) {
        const b = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(mesh as THREE.Object3D);
        if (!b.isEmpty()) box.union(b);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  if (box.isEmpty()) {
    box.setFromCenterAndSize(cog, new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1));
  }
  return box;
}

/** Apply orbit pivot to CameraControls + navigation target. */
export function applyOrbitPivot(point: THREE.Vector3): void {
  if (!worldReady() || !point || !Number.isFinite(point.x)) return;
  lastPivot.copy(point);
  hasPivot = true;

  try {
    const tools = (ctx.features as Any)?.cameraTools;
    if (typeof tools?.setOrbitPivot === "function") {
      tools.setOrbitPivot(point);
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // Direct controls write (always)
  try {
    const controls: Any = (ctx as Any).world?.camera?.controls;
    const cam = (ctx as Any).world?.camera?.three as THREE.Camera;
    if (controls) {
      if (controls.target?.isVector3) {
        controls.target.set(point.x, point.y, point.z);
      }
      if (typeof controls.setTarget === "function") {
        controls.setTarget(point.x, point.y, point.z, false);
      }
      if (typeof controls.setLookAt === "function" && cam) {
        const p = (cam as Any).position;
        controls.setLookAt(p.x, p.y, p.z, point.x, point.y, point.z, false);
        try {
          controls.update?.(0);
        } catch {
          /* */
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // Expose for navigation.ts Ctrl-orbit and wheel consumers
  try {
    (window as Any).__OBS_ORBIT_PIVOT = point.clone();
    (window as Any).__OBS_HAS_SELECTION_PIVOT = true;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

export function clearOrbitPivotFlag(): void {
  hasPivot = false;
  try {
    (window as Any).__OBS_HAS_SELECTION_PIVOT = false;
    (window as Any).__OBS_ORBIT_PIVOT = null;
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

export async function syncPivotFromSelection(): Promise<boolean> {
  const cog = await computeSelectionCOG();
  if (!cog) {
    clearOrbitPivotFlag();
    return false;
  }
  applyOrbitPivot(cog);
  return true;
}

/* -- Zoom toward selection COG ------------------------------------------- */

export function zoomTowardSelection(factor: number): void {
  if (!worldReady()) return;
  const focus =
    hasPivot && lastPivot
      ? lastPivot.clone()
      : ((window as Any).__OBS_ORBIT_PIVOT as THREE.Vector3 | null) ?? null;

  try {
    // Prefer camera-tools zoomBy (handles ortho.zoom correctly)
    const tools = requireCameraTools();
    if (tools?.zoomBy) {
      tools.zoomBy(factor, focus ?? undefined);
      return;
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // Fallback manual
  const cam: Any = (ctx as Any).world.camera.three;
  const controls: Any = (ctx as Any).world.camera.controls;
  const target = new THREE.Vector3();
  if (focus) target.copy(focus);
  else if (controls?.target?.isVector3) target.copy(controls.target);
  else {
    const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
    cam.getWorldDirection(dir);
    target.copy(cam.position).addScaledVector(dir, 10);
  }

  if (cam.isOrthographicCamera) {
    const oldZ = Math.max(1e-3, cam.zoom || 1);
    // factor > 1 => zoom in (closer) => higher ortho.zoom
    cam.zoom = Math.max(0.01, Math.min(5000, oldZ * factor));
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  } else {
    const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(cam.position, target);
    const dist = dir.length();
    if (dist < 1e-6) return;
    const newDist = Math.max(1e-4, dist / factor);
    dir.normalize().multiplyScalar(newDist);
    const np = target.clone().add(dir);
    try {
      controls?.setLookAt?.(np.x, np.y, np.z, target.x, target.y, target.z, false);
      controls?.update?.(0);
    } catch {
      cam.position.copy(np);
      cam.lookAt(target);
    }
  }
  try {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs:camera-changed"));
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

function requireCameraTools(): Any | null {
  try {
    return (ctx.features as Any)?.cameraTools ?? null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function zoomToSelection(): Promise<void> {
  const box = await computeSelectionBox();
  if (!box || box.isEmpty()) {
    toast("info", "Nothing selected to zoom to");
    return;
  }
  const tools = requireCameraTools();
  if (tools?.focusOnBox) {
    tools.focusOnBox(box);
  } else if (tools?.fitAll) {
    // fallback: center on COG
    const c = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
    applyOrbitPivot(c);
    tools.centerOnPoint?.(c);
  }
  applyOrbitPivot(box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()));
  toast("success", "Zoomed to selection");
}

/* -- Orthographic toggle (fixed) ----------------------------------------- */

export function isOrthographic(): boolean {
  if (!worldReady()) return false;
  const cam: Any = (ctx as Any).world.camera.three;
  if (cam?.isOrthographicCamera) return true;
  try {
    const tools = requireCameraTools();
    if (tools?.getProjection) return tools.getProjection() === "orthographic";
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
  return false;
}

export function setOrthographic(on: boolean): boolean {
  if (!worldReady()) return false;
  const tools = requireCameraTools();
  const mode = on ? "orthographic" : "perspective";

  // 1) Prefer camera-tools API
  if (tools?.setProjection) {
    const ok = tools.setProjection(mode);
    if (ok) {
      // Keep pivot after switch
      if (hasPivot) applyOrbitPivot(lastPivot);
      ensureOrthoFrustum();
      toast("info", on ? "Orthographic view" : "Perspective view");
      return true;
    }
  }

  // 2) ThatOpen / fragments camera setCameraType
  try {
    const camApi: Any = (ctx as Any).world.camera;
    if (typeof camApi.setCameraType === "function") {
      camApi.setCameraType(on ? "Plan" : "Orbit");
      if (hasPivot) applyOrbitPivot(lastPivot);
      ensureOrthoFrustum();
      toast("info", on ? "Orthographic view" : "Perspective view");
      return true;
    }
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  toast("warn", "Could not switch projection on this camera API");
  return false;
}

export function toggleOrthographic(): boolean {
  return setOrthographic(!isOrthographic());
}

function ensureOrthoFrustum(): void {
  try {
    const cam: Any = (ctx as Any).world.camera.three;
    if (!cam?.isOrthographicCamera) return;
    const host = (ctx as Any).rightHost as HTMLElement | undefined;
    let aspect = 1;
    if (host) {
      const r = host.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.width > 0 && r.height > 0) aspect = r.width / r.height;
    }
    // Do not reset zoom - only fix near/far and frustum if degenerate
    if (!(cam.right > cam.left) || !(cam.top > cam.bottom)) {
      const halfH = 20;
      cam.left = -halfH * aspect;
      cam.right = halfH * aspect;
      cam.top = halfH;
      cam.bottom = -halfH;
    }
    cam.near = -1e6;
    cam.far = 1e6;
    if (!Number.isFinite(cam.zoom) || cam.zoom <= 0) cam.zoom = 1;
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  } catch {
    /* */
  }
}

/* -- Wire selection change -> pivot -------------------------------------- */

function onSelectionMaybeChanged(): void {
  void syncPivotFromSelection();
}

function installSelectionListeners(): void {
  // Fragment selection events
  try {
    window.addEventListener("obs:selection-changed", onSelectionMaybeChanged);
    window.addEventListener("obs:authoring-selection-changed", onSelectionMaybeChanged);
    window.addEventListener("obs:authoring-changed", onSelectionMaybeChanged);
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  // Poll lightly as backup (some selection paths miss events)
  let lastSize = -1;
  selectionListener = () => {
    try {
      const sel = (ctx.features as Any)?.selection;
      const a = (ctx.features as Any)?.authoring;
      const size =
        (sel?.size?.() ?? 0) +
        (a?.getSelectedIds?.()?.length ?? a?.selectedIds?.length ?? 0);
      if (size !== lastSize) {
        lastSize = size;
        onSelectionMaybeChanged();
      }
    } catch {
      /* */
    }
  };
  window.setInterval(selectionListener, 400);
}

/* -- Wheel: prefer selection pivot when present -------------------------- */

function installWheelPivotHook(): void {
  // When selection pivot is active, nudge wheel-arbiter zoom to use it by
  // temporarily setting controls target before zoom (arbiter reads target).
  window.addEventListener(
    "wheel",
    (e) => {
      if (!hasPivot) return;
      if ((window as Any).__OBS_MMB_HELD) return;
      try {
        const controls: Any = (ctx as Any).world?.camera?.controls;
        if (controls?.target?.isVector3) {
          controls.target.copy(lastPivot);
        }
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    },
    { capture: true, passive: true },
  );
}

/* -- Keyboard ------------------------------------------------------------ */

function installKeys(): void {
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (t?.closest?.("input,textarea,[contenteditable],select")) return;

    const key = e.key;
    // Zoom in / out
    if (key === "+" || key === "=") {
      e.preventDefault();
      zoomTowardSelection(e.shiftKey ? 1.35 : 1.15);
      return;
    }
    if (key === "-" || key === "_") {
      e.preventDefault();
      zoomTowardSelection(e.shiftKey ? 1 / 1.35 : 1 / 1.15);
      return;
    }
    // Ctrl+Shift+O = ortho
    if (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && (key === "O" || key === "o")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleOrthographic();
      return;
    }
  });

  // Two-key chords VO, ZO via small buffer
  let buf = "";
  let bufTimer = 0;
  window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const t = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (t?.closest?.("input,textarea,[contenteditable],select")) return;
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
    if (e.key.length !== 1) return;
    buf += e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (buf.length > 2) buf = buf.slice(-2);
    window.clearTimeout(bufTimer);
    bufTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      buf = "";
    }, 600);
    if (buf === "vo" || buf === "op") {
      e.preventDefault();
      buf = "";
      toggleOrthographic();
    } else if (buf === "zo" || buf === "zs") {
      e.preventDefault();
      buf = "";
      void zoomToSelection();
    }
  });
}

export function setupSelectionOrbitPivot(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  installSelectionListeners();
  installWheelPivotHook();
  installKeys();

  // Initial sync
  window.setTimeout(() => void syncPivotFromSelection(), 800);

  (window as Any).__obsSelPivot = {
    sync: syncPivotFromSelection,
    cog: computeSelectionCOG,
    zoomIn: () => zoomTowardSelection(1.2),
    zoomOut: () => zoomTowardSelection(1 / 1.2),
    zoomToSelection,
    toggleOrtho: toggleOrthographic,
    setOrtho: setOrthographic,
    isOrtho: isOrthographic,
    applyPivot: applyOrbitPivot,
  };

  // Register camera-tools on ctx if missing link
  try {
    void import("./camera-tools").then((m: Any) => {
      if (!(ctx.features as Any).cameraTools) {
        (ctx.features as Any).cameraTools = m;
      }
    });
  } catch {
    /* */
  }

  console.log(
    "[selection-orbit-pivot] ready - orbit/zoom about selection COG; VO=ortho; +/-=zoom; ZO=zoom selection",
  );
}
```
