--- FILE: src/features/sheets-2d-panel.ts ---
```ts
/**
 * Sheets 2D panel â€” renders sheets with live viewport content.
 *
 * Composes:
 *   - the sheets store (list/create/delete sheets, add/remove viewports)
 *   - the views store (list ViewDefs)
 *   - the view generators (plan / section / elevation)
 *   - the SVG renderer + annotation layer
 *
 * Viewports are drag-moveable and clip their content to the viewport rect.
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import {
  listSheets, getSheet, createSheet, deleteSheet, updateSheet,
  addViewport, removeViewport, onSheetsChange, getSheetSizeMm,
  ensureDefaultTitleblock,
} from "../modules/sheets/sheets";
import { listViews, getView } from "../modules/views/store";
import { generatePlanScene } from "../modules/views/generators/plan";
import { generateSectionScene } from "../modules/views/generators/section";
import { generateElevationScene } from "../modules/views/generators/elevation";
import { renderSceneToSvg } from "../modules/views/renderers/svg";
import { buildAnnotationLayer } from "../modules/views/annotation-layer";
import { emptyScene, type Scene2D } from "../modules/views/scene";
import { computeViewportTransform } from "../modules/views/sheet-layout";
import { downloadSingleSheetPdf, exportAllSheetsToPdf } from "../modules/export/sheet-pdf";
import type { ViewDef } from "../modules/views/types";
import type { SheetDef, SheetViewport } from "../modules/projects/types";

const SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
const PANEL_ID = "obs-sheets-2d-panel";

let panel: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let sheetListEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let canvasHost: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let viewPicker: HTMLSelectElement | null = null;
let statusEl: HTMLSpanElement | null = null;
let currentSheetId: string | null = null;
let selectedVpId: string | null = null;
let visible = false;

const sceneCache = new Map<string, { scene: Scene2D; at: number }>();

interface DragState {
  vpId: string;
  startMouseX: number;
  startMouseY: number;
  startVpX: number;
  startVpY: number;
  sheetMmPerPx: number;
}
let drag: DragState | null = null;

let pendingRender = false;
function scheduleRender(): void {
  if (pendingRender) return;
  pendingRender = true;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    pendingRender = false;
    render();
  });
}

export function setupSheets2dPanel(): void {
  ensureDefaultTitleblock();

  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = PANEL_ID;
  panel.style.cssText = [
    "position:fixed",
    "left:400px",
    "top:90px",
    "right:14px",
    "bottom:40px",
    "z-index:36",
    "display:none",
    "flex-direction:column",
    "background:#1a1d27",
    "color:#e8eaf0",
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a",
    "border-radius:10px",
    "box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.55)",
    "font:12px system-ui,sans-serif",
    "overflow:hidden",
  ].join(";");
  panel.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

  const header = document.createElement("div");
  header.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;" +
    "border-bottom:1px solid #2a2e3a;background:#12141b;flex-shrink:0;flex-wrap:wrap";

  const title = document.createElement("div");
  title.textContent = "Sheets";
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:700;margin-right:8px";

  viewPicker = document.createElement("select");
  viewPicker.style.cssText =
    "padding:4px 8px;background:#0e1017;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:4px;" +
    "color:#e8eaf0;font:11px system-ui;max-width:220px";

  const addVpBtn = mkBtn("+ Viewport", () => addSelectedViewport());
  const newSheetBtn = mkBtn("+ Sheet", () => {
    const s = createSheet();
    currentSheetId = s.id;
    selectedVpId = null;
    render();
  });
  const delSheetBtn = mkBtn("Delete Sheet", () => {
    if (!currentSheetId) return;
    const s = getSheet(currentSheetId);
    if (!s) return;
    if (confirm("Delete sheet \"" + s.number + " - " + s.name + "\"?")) {
      deleteSheet(currentSheetId);
      currentSheetId = null;
      selectedVpId = null;
      render();
    }
  });
  const delVpBtn = mkBtn("Delete Viewport", () => {
    if (!currentSheetId || !selectedVpId) return;
    removeViewport(currentSheetId, selectedVpId);
    selectedVpId = null;
    render();
  });
  const exportBtn = mkBtn("Export SVG", () => exportSheet());

  const pdfBtn = mkBtn("Export PDF", () => {
    if (!currentSheetId) { alert("No sheet selected."); return; }
    void downloadSingleSheetPdf(currentSheetId).catch((err) => {
      console.error("[sheets-2d] PDF export failed", err);
      alert("PDF export failed: " + (err && err.message ? err.message : err));
    });
  });

  const pdfAllBtn = mkBtn("PDF All", () => {
    const sheets = listSheets();
    if (!sheets.length) { alert("No sheets to export."); return; }
    void exportAllSheetsToPdf(sheets, "open-bim-studio-sheets.pdf").catch((err) => {
      console.error("[sheets-2d] batch PDF failed", err);
      alert("Batch PDF failed: " + (err && err.message ? err.message : err));
    });
  });




  const closeBtn = mkBtn("Close", () => toggleSheets2dPanel());

  header.append(title, viewPicker, addVpBtn, newSheetBtn, delSheetBtn, delVpBtn, exportBtn, pdfBtn, pdfAllBtn, closeBtn);

  const body = document.createElement("div");
  body.style.cssText = "flex:1;display:flex;min-height:0";

  sheetListEl = document.createElement("div");
  sheetListEl.style.cssText =
    "width:220px;flex:none;border-right:1px solid #2a2e3a;overflow-y:auto;background:#0e1017";

  canvasHost = document.createElement("div");
  canvasHost.style.cssText =
    "flex:1;overflow:auto;background:#e9ecf1;position:relative;padding:20px;box-sizing:border-box";

  body.append(sheetListEl, canvasHost);

  const footer = document.createElement("div");
  footer.style.cssText =
    "padding:6px 12px;border-top:1px solid #2a2e3a;background:#12141b;" +
    "display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:11px system-ui;color:#94a3b8;flex-shrink:0";
  statusEl = document.createElement("span");
  statusEl.style.cssText = "font:11px system-ui;color:#94a3b8";
  footer.append(
    document.createTextNode("Click a viewport to select. Drag to move."),
    statusEl,
  );

  panel.append(header, body, footer);
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);

  onSheetsChange(() => { if (visible) scheduleRender(); });

  (ctx.features as any).sheets2dPanel = {
    open: () => { visible = true; if (panel) panel.style.display = "flex"; render(); },
    close: () => { visible = false; if (panel) panel.style.display = "none"; },
    toggle: () => toggleSheets2dPanel(),
    isVisible: () => visible,
    invalidateCache: () => sceneCache.clear(),
  };
}

function mkBtn(label: string, onclick: () => void): HTMLButtonElement {
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.textContent = label;
  b.style.cssText =
    "padding:4px 9px;background:transparent;color:#cbd5e1;border:1px solid #2a2e3a;" +
    "border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font:11px system-ui";
  b.onmouseenter = () => { b.style.background = "#1e2330"; };
  b.onmouseleave = () => { b.style.background = "transparent"; };
  b.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onclick(); };
  return b;
}

function render(): void {
  if (!panel || !sheetListEl || !canvasHost || !viewPicker) return;
  const sheets = listSheets();

  // View picker options
  const views = listViews();
  const prevPickerValue = viewPicker.value;
  viewPicker.innerHTML = "";
  if (!views.length) {
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.textContent = "(no views - open the Views panel first)";
    opt.value = "";
    viewPicker.appendChild(opt);
  } else {
    for (const v of views) {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = v.id;
      opt.textContent = v.name + "  (" + v.kind + ")";
      viewPicker.appendChild(opt);
    }
    viewPicker.value = views.some((v) => v.id === prevPickerValue) ? prevPickerValue : views[0].id;
  }

  // Sheet list
  sheetListEl.innerHTML = "";
  if (!sheets.length) {
    const hint = document.createElement("div");
    hint.textContent = "No sheets. Click + Sheet.";
    hint.style.cssText = "padding:14px;color:#6b7280;font-size:11px;text-align:center";
    sheetListEl.appendChild(hint);
  } else {
    for (const s of sheets) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      const active = s.id === currentSheetId;
      row.style.cssText =
        "padding:8px 10px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid #1a1d27;" +
        (active ? "background:#16233a;color:#38bdf8;" : "color:#cbd5e1;");
      row.textContent = s.number + " - " + s.name;
      row.onclick = () => { currentSheetId = s.id; selectedVpId = null; render(); };
      sheetListEl.appendChild(row);
    }
  }
  if (!currentSheetId && sheets.length) currentSheetId = sheets[0].id;

  canvasHost.innerHTML = "";
  if (!currentSheetId) {
    const hint = document.createElement("div");
    hint.textContent = "Create or select a sheet.";
    hint.style.cssText = "padding:40px;text-align:center;color:#6b7280;font:13px system-ui";
    canvasHost.appendChild(hint);
    return;
  }
  const sheet = getSheet(currentSheetId);
  if (!sheet) return;

  void drawSheet(sheet);
}

async function drawSheet(sheet: SheetDef): Promise<void> {
  if (!canvasHost) return;
  const sizeMm = getSheetSizeMm(sheet.size, sheet.orientation);
  const sheetWmm = sizeMm.w;
  const sheetHmm = sizeMm.h;
  const hostW = canvasHost.clientWidth || 800;
  const targetWidth = Math.min(hostW - 40, sheetWmm * 0.9);
  const targetHeight = (sheetHmm / sheetWmm) * targetWidth;

  const svg = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "svg");
  svg.setAttribute("xmlns", SVG_NS);
  svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + sheetWmm + " " + sheetHmm);
  svg.setAttribute("width", String(targetWidth));
  svg.setAttribute("height", String(targetHeight));
  svg.style.cssText =
    "display:block;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;" +
    "box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.12)";

  const bg = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "rect");
  bg.setAttribute("x", "0");
  bg.setAttribute("y", "0");
  bg.setAttribute("width", String(sheetWmm));
  bg.setAttribute("height", String(sheetHmm));
  bg.setAttribute("fill", "#ffffff");
  svg.appendChild(bg);

  const border = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "rect");
  border.setAttribute("x", "6");
  border.setAttribute("y", "6");
  border.setAttribute("width", String(sheetWmm - 12));
  border.setAttribute("height", String(sheetHmm - 12));
  border.setAttribute("fill", "none");
  border.setAttribute("stroke", "#111827");
  border.setAttribute("stroke-width", "0.4");
  svg.appendChild(border);

  // Titleblock
  const tbW = Math.min(180, sheetWmm * 0.28);
  const tbH = 40;
  const tbX = sheetWmm - 6 - tbW;
  const tbY = sheetHmm - 6 - tbH;
  const tb = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "rect");
  tb.setAttribute("x", String(tbX));
  tb.setAttribute("y", String(tbY));
  tb.setAttribute("width", String(tbW));
  tb.setAttribute("height", String(tbH));
  tb.setAttribute("fill", "#f8fafc");
  tb.setAttribute("stroke", "#111827");
  tb.setAttribute("stroke-width", "0.3");
  svg.appendChild(tb);

  const addText = (x: number, y: number, text: string, size: number, weight: number, color: string) => {
    const t = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "text");
    t.setAttribute("x", String(x));
    t.setAttribute("y", String(y));
    t.setAttribute("font-family", "Arial, system-ui, sans-serif");
    t.setAttribute("font-size", String(size));
    t.setAttribute("font-weight", String(weight));
    t.setAttribute("fill", color);
    t.textContent = text;
    svg.appendChild(t);
  };
  addText(tbX + 3, tbY + 8, "Sheet: " + sheet.number, 5, 700, "#111827");
  addText(tbX + 3, tbY + 15, sheet.name, 4, 400, "#111827");
  addText(tbX + 3, tbY + 22, "Scale: as noted", 3.5, 400, "#475569");
  addText(tbX + 3, tbY + 28, "Date: " + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), 3.5, 400, "#475569");
  addText(tbX + 3, tbY + 34, "Open BIM Studio", 3, 400, "#94a3b8");

  // Draw viewports
  for (const vp of sheet.viewports) {
    const viewDef = getView(vp.viewId);
    if (!viewDef) {
      drawMissingViewport(svg, vp);
      continue;
    }
    let scene: Scene2D;
    try {
      scene = await getSceneForView(viewDef);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[sheets-2d] scene failed for", viewDef.id, err);
      scene = emptyScene();
    }
    drawViewport(svg, sheet, vp, viewDef, scene);
  }

  canvasHost.appendChild(svg);
  installDragHandler(svg, sheet, sheetWmm);

  if (statusEl) {
    statusEl.textContent =
      sheet.viewports.length + " viewport(s) - " +
      sheet.size + " " + sheet.orientation + " - " +
      sheetWmm + "x" + sheetHmm + " mm";
  }
}

function drawMissingViewport(svg: SVGSVGElement, vp: SheetViewport): void {
  const rect = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "rect");
  rect.setAttribute("x", String(vp.x));
  rect.setAttribute("y", String(vp.y));
  rect.setAttribute("width", String(vp.width));
  rect.setAttribute("height", String(vp.height));
  rect.setAttribute("fill", "#fee2e2");
  rect.setAttribute("stroke", "#ef4444");
  rect.setAttribute("stroke-width", "0.4");
  rect.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "2 1");
  svg.appendChild(rect);

  const t = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "text");
  t.setAttribute("x", String(vp.x + vp.width / 2));
  t.setAttribute("y", String(vp.y + vp.height / 2));
  t.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
  t.setAttribute("font-size", "4");
  t.setAttribute("fill", "#991b1b");
  t.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
  t.textContent = "View missing: " + vp.viewId;
  svg.appendChild(t);
}

function drawViewport(
  svg: SVGSVGElement,
  sheet: SheetDef,
  vp: SheetViewport,
  viewDef: ViewDef,
  scene: Scene2D,
): void {
  const tf = computeViewportTransform(vp, sheet, viewDef, scene);

  const clipId = "clip-" + vp.id.replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/gi, "_");
  const clipPath = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "clipPath");
  clipPath.setAttribute("id", clipId);
  const clipRect = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "rect");
  clipRect.setAttribute("x", String(tf.x));
  clipRect.setAttribute("y", String(tf.y));
  clipRect.setAttribute("width", String(tf.widthMm));
  clipRect.setAttribute("height", String(tf.heightMm));
  clipPath.appendChild(clipRect);
  svg.appendChild(clipPath);

  const inner = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "svg");
  inner.setAttribute("x", String(tf.x));
  inner.setAttribute("y", String(tf.y));
  inner.setAttribute("width", String(tf.widthMm));
  inner.setAttribute("height", String(tf.heightMm));
  inner.setAttribute(
    "viewBox",
    tf.viewBox.x + " " + tf.viewBox.y + " " + tf.viewBox.w + " " + tf.viewBox.h,
  );
  inner.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid slice");
  inner.setAttribute("clip-path", "url(#" + clipId + ")");
  inner.setAttribute("data-viewport-id", vp.id);

  const sceneSvg = renderSceneToSvg(scene, {
    scale: viewDef.scale,
    padding: 0,
    widthPx: tf.widthMm,
    heightPx: tf.heightMm,
  });
  const g = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "g");
  while (sceneSvg.firstChild) {
    g.appendChild(sceneSvg.firstChild);
  }
  inner.appendChild(g);
  svg.appendChild(inner);

  const borderRect = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "rect");
  borderRect.setAttribute("x", String(tf.x));
  borderRect.setAttribute("y", String(tf.y));
  borderRect.setAttribute("width", String(tf.widthMm));
  borderRect.setAttribute("height", String(tf.heightMm));
  borderRect.setAttribute("fill", "none");
  borderRect.setAttribute("stroke", selectedVpId === vp.id ? "#38bdf8" : "#334155");
  borderRect.setAttribute("stroke-width", selectedVpId === vp.id ? "0.8" : "0.3");
  borderRect.setAttribute("data-viewport-border", vp.id);
  svg.appendChild(borderRect);

  const label = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "text");
  label.setAttribute("x", String(tf.x + 1));
  label.setAttribute("y", String(tf.y - 1.5));
  label.setAttribute("font-size", "3.5");
  label.setAttribute("font-weight", "600");
  label.setAttribute("fill", "#334155");
  label.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
  label.textContent = (vp.title || viewDef.name) + " - " + (vp.scale || "1:" + viewDef.scale);
  svg.appendChild(label);
}

async function getSceneForView(viewDef: ViewDef): Promise<Scene2D> {
  const now = Date.now();
  const cached = sceneCache.get(viewDef.id);
  if (cached && now - cached.at < 15000) return cached.scene;

  let scene: Scene2D;
  if (viewDef.kind === "plan" || viewDef.kind === "rcp") {
    scene = await generatePlanScene(viewDef);
  } else if (viewDef.kind === "section") {
    scene = await generateSectionScene(viewDef);
  } else if (viewDef.kind === "elevation") {
    scene = await generateElevationScene(viewDef);
  } else {
    scene = emptyScene();
  }
  const ann = buildAnnotationLayer(viewDef.id, viewDef.scale);
  scene.layers.annotation = ann.entities;
  sceneCache.set(viewDef.id, { scene, at: now });
  return scene;
}

function installDragHandler(svg: SVGSVGElement, sheet: SheetDef, sheetWmm: number): void {
  svg.addEventListener("mousedown", (ev) => {
    const target = ev.target as Element;
    const directId = target.getAttribute ? target.getAttribute("data-viewport-border") : null;
    const parent = target.parentElement as Element | null;
    const innerId = parent && parent.getAttribute ? parent.getAttribute("data-viewport-id") : null;
    const vpId = directId || innerId;

    if (!vpId) {
      if (selectedVpId) { selectedVpId = null; render(); }
      return;
    }
    const vp = sheet.viewports.find((v) => v.id === vpId);
    if (!vp) return;

    if (selectedVpId !== vpId) {
      selectedVpId = vpId;
      render();
      return;
    }

    const rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const sheetMmPerPx = sheetWmm / rect.width;
    drag = {
      vpId,
      startMouseX: ev.clientX,
      startMouseY: ev.clientY,
      startVpX: vp.x,
      startVpY: vp.y,
      sheetMmPerPx,
    };
    ev.preventDefault();
  });

  window.addEventListener("mousemove", onDragMove);
  window.addEventListener("mouseup", onDragEnd);
}

function onDragMove(ev: MouseEvent): void {
  if (!drag || !currentSheetId) return;
  const sheet = getSheet(currentSheetId);
  if (!sheet) return;
  const vp = sheet.viewports.find((v) => v.id === drag!.vpId);
  if (!vp) return;
  const dx = (ev.clientX - drag.startMouseX) * drag.sheetMmPerPx;
  const dy = (ev.clientY - drag.startMouseY) * drag.sheetMmPerPx;
  vp.x = Math.round((drag.startVpX + dx) * 10) / 10;
  vp.y = Math.round((drag.startVpY + dy) * 10) / 10;
  scheduleRender();
}

function onDragEnd(): void {
  if (!drag) return;
  drag = null;
  if (currentSheetId) updateSheet(currentSheetId, {});
}

function addSelectedViewport(): void {
  if (!currentSheetId || !viewPicker) return;
  const sheet = getSheet(currentSheetId);
  if (!sheet) return;
  const viewId = viewPicker.value;
  if (!viewId) { alert("No views available. Open the Views panel first."); return; }
  const viewDef = getView(viewId);
  if (!viewDef) return;

  const sizeMm = getSheetSizeMm(sheet.size, sheet.orientation);
  const offset = sheet.viewports.length * 15;
  const vpWidth = Math.min(400, sizeMm.w * 0.5);
  const vpHeight = Math.min(280, sizeMm.h * 0.5);
  const viewType: SheetViewport["viewType"] =
    (viewDef.kind === "plan" || viewDef.kind === "rcp") ? "plan"
    : viewDef.kind === "section" ? "section"
    : viewDef.kind === "elevation" ? "elevation"
    : "3d";

  addViewport(currentSheetId, {
    viewId,
    viewType,
    x: 20 + offset,
    y: 20 + offset,
    width: vpWidth,
    height: vpHeight,
    scale: "1:" + viewDef.scale,
    title: viewDef.name,
  });
  render();
}

function exportSheet(): void {
  if (!currentSheetId || !canvasHost) return;
  const sheet = getSheet(currentSheetId);
  if (!sheet) return;
  const svgEl = canvasHost.querySelector("svg");
  if (!svgEl) { alert("Nothing to export."); return; }
  const xml = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svgEl);
  const blob = new Blob(
    ["<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n" + xml],
    { type: "image/svg+xml" },
  );
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = sheet.number.replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/gi, "_") + ".svg";
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
}

export function toggleSheets2dPanel(): void {
  visible = !visible;
  if (!panel) return;
  panel.style.display = visible ? "flex" : "none";
  if (visible) render();
}
export function isSheets2dPanelVisible(): boolean { return visible; }
export function openSheets2dPanel(): void {
  visible = true;
  if (panel) { panel.style.display = "flex"; render(); }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Sheets panel — production documentation UI.
 * Create sheets, place viewports, export SVG for print/PDF workflows.
 */
import {
  listSheets,
  createSheet,
  updateSheet,
  deleteSheet,
  addViewport,
  removeViewport,
  exportSheetSvg,
  createDefaultSheetSet,
  ensureDefaultTitleblock,
  onSheetsChange,
  getSheetSizeMm,
} from "../modules/sheets/sheets";
import type { SheetDef } from "../modules/projects/types";

let panel: HTMLElement | null = null;
let visible = false;
let activeId: string | null = null;

function esc(s: string) {
  return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);
}

function render() {
  if (!panel) return;
  const sheets = listSheets();
  const active = sheets.find((s) => s.id === activeId) ?? sheets[0] ?? null;
  if (active) activeId = active.id;

  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="obs-panel-header">
      <span>Sheets · Production</span>
      <button type="button" class="obs-icon-btn" data-act="close">×</button>
    </div>
    <div class="obs-panel-body obs-sheets">
      <div class="obs-sheets__hint">
        Professional drawing sheets with titleblocks. Place plans, export SVG for print or PDF.
        Competes with Revit / Bentley sheet production.
      </div>
      <div class="obs-sheets__toolbar">
        <button type="button" data-act="new">+ Sheet</button>
        <button type="button" data-act="defaults">Default set</button>
        <button type="button" data-act="export" ${active ? "" : "disabled"}>Export SVG</button>
      </div>
      <div class="obs-sheets__list">
        ${sheets.length === 0
          ? `<div class="obs-sheets__empty">No sheets. Create one or load the default set.</div>`
          : sheets.map((s) => `
            <div class="obs-sheets__row ${s.id === activeId ? "is-active" : ""}" data-id="${esc(s.id)}" data-act="select">
              <span class="obs-sheets__no">${esc(s.number)}</span>
              <span class="obs-sheets__name">${esc(s.name)}</span>
              <span class="obs-sheets__meta">${s.size} · ${s.viewports.length} vp</span>
              <button type="button" data-act="del" data-id="${esc(s.id)}" title="Delete">×</button>
            </div>`).join("")}
      </div>
      ${active ? renderActive(active) : ""}
    </div>
  `;

  panel.querySelectorAll("[data-act]").forEach((el) => {
    const act = (el as HTMLElement).dataset.act!;
    const id = (el as HTMLElement).dataset.id;
    el.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (act === "close") { setVisible(false); return; }
      if (act === "new") {
        const s = createSheet();
        activeId = s.id;
        render();
        return;
      }
      if (act === "defaults") { createDefaultSheetSet(); render(); return; }
      if (act === "export" && activeId) { exportSheetSvg(activeId); return; }
      if (act === "select" && id) { activeId = id; render(); return; }
      if (act === "del" && id) {
        if (confirm("Delete this sheet?")) {
          deleteSheet(id);
          if (activeId === id) activeId = null;
          render();
        }
        return;
      }
      if (act === "add-vp" && activeId) {
        const size = getSheetSizeMm(active!.size, active!.orientation);
        addViewport(activeId, {
          viewId: "plan-current",
          viewType: "plan",
          x: 20,
          y: 20,
          width: Math.min(400, size.w - 40),
          height: Math.min(280, size.h - 80),
          scale: "1:100",
          title: "Plan View",
        });
        render();
        return;
      }
      if (act === "rename" && activeId) {
        const name = prompt("Sheet name", active!.name);
        if (name != null) updateSheet(activeId, { name: name.trim() || active!.name });
        render();
        return;
      }
      if (act === "renumber" && activeId) {
        const number = prompt("Sheet number", active!.number);
        if (number != null) updateSheet(activeId, { number: number.trim() || active!.number });
        render();
        return;
      }
    });
  });
}

function renderActive(s: SheetDef) {
  return `
    <div class="obs-sheets__detail">
      <div class="obs-sheets__detail-head">
        <strong>${esc(s.number)}</strong>
        <button type="button" data-act="renumber">No.</button>
        <button type="button" data-act="rename">Name</button>
      </div>
      <div class="obs-sheets__detail-name">${esc(s.name)}</div>
      <div class="obs-sheets__detail-meta">${s.size} · ${s.orientation} · ${s.viewports.length} viewports</div>
      <button type="button" data-act="add-vp" class="obs-sheets__add-vp">+ Place plan viewport</button>
      <ul class="obs-sheets__vps">
        ${s.viewports.map((v) => `
          <li>${esc(v.title ?? v.viewType)} · ${esc(v.scale)}
            <button type="button" data-act="rm-vp" data-vpid="${esc(v.id)}">×</button>
          </li>`).join("")}
      </ul>
    </div>
  `;
}

function ensurePanel() {
  if (panel) return panel;
  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.className = "obs-side-panel obs-sheets-panel";
  panel.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;top:48px;right:12px;width:360px;max-height:calc(100vh - 80px);" +
    "background:#1e2430;color:#e2e8f0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45);z-index:8000;display:none;overflow:auto;" +
    "font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;";
  document.body.appendChild(panel);

  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.textContent = `
    .obs-sheets__hint { font-size:11px; color:#94a3b8; margin-bottom:10px; }
    .obs-sheets__toolbar { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin-bottom:10px; }
    .obs-sheets__toolbar button {
      background:#334155; border:1px solid #475569; color:#e2e8f0; border-radius:6px;
      padding:5px 10px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px;
    }
    .obs-sheets__toolbar button:hover { background:#475569; }
    .obs-sheets__toolbar button:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:default; }
    .obs-sheets__row {
      display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:6px;
      cursor:pointer; border:1px solid transparent;
    }
    .obs-sheets__row:hover { background:#0f172a; }
    .obs-sheets__row.is-active { background:#0f172a; border-color:#3b82f6; }
    .obs-sheets__no { font-weight:600; min-width:52px; color:#93c5fd; }
    .obs-sheets__name { flex:1; min-width:0; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
    .obs-sheets__meta { font-size:11px; color:#64748b; }
    .obs-sheets__empty { color:#64748b; text-align:center; padding:16px 0; font-size:12px; }
    .obs-sheets__detail {
      margin-top:12px; padding:12px; background:#0f172a; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #334155;
    }
    .obs-sheets__detail-head { display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:4px; }
    .obs-sheets__detail-head button {
      background:#1e293b; border:1px solid #334155; color:#94a3b8; border-radius:4px;
      padding:2px 6px; font-size:11px; cursor:pointer;
    }
    .obs-sheets__detail-name { font-size:14px; margin-bottom:2px; }
    .obs-sheets__detail-meta { font-size:11px; color:#64748b; margin-bottom:10px; }
    .obs-sheets__add-vp {
      width:100%; background:#1d4ed8; border:none; color:#fff; border-radius:6px;
      padding:7px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .obs-sheets__add-vp:hover { background:#2563eb; }
    .obs-sheets__vps { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; font-size:12px; }
    .obs-sheets__vps li { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 0; color:#cbd5e1; }
    .obs-panel-header {
      display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
      padding:10px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid #334155; font-weight:600;
    }
    .obs-panel-body { padding:12px; }
    .obs-icon-btn { background:none; border:none; color:#94a3b8; font-size:18px; cursor:pointer; }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
  onSheetsChange(render);
  ensureDefaultTitleblock();
  return panel;
}

export function setVisible(on: boolean) {
  visible = on;
  const el = ensurePanel();
  el.style.display = on ? "block" : "none";
  if (on) render();
}

export function toggleSheetsPanel() {
  setVisible(!visible);
}

export function isSheetsPanelVisible() {
  return visible;
}

export function setupSheetsPanel() {
  ensurePanel();
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Keyboard command registry (Revit + Blender hybrid).
 *
 * Two-letter sequences (Revit-style): WA = Wall, CM = Column.
 * Single-letter modals (Blender-style): G = move gizmo, R = rotate, S = scale.
 * Standard modifiers: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+A, Delete, Esc.
 *
 * Sequence resolution:
 *   - If a key starts a two-letter command, wait up to 800 ms for the next.
 *   - If the second key completes a command, run it.
 *   - If timeout expires and the first key is a single-letter command, run it.
 *
 * Handlers fire with stopImmediatePropagation so no downstream listener
 * (walk mode, custom windows, project auto-save) can double-fire.
 */
export interface Shortcut {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** "ctrl+shift+z", "delete", "g", or a two-letter sequence "wa". */
  keys: string;
  handler: (e: KeyboardEvent) => void;
  when?: () => boolean;
  category: "edit" | "view" | "select" | "tool" | "modal" | "navigate" | "app";
}

const SEQ_TIMEOUT = 800;

class ShortcutRegistry {
  private shortcuts = new Map<string, Shortcut>();
  private buffer = "";
  private timer: number | null = null;
  private installed = false;

  register(s: Shortcut): void {
    this.shortcuts.set(s.id, s);
  }
  unregister(id: string): void {
    this.shortcuts.delete(id);
  }
  list(): Shortcut[] {
    return [...this.shortcuts.values()];
  }

  install(): void {
    if (this.installed) return;
    this.installed = true;
    window.addEventListener("keydown", this.onKeyDown, true);
  }

  private resetBuffer(): void {
    this.buffer = "";
    if (this.timer != null) {
      clearTimeout(this.timer);
      this.timer = null;
    }
  }

  private matchExact(combo: string): Shortcut | null {
    for (const s of this.shortcuts.values()) {
      if (s.keys !== combo) continue;
      if (s.when && !s.when()) continue;
      return s;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private matchSeqPrefix(prefix: string): Shortcut[] {
    const out: Shortcut[] = [];
    for (const s of this.shortcuts.values()) {
      if (s.keys.length === 2 && s.keys.startsWith(prefix)) {
        if (!s.when || s.when()) out.push(s);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  private fire(s: Shortcut, e: KeyboardEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    // stopImmediatePropagation prevents every later window listener
    // (including the project module's own Ctrl+S handler, walk mode,
    // and any custom handler registered afterwards).
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    this.resetBuffer();
    try {
      s.handler(e);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[shortcuts] handler failed", s.id, err);
    }
  }

  private onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent): void => {
    // Ignore keystrokes inside text inputs / contenteditable.
    const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (t) {
      const tag = t.tagName?.toLowerCase();
      if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || t.isContentEditable) return;
    }

    // Build combo string for modifier-based shortcuts.
    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) parts.push("ctrl");
    if (e.shiftKey) parts.push("shift");
    if (e.altKey) parts.push("alt");
    const key = e.key.length === 1 ? e.key.toLowerCase() : e.key.toLowerCase();
    const combo = [...parts, key].join("+");

    // Modifier-based commands handled first (they never start a sequence).
    if (parts.length) {
      const exact = this.matchExact(combo);
      if (exact) {
        this.fire(exact, e);
        return;
      }
    }

    // Pure letter → sequence logic.
    if (!e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey && /^[a-z]$/.test(key)) {
      const candidate = this.buffer + key;
      // Is this a complete two-letter command?
      const exactTwo = this.matchExact(candidate);
      if (exactTwo && this.buffer.length === 1) {
        this.fire(exactTwo, e);
        return;
      }
      // Does candidate prefix any two-letter command?
      const prefixes = this.matchSeqPrefix(candidate);
      if (prefixes.length) {
        e.preventDefault();
        this.buffer = candidate;
        if (this.timer != null) clearTimeout(this.timer);
        this.timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
          this.timer = null;
          const single = this.matchExact(key);
          if (single && this.buffer === key) single.handler(e);
          this.resetBuffer();
        }, SEQ_TIMEOUT);
        return;
      }
      // No prefix; check single-letter exact.
      const single = this.matchExact(key);
      if (single) {
        this.fire(single, e);
        return;
      }
      this.resetBuffer();
      return;
    }

    // Non-letter keys without modifiers (Delete, Escape, F2, F5, etc.)
    if (parts.length === 0) {
      const exact = this.matchExact(key);
      if (exact) {
        this.fire(exact, e);
        return;
      }
    }
  };
}

export const shortcuts = new ShortcutRegistry();
```

```ts
/**
 * Object snap system (AutoCAD / Revit class).
 *
 * Each snap type has:
 *   - A priority level. Higher priority wins over a closer low-priority
 *     snap â€” same as Revit. Endpoint (100) beats Nearest (55) even if
 *     Nearest is a few pixels closer.
 *   - A distinctive SVG marker drawn at the snapped point.
 *   - A short label shown next to the marker.
 *
 * Snaps are gated by the current tool â€” dims prefer endpoints/corners/faces;
 * wall placement prefers grid/endpoint/midpoint.
 */
import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";

export type SnapType =
  | "endpoint"
  | "intersection"
  | "corner"
  | "midpoint"
  | "center"
  | "perpendicular"
  | "tangent"
  | "quadrant"
  | "vertex"
  | "face"
  | "nearest"
  | "parallel"
  | "extension"
  | "grid";

export interface SnapResult {
  point: THREE.Vector3;
  type: SnapType;
  screenDist: number;
}

/** Priority table â€” higher wins. Matches Revit's hierarchy. */
const SNAP_PRIORITY: Record<SnapType, number> = {
  endpoint:      100,
  intersection:   95,
  corner:         92,
  midpoint:       90,
  center:         85,
  perpendicular:  80,
  tangent:        75,
  quadrant:       70,
  vertex:         65,
  face:           60,
  nearest:        55,
  parallel:       45,
  extension:      40,
  grid:           15,
};

const ALL_TYPES: SnapType[] = [
  "endpoint", "intersection", "corner", "midpoint", "center",
  "perpendicular", "tangent", "quadrant", "vertex", "face",
  "nearest", "parallel", "extension", "grid",
];

/* Revit-style SVG markers â€” 32Ã—32 viewBox. */
const SVG_MARKER: Record<SnapType, string> = {
  endpoint:

  intersection:

  corner:

  perpendicular:

  quadrant:
    `<circle cx="16" cy="16" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#34D399" stroke-width="2"/>` +

    `<circle cx="25" cy="16" r="2" fill="#34D399"/>` +

  vertex:

  face:

  grid:

};

const SVG_LABEL: Record<SnapType, string> = {
  endpoint:       "End",
  intersection:   "Int",
  corner:         "Corner",
  midpoint:       "Mid",
  center:         "Cen",
  perpendicular:  "Perp",
  tangent:        "Tan",
  quadrant:       "Quad",
  vertex:         "Vtx",
  face:           "Face",
  nearest:        "Near",
  parallel:       "Par",
  extension:      "Ext",
  grid:           "Grid",
};

type AuthoredLite = {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  params: {
    start?: [number, number];
    end?: [number, number];
    point?: [number, number];
    polygon?: [number, number][];
    elevation?: number;
    height?: number;
    width?: number;
    depth?: number;
    thickness?: number;
  };
};

function getAuthoredSafe(): AuthoredLite[] {
  try {
    const mod = (window as any).__obsAuthoring;
    if (mod?.getElements) return mod.getElements() as AuthoredLite[];
  } catch { /* */ }
  try {
    const auth = (ctx.features as any)?.authoring;
    if (auth?.getElements) return auth.getElements();
  } catch { /* */ }
  return [];
}

class SnapManager {
  private enabled = true;
  private types: Set<SnapType> = new Set(ALL_TYPES);
  private gridSize = 0.1;
  private pixelTolerance = 16;
  private workPlaneY = 0;

  private orthoOn = false;
  private orthoBase: THREE.Vector3 | null = null;
  private orthoAxis: "x" | "y" | "z" | null = null;

  private overlay: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private marker: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private label: HTMLDivElement | null = null;

  private lastPointer = { x: 0, y: 0 };

  setEnabled(on: boolean) {
    this.enabled = on;
    if (!on) this.hideIndicator();
  }
  isEnabled() { return this.enabled; }

  setGridSize(m: number) { this.gridSize = Math.max(0.001, m); }
  getGridSize() { return this.gridSize; }
  setPixelTolerance(px: number) { this.pixelTolerance = Math.max(4, px); }
  getPixelTolerance() { return this.pixelTolerance; }
  setWorkPlaneY(y: number) { this.workPlaneY = y; }
  getWorkPlaneY() { return this.workPlaneY; }

  setTypes(types: SnapType[]) { this.types = new Set(types); }
  getTypes(): SnapType[] { return [...this.types]; }
  getAllTypes(): SnapType[] { return [...ALL_TYPES]; }

  toggleType(t: SnapType, on?: boolean) {
    const enable = on ?? !this.types.has(t);
    if (enable) this.types.add(t);
    else this.types.delete(t);
  }
  enableAllTypes() { this.types = new Set(ALL_TYPES); }
  disableAllTypes() { this.types.clear(); }

  setOrtho(on: boolean, base: THREE.Vector3 | null, axis: "x" | "y" | "z" | null = null) {
    this.orthoOn = on;
    this.orthoBase = base ? base.clone() : null;
    this.orthoAxis = axis;
  }
  clearOrtho() {
    this.orthoOn = false;
    this.orthoBase = null;
    this.orthoAxis = null;
  }
  isOrtho() { return this.orthoOn; }

  private ensureOverlay() {
    if (this.overlay) return;
    try {
      const host = ctx.rightHost;
      if (!host) return;
      this.overlay = document.createElement("div");
      this.overlay.style.cssText =
        "position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:22;overflow:hidden";
      this.marker = document.createElement("div");
      this.marker.style.cssText =
        "position:absolute;width:32px;height:32px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:none";
      this.label = document.createElement("div");
      this.label.style.cssText =
        "position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,calc(-100% - 18px));" +
        "font:700 10px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#0B0D12;background:#FBBF24;" +
        "padding:2px 7px;border-radius:3px;white-space:nowrap;display:none;" +
        "box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35);letter-spacing:.2px";
      this.overlay.append(this.marker, this.label);
      host.appendChild(this.overlay);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[snap] overlay init failed", e);
    }
  }

  showIndicator(result: SnapResult | null) {
    try {
      this.ensureOverlay();
      if (!result || !this.marker || !this.label || !ctx.world?.camera?.three) {
        if (this.marker) this.marker.style.display = "none";
        if (this.label) this.label.style.display = "none";
        return;
      }
      const cam = ctx.world.camera.three;
      const p = result.point.clone().project(cam);
      const rect = ctx.rightHost.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = (p.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.width;
      const y = (-p.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.height;
      this.marker.innerHTML = `<svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32">${SVG_MARKER[result.type]}</svg>`;
      this.marker.style.left = `${x}px`;
      this.marker.style.top = `${y}px`;
      this.marker.style.display = "block";
      this.label.textContent = SVG_LABEL[result.type];
      // Match label color to marker color
      const colorByType: Partial<Record<SnapType, string>> = {
        endpoint: "#F59E0B",
        intersection: "#EF4444",
        corner: "#FBBF24",
        midpoint: "#22C55E",
        center: "#38BDF8",
        perpendicular: "#C084FC",
        tangent: "#F472B6",
        quadrant: "#34D399",
        vertex: "#38BDF8",
        face: "#38BDF8",
        nearest: "#F59E0B",
        parallel: "#A78BFA",
        extension: "#F472B6",
        grid: "#38BDF8",
      };
      this.label.style.background = colorByType[result.type] ?? "#FBBF24";
      this.label.style.left = `${x}px`;
      this.label.style.top = `${y}px`;
      this.label.style.display = "block";
    } catch { /* never crash the modeling loop */ }
  }

  hideIndicator() { this.showIndicator(null); }

  /** Best snap for a pointer event. Priority-aware, never throws. */
  async query(e: MouseEvent, cursorWorld: THREE.Vector3 | null): Promise<SnapResult | null> {
    try {
      if (!this.enabled) return null;
      this.lastPointer = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
      const host = ctx.rightHost;
      if (!host || !ctx.world?.camera?.three) return null;
      const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.width < 1 || rect.height < 1) return null;

      const ndc = new THREE.Vector2(
        ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
        -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1,
      );

      const candidates: SnapResult[] = [];
      const add = (point: THREE.Vector3, type: SnapType) => {
        const px = this.screenDistToPointer(point, rect, e.clientX, e.clientY);
        if (px <= this.pixelTolerance) {
          candidates.push({ point: point.clone(), type, screenDist: px });
        }
      };

      // Grid snap
      if (this.types.has("grid") && cursorWorld) {
        const g = this.gridSize;
        const gp = new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.round(cursorWorld.x / g) * g,
          this.workPlaneY,
          Math.round(cursorWorld.z / g) * g,
        );
        add(gp, "grid");
      }

      // Authored element snaps (endpoint, midpoint, center, corner, face, quadrant)
      const authored = getAuthoredSafe();
      for (const el of authored) {
        this.collectAuthoredSnaps(el, add, authored);
      }

      // Raycast â€” nearest + vertex
      if (this.types.has("nearest") || this.types.has("vertex") || this.types.has("face")) {
        try {
          const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
          ray.setFromCamera(ndc, ctx.world.camera.three);
          const targets: THREE.Object3D[] = [];
          if (ctx.groundPlane) targets.push(ctx.groundPlane);
          if (ctx.fragments?.list) {
            for (const [, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
              if (model?.object) targets.push(model.object);
            }
          }
          if (targets.length) {
            const hits = ray.intersectObjects(targets, true);
            if (hits.length && this.types.has("nearest")) {
              add(hits[0].point, "nearest");
            }
          }
        } catch { /* raycast can fail on disposed geometry */ }
      }

      // Ortho constraint â€” project candidates onto the axis
      if (this.orthoOn && this.orthoBase) {
        for (const c of candidates) {
          const d = c.point.clone().sub(this.orthoBase);
          if (this.orthoAxis === "x") {
            c.point.set(this.orthoBase.x + d.x, this.orthoBase.y, this.orthoBase.z);
          } else if (this.orthoAxis === "y") {
            c.point.set(this.orthoBase.x, this.orthoBase.y + d.y, this.orthoBase.z);
          } else if (this.orthoAxis === "z") {
            c.point.set(this.orthoBase.x, this.orthoBase.y, this.orthoBase.z + d.z);
          } else {
            const ax = Math.abs(d.x), ay = Math.abs(d.y), az = Math.abs(d.z);
            if (ax >= ay && ax >= az) c.point.set(this.orthoBase.x + d.x, this.orthoBase.y, this.orthoBase.z);
            else if (ay >= az) c.point.set(this.orthoBase.x, this.orthoBase.y + d.y, this.orthoBase.z);
            else c.point.set(this.orthoBase.x, this.orthoBase.y, this.orthoBase.z + d.z);
          }
          c.screenDist = this.screenDistToPointer(c.point, rect, e.clientX, e.clientY);
        }
      }

      if (!candidates.length) return null;

      // Priority-aware sort â€” a higher-priority snap wins over a closer
      // lower-priority one, exactly like Revit.
      candidates.sort((a, b) => {
        const pa = SNAP_PRIORITY[a.type] ?? 0;
        const pb = SNAP_PRIORITY[b.type] ?? 0;
        if (pa !== pb) return pb - pa;
        return a.screenDist - b.screenDist;
      });

      return candidates[0];
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[snap] query failed", err);
      return null;
    }
  }

  private collectAuthoredSnaps(
    el: AuthoredLite,
    add: (p: THREE.Vector3, t: SnapType) => void,
    all: readonly AuthoredLite[],
  ) {
    try {
      const y = el.params.elevation ?? this.workPlaneY;
      const p = el.params;

      if (p.start && p.end) {
        const a = new THREE.Vector3(p.start[0], y, p.start[1]);
        const b = new THREE.Vector3(p.end[0], y, p.end[1]);
        const dx = b.x - a.x;
        const dz = b.z - a.z;
        const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
        const ux = dx / L;
        const uz = dz / L;
        const nx = -uz;
        const nz = ux;

        if (this.types.has("endpoint")) { add(a, "endpoint"); add(b, "endpoint"); }

        if (this.types.has("midpoint")) {
          add(new THREE.Vector3((a.x + b.x) / 2, y, (a.z + b.z) / 2), "midpoint");
        }

        // Corner â€” this endpoint coincides with another element's endpoint
        if (this.types.has("corner")) {
          const tol = 0.2;
          for (const endpoint of [a, b]) {
            for (const other of all) {
              if (other.id === el.id) continue;
              const op = other.params;
              if (!op.start || !op.end) continue;
              const oy = op.elevation ?? this.workPlaneY;
              const os = new THREE.Vector3(op.start[0], oy, op.start[1]);
              const oe = new THREE.Vector3(op.end[0], oy, op.end[1]);
              if (endpoint.distanceTo(os) < tol || endpoint.distanceTo(oe) < tol) {
                add(endpoint, "corner");
                break;
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // Face â€” sample points along both faces of a wall-like element
        if (this.types.has("face")) {
          const half = Math.max(0.02, (p.thickness ?? 0.2) / 2);
          const faceTypes = new Set(["wall", "duct", "pipe", "cable-tray", "conduit", "beam", "strip"]);
          if (faceTypes.has(el.type)) {
            for (const t of [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]) {
              const cx = a.x + dx * t;
              const cz = a.z + dz * t;
              add(new THREE.Vector3(cx + nx * half, y, cz + nz * half), "face");
              add(new THREE.Vector3(cx - nx * half, y, cz - nz * half), "face");
            }
          }
        }

        // Tangent â€” only meaningful for arc-based elements; skip silently
        // for linear elements. Activate when arc elements exist.

        // Extension â€” points slightly beyond each end
        if (this.types.has("extension")) {
          add(a.clone().addScaledVector(new THREE.Vector3(ux, 0, uz), -0.5), "extension");
          add(b.clone().addScaledVector(new THREE.Vector3(ux, 0, uz), 0.5), "extension");
        }
      }

      if (p.point) {
        const c = new THREE.Vector3(p.point[0], y, p.point[1]);
        if (this.types.has("center") || this.types.has("endpoint")) add(c, "center");
        if (this.types.has("quadrant") && (p.width || p.depth)) {
          const hw = (p.width ?? p.depth ?? 0.3) / 2;
          const hd = (p.depth ?? p.width ?? 0.3) / 2;
          add(new THREE.Vector3(c.x + hw, y, c.z), "quadrant");
          add(new THREE.Vector3(c.x - hw, y, c.z), "quadrant");
          add(new THREE.Vector3(c.x, y, c.z + hd), "quadrant");
          add(new THREE.Vector3(c.x, y, c.z - hd), "quadrant");
        }
      }

      if (p.polygon && p.polygon.length >= 2) {
        for (let i = 0; i < p.polygon.length; i++) {
          const pt = p.polygon[i];
          const v = new THREE.Vector3(pt[0], y, pt[1]);
          if (this.types.has("vertex") || this.types.has("endpoint")) add(v, "vertex");
          if (this.types.has("midpoint")) {
            const n = p.polygon[(i + 1) % p.polygon.length];
            add(new THREE.Vector3((pt[0] + n[0]) / 2, y, (pt[1] + n[1]) / 2), "midpoint");
          }
        }
      }
    } catch { /* skip broken element */ }
  }

  private screenDistToPointer(
    p: THREE.Vector3,
    rect: DOMRect,
    clientX: number,
    clientY: number,
  ): number {
    try {
      const v = p.clone().project(ctx.world.camera.three);
      const sx = (v.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.width + rect.left;
      const sy = (-v.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.height + rect.top;
      return Math.hypot(sx - clientX, sy - clientY);
    } catch { return 9999; }
  }
}

export const snapping = new SnapManager();

/* -- Snap settings panel (unchanged API) ------------------------------ */

let snapPanel: HTMLElement | null = null;
let snapPanelVisible = false;

export function toggleSnapSettings() {
  setSnapSettingsVisible(!snapPanelVisible);
}

export function isSnapSettingsVisible() { return snapPanelVisible; }

export function setSnapSettingsVisible(on: boolean) {
  snapPanelVisible = on;
  if (!snapPanel) buildSnapPanel();
  if (snapPanel) snapPanel.style.display = on ? "block" : "none";
  if (on) renderSnapPanel();
}

function buildSnapPanel() {
  snapPanel = document.createElement("div");
  snapPanel.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;bottom:48px;left:12px;width:300px;z-index:8500;" +
    "background:#1e2430;color:#e2e8f0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.4);font:12px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;display:none";
  document.body.appendChild(snapPanel);
}

function renderSnapPanel() {
  if (!snapPanel) return;
  const types = snapping.getAllTypes();
  const active = new Set(snapping.getTypes());

  // Color chips matching the marker colors
  const colorByType: Record<string, string> = {
    endpoint: "#F59E0B", intersection: "#EF4444", corner: "#FBBF24",
    midpoint: "#22C55E", center: "#38BDF8", perpendicular: "#C084FC",
    tangent: "#F472B6", quadrant: "#34D399", vertex: "#38BDF8",
    face: "#38BDF8", nearest: "#F59E0B", parallel: "#A78BFA",
    extension: "#F472B6", grid: "#38BDF8",
  };

  const checkboxes = types.map((t) => {
    const on = active.has(t);
    const color = colorByType[t] ?? "#94a3b8";
    return (
      '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;' +
      (on ? "background:#0f172a;" : "background:transparent;") + '">' +
      '<input type="checkbox" data-snap="' + t + '" ' + (on ? "checked" : "") +
      ' style="accent-color:' + color + '"/>' +
      '<span style="display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;background:' + color + ';flex:none"></span>' +
      '<span style="flex:1">' + SVG_LABEL_FOR_PANEL(t) + '</span>' +
      '</label>'
    );
  }).join("");

  snapPanel.innerHTML =
    '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #334155;font-weight:600">' +
      '<span>Object Snaps</span>' +
      '<button type="button" id="obs-snap-close" style="background:none;border:none;color:#94a3b8;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer">Ã—</button>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div style="padding:10px 12px">' +
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px">' +
        '<button type="button" id="obs-snap-all" style="flex:1;background:#334155;border:1px solid #475569;color:#e2e8f0;border-radius:6px;padding:4px;cursor:pointer">All</button>' +
        '<button type="button" id="obs-snap-none" style="flex:1;background:#334155;border:1px solid #475569;color:#e2e8f0;border-radius:6px;padding:4px;cursor:pointer">None</button>' +
        '<button type="button" id="obs-snap-toggle" style="flex:1;background:' + (snapping.isEnabled() ? "#1d4ed8" : "#334155") + ';border:1px solid #475569;color:#e2e8f0;border-radius:6px;padding:4px;cursor:pointer">' +
          (snapping.isEnabled() ? "ON" : "OFF") +
        '</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px;margin-bottom:10px">' + checkboxes + '</div>' +
      '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8">' +
        'Grid size (m)' +
        '<input type="number" id="obs-snap-grid" value="' + snapping.getGridSize() + '" step="0.05" min="0.001" ' +
          'style="flex:1;background:#0f172a;border:1px solid #334155;color:#e2e8f0;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 6px"/>' +
      '</label>' +
      '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8;margin-top:6px">' +
        'Tolerance (px)' +
        '<input type="number" id="obs-snap-tol" value="' + snapping.getPixelTolerance() + '" step="1" min="4" ' +
          'style="flex:1;background:#0f172a;border:1px solid #334155;color:#e2e8f0;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 6px"/>' +
      '</label>' +
      '<div style="margin-top:8px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid #334155;font-size:10px;color:#64748b;line-height:1.4">' +
        'Higher priority wins over closer snaps. Endpoint / Intersection / Corner beat Nearest and Grid.' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';

  snapPanel.querySelector("#obs-snap-close")?.addEventListener("click", () => setSnapSettingsVisible(false));
  snapPanel.querySelector("#obs-snap-all")?.addEventListener("click", () => { snapping.enableAllTypes(); renderSnapPanel(); });
  snapPanel.querySelector("#obs-snap-none")?.addEventListener("click", () => { snapping.disableAllTypes(); renderSnapPanel(); });
  snapPanel.querySelector("#obs-snap-toggle")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    snapping.setEnabled(!snapping.isEnabled());
    renderSnapPanel();
  });
  snapPanel.querySelectorAll("[data-snap]").forEach((el) => {
    el.addEventListener("change", () => {
      const t = (el as HTMLInputElement).dataset.snap as SnapType;
      snapping.toggleType(t, (el as HTMLInputElement).checked);
    });
  });
  snapPanel.querySelector("#obs-snap-grid")?.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
    snapping.setGridSize(Number((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value) || 0.1);
  });
  snapPanel.querySelector("#obs-snap-tol")?.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
    snapping.setPixelTolerance(Number((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value) || 16);
  });
}

function SVG_LABEL_FOR_PANEL(t: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    endpoint: "Endpoint", intersection: "Intersection", corner: "Corner",
    midpoint: "Midpoint", center: "Center", perpendicular: "Perpendicular",
    tangent: "Tangent", quadrant: "Quadrant", vertex: "Vertex",
    face: "Face", nearest: "Nearest", parallel: "Parallel",
    extension: "Extension", grid: "Grid",
  };
  return map[t] ?? t;
}
```

```ts
let lastRun: RunResult | null = null;
const selected = new Set<string>();

/* ── Pack list rendering ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

function renderPacks(): void {
  packList.innerHTML = "";
  const packs = listPacks();
  const byJurisdiction = new Map<string, RulePack[]>();
  for (const p of packs) {
    const jKey = p.jurisdiction ?? "intl";
    const arr = byJurisdiction.get(jKey) ?? [];
    arr.push(p);
    byJurisdiction.set(jKey, arr);
  }

  const order = ["GB", "US", "DE", "FR", "CN", "JP", "intl"];
  const sorted = [...byJurisdiction.entries()].sort((a, b) => {
    const ai = order.indexOf(a[0]);
    const bi = order.indexOf(b[0]);
    return (ai === -1 ? 99 : ai) - (bi === -1 ? 99 : bi);
  });

  for (const [jurisdiction, group] of sorted) {
    const gLabel = document.createElement("div");
    gLabel.textContent = jurisdiction === "intl" ? "International" : jurisdiction;
    gLabel.style.cssText =
      "font:700 10px system-ui;color:#6b7280;letter-spacing:.5px;" +
      "text-transform:uppercase;margin:8px 2px 4px";
    packList.appendChild(gLabel);

    for (const pack of group) {
      const row = document.createElement("label");
      row.style.cssText =
        "display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;padding:6px 7px;border-radius:5px;" +
        "cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:2px";
      row.onmouseenter = () => (row.style.background = "var(--bg-hover,#232633)");
      row.onmouseleave = () => (row.style.background = "");

      const cb = document.createElement("input");
      cb.type = "checkbox";
      cb.checked = selected.has(pack.id);
      cb.style.cssText = "margin-top:2px;cursor:pointer;flex:none";
      cb.onchange = () => {
        if (cb.checked) selected.add(pack.id);
        else selected.delete(pack.id);
      };

      const text = document.createElement("div");
      text.style.cssText = "flex:1;min-width:0";
      const name = document.createElement("div");
      name.textContent = pack.name;
      name.style.cssText = "font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px";
      const desc = document.createElement("div");
      desc.textContent = `${pack.rules.length} rules · ${pack.version}`;
      desc.style.cssText = "font-size:10px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:1px";
      text.append(name, desc);

      row.append(cb, text);
      packList.appendChild(row);
    }
  }
}

/* ── Run ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

async function run(): Promise<void> {
  if (!selected.size) {
    summary.textContent = "Select at least one rule pack.";
    return;
  }

  const signal = { cancelled: false };
  runBtn.disabled = true;
  runBtn.textContent = "Running…";
  cancelBtn.style.display = "inline-block";
  cancelBtn.onclick = () => { signal.cancelled = true; };
  results.innerHTML = "";

  try {
    lastRun = await runRules({
      packIds: [...selected],
      signal,
      onProgress: (done: number, total: number, note?: string) => {
        summary.textContent = `${done} / ${total} · ${note ?? ""}`;
      },
    });
    renderResults();
  } catch (err) {
    summary.textContent = `Failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : err}`;
  } finally {
    runBtn.disabled = false;
    runBtn.textContent = "▶ Run selected";
    cancelBtn.style.display = "none";
  }
}

/* ── Results rendering ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

function renderResults(): void {
  if (!lastRun) return;
  const { summary: s, violations } = lastRun;

  summary.innerHTML =
    `<b>${s.violations}</b> violation(s) · ` +
    `<span style="color:#ef4444">${s.errors} error(s)</span> · ` +
    `<span style="color:#f59e0b">${s.warnings} warning(s)</span> · ` +
    `<span style="color:#38bdf8">${s.infos} info</span> · ` +
    `${s.ruleCount} rule(s) in ${s.durationMs} ms`;

  results.innerHTML = "";
  if (!violations.length) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.textContent = "No violations.";
    empty.style.cssText = "padding:30px;text-align:center;color:#6b7280";
    results.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }

  const colourOf = (sev: RuleSeverity) =>
    sev === "error" ? "#ef4444" : sev === "warning" ? "#f59e0b" : "#38bdf8";

  for (const v of violations) {
    if (!filterState[v.severity]) continue;

    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText =
      `padding:8px 10px;margin:4px 2px;border-radius:6px;` +
      `background:var(--bg-elevated,#181a23);` +
      `border-inline-start:3px solid ${colourOf(v.severity)}`;

    const top = document.createElement("div");
    top.style.cssText = "display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center";
    const sev = document.createElement("span");
    sev.textContent = v.severity.toUpperCase();
    sev.style.cssText =
      `padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;font:700 9px system-ui;color:#0b0d12;` +
      `background:${colourOf(v.severity)}`;
    const name = document.createElement("div");
    name.textContent = v.elementName;
    name.style.cssText = "flex:1;font-weight:700;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap";
    const std = document.createElement("span");
    std.textContent = v.standard;
    std.style.cssText = "font-size:10px;color:#6b7280";
    top.append(sev, name, std);

    const msg = document.createElement("div");
    msg.textContent = v.message;
    msg.style.cssText = "font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:4px";

    const meta = document.createElement("div");
    meta.style.cssText = "font-size:9.5px;color:#6b7280;margin-top:3px;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace)";
    const metaParts: string[] = [`#${v.elementId}`, v.elementCategory];
    if (v.actual) metaParts.push(`actual ${v.actual}`);
    if (v.required) metaParts.push(`required ${v.required}`);
    meta.textContent = metaParts.join(" · ");

    row.append(top, msg, meta);
    row.onclick = () => focusElement(v.elementId);
    row.style.cursor = "pointer";
    results.appendChild(row);
  }
}

async function focusElement(localId: number): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const modelId = lastRun ? [...ctx.fragments.list.keys()][0] : null;
    if (!modelId) return;
    const sel = (ctx.features as any).selection;
    sel?.replace?.({ [modelId]: new Set([localId]) });
    await sel?.applyToHighlighter?.();
    const cam = (ctx.features as any).camera;
    await cam?.fitToMap?.({ [modelId]: new Set([localId]) });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[standards] focus failed", err);
  }
}

/* ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export function openStandardsPanel(): void {
  registerStandardPacks();
  renderPacks();
  if (!dock) {
    dock = makeDockable(panel, {
      id: "standards",
      host: ctx.rightHost,
      header,
      minWidth: 720, minHeight: 480,
      defaultDock: "right",
      defaultWidth: 900, defaultHeight: 700,
    });
  }
  visible = true;
  panel.style.display = "flex";
  dock.show();
}

export function closeStandardsPanel(): void {
  visible = false;
  dock?.hide();
  panel.style.display = "none";
}

export function toggleStandardsPanel(): void {
  visible ? closeStandardsPanel() : openStandardsPanel();
}

export function isStandardsPanelVisible(): boolean {
  return visible;
}

export function setupStandardsPanel(): void {
  registerStandardPacks();
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);
  dock = makeDockable(panel, {
    id: "standards",
    host: ctx.rightHost,
    header,
    minWidth: 720, minHeight: 480,
    defaultDock: "right",
    defaultWidth: 900, defaultHeight: 700,
  });
  panel.style.display = "none";
  runBtn.onclick = () => void run();
  allOn.onclick = () => {
    for (const p of listPacks()) selected.add(p.id);
    renderPacks();
  };
  allOff.onclick = () => {
    selected.clear();
    renderPacks();
  };
  register("standards", { run: runRules });

  ctx.features.standardsPanel = {
    open: openStandardsPanel,
    close: closeStandardsPanel,
    toggle: toggleStandardsPanel,
    isVisible: isStandardsPanelVisible,
    run: runRules,
  };
  console.log("[standards] panel ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Combined coordination report: Clashes + Standards compliance.
 *
 * The report is a single self-contained HTML file with three tabs —
 * Summary, Clashes, Standards — so it can be emailed, embedded in a CDE,
 * or printed.
 */
import {
  listClashes,
  getClashState,
  testNameInput,
  type ClashStatus,
} from "./clash";
import { services, tryUse } from "../core/services";
import { getCurrentProject } from "../modules/projects/projects";

interface StandardsViolation {
  ruleId: string;
  ruleName: string;
  standard: string;
  jurisdiction: string;
  severity: "info" | "warning" | "error";
  category: string;
  elementId: number;
  elementName: string;
  elementCategory: string;
  message: string;
  actual?: string;
  required?: string;
}

interface StandardsSummary {
  packCount: number;
  ruleCount: number;
  violations: number;
  errors: number;
  warnings: number;
  infos: number;
  startedAt: number;
  finishedAt: number;
  durationMs: number;
  cancelled: boolean;
}

interface StandardsResult {
  summary: StandardsSummary;
  violations: StandardsViolation[];
}

const STATUS_COLOR: Record<ClashStatus, string> = {
  new: "#38bdf8",
  active: "#f59e0b",
  reviewed: "#c084fc",
  approved: "#22c55e",
  resolved: "#6b7280",
};

const KIND_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  intersect: "#ef4444",
  touching: "#f59e0b",
  clearance: "#38bdf8",
  duplicate: "#a855f7",
};

const SEV_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  error: "#ef4444",
  warning: "#f59e0b",
  info: "#38bdf8",
};

const esc = (s: unknown) =>
  String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);

const fmtDate = (t: number) => new Date(t).toLocaleString();

function section(id: string, title: string): string {
  return `<h2 id="${id}">${esc(title)}</h2>`;
}

function clashTableHtml(): string {
  const rows = listClashes();
  if (!rows.length) {
    return `<p class="empty">No clash results in memory. Run a clash test, then re-export.</p>`;
  }
  let html =
    `<table><thead><tr>` +
    `<th>#</th><th>Kind</th><th>Status</th>` +
    `<th>Model A</th><th>Element A</th>` +
    `<th>Model B</th><th>Element B</th>` +
    `<th>Gap / Overlap</th><th>Method</th>` +
    `</tr></thead><tbody>`;
  rows.forEach((c, i) => {
    const st = getClashState(c);
    const gap =
      c.kind === "intersect" ? `${(c.depthVol * 1e6).toFixed(1)} cm³`
      : c.kind === "duplicate" ? `Identical (Δ ≤ ${(c.minGap * 1000).toFixed(1)} mm)`
      : `${(c.minGap * 1000).toFixed(1)} mm`;
    html +=
      `<tr>` +
      `<td>${i + 1}</td>` +
      `<td><span class="badge" style="background:${KIND_COLOR[c.kind] ?? "#666"};color:#fff">${c.kind}</span></td>` +
      `<td><span class="badge" style="background:${STATUS_COLOR[st.status]};color:#fff">${st.status}</span></td>` +
      `<td class="dim">${esc(c.a.modelId)}</td>` +
      `<td>${esc(c.a.name)}<br><span class="dim">${esc(c.a.cat)} · #${c.a.localId}</span></td>` +
      `<td class="dim">${esc(c.b.modelId)}</td>` +
      `<td>${esc(c.b.name)}<br><span class="dim">${esc(c.b.cat)} · #${c.b.localId}</span></td>` +
      `<td class="num">${gap}</td>` +
      `<td class="dim">${c.method}</td>` +
      `</tr>`;
  });
  html += `</tbody></table>`;
  return html;
}

function standardsTableHtml(res: StandardsResult | null): string {
  if (!res) {
    return `<p class="empty">No standards run yet. Run a compliance check from the Standards panel, then re-export.</p>`;
  }
  if (!res.violations.length) {
    return `<p class="empty">No violations — the model passes all enabled rule packs.</p>`;
  }
  const grouped = new Map<string, StandardsViolation[]>();
  for (const v of res.violations) {
    const key = `${v.standard} · ${v.jurisdiction}`;
    const arr = grouped.get(key) ?? [];
    arr.push(v);
    grouped.set(key, arr);
  }
  let html = "";
  for (const [group, items] of grouped) {
    html += `<h3>${esc(group)} <span class="dim">(${items.length})</span></h3>`;
    html +=
      `<table><thead><tr>` +
      `<th>Severity</th><th>Rule</th><th>Category</th>` +
      `<th>Element</th><th>Message</th><th>Actual</th><th>Required</th>` +
      `</tr></thead><tbody>`;
    for (const v of items) {
      html +=
        `<tr>` +
        `<td><span class="badge" style="background:${SEV_COLOR[v.severity]};color:#fff">${v.severity}</span></td>` +
        `<td>${esc(v.ruleName)}<br><span class="dim">${esc(v.ruleId)}</span></td>` +
        `<td class="dim">${esc(v.category)}</td>` +
        `<td>${esc(v.elementName)}<br><span class="dim">${esc(v.elementCategory)} · #${v.elementId}</span></td>` +
        `<td>${esc(v.message)}</td>` +
        `<td class="dim">${esc(v.actual ?? "—")}</td>` +
        `<td class="dim">${esc(v.required ?? "—")}</td>` +
        `</tr>`;
    }
    html += `</tbody></table>`;
  }
  return html;
}

function summaryCards(res: StandardsResult | null): string {
  const clash = listClashes();
  const byStatus: Record<string, number> = { new: 0, active: 0, reviewed: 0, approved: 0, resolved: 0 };
  for (const c of clash) byStatus[getClashState(c).status]++;
  const card = (label: string, value: number | string, color = "#e8eaf0") =>
    `<div class="card"><div class="label">${esc(label)}</div>` +
    `<div class="value" style="color:${color}">${value}</div></div>`;

  let html = `<div class="cards">`;
  html += card("Total clashes", clash.length, "#38bdf8");
  html += card("New", byStatus.new, STATUS_COLOR.new);
  html += card("Active", byStatus.active, STATUS_COLOR.active);
  html += card("Reviewed", byStatus.reviewed, STATUS_COLOR.reviewed);
  html += card("Approved", byStatus.approved, STATUS_COLOR.approved);
  html += card("Resolved", byStatus.resolved, STATUS_COLOR.resolved);
  if (res) {
    html += card("Violations", res.summary.violations, "#ef4444");
    html += card("Errors", res.summary.errors, SEV_COLOR.error);
    html += card("Warnings", res.summary.warnings, SEV_COLOR.warning);
    html += card("Info", res.summary.infos, SEV_COLOR.info);
    html += card("Rule packs", res.summary.packCount);
    html += card("Rules run", res.summary.ruleCount);
    html += card("Duration", `${(res.summary.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(2)} s`);
  }
  html += `</div>`;
  return html;
}

export function buildCoordinationReportHtml(standards: StandardsResult | null): string {
  const project = getCurrentProject();
  const testName = testNameInput.value || "Clash Test";
  const reportTitle = standards
    ? `${testName} + Standards Compliance`
    : testName;

  return `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>${esc(reportTitle)} — Coordination Report</title>
<style>
  :root { color-scheme: light; }
  body { font-family: system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
         background:#f5f6f8; color:#1a1d23; margin:0; padding:28px; }
  h1 { font-size:22px; margin:0 0 4px; }
  h2 { font-size:15px; margin:26px 0 10px; color:#3d4250;
       border-bottom:1px solid #d5d8de; padding-bottom:6px; }
  h3 { font-size:13px; margin:18px 0 8px; color:#4b5563; }
  .meta { color:#6b7280; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:20px; }
  .tabs { display:flex; gap:4px; border-bottom:1px solid #d5d8de; margin-bottom:18px; }
  .tab { padding:8px 16px; font:600 12px system-ui; cursor:pointer;
         border:1px solid transparent; border-bottom:none; border-radius:6px 6px 0 0;
         background:transparent; color:#6b7280; }
  .tab.active { background:#fff; border-color:#d5d8de; color:#1a1d23; margin-bottom:-1px; }
  .panel { display:none; }
  .panel.active { display:block; }
  .cards { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr));
           gap:10px; margin-bottom:18px; }
  .card { background:#fff; border:1px solid #e3e6ea; border-radius:8px;
          padding:10px 12px; }
  .card .label { font-size:10px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.6px;
                 color:#6b7280; }
  .card .value { font-size:22px; font-weight:700; margin-top:2px;
                 font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,monospace; }
  table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; background:#fff;
          border:1px solid #e3e6ea; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden;
          font-size:11px; margin-bottom:14px; }
  th { background:#f0f2f5; text-align:left; padding:8px 10px;
       font-size:10px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase;
       letter-spacing:.4px; color:#4b5563; border-bottom:1px solid #e3e6ea;
       white-space:nowrap; }
  td { padding:7px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #eef0f3; vertical-align:top; }
  tr:last-child td { border-bottom:none; }
  tr:hover td { background:#fafbfc; }
  .badge { display:inline-block; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:3px;
           font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.3px;
           text-transform:uppercase; }
  .num { text-align:right; font-family:ui-monospace,monospace; }
  .dim { color:#9ca3af; font-size:10px; }
  .empty { padding:20px; color:#9ca3af; text-align:center; background:#fff;
           border:1px dashed #d5d8de; border-radius:8px; font-size:12px; }
  .footer { margin-top:40px; color:#9ca3af; font-size:10px; text-align:center; }
  @media print {
    body { padding:0; background:#fff; }
    .tabs { display:none; }
    .panel { display:block !important; page-break-before: always; }
    .panel:first-of-type { page-break-before: auto; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<h1>${esc(reportTitle)}</h1>
<div class="meta">
  ${project ? `Project: <b>${esc(project.name)}</b> · ` : ""}
  Generated: ${fmtDate(Date.now())}
</div>

<div class="tabs" role="tablist">
  <button class="tab active" data-tab="summary">Summary</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="clashes">Clashes (${listClashes().length})</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="standards">Standards${
    standards ? ` (${standards.violations.length})` : ""
  }</button>
</div>

<div class="panel active" data-panel="summary">
  ${summaryCards(standards)}
  ${standards ? `<h2>Standards run</h2>
    <table><thead><tr><th>Metric</th><th>Value</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    <tr><td>Rule packs</td><td class="num">${standards.summary.packCount}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Rules evaluated</td><td class="num">${standards.summary.ruleCount}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Violations</td><td class="num">${standards.summary.violations}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Errors</td><td class="num">${standards.summary.errors}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Warnings</td><td class="num">${standards.summary.warnings}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Info</td><td class="num">${standards.summary.infos}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Duration</td><td class="num">${(standards.summary.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(2)} s</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Cancelled</td><td class="num">${standards.summary.cancelled ? "yes" : "no"}</td></tr>
    </tbody></table>` : ""}
</div>

<div class="panel" data-panel="clashes">
  ${section("clashes", "Clashes")}
  ${clashTableHtml()}
</div>

<div class="panel" data-panel="standards">
  ${section("standards", "Standards compliance")}
  ${standardsTableHtml(standards)}
</div>

<div class="footer">
  Open BIM Studio · coordination report · ${fmtDate(Date.now())}
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".tab");
  const panels = document.querySelectorAll(".panel");
  tabs.forEach((t) => t.addEventListener("click", () => {
    tabs.forEach((x) => x.classList.remove("active"));
    panels.forEach((p) => p.classList.remove("active"));
    t.classList.add("active");
    document.querySelector('[data-panel="' + t.dataset.tab + '"]')?.classList.add("active");
  }));
})();
</script>
</body></html>`;
}

/** Run a fresh standards check (uses whatever is enabled in the panel), then
 *  return the report HTML. Used by the export / preview actions. */
export async function runStandardsForReport(): Promise<StandardsResult | null> {
  const svc = tryUse("standards");
  if (!svc) return null;
  try {
    const res = await svc.run();
    return res as StandardsResult;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[standards-report] run failed", err);
    return null;
  }
}

/* ── Export actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function triggerDownload(html: string, filename: string): void {
  const blob = new Blob([html], { type: "text/html;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 8000);
}

export async function exportCoordinationReportHtml(): Promise<void> {
  const hasClash = listClashes().length > 0;
  const standards = hasClash || tryUse("standards") ? await runStandardsForReport() : null;
  const html = buildCoordinationReportHtml(standards);
  triggerDownload(html, `coordination-report-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.html`);
}

export async function previewCoordinationReportHtml(): Promise<void> {
  const standards = tryUse("standards") ? await runStandardsForReport() : null;
  const html = buildCoordinationReportHtml(standards);
  const w = window.open("", "_blank");
  if (!w) { alert("Popup blocked — allow popups to preview."); return; }
  w.document.write(html);
  w.document.close();
}

export function setupStandardsReport(): void {
  // Nothing to install at runtime — commands are registered by the
  // command palette bootstrap. Kept for symmetry with the other features.
  services.tryUse("standards");  // touch — no-op if absent
  console.log("[standards-report] ready");
}
```
