```ts
// openbim-fix:status-bar-extras
//
// Adds four live readouts to the bottom status bar:
//   * Selection   -- "N selected" / "No selection"  (click clears)
//   * Level       -- active level + elevation        (click opens dropdown)
//   * Tool        -- active authoring tool
//   * Locale      -- current locale code             (click rotates)
//
// The status bar is discovered from the outside, exactly like
// ribbon-persist does for the ribbon, so this module never has to know
// the shell's internal class names beyond a small set of fallbacks.

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { selection } from "./selection";
import { levels } from "../modules/levels";

const STATUSBAR_SELECTORS = [
  ".bb-status",
  "[data-obs-status-bar]",
  ".obs-status-bar",
  "[role='status']",
];

function findStatusBar(): HTMLElement | null {
  for (const sel of STATUSBAR_SELECTORS) {
    const el = document.querySelector(sel) as HTMLElement | null;
    if (el) return el;
  }
  return null;
}

function ensureSegment(
  bar: HTMLElement,
  key: string,
  title: string,
): HTMLElement {
  const existing = bar.querySelector(
    "[data-obs-status='" + key + "']",
  ) as HTMLElement | null;
  if (existing) return existing;

  const el = document.createElement("span");
  el.dataset.obsStatus = key;
  el.title = title;
  el.style.cssText =
    "padding:0 8px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280);" +
    "cursor:pointer;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap;display:inline-flex;" +
    "align-items:center;gap:4px;border-left:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.15)";
  bar.appendChild(el);
  return el;
}

function textOf(el: HTMLElement, value: string, tint?: string): void {
  el.textContent = value;
  if (tint) el.style.color = tint;
}

function installSegments(bar: HTMLElement): void {
  const selSeg  = ensureSegment(bar, "selection", "Selection - click to clear");
  const lvlSeg  = ensureSegment(bar, "level",     "Active level - click to switch");
  const toolSeg = ensureSegment(bar, "tool",      "Active authoring tool");
  const locSeg  = ensureSegment(bar, "locale",    "Locale - click to cycle");

  // ---- Selection -------------------------------------------------------
  const renderSelection = () => {
    const n = selection.size();
    if (n === 0) {
      textOf(selSeg, "\u25CB No selection", "var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)");
    } else {
      const models = selection.modelCount();
      const suffix = models > 1 ? "  \u00B7 " + models + " models" : "";
      textOf(selSeg, "\u25CF " + n + " selected" + suffix, "var(--accent,#38bdf8)");
    }
  };
  selSeg.addEventListener("click", () => {
    try {
      selection.clear();
      void selection.applyToHighlighter();
    } catch { /* */ }
  });
  try { selection.onChange(renderSelection); } catch { /* */ }
  renderSelection();

  // ---- Level -----------------------------------------------------------
  const renderLevel = () => {
    const active = levels.getActive();
    if (!active) {
      textOf(lvlSeg, "\u25C7 No level", "var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)");
    } else {
      const elev = active.elevation >= 0
        ? "+" + active.elevation.toFixed(2)
        : active.elevation.toFixed(2);
      textOf(lvlSeg, "\u25C6 " + active.name + "  " + elev + " m",
        "var(--accent,#38bdf8)");
    }
  };
  lvlSeg.addEventListener("click", () => {
    try {
      const mod: any = (window as any).__obs_level_chip__;
      if (mod?.openDropdown) { mod.openDropdown(); return; }
      // Fallback: rotate to next level.
      const all = levels.list();
      if (all.length < 2) return;
      const cur = levels.getActiveId();
      const i = all.findIndex((l) => l.id === cur);
      const next = all[(i + 1) % all.length];
      levels.setActiveId(next.id);
    } catch { /* */ }
  });
  try { levels.onChange(renderLevel); } catch { /* */ }
  renderLevel();

  // ---- Tool ------------------------------------------------------------
  const renderTool = () => {
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    const tool = auth?.getActiveTool?.() ?? null;
    if (!tool || tool === "select") {
      textOf(toolSeg, "\u25B8 Select", "var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)");
    } else {
      const nice = String(tool).replace(/-/g, " ")
        .replace(/\b\w/g, (c: string) => c.toUpperCase());
      textOf(toolSeg, "\u25B8 " + nice, "var(--text-secondary,#a0a6b5)");
    }
  };
  try {
    const auth: any = (ctx.features as any).authoring;
    auth?.onAuthoringChange?.(renderTool);
  } catch { /* */ }
  renderTool();

  // ---- Locale ----------------------------------------------------------
  const renderLocale = () => {
    const i18n: any = (ctx.features as any).i18n;
    const loc = i18n?.getLocale?.() ?? "en";
    textOf(locSeg, "\u2295 " + String(loc).toUpperCase(),
      "var(--text-tertiary,#6b7280)");
  };
  locSeg.addEventListener("click", () => {
    try {
      const i18n: any = (ctx.features as any).i18n;
      if (!i18n?.listLocales || !i18n?.setLocale) return;
      const list = i18n.listLocales();
      if (list.length < 2) return;
      const cur = i18n.getLocale();
      const i = list.findIndex((l: any) => l.id === cur);
      const next = list[(i + 1) % list.length];
      i18n.setLocale(next.id);
    } catch { /* */ }
  });
  try {
    const i18n: any = (ctx.features as any).i18n;
    i18n?.onChange?.(renderLocale);
  } catch { /* */ }
  renderLocale();

  (window as any).__obsStatusBar = {
    refresh: () => {
      renderSelection(); renderLevel(); renderTool(); renderLocale();
    },
    segments: { selSeg, lvlSeg, toolSeg, locSeg },
  };
}

let installed = false;

export function setupStatusBarExtras(): void {
  if (installed) return;
  installed = true;

  // If the bar is already mounted, install immediately.
  const existing = findStatusBar();
  if (existing) {
    installSegments(existing);
    console.log("[status-bar-extras] ready");
    return;
  }

  // Otherwise wait for it.
  const obs = new MutationObserver(() => {
    const bar = findStatusBar();
    if (!bar) return;
    obs.disconnect();
    installSegments(bar);
    console.log("[status-bar-extras] ready");
  });
  obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  // Safety: if the bar never appears, do not hold onto the observer.
  window.setTimeout(() => {
    try { obs.disconnect(); } catch { /* */ }
  }, 15_000);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * System Browser â€” MEP systems tree.
 *
 * Scans the loaded fragment models for MEP categories and groups them
 * into systems (Supply Air, Return Air, Domestic Cold Water, Sanitary,
 * Power, Lighting, Fire). Clicking a system selects all its elements.
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { selection } from "./selection";
import { getElements } from "./authoring";

interface SystemDef {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  color: string;
  categories: RegExp;
}

const SYSTEMS: SystemDef[] = [
  { id: "supply-air",     label: "Supply Air",           icon: "\u2191", color: "#38bdf8", categories: /^IFC(DuctSegment|DuctFitting|AirTerminal|AirTerminalBox)/i },
  { id: "return-air",     label: "Return Air",           icon: "\u21BB", color: "#22d3ee", categories: /^IFC(DuctSegment|DuctFitting|AirTerminal)/i },
  { id: "exhaust-air",    label: "Exhaust Air",          icon: "\u2193", color: "#06b6d4", categories: /^IFC(DuctSegment|DuctFitting)/i },
  { id: "cold-water",     label: "Domestic Cold Water",  icon: "\u25CF", color: "#3b82f6", categories: /^IFC(PipeSegment|PipeFitting|Valve|Pump)/i },
  { id: "hot-water",      label: "Domestic Hot Water",   icon: "\u25CF", color: "#ef4444", categories: /^IFC(PipeSegment|PipeFitting|Valve)/i },
  { id: "sanitary",       label: "Sanitary / Drainage",  icon: "\u25C6", color: "#22c55e", categories: /^IFC(PipeSegment|PipeFitting|SanitaryTerminal)/i },
  { id: "power",          label: "Power",                icon: "\u26A1", color: "#f59e0b", categories: /^IFC(CableCarrier|CableSegment|Electric)/i },
  { id: "lighting",       label: "Lighting",             icon: "\u2600", color: "#fbbf24", categories: /^IFC(LightFixture|LightingDevice)/i },
  { id: "fire",           label: "Fire Protection",      icon: "\u{1F525}", color: "#dc2626", categories: /^IFC(FireSuppression|Sprinkler)/i },
  { id: "controls",       label: "Controls & Sensors",   icon: "\u25CB", color: "#a855f7", categories: /^IFC(Sensor|Controller|Alarm|Actuator)/i },
];

let panel: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let listHost: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let visible = false;

export function setupSystemBrowser(): void {
  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = "obs-system-browser";
  panel.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;left:16px;top:200px;width:280px;max-height:60vh;z-index:33;" +
    "display:none;flex-direction:column;background:#1a1d27;color:#e8eaf0;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.5);font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden";
  panel.onmousedown = (e) => e.stopPropagation();

  const header = document.createElement("div");
  header.style.cssText =
    "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:9px 10px;" +
    "border-bottom:1px solid #2a2e3a;background:#12141b;flex-shrink:0";
  header.innerHTML = "<div style='font-weight:700;flex:1'>\u2637 System Browser</div>";

  const refreshBtn = document.createElement("button");
  refreshBtn.textContent = "\u21BB";
  refreshBtn.title = "Refresh";
  refreshBtn.style.cssText =
    "padding:2px 8px;background:transparent;color:#94a3b8;" +
    "border:1px solid #2a2e3a;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px";
  refreshBtn.onclick = () => renderTree();
  header.appendChild(refreshBtn);

  listHost = document.createElement("div");
  listHost.style.cssText = "flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:4px";

  panel.append(header, listHost);
  ctx.rightHost.appendChild(panel);

  (ctx.features as any).systemBrowser = {
    show: () => { visible = true; if (panel) panel.style.display = "flex"; renderTree(); },
    hide: () => { visible = false; if (panel) panel.style.display = "none"; },
    toggle: () => { visible ? (ctx.features as any).systemBrowser.hide() : (ctx.features as any).systemBrowser.show(); },
    isVisible: () => visible,
    refresh: renderTree,
  };
}

async function renderTree(): Promise<void> {
  if (!listHost) return;
  listHost.innerHTML = "<div style='padding:16px;text-align:center;color:#6b7280'>Scanning models\u2026</div>";

  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const s of SYSTEMS) counts.set(s.id, 0);

  for (const [, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    try {
      const cats = await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
      for (const [cat, ids] of Object.entries(cats ?? {})) {
        const upper = String(cat).toUpperCase();
        for (const sys of SYSTEMS) {
          if (sys.categories.test(upper)) {
            counts.set(sys.id, (counts.get(sys.id) ?? 0) + ((ids as number[]) ?? []).length);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
  }

  // Authored elements
  for (const el of getElements()) {
    const type = el.type;
    if (type === "duct" || type === "fitting") counts.set("supply-air", (counts.get("supply-air") ?? 0) + 1);
    else if (type === "pipe") counts.set("cold-water", (counts.get("cold-water") ?? 0) + 1);
    else if (type === "cable-tray" || type === "conduit") counts.set("power", (counts.get("power") ?? 0) + 1);
    else if (type === "equipment") counts.set("controls", (counts.get("controls") ?? 0) + 1);
  }

  listHost.innerHTML = "";
  let totalSystems = 0;
  let totalElements = 0;

  for (const sys of SYSTEMS) {
    const count = counts.get(sys.id) ?? 0;
    if (count === 0) continue;
    totalSystems++;
    totalElements += count;

    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText =
      "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:5px;" +
      "cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:2px;background:#0e1017;border:1px solid #2a2e3a";
    row.onmouseenter = () => { row.style.background = "#181a23"; };
    row.onmouseleave = () => { row.style.background = "#0e1017"; };

    const dot = document.createElement("span");
    dot.textContent = "\u25CF";
    dot.style.cssText = "color:" + sys.color + ";font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0";

    const icon = document.createElement("span");
    icon.textContent = sys.icon;
    icon.style.cssText = "font-size:12px;opacity:.7;flex-shrink:0";

    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.textContent = sys.label;
    label.style.cssText = "flex:1;font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px";

    const badge = document.createElement("span");
    badge.textContent = String(count);
    badge.style.cssText =
      "font:600 10px ui-monospace,monospace;color:#94a3b8;background:#1a1d27;" +
      "padding:2px 7px;border-radius:10px;flex-shrink:0";

    row.append(dot, icon, label, badge);
    row.onclick = () => void selectSystem(sys);

    listHost.appendChild(row);
  }

  if (!totalSystems) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.style.cssText = "padding:20px;text-align:center;color:#6b7280;font:11.5px system-ui;line-height:1.6";
    empty.innerHTML = "No MEP systems detected.<br>Load an IFC with ducts, pipes, or cable trays.";
    listHost.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }

  const summary = document.createElement("div");
  summary.style.cssText =
    "padding:8px 10px;border-top:1px solid #2a2e3a;font:10.5px ui-monospace,monospace;" +
    "color:#6b7280;text-align:center";
  summary.textContent = totalSystems + " system(s) \u00B7 " + totalElements + " element(s)";
  listHost.appendChild(summary);
}

async function selectSystem(sys: SystemDef): Promise<void> {
  const map: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};
  for (const [modelId, model] of ctx.fragments.list) {
    try {
      const cats = await (model as any).getItemsOfCategories([/.+/]);
      for (const [cat, ids] of Object.entries(cats ?? {})) {
        if (sys.categories.test(String(cat).toUpperCase())) {
          if (!map[modelId]) map[modelId] = new Set();
          for (const id of (ids as number[]) ?? []) map[modelId].add(id);
        }
      }
    } catch { /* */ }
  }
  if (!Object.keys(map).length) {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
      detail: { message: "No federated elements in " + sys.label, kind: "warn" },
    }));
    return;
  }
  selection.replace(map);
  await selection.applyToHighlighter();
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-toast", {
    detail: { message: "Selected " + sys.label, kind: "success" },
  }));
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Temporary Dimensions - Revit-style live dimensions during edit/place.
 *
 * Shows pixel-space dimension strings between the active element's key
 * points and nearby references (walls, levels, ref planes) while a tool
 * is active or a single element is selected.
 */

import * as THREE from "three";
import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { units } from "../core/units";

type Any = Record<string, any>;

interface TempDim {
  id: string;
  a: THREE.Vector3;
  b: THREE.Vector3;
  label: string;
}

let host: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let dims: TempDim[] = [];
let raf = 0;
let enabled = true;

function getCamera(): THREE.Camera | null {
  return (
    (ctx as Any).world?.camera?.three ??
    (ctx as Any).world?.camera ??
    null
  );
}

function getRenderer(): THREE.WebGLRenderer | null {
  return (
    (ctx as Any).world?.renderer?.three ??
    (ctx as Any).world?.renderer ??
    null
  );
}

function formatLength(metres: number): string {
  try {
    const u = units as any;
    if (u && typeof u.format === "function") return String(u.format("length", metres));
    if (u && typeof u.formatLength === "function") return String(u.formatLength(metres));
  } catch { /* */ }
  if (Math.abs(metres) >= 1) return metres.toFixed(2) + " m";
  return (metres * 1000).toFixed(0) + " mm";
}

function project(v: THREE.Vector3): { x: number; y: number; visible: boolean } | null {
  const cam = getCamera();
  const renderer = getRenderer();
  if (!cam || !renderer) return null;
  const canvas = renderer.domElement;
  const w = canvas.clientWidth;
  const h = canvas.clientHeight;
  const ndc = v.clone().project(cam);
  if (ndc.z > 1 || ndc.z < -1) return { x: 0, y: 0, visible: false };
  return {
    x: (ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * w,
    y: (-ndc.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * h,
    visible: true,
  };
}

function ensureHost(): HTMLDivElement {
  if (host) return host;
  host = document.createElement("div");
  host.id = "obs-temp-dims";
  host.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:70;overflow:hidden;";
  const viewport =
    (ctx as Any).rightHost ??
    document.getElementById("viewport") ??
    document.querySelector(".obs-viewport") ??
    document.body;
  if (getComputedStyle(viewport).position === "static") {
    (viewport as HTMLElement).style.position = "relative";
  }
  viewport.appendChild(host);
  return host;
}

function render(): void {
  const h = ensureHost();
  h.innerHTML = "";
  if (!enabled || !dims.length) return;

  for (const d of dims) {
    const pa = project(d.a);
    const pb = project(d.b);
    if (!pa || !pb || !pa.visible || !pb.visible) continue;

    const svg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg");
    svg.setAttribute(
      "style",
      "position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;",
    );
    svg.innerHTML = `
      <line x1="${pa.x}" y1="${pa.y}" x2="${pb.x}" y2="${pb.y}"
        stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="1.25" stroke-dasharray="4 3" opacity="0.9"/>
      <circle cx="${pa.x}" cy="${pa.y}" r="3" fill="#38bdf8"/>
      <circle cx="${pb.x}" cy="${pb.y}" r="3" fill="#38bdf8"/>
    `;
    h.appendChild(svg);

    const mx = (pa.x + pb.x) / 2;
    const my = (pa.y + pb.y) / 2;
    const label = document.createElement("div");
    label.style.cssText =
      "position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);" +
      "background:rgba(15,17,23,.92);border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.45);" +
      "color:#e0f2fe;font:600 10px/1.2 var(--font-mono,monospace);" +
      "padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;";
    label.style.left = `${mx}px`;
    label.style.top = `${my - 12}px`;
    label.textContent = d.label;
    h.appendChild(label);
  }
}

function tick(): void {
  render();
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

/** Set temporary dimensions from world-space point pairs. */
export function setTempDimensions(
  pairs: Array<{ a: THREE.Vector3; b: THREE.Vector3; label?: string }>,
): void {
  dims = pairs.map((p, i) => {
    const len = p.a.distanceTo(p.b);
    return {
      id: `td-${i}`,
      a: p.a.clone(),
      b: p.b.clone(),
      label: p.label ?? formatLength(len),
    };
  });
}

/** Convenience: dimension a single segment. */
export function setTempSegment(
  a: THREE.Vector3,
  b: THREE.Vector3,
  label?: string,
): void {
  setTempDimensions([{ a, b, label }]);
}

/** Clear all temporary dimensions. */
export function clearTempDimensions(): void {
  dims = [];
  if (host) host.innerHTML = "";
}

/**
 * Auto-generate dims for an authored element against its host / nearby walls.
 */
export function autoDimsForElement(el: Any): void {
  const p = el?.params;
  if (!p) {
    clearTempDimensions();
    return;
  }
  const pairs: Array<{ a: THREE.Vector3; b: THREE.Vector3 }> = [];
  const elev = Number(p.elevation ?? 0);

  if (p.start && p.end) {
    const a = new THREE.Vector3(p.start.x, elev, p.start.z ?? p.start.y ?? 0);
    const b = new THREE.Vector3(p.end.x, elev, p.end.z ?? p.end.y ?? 0);
    pairs.push({ a, b });
    // Height
    pairs.push({
      a: b.clone(),
      b: b.clone().setY(elev + Number(p.height ?? 0)),
    });
  } else if (p.point) {
    const c = new THREE.Vector3(p.point.x, elev, p.point.z ?? p.point.y ?? 0);
    const w = Number(p.width ?? 0.3) / 2;
    pairs.push({
      a: c.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(-w, 0, 0)),
      b: c.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(w, 0, 0)),
    });
    pairs.push({
      a: c.clone(),
      b: c.clone().setY(elev + Number(p.height ?? 0)),
    });
  }

  // Hosted offset
  if (typeof p.offsetAlongHost === "number" && p.start) {
    const a = new THREE.Vector3(p.start.x, elev, p.start.z ?? 0);
    const b = a.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(p.offsetAlongHost, 0, 0));
    pairs.push({ a, b });
  }

  setTempDimensions(pairs);
}

export function setTempDimsEnabled(on: boolean): void {
  enabled = on;
  if (!on) clearTempDimensions();
}

export function setupTempDimensions(): void {
  ensureHost();
  if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);

  (ctx.features as any).tempDimensions = {
    set: setTempDimensions,
    setSegment: setTempSegment,
    clear: clearTempDimensions,
    autoForElement: autoDimsForElement,
    setEnabled: setTempDimsEnabled,
  };
  (window as any).__obsTempDims = (ctx.features as any).tempDimensions;
  console.log("[temp-dimensions] ready");
}
```

```ts
/**
 * 4D Timeline panel — construction simulation UI.
 * Competitive feature vs Navisworks TimeLiner / Synchro.
 */
import {
  getTimelineState,
  listPhases,
  addPhase,
  updatePhase,
  removePhase,
  assignSelectionToPhase,
  clearPhaseElements,
  setProgress,
  setPlaying,
  setSpeed,
  resetTimeline,
  createDefaultPhases,
  exportTimelineJson,
  importTimelineJson,
  onTimelineChange,
} from "../modules/timeline/timeline";
import { selection } from "./selection";

let panel: HTMLElement | null = null;
let visible = false;

function esc(s: string) {
  return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) =>
    ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" } as any)[c]);
}

function download(name: string, text: string) {
  const blob = new Blob([text], { type: "application/json" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 4000);
}

function render() {
  if (!panel) return;
  const st = getTimelineState();
  const phases = listPhases();

  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="obs-panel-header">
      <span>4D Construction Simulation</span>
      <button type="button" class="obs-icon-btn" data-act="close" title="Close">×</button>
    </div>
    <div class="obs-panel-body obs-timeline">
      <div class="obs-timeline__hint">
        Assign selected elements to phases, then play the timeline.
        Competes with Navisworks TimeLiner for open federated models.
      </div>

      <div class="obs-timeline__transport">
        <button type="button" data-act="reset" title="Reset">⏮</button>
        <button type="button" data-act="play" title="${st.playing ? "Pause" : "Play"}">
          ${st.playing ? "⏸" : "▶"}
        </button>
        <input type="range" min="0" max="1000" value="${Math.round(st.progress * 1000)}"
               data-act="scrub" class="obs-timeline__scrub" />
        <span class="obs-timeline__pct">${Math.round(st.progress * 100)}%</span>
      </div>

      <div class="obs-timeline__speed">
        <label>Speed</label>
        <input type="range" min="1" max="100" value="${Math.round(st.speed * 50)}" data-act="speed" />
      </div>

      <div class="obs-timeline__actions">
        <button type="button" data-act="add">+ Phase</button>
        <button type="button" data-act="defaults">Default phases</button>
        <button type="button" data-act="export">Export</button>
        <button type="button" data-act="import">Import</button>
      </div>

      <div class="obs-timeline__list">
        ${phases.length === 0
          ? `<div class="obs-timeline__empty">No phases yet. Add phases or load defaults.</div>`
          : phases.map((p) => `
            <div class="obs-timeline__phase" data-id="${esc(p.id)}">
              <div class="obs-timeline__phase-head">
                <span class="obs-timeline__swatch" style="background:${esc(p.color)}"></span>
                <input class="obs-timeline__name" value="${esc(p.name)}" data-act="rename" data-id="${esc(p.id)}" />
                <span class="obs-timeline__count">${p.elementIds.length}</span>
                <button type="button" data-act="assign" data-id="${esc(p.id)}" title="Assign selection">＋</button>
                <button type="button" data-act="clear" data-id="${esc(p.id)}" title="Clear elements">⌀</button>
                <button type="button" data-act="del" data-id="${esc(p.id)}" title="Delete">×</button>
              </div>
              <div class="obs-timeline__phase-meta">
                <label>Before
                  <select data-act="before" data-id="${esc(p.id)}">
                    <option value="hidden" ${p.beforeMode === "hidden" ? "selected" : ""}>Hidden</option>
                    <option value="ghost" ${p.beforeMode === "ghost" ? "selected" : ""}>Ghost</option>
                    <option value="visible" ${p.beforeMode === "visible" ? "selected" : ""}>Visible</option>
                  </select>
                </label>
                <label>After
                  <select data-act="after" data-id="${esc(p.id)}">
                    <option value="hidden" ${p.afterMode === "hidden" ? "selected" : ""}>Hidden</option>
                    <option value="ghost" ${p.afterMode === "ghost" ? "selected" : ""}>Ghost</option>
                    <option value="visible" ${p.afterMode === "visible" ? "selected" : ""}>Visible</option>
                    <option value="complete" ${p.afterMode === "complete" ? "selected" : ""}>Complete</option>
                  </select>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>`).join("")}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  // Wire events
  panel.querySelectorAll("[data-act]").forEach((el) => {
    const act = (el as HTMLElement).dataset.act!;
    const id = (el as HTMLElement).dataset.id;

    if (el.tagName === "INPUT" && (el as HTMLInputElement).type === "range") {
      el.addEventListener("input", () => {
        if (act === "scrub") setProgress(Number((el as HTMLInputElement).value) / 1000);
        if (act === "speed") setSpeed(Number((el as HTMLInputElement).value) / 50);
      });
      return;
    }

    if (el.tagName === "SELECT") {
      el.addEventListener("change", () => {
        const val = (el as HTMLSelectElement).value as any;
        if (act === "before" && id) updatePhase(id, { beforeMode: val });
        if (act === "after" && id) updatePhase(id, { afterMode: val });
      });
      return;
    }

    if (el.tagName === "INPUT" && act === "rename" && id) {
      el.addEventListener("change", () => {
        updatePhase(id, { name: (el as HTMLInputElement).value.trim() || "Phase" });
      });
      return;
    }

    el.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (act === "close") { setVisible(false); return; }
      if (act === "play") setPlaying(!getTimelineState().playing);
      if (act === "reset") resetTimeline();
      if (act === "add") addPhase();
      if (act === "defaults") createDefaultPhases();
      if (act === "export") download("timeline-4d.json", exportTimelineJson());
      if (act === "import") {
        const input = document.createElement("input");
        input.type = "file";
        input.accept = ".json";
        input.onchange = async () => {
          const f = input.files?.[0];
          if (!f) return;
          importTimelineJson(await f.text());
        };
        input.click();
      }
      if (act === "assign" && id) {
        const snap = selection.snapshot?.() ?? {};
        const ids: string[] = [];
        for (const [modelId, set] of Object.entries(snap)) {
          for (const localId of set as Set<number>) {
            ids.push(`${modelId}:${localId}`);
          }
        }
        if (!ids.length) {
          alert("Select elements in the model first, then click Assign.");
          return;
        }
        assignSelectionToPhase(id, ids);
      }
      if (act === "clear" && id) clearPhaseElements(id);
      if (act === "del" && id) removePhase(id);
    });
  });
}

function ensurePanel() {
  if (panel) return panel;
  panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.className = "obs-side-panel obs-timeline-panel";
  panel.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;top:48px;right:12px;width:340px;max-height:calc(100vh - 80px);" +
    "background:#1e2430;color:#e2e8f0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:10px;" +
    "box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45);z-index:8000;display:none;overflow:auto;" +
    "font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;";
  document.body.appendChild(panel);

  // Minimal styles
  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.textContent = `
    .obs-timeline__hint { font-size:11px; color:#94a3b8; margin-bottom:10px; }
    .obs-timeline__transport { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-bottom:8px; }
    .obs-timeline__scrub { flex:1; }
    .obs-timeline__pct { width:36px; text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
    .obs-timeline__speed { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:10px; font-size:12px; }
    .obs-timeline__speed input { flex:1; }
    .obs-timeline__actions { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin-bottom:12px; }
    .obs-timeline__actions button, .obs-timeline__transport button {
      background:#334155; border:1px solid #475569; color:#e2e8f0; border-radius:6px;
      padding:4px 8px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px;
    }
    .obs-timeline__actions button:hover, .obs-timeline__transport button:hover { background:#475569; }
    .obs-timeline__phase {
      background:#0f172a; border:1px solid #334155; border-radius:8px; padding:8px; margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .obs-timeline__phase-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
    .obs-timeline__swatch { width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:3px; flex-shrink:0; }
    .obs-timeline__name {
      flex:1; background:transparent; border:none; color:#f1f5f9; font:inherit; min-width:0;
    }
    .obs-timeline__count { font-size:11px; color:#64748b; }
    .obs-timeline__phase-meta { display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:6px; font-size:11px; color:#94a3b8; }
    .obs-timeline__phase-meta select {
      background:#1e293b; border:1px solid #334155; color:#e2e8f0; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px;
    }
    .obs-timeline__empty { color:#64748b; font-size:12px; padding:12px 0; text-align:center; }
    .obs-panel-header {
      display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
      padding:10px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid #334155; font-weight:600;
    }
    .obs-panel-body { padding:12px; }
    .obs-icon-btn { background:none; border:none; color:#94a3b8; font-size:18px; cursor:pointer; }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(style);

  onTimelineChange(render);
  return panel;
}

export function setVisible(on: boolean) {
  visible = on;
  const el = ensurePanel();
  el.style.display = on ? "block" : "none";
  if (on) render();
}

export function toggleTimelinePanel() {
  setVisible(!visible);
}

export function isTimelinePanelVisible() {
  return visible;
}

export function setupTimelinePanel() {
  ensurePanel();
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Registers all built-in UI items with the ui-registry.
 *
 * Called once during boot, after every feature has been set up so the
 * features object is populated.
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { registerUiItem, loadStoredVisibility, persistItem } from "../modules/ui-registry";

function getFeatures(): any { return ctx.features as any; }

export function registerUiItems(): void {
  const F = getFeatures();
  const stored = loadStoredVisibility();

  const safeToggle = (id: string, toggle: () => void) => {
    try { toggle(); } catch { /* */ }
    persistItem(id, true);
  };

  // â”€â”€ ViewCube â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  registerUiItem({
    id: "viewcube",

    group: "panels",

    isVisible: () => {
      try { return !!(F.viewcube && F.viewcube.host && F.viewcube.host.style.display !== "none"); }

      try {

        if (!h) return;
        h.style.display = h.style.display === "none" ? "block" : "none";

  registerUiItem({

  registerUiItem({

  // ---- Advanced / Critical Gaps toolbar (open / close) -----------------
  // The [D] [H] [S] [A] [L] [C] [R] [P] toolbar. Starts hidden.

        (window as any).__obsCriticalGapsUI?.toggle?.();
      } catch {
        /* */
      }
    },
  });

  registerUiItem({
    id: "status-bar",
    label: "Status Bar",
    group: "bars",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => {
      const el = document.querySelector(".bb-status") as HTMLElement | null;
      return !!el && el.style.display !== "none";
    },
    toggle: () => {
      const el = document.querySelector(".bb-status") as HTMLElement | null;
      if (!el) return;
      el.style.display = el.style.display === "none" ? "" : "none";

  // â”€â”€ Status Bar Â· Worksets â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

  registerUiItem({

    group: "bars",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => {
      try { return !!F.designOptionsBadge?.isVisible?.(); } catch { return false; }
    },
    toggle: () => {
      try {
        if (F.designOptionsBadge?.toggle) F.designOptionsBadge.toggle();
        else toggleStatusBadge("design-options");
      } catch { toggleStatusBadge("design-options"); }
    },
  });

  void safeToggle;
  void stored;
}

/** Adds a small label to the bottom status bar for a named feature. */
function toggleStatusBadge(kind: "worksets" | "design-options"): void {
  const bar = document.querySelector(".bb-status") as HTMLElement | null;
  if (!bar) return;
  const id = "obs-status-" + kind;
  const existing = document.getElementById(id);
  if (existing) { existing.remove(); return; }

  const label = document.createElement("span");
  label.id = id;
  label.className = "bb-status__seg";
  label.style.cssText = "padding:0 6px;font-size:10.5px;color:#94a3b8;opacity:.9";
  label.textContent = kind === "worksets" ? "Worksets: 1" : "Design Options: Main";
  bar.appendChild(label);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * UI Items Register - GAP CLOSURE PATCH
 *
 * Replaces the four `available: false` stubs with live toggles bound to
 * the real feature modules that already ship in the codebase:
 *   - navigation-bar.ts
 *   - system-browser.ts
 *   - mep-fabrication.ts
 *   - pid-modeler.ts
 *
 * Apply by merging these registerUiItem() calls into registerUiItems()
 * (or call registerClosedGapUiItems() after registerUiItems()).
 */

import { ctx } from "../core/context";
import { registerUiItem, persistItem } from "../modules/ui-registry";

function F(): any {
  return (ctx.features as any) ?? {};
}

function safeToggle(id: string, fn: () => void): void {
  try {
    fn();
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[ui-items]", id, e);
  }
  persistItem(id, true);
}

/**
 * Call once after feature modules have been set up.
 * Overwrites / re-registers the previously unavailable items as available.
 */
export function registerClosedGapUiItems(): void {
  // -- Navigation Bar ------------------------------------------------
  registerUiItem({
    id: "nav-bar",
    label: "Navigation Bar",
    group: "panels",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => {
      try {
        return !!F().navigationBar?.isVisible?.();
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    },
    toggle: () =>
      safeToggle("nav-bar", () => {
        const nav = F().navigationBar;
        if (nav?.toggle) nav.toggle();
        else if (nav?.setVisible) nav.setVisible(!nav.isVisible?.());
        else {
          // Lazy import fallback
          void import("./navigation-bar").then((m: any) => {
            m.setupNavigationBar?.();
            m.toggleNavigationBar?.();
          });
        }
      }),
  });

  // -- MEP System Browser --------------------------------------------
  registerUiItem({
    id: "system-browser",
    label: "System Browser",
    group: "panels",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => {
      try {
        return !!F().systemBrowser?.isVisible?.();
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    },
    toggle: () =>
      safeToggle("system-browser", () => {
        const sb = F().systemBrowser;
        if (sb?.toggle) sb.toggle();
        else {
          void import("./system-browser").then((m: any) => {
            m.setupSystemBrowser?.();
            m.toggleSystemBrowser?.();
          });
        }
      }),
  });

  // -- MEP Fabrication Parts -----------------------------------------
  registerUiItem({
    id: "mep-fabrication",
    label: "MEP Fabrication Parts",
    group: "panels",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => {
      try {
        return !!F().mepFabrication?.isVisible?.();
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    },
    toggle: () =>
      safeToggle("mep-fabrication", () => {
        const fab = F().mepFabrication;
        if (fab?.toggle) fab.toggle();
        else {
          void import("./mep-fabrication").then((m: any) => {
            m.setupMepFabrication?.();
            m.toggleMepFabrication?.();
          });
        }
      }),
  });

  // -- P&ID Modeler --------------------------------------------------
  registerUiItem({
    id: "pid-modeler",
    label: "P&ID Modeler",
    group: "panels",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => {
      try {
        return !!F().pidModeler?.isVisible?.();
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    },
    toggle: () =>
      safeToggle("pid-modeler", () => {
        const pid = F().pidModeler;
        if (pid?.toggle) pid.toggle();
        else {
          void import("./pid-modeler").then((m: any) => {
            m.setupPidModeler?.();
            m.togglePidModeler?.();
          });
        }
      }),
  });

  // -- New gap-closure panels ----------------------------------------
  registerUiItem({
    id: "rooms-panel",
    label: "Rooms & Areas",
    group: "panels",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => !!(window as any).__obsRooms,
    toggle: () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-open-panel", { detail: { id: "rooms" } }));
    },
  });

  registerUiItem({
    id: "phases-panel",
    label: "Phasing",
    group: "panels",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => !!(window as any).__obsPhases,
    toggle: () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-open-panel", { detail: { id: "phases" } }));
    },
  });

  registerUiItem({
    id: "design-options-panel",
    label: "Design Options",
    group: "panels",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => !!(window as any).__obsDesignOptions,
    toggle: () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-open-panel", { detail: { id: "design-options" } }));
    },
  });

  registerUiItem({
    id: "ref-planes-panel",
    label: "Reference Planes",
    group: "panels",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => !!(window as any).__obsRefPlanes,
    toggle: () => {
      const rp = (window as any).__obsRefPlanes;
      rp?.showOverlay?.(true);
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-open-panel", { detail: { id: "ref-planes" } }));
    },
  });

  
  registerUiItem({
    id: "groups-panel",
    label: "Model Groups",
    group: "panels",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => !!(window as any).__obsGroups,
    toggle: () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-open-panel", { detail: { id: "groups" } }));
    },
  });

  registerUiItem({
    id: "copy-monitor-panel",
    label: "Copy / Monitor",
    group: "panels",
    available: true,
    isVisible: () => !!(window as any).__obsCopyMonitor,
    toggle: () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("obs-open-panel", { detail: { id: "copy-monitor" } }));
    },
  });

console.log("[ui-items-register-patch] closed-gap UI items registered");
}
```
